<Title>New Cooking Show</>
- We’ve added a new cooking show hosted by Chef Sisca, airing every Friday on your in-game TV.
- By watching, you’ll learn and unlock new cooking recipes, which can then be prepared in your kitchen at home.

<Title>Goddess Daily Blessing</>
- Introducing the Goddess Daily Blessing, a feature that grants players one daily buff.  
- Buffs can improve your chances of catching insects, fish, or scavenging rare items, among other benefits.  
- To unlock this feature, complete four offerings. Once unlocked, visit the nearest fast travel point to access the Goddess Blessing option (the second choice). This feature resets daily, so remember to visit the fast travel point each day to receive your blessing!

<Title>Mystery Rocks</>
Mystery Rocks are a new type of debris found in the Starlet Mines and the Cave of Memories.  
Breaking these rocks may yield ores, ore veins, seeds, rare fish, rare insects, or occasionally unleash monsters!  
The number of Mystery Rocks that spawn per floor depends on the number of offerings made to the Goddess. For every two offerings, more Mystery Rocks will appear.

<Title>Fish Nets</>
We’ve added Bamboo Nets, a new item for passively catching fish.

- Unlock the Small Bamboo Net at Fishing Level 3 and the Large Bamboo Net at Fishing Level 7.    
- To use, place the net at the edge of a water body. It will automatically catch fish daily.
- Small Bamboo Nets hold 1 fish, while Large Bamboo Nets hold up to 3 of the same type.
- Add bait to increase your chances of catching fish! Unused bait will remain intact if no fish are caught. Note: Bamboo Nets cannot catch legendary fish.
   
<Title> Additional General Store Quests</>
Help Sam revive the empty sections of the general store by completing various requests.  
Start by triggering the Local Produce quest. Sam will provide more details at the store. Once completed, Sam will continue requesting your assistance to stock his store with goods, improving life for the townsfolk.

<Title> Hangout Hours for Attractions</>
We’ve adjusted the available times for certain attractions:
- Observatory: Open only at night.
- Hot Air Balloon: Open only during the day.
- Afternoon Tea: Available from 12 PM to 5 PM.

<Title> UI Improvements</>
- Updated Decor Mode UI to improve switching between inventory and non-inventory modes. 
- Added an Inventory Full message when buying decor in furniture shops with a full inventory.
- Added permanent interactable objects in the Lake Temple to show progress and rewards.
- Added one-time notifications when new areas unlock at the start of a new day.
- Added VFX and SFX for giving NPCs items they love.
- Improved the crafting menu order to display items from the same category together.
- Added VFX for interactables at Cave of Memories checkpoints.
- Added icons to indicate if a new heart event cutscene is available.
- Updated the NPC Relationship Menu with heart event locations and hangout locations.
- Added Heart Event tracking information to the Player’s HUD.
- Added income tracking to the day-end UI.
- Updated the day-end UI to show heart progress and allow day changes.
    
<Title> Dialogue Improvements:</>
- Added new dynamic dialogue for Aaliyah about her trip to space.
- Introduced a cooldown for all dialogues (except marriage dialogue) of 2 in-game hours.
- Added emotes for spouses after kissing or hugging.
- Added dynamic dialogue for when your spouse randomly gives a dish to the player.
- Added dynamic dialogue for the day after a meteor or satellite has fallen.
- Added dynamic dialogue where your spouse mentions the wedding anniversary every year on the day of marriage.
- Added dynamic dialogue for when Eva gives the player cookies at random.

<Title> Lowered Requirements for Town Rank A</>
We’ve reduced the requirements for reaching Town Rank A to make it more accessible:
- Town Rank B requirements reduced by 6%.    
- Town Rank A requirements reduced by 10%.
    
These adjustments will help players achieve higher ranks faster and enjoy community projects sooner.

<Title> Balancing Changes:</>
- Players now unlock the ocean farm sooner. Three days after completing the Roots Above quest, you’ll receive a letter from King Krakatoa, summoning you to Naga Castle.  
- Using the Milk Pail, Shears, and Petting Animals now costs 3 stamina.
- Hangouts are now available at Heart Level 2 (previously Heart Level 3).
- Removed stamina cost for tools used without hitting a target.
    
<Title> Additional Features:</>
- Updated the quest to unlock the underwater farm. The quest now triggers after the Coral Tree is healed.  
- Improved save stability to prepare for Multiplayer.
- Added the ability to retrieve tools from the player’s bed.
- Added a new cutscene after completing the Spooky Festival Treasure Hunt mini-game.

Best Regards,
Stairway Team

Here are the contents for our "Merfolk & Fall Update Changelist":

<Title>NPCs:</>
- Heart level 8 dialogue for all NPC
- Dateable NPC and some townies now have new outfit for the entire Fall Season. 
- Summer Outfit Shopkeepers
- Adding a secret new NPC for the harvest festival.

<Title>Spooky Festivals:</>
- Spooky festival 
- Ogoh-ogoh Show
- Bonk the skeleton mini-game 
- Glow in the dark ring toss mini-game 
- Apple Bobbing mini-game

<Title>Merfolk Kingdom:</>
- You can now access merfolk kingdom.
- Huge update to the Merfolk Storyline. 
- Diving 30m, 40m, and 50m level is now open. 
- Underwater Caves are now open. 
- Diving Fast Travel
- New Ocean Critters

<Title>Automation:</>
- Adding Auto Ranching Equipments. 
- Auto Chests allow you to create the ultimate farm automation. 

<Title>Adoptable Pet:</>
- Petshop is now open. 
- You an adopt your very own pet after you satisfy certain requirements. 

<Title>New Contents:</>
- Story quest part 2
- Sturdy Computer
- Shed
- Indoor & Outdoor Mermaid Decor
- Deep forest accessible
- Excavation Soil Feature
- Architect Desk
- Animal Mood System
- New Weapon Sets
- Slice of Life Cutscenes
- Founder Statues
- New Ocean Critters
396E65614AED8E483367A4AF2C71D94F:
Here are the contents for our "Summer Content Update":

<Title>Animal Festival:</>

- Join the Animal Festival on Summer 12, in the town center.
- Rodeo Challenge: Test your skills on a mechanical bull!
- Chicken Stare-Off: See whose chicken has the strongest stare.
- Cow Race: Find out the fastest cow in town!

<Title>NPCs:</>

- Dateable and some townies switch to Summer outfits during the season.
- In-game models and portraits change too!
- Enjoy additional dialogues and new heart events.

<Title>New Content:</>

- Fire Gate: now open for exploration!
- Fire Gate: discover osmium ores, gems, and new monsters.
- BOS Hideout: unlock through story progression.
- BOS Hideout: shop for rings and 4 new weapon types.
- Combat Rework: unique standard and special attacks for each weapon.
- Giants Storyline: free the fire giant and embark on a special quest.
- Errands: dynamic quests in Town and BOS Hideout.
- Traps: craft to passively catch insects and ocean critters.
- Scents: consumables to reduce detection by insects, critters, and monsters.
- Fish Pond & Insect House: available at the Carpenter for breeding.
- Ranching: Pig and Quail now available at Jack's Ranch.
- Sprinkler Attachments: auto seed/fertilizer can be developed at Ling's Lab starting Summer 8.
- Ocean Critters: new species to catch while diving.
- Mastery: level cap raised to 9!
- Town Rank: increased to Rank C.
- Festivals: shops added at various festivals.

<Title>Improvements/Bug Fixes:</>

- Reduced memory usage for smoother gameplay.
- Game balance optimizations.
- Over 175 community-reported bugs fixed!

Hi Farmers,

Here are all the new changes for our 1.1 Finale: Land and Sea update:

<Title>Hangout System:</>
- You can now ask your favorite dateable NPC to hangout with them at a place you choose to get some relationship points.
- More Hangout locations become available as you progress through the game.
- Similar to gifting, Hangouts are limited to twice a week. Hangouts become available starting Heart 3.

<Title>Attractions:</>
- An entirely new town rank category is added sometime after you reach Town Rank A.
- You can access The attractions menu inside the Community Center Town Hall room.
- The attractions will benefit townies and attract visitors.
- Recycling centers can now be upgraded to Treasure Trove Recycler allow you to donate trash for some rewards. 

<Title>Recreation Center:</>
- Recreation center is one of the attractions you can build.
- This building adds a lot of new things for the townies to do. As such, some of their schedules will change once this building (and all the rooms inside it) are built.
- Townies will start hanging out in the Recreation Center. 

<Title>Storyline Completion & New Quests:</>
- Town Rank S 
- Attraction Rank S
- Heritage Rank S
- Museum Rank S (Holographic Dino)
- Song of the Sea (Ocean Rank S)
- Rebuild Merfolk Kingdom
- Starlet Expedition
- Giants Storyline completion (Savannah)

<Title>Tourist System:</>
- As the town rank grows, more tourists will start visiting Coral Island once per week. 
- That includes our tourist Backer NPC. 
- Each tourist Backer NPC will have their unique seasonal outfits.
- You can chat with the tourist Backer NPC.
- The tourists arrive via tourist boat. 
- Tourist boat changes based on the current in-game Town Rank.

<Title>Cutscenes:</>
- Heart cutscenes for all townies. 

<Title>Savannah Area:</>
- Savannah Cave (Cave of Memories).
- Ability to buy two more animals in the savannah:
	- Ostrich
	- Buffalo
- New scavangeable.
- Treasure Bubbles give various reward items. 
- One new mini-game in Savannah.

<Title>Flower Teleport:</>
- New magical teleport to fast travel to new locations around the map. 
- You can fast travel to Savannah using this. 

<Title>New Decor and Clothing:</>
- New Indoor Decor: 142
- New Outdoor Decor: 122
- New Clothing: 62

<Title>Spouse Interactions:</>
- You can now hug and kiss your spouse once daily to get some point in the relationship. 
- Your spouse's relatives will send wedding gifts via mail once you get married. 

<Title>Library Books:</>
- The library now slowly gets populated as you increase town ranks.
- Reading some books offers perks like mastery points and recipe unlock. 

<Title>Merfolk NPC Marriage:</>
- Merfolk Heart Events. 
- Merfolk Wedding cutscenes. 
- New dialogues after marriage for your spouse.

<Title>Underwater Outdoor Decor:</>
- New outdoor underwater decor.

<Title>New Merfolk NPC:</>
- Rysy
- Jannu
- Slamet
- Tahat
- Goolong
- Lawu
- Lanin
- Vihren
- Todi
- Etna

<Title>New dialogues:</>
- New Merfolk NPC Dialogues
- New Dynamic Dialogues
- Merfolk NPC Gift Dialogues

<Title>Underwater Farming:</>
- You can farm underwater.
- 15 different seeds. 
- You can mix your land seeds with sea creatures to produce ocean underwater seeds. 

<Title>Underwater Ranch:</>
- You can ranch the following animals: 
	- Shellcluck producing Pearls.
	- InkHog producing Deepvoid Ink.
	- Carapoultry producing Cara Egg.
	- Seashroud producing Seashroud Algae.
	- Mermoo producing Mermoo Milk. 

<Title>Underwater Stores:</>
- Underwater General Store
- Underwater Ranch Store
- Underwater Clothing Store
- Underwater Furniture Store

<Title>New Errands:</>
- Special Errands.
- Underwater Errand.

<Title>Shed Skins:</>
- Items that allow you to change the look of your Shed can be obtained from Treasure Trove Recycler.
- To change the Shed's look, you must go through the Carpenters. Dinda and Joko will make the 
change for you.

<Title>Ranch Animal Dino Skins: </>
- Completing specific collections rewards you with items to change your farm animals into Dinos. 
- It also works with underwater farm animals.
- The dino skin is removable. 
- You can buy more dino skins in Concerned Monkey shops once unlocked.

<Title>Bark Dialogue (speech bubble text): </>
- All spouses now feature bark dialogue. What they say depends on the spawn condition (time/location/etc). For example, a spouse will say "Good morning" to you (in the morning) or "Welcome back home" (in the evening).
- Most townies also have bark dialogue. What they say also depends on the spawn condition (time/location/etc.).

<Title>Additional features:</>
- You can rename your player name, farm, and pet in the town hall. The rename will be applied the next day.
- Your farm can now support up to 3 adopted pets + 1 mythical pet.

Best regards, 
Stairway Team
2914515F4EE33DBF63A1459BF5FA46F6:
Hi Farmers,

We’re thrilled to share all the new changes coming in the v1.2 Multiplayer Update!

<Title>Multiplayer Gameplay</> 
- Co-op Fieldwork: Share resources and daily chores with friends!
- Co-op Farming: Grow crops, expand your farms, and build bigger barns together.
- Co-op Exploration: Dive into the ocean, explore the mines, and uncover secrets of the Cave of Memories as a team!
- Co-op Rivalries: Compete in fun festival mini-games and see who’s the ultimate farmer.
- Co-op Marriage: Ready to take the next step? You can now marry another player!

<Title>Multiplayer System (Co-op) </>
- A new Co-op Menu is available on the Title Screen.
- You can Host a Game or Join a Game.
- When creating a multiplayer game, you can customize gameplay and server settings.
- Once in-game, use the Party Management menu (from the Pause Menu) to manage your group.
- Friends can join using a code or via Invite Friends on your platform.
- Guests will create their characters after joining the room.

As the host, you’ll be able to manage players, view their characters, and more through the Party Management menu.

<Title>Multiplayer Game Settings</>
Host can adjust the settings to suit the group preferences!
Gameplay Settings
- Profit Margin: Adjust how much profit you earn.
- Money Style:
	* Shared Money: One pool of money for all players.
	* Separate Money: Each player has their own funds.
- Debris Health: Change how many hits it takes to clear.

Server Settings:
- Cross-play: Toggle cross-platform play on or off.
- Invite Mode:
	* Code Only.
	* Code + Friend Invite.
- Decor Mode:
	* Owner Only: Only house owners can enter Decor Mode.
	* Host Only: Only the host can enter Decor Mode.
	* Everyone: All players can enter Decor Mode in any home.
- Architect Mode:
	* Everyone.
	* Host Only.

<Title>Multiplayer In-Game Chat and UI</>
- Chat System: Talk with friends during co-op play.
- Player Status Display: Shows player names, stamina, and connection quality.
- Overhead Name Tags: Identify others easily.
- Map UI: Check player locations and names.
- Journal UI: Added Best Daily Earning in the Journal.
- Barn and Coop UI: Ownership details are now displayed on buildings and ranch animals (Multiplayer only). 

<Title>Item Sharing Features</>
- Open the same chest together and share its contents.
- Drop items on the ground for others to pick up as floaties.

<Title>Multiplayer Quests</>
- Shared Quests: Everyone contributes to the same goal.
- Separate Quests: Unique to each player.

<Title>Multiplayer Relationships</>
- Heart levels and relationships with NPCs are tracked per player.
- Everyone can romance NPCs individually, but you may only marry one NPC.

<Title>Marriage Between Players</>
- Players can now marry each other in multiplayer mode.
- To propose, give a Diamond Ring (Multiplayer)--available at the Blacksmith for 5,000 coins.
- Married players can also have children.

<Title>Global Improvements (Single-Player & Multiplayer)</>
- NPCs & Romance:
	* All romanceable NPCs now go up to heart level 15.
	* Level 11	- 15 are unlocked after marriage.
	* New spooky outfits for NPCs and kids during the Spooky Festival.
	* Gym outfits for NPCs who work out.

<Title>Revamped Romance Progression:</>
- New Relationship Progression -- Heart-Locking System:

We’re adding more depth and meaning to your relationships with a Heart-Locking system! Now, advancing your relationship isn’t just about reaching the right heart level—it’s also about creating memorable moments along the way.

Here’s how it works
- Heart Level 1–5: Hangout events unlock between levels 2-4. Watch all of them to reach level 6.
- Heart Level 6–8: Things are getting serious! More hangouts unlock. Complete all events to reach level 9.
- Heart Level 9–10: Love is in the air. Four final heart events appear. Finish all before you can propose with the Diamond Ring.    

- New Relationship UI:
	* The new relationship UI shows which NPCs have new heart events.
	* Click on an NPC to see if any hangout events are available. 

<Title>Post-Marriage Cutscenes:</>
- Heart Level 12 unlocks special post-marriage cutscenes that explore life beyond the wedding.
- There are also new post-marriage hangout events for each romanceable character.

<Title>Hangout System:</>
- New hangout cutscenes have been added for all romanceable characters.

<Title>Festivals:</>
- Added a picnic state to the Tree Planting Festival (after completing all areas).
- Added notifications for Winter Festival start and end.

<Title>Ranching: </>
- Barns and coops can now be upgraded to level 3.

<Title>New Assets: </>
- Winter assets have been revamped. Winter looks even better now!
- Semeru, Denali, Princess Miranjani wedding outfits. 
- Pumpkin, Strawberry, Grass Shed costume. 

<Title>Journal:</>
- Added a new Best Daily Earning record (Multiplayer only).

<Title>Sounds:</>
Added SFX for:
- Unlocking heart tiers.
- Animations in the Town Rank Pause UI.
- Cow Suit jingle.
- Eating Wellness Fruit and Stamina Fruit.

<Title>UI Improvements:</>
- Improved layout for Day End screen.
- Updated design for Relationship Heart Events and Hangout Details checkmarks.
- Added a new design for Best Daily Earning in the Journal.

<Title>Achievements:</>
- Heal the World now unlocks after completing all 24 offerings.

<Title>Various Improvements:</>
- Ranch animals now show heart emotes when interacted with.
- Added various new cutscenes.
- The health bar now hides when not in combat.
- You can now interact with babies in the crib.
- Artisan Machine: All vegetables can now be turned into pickles; fruits into jams.
- New map designs for Foggy Area, Deep Forest, and Savannah.
- Bonfires now have a toggleable Interact button.
- Baroque Rug is now sized 3x3 tiles.
- Urgent quest text now changes based on errand type.
- B.O.S. slay errands now show monster icons
 
Best regards,  
Stairway Team

Welcome players!

Coral Island is in an Early Access state, which means that we’re still actively developing it. The game will continue to take shape during this period based on your feedback and our vision.

We plan to continue adding features and content to the game, such as cutscenes, dialogue, festivals, environments, and much more. Our goal is to continue improving and polishing the game experience.

Because we’re still in active development, some features may not work correctly. You may also encounter unstable and or performance issues during play. Should you encounter bugs, crashes, or other issues, please reach out via email qa@stairwaygames.com, or join the Stairway Games public Discord server: https://discord.gg/stairway

We hope you enjoy your new home in Starlet Town.

Stairway Games

Alice_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.4_dialogueText: No, <NpcName>Suki</>.//<portrait=concerned>I don’t want to bother them yet. Especially when they haven’t done anything wrong.

Alice_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.1B64FC64497907FC8CBE3E828A1B7DC3: Oh, blimey, didn' expect company! Just tryin' to fix this thing, but it's all hands and thumbs, I am.

Ben_Heart_2_Cutscene.8_dialogueText: <NpcName>Luke</>! What’s gotten into you? That was rude!
Ben_Heart_2_Cutscene.A9FF331C40DF01C0B4597182774A8852: Accusatory... But yes, we are leaving somewhere.
Ben_Heart_2_Cutscene.9_dialogueText: But you’re right, the lamp does look a little beat up.//<portrait=annoyed>Some of the paint is missing, and it has a funny smell.//<portrait=concerned>Will it wash off, dear?
Ben_Heart_2_Cutscene.12_dialogueText: Hey, look who we have here!
Ben_Heart_2_Cutscene.3_dialogueText: I won’t take no for an answer. You need to stop worrying about being a bother. You’re family, <NpcName>Ben</>.//<portrait=happy>How about I make it easy for both of us? It would be an <Italic>insult</> if you couldn’t make it.
Ben_Heart_2_Cutscene.10_dialogueText: It’s no longer for sale, folks. I don’t know what to tell you.//It was a rare find. It has character. With these things, you either see it or you don’t.
Ben_Heart_2_Cutscene.6_dialogueText: Now, where did you get this <Italic>amazing</> lamp?//I don’t think I’ve ever seen anything like it.
Ben_Heart_2_Cutscene.B67A52064C4F365A9CB432ACE4A162FD: We're heading to the vineyard for the day. You need anything from the caravan, Player?
Ben_Heart_2_Cutscene.4_dialogueText: Well, that’s very kind of you. If it isn’t any trouble, sure…//<portrait=happy>I’ll join you guys.
Ben_Heart_2_Cutscene.11_dialogueText: Well, we don’t.//<portrait=normal>Okay, mate, let’s close up the caravan. I’ve got a pie in the oven.
Ben_Heart_2_Cutscene.2_dialogueText: What’s this nonsense <NpcName>Luke</> said about you not making it to my dinner party tonight?
Ben_Heart_2_Cutscene.7_dialogueText: You better not charge a premium for that, <NpcName>Ben</>.//<portrait=sad>It looks like it’s been in the trash for a week.

Betty_Heart_2_Cutscene.6BBC873743AD80CD694DE4B5F8294E65: All right then, Ma. When should we go to the cemetery?//If we aren’t waiting for anyone else, can’t we just do it today?
Betty_Heart_2_Cutscene.4_dialogueText: All right then, Ma. When should we go to the graveyard?//If we aren’t waiting for anyone else, can’t we just do it today?

Betty_Heart_2_Cutscene.1_dialogueText: Hi, <PlayerName>$player</>. One moment, please.//I’ll be right with you…

Carpenter_01_Cutscene.1_dialogueText: Good morning, <PlayerName>$player</>! You look like you just woke up from a great night sleep. I heard that farming does that to you.
Carpenter_01_Cutscene.2_optionsChoice: It's true. I did have a good night sleep!
Carpenter_01_Cutscene.8_dialogueText: Let's try it out, shall we?
Carpenter_01_Cutscene.9_dialogueText: Nice spot! Alright then. See you around!
Carpenter_01_Cutscene.7_dialogueText: No, the one that I just gave you is on the house... A welcome freebie from <NpcName>Joko</> and me.
Carpenter_01_Cutscene.6_dialogueText: That's the blueprint for a pet house. You will need blueprints to be able to build things around here, but don't worry. I have some for sale in my store.
Carpenter_01_Cutscene.3_optionsChoice: That's true, you know! What brought you here so early in the morning?
Carpenter_01_Cutscene.5_dialogueText: The last time I was here, I noticed that there was a nice little spot over there. Maybe you can turn that into a pet area? It would be nice to have a pet in a large farming area like this. To kind of keep us company.

Charles_Heart_2_Cutscene.1_dialogueText: DIDN’T WE JUST DO THAT LAST YEAR?
Charles_Heart_2_Cutscene.4_dialogueText: Errr… I don’t think it’s a good idea to not do it.
Charles_Heart_2_Cutscene.3_dialogueText: IT’S NERVE RACKING TO WAIT FOR THE RESULTS.//I REALLY DON’T LIKE IT.
Charles_Heart_2_Cutscene.6_optionsChoice: It’s scary, but it’s just a routine test. We should trust <NpcName>Charles</> on this.
Charles_Heart_2_Cutscene.7_dialogueText: Like <PlayerName>$player</> said...//<portrait=happy>Waiting for test results can be uncomfortable.//It’s scary to think about what could be wrong… But you’re a healthy man, <NpcName>Sunny</>.//<portrait=normal>Besides, your blood work will help me detect any problems early.//So, if you’re nervous about having an illness, the test will help us find the best solution as soon as possible.
Charles_Heart_2_Cutscene.8_dialogueText: YES, THAT’S TRUE. OKAY, THEN.//LET’S DO IT.
Charles_Heart_2_Cutscene.5_optionsChoice: Yeah, I agree. It’s nerve racking, but it shows us the state of our health. It’s wise to do it every year.
Charles_Heart_2_Cutscene.4_optionsChoice: Yeah, I’m with you on that. It is nerve racking. You should skip it this year.
Charles_Heart_2_Cutscene.2_dialogueText: Yes, but it’s important for you to get a blood test every year. It’s just routine…//<portrait=happy>It’ll give us a snapshot of your overall health.//Nothing to be nervous about.

Connor_Heart_1_Cutscene.21ED19844FD86569B71BB1A56BF69AB2: Certainly, we don’t want to cause a disturbance among…//Errr...
Connor_Heart_1_Cutscene.60A1905A4FBC842BB18CAC8DCB10616F: Delighted to. Just name a day.
Connor_Heart_1_Cutscene.3_dialogueText: I didn’t want to go there, but scarecrows as decorations—really <NpcName>Sam</>?//<portrait=concerned>They seem out of place in a town like this.
Connor_Heart_1_Cutscene.AE069BBB47B6C3389E443A9DB8A3BFD9: If you say so, Mr. Mayor.
Connor_Heart_1_Cutscene.1_dialogueText: It’s just that we don’t want to violate the town’s code…
Connor_Heart_1_Cutscene.4_dialogueText: Not to mention it isn’t in compliance with some of our codes.
Connor_Heart_1_Cutscene.7_dialogueText: Please excuse me. I have scarecrows to take care of.
Connor_Heart_1_Cutscene.6_dialogueText: Thank you. I appreciate it.//Maybe we can talk about the other violations some other time.
Connor_Heart_1_Cutscene.5_dialogueText: Well, I’ll wrap up the scarecrows, and you can be sure there won’t be any left tomorrow.

DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.BE114ACA47DB26939A58FF89E420869A: *mumbles* What am I going to do if this person doesn’t work out either…?
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.9C4FCABE44E36ED0F42E54AF0E7481D5: <NpcName>Bree</>! Oh, not a bad time at all. What brings you here?
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.2DA1D7004D776C12520C8BBE76F8242F: <NpcName>Ling</>, I need to print out these results. Is the printer working today?
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.A6E4C4A14A96F6AEC918F7A7F6F3E1CA: <NpcName>Randy</> would be happier, I’d be happier—and there’s even talk of expanding the lab. It’s a dream come true.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.41FD637E4314933F0F0E45B1F9B11DA7: <PlayerName>$player</>! Have you seen <NPCName>Scott</>? He’s late! He’s supposed to start the ceremony…
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.C9D94340469C97D8B0A98AA9FB754D49: <PlayerName>$player</>! Have you seen <NPCName>Scott</>? He’s late! He’s supposed to start the ceremony…
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.50CD2F0F46919894B18805869693518F: Actually, that’s not true. They still remember.// It’s just someone else’s problem now. Someone else will fix it. Their concern is enough.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.810CBB2D445D2021EB1484A1B744C339: Ah! <PlayerName>$player</>, welcome to the Lab.//<portrait=normal>I've been expecting you.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.7D38D5A3438250F8991F5A840B37FAF1: Ah, hello there… //I was just looking out to sea.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.13_dialogueText: Amazing! Here’s a <Items>diving suit</>... The <Places>diving spot</> is on the pier in front of the <Places>inn</> at the beach, near the dock where all the boats are!
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.D9DFCDCF4B11545B849339A0192BFC44: And I don’t want to pressure you! <NpcName>Ling</> said no and that’s totally fine. //We’re just looking to plant a new grove, and the mansion is sitting on some pristine land.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.D11624A54015D36058FF7DBB21E56F6E: And we want to buy your house.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.DB13CE784DC77CEE007D34860EF122BB: And you’d offer…how much, exactly? For the house?
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.809F53BF452FC36C2147908B53B408C0: But I can’t help but feel it’s not the right move.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.CDA18934403179FEAD72D490D5D9FDE1: But I wasn’t sure I wanted to sell, <NpcName>Randy</>.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.9CC3013642BC0B01033F2E85028C3D9F: But you know what, <PlayerName>$player</>? Thank you. Talking to you helped me articulate these thoughts for myself. There’s nothing holding me back.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.ACCCB86148FC3E70C5FF34928DCEF6DD: Come on! Why does nothing work around here?!
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.08A31D5243957A7F078F35BEEC9565AA: Come on, you annoying thing! Print!
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.4B2A9C144A87517DD0DEA09B834110D5: Do you want me to pull up another chair?
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.D4CAB04345C82106D74F85B1319DAF25: Don’t be ridiculous. We’d knock it down, of course.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.79D077B7495B913760E0F3B268E2AF83: Don’t be sorry, <NpcName>Ling</>! Really, it was just an idea. I don’t want to put you in a position where you’d be uncomfortable.//If you don’t want to sell, that’s completely fine. We’ll find another place.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.3C9281F44161A7682C0622AC8ED60B09: Excuse me, I’d like to talk to one of the researchers here.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.BFA12F5E42EE2E7230A7578D23C5E534: Excuse me? You haven’t even heard of what I had to say.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.4D8C0C5847A61604945828B31BF21D64: Hey <PlayerName>$player</>, good to see you here. We’re all waiting for <NPCName>Scott</> to arrive.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.8E96C5EF4CFB433EB390B693A5C62315: Hey <PlayerName>$player</>, good to see you here. We’re just waiting on <NPCName>Scott</>—once he arrives, we’ll finally launch the Pickstarter campaign!
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.8F0B5CC443850098AD9A6798DA909D42: I don’t know how much she’s offering you—and I’m not asking, that’s not my business—but I’m just thinking out loud. //If it was a lot of money, maybe you could expand like you’ve always wanted to. Open up more labs on more islands, hire more staff…
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.FD7F0BCE4CF2F6BEB18852878D2C7903: I don’t know. It could be the beginning of a new chapter for you.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.F7BF030842FB4D594DF4B28EC47C3193: I don’t know. Nothing. A feeling I can’t shake.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.667E4A0A483B383E1E2161B9357CFE23: I guess not. I’ve been distracted recently…
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.29E73C65421CA82F651B299A51148961: I guess we’re ready for the—
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.A47B0E2F495A03680B2859B120D107F1: I know it’s not really my place, <NpcName>Ling</>, but is there any room in the budget for a new printer? Or a new chair? //This one is totally lacking lumbar support, and my back is…it’s not good.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.7C92B7BD44B81BB0F7391F82B4762D0A: I know you’re not attached to the house. How many times have you told me that? So I figure this is a win-win!
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.3A715B6B4C88F7074C3B55B0D5324056: I never thought about selling my house. Truth is, I never think much about my house at all. //I’m not very sentimental about it.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.5B094FD24761A6E656E9BABECA6CA8F6: I would, though we’re just finishing up…
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.3B53B3E34395C362C905B1AF30EBD208: It is. And the thing is, I don’t know why I didn’t already accept. //There wasn’t a lot of housing when I first moved to the island, so I just grabbed the first place I saw. //I don’t really have any attachment to the place.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.EBCEBAB940A9A871164AFE9786D5FB0F: It should be an easy decision, right? But something’s...I don’t know.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.38C3EC3A45D72B48D1B369943F5C73DE: It’d be nice to not have to worry about getting dessert, though. Wouldn’t it?
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.FA69E12C493BEC0B1273F59E9AEE2CCA: I’m not sure we were getting dessert, <NpcName>Randy</>. You had that extra glass of wine, remember? We’re going over our budget...
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.9ED9D2174847B23831576893DC56FCB3: I’m not. It’s drafty, and it takes forever to get from my bedroom to the kitchen.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.785CA5744720DE42108A3FAF1F717228: I’m sorry, <NpcName>Surya</>. I can bring you a pillow from home.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.8B8CAC814F1B2B33FAA675A427AFF7B8: I’m weighing an important decision, <PlayerName>$player</>. I know what to do—logically, that is.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.3_dialogueText: Let me give you a little tour...
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.6_dialogueText: Neat, isn't it? That's the new <Items>beacon</> that I've been working on. <Items>CUMI2-2.0</>, I call it. The new <Items>beacon</> can clear up the <Items>trash</> too.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.0A6B61FB4BF1FB5D9D13BB827CC2B0D6: No pressure <NpcName>Ling</>, but let me know if you ever rethink my offer about the house. We haven’t found another spot yet.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.9E724BF149458B678627018AA93953D7: No problem, I’ll go find your mom. Though we may have some supply issues the next month or so. We can only grow the grapes so fast!
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.ADF83795454FABB108445690AC0245C2: No. Yes. But you know what? It doesn’t matter. The house is in your name, sweetie. It’s your decision. I’ll support you whatever you want to do.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.3BA4CFB74DC8C51C2375C0B1327B849C: Not really. I’m going to take the deal.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.E6F0543D435AEF2D7043EFB5978BF36C: Now for the next step, let's replace these <Items>corals</> with our <Items>super coral</>.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.32DBF7EC4A84BF7A8D3EBEA3EC19D6FA: Now now, it’s a big decision. We don’t want to rush things…
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.41CD1CB14AE87A92CE7ABD9328EA6B2A: Of course, I already know everything that happened while you were diving. You were able to activate the solar orb.//<portrait=normal>I saw everything unfold from Kibles's point of view.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.5F336F6B422D7D97976573B0C2EC6D09: Of course. Of course you would…
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.28A5933C44097C74804D4DB4D8B2407C: Of course. You know, that’s actually why I came down here today.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.836566014E24FC80BDD2609ECF4620F3: Oh good, you're finally here <PlayerName>$player</>.// I'm so happy you've managed to activate all the <Items>beacons</> in the South 10m zone!
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.8766E8A043806B7EF1312CA12DE61044: Oh yeah, thanks for reminding me! Your wine is going like hotcakes!
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.0CE91D104A3CAB8B22B2B7900BDE89FC: Oh! Silly me, I know the problem.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.044CC22D4DD9D691E824C086AB77E50A: Oh, I’m sure you’d find something in the area. With what we’d give you for the place?
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.4A6F2A1B4B3E52444E60948E6532E67A: Oh, don’t worry, I’m just popping in and out to check on their wine stock.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.E6C6B1F248FEA8BA93ABC68907273F0C: Oh, it’s not your fault. I was just lost in thought...
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.40EF776C4898DB2FC2AB99B91A31C0EB: Oh, it’s nothing. <NpcName>Bree</> just offered to…you know. Buy our house.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.AE118C384089981050D3DB8D5190610A: On the one hand, I want to take this deal. Between you and me, the money would be a godsend. And what do I need a big, dusty house to putter around in anyway?
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.D53E1E374128561B48D965B166E8AB0F: Really…thank you anyway, <NpcName>Bree</>. I appreciate it.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.5613D4E2413B032113BF28BD1423EF1F: Right. So why not sell? You could use the money to fix up the lab, at least. And maybe…
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.1EFE4F7844C0E0E71DB08BA66C675793: So did you guys decide what you wanted for dessert?
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.12_dialogueText: So, the task would be... When you go diving, clear the <Items>trash</> and locate the <Items>beacons</>. What do you say?
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.8E274CB642B89B941DCB17A356E2A89C: Sure. But…it’s my home. I just don’t know...
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.377C223246FDD48D0160D1B3BCE5F472: Thank you for the offer, really. But I can’t sell my house. Where would I go?
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.4FBA261A43876F13B41E08BD1A4EE76C: The Vineyard’s been doing well, <NpcName>Ling</>. Really well.//<portrait=Normal>We have so many customers we don’t know what to do with them, and we’re thinking about opening up a small shop on the mainland.//You know...test the waters, so to speak.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.B6C1C23A483F2861E91B5AB644BC483A: The room we're in also holds, er, Merf-...//<portrait=normal>Ancient technology that can remove those stubborn oil-covered roots and heal sick coral.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.95F1E27A45837A844EDBE89BEC4930B9: These printers always break on me after about a week. That’s what you get through donations though, I guess. Can’t really be too picky.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.7_dialogueText: Unfortunately, in order to upgrade the old models to the new ones, we need to locate them all first.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.0BF4726F414ADB66F5CBF6824296C754: We didn’t have to. <NpcName>Ling</> knows I’d make her a great deal.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.FE3648F04AC0A2BA6ADCE78E09A4ECBB: Well, got to toodle. <NpcName>Betty</> will probably be in the back. Offer stands, <NpcName>Ling</>. Just let me know.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.759FEFA846407360A717B3BE8AA43553: Well, it’s funny. Seems my house is sitting on a perfect plot of land for <NpcName>Bree</> to plant another vineyard. //I guess things are going well for them and they’re looking to expand.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.71C7D7AF42C8FF1109558DA1597479A6: Well, the thing is that with so much demand, our little vineyard isn’t really cutting it anymore. We need to expand.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.4846FB1848C48BED7CD00F84A4425B17: We’ll offer you a fair price, of course. More than fair, if I’m being honest.//<portrait=Happy>You’ll finally be able to fix up the lab! Get as many printers as you could possibly want.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.4_dialogueText: We’ve been trying to research and breed <Items>super coral</>...like these little fellas here. These <Items>corals</> can adapt to survive rising ocean temperatures.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.B83267204F135C91E4F4FAB40DEDA5E5: Where to start... well, many years ago, I planted super corals, just like the one here, all around Coral Island.//They've been specifically bred to survive rising ocean temperatures and hostile environments.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.A7AA99C547412887F11F3DBC9DA3E8C6: Why are you telling me this?
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.EDA7A7E04E6C5C5021B3A091EDFCC2D3: Why don’t you pick up a new one down at <NpcName>Luke</>’s? Printers aren’t too expensive.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.A1A52BF0436A08425387AA8FC52B3933: You did? That’s great! Take it! What’s the offer?
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.5541BE734FB5AE3F79425BAFCA6DF0C8: You know what? I’ll come back.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.2443A4C0424C2A2F23A36984136830A9: You know…I probably shouldn’t mention this, but I got an offer a little bit ago that would bring some more money into the lab.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.D6B1CB7E4A38D9F78C962EB2C5F8367E: Your house, <NpcName>Ling</>. The mansion you bought because nothing else was available? It’s sitting on a perfect plot of land.//<NpcName>Walter</> and I want to plant a second vineyard there.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.F4006B284855394F7DA90D8F15E2FBEA: You’re right. I need to think this through.
DivingSuit_01_Cutscene__1_.1DC86FCF4DA6ED767B39029899327DE3: You’re thinking about the dessert again, aren’t you?

DT_AliceCutscene.7_dialogueText: Ah, you both are two peas in a pod. Alright then, we'll wait 'till tomorrow. But if they don't arrive by tomorrow noon, I'm calling them myself.
DT_AliceCutscene.6_dialogueText: Err... Okay. I guess I can try contacting them.
DT_AliceCutscene.8_optionsChoice: I can't decide. I don't know what to do.
DT_AliceCutscene.7_optionsChoice: I wouldn't call either. Can you just email them?
DT_AliceCutscene.1_dialogueText: It really is not a big deal. Just call them up and ask where they are.
DT_AliceCutscene.4_dialogueText: No, <NpcName>Suki</>. I don't feel comfortable bothering them yet. Especially when they are doing nothing wrong.
DT_AliceCutscene.2_dialogueText: No. It's not like they're late on delivery, the blankets are suppose to arrive today. You need to calm down and let me handle this. I will give them a call tomorrow.
DT_AliceCutscene.3_dialogueText: Well, no. Today is supposed to be the last day that the blankets arrive. I don't see why you don't just call them real quick. Confirm if they did send it, at least?
DT_AliceCutscene.6_optionsChoice: You should give them a call and find out where the blankets are.

DT_CreditBackers.14_title: Hope is always there, sometimes you're blind" - Alwyn Laurado

DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.5_Text: <PlayerName>$honorifics $player</>, who do you think will collect the most trash?//<portrait=happy>Last year it was <NPCName>Mr. Pablo</>. He zoomed around so fast!
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.90_Text: A cold coconut sounds like a good idea. I'll get us some after this.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.6_Text: Ah, it’s always so much fun seeing the youngsters racing around and having fun.//<portrait=normal>Make sure you have fun too, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.50_Text: Alright, Starlet Town! Let's turn this beach from trashy to classy.//<portrait=normal>Every bit counts!
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.26_Text: Are you going to join us, <PlayerName>$honorifics $player</>?//<portrait=happy>I bet I can pick up more trash than you!
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.86_Text: Babe, do you know where we kept our hats? I might run back home and get one.//My head's getting a bit toasty.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.78_Text: Babe, if you're feeling dizzy, please stop and let me know, okay? I'll get one of the doctors right away.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.87_Text: Babe, since it's such a beautiful day, I was thinking maybe we could stay back after it's all done.//<portrait=normal>How about we chill outside for a bit before going home?
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.57_Text: Beach cleanup here in the Summer is actually kinda fun.//You find the weirdest stuff, and it's like you're on a treasure hunt, but for trash.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.92_Text: Can I have another coconut drink, pretty please?
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.93_Text: Can I have another coconut drink, pretty please?
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.19_Text: Can you take a picture of me over there?
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.12_Text: Chatting helps pass the time. Before I know it, I’ve filled up lots of bags!
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.96_Text: Cleaning the beach with my friends is the best!
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.97_Text: Cleaning the beach with my friends is the best!
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.40_Text: Dad said picking up trash is good. Even though it’s not our trash.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.85_Text: Dad was asking about you earlier, babe. I let him know you're all good.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.89_Text: Darling, tell me, should I have <NPCName>Denali</> fetch us some food for dinner from the chef?//With all we've done today, I don't think either of us should prepare meals.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.37_Text: Days like these are why we chose to move out here. The sun is just beaming, isn’t it?
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.79_Text: Did you get a chance to stretch, honey? Come over here, I'll help you.//<portrait=blushing>Let me show you this great move I know.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.83_Text: Do you mind if we stop by the inn before heading home, babe?//I need to pick up some stuff.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.8_Text: Don’t strain yourself if you plan on joining the swimming race, <PlayerName>$player</>.//<portrait=normal>Just have fun with it.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.68_Text: Don’t strain yourself if you plan on joining the swimming race, darling.//Just enjoy it, we're here to have fun...and pick up some trash.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.46_Text: Heard there's some sweet prize for the team that bags the most trash. We on it?//<portrait=annoyed>No? <Italic>Man</>, that's a bummer. Well, it's all good.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.67_Text: Heard there's some sweet prize for the team that bags the most trash. We on it?//<portrait=annoyed>No? <Italic>Oh, honey</>, that's a bummer. Well, it's all good.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.49_Text: Hey, <NpcName>Raina</>, take a picture of us by the clean-up banner.//Let's show people we care!
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.64_Text: Hey, could you pass me another trash bag, babe? Found quite a few plastic bottles here.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.3_Text: Hmm, it seems counterintuitive for Pufferfish Corp to be distributing those flyers, doesn’t it?//<portrait=annoyed>Shouldn’t we be decreasing the trash, not adding to it?
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.69_Text: Hmm, what's on your mind, dear? Can I get you something to drink?
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.31_Text: Honestly, I think I’m a bit too old for it.//<portrait=happy>But they always get so excited when I join them.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.91_Text: How about a nice hot bath tonight? After all this hard work, what do you say, babe?//<portrait=happy>And maybe a massage later for my environment warrior?
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.14_Text: I can hear <NPCName>Sunny</> talking all the way from here.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.36_Text: I can’t wait to grow up so I can join the swimming contest.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.60_Text: I could really go for some coconut water right now. Any idea where I can grab some?
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.56_Text: I couldn't believe how much junk we picked up last year. It's an eye-opener.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.22_Text: I lost count of how much water I drank.//<portrait=normal>Good thing the Beach Shack’s nearby.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.100_Text: I miss living near the beach sometimes.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.21_Text: I remember the first beach festival I attended was more about the town coming together and celebrating Summer one last time.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.48_Text: I sneaked a peek at 5 a.m., and <NpcName>Pablo</> and <NpcName>Rafael</> were already outdoors, getting this place ready.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.20_Text: I think it’s working, <PlayerName>$player</>. I’m not getting a sunburn.//<portrait=happy>THANK YOU, <NPCName>CHARLES</>!
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.28_Text: I think my daughter said she saw a dolphin nearby.//Maybe they’re curious and wanted to see why so many humans were gathering.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.72_Text: I think your sunscreen trick is working, babe. I’m not getting sunburned.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.38_Text: I was just telling my buddy <NPCName>Randy</> here about how we can sell tickets to these events. Make money from it, hmm?
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.59_Text: I'm thinking of joining the swim race later, once I've finished cleaning up here. The weather's perfect for it.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.63_Text: I've been assigned to clean up the trash and sort it later. Should be easy. I've seen all this trash before, so it'll be quick for me.//<portrait=normal>What about you? What tasks do you have?
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.25_Text: If you're feeling dizzy, please stop and see one of the doctors right away.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.51_Text: Is everyone staying hydrated?//<portrait=normal>We have a ton of coconut water here.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.62_Text: It almost brings me to tears, seeing all this... I’m so touched that so many people showed up to clean the beach.//<portrait=happy>Thank you, <PlayerName>$Player</>...and everyone. As a creature of the sea, I truly appreciate it.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.4_Text: It’s getting a bit toasty, don’t you think? I hope my sunscreen holds up.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.10_Text: It’s great that we’re gathering today to clean up the beach.//<portrait=concerned>But I wonder if it’s enough…
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.34_Text: It’s so hot today. Gotta keep hydrated!
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.84_Text: It’s so hot today. Remember, we need to stay hydrated, babe!
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.39_Text: It’s so nice out. I don’t wanna go home!
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.9_Text: It’s the perfect weather for swimming.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.74_Text: I’m excited to take some great photos today, babe.//<portrait=happy>The lighting is perfect, and it's a cloudless sky.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.24_Text: I’m excited to take some great photos today.//<portrait=happy>The light looks great, and I don’t see a single cloud in the sky.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.35_Text: I’m glad the town is working together to clean the beach.//<portrait=sad>Do you know how much trash I gather just from fishing?//Too much, <PlayerName>$player</>, too much…
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.73_Text: Let me know if you need some water, love. I can quickly go over to the Beach Shack and grab some for you.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.70_Text: Let’s focus on cleaning up for now, sweetheart.//I’m ready to pick up some trash.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.16_Text: Let’s forget about Pufferfish for now.//I’m ready to pick up some trash.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.75_Text: Make sure to stay under the shade, baby. This heat isn't good for you.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.80_Text: My back's starting to feel the sunburn.//<portrait=concerned>Could you...could you help me with some more sunscreen?
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.30_Text: My students love the cleaning race.//They basically forced me to take part!
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.11_Text: Oh yeah, the swimming race...contest, whatever.//<portrait=normal>I used to participate a few years ago, but now I just like to chat with people while we’re picking up trash.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.7_Text: Oh, look at that. Looks like <NPCName>Kira</> is all fired up.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.77_Text: Oh, my darling! You look so hot in that!//<portrait=happy>That outfit really suits you.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.81_Text: Oh, there you are, babe. I've been looking for you.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.82_Text: Oh, there you are, babe. I've been waiting for you.//<portrait=normal>Check out my outfit! Been hitting the gym a bit, you know – trying to not look too shabby standing next to you!
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.76_Text: Okay, Starlet Town, time to transform this beach from trashy to classy!//<portrait=normal>How was that for a cheer, babe? Think I should tweak my rallying cry a bit?
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.44_Text: Pass me another trash bag, will ya? Found quite a few plastic bottles here.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.47_Text: Remember, folks, we're not just cleaning up. We're safeguarding our marine life too.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.55_Text: Should've brought a hat. My head's getting a bit toasty.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.15_Text: Shoveling trash might not be the most glamorous thing, but it’s much better than shoveling manure, trust me.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.1_Text: Since our inn is right by the beach, it’s important to me that it’s kept clean.//<portrait=happy>That’s why I always take part in the cleanup.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.52_Text: Such a fitting end to Summer, don't you think?//A clean beach for a fresh start to Fall.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.17_Text: Sure is real nice down here at the beach...reckon I oughta come here more often.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.58_Text: The doctor keeps telling me to put on some sunscreen.//Kinda makes me wonder if he's got a deal with a sunscreen brand or something.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.23_Text: The other good thing about this festival is we’re nearing the end of Summer.//<portrait=happy>I’m ready for Fall.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.45_Text: The vibrations here are truly in harmony with Mother Earth.//<portrait=happy>Powerful energy!
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.66_Text: The vibrations here feel even more harmonious with you by my side.//<portrait=happy>Powerful energy!
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.29_Text: This is fun.//Are you having fun, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.53_Text: This isn't just about today, it's about setting a precedent.//A clean beach should be the norm, not an annual event.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.94_Text: We make an awesome team cleaning together, {ParentLabel}!
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.95_Text: We make an awesome team cleaning together, {ParentLabel}!
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.88_Text: We should definitely take a dip later, babe. The water seems perfect for a swim!
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.43_Text: What are you doing here, chatting?//<portrait=normal>We got some cleaning up to do, Garden Rake.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.54_Text: Who's up for a quick swim after we finish?//The water's perfect today.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.2_Text: Will you be joining the race, <PlayerName>$player</>?//At the very least, it should be fun.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.65_Text: Will you be joining the race, babe?//At the very least, it should be fun.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.61_Text: Would it be cheating if I enter the swimming contest with my tail?
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.71_Text: Would you mind taking a picture of me over there, darling?
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.42_Text: You look good! That outfit really suits you.
DT_DialogBeachCleanUp.18_Text: You might not think so, but collecting trash can be hard physical work.//Gotta make sure I warm up properly, or I might pull something.//<portrait=annoyed>I’m not as spry as I used to be, unfortunately.

DT_DialogCherryBlossom.21_Text: <NPCName>Archie</>! Be careful with the worms!//*sighs* There he goes again…
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.45_Text: <NPCName>Eva</>'s croissant is getting a lot of compliments, just for the looks.//Maybe I should ask her to add it to the menu.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.16_Text: <NPCName>Mr. Theo</> is sooooo good at singing. I wanna be like him when I grow up.//What do you wanna do when you grow up?
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.56_Text: <NPCName>Walter</> was asking me questions about my coffee bean dealer. I’m not telling.//<portrait=normal>I know what he’s doing.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.10_Text: <PlayerName>$player</>, are you ready for the main event?
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.38_Text: <PlayerName>$player</>, we are finished with preparations for the main event.//Talk to the mayor if you’re ready.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.5_Text: Ah, perhaps you’re not the gaming type.//<portrait=normal>Please sit tight. We’ll start soon!
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.96_Text: Are we allowed to grab some food?
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.13_Text: Are you saying hi to everybody?//<portrait=concerned>You poor thing. It sounds exhausting.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.2_Text: Are you sure? Hmm…//<portrait=normal>Okay, then, sit tight. We’ll start soon!
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.99_Text: Can I get you something from the grill, baby?
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.81_Text: Can I get you something to eat, babe? Or do you want to mingle first?
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.106_Text: Can we go fishing, {ParentLabel}? I wanna catch a big one!
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.107_Text: Can we go fishing, {ParentLabel}? I wanna catch a big one!
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.103_Text: Can we stay here all day? This festival is amazing!
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.100_Text: Can we take some petals home, {ParentLabel}?
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.26_Text: Cooking is relaxing…//<portrait=happy>But it’s more relaxing to sit back, eat, and look at these cherry blossoms.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.74_Text: Did you open the window, babe? I forgot to do it before coming here.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.83_Text: Do you like this song? I could try singing it for you later...in our bedroom.//A private concert.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.64_Text: Do you want to grab a bite to eat? I can get it for you, what do you want?
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.44_Text: Eh… This is fine by me. I don’t crave durian all that bad.//<portrait=happy>As long as <NPCName>Frank</> here grills enough apples, we are a-ok!
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.92_Text: Everyone’s brought such lovely dishes to the potluck. I can smell the yumminess from here!
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.47_Text: GOOD FOOD, GOOD WEATHER, GOOD COMPANY.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.11_Text: Great! Take your spot. We’ll start soon.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.25_Text: Hey, <PlayerName>$player</>! How’s the festival?//<portrait=surprised>There’s more to come, don’t worry!
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.80_Text: Hey, babe, what did we decide to bring for the potluck today?
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.46_Text: Hey, come over here <PlayerName>$player</>! Let’s dance!
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.75_Text: How about we find a spot to sit and just enjoy the view for a while, darling?
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.29_Text: I did say there’s way too much food, but…//<portrait=happy>I think it’s okay once in a while.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.40_Text: I got some fish, so I gave them to <NPCName>Mr. Frank</>.//<portrait=happy>I hope he can make it like <NPCName>Mr. Jim</>’s smoked salmon!
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.20_Text: I hope they didn’t strain themselves doing the sack race.//You included, Farmer <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.24_Text: I love the food here. Everything is delicious!
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.78_Text: I really love the cherry blossoms. They're so pretty...just like you.//I'm glad we're here together.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.68_Text: I reckon I could just sit here all day watchin' them blossoms fall. Sure is a peaceful sight
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.14_Text: I saw <NPCName>Oliver</> trying to catch fish at the lake earlier this morning. I think he wanted to contribute to the potluck.//<portrait=happy>So cute.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.98_Text: I should ask the princess if she needs anything, then I'll be all yours, babe.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.34_Text: I should’ve brought little Stephen. He would’ve enjoyed this.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.108_Text: I simply can't resist indulging in all this unlimited food...though I dare say the real feast is standing right next to me.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.31_Text: I think I spend way too much time at my PC.//<portrait=sad>My eyes feel kind of crusty.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.55_Text: I think I’ll wrap up some of this tumpeng for dad.//Do you think it’ll still be good later?
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.58_Text: I wonder how many people it took to get these decorations up.//It looks like a lot of work, if you ask me.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.65_Text: I'm glad the weather held up for this. Couldn’t have asked for a better day to see the blossoms.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.69_Text: I'm hungry, babe. Get me something from the potluck?
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.73_Text: I'm hungry. Get me something from the potluck?
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.61_Text: I'm not interested in the sack race. I'm here for the potluck.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.109_Text: I'm planning to catch up with Aunt <NPCName>Alice</> right after this.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.95_Text: I've cleared the area – just locals and some tourists around. Everything should be safe for the festival.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.42_Text: It sure is pretty today!//Can’t ask for better potluck weather.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.60_Text: It's always a pleasure to spend my Spring here.//Well, part of my Spring anyway.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.88_Text: It's so heartwarming to see the kids out here fishing – they're naturals and so darn cute with their fishing rods!
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.19_Text: It’s nice to see everyone enjoying the festival.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.52_Text: I’d better go tell <NPCName>Charles</> to calm down with the unsolicited doctor advice.//He could ruin the festival for everyone.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.48_Text: I’ll bring over some lodeh next year.//It’s this delicious dish with coconut milk, you’ll love it.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.51_Text: Just like our wine, festivals like this are the identity of Coral Island.//<portrait=normal>Don’t you agree, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.67_Text: Let me grab us some food. What are you in the mood for, babe?
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.23_Text: Listen, <PlayerName>$player</>. Sometimes, getting to know everybody is tiring, but it’s worth it.//<portrait=happy>You’re part of this community now.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.66_Text: Look at how beautiful it is around here during this season, sweetheart.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.71_Text: Love, remind me, what are we bringing for the potluck?
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.39_Text: Mom spent the whole night baking.//<portrait=normal>I’m glad to see her having a good time today.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.54_Text: Mom told me to keep an eye out for beavers while fishing!//Did you see any, <PlayerName>$honorifics $player</>?
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.15_Text: More people told me they saw beavers on the lake.//Thankfully, <NPCName>Paul</> brought his camera. If we’re lucky, we might get a picture or two.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.59_Text: My baby brother <NPCName>Frank</> is your guy for grilling stuff. A lot like dad.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.82_Text: My neck's feeling a bit stiff. Can you massage it later?
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.12_Text: No rush, <PlayerName>$player</>. Maybe you could chat with people for a bit.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.3_Text: No rush, <PlayerName>$player</>. The festival’s about immersion. Immerse yourself!
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.6_Text: No rush, <PlayerName>$player</>. We only have these games during festivals, so don’t miss out!
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.9_Text: No rush, <PlayerName>$player</>. With a potluck, it’s always the more the merrier.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.37_Text: Please wait just a little longer, we’re still preparing for the main event.//<NPCName>Frank</> is still accepting contributions for the potluck. How about visiting him?
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.36_Text: Please wait just a little longer, we’re still preparing for the main event.//People are still playing games. How about giving them a try?
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.35_Text: Please wait just a little longer, we’re still preparing for the main event.//You should try the minigames!
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.85_Text: Really hoping no one's sick today. I just want to relax and not think about work.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.49_Text: Sing along, <PlayerName>$player</>! Come on, you know the next part, right?
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.41_Text: Smells good, right? I gathered dried coconut husk for the grill this morning.//We’ve been grilling with dried coconut husk for generations. <NPCName>Frank</>’s super excited about it.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.43_Text: So much good food on the table.//<portrait=concerned>Maybe I should calm down with the tumpeng and save some space for them…
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.87_Text: Still feeling a bit off from that boat ride when I got here. I never seem to get the hang of it. Maybe some soup later will help sort me out.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.8_Text: That’s…unfortunate.//<portrait=normal>Okay, then, sit tight. We’ll start soon!
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.89_Text: The cherry blossoms are in full bloom! It sure is a nice change from my last vacation in the Alps.//Not that I'm complaining, the Alps were great.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.86_Text: The cherry blossoms really make you think about the beauty of life, don't they?//I'm happy to share these moments with you.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.33_Text: The food is way too heavy for me.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.27_Text: The kids aren’t even stopping for a break.//<portrait=happy>Looks like I managed to reel them into fishing! What about you? Are you fishing these days?
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.91_Text: The lake looks so serene surrounded by these blossoms.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.97_Text: The lake looks so serene with all the pink petals, darling.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.93_Text: The princess requested the kingdom's special seaweed for the potluck, so I quickly swam down this morning to pick them up.//<portrait=happy>Phew, good thing I made it out on time!
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.30_Text: The songs <NPCName>Theo</> sang really fit the mood.//<portrait=happy>He’s not a bad-looking—I mean, not a bad singer.//<portrait=angry>You heard nothing.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.18_Text: The tumpeng is over there, dear.//<portrait=normal>I hope it's enough for everybody.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.90_Text: There's something truly enchanting about these blossoms. They make the entire town look like a painting.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.79_Text: These cherry blossoms are gorgeous, but not nearly as gorgeous as you.//Being here with you makes everything perfect, my coffee bean.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.62_Text: These cherry blossoms sure are something. I see why people make a big deal about them.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.70_Text: This place is pretty crowded, but I'm just happy we're spending the day together.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.102_Text: This place is so pretty with all the pink petals!
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.76_Text: This weather is just perfect, isn't it? So glad we decided to come out.//Oh, and Mom was asking about you, wanted to know how you're doing.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.17_Text: Time to absorb the good vibes.//Breathe in energy… Breathe out stress… Aaaaah…
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.57_Text: Today is a rest day for me.//<portrait=normal>What?
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.4_Text: We’re still getting ready for the main event. Maybe you can play some games while you wait.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.7_Text: We’re still getting ready for the main event. Maybe you could contribute to the potluck before it starts.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.1_Text: We’re still getting ready for the main event. You have some time to contribute to the potluck and play a few games.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.63_Text: Would you like to walk around a bit more, or are you comfortable here?
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.72_Text: Wow, look at all these blossoms! It's so beautiful and bright.//Babe, take a picture with me!
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.22_Text: Wow, the potluck looks amazing!//<portrait=concerned>But… Oh, never mind.
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.50_Text: Yay! <NPCName>Mr. Theo</> is finally singing a good song!
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.84_Text: You look a little cold, sweetheart. Should I fetch you a hot drink or a jacket?
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.32_Text: You look like you’re having fun.//<portrait=happy>It’s not all bad hanging out in open air like this, is it?
DT_DialogCherryBlossom.101_Text: {ParentLabel}! Can I have some soup?//I really want some soup!

DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.15_Text: <NPCName>Betty’s</> mooncakes are just the best. Maybe I should try making some too…
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.94_Text: <NPCName>Bobby</> doesn’t seem like much of a farmer, does he? You've totally got this, babe.//<portrait=normal>He's no match for you.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.6_Text: <PlayerName>$player</>! Oh, you missed the best part. I just told a story about meeting a slime at the mine.//<portrait=normal>It was intense!
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.83_Text: <PlayerName>$player</>, are you ready with the crops? Go get 'em, babe!
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.36_Text: <PlayerName>$player</>, are you ready with the crops?//<portrait=happy>Don’t worry too much about the competition. It’s all in good fun!
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.110_Text: Ah, darling, can you feel that breeze?//Fall always brings the best weather, don’t you think?
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.58_Text: All these lanterns remind me of a festival I attended a long time ago…
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.35_Text: And of course the massive cow over there! Have you seen it?
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.5_Text: And then I told that slime to scram! Luckily, it agreed. Close call!
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.90_Text: Aunt <NPCName>Dinda</> was wondering if we're planning to plant anything this Winter. I told her I'd check with you.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.51_Text: Aunt <NPCName>Dinda</>'s been testing out new recipes at home for the cooking contest.//Dinners have been great!//<portrait=sad>And interesting at times.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.84_Text: Babe, do you mind if we walk my mom home later before we go back?
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.82_Text: Babe, you seem cold. Do you want my scarf or maybe we can find a warm spot to sit?
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.73_Text: Babe, you should have heard me telling the story about those strange noises we've been hearing at our farm!
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.87_Text: Be careful where you step, babe. I nearly slipped into the lake earlier – those woods are super slippery.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.81_Text: Brought lots of film today! Can't wait to take photos of that giant chicken.//<portrait=blushing>Babe, I want one of those! Can we get it, please? I think it would look good in our room.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.44_Text: But I don’t mind. It’s the least I can do since I’m not that good at other things.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.72_Text: Can you get me more mooncakes, babe? I've been going back and forth so much today.//<portrait=concerned>Pretty please?
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.50_Text: DON'T BE TOO FOCUSED ON BUSINESS, <NPCName>SAM</>.//<portrait=laugh>RELAX AND ENJOY THE FESTIVAL.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.97_Text: Do you think it's possible to buy that giant chicken? But then, how would you even ship something like that? Hmm.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.20_Text: Do you want to join our table?
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.41_Text: Don’t worry about winning. Just have fun!
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.30_Text: Enjoy it, <PlayerName>$player</>. You don’t see these kinds of things in Pokyo.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.47_Text: Even though it’s always crowded in the city, people there are distant.//<portrait=happy>It’s intimate here… I like it.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.62_Text: Fall must be a busy time for you.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.24_Text: Farmer! It’s your festival, isn’t it? It’s the festival of the farmers, my mom always said.//<portrait=happy>No, no she didn’t. I made that part up.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.55_Text: Good luck against Beluga, <PlayerName>$player</>.//<portrait=annoyed>We need to teach them a lesson.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.34_Text: Good thing I brought lots of film for today! I’m gonna take some photos of the giant chicken later.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.78_Text: Good thing I chose to wear my long pants today. It's a bit chilly out, isn't it babe?
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.3_Text: Have you tried the mooncakes yet?
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.13_Text: Hello, <PlayerName>$player</>! Are you interested in carpentry too, like this young man? We’d be more than happy to teach you.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.89_Text: Hey babe, are you enjoying yourself?
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.92_Text: How about a mooncake, babe? I'll go grab one for you.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.93_Text: How about we give our farm a decoration makeover like this one day? Ha, just kidding...or am I?
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.42_Text: I gotta learn to make mooncakes.//You’re a farmer, right? Do you know how to make them?
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.108_Text: I hope our farm gets a prize, {ParentLabel}!
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.109_Text: I hope our farm gets a prize, {ParentLabel}!
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.60_Text: I hope to uncover the mystery one day.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.16_Text: I hope you’re having a good time,<PlayerName>$player</>!
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.57_Text: I just like looking at the decorations.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.23_Text: I like coming to events like this sometimes. I get to do my all socializing at once.//Then I can use my spare time to do something more useful.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.54_Text: I like the Harvest Festival. Nana said it’s her favorite festival in the world.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.17_Text: I love it here. I think this spot has the best view.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.98_Text: I made it just in time for the Harvest Festival. Super glad I decided to come this year – might even come back to check out the Winter season.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.53_Text: I might do one about someone getting run over by the massive chicken on the way here.//<portrait=surprised>Oh yeah! That’d be a hit.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.65_Text: I overheard that the Beluga farmers sent their best crops this year. Better than last year, apparently…
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.74_Text: I overheard that the Beluga farmers sent their best crops this year. Better than last year, apparently…//How are you feeling, babe?
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.19_Text: I really like your outfit today. I think it’s very flattering.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.76_Text: I really like your outfit today. It looks amazing on you, baby.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.100_Text: I saw some kids fishing over there. Are they catching fish?
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.33_Text: I should try out pumpkin smashing—it looks like a lot of fun!
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.11_Text: I think I ate too many mooncakes. But I just can’t stop myself from taking more…
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.31_Text: I think I might dance later.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.86_Text: I was, uh, chatting with <NPCName>Betty</> about how we've got so much land for planting pumpkins. It was, you know, pretty neat.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.39_Text: I won’t be fishing today. Looking for bugs is more exciting!
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.4_Text: I won’t lose to <NPCName>Valentina</>! I can catch five fish too!
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.79_Text: I'm thinking of dancing later.//<portrait=happy>But only if you're up for it, babe. Maybe after dinner?
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.91_Text: I'm thinking of spending some time writing songs later, babe.//I hope it's okay if I stay up a bit – I'm really feeling the creative vibes.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.45_Text: If <NPCName>Betty’s</> interested in selling her mooncakes at the store,//<portrait=happy>I could have a business discussion with her.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.29_Text: In the city, there’s just so much light pollution we can barely see the moon.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.112_Text: It was really nice catching up with Aunt <NPCName>Alice</> earlier.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.49_Text: It’s my ex-mother-in-law’s favorite festival.//<portrait=normal>And I think it might be mine too… I haven’t decided yet.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.28_Text: It’s not a bad idea to come here every now and then. I should do it more often.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.56_Text: I’d feel better losing to you than losing to Beluga’s farmers.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.32_Text: I’ll ask my brother if he wants to dance with me. I don’t wanna do it alone.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.43_Text: I’m a bit tired after getting the festival ready. Those giant papier-mâché animals are very heavy!
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.61_Text: I’m cold. I think I want some hot cocoa.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.52_Text: I’m getting lots of inspiration for my new song!
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.106_Text: I’m going to play with my friends. Can you find me when we have to go, {ParentLabel}?
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.107_Text: I’m going to play with my friends. Can you find me when we have to go, {ParentLabel}?
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.69_Text: I’m here to keep my niece company.//She said she wanted to look for worms with me.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.21_Text: I’m not cooking today. Just enjoying the day with my beautiful wife here…//<portrait=annoyed>Uh, where is she?
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.27_Text: I’m only here to see <NPCName>Jack</> compete.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.96_Text: I’m planning to grab one of these local pumpkins to take back to the city.//The quality here just seems top-notch, way better than a typical souvenir.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.46_Text: I’ve never seen anything like this before! Things are different back in the city.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.80_Text: Let's not stay out too late tonight, love. It's quite a walk back home, and I wouldn't want you catching a cold tomorrow.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.37_Text: Making these lanterns with <NPCName>Alice</> really brought back some good memories.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.2_Text: Maybe later. I’ve been going back and forth a lot.//People notice, you know.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.67_Text: My brothers and I helped Mom bake the mooncakes last night.//It was fun. I got to put durian inside one of them.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.18_Text: My favorite neighbor is here.//What have you been up to?
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.12_Text: No worries, <NPCName>Rafael</>. It’s fun once you get the hang of it!
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.75_Text: Oh no... I think I ate too many mooncakes.//Babe, I might need to head out early later on. But you should definitely stay and have a good time!
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.85_Text: Oh, I know! We should enter the pumpkin smash together!//<portrait=blushing>We're married now. We're practically one person.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.68_Text: Oh, don’t worry. I already gave it to <NPCName>Noah</>.//Ha ha! You should’ve seen his face.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.1_Text: Should I get more mooncakes, you think?
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.8_Text: So, listen up. Tickets for the festival. You’d need a separate ticket to enter the contest. What do you say?//<portrait=happy>I think it’s a brilliant idea, if I say so myself.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.63_Text: Sometimes I get carried away tweaking the blend of coffee beans for special events like these, and when I try to replicate it, I have no idea how…
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.64_Text: That is what we call pain, my friend.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.38_Text: The crops competition, though—sometimes it gets a little bit…intense for some folks.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.48_Text: The mooncakes, the ambience… Everything is always great this time of year.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.40_Text: The pumpkin smash is so much fun. You should give it a try!
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.59_Text: The temple right there, the one in the middle of this lake—it’s full of mystery.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.25_Text: The trees are happy today… So am I.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.77_Text: The trees are happy today…so am I.//But how's my sweetie here? Are you happy?
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.99_Text: The weather's great tonight. I'm so happy we decided to come, darling.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.111_Text: There’s something so enchanting about this lake in the Fall, don’t you think, darling?//It never loses its charm.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.101_Text: These mooncakes are free.//<portrait=sad>Should we donate somewhere, babe? I feel a bit odd taking free stuff.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.66_Text: Today is a cheat day though. At least that's what I'm telling myself.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.88_Text: Ugh, I don't like <NPCName>Bobby</>. You tell me if he causes any problems for you, babe. I'll talk to him.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.14_Text: Usually, I don’t go to these festivals. But since <NPCName>Emma</> insisted…
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.95_Text: Walking back alone after the Harvest Festival at night feels so safe here.//It's kinda nice.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.71_Text: We baked mooncakes with Mom last night, and guess what? I snuck durian into one of them.//<portrait=happy>Oh, don’t worry, babe, I already gave that one to <NPCName>Noah</>.//Ha ha! You should've seen his face. Wish you were there to see it!
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.70_Text: We used to have a swimming contest here at the lake.//But the community voted to move it to the beach.
DT_DialogMooncakeFestival.9_Text: You agree with me on that one, eh, old sport?

DT_DialogNewYearFeast.75_Text: *Brrr* I think I'm going to catch a cold tomorrow. I can feel it.//Don't get too close to me, babe.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.42_Text: <NPCName>BEN</> HAS A VERY INTERESTING WAY OF SEEING THINGS.//<portrait=happy>THESE YOUNG PEOPLE THESE DAYS ARE TRULY SOMETHING!
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.71_Text: <NPCName>Bree</> hired me to take official photos of today's party.//It's just a side gig; we can use the extra cash for something like a new shed.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.27_Text: <NPCName>Bree</> hired me to take official pics of today’s party.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.19_Text: <NPCName>Dinda</> won’t be happy seeing me getting another piece of cake. Heh heh.//<portrait=happy>AIN’T THAT RIGHT, HON?
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.22_Text: <NPCName>Randy’s</> prosthetic arm looks really interesting…//I might have an idea or two about how he can use it more efficiently.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.25_Text: <NPCName>Theo</> and I used to play the balloon game too, like kids.//<portrait=annoyed>We always kicked the balloon way too hard, and it popped.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.40_Text: <NPCName>Zarah’s</> stories are really fun. She should hang out at the inn sometime.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.3_Text: <PlayerName>$honorifics $player</>, is there a trick to this game? It’s kinda hard.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.47_Text: <PlayerName>$player</>, have you tried the cake?//<portrait=happy>It’s so good. I’ll grab another piece!
