DT_DialogNewYearFeast.35_Text: <PlayerName>$player</>, you wanna light some sparklers too?
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.90_Text: Another year draws to a close...
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.68_Text: Another year with you has been perfect, and I'm ready to start another one.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.59_Text: As the clock ticks down, it's time to bid farewell to the old year and embrace the new.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.62_Text: Babe!!! Babe!!! You know, we humans basically invented time to make sense of it, but time doesn't really exist if you think about it. It's just our way of measuring aging and change.//<portrait=annoyed>By the way, what do they put in those punches? They're sooo good!
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.81_Text: Babe, let me ask you something. Why would...hic...if there were different beings living underwater...hic...would it be...would it be...
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.76_Text: Babe, stay close. I need you nearby for our New Year's kiss.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.73_Text: Bree is so generous with her parties. Just look at the decorations, babe.//<portrait=happy>How much do you think she's spending on them? I'm gonna talk to Erika. She might know something.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.80_Text: By the way, babe, I'll need to visit the inn next week. New Year's is always a busy time there.//<portrait=happy>But for tonight, I'm here to have a great time with you.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.31_Text: Can you believe another year's gone by? Feels like we were just welcoming this one.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.88_Text: Can you believe it's almost New Year's already? <Italic>Man</>, this year just flew by!
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.97_Text: Can't wait to share a midnight kiss with you.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.16_Text: Crazy how the year goes so fast, eh, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.74_Text: Darling, stay close. I need you nearby for our New Year's kiss.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.87_Text: Do you know what time the winter fair ends? I want to make sure I see everything.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.54_Text: Evening, <PlayerName>$player</>. You like pie?//I prefer the wine, personally.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.51_Text: Everything here is so elegant. The wine, the atmosphere…
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.9_Text: Everything in moderation, right, <PlayerName>$player</>? Too much pie will do you no good.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.18_Text: From here, everything looks so bright down there.//<portrait=happy>It’s kind of relaxing.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.96_Text: Go and socialize, darling. I'll be right here.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.86_Text: Going to give the trivia game a shot. Wish me luck!
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.57_Text: Happy New Year everyone! Let's ring in the year with joy and laughter!
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.95_Text: Hmm, I can't feel my nose...
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.44_Text: Hmm, are you good at this balloon game, <PlayerName>$honorifics $player</>?//It’s a bit hard to keep the balloon in the air…
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.24_Text: Hmm? Oh, <PlayerName>$player</>. Here for the scenery?
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.67_Text: How are you doing over there, sweetie?
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.12_Text: I always adore New Year’s Eve dinner parties. We’re ending the year with a bang!
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.83_Text: I can't wait to kiss you at midnight.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.37_Text: I didn't want to come initially.//<portrait=happy>But seeing everyone enjoying, it's not as overwhelming as I thought. Kinda nice, actually.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.63_Text: I enjoy going to events like these with you. It's so much better than going alone, let me tell you.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.49_Text: I get to stay up late tonight.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.99_Text: I get to stay up tonight. Yay!
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.14_Text: I hope I’m wearing enough layers tonight.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.94_Text: I just tried a little from that huge jar of juice, and it's delicious.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.4_Text: I left my crystals out to charge before I came here.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.60_Text: I might have an early start tomorrow, but I couldn't miss this.//Just one more toast before I call it a night, eh?
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.93_Text: I see people playing with fire over there. Isn't it hazardous?//That's always been the caution in human world safety lessons.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.64_Text: I still get the shivers around here. I'm pretty convinced that the observatory is haunted.//You can't convince me otherwise, babe.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.17_Text: I think the wine today made everything go faster too! Heh heh.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.13_Text: I used to come here a lot for the dinner parties, but for some reason, the invites stopped coming.//<portrait=normal>I don't know what's going on, but it's water under the bridge. Great party, by the way.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.79_Text: I was thinking of showing you this keg stand trick I know, babe. Let me find a keg, just stay right here!
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.78_Text: I'm loving the decor here. I'm gonna take some inspiration for our farm.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.26_Text: I'm so glad you made it to the party.//Please help yourself.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.84_Text: I'm thinking of making this punch at home, babe. Do you like it?
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.61_Text: Is it too early for a New Year's kiss?
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.53_Text: Is it too early to say Happy New Year?
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.70_Text: It's nice to come back here sometimes.//<portrait=happy>You know, love, the house is empty, and my room is too.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.77_Text: It's nice to see <NPCName>Pablo</>. I'm having a great time here, babe.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.52_Text: It's pretty cold. Good thing I'm all wrapped up.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.15_Text: It’s only getting started, and I can feel the chill in my bones.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.20_Text: It’s really fun to talk about all sort of things with <NPCName>Surya</>.//He’s really passionate about his field.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.11_Text: I’m glad to see <NPCName>Aaliyah</> today!//<portrait=normal>She’s usually away for training.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.69_Text: Let's grab something to eat, babe. I'm hungry.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.34_Text: Let's make some noise! It's almost time for the countdown!
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.58_Text: Look at all the beautiful lights and decorations. <NpcName>Bree</>'s outdone herself this year.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.50_Text: Looks like everyone's partying tonight.//<portrait=normal>Guess I'll join the fun; can't really focus anyway.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.21_Text: Maybe I can help with his research sometime later.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.39_Text: Oh gosh, <NpcName>Antonio</>'s hogging all the amuse-bouche. Somebody stop him!//<portrait=sad>He's going to finish them all, and I want some!
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.29_Text: Oh, <PlayerName>$player</>! Good to see you. We’re working with <NPCName>Bree</> at today’s New Year’s party.//The raffle will start soon.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.5_Text: Oh, it’s good to see you all dressed up.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.98_Text: Oops, had a bit too much punch – you might have to carry me home, babe.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.85_Text: Ready for another year with me, sweetie?
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.30_Text: So, ready for your midnight kiss?
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.65_Text: Sweetie, could you please ask <NPCName>Bree</> for the pie recipe?//<portrait=concerned>I really like it, but I feel a bit weird asking myself. Can you do it for me, please?
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.10_Text: That being said, this is my fourth piece of pie today…//<portrait=normal>Oh, well. Do as I say, not as I do!
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.72_Text: The hot spring is empty. We should go there instead, babe.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.55_Text: These lights are blinding. But I guess it adds to the 'festive charm', eh?
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.2_Text: These pies are great! <NPCName>Bree</> really went all out this year.//<portrait=normal>I hope she’ll have them next year.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.38_Text: They do serve the best wine here. Let's call a spade a spade.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.92_Text: This food's amazing! Bet it could even give <NPCName>Olan</>'s feasts a run for his money.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.32_Text: This game is so much fun!
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.46_Text: This is what I live for! The energy, the crowd, the music!
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.28_Text: To be honest, I would’ve done it for free. So nice of her!
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.56_Text: Today’s atmosphere is so festive. Perfect for some wine drinking.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.66_Text: Ugh, this scarf is a bit itchy, babe.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.33_Text: We need to be careful, though. <NPCName>Lily</> says somebody once kicked the balloon so hard it popped!
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.45_Text: Welcome to our New Year’s party, <PlayerName>$player</>.//Enjoy yourself!
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.7_Text: Welcome to the party!//<portrait=happy>I like your hair. Did you do it yourself?//<portrait=normal>Ah yes, I could tell it's homemade.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.48_Text: Well, this punch isn't half bad. I've had worse.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.89_Text: Whoa, what's in this punch? It's awesome!
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.23_Text: Wine, fireworks… It’s a perfect ending to the year.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.91_Text: Wishing you an early Happy New Year, <PlayerName>$Player</>, just in case we don't meet tomorrow.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.36_Text: You know what’s better than this cake?//<portrait=happy>Collaboration! <NPCName>Ling</> just told me about some interesting projects.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.1_Text: You know, we basically invented time to make sense of it.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.82_Text: You look beautiful tonight, darling. This song is for you.
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.6_Text: You remind me of a young Blythe Moss…
DT_DialogNewYearFeast.41_Text: You too, <PlayerName>$player</>. How about making it a New Year’s resolution?//<portrait=happy>Hang out at the inn and maybe spend some nights too.

DT_DialogPetFestival.17_Text: <NPCName>Archie’s</> having so much fun.//<portrait=happy>That kid’s good with animals.
DT_DialogPetFestival.16_Text: <NPCName>Kenny</> is such a good animal whisperer. He has a gift.
DT_DialogPetFestival.56_Text: <NpcName>Betty</> was saying how far back Peanut and Butter have been with her family. We need to get more pets, babe!
DT_DialogPetFestival.29_Text: <NpcName>Betty</> was telling me how long Peanut and Butter have been with her family.
DT_DialogPetFestival.24_Text: <NpcName>Pablo</> here bet I wouldn’t last three minutes on the mechanical bull. What do you think, <PlayerName>$Player</>?
DT_DialogPetFestival.65_Text: <NpcName>Pablo</> here was betting that I wouldn't last 3 minutes on the mechanical rodeo. What do you think, baby?
DT_DialogPetFestival.38_Text: A lot of the animals here are from our ranch.//<portrait=happy>It wasn't easy getting them here, but look at how happy they are!
DT_DialogPetFestival.5_Text: Ah, there’s our farmer-slash-rancher. Good to see you, good to see you.
DT_DialogPetFestival.69_Text: Babe, let's team up for the rodeo. We've got what it takes to beat <NPCName>Chaem</>!
DT_DialogPetFestival.52_Text: Babe, look! Peanut looks so fluffy! I wish I was <NpcName>Erika</> today...//<portrait=normal>I wonder how often you need to bathe a cat...not often, I don't think.
DT_DialogPetFestival.36_Text: Baby, baby. You have to stop moving so much! Look at your Uncle <NpcName>Luke</> over there.
DT_DialogPetFestival.87_Text: Can I run home for a sec, {ParentLabel}? I left my ball.
DT_DialogPetFestival.85_Text: Can we bring those cows back, {ParentLabel}? Please, please?
DT_DialogPetFestival.35_Text: Did I lock my door this morning?
DT_DialogPetFestival.75_Text: Did we lock our door this morning?
DT_DialogPetFestival.27_Text: Did you see our dance, <PlayerName>$honorifics $player</>?//<portrait=happy>My dad taught it to me!
DT_DialogPetFestival.79_Text: Do you have animals here joining the festival? I wish I could bring my Boo, but she doesn't travel well.//Oh, Boo is my dog. She's at home with her grandma now.
DT_DialogPetFestival.26_Text: Family portrait drama. Heh! It’s gonna be a long day.
DT_DialogPetFestival.55_Text: Festivals are always fun, but this one is special because you're here with me. I used to come to these alone.//<portrait=happy>Oh! Our four-legged friends are here too.
DT_DialogPetFestival.28_Text: Festivals are always fun, but this one’s special. We have lots of special guests.//<portrait=happy>Our four-legged friends are here too.
DT_DialogPetFestival.20_Text: Great. Seeing everybody with their pets makes me want one.
DT_DialogPetFestival.74_Text: Hey there, babe! Just give me a moment, got to wrap this up first.
DT_DialogPetFestival.43_Text: Hey, what’s up, <PlayerName>$Player</>?//<portrait=happy>The coffee shop’s closed today. This is a day for playing with animals.
DT_DialogPetFestival.42_Text: I can’t believe it’s already the middle of Summer.
DT_DialogPetFestival.51_Text: I knew I shouldn't go in too hard on that rodeo today...//<portrait=sad><NPCName>Chaem</> always succeed in egging me on these days! It's annoying, babe!
DT_DialogPetFestival.67_Text: I like animals.//<portrait=blushing> They're cute... yeah.//Oh! Should I follow you around, babe, or just stay here? What, um...what do you think?
DT_DialogPetFestival.31_Text: I might do the mechanical bull later. Not now, though. I just had some snacks.
DT_DialogPetFestival.114_Text: I might stop by the inn on my way home to grab something from my room—please don’t lock the door tonight.
DT_DialogPetFestival.19_Text: I might take my picture with Bonbon later.//After <NpcName>Frank</> and <NpcName>Erika</> are done with theirs.
DT_DialogPetFestival.76_Text: I never miss the Animal Festival in the Summer. It's the highlight of my year.
DT_DialogPetFestival.1_Text: I see you’re ready for the festival today, <PlayerName>$player</>!//<portrait=normal>Enjoy it, and don’t forget to introduce the little one to the others.
DT_DialogPetFestival.4_Text: I wanna take one of the animals home. Could you teach me how to brush it properly, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_DialogPetFestival.91_Text: I'll be the best bull rider in Coral Island! Watch me, {ParentLabel}!
DT_DialogPetFestival.62_Text: I'm glad we decided to come.
DT_DialogPetFestival.54_Text: I'm gonna head over there to watch the contest soon. Wanna come with me, babe?//I'm just gonna stretch for a bit.
DT_DialogPetFestival.53_Text: I'm loving the good vibes here, now that you're here, baby. It's all about love.
DT_DialogPetFestival.83_Text: If you smell something unpleasant, it's not me, love. It's the cows.
DT_DialogPetFestival.73_Text: It's adorable watching you run around here. You're just so cute.//How can you be this cute!
DT_DialogPetFestival.6_Text: It’s a perfect way for animals and their human companions to bond.//<portrait=happy>Don’t you think so, dear?
DT_DialogPetFestival.45_Text: I’ll head over there to watch the contest soon.//<portrait=determined>I’m just gonna stretch for a bit.
DT_DialogPetFestival.44_Text: I’m glad I decided to come.
DT_DialogPetFestival.25_Text: I’m on duty today. In case somebody gets hurt on the mechanical bull or something.//<portrait=concerned>It happened, trust me.
DT_DialogPetFestival.66_Text: Just putting it out there, <NPCName>Surya</>... if you're up for timing the mechanical rodeo, I'm your guy. Ha ha!//My baby here can vouch for me. If I lose, I'll take it in stride.
DT_DialogPetFestival.32_Text: Just saying, <NpcName>Noah</>. If you want someone to time you on the mechanical bull, I’m right here. Ha ha ha!
DT_DialogPetFestival.71_Text: Let's take our picture later on.//We can do it after <NPCName>Frank</> and <NPCName>Erika</> finish taking theirs.
DT_DialogPetFestival.82_Text: Look at Poseidon! He looks so happy!
DT_DialogPetFestival.80_Text: Maharaja Putput would have loved this. Nagalita wouldn't have...she's a bit moody in crowded places.
DT_DialogPetFestival.21_Text: Maybe once I have my own place!//With a big yard for them to run around in.
DT_DialogPetFestival.63_Text: My magnificent canary is here!//Oh how I love working with animals, and people seemed to love it too!
DT_DialogPetFestival.10_Text: Not as often as you bathe dogs, that’s for sure.
DT_DialogPetFestival.81_Text: Oh babe! Can we try the mechanical bull later? Pretty please?!
DT_DialogPetFestival.70_Text: Oh, babe, you're here! I might do the rodeo later...not now though.//<portrait=happy>I just had some snacks.
DT_DialogPetFestival.13_Text: Oof! My back! I think I might’ve pulled a muscle setting up those giant piñatas over there.//Oh, I’m going to feel it tomorrow!
DT_DialogPetFestival.9_Text: Peanut is so fluffy! I wonder how often you need to bathe a cat. Not often, I don’t think.
DT_DialogPetFestival.15_Text: Say hi to <PlayerName>$player</>, Funbucket!//I’m loving the good vibe here. Love all around.
DT_DialogPetFestival.23_Text: Taco is sooooo much fun! We used to play this game all the time at the inn before he moved to the vineyard.
DT_DialogPetFestival.7_Text: The atmosphere today is fantastic!//<portrait=normal>Everybody loves and respects their pets. What an amazing day!
DT_DialogPetFestival.68_Text: The coffee shop is closed for the day. I thought I could spend it with you.
DT_DialogPetFestival.77_Text: The cows are so adorable. They're so round and cute and <Italic>round</>!
DT_DialogPetFestival.93_Text: The cows are stealing hearts today!
DT_DialogPetFestival.92_Text: The cows are the highlight of the festival for me!
DT_DialogPetFestival.46_Text: The town always goes above and beyond for festivals. It’s amazing.//<portrait=normal>I missed it when I was away.
DT_DialogPetFestival.78_Text: There’s something special about the Animal Festival. It brings out the child in all of us, don’t you think?
DT_DialogPetFestival.39_Text: This festival is a learning experience for the children, <Italic>and</> a recreational one.//<portrait=normal>I’m glad they all could make it today.
DT_DialogPetFestival.59_Text: This is nice. Don't go too far from me, babe.
DT_DialogPetFestival.11_Text: This is nice. Maybe the town will have an event for bonsai in the future.//Something like a design contest, maybe?
DT_DialogPetFestival.47_Text: This is the best spot for watching the competition.//The key is getting here early and staying until it starts.
DT_DialogPetFestival.2_Text: Too bad you can’t participate today, <PlayerName>$player</>.//<portrait=happy>But don’t worry. Watching the action from the sidelines is exciting too!
DT_DialogPetFestival.33_Text: WHAT ARE WE WAITING FOR? THE STAGE IS READY!
DT_DialogPetFestival.41_Text: We brought Taco. He’s playing with <NpcName>Dinda</>'s boy, little <NpcName>Archie</>.
DT_DialogPetFestival.37_Text: We meet again, <PlayerName>$Player</>. How’s the farm?
DT_DialogPetFestival.58_Text: We should take a photo together soon, babe. Does my hair look alright?
DT_DialogPetFestival.3_Text: Welcome, you magnificent canary!//Oh, how I love working with animals.
DT_DialogPetFestival.12_Text: We’ve been here since dawn, helping to get the animals and the decorations ready.
DT_DialogPetFestival.40_Text: What a day to be outside!
DT_DialogPetFestival.34_Text: Where’s your chicken, <PlayerName>$Player</>?//<portrait=annoyed>You are a rancher, I believe.
DT_DialogPetFestival.14_Text: Would you like to join our singing, friend?//These birds are experts!
DT_DialogPetFestival.72_Text: Would you like to join us singing, babe?//<portrait=normal>These birds are the expert- oh wait, they're gone.
DT_DialogPetFestival.30_Text: Yeah! There you go!//Hold it…//Butter! Butter, look here!
DT_DialogPetFestival.60_Text: Yeah! There you go!//Hold the pose for a bit...//Butter...Butter look here!
DT_DialogPetFestival.104_Text: [<NpcName>Bode</>’s tongue lolls out as he pants, clearly having the best day of his life.]
DT_DialogPetFestival.105_Text: [<NpcName>Copper</> nudges your hand with its head, demanding pets on its terms.]
DT_DialogPetFestival.103_Text: [<NpcName>Fizz</> nuzzles your hand, and you feel your stress melt away.]
DT_DialogPetFestival.94_Text: [<NpcName>Geddy</> bounds toward you, tail wagging so hard it’s practically a propeller.]
DT_DialogPetFestival.111_Text: [<NpcName>Kimba</> stretches out lazily, completely unbothered by the festival chaos.]
DT_DialogPetFestival.113_Text: [<NpcName>Kitkat</> purrs softly, curling up on a blanket at the pet nap zone.]
DT_DialogPetFestival.96_Text: [<NpcName>Luna</> flicks its tail and gives you a long, unimpressed stare. You feel judged.]
DT_DialogPetFestival.107_Text: [<NpcName>Mister Fluff</> flicks its tail at you, letting you know you're allowed exactly two seconds of attention.]
DT_DialogPetFestival.57_Text: [Kenny is playing the flute passionately. Maybe you shouldn't bother him.]
DT_DialogPetFestival.98_Text: [You can tell <NpcName>Inari</> is having the time of its life. Its tail wagging is practically a festival on its own.]
DT_DialogPetFestival.109_Text: [You crouch down to say hello to <NpcName>Spike Bonkers</>, who immediately licks your face. That’s love right there.]
DT_DialogPetFestival.97_Text: [You hear a soft purr as <NpcName>Bast</> brushes against your leg. It’s the ultimate honor.]
DT_DialogPetFestival.95_Text: [You scratch behind the <NpcName>Malcolm</>'s ears, and <NpcName>Malcolm</> leans into it.]
DT_DialogPetFestival.50_Text: [You tell Bonbon he’s doing a great job dancing.]//[He’s happy.]
DT_DialogPetFestival.99_Text: [You’ve never seen such a magical creature before. <NpcName>Hippeastrum</> looks like it stepped out of a dream.]
DT_DialogPetFestival.108_Text: [“Aren’t you the fluffiest little thing in the world?” you coo to <NpcName>Omar</>.]
DT_DialogPetFestival.112_Text: [“Hey <NpcName>Gary Kun</>, it’s good to see you again,” you say warmly.]
DT_DialogPetFestival.110_Text: [“Hi, <NpcName>Cody</>. Did you find the best sunny spot in the whole festival?” you ask, admiring its choice of a warm patch.]
DT_DialogPetFestival.106_Text: [“Who’s a good kitty?” you say to <NpcName>Frankie</>.]
DT_DialogPetFestival.100_Text: [“Who’s a good lizard?” you say to <NpcName>Lindi</>.]
DT_DialogPetFestival.102_Text: [“You’re such a good boy!” you say to <NpcName>Spiker Doo</>, and its tail wags even harder.]
DT_DialogPetFestival.88_Text: {SpouseLabel} said I can pet Funbucket, but not too hard. I said okay.
DT_DialogPetFestival.89_Text: {SpouseLabel} said I'm too little to ride the bull.

DT_DialogSpookyFestival.74_Text: <Italic>Oh!</> My favorite tropical fish! I'm so excited now that you're here!!!
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.2_Text: <Italic>Oh!</> My favorite tropical fish!//<portrait=normal>Have you checked out the haunted house yet?
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.17_Text: <NPCName>Emma</>'s really good at things like this.//I guess she must be in order to keep a food truck running until midnight.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.24_Text: <NPCName>Paul</> is just unflappable, especially when it comes to spooky things.//<portrait=concerned>When we went through the haunted house earlier, instead of screaming, he was commenting on the props!
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.41_Text: <NpcName>Dinda</> and I made a lot of the props. You can tell we used the best quality wood.//<portrait=happy>The town’s been using the same props for years, and nothing’s broken! No poor quality materials for us!
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.51_Text: <NpcName>Frank</> dressed up as himself. He’s so <Italic>boring</>.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.62_Text: <NpcName>Frank</> dressed up as himself. He’s so <Italic>boring</>.//<portrait=happy>Next year, let's lend him our scarecrow. He might just pull off a farmer look with it.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.58_Text: <NpcName>Luke’s</> whole family is here, even Taco.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.11_Text: Are you brave, <PlayerName>$honorifics $player</>?//Did <Italic>your</> mom say you’re brave?
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.42_Text: Attaching that massive skull to the arch couldn’t have been easy. <NpcName>Pablo</> did great.//<portrait=normal>That skull is very heavy. I made it.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.69_Text: Babe, could you give me a hand taking it off later?//It's pretty snug...a little hard to move in this costume, but sometimes fashion requires sacrifice.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.83_Text: Babe, do you mind if we take <NPCName>Lily</> to the haunted house later? She asked, and I kinda said yes.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.76_Text: Babe, stay away from the back. I'm pretty sure I saw something moving, but when I approached it, bam! It was gone.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.106_Text: Can we go to the haunted house next?
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.107_Text: Can we go to the haunted house next?
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.86_Text: Do you like my costume, babe?
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.20_Text: Don’t tell him this, but Dad’s not good with scary things.//<portrait=happy>That’s why he hated the haunted house!
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.84_Text: Enjoy yourself, babe. I'll be right here if you need me.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.49_Text: Have you heard the tale of the little boy who steals at night?//<portrait=annoyed><NpcName>Alice</> told me about it. I personally haven’t lost anything, but she said the little ghost boy likes freshly harvested crops. They remind him of his farmer family.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.94_Text: Have you played any of the games around here?
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.55_Text: Heads up – avoid <NpcName>Sam</>. I was talking to him earlier, and he can’t seem to stop complaining about the town code.//I think he’s had it with Mr. Mayor.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.79_Text: Hey babe, there you are! We should take a picture together. Hang on, let me go find <NPCName>Macy</>...
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.80_Text: Hey there, gorgeous, here's the thing...you look good, I look good. What do you say we kick back and have some fun?//<portrait=happy>Ha ha ha, just teasing, babe.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.30_Text: Hey, <PlayerName>$player</>, you look nice.//Enjoying the festival so far?
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.3_Text: I THINK I SAW A GHOST OVER THERE!
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.16_Text: I can’t help but worry that somebody might get too scared at this festival.//<portrait=sad>What if somebody’s heart can’t handle the scary surprises?
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.43_Text: I don’t usually look like this. Um…//<portrait=normal>It’s a festival, so I thought maybe I could dress up a little. Bad idea?
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.40_Text: I dressed up as <NpcName>Frank</>, the bartender. What do you think?
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.54_Text: I got this costume back in San Franciskyo. Full price.//<portrait=sad>It went on sale three weeks later.//<portrait=normal>But it’s worth it. Look at the quality of the fabric.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.1_Text: I hope you enjoy the Spooky Festival, <PlayerName>$Player</>. Plenty to do here.//<portrait=normal>Take a look around, will you?
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.81_Text: I know I've worn this blueberry costume multiple times, but it means a lot to me.//<portrait=normal>It's like a bonding time with <NPCName>Alice</>.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.87_Text: I love your costume. What are you supposed to be?//Bringing mine took up half my suitcase, but totally worth it – got plenty of cute pics.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.21_Text: I overheard <NpcName> Sunny</> mentioning something about a ghost. Do you think it could be real?//<portrait=thinking>I haven't seen anything myself, but I did feel a sudden cold breeze near my neck earlier. Have you noticed anything strange?
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.63_Text: I really enjoy the spooky festival. It’s like our special bonding time with <NpcName>Suki</>.//<portrait=happy>We never miss our tradition of dressing up as Blueberries in Pajamas.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.67_Text: I rushed through getting ready today. I hope my makeup looks alright.//What do you think, babe?
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.92_Text: I shall speak to the mayor to express my appreciation for this year's Spooky Event.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.85_Text: I should wear this to work tomorrow. What do you think, babe?
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.99_Text: I think I'll stay here. Go ahead and enjoy yourself, baby.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.73_Text: I thought I'd dress up a bit for you...yeah?
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.78_Text: I thought maybe I could dress up a little for you...um, yeah.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.14_Text: I wanna play the bonk skeleton game next.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.95_Text: I was expecting it to be much colder outside, but to my delight, it's not as cold as I thought.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.75_Text: I'm absolutely loving this. Everybody looks amazing, but nothing compares to how good you look.//<portrait=happy>So, are you single? Can I get your number?
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.88_Text: I'm planning to call it an early night tonight – got a big hiking adventure lined up for tomorrow.  Gotta start early, you know.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.48_Text: If this event goes on till late, I don’t think I’ll be brave enough to walk home alone.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.6_Text: It’s a little hard to move in this costume, but sometimes fashion requires sacrifice.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.15_Text: It’s fun to get all dressed up sometimes.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.56_Text: It’s like I’m not even in Starlet Town anymore. The whole place is spooky.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.18_Text: It’s neat seeing everybody’s costumes with different ideas of what a ghost looks like.//<portrait=normal>The <Italic>real</> thing is a lot more boring.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.57_Text: I’m <Italic>so</> loving this. Everybody looks amazing.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.66_Text: I’m not here for work. I’m here to have fun with you. Yay!
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.31_Text: I’m not here for work.//<portrait=happy>I’m here to have fun. Yay!
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.91_Text: Just look at the crowd of commoners!
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.104_Text: Look at all the spooky decorations, {ParentLabel}!
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.105_Text: Look at all the spooky decorations, {ParentLabel}!
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.96_Text: My feet are killing me. I need to sit down.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.53_Text: My niece made me dress up like this.//<portrait=angry>Don’t get any ideas.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.34_Text: Now they’re having an event to get spooked.//Odd thing to spend money on.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.27_Text: Oh! What are you supposed to be?
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.98_Text: Oh, I'm so glad you're finally here. You look amazing, baby.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.90_Text: Oh, and I'm definitely hitting up the skeleton bonk game again. Last time, a kid totally outplayed me!
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.93_Text: Oh, you...well, yes, that outfit suits you nicely.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.60_Text: Party yesterday was fun, oh yes, it was.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.4_Text: People say the festival is supposed to be scary, but I see smiles everywhere.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.64_Text: Positive energy’s everywhere today, babe. Absorb it.//This is where we're supposed to be right now. I can feel it in my gut.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.47_Text: Positive energy’s everywhere today.//This is where I’m supposed to be right now. I can feel it in my gut.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.50_Text: Some of the ghosts in the haunted house scare me for real.//<portrait=concerned>And I don’t get scared easily.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.89_Text: Spent forever getting ready today, but it's worth it for the Spooky Festival – such a blast. I think I blend in pretty well with the locals, don't you?
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.44_Text: Thank you. That’s what I was going for.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.102_Text: The Spooky Festival is finally here!
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.103_Text: The Spooky Festival is finally here!
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.10_Text: The haunted house was so scary, but I did it!//<portrait=happy>Mom said I was brave.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.38_Text: The last time <NpcName>Suki</> and I dressed up as a pair was freshman year in university.//<portrait=normal>We went as Blueberries in Pajamas. She went as B1, of course.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.39_Text: The mayor has a problem with my scarecrow decorations, yet he’s all smiles about the millions of pumpkins scattered all over town.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.25_Text: The things they made for this festival are so interesting!//I’m curious about how much work it was to get that haunted house up and running.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.32_Text: The town looks good.//<portrait=happy>The Sanchezes have done great job decorating.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.35_Text: The town sure is dressing up today.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.68_Text: The town sure is dressing up today. I like it.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.61_Text: This chilly weather's just right for some warm indoor yoga. Y'all got any sessions like that around here?
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.9_Text: This event takes me back to my youth.//This time of year was always busy for us models.//Work invitations flying around everywhere.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.19_Text: This festival could be about something more profound, like honoring our late loved ones.//<portrait=concerned>Now all we have are people going into a silly empty house.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.82_Text: This is actually quite fun, dressing up. Maybe I'll keep my costume on tonight.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.100_Text: This is the best day ever!
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.101_Text: This is the best day ever!
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.77_Text: Thought I’d dress up a little today, spice things up.//<portrait=blushing>Do you like it?
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.36_Text: Thought I’d dress up a little today, spice things up.//<portrait=blushing>I can’t come as a blacksmith, can I? That’d be sooooo boring.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.12_Text: Today is super fun! Mom and Auntie dressed up too!
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.8_Text: Too bad I can’t dress Stephen up.//I had this idea. He’d be Watson, and I’d be Sherlock!//<portrait=concerned>It wasn’t in the budget this year. Oh well.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.22_Text: Tossing rings can be a bit of a workout.//Especially when you’re trying for a high score.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.70_Text: Ugh! My hands are feeling exhausted from all those ring toss games.//<portrait=normal>Babe, could you...uh, give me a massage later?
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.52_Text: Up for a bonk skeleton game, <PlayerName>$Player</>?
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.65_Text: Want to try the bonk skeleton game with me, babe? Come on! I'll let you win. He he he!
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.5_Text: We used to make our own costumes.//With four kids, we had no other choice, dear.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.7_Text: What are you wearing? Good gosh!
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.97_Text: What should we do first, darling?
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.33_Text: Where did the town get this many pumpkins? Did you supply them?
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.26_Text: Whoa! You look good.//<portrait=happy>What about me? Do I look good?
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.23_Text: Why am I the only one sweating, though? It <Italic>is</> tiring, right?
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.59_Text: Winter settling in, goom...is a great time for serene snowy hikes.
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.37_Text: Wouldn’t it be funny if one of these “ghosts” turned out to be the real deal?//<portrait=happy>Well, not funny. You know what I mean, right?
DT_DialogSpookyFestival.71_Text: You look stunning, my love. As always.

DT_DialogTreePlanting.111_Text: <NpcName>Frank</>’s got the right idea! A little dancing makes the day even better.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.50_Text: <NPCName>Emily</> and I brought the same kind of tree seeds today.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.40_Text: <NPCName>Lily</> looks like she’s dying, even though I’m the one with the shovel.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.74_Text: <NPCName>Lily</> looks like she’s dying, even though I’m the one with the shovel.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.45_Text: <NPCName>Randy</> here has an interesting proposition.//It gets my retired investor’s blood going again.//<portrait=happy>Isn’t that right, <NPCName>Randy</>?
DT_DialogTreePlanting.117_Text: <NpcName>Eva</> said it’d be cool to have a picnic once a week, and honestly, that would be great!//<portrait=concerned>But I’m not sure who would want to cater.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.182_Text: <NpcName>Eva</> said it’d be cool to have a picnic once a week, babe, and honestly, I think she’s onto something.//<portrait=happy>I told her we’d host if she handles the cooking!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.140_Text: <NpcName>Wakuu</>, I can’t give away my muffin recipe! You’re one of my best customers!//<portrait=happy>Ha ha! I’d go out of business!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.14_Text: <PlayerName>$honorifics $player</>, are you planting trees today?//I like this place better than the beach.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.1_Text: <PlayerName>$player</>, I hope you brought your A game today!//<portrait=normal>Let’s rock and roll!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.8_Text: ACHOOO!//Ahem, sorry for that, <PlayerName>$player</>. I just need to…
DT_DialogTreePlanting.15_Text: Ah, back again!//I packed some green tea for later. Did you bring anything?
DT_DialogTreePlanting.163_Text: Ah, this takes me back to the picnics we had when I was a kid.//Mama would take us to the beach, we'd watch the sunset, and eat ramen—sand and all, ha ha ha!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.56_Text: All good vibes today, baby. It’s what I’m all about.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.52_Text: All good vibes today. It’s what I’m all about.//<portrait=annoyed>Except for <NPCName>Jim</>. He’s not good vibes.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.69_Text: Are you comfortable? Can I, uh...get you a drink, maybe?
DT_DialogTreePlanting.178_Text: Are you enjoying yourself, my love?//Can I get you some drink?
DT_DialogTreePlanting.165_Text: Babe, have you tried the berry tart over there,?//It’s so good, I’m tempted to grab another one for the boat ride.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.30_Text: Being on that boat brought back a lot of memories. About Dad.//The way the boat sways in the water, the wind… Ahh…//<portrait=happy>I like it.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.41_Text: Being up here makes me miss being in the ocean…//<portrait=annoyed>Oops…umm…
DT_DialogTreePlanting.90_Text: Can we ride the frog boat again later?
DT_DialogTreePlanting.145_Text: Can we run around the trees?
DT_DialogTreePlanting.146_Text: Can we run around the trees?
DT_DialogTreePlanting.138_Text: Come join us, <PlayerName>$Player</>. We’re just having a chat.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.166_Text: Come on, baby, let’s hit the dance floor! Time to burn off some of that lunch!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.89_Text: Do we get to take a frog boat ride back home?
DT_DialogTreePlanting.129_Text: Do you like my new song?
DT_DialogTreePlanting.87_Text: Do you think my tree will grow really tall?
DT_DialogTreePlanting.91_Text: Do you think our tree will grow big and strong?
DT_DialogTreePlanting.44_Text: Do you wanna go down there with me?//I’ll walk with you.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.78_Text: Does anyone else get a super itchy nose here in Spring? I swear, every time I step outside, I'm sneezing. Is the pollen count high today?
DT_DialogTreePlanting.63_Text: Don't overdo it, love. Just do what's comfortable for you and make sure to rest in the shade.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.173_Text: Everyone looks so relaxed and happy today, don’t they, darling? It’s contagious!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.109_Text: Everyone looks so relaxed and happy!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.21_Text: FARMER, YOU’RE GOOD-LOOKING, LET ME SAY… BUT YOU’RE BLOCKING THE EPIC VIEW BEHIND YOU.//<portrait=normal>LOOK AT THAT…
DT_DialogTreePlanting.37_Text: Give me a second… I just need to catch my breath…//It’s just so tiring trekking up here…
DT_DialogTreePlanting.2_Text: Glad to see you here, golden moth!//<portrait=normal>Such a good turnout today.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.183_Text: Good thing I put on some extra sunscreen—I had a feeling the sun would be blazing today.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.104_Text: Hey, <PlayerName>$honorifics $player</>, what are you doing here?
DT_DialogTreePlanting.174_Text: Hey, don’t skip the sunscreen, babe. The sun’s not messing around today.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.58_Text: How about we plan a picnic here sometime soon?
DT_DialogTreePlanting.35_Text: How are you doing this fine afternoon?
DT_DialogTreePlanting.80_Text: I always look forward to the tree planting event. It gives me the perfect excuse to get active again after spending Winter lounging on the couch.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.135_Text: I brought my smoked fish... it’s over there on the other table.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.25_Text: I brought some cookies to snack on, but <NPCName>Alice</> and I ate them on the boat… And we haven’t even started planting yet.//<portrait=sad>What are we gonna do now?
DT_DialogTreePlanting.184_Text: I came prepared with extra sunscreen—can’t say I didn’t see this sunny day coming!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.42_Text: I can feel it. Nature is slowly healing, thanks to everyone’s efforts.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.153_Text: I can run so fast! Wanna see?
DT_DialogTreePlanting.154_Text: I can run so fast! Wanna see?
DT_DialogTreePlanting.4_Text: I can’t wait to roll up my sleeves and get to work planting some trees!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.115_Text: I could eat this all day, it’s just so delicious!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.186_Text: I could get used to this, babe. Fresh air, good company, and all this free food—we don't have to cook today!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.101_Text: I could get used to this. Fresh air, free food!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.136_Text: I could’ve sworn it was going to rain today. Thank goodness it didn’t!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.179_Text: I didn’t think I’d need my hat, but wow, this sun is intense!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.67_Text: I feel sick, babe. I don’t know if I can plant any trees.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.162_Text: I got up really early today to make sure I didn’t miss the boat ride.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.113_Text: I gotta admit, it's nice to see this place green again.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.159_Text: I guess it’s nice to be outside
DT_DialogTreePlanting.160_Text: I guess it’s nice to be outside
DT_DialogTreePlanting.24_Text: I hope we have enough water for everyone.//<portrait=happy>This is gonna be a long day of laborious work, I can tell.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.175_Text: I love seeing the kids so involved, don’t you, darling? It really adds a special touch to the day.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.97_Text: I love seeing the kids so involved.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.60_Text: I love that we're doing this together, sweetheart. Planting trees, feeling the spring air - it's like we're part of nature.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.143_Text: I love this crunchy thing! It tastes like...well, mostly like air.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.88_Text: I loved riding the frog boat!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.62_Text: I need a moment to breathe. Go ahead and socialize, babe.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.130_Text: I remember when this place was all dry, and now it’s so lush and vibrant.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.139_Text: I should’ve brought my crystals to charge them here.//<portrait=happy>Ah, well. There’s always next time!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.189_Text: I spotted some free coffee over there—want me to grab us a couple cups?
DT_DialogTreePlanting.119_Text: I think I overdid it on the coffee. I should eat something to soak up all that caffeine.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.79_Text: I think it's time to visit the doctor and get some antihistamines or something.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.23_Text: I told <NPCName>Kira</> and her boy here to relax a bit.//<portrait=concerned>We don’t want people getting nervous about monsters.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.11_Text: I wanna grow tall like a tree!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.121_Text: I was just telling <NpcName>Raj</> they have the best muffins in town!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.76_Text: I'm keeping an eye on <NPCName>Noah</>, babe. He seems super sick.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.81_Text: I've got some fresh potatoes with me, picked them up from Sam's.//Fingers crossed everyone likes them!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.47_Text: If it weren’t for our actions, we wouldn’t need to do this.//<portrait=annoyed>I’m not talking about you and me. Bah! I was referring to us humans.//<portrait=normal>We don’t know our place sometimes.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.144_Text: Is it weird if I go up to that cutie with the red hair and ask about the short? I really want to get one!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.155_Text: Is today a work day or a fun day?
DT_DialogTreePlanting.156_Text: Is today a work day or a fun day?
DT_DialogTreePlanting.141_Text: It feels safe here—no shady characters in sight.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.64_Text: It is literally the best day for tree planting!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.65_Text: It's alright out here. We could come back, just the two of us, so it's not so packed with people.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.82_Text: It's kinda wild how there aren't many mosquitoes around.//Maybe it's because it's still Spring, but we <Italic>are</> outdoors.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.77_Text: It's so lovely out here, babe! I can't wait to come back and enjoy this place with you again.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.55_Text: It's such a beautiful day to be outdoors! How about we have dinner outside tonight, babe?//<portrait=normal>Sounds good, doesn't it?
DT_DialogTreePlanting.118_Text: It’s a nice break not having to cook every now and then.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.39_Text: It’s been a long time since I dug this hard.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.51_Text: It’s healthy to get outside the town once in a while.//<portrait=normal>A change of environment is good for the soul.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.28_Text: It’s reassuring to see folks who deal with trees also making the effort to replant.//<portrait=happy>It’ll help wildlife to thrive too. You have to be conscious of the whole ecosystem.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.71_Text: It’s such a chill day for tree planting. Glad we're doing this together, babe.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.170_Text: I’d love to dance in a bit, if you’re up for it.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.17_Text: I’ll never get used to the boat ride…//I think I’m gonna be sick.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.133_Text: I’ll talk to the mayor, <NpcName>Randy</>. If we both push for it, we might get the budget for more books to flow.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.107_Text: I’m glad to see everyone out here today.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.164_Text: I’m going to enjoy the breeze here for a bit. You should go and mingle, babe.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.103_Text: I’m gonna eat so many snacks!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.191_Text: I’m gonna eat so many snacks!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.157_Text: I’m gonna go find a quiet spot, maybe read or something.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.158_Text: I’m gonna go find a quiet spot, maybe read or something.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.49_Text: I’m gonna make a pot of lodeh tonight and feast!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.128_Text: I’m halfway through this book, it's so good!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.134_Text: I’m really grateful for <NpcName>Walter</> and <NpcName>Bree</>. They’ve been such a great addition to our town since moving to Coral Island.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.116_Text: I’m thinking we need to make picnics a regular thing. Once a week wouldn’t hurt!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.168_Text: I’m thinking we should make picnics a regular thing, darling.//Once a week wouldn’t hurt, right?
DT_DialogTreePlanting.34_Text: I’ve been here many times. Not for tree planting, though.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.20_Text: I’ve spoken to everyone here. You know, on the boat ride. And I’m disappointed.//<portrait=annoyed>I’ve learned nothing new about anyone. <Italic>Nothing!</>
DT_DialogTreePlanting.171_Text: Just a few more pages, babe. Why don’t you go ahead and mingle?//I’ll join you soon.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.185_Text: Kind of wishing I brought my hat—this sun is brighter than I expected.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.19_Text: Look at us! Creating a forest in our backyard.//<portrait=normal>So proud of us! So proud of you.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.9_Text: Look! My outfit matches the theme. Green!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.190_Text: Make sure you don’t push yourself too hard, babe. It’s sweltering out here.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.137_Text: My dear, how are you feeling today?//Looks like the boat ride didn’t suit you—you look a little pale.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.122_Text: Need anything? The food’s just over there.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.7_Text: No doctoring today for me and <NpcName>Yuri</>.//We’ve got a planet to save!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.43_Text: No, <NPCName>Scott</>, feeling nature isn’t the same as feeling the <Italic>call</> of nature.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.181_Text: Now this is a great way to recharge after a morning run, don’t you think, babe? Fresh air and plenty of carbs!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.16_Text: Oh dear, the trip is getting more tiring these days…//<portrait=happy>But it’s wonderful to see the beautiful view from up here again.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.72_Text: Oh shoot, I left my bug repellent on the table at home!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.102_Text: Oh! Look! There's a giant blue bird over there!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.12_Text: Oh, <PlayerName>$honorifics $player</>, did you know bugs and worms also live in trees?
DT_DialogTreePlanting.127_Text: Oh, I should take some pictures of the food once I’m done here!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.94_Text: Oh, what a beautiful day to plant trees!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.29_Text: One simple way we can all make a difference is by planting trees.//<portrait=happy>I can feel the clean air coming already!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.167_Text: Perfect day for a picnic, huh, darling?//<portrait=surprised>But, uh, you might want to keep your distance—I’m about to—achoo!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.100_Text: Perfect day for a picnic, huh?//<portrait=concerned>Ah-choo! If only these allergies would let me enjoy it!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.5_Text: Planting trees is good for the environment.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.131_Text: Scottie here was sayin’ how rocks can go for hundreds of coins...rocks, can ya believe that?
DT_DialogTreePlanting.68_Text: Stay clear of <NPCName>Noah</>, babe. Looks like he's about to be sick.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.75_Text: Take it easy, my love. Do as much as you feel you can and don't forget to relax under the shade.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.86_Text: That frog boat ride was so cool, {ParentLabel}!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.84_Text: The boat ride to get here was so relaxing.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.177_Text: The farm’s been wonderful, Ma.//<portrait=happy><PlayerName>$Player</> and I are really enjoying the peaceful mornings. You should visit us sometime, okay?
DT_DialogTreePlanting.172_Text: The food here is delightful, but I think I could tweak that salad recipe a bit. What do you say, love?//Think they’d let me give it a try?
DT_DialogTreePlanting.93_Text: The frog boat was my favorite part!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.110_Text: The only thing better than food at a picnic is dancing after. Keeps the energy up!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.70_Text: The soil here isn’t fit for coffee beans.//It's a shame, babe, because we could have planted so much. It would have been ideal for our next farm.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.53_Text: The soil here isn’t fit for coffee beans.//Yeah, they’ll grow okay, but if excellence is what you’re after, uh-uh! You won’t get it.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.126_Text: The view here is unbeatable. I’m really proud of the progress we’ve made.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.176_Text: The way the sunlight filters through the trees here...it’s like a painting, don’t you think, my love?//I wish I had my sketchbook.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.95_Text: There’s something so serene about being here, darling.//Planting trees and watching the earth flourish—it’s just lovely, don’t you think?
DT_DialogTreePlanting.106_Text: There’s something special about sitting together on the ground and sharing a meal.//Feels like family.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.180_Text: They weren’t kidding when they said the mayor was serious about good coffee. He paid well for our setup today.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.187_Text: They’re offering free coffee, babe. Should I go get us some?
DT_DialogTreePlanting.46_Text: Think about it for a second, <NPCName>Walter</>.//<portrait=happy>Funding a fully automated tree planter shouldn’t be out of your reach!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.33_Text: This area gets a lot of rain. It’s good because a nice, stable water supply is what we need for reforestation.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.99_Text: This is a nice break from the workshop.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.188_Text: This is such a blast! Thanks for taking me here, darling.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.92_Text: This is the best festival ever, {ParentLabel}!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.54_Text: This place is great, you can't beat the view.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.85_Text: This place is so beautiful in Spring.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.61_Text: This place up here is so isolated.//<portrait=happy>A lot like our farm.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.36_Text: This place up here is so isolated.//<portrait=happy>A lot like your farm.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.161_Text: This spot has the best view—you can see everything from here!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.120_Text: This tofu dish is amazing! Have you tried it yet?
DT_DialogTreePlanting.48_Text: This’ll be my workout for the week.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.59_Text: Try not to wear yourself out, dear.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.151_Text: Ugh, why do we have to stay so long? Can’t we leave after we eat?
DT_DialogTreePlanting.152_Text: Ugh, why do we have to stay so long? Can’t we leave after we eat?
DT_DialogTreePlanting.27_Text: We make our carpentry as sustainable as we can.//<portrait=happy>That’s why I’m always here for these planting festivals. Giving back to Mother Nature, right?
DT_DialogTreePlanting.3_Text: We won’t see progress right away, but hopefully, in time, we’ll be able to see the difference we’re making.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.114_Text: Well, that sure looks tasty! Lemme scoot on over and grab me some of that too
DT_DialogTreePlanting.31_Text: We’re here to make sure everything goes smoothly…//<portrait=angry>And to plant trees, yeah. Sure.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.18_Text: What a day to be outside!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.142_Text: What kind of food is this? It doesn’t really have any flavor.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.26_Text: What type of trees do you think would be best for planting here?//<portrait=concerned>Do you think oak trees are all right?
DT_DialogTreePlanting.22_Text: Why are we still chitchatting? Plant your trees.//<portrait=normal>Keep your sword close by.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.10_Text: Woo-hoo! Everything looks so close with this!//I can even see a pebble at the bottom!
DT_DialogTreePlanting.169_Text: You can practically hear the birds celebrating, my darlin'!//It’s like they’re part of the picnic too.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.73_Text: You doing okay there, babe? Want me to grab you a drink?
DT_DialogTreePlanting.108_Text: You know, Ma, I think I'll skip breakfast next time...before coming here.
DT_DialogTreePlanting.132_Text: You sold some pricey rocks, didn’t you, <PlayerName>$Player</>?//Go ahead and tell <NpcName>Kenny</> here—he thinks I’m joking!

DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.13_Text: <NPCName>Chaem</> is fun to play volleyball with. She’s really good.//Learning a lot of tricks and stuff from her.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.120_Text: <NPCName>Eddy</> is never going home for good.//Don't get me wrong, I'm happy for him. I just miss him sometimes.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.123_Text: <NPCName>Frank</> is so much like my dad, it hurts sometimes.//<portrait=happy>The other day he cracked a joke and it was like my old man was speaking through him from the other side. It was <Italic>something</>.//<portrait=normal>It’s funny how kids turn into their parents, huh?
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.4_Text: <NPCName>Frank</> will be manning the grill, and my brother is more or less the grill master of Coral Island, so…
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.151_Text: <NpcName>Eddy</>'s been a tech geek since he was a kid, always fiddling with electronics and computers.//<portrait=happy>So, it's not surprising that he's crushing it in coding now.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.166_Text: <NpcName>Erika</>'s my go-to girl for hair. Seriously, every dime I drop on her is totally worth it.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.85_Text: <PlayerName>$player</>, want to watch some TV with me?//<portrait=normal>I don’t even know what I’m watching. I wasn’t paying attention.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.148_Text: Always clean the house from top to bottom in Spring, <PlayerName>$Player</>.//<portrait=happy>It's a way to get rid of any bad luck from the previous year and make room for good fortune.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.8_Text: Are you going to <NPCName>Bree’s</> for the New Year’s feast? It’s going to be a good time!
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.144_Text: At every New Year's at Ama's house, we used to throw down and make dumplings as a family. And let me tell you, Ama had skills!//She was good at it. Ama knew how to whip up the best dumplings around.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.57_Text: At the rate it’s been snowing, I’ll be out shoveling every day starting tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.58_Text: At the rate it’s been snowing, I’ll be out shoveling every day starting tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.59_Text: At the rate it’s been snowing, I’ll be out shoveling every day starting tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.60_Text: At the rate it’s been snowing, I’ll be out shoveling every day starting tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.125_Text: Being an astronaut is a dangerous job. I know there are risks.//It’s the same with flying jets – there’s always a chance you won’t come home.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.35_Text: Being outdoors on a warm Spring day like this is my favorite.//Get that vitamin D, move your body… When your mind is clear, your day will be too.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.139_Text: Being up there among the stars was like nothing I've ever experienced before.//It felt like I was part of something bigger than myself.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.32_Text: Besides, she told me she needed a partner to train with.//<portrait=normal>I mean, if I can be of help, why not, right?
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.75_Text: Blech! Sorry! Don’t worry about it.//<portrait=normal>You can bring whatever you want.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.80_Text: Bring on the snow! Winter’s here, so let’s get on with it. *laughs*
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.129_Text: But I’ll be honest, sometimes I have to pinch myself and ask, “Is this real? Is this really my life?”
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.126_Text: But I’m not going to let fear keep me from following my dream.//<portrait=concerned>If you live your whole life playing it safe, and never do the things you most wanted to do… Well, did you really live, then?
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.128_Text: But now that I’m in the astronaut program and my dream’s finally within reach… I can’t slack off now.//<portrait=normal>I have to keep working for it.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.108_Text: Can’t wait to actually live on a spaceship up there and see Earth from above.//<portrait=happy>The view will be unbelievable!
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.54_Text: Could’ve been worse, I guess… It could’ve been a dead rat or worse…
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.5_Text: Did you enjoy the Cherry Blossom Festival? I ate so much I could hardly walk home!
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.76_Text: Do you grow strawberries on your farm? If you don’t, you should!//They’re so good when they’re fresh. My absolute favorite fruit.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.65_Text: Do you grow trees on your farm? I heard they don’t die.//Food for thought.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.26_Text: Do you have more layers at home you can wear?//<portrait=normal>Winter is next week, and it seems like it might be a cold one this year.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.61_Text: Do you think you might enter the crop display contest at the Harvest Festival?//<portrait=surprised>You should! You might win something!
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.67_Text: Don’t always believe everything you hear around here.//One time I heard a rumor from my own little brother about a ghost playing the piano in the community center. Yada yada yada.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.51_Text: Don’t let the heat get you, <PlayerName>$Player</>!//Power through!
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.89_Text: Eggplant lasagna is far superior to generic lasagna.//The texture is out of this world!
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.155_Text: Eggplant lasagna is where it's at. It's so dang good, hearty and healthy at the same time.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.33_Text: Every several weeks or so, <NPCName>Eddy</> does his disappearing act where he doesn’t answer mail and makes Mama all worried.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.162_Text: Everyone and their moms are trying to hit the beach and catch some sun.//<portrait=happy>It's way more crowded than Spring, but it's all good. More people, more fun.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.171_Text: Everything's just so quiet and serene.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.164_Text: Fall is my favorite season, hands down.//<portrait=normal>The colors, the crisp air, it's all just so cozy and inviting.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.43_Text: Gah! I got sand in my mouth!
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.82_Text: Gah! People here can get all over your business, right? Everyone keeps talking about poor <NpcName>Charles</> this, poor <NpcName>Charles</> that.//<portrait=concerned>Leave the man alone, people!
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.48_Text: Going on a walk?//I’m gonna have to wash my hair tonight… The smell of the ocean is strong today.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.38_Text: Going on a walk?//I’m here to train. Gotta keep fit to be an astronaut…and smart.//<portrait=concerned>Oof, a lot of things to keep up with! But I’ll be okay.//<portrait=angry>I will be A-OK… Yep!
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.124_Text: Gosh! Am I turning into my mom?!
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.118_Text: Gotta say, it isn’t a walk in the park, but my siblings prepared me for it just fine.//<portrait=happy>I don’t think I’m doing so bad.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.94_Text: Have you heard of this show? I think it’s called Game of Cones? <NPCName>Noah’s</> always going on about it.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.134_Text: Hey you, cutie snowball.//<portrait=surprised>Oh no! I didn't mean to say that you <Italic>look</> like a snowball.//<portrait=sad>It was meant to be a compliment...and it's Winter...ugh.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.83_Text: Hey, <PlayerName>$player</>. Did you stop in for a drink?
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.79_Text: Hmm. I get it, I do. You have to go where you need to be, know what I’m saying?//But I hope you’ll stick around for a while. We’re just getting to know each other.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.105_Text: Hmm… Maybe not here, on Coral Island.//I visited an island some Summers ago – the heat reminds me of that trip. Anyway, some of the villagers there get very excited over the price of turnips.//<portrait=happy>It was oddly wholesome to see.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.169_Text: Honestly, I can't even remember the last time I had a proper sleep-in.//My body just wakes up on autopilot.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.110_Text: Hopefully with the rain this heavy, the sky clears up tomorrow night. It would be nice to stargaze if you ask me.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.112_Text: Hopefully with the rain this heavy, the sky clears up tomorrow night. It would be nice to stargaze if you ask me.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.114_Text: Hopefully with the rain this heavy, the sky clears up tomorrow night. It would be nice to stargaze if you ask me.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.116_Text: Hopefully with the rain this heavy, the sky clears up tomorrow night. It would be nice to stargaze if you ask me.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.109_Text: Hopefully, with the rain this heavy, the sky will be clear by tomorrow night. It would be nice to stargaze, if you ask me.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.111_Text: Hopefully, with the rain this heavy, the sky will be clear by tomorrow night. It would be nice to stargaze, if you ask me.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.113_Text: Hopefully, with the rain this heavy, the sky will be clear by tomorrow night. It would be nice to stargaze, if you ask me.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.115_Text: Hopefully, with the rain this heavy, the sky will be clear by tomorrow night. It would be nice to stargaze, if you ask me.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.153_Text: Hummus is my go-to snack. I could eat that stuff all day, every day.//Dip some carrots or pita chips in there, and it's a total game-changer.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.141_Text: I always dreamed of being an astronaut, and now that I've been to space, I feel like I've accomplished everything I've ever wanted to.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.161_Text: I can finally wear my shorts and tanks and let my skin breathe.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.30_Text: I can’t imagine going to the hot spring in this heat.//But I heard from my friend <NPCName>Chaem</> that the hunter dude goes there in Summer.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.6_Text: I don’t mind the cold weather and stuff, but nothing, and I mean, <Italic>nothing</> beats eating outdoors.//But it’s much better in Spring than in the middle of an ice-cold Winter afternoon, of course.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.152_Text: I feel like my dad is still with me every time I take off in a plane.//<portrait=happy>It's a comforting feeling, like he's watching over me.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.136_Text: I got plenty of this pants in my closet.//I got them when I joined the military. They're free for grabs.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.172_Text: I hate having to wear so many layers.//It's like a workout just to get dressed in the morning!
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.103_Text:
I help out my brothers at the Tavern sometimes, cleaning up, closing, business advice –
things like that.//It’s what big sisters are for, right?
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.99_Text: I joined the military after university because I knew it was a path to becoming an astronaut.//<portrait=happy>Who doesn’t wanna be an astronaut?!
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.49_Text: I like getting coffee at <NPCName>Raj’s</> place.//They’re good at making coffee – my favorite!
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.72_Text: I like to eat the same things, especially for lunch.//It’s simple, you know? Eggplant lasagna or some hummus with <Italic>things</>. I just made a bunch of food and put it in the fridge.//<portrait=happy>It’s one less thing to think about in the morning.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.140_Text: I remember looking out the window and seeing the Earth below me, and it just took my breath away.//<portrait=normal>It was so beautiful.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.102_Text: I saw one of my brother’s cats on the roof the other day!//<portrait=normal>It was at <NPCName>Sam's</> General Store. Do they go to your place too?
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.41_Text: I see your work around the community, <PlayerName>$Player</>. Respect! I’d tip my hat to you if I were wearing one!//<portrait=happy>I don’t shy away from hard work either… I see we have a lot in common.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.137_Text: I should've asked for more. They're comfy and <Italic>really</> warm.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.163_Text: I sometimes hit the beach with <NpcName>Chaem</>, and we play some mean volleyball.//Gotta stay active, ya know?
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.165_Text: I think Fall might be <Italic>everyone</>'s favorite season.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.78_Special: I think I will! I like it here.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.95_Text: I tried watching it with him, but it just made me hungry.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.70_Text: I used to dream about going to the moon when I was little. Mama told us about the <NPCName>Moon Goddess </> and her rabbit.//<portrait=normal>I wanted to go there too. Ha ha! Thought it was the coolest thing.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.11_Text: I wouldn’t let Mama hear me say that, though. She seems to think I’m home for good.//It’ll be easier for everyone if we let her keep thinking that until I have to leave again.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.158_Text: I'm all about trying new things. Life's too short to not take risks and step outside your comfort zone, ya know?//<portrait=annoyed>Except for <NpcName>Frank</>'s new recipes, yeah, nope.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.135_Text: If it matters, I happen to <Italic>like</> snowball.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.84_Text: If you want to order, go to the counter. <NPCName>Frank</> will take care of you.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.45_Text: It brings back a lot of childhood memories.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.106_Text: It got pretty lonely at basic training. I missed my family.//<portrait=sad>Never leaving a place for months. That’s a long time.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.64_Text: It sure doesn’t sound like a bad idea to fly over Coral Island right now. Just when the leaves are changing color.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.168_Text: It's a constant battle to stay moisturized. Bah!//<portrait=concerned>Time to stock up on lip balm and lotion.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.90_Text: It’s a little chilly today. It’s kinda nice.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.91_Text: It’s a little chilly today. It’s kinda nice.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.92_Text: It’s a little chilly today. It’s kinda nice.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.93_Text: It’s a little chilly today. It’s kinda nice.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.63_Text: It’s never easy to lose a parent… It wasn’t easy when I was little, and it isn’t easy now.//I feel for her and her brother.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.117_Text: It’s tricky to get some space in space…Heh heh!//<portrait=normal>Jokes aside, you gotta learn to coexist with others in a confined environment while under a <Italic>lot</> of stress.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.28_Text: I’m A-OK to spend my whole Summer at the beach, playing volleyball.//But the thing is, I can’t seem to find any partners other than <NPCName>Chaem</>.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.36_Text: I’m glad to be where I am in life, but I can’t stop here, no. I wanna keep educating myself…reach for the stars, as it were.//<portrait=normal>I gotta set a good example for my little brothers.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.34_Text: I’m gonna have to snoop on social media and find out what he’s up to.//<portrait=angry>He’s got me all worried too!
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.88_Text: I’m looking forward to spending some time at the beach and soaking up the sun.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.119_Text: I’m pretty sure my brother <NPCName>Frank</> will stick around on Coral Island. He and <NPCName>Erika</> have a life here.//<NPCName>Frank</> and <NPCName>Noah</>, yeah, they're set here.//I’m not sure about <NPCName>Eddy</>, though. I got the feeling he’s itching to see the world since he was a <Italic>baby</>.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.40_Text: I’m ready to relocate my family to the city if I have to… You know, with the whole oil spill thing.//It hasn’t gotten that bad, I suppose.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.86_Text: I’m trying to unwind, but my brain’s going a mile a minute tonight.//It’s hard to stop it when my brain starts doing its <Italic>thing</>.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.154_Text: Kimchi and brussels sprouts? Bleh! No, thank you. They're like the two things I can't stand.//The smell alone is enough to make me run in the opposite direction.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.122_Text: Losing people we love is an inevitable part of getting older, huh?//It sucks, but we have to let go and keep living.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.66_Text: Mama likes to be busy… I told <NpcName>Noah</> that it’s best to just let her.//It’s good for her to have activities so she doesn’t just sit around the house.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.96_Text: Mama loves feeding the birds. She always has. When my brothers and I were kids, she taught us how to make bird feeders.//<portrait=happy>I still know how. I’ve just never done it.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.121_Text: Mama seems to be doing okay, without Dad.//For a while I was worried about her, but I’m not anymore.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.25_Text: Mama’s been baking up a storm lately. I keep telling her, “Don’t tempt me – I have to stay in shape!”//But then she waves a chocolate chip muffin under my nose, and that’s it, I’m gone.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.9_Text: My brothers and I used to build snow forts in weather like this. Our snowball wars were epic!
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.138_Text: My brothers got me this sweater when I got accepted into the military.//<portrait=happy>It's my favorite sweater.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.97_Text: My little brother and his friend, <NPCName>Alice</>, sure like talking about aliens. They have some…interesting theories.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.79_Special: Not sure yet… This might just be a pit stop.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.10_Text: Now that I’m home, I don’t get to fly as much… I miss it! I’m itching to get back in the cockpit.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.27_Text: Now that it’s Fall, Mama can’t stop baking mooncakes at home.//<portrait=happy>It’s not that I want her to, anyway. Heh heh!
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.71_Text: Oh hey, by the way… I like chatting with you.//You’re smart. You know a lot of things, that’s for sure!
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.1_Text: Oh, hello! I don’t think we’ve met.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.69_Text: One day I’ll go to visit the moon.//<portrait=happy>No, I’ll get <Italic>paid</> to visit the moon. Now, that’s cool!
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.12_Text: Or maybe it makes it worse…? I just don’t want unnecessary conflict, is all.//Not while I’m living under the same roof with her.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.142_Text: People always ask me what it's like to be in zero gravity, and it's hard to put into words.//<portrait=happy>It's like you're weightless, but at the same time, you feel like you're flying.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.3_Text: Planning to go to the Cherry Blossom Festival, <PlayerName>$player</>? You don’t want to miss it!
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.31_Text: Playing volleyball with <NPCName>Chaem</> pushes me to be a better player… I like it.//It makes me better, <Italic>and</> I get to work out.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.62_Text: Saw <NpcName>Lily</> cleaning up her mom’s grave the other day.//It must’ve been the day when–
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.173_Text: Since Dad's not in the picture anymore, my brothers and I gotta have each other's backs for Mama.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.104_Text: So tell me, <PlayerName>$Player</>, as a <Italic>vegetable grower</>. Why do people care so much about the price of turnips?
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.149_Text: Sometimes I feel like I don't fully fit in with either community, Dad's or my mom's...but then I remember that I don't have to choose.//<portrait=happy>I can be both.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.150_Text: Sometimes people look at us funny when I call my mom, Mama.//I guess I don't look <Italic>too much</> like her.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.143_Text: Sometimes, when I'm having a bad day, I just close my eyes and think back to my time in space.//It reminds me that anything is possible if you work hard enough for it.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.175_Text: Sorry, <PlayerName>$Player</>, you're kind of on the way. Gotta clean these up.//If you need to order, talk to <NpcName>Frank</> over there.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.81_Text: Spring is cool, but poor <NpcName>Char</>–//<portrait=happy>Ah! I’m just messing with you! Ha ha!
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.77_Text: Tell me, <PlayerName>$player</>, do you think you’ll stick around on Coral Island? What’s your master plan?
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.53_Text: Thankfully I’ve fixed Fishensips’ ventilation just in time for Summer. It turned out there were clumped-up leaves stuck in there.//<portrait=annoyed>Gah!
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.130_Text: Thanks for always beliving in me, <PlayerName>$Player</>.//<portrait=normal>You're my rock.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.46_Text: That volleyball thing over there…it’s been here since I was little.//But the bright-red color is new.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.133_Text: That's one of the things that I love about you.//You always smell so <Italic>yummy</>.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.44_Text: The beach is nice this time of year.//<portrait=happy>Well, the beach is nice <Italic>any</> time of year, to be honest. Especially when the weather is perfect like this.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.55_Text: The grass changes color in Summer. Did you notice that?
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.156_Text: The tavern is legit the definition of community.//<portrait=normal>We got our regulars who've been with us since forever and always new faces to meet.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.87_Text: The trickiest part about being in basic training is the confinement. You gotta be okay with being with people in a small space for a long time.//<portrait=happy>Good thing I grew up with a lot of siblings. Trained since childhood, if you ask me!
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.98_Text: The universe is big, so maybe we aren’t the only ones! But who knows?//<portrait=happy>If I see something when I’m in space, I’ll let you know. Ha ha!
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.37_Text: The weekend’s here. I’m gonna get <NPCName>Noah</> to play volleyball with me tomorrow.//<portrait=annoyed>He’s probably gonna say no again. It’s hard to get that one to do any sports.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.47_Text: The whole area, including the chair, used to be blue.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.50_Text: They once told me about how every cup is special – creating one is a work of art, things like that.//<portrait=happy>It works, though! Because the coffee at their place just tastes better than it does at home. I don’t know how to describe it.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.68_Text: To have a ghost is one thing. Now they play the piano <Italic>too</>?//<portrait=angry>Where would they even learn to do such a thing?
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.107_Text: We <Italic>did</> have a lot of things to do. The work never really stopped, so it wasn’t like we were sitting down, being bored.//<portrait=sad>But yeah. It gets to you sometimes.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.147_Text: We moved the big mirror to my room, I never take them back out.//<portrait=concerned>Too lazy, I guess. Meh.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.174_Text: What's in this cleaning spray?//<portrait=annoyed>It smells so strong. This thing can kill <Italic>everything</>.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.74_Text: Whatever you bring to the Cherry Blossom Festival, please don’t let it be brussels sprouts. Yuck!
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.146_Text: When Dad passed away, we covered all the mirrors in the house.//Good thing we don't have that many mirrors.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.127_Text: When I joined the military, becoming an astronaut wasn’t a sure thing.//For that matter, becoming a pilot wasn’t even a sure thing! I had to work my butt off to get where I am today.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.14_Text: When I was in basic training, they made us camp out for three days in weather like this.//A test of endurance and your ability to stay cooped up in a small space with a bunch of people.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.15_Text: When I was in basic training, they made us camp out for three days in weather like this.//A test of endurance and your ability to stay cooped up in a small space with a bunch of people.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.16_Text: When I was in basic training, they made us camp out for three days in weather like this.//A test of endurance and your ability to stay cooped up in a small space with a bunch of people.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.17_Text: When I was in basic training, they made us camp out for three days in weather like this.//A test of endurance and your ability to stay cooped up in a small space with a bunch of people.
