DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.18_Text: When I was in basic training, they made us camp out for three days in weather like this.//A test of endurance and your ability to stay cooped up in a small space with a bunch of people.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.19_Text: When I was in basic training, they made us camp out for three days in weather like this.//A test of endurance and your ability to stay cooped up in a small space with a bunch of people.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.170_Text: When it comes to coffee, I'm a bit of a snob. I can't stand anything that tastes burnt or watery.//<portrait=concerned>I'm no expert, but I can definitely tell when the coffee's bad.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.52_Text: Whoa! The farmer is here!//<portrait=normal>You look like you’re ready for Summer. Good for you.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.56_Text: Winter is nice here. I like the snow in the trees.//<portrait=annoyed>Only in trees! When there’s snow on the path – that’s different.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.160_Text: With Spring in full swing, I can finally ditch the bulky Winter coat and bust out my collection of freebies tees.//<portrait=normal>No more bundling up in layers.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.157_Text: Working at the tavern has taught me some real-life skills. Like how to hustle and handle all sorts of characters.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.29_Text: Yeah, <NPCName>Paul</> is there sometimes and stuff. Just not often enough, you know?
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.78_Text: Yeah, I hear you. My career took me away from Coral Island for a bit, but this place is always home.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.100_Text: You can cook nice hot meals if you have a kitchen.//<portrait=happy>Now that it’s Winter, you might want to have hot dinners. Thaw out your frozen insides. Ha ha!
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.20_Text: You know what I’m craving right now, <PlayerName>$player</>? A nice hot cup of coffee…//I’m gonna go and get some.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.21_Text: You know what I’m craving right now, <PlayerName>$player</>? A nice, hot cup of coffee…//I’m gonna go and get some.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.22_Text: You know what I’m craving right now, <PlayerName>$player</>? A nice, hot cup of coffee…//I’m gonna go and get some.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.23_Text: You know what I’m craving right now, <PlayerName>$player</>? A nice, hot cup of coffee…//I’m gonna go and get some.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.24_Text: You know, I’m glad to be back on Coral Island, but it’s not quite the same without my dad and my little brother here.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.101_Text: You wanna have a snowball fight?//<portrait=normal>C’mon! It’ll be fun.
DT_Dialogue_Aaliyah_Production.42_Text: You’re one reliable farmer, <PlayerName>$Player</>.//I like that trait in a person.

DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.AF6602EA4FFB687CA2B4ADB363D7F152: ...//Is there something you needed from me?
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.172_Text: <Italic>Like</>, sometimes I don’t tell her important things… I hate this feeling and having to tiptoe around.//<portrait=concerned>I wish I could just tell her everything.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.102_Text: <NPCName>Dinda</> and <NPCName>Joko</> are very talented. They made some of our cabinets.//I wonder how long it took them to get so good at carpentry.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.BC49D8FC40A8E751CC2E8984978BF0EE: <NPCName>Dinda</> and <NPCName>Joko</> are very talented. They made some of our cabinets.//I wonder how long it took them to get so good at carpentry.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.140_Text: <NPCName>Karen</> used to have a room at the inn before she rented that space over there.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.E9707FC94B65060AEC12F4AECEEE9CEA: <NPCName>Karen</> used to have a room at the inn before she rented that space over there.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.103_Text: <NPCName>Noah</> wanted to open a booth at the Harvest Festival with the information we gathered on flying saucers.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.51285F05411406A1810DA4BB216E39D2: <NPCName>Noah</> wanted to open a booth with the information we gathered on flying saucers.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.19CB524C47DD7F8F3968C7A03D55A0D4: <NPCName>Rafael</>? Yeah, he might be at the inn today.//He does visit us on Sunday when he can.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.51_Text: <NPCName>Rafael</>? Yeah, he might be at the inn today.//He does visit us on Sunday when he can.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.5C1E80CA4047F3373F46C498E1C9E289: <NPCName>Suki</> and I divide our workload.//I get the weekday shift, and she covers the weekend.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.8E6C5FE447DA7FE726C11BA0724936FD: <NPCName>Suki</> and I divide our workload.//I get the weekday shift, and she covers the weekend.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.11_Text: <NPCName>Suki</> and I split our responsibilities. I take the weekdays, and she takes the weekends.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.129_Text: <NPCName>Suki</>’s too active for a desk job.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.F7F7BE964C42DEA644E7969F2A35E827: <NPCName>Suki</>’s too active for a desk job.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.207_Text: <NpcName>Anne</> asked me about where <NpcName>Suki</> got <NpcName>Valentina</>'s dresses and stuff.//I wasn't sure, but I think it was <NpcName>Antonio</> who shopped for her.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.208_Text: <NpcName>Antonio</> gets great discount, being the owner of boutiques and all.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.209_Text: <NpcName>Antonio</> lives at the inn part time. It makes it easier for him to see <NpcName>Valentina</>.//<portrait=happy>His <Italic>empanada</>. Ha ha! So cute.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.210_Text: <NpcName>Suki</> looks great with purple hair. It makes me wanna try coloring my hair too.//<portrait=annoyed>No...it's too much of a commitment. What if I didn't like it?
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.202_Text: <NpcName>Suki</>'s divorce was hard on her, but I'm glad she's doing better now.//I hope running the inn gives her a sense of purpose and independence.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.206_Text: <NpcName>Suki</>'s short is so cute! I'm gonna see if I could borrow them.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.212_Text: <NpcName>Valentina</> is a natural at art. <NpcName>Nina</> taught her how to paint.//<portrait=happy>I can't paint to save my life and so is <NpcName>Suki</>.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.201_Text: <NpcName>Valentina</> is such a sweet girl. I love spending time with her.//She reminds me of <NpcName>Suki</> when she was younger.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.74EB4EB6498955A1D8C6E68C86821586: Ah, she doesn’t mind anyway. Besides, it’s not like I use it every day… Maybe three times a year, tops!
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.45_Text: Ah, she doesn’t mind anyway. Besides, it’s not like I use it every day…//<portrait=surprised>Maybe three times a year, tops!
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.8FD25B48457FFD7940BC3E8C139BEB8B: Ah, she doesn’t mind anyway. Besides, it’s not like I use it every day…//<portrait=surprised>Maybe three times a year, tops!
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.396276E04FC22382F1CD0CA01E007254: Ah, the beach looks so clean. But I hope we don’t forget there’s still so much trash in the sea and the river.//We still need to change our lifestyle to stop this from happening.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.94_Text: Ah, the beach looks so clean. But I hope we don’t forget there’s still so much trash in the sea and the river.//We still need to change our lifestyle to stop this from happening.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.58_Text: Ah… I kinda miss the snow already.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.D75A328C45B35FCA8AFB5EAE96E6CB91: Ah… I kinda miss the snow already.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.174_Text: And let’s face it… Some of the things that I said were… Borderline mean.//A bit harsh, sometimes.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.CABA567641BFFDC3B42FEE824C80CD20: Another good hobby is having meaningful discussions. Pick each other’s brains and share views…//You learn a lot of new things that way.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.145_Text: Are you heading to the cavern?
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.FA62BA35403B18E64BFA96A498794285: Are you heading to the cavern?
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.60_Text: Are you planning on planting pineapples this Summer?
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.A08970D449EED3C8A07BA6BAC7ADA383: Are you planning on planting pineapples this Summer?
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.0F16BE4544379CC2B252C98966B791D3: As soon as <NPCName>Suki</> was back in town, our parents decided to retire early. They didn’t think the inn had enough work for four people.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.10E234CF41EFF79E9EB84CAF10FF6D87: As soon as <NPCName>Suki</> was back in town, our parents decided to retire early. They didn’t think the inn had enough work for four people.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.47_Text: As soon as <NPCName>Suki</> was back in town, our parents decided to retire early.//They didn’t think the inn had enough work for four people.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.190_Text: Aww… Come and see me if you get lonely, okay? I’ll keep you company.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.41F8411445746423E3246192C1EF803D: Being alone isn't always bad.//Personal space is rarely a thing when you grow up with someone <Italic>sparkly</> like <NPCName>Suki</>.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.6_Text: Being alone isn't always bad.//Personal space is rarely a thing when you grow up with someone <Italic>sparkly</> like <NPCName>Suki</>.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.54FF2A2A457D43AA0EC8E99E6B588C83: Brrrr. It’s starting to get cold. I’ll have to do my reading inside soon.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.80_Text: Brrrr. It’s starting to get cold. I’ll have to do my reading inside soon.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.4_Text: Can I assist you with something?
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.8425797D4F03F5A1543BA5B97D47AA77: Can you imagine what life is like on Mars? I would love to go there and see it for myself.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.DC5DF23F4138F3F80EB8F4BBF0C6D078: Can you imagine what life is like on Mars? I would love to go there and see it for myself.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.33_Text: Can you imagine what life is like on Mars? I would love to go there and see it for myself.//<portrait=concerned>It sounds a bit scary, though. Getting shot up to space.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.156_Text: Can you smell the salt? Hmmm…
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.D2540DD9496B142453C8E9A6824D2C3B: Can you smell the salt? Hmmm…
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.185_Text: Come and see me again tomorrow? We’ll talk about something fun.//Like giant meteorites.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.148_Text: Could be nothing, but who knows…//<portrait=normal>I might see something one of these days and decide for myself.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.BA65F4F64D3DAB7B2A6F6E89BAD9C66D: Could be nothing, but who knows…//<portrait=normal>I might see something one of these days and decide for myself.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.142_Text: Did you hear about the light phenomenon over on Turtle Island?
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.2CE6A8A64B10D1FAC1CF57969CFA3168: Did you hear about the light phenomenon over on Turtle Island?
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.138_Text: Did you just have your morning walk too? I like how quiet it is in the morning.//Right before everyone wakes up. It’s just you and the birds.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.3102FBE04FF2E7D4B286AF952E3DB895: Did you just have your morning walk too? I like how quiet it is in the morning.//Right before everyone wakes up. It’s just you and the birds.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.69_Text: Do you know what Summer is good for? Spending time outside, eating tons of minced jackfruit pies, going to the beach – all that good stuff.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.D63A4E97444CBFBC8FDB8D986360F2C4: Do you know what Summer is good for? Spending time outside, eating tons of minced jackfruit pies, going to the beach – all that good stuff.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.128_Text: Don’t even try to tell <NPCName>Suki</> to sit still and work the desk for too long.//She won’t be able to do it.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.2D741C534F7EA11D599D66B15F3AEE73: Don’t even try to tell <NPCName>Suki</> to sit still and work the desk for too long.//She won’t be able to do it.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.4A09765848F235BE61A65AB0491D08DD: Easily the best thing about Summer is the abundance of jackfruit. I can make as many minced jackfruit pies as I want!
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.71_Text: Easily the best thing about Summer is the abundance of jackfruit. I can make as many minced jackfruit pies as I want!
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.191_Text: Errr… Be honest with me, have you ever seen anything…weird on your farm?
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.95_Text: Everyone did such a great job yesterday.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.D47EE5484D0DFFE29EAA47B1B2095390: Everyone did such a great job yesterday.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.79_Text: Fall is so pretty, isn’t it? Now, if only it were a bit warmer…
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.DFCA9B3548A92AFCDA52E8B3A6E90CD6: Fall is so pretty, isn’t it? Now, if only it were a bit warmer…
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.144_Text: Fancy meeting you here!//<portrait=happy>I only ever see <NPCName>Ben</> and sometimes a monkey or two.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.9B8C56BE4E9E747903F2A889BD37CFD5: Fancy meeting you here!//<portrait=happy>I only ever see <NPCName>Ben</> and sometimes a monkey or two.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.197_Text: Find anything interesting to read, <PlayerName>$player</>? There’s plenty here.//<portrait=concerned>I wish I could just take it all over to the inn.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.72D642C0469EB666D98F22B7C52A6934: Ha ha! It IS Monday. Too early to tell, huh?
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.39C1F93F421F4FA1F1970DAB317544A9: He sure is dedicated. <NPCName>Rafael</> visits <NPCName>Valentina</> on weekends and makes sure she’s all right.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.52_Text: He sure is dedicated. <NPCName>Rafael</> visits <NPCName>Valentina</> on weekends and makes sure she’s all right.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.18_Text: Here's a pro tip from a lifelong beach resident. Sometimes, you can stumble upon really rare seashells.//<portrait=happy>I’m talking rare as in expensive!
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.19_Text: Here's a pro tip from a lifelong beach resident. Sometimes, you can stumble upon really rare seashells.//<portrait=happy>I’m talking rare as in expensive!
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.30_Text: Here's a thought for community improvement. Maybe the library could stock up on books about extraterrestrial life.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.9AFCEAE34B4B3F1A44D473A5C90E5600: Here’s a way to improve the community. The library should get more books about extraterrestrial life.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.F10454E246DC942B601E669ADF474F9A: Here’s a way to improve the community. The library should get more books about extraterrestrial life.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.FCC883B94779B29EAF23D8884B4B84B9: Here’s a way to improve the community. The library should get more books about extraterrestrial life.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.146_Text: Hmm… I think I’ll walk through town on my way home.//<portrait=normal>I have to make a quick stop at the library.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.B86A8F38491D0CFA8FBCAEBF981F64EC: Hmm… I think I’ll walk through town on my way home.//<portrait=normal>I have to make a quick stop at the library.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.25_Text: How’s your week been so far?
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.8444E0EB4CC69392417B4EACEFAB438D: How’s your week been so far?
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.ADF54F624A934B400352339995CE3E32: I <Italic>did</> take some questionable courses in university.//<portrait=normal>But actually, those classes were the most fun. Looking back, that should have been my major.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.17_Text: I also like to have meaningful discussions. Pick each other’s brains and share views…//You learn a lot of new things that way.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.21E92C9B4D8F25BB5B51F3BEF3E80C21: I asked my parents <Italic>and</> <NPCName>Suki</> if we could just close the inn for Winter, but they shot me down. Many times.//<portrait=annoyed>You think a broken air conditioner is a problem, wait until you deal with a guest complaining about the heater.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.85_Text: I asked my parents <Italic>and</> <NPCName>Suki</> if we could just close the inn for Winter, but they shot me down. Many times.//<portrait=annoyed>You think a broken air conditioner is a problem, wait until you deal with a guest complaining about the heater.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.43_Text: I could be wrong… But I’m keeping my mind open.//<portrait=happy>Let’s see where it gets me.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.B7ACAAE5483758D184F611AC2A0F3A42: I could be wrong… But I’m keeping my mind open.//<portrait=happy>Let’s see where it gets me.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.08D7595B47BDD8B954E425A6E90D7FA6: I couldn’t get to sleep until 1 am. I might have had too much caffeine yesterday.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.107_Text: I couldn’t get to sleep until 1 am. I might have had too much caffeine yesterday.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.28_Text: I didn't <Italic>like</> wine-making, but I did enjoy the class. Does that make sense?//Yeah, I'm confused too.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.141_Text: I didn’t know then that she was going to install drills around the island…//She was always very secretive. Never really looked like a tourist, either.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.EEFCE4E34ED046172B449389309311E8: I didn’t know then that she was going to install drills around the island…//She was always very secretive. Never really looked like a tourist, either.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.143_Text: I do like to read about odd phenomena all over the world.//<portrait=surprised>It fascinates me.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.BEF454194CC55303CBE5DA9FC62598A0: I do like to read about odd phenomena all over the world.//<portrait=surprised>It fascinates me.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.1880E4584A5979BD241EAABC2A6BE995: I don't think I'm ready for marriage just yet. Let's get to know each other better, okay?
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.164_Text: I don’t know how to say this, but…errr… Pizza is disgusting.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.192_Text: I don’t know. Maybe…a large masked figure?//Why? What did you see?
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.44_Text: I don’t see why I should buy my own camera.//<portrait=normal>I don't want to spend money on a camera when I can just borrow <NPCName>Macy</>’s.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.837C02544EE423D056ABFCBE20B15CB4: I don’t see why I should buy my own camera.//I don't want to spend money on a camera when I can just borrow <NPCName>Macy</>’s.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.AF87EFFB4F9E64D860D8DCAC7C51CA08: I don’t see why I should buy my own camera.//I don't want to spend money on a camera when I can just borrow <NPCName>Macy</>’s.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.1A9BCFE54E82CC5053090CA0330DA55A: I don’t think we’re alone in the universe…//I’ve read some interesting theories.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.25E7C65B4181BFCD7A99338351AFF937: I don’t think we’re alone in the universe…//I’ve read some interesting theories.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.66_Text: I don’t usually love the color pink, but I make an exception for cherry blossoms.//<portrait=happy>They’re just so beautiful.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.C8DDA13E44140D6C32ED19A71C8089DE: I don’t usually love the color pink, but I make an exception for cherry blossoms.//<portrait=happy>They’re just so beautiful.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.173_Text: I don’t want to hide things from you, <PlayerName>$player</>… And I won’t.//You’ve never judged me, and I appreciate that.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.171_Text: I feel bad, but sometimes I don’t even wanna tell my sis things.//I just know that I won’t like her reaction.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.158_Text: I feel like I’m talking too much… I am, aren’t I? I’m really not usually like this.//I think I’m just comfortable talking to you.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.32_Text: I find it hard to believe we're the only life in the universe... There are some intriguing theories out there.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.216_Text: I get major bloated after eating pizza. I can't.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.183_Text: I had a dream about you last night… I was tempted to write you a letter about it, but I…I don’t know.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.106_Text: I had my green tea too late today.//<portrait=sad>I don’t think I’ll be able to sleep tonight…
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.78E95798449DEFB4C4782886F2CC3B5C: I had my green tea too late today.//<portrait=sad>I don’t think I’ll be able to sleep tonight…
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.218_Text: I have to admit that when <NpcName>Suki</> was pregnant, I thought she was gonna have twins.//<portrait=surprised>Can you imagine two <NpcName>Valentina</>s? Double the <Italic>sass</>.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.100_Text: I have to start working on a new marketing plan for Winter…
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.D2DFD2454DB9F131FD70C2BF7BE05C87: I have to start working on a new marketing plan for Winter…
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.139_Text: I have to work today. I’m going straight to the inn after this.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.F6007C5C41327234872D879EB7D68CF7: I have to work today. I’m going straight to the inn after this.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.179_Text: I have to wrap up work for the week and make sure everything’s ready for <NPCName>Suki</> tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.217_Text: I heard corn can grow really <Italic>really</> tall.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.116_Text: I hope it doesn’t turn into a storm like last time! We can’t afford to install a new heating system every Winter.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.4CEA92714BC5DE58C74CE589CF834517: I hope it doesn’t turn into a storm like last time! We can’t afford to install a new heating system every Winter.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.122_Text: I just updated our point-of-sale system. Let’s see how it works!
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.9E285FB6459B904A35700DBE7FE1E7F8: I just updated our point-of-sale system. Let’s see how it works!
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.195_Text: I know something better to do on Sunday… If you want, we could go hiking in the forest and…
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.178_Text: I know that I always say how my sister can be hard and stuff, but I don’t know what I would do without her.//I don’t think I’d have survived grade school, to tell you the truth.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.205_Text: I let <NpcName>Suki</> borrow the <Italic>taupe</> one. She loves them too!
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.108_Text: I like dinner parties, but sometimes people can wear you out…
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.77DEE7E74E0535DF19877BB7936FBD63: I like dinner parties, but sometimes people can wear you out…
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.211_Text: I like this part of the beach. It's very quiet.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.91_Text: I love seeing all these pretty Summer flowers around the island.//Diversity is beautiful, isn’t it?
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.F5C8031A463FC51F0B7568993875E32B: I love seeing all these pretty Summer flowers around the island.//Diversity is beautiful, isn’t it?
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.76_Text: I love seeing the daisies popping up everywhere. It practically screams Summer.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.9F989D9041C1E07C757E8097DB28F21B: I love seeing the daisies popping up everywhere. It practically screams Summer.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.00DF4EBD4B43AC67ABCA4491DCC1247C: I love walking through the leaves. Do you ever do that?
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.99_Text: I love walking through the leaves. Do you ever do that?
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.131_Text: I meant, like, <NPCName>Luke</>  for instance. He could rent some space over there, by the door, and sell electronics.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.4DE481B2493EC11D41D8EA813C5D97E2: I meant, like, <NPCName>Luke</>  for instance. He could rent some space over there, by the door, and sell electronics.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.215_Text: I need to find my bathing suit.//<portrait=surprised>It's getting warmer. Soon, the snow will melt. Yay!
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.169_Text: I really can’t with <NPCName>Suki</>, sometimes. Ugh.

DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.130_Text: I think it may be a good idea to rent out sales space in the lobby.

DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.75_Text: I wish <NPCName>Noah</> would come to the forest with me to help with my research, but he just wants to stay at the beach all day.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.AEEBCC49480BC49AEB34C29BB0581220: I wish <NPCName>Noah</> would come to the forest with me to help with my research, but he just wants to stay at the beach all day.

DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.96_Text: I wonder if <NPCName>Ben</> has left on his trip yet…
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.154_Text: I wonder if the library has any new books. I’ve been reading the same old books.

DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.D811264A4111D5155F85689993380453: If I ever leave this town, the festival would be one thing that I’d miss.

DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.F3A34EA74ED4A8F875BD1992CDB68512: If this Winter gets any colder, I’m afraid we’ll start losing business.

DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.34_Text: If you’re not a caffeine person, a quick jog does the trick when you need to wake up.//<portrait=normal>It works on me.

DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.D545C8EA4A3DE96BBB1D24AAE4ECA0A2: Is it too early to say Happy New Year?
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.1_Text: Is that… Is that you, <PlayerName>$player</>?//<portrait=surprised>Wow! I almost didn’t recognize you in that getup.//<portrait=normal>Oh, so you’re the one moving into the lot, huh? That would explain the outfit.

DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.736558AE42FF15DD3A64EAA6317B2B8D: It’s easier to do my…research in Summer.//I can stay out longer to see if there’s anything strange on the island.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.73_Text: It’s easier to do my…research in Summer.//I can stay out longer to see if there’s anything strange on the island.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.177_Text: It’s hard for me to admit this, but…well, we’re friends, right?
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.74_Text: It’s nice to see the community come together. It’s one of the reasons I love the Beach Cleanup Festival.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.A37B526240E7D781D8F21EAE194DF94F: It’s nice to see the community come together. It’s one of the reasons I love the Beach Cleanup Festival.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.23_Text: It’s nice to see you here, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.421D824E4944CCC21DA9FE88EB451E37: It’s nice to see you here, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.182_Text: It’s not okay to force your opinions on other people. I told <NpcName>Suki</> that.//We’re all adults, right? We can talk it out.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.12_Text: It’s pretty fair, I think… Right?
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.E8FC92264BB28706A443B4A09BA46094: It’s pretty fair, I think… Right?
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.295DECB74DFD931E7771858161CFE393: It’s pretty fair, I think… Right?//<portrait=sad>Maybe she doesn’t see it that way...//<portrait=sad>I mean, she does a lot of the cooking, but she doesn’t seem to mind. So don’t you think that’s fair?
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.149_Text: It’s such a different vibe in here compared to the inn.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.8D3593C943E45F1F6B3206ABE169548E: It’s such a different vibe in here compared to the inn.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.42D567464E5E2DF3D3A6F2A55454936B: It’s the last week of Fall, and do you know what that means?//<portrait=annoyed>We have to prepare the inn for Winter. Ugh.

DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.FAB5BC3F4146B75AC7C366B9DD6B0355: I’d close the inn all Winter if it were up to me. But we can’t. Something about being the only inn in town. Ugh.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.86_Text: I’d close the inn all Winter if it were up to me. But we can’t.//Something about being the only inn in town. Ugh.

DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.737A5B7A494744F805191E945479D85E: I’ll head back to the inn soon. I just wanna get some new books first at the library.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.6D73923A499E3445A819148D091C4402: I’ll read anywhere, but there’s something about reading outside in the Summer sun that’s more relaxing.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.70_Text: I’ll read anywhere, but there’s something about reading outside in the Summer sun that’s more relaxing.

DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.FA96EC424A8E8ED4F6A29BA00942F751: I’m a little busy right now…
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.2556507F4128579155F34CA12E691606: I’m excited about the Beach Cleanup Festival later this season. Are you?
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.72_Text: I’m excited about the Beach Cleanup Festival later this season. Are you?

DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.3968B4C845F3380CAF3AA9B9B5A24256: I’m glad I made it through another Winter.//<portrait=happy>Now I can look forward to Summer!
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.64_Text: I’m glad I made it through another Winter.//<portrait=happy>Now I can look forward to Summer!

DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.20BAB2854EEA541B5C827FA33C8EF05B: I’m going to put all the extra blankets up front. In case any of our guests need one.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.124_Text: I’m gonna get ready for bed, then read for a bit…
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.1E97B889494E605E082E22B74AADCD10: I’m gonna get ready for bed, then read for a bit…
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.5DA58BC5428F32ED46B8CC84B21CE730: I’m just counting the days until Summer is here, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.65_Text: I’m just counting the days until Summer is here, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.C579639C46BFC03A859C06BA4E05F937: I’m looking forward to the New Year’s Eve Festival. It’s so fun and festive, but it also means Winter is officially over.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.87_Text: I’m looking forward to the New Year’s Eve Festival.//It’s so fun and festive, but it also means Winter is officially over.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.04EBC271419B5E00BB446FB8AE08FA88: I’m not being fair. It’s my own fault because I like to reread the same old books.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.155_Text: I’m not being fair. It’s my own fault because I like to reread the same old books.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.359B7CD6455100457616D0A38239DCC7: I’m not doing anything today.//<portrait=happy>Fun, fun!

DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.579E42F74DB4589EFC078F95F9857275: I’m pretty much free today. I usually pay the bills on Wednesdays…//That way, I can make sure that we don’t double pay.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.62_Text: I’m so happy Spring is almost over, because it means Summer is right around the corner. I love the longer days!

DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.31_Text: Just putting it out there. There's definitely interest in that field.//<portrait=annoyed>Not only from me... let's see... Hmm… <NPCName>Noah</>.//And, Hmm…me?

DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.0D4F57C042E21B922FFD2B8CAB081CD6: Morning jogs can be fun, especially with a partner.//Don’t brush it off just yet. Give it a try!

DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.166_Text: Oh, it’s you! I’m so glad to see you!

DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.16_Text: One of my hobbies is definitely reading!//What about you? What do you like to do in your spare time?
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.F3204F0F45AA613E574EE58E36927938: One of my hobbies is definitely reading!//What about you? What do you like to do in your spare time?

DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.625750004919EDB3FB5B648674255871: Or – oh! The vineyard! They could sell wine here.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.22_Text: Our kitchen is free to use! It’s included in the room rate.//<portrait=normal>Guests can use our kitchen and anything we put out in the lobby.//But you knew that. You stayed in our inn that summer.

DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.26_Text: Right! It's only Monday. Bit early for a week's progress report, huh?

DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.170_Text: She can be so pushy, <PlayerName>$player</>. But don’t worry, I don’t let it bother me anymore.//<portrait=normal>Inhale...exhale...
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.180_Text: She hates it if everything’s not just right. I suppose that’s good, though.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.181_Text: She only wants the best for me. I know, I know… Trust me, it’s the same old song.//But that doesn’t make <NPCName>Suki</>’s behavior okay.
