DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.0C74D33A413B1838441AA6AFE1698B7E: The inn usually gets more guests during festivals.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.15_Text: The inn usually gets more guests during festivals.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.49_Text: The internet has way too many poorly sourced articles about flying saucers… Hmm…
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.B1E73AA642076BB945CC61B9E0FA238D: The internet has way too many poorly sourced articles about flying saucers… Hmm…
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.5885B73044DA3AB06D953D9D4EFC19E1: The leaves were crunchy on my walk this morning.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.98_Text: The leaves were crunchy on my walk this morning.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.160_Text: The lobster tank? I’m okay with it. For all I care, anyone can have whatever pet they want.//<portrait=annoyed>But I’m not the only one running the inn.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.14_Text: The mayor is always watching the economy.//He gets excited about the analysis when we go over what we learned in the past season and all that.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.79EAC3E74983ED67B987E9A965B1BEF9: The mayor is always watching the economy.//He gets excited about the analysis when we go over what we learned in the past season and all that.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.84_Text: The only good thing about Winter is it’s when our birthday is.//<portrait=annoyed>Everything else I can do without.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.FC08168B4CEEAB2EDD988CA80CDBC6DA: The only good thing about Winter is it’s when our birthday is.//<portrait=annoyed>Everything else I can do without.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.7014D79E491B2BA5F806EBA90FEA330D: The snow is pretty, I’ll admit. But does it have to be so cold?
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.89_Text: The snow is pretty, I’ll admit. But does it have to be so cold?
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.1BE802AB43406D7423DBAEBCF71518C9: The universe is so big, don’t you think?//<portrait=happy>I mean, look at Earth. We haven’t even fully explored it yet.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.41_Text: The universe is so big, don’t you think?//<portrait=happy>I mean, look at Earth. We haven’t even fully explored it yet.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.53_Text: The whole Sanchez family is very caring and tight-knit. <NPCName>Rafael</>, <NPCName>Antonio</>, <NPCName>Pablo</>...all of them.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.35_Text: There is this magnificent rainbow seashell one time that <NPCName>Valentina</> brought home.//<portrait=surprised>Have you seen one of those?//<portrait=normal>Oh, it was so beautiful. I’m pretty sure it would sell for a lot too.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.F2A6B05B4A506198C4A5D79180B83DC0: There is this magnificent rainbow seashell one time that <NPCName>Valentina</> brought home.//<portrait=surprised>Have you seen one of those?//<portrait=normal>Oh, it was so beautiful. I’m pretty sure it would sell for a lot too.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.93_Text: There’s a swimming contest too.//<NPCName>Sunny’s</> going to be the winner again, I bet. Ha ha!
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.A19D1F6E467251434E57F7A004ACBEA0: There’s a swimming contest too.//<NPCName>Sunny’s</> going to be the winner again, I bet. Ha ha!
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.63_Text: There’s something cheerful about the flowers in Spring. I know <NPCName>Suki</> can’t get enough of them.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.81BB464048CCEC5560E4E28EDA0217D2: There’s something cheerful about the flowers in Spring. I know <NPCName>Suki</> can’t get enough of them.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.204_Text: These boots are so comfy, I have two pair of them!//<portrait=happy>Oh, this isn't the one I wore last week. That was in <Italic>taupe</>, this is the brown one.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.101_Text: They give out free mooncakes at the Harvest Festival.//They’re <NPCName>Betty’s</>, so they’re good, for sure!
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.2B5D7CB04649BF9C3C072D8C0CB669C9: They give out free mooncakes at the Harvest Festival.//They’re <NPCName>Betty’s</>, so they’re good, for sure!
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.0472F43549AD1EA1AA29AF91077C3B81: They’re all right. I was just curious…//But I heard that <NPCName>Joko</> loves pineapples. One time he gave us some as a souvenir from his trip.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.61_Text: They’re all right. I was just curious…//But I heard that <NPCName>Joko</> loves pineapples. One time he gave us some as a souvenir from his trip.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.188_Text: Think about it… <NPCName>Suki</> and I have been living together since before we were born.//<portrait=normal>We’re bound to get on each other’s nerves, and squabbles are okay as long as we respect our boundaries.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.21_Text: Think of it this way, the more people that are allowed access to paying the bills, the more chance that there’ll be mistakes – overpaying, missing invoices, all that.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.E70760814FEB451B3FA52B91F164530A: Think of it this way, the more people that are allowed access to paying the bills, the more chance that there’ll be mistakes – overpaying, missing invoices, all that.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.56_Text: This time of year, you can find fresh wasabi by the river…
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.95A8B3FF49AB21F550DF7F9B7722B4A4: This time of year, you can find fresh wasabi by the river…
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.E06851B74DA33B822C26819DD3415D58: This time of year, you can find fresh wasabi by the river…
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.AFA1F8394F22834A9C44108BAD2143BF: Uh-uh. Not just me… Let me see… Hmm… <NPCName>Noah</>…and, um…
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.C88D41A1493DEEA8F9277585CACA517C: Uh-uh. Not just me… Let me see… Hmm… <NPCName>Noah</>…and, um…
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.D66CC0D24EEDDDEF0579349126C01686: Uh-uh. Not just me… Let me see… Hmm… <NPCName>Noah</>…and, um…
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.9DD25B56418F51150C4D2188C4A96F64: We keep track of guests daily and run an analysis at the end of the season.//That's how we're taught by our parents.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.13_Text: We monitor our guests daily and compile data for an end-of-season review.//That's the system our parents passed down to us.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.125_Text: We offer wine in the evening and a fresh fruit bar in the morning…//<portrait=happy>I think that should be enough, don’t you?
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.500A1BED48BC7B98F3E1FA980F08ABAE: We offer wine in the evening and a fresh fruit bar in the morning…//<portrait=happy>I think that should be enough, don’t you?
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.2100CFB44CC0CF220A8CA5AC3C2F8308: We seem to keep finding new species of animals… On land, in the ocean! Ancient fish. Gosh.//<portrait=surprised>What else is out there?!//<portrait=happy>Could there be life on other planets? I think so.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.42_Text: We seem to keep finding new species of animals… On land, in the ocean! Ancient fish. Gosh.//<portrait=surprised>What else is out there?!//<portrait=happy>Could there be life on other planets? I think so.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.167_Text: We should hang out on the weekend or something. When you’re not too busy.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.162_Text: We used to have a rescue, but he ended up living in a mansion.//I suppose he’s used to living large now.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.198_Text: Well, of course not. I wasn’t serious. It wouldn’t fit in our inn.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.193_Text: What about <NPCName>Noah</>? He’s a good friend, that’s all.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.151_Text: What if…//<portrait=annoyed>What if she’s not a spiritual figure like the locals believe, but actually from another planet?!
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.199_Text: When <NpcName>Suki</> got pregnant and married <NpcName>Antonio</>, I was worried about her future.//<portrait=happy>But she's proved me wrong and become an amazing mom and business partner.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.24_Text: When I first took over Coral Inn, I was pretty clueless. It definitely involves a lot.//But I imagine it's not quite as demanding as running a farm.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.EB4701F14D79680C32744A9BC346216A: When we were kids, <NPCName>Suki</> and I used to dress the same to confuse our friends. It didn’t always work, because we aren’t identical, but when it did, it was great!
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.39_Text: When we were kids, <NPCName>Suki</> and I used to dress the same to confuse our friends.//It didn’t always work, because we aren’t identical, but when it did, it was great!
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.83_Text: When will this Winter be over?
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.98B3EFB14C9093D9582B409B7649CD40: When will this Winter be over?
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.153_Text: Who orders the books inside the library, I wonder?//There are way too many cookbooks.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.6437F3F046333CA04ABE148ED757CE6B: Who orders the books inside the library, I wonder?//There are way too many cookbooks.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.77_Text: Why can’t Summer be longer? I haven’t finished my reading yet!
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.E62E62AF40B2344519924CA3EC91BB60: Why can’t Summer be longer? I haven’t finished my reading yet!
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.730FB11948B7539114E6898E06C0A8DA: Yeah! There are plenty of rare, pretty shells on our beach. Kids love collecting them.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.92E4073C412A85408F64F497173FCE7D: Yeah! There are plenty of rare, pretty shells on our beach. Kids love collecting them.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.163_Text: Yes! <NPCName>Taco</>! I still see him from time to time.//<portrait=normal>He followed <NPCName>Suki</> down from the forest one time and sort of lived here until he decided he liked the vineyard better.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.7AF3C5464E099E8CC2E7CABE164DDF0D: Yes! I'd love to get to know you better. Thank you for the locket.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.137_Text: Yes? I don’t want to be rude, but I’m a little too tired to chat…
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.A65BD12244EA4C142ADFF896CCB296CC: Yes? I don’t want to be rude, but I’m a little too tired to chat…
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.A00A3F1140248118E1A0AB965E36A5D0: You could say that about pretty much anything, though, huh?
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.189_Text: You must be so lonely on that big farm of yours.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.74B49CBD4975C3ADF13E1098B862DF5D: You see, my sis used to live in Labuan Bajo, the little town on the other side of Coral Island, with her ex-husband. But since the, errr, separation, she moved back here.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.A6E2274C41A0342933E8D49DECF94C7A: You see, my sis used to live in Labuan Bajo, the little town on the other side of Coral Island, with her ex-husband. But since the, errr, separation, she moved back here.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.48_Text: You see, my sis used to live in Labuan Bajo, the little town on the other side of Coral Island, with her ex-husband.//<portrait=sad>But since the, errr, separation, she moved back here.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.159_Text: You will reach out to me when you need someone to talk to, right? I’ll try to be a good listener… Promise.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.176_Text: You're so fun to talk to.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.175_Text: You’re different, aren’t you? In a good way, I mean.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.118_Text: …I hope it doesn’t get to that point.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.24833088495ACDBBFAA80E91C89EBD59: …I hope it doesn’t get to that point.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.225244AA4EFAE53E3BA536B4D5E4C6CD: …Just saying. Some people are interested in that stuff, you know.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.2691DD0240E837F87E2ABD91AC522B18: …Just saying. Some people are interested in that stuff, you know.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.EBFE9E8E456A36368D70988518C06F4C: …Just saying. Some people are interested in that stuff, you know.
DT_Dialogue_Alice_Production.D8A0B65B42914545B3CC69AC600A0AAA: …What if…//<portrait=annoyed>What if she’s not a spiritual figure like the locals believe, but actually from another planet?!

DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.86_Text: <NpcName>Dippa</>? Yeah, I see them around the island, painting.//They’re very quiet, so they don’t scare the wildlife very much.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.107_Text: <NpcName>Mark</> is like a magnet for animals. Dogs, especially.//<portrait=normal>He’s great with them. He and Bonbon are like two peas in a pod.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.113_Text: <NpcName>Paul</> and <NpcName>Zoe</> teamed up to play pranks on me last week.//<portrait=annoyed>They put a cutout picture of a face inside a jar in the fridge. My heart jumped for sure. I might’ve jumped too. I don’t remember.//They think they’re so funny!
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.81_Text: <NpcName>Paul</> is no good at keeping the house clean.//I mean, you’ve seen him. Well, that goes for both of us, actually. We both spend our time outdoors, in literal mud sometimes.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.111_Text: <NpcName>Paul</> talks about borrowing <NpcName>Theo’s</> boat. It does sound fun, but I’m not sure if the boat could fit all of us.//<portrait=annoyed>Besides, it’s pretty <Italic>old</>.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.93_Text: <NpcName>Paul’s</> a good guy, but sometimes I think he lives in a different world.//I mean, who goes fishing for vegetables?//<portrait=normal>He’s silly that way. I guess that’s what made me fall for him.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.82_Text: <NpcName>Zoe</> keeps me busy all day with her mischief.//I can barely keep up with her. You’ll see, she’ll come home with <NPCName>Goddess</> knows what tomorrow!
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.96_Text: <NpcName>Zoe</> loves the outdoors, but I always make sure to keep her safe.//The woodland has the perfect balance of adventure and security.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.84_Text: <NpcName>Zoe</> needs to focus on school right now. I don’t mean she can’t go on adventures. Homework comes first and adventuring second. She’ll have plenty of time for adventures in the future.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.120_Text: <NpcName>Zoe</> wouldn’t wear that, no! She wouldn’t want to wear a dress.//<portrait=normal>But the store might have other styles in that fabric, a cute yellow beanie, or some nice, frilly shorts.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.50_Text: A little rain wouldn’t hurt, I don’t think.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.2_Text: A quick word of advice from your new neighbor.//Be patient! Since last year, those darn crops aren’t growing like they used to.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.39_Text: Ah, that reminds me! I need to ask <NpcName>Paul</> to bring in some extra blankets from the shed now that it’s getting colder.//I’ll just ask him tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.56_Text: All right, it may not be a storm, but it’s so cold out it might as well be. Some animals are in their hideouts. They need to keep warm, you know.//<portrait=normal>Just like us.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.58_Text: All right, it may not be a storm, but it’s so cold out it might as well be. Some animals are in their hideouts. They need to keep warm, you know.//<portrait=normal>Just like us.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.91_Text: All right, that’s fair. Our problem now isn’t getting the footage, it’s editing. I just mean there are ups and downs in this job.//<portrait=happy>I wouldn’t trade it for anything, though. We always have fun.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.22_Text: As a mom, I worry all the time. I don’t like <NpcName>Zoe</> walking too far, especially on rainy days.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.62_Text: As soon as I get home, I’ll realize I forgot to buy something.//<portrait=concerned>It’s pretty annoying, if you ask me.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.28_Text: But it’s a little outside our budget right now. Oh well! It’s not the end of the world.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.90_Text: Documentaries are tricky, especially when they’re about wildlife.//We really can’t predict when we’ll be able complete a project.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.116_Text: Even though it can get pretty cold, I still love Winter.//<portrait=happy>Plus, seeing <NpcName>Archie</> building a snowman the other day made me so happy. It took me back to when I was a kid.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.1_Text: Good day, stranger!//Oh, you just moved to the farm? Welcome to the community.//<portrait=normal>My name is <NPCName>Anne</>.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.112_Text: Good thing it isn’t going to rain today.//I’ve been looking forward to the beach all week.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.106_Text: He’s such an adventurer, always exploring and taking risks. He’s inspiring, really.//<portrait=happy>In a way, we’re both dedicating our lives to wildlife.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.32_Text: Hmm… It would be interesting to observe wildlife behavior in different settings.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.97_Text: I always get a little nervous when there’s a storm coming.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.43_Text: I always need to be ready in case we have to run out and film.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.52_Text: I always need to be ready in case we have to run out and film.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.61_Text: I always seem to forget something. I wonder if that’s a grocery thing.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.64_Text: I can’t ask <NpcName>Paul</> to get groceries. He’d just forage some vegetables by the lake or something and bring them home.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.34_Text: I can’t do my shopping on the weekend.//I’d have to take <NpcName>Zoe</> with me, and she’d want to buy all the cookies.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.100_Text: I can’t help but worry about <NpcName>Mark</> all the time. He’s always dealing with who knows what.//At least with him living here in Starlet Town, I can <Italic>babysit</> him.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.17_Text: I don’t know how safe it is to live in the forest, especially with small children.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.104_Text: I don’t think <NpcName>Mark</> cares about <NpcName>Mark’s</> safety!
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.80_Text: I don’t think I could manage if our house was any bigger.//We’d just keep piling things in it.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.92_Text: I hate it when I forget something at the store.//<portrait=concerned>It’s like my brain decides to play tricks on me, and I end up remembering everything but the one thing I needed.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.85_Text: I hate to nag, but nothing else seems to be working.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.99_Text: I heard from <NpcName>Paul</> that you watched Friends with Wildlife back in Pokyo?//<portrait=happy>That’s amazing. Thank you for your support.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.122_Text: I hope they keep her warm.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.102_Text: I keep telling <NpcName>Mark</> he needs to write back to Mom.//He writes, yes, just not often.//<portrait=annoyed>He needs to send her things too so she knows he still loves her.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.119_Text: I love <NpcName>Valentina’s</> dress. It’s bright yellow with orange flowers, and it has fancy tiers.//<portrait=happy>I’ll have to ask <NpcName>Suki</> where she got it. Do you think <NpcName>Valentina’s</> style is her own or <NpcName>Antonio’s</>?
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.114_Text: I love their pranks.//It shows how close they are.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.65_Text: I mean, there’s nothing wrong with wild vegetables.//<portrait=annoyed>But they’re different.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.45_Text: I might open up the windows tonight so we can hear the rain.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.5_Text: I need to drop off my recycling before going shopping tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.38_Text: I think I saw a couple of beavers swimming in the lake on my way here.//Did you see them too?
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.19_Text: I think I’ll make some gnocchi and hummus for dinner.//Make a little extra for tomorrow too.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.89_Text: I told her so many times to never go past the recycling center.//Yet for some reason, I keep hearing this from <NpcName>Emma</>. And now you.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.59_Text: I wonder how long the snow will last. I’m not complaining though.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.70_Text: I wonder if I should get a couple bottles of milk instead of just one. But I don’t want it to go bad if nobody drinks it.//That would be such a waste.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.6_Text: I wonder where we’ll put our recycling once the bin is full…
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.55_Text: If we were living in the middle of the forest, what would we do during a snowstorm like this?
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.57_Text: If we were living in the middle of the forest, what would we do during a snowstorm like this?
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.8_Text: If you grow soybeans, you can use them to make tempeh. Neat, eh?
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.23_Text: If you look closely in the trees, you may notice some birds’ nests.//<portrait=normal><NpcName>Zoe</> gets really excited when she spots one.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.66_Text: If you need a carrot, you can’t just come home with kale…//Or a fig.//You can’t substitute just anything for anything.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.30_Text: In this job, I believe patience is key.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.29_Text: It takes us days and sometimes weeks to capture the best wildlife footage.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.36_Text: It’s <NpcName>Paul’s</> birthday this weekend. To be honest, I haven’t gotten anything for him yet.//I hope there’s still time.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.48_Text: It’s Summer after all. What else can you expect?
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.94_Text: It’s funny how one missing ingredient can ruin a whole recipe.//<portrait=concerned>You can’t substitute just anything for anything. Trust me, I’ve tried.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.21_Text: It’s great that <NpcName>Paul</> and I can observe wildlife around the clock, since we’re surrounded by nature.//But I also like that the woodland is so close to the school.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.76_Text: It’s important to keep a safe distance from wild animals so they don’t attack.//I really don’t want to lecture you. But the number of people who don’t know any better is shocking.//<portrait=annoyed>And not in a good way, you know. Shockingly bad!
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.47_Text: It’s so humid today. Even the rain hasn’t helped to break this humidity.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.4_Text: It’s too far from the town and whatnot. Oh well!
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.60_Text: I’m here to pick up some groceries for the week. Hopefully, I’ll get everything I need.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.105_Text: I’m proud of <NpcName>Mark</>, I am. Even though I worry about him <Italic>constantly</>.//<portrait=normal>I’m proud of everything he’s accomplished.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.10_Text: I’m trying to find time to edit all this video footage before the deadline.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.121_Text: I’ve bundled <NpcName>Zoe</> up for Winter.//Wool socks, wool beanie.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.73_Text: Just try not to step on anything, will you?
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.53_Text: Keep your jacket on, <PlayerName>$player</>! It’s freezing out.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.25_Text: Let me get this straight. You quit your job and moved to Coral Island to become a farmer?
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.46_Text: Let’s just hope there isn’t a storm.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.101_Text: Mom’s always sending me letters, asking if my brother’s okay.//<portrait=annoyed>She’s so worried about him, and I am too.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.108_Text: My brother’s teaching <NpcName>Zoe</> how to defend herself.//<portrait=annoyed>With her interest in exploring the woods, gosh, we need it.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.7_Text: Not everybody has one of those fancy compact recycling machines.//<portrait=concerned>Ah, you know – the little machine that you put in your yard? Don’t you have one?//<portrait=happy>Oh well. No point complaining about it.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.20_Text: Oh no. I don’t think I have any tomatoes.//<portrait=concerned>Oh well! Hummus it is.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.72_Text: Oh, don’t worry about the mess. It’s never neat in here!
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.24_Text: Oh, so you’ve done all your farming chores for the day?
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.68_Text: Okay. That’s a funny story, but I still don’t know why you’re telling me all this.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.98_Text: Our show, Friends with Wildlife, has been a labor of love.//We want to show people how amazing and important these animals are and why we need to protect them.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.40_Text: Phew! Good thing we found extra blankets right before all this. I really need to organize stuff better.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.71_Text: See, I knew it!//I forgot to pick up some oil. We’re running out, and I don’t know what I’ll do.//<portrait=normal>Hey! What’s up?
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.35_Text: She can be quite strong willed. It’s easier for me to just shop during the week.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.67_Text: So you woke up holding an egg and somehow didn’t break it in your sleep?
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.42_Text: Some animals only come out when it rains. Have you noticed that too?
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.51_Text: Some animals only come out when it rains. Have you noticed that too?
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.103_Text: Sometimes I feel like I’m the only one who cares about <NpcName>Mark’s</> safety.//He takes so many risks, and he doesn’t always think things through.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.77_Text: Soybean cakes are best sliced thinly and fried.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.95_Text: Summer’s a mixed bag, you know? I love the long days and warm nights, but the humidity can be brutal. It’s a trade-off.//<portrait=concerned>It’s like the air is clinging to your skin.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.26_Text: That sounds so exciting!//<NpcName>Paul</> and I should make a documentary about you one day. It would be different from what we usually do, but it sure would be inspiring.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.83_Text: That was too harsh. She’s a sweetheart, she <Italic>is</>, but it’s not easy keeping her in line.//Especially when it comes to homework.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.117_Text: The Winter Fair is always so festive and joyful. I love seeing all the lights and decorations.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.118_Text: The Winter Fair is always so festive and joyful. I love seeing all the lights and decorations.//I’m <Italic>so</> looking forward to it.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.109_Text: The other day, I saw them gardening together.//<NpcName>Zoe</> loves her Uncle <NpcName>Mark</>.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.18_Text: The woodland is as close as I’ll let <NpcName>Zoe</> get.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.12_Text: There could be luwaks at your farm, or maybe bees. If you build a bee house, it might encourage them to come out.//Make them feel comfortable, that’s the trick.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.33_Text: There will be plenty of time for <NpcName>Zoe</> to go on adventures. For now, I think it’s safer for her to focus on school.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.115_Text: There’s something magical about the snow.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.37_Text: There’s still time to make jam, I suppose!//That’ll be perfect. He loves jam.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.87_Text: They live next to us. Sometimes we share fertilizer or the harvest from our gardens, but that’s about it.//<portrait=normal><NpcName>Dippa</> and <NpcName>Emma</> keep to themselves most of the time.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.78_Text: They’re really easy to overeat. I can down plates of them in one go.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.3_Text: They’re talking about building a community garden someday. You must have heard, right?//We offered the space behind our house, but I don’t think anybody much likes the idea.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.74_Text: We don’t have any tea, but would you like some warm hummus, maybe?
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.79_Text: We usually have a beach day on the weekend and just play some volleyball or something.//I’m looking forward to it.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.27_Text: We want to get those little video cameras that attach to your hat. That way, we could capture more footage.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.41_Text: What a pain to dig them up. I need boxes so I can label them. It would make things easier to find next year.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.75_Text: When you encounter wildlife, make sure to keep your distance. If you get too close, you’ll scare them.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.63_Text: Write it down? Ha! That’s an idea.//<portrait=happy>All right. Maybe…
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.14_Text: Yeah, us too.//<portrait=happy>Oh, you know, the usual. Wildlife…blah, blah, blah.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.16_Text: Yeah, us too.//<portrait=happy>Oh, you know, the usual. Wildlife…blah, blah, blah.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.11_Text: You can’t always spot wild animals. Sometimes they stay in hiding because they’re too shy to come out.//Wild animals might have already made a home at your farm, but you wouldn’t even know.//Happens to us a lot. That’s why we leave fodder for them in an open shed. It’s free food!
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.9_Text: You do need a press to make tempeh, though.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.31_Text: Your farm is pretty close to the ocean. I don’t know if that’s a good or a bad thing for spotting nocturnal animals.
DT_Dialogue_Anne_Production.110_Text: You’ve done great things for the community, <PlayerName>$Player</>.//<portrait=happy>You’re a caring person, I can tell.

DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.6_Text: <NPCName>Suki</> is a super mom. Whoever ends up with her will be one lucky –//Ah, my jealousy is showing.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.58_Text: <NpcName>Alice</> might look timid, but that one – oof, she’s feisty too.//<portrait=normal>They’ll be okay. They always make up in the end.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.54_Text: <NpcName>Valentina</> is becoming more and more like her mother as she grows up.//I couldn’t be more proud.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.11_Text: Ah, Starlet Town in Fall.//What a place to be.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.48_Text: Ah, it’s cuddle weather. Too bad I’m single.//Hopefully, that changes soon.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.40_Text: Ah, that’s a nice outfit. Is it from White Flamingo?//Very suitable for the snow with that whole Winter vibe.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.16_Text: Ah, the storm… A productivity killer.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.18_Text: Ah, the storm… A productivity killer.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.39_Text: Ah, you look dashing today. Who are you wearing?//White Flamingo?
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.30_Text: Changing diapers, pushing a stroller – I’ve done that life.//I don’t miss it much.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.62_Text: Do you know if the hot spring near the forest is open for visitors again? It’d be nice to go there tonight.//<portrait=concerned>Ah, I can’t. I have a business call scheduled. Dang it!
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.60_Text: Don’t think I slept at all!
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.44_Text: Hard pill to swallow, it was. Yeah.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.59_Text: Having a kid is not cheap, <PlayerName>$Player</>. Ha ha!//Last night, I started thinking about how much it’ll cost for <NpcName>Valentina</> to go to university. Oof! Kept me awake for hours.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.38_Text: I could never get <NpcName>Rafael</> to go out.//The man likes his solitude.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.46_Text: I don’t live at the inn, no.//I have a room there when I visit my little empanada. Free of charge, of course.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.33_Text: I keep some of the old stock in storage when it’s out of season.//Put it back out the next year. The thing about fashion is it often cycles back <Italic>fast</>.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.4_Text: I make a decent amount of money from my store.//<portrait=annoyed>Well, I used to, anyway. When there were a lot of tourists before the oil spill incident.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.50_Text: I need to tell <NpcName>Pablo</> about the draft from my bedroom window.//It’s starting to get unbearable at night.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.64_Text: I noticed people here like to dye their hair.//<portrait=happy>Saw a customer at the store the other day with bright-blue hair. What a choice!
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.3_Text: I personally never saw the appeal of living here in Starlet Town.//It’s a bit too sleepy for my taste.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.28_Text: I want to spend more of my time here, but ah, you know – business.//It won’t run itself. The store back home is much larger and needs more attention.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.53_Text: It doesn’t have anybody’s name on it.//I think it’s free to take. Want some?
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.37_Text: It’s certainly no picnic visiting <NpcName>Pablo</> and <NpcName>Rafael</>. They should open that house a little.//Let the heat out.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.22_Text: It’s kind of cold in this storm.//Excuse me.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.42_Text: It’s not for me. It’s giving me bad flashbacks.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.13_Text: It’s the twins’ birthday season.//I got them pies and cases of green smoothies last year. That was a hit.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.8_Text: It’s very bright out lately.//<portrait=normal>It’s the Spring sun. It’s waking up again.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.36_Text: I‘m teaching <NpcName>Valentina</> the importance of being close to her family and visiting her uncles, even if their house is hot.//<portrait=concerned>Speaking of – Why is that, do you think? Why do they have a whole furnace inside their house, huh?
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.61_Text: I’ll have to set aside some time to enjoy the beach.//It’s what Summer’s for, right? It’s a pity I didn’t bring a bathing suit with me.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.45_Text: I’m only here on the weekends.//Sometimes I come on Thursday, sometimes Friday. It depends on my work schedule.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.47_Text: I’ve been enjoying Spring so far. It’s so…springy, you know?
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.51_Text: Maybe I can fix it myself. How hard could it be?
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.29_Text: My <NpcName>Valentina</> is very special to me, a blessing. But I must say I don’t see another baby in my future.//Not in the near future anyway.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.14_Text: My baby likes to play in the snow.//She’s creative and likes to make things with her hands as well. I’m very proud.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.9_Text: My daughter is a very good artist.//I want to send her to Summer art programs when she’s a bit older.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.2_Text: My ex told me about the grandchild of some farmer moving back in. That must be you.//See you around!
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.5_Text: My girls love jackfruit pies, so I always make sure to bring some every time I visit.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.27_Text: My little empanada’s very good at art. Maybe someday she’ll be in the fashion industry, following in my footsteps.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.55_Text: My parents used to farm a little. Well, they were blacksmiths, and they farmed on the side.//<portrait=happy>There were lots of kids. We needed some extra money.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.49_Text: My relationship status, I mean, not the weather.//<portrait=normal>I like this weather just fine. The lack of a partner, however…
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.34_Text: My room here in Starlet Town is smaller than I’m used to. But no complaints.//<portrait=happy>You don’t hear me complaining! Only gratitude coming from this dude.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.12_Text: My visits here are never <Italic>not</> special in Fall.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.23_Text: Not the best idea to stand around in this rain.//We should go inside somewhere if you want to chat.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.24_Text: Not the best idea to stand around in this rain.//We should go inside somewhere if you want to chat.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.25_Text: Not the best idea to stand around in this rain.//We should go inside somewhere if you want to chat.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.26_Text: Not the best idea to stand around in this rain.//We should go inside somewhere if you want to chat.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.32_Text: Oh, don’t worry! I’ve moved on.//I don’t want to get back with her, but can you blame a man, <PlayerName>$Player</>? She’s the mother of my child.//<portrait=happy>Not to mention one of the most beautiful women I’ve ever laid eyes on.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.7_Text: Spring is when retailers like myself get the new clothing catalogs.//Spring and Fall, actually.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.41_Text: Stop me if you ever catch me listening to rock music, will you?//<NpcName>Pablo</> got me listening to it in his den. Couldn’t hear for two days.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.10_Text: The inn, where I stay when I’m here, is beautiful this time of year.//It’s right on the water, you see.//<portrait=happy>Maybe I’ll stay a little longer this Summer.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.63_Text: The last time I went there, it was all dried out and dirty.//That was years ago, though.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.21_Text: The rain is kind of cold.//Excuse me.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.35_Text: The twins are complete opposites of each other. Yeah, they might like the same food and the same weird drink, but their personalities couldn’t be more different.//<portrait=happy>My girls complete each other.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.57_Text: The twins fight all the time.//If you happen to witness one, better not get involved.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.31_Text: There’s nothing in the world that would stop my love for <NPCName>Suki</>.//There’ll always be a part of my heart that belongs to her.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.52_Text: This is delicious. I found it in the fridge.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.19_Text: This suit isn’t made for the rain, I’m afraid. Please excuse me.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.20_Text: This suit isn’t made for the rain, I’m afraid. Please excuse me.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.43_Text: To be honest, I probably knew deep down it was never going to be <NpcName>Suki</> and me.//<portrait=concerned>We… We’re different people now from who we were when we married a long time ago.
DT_Dialogue_Antonio_Production.56_Text: We mostly grew jackfruits and radishes. Multi-season crops. They’re cheaper to grow.

DT_Dialogue_Apo_Production.56_Text: Another tide, another meal for the royal family. What will it be today?
DT_Dialogue_Apo_Production.103_Text: Every day’s a beautiful day for eating, really.
DT_Dialogue_Apo_Production.49_Text: Finally! A day off from standing in front of the stove.
DT_Dialogue_Apo_Production.10_Text: Greetings, $player. What can I help you with today?
DT_Dialogue_Apo_Production.59_Text: He might even fire me. I don’t want that to happen. Adults don’t get fired from things.
DT_Dialogue_Apo_Production.85_Text: I bet you could grow some really fresh ingredients there.
DT_Dialogue_Apo_Production.107_Text: I don’t think I’d want to be a king. That seems like a lot of responsibility for one person.
DT_Dialogue_Apo_Production.79_Text: I guess I have to contribute to merfolk society somehow.
DT_Dialogue_Apo_Production.94_Text: I know the palace better than just about anyone. Like, did you know there’s a hidden—
DT_Dialogue_Apo_Production.73_Text: I know, I know, it’s so hard to choose. I don’t think I could pick just one!
DT_Dialogue_Apo_Production.19_Text: I need a sugar boost, $player. Got anything sweet on you?
DT_Dialogue_Apo_Production.71_Text: It’s a lot of fun! And it’s a really good workout.
DT_Dialogue_Apo_Production.57_Text: I’m already looking forward to the cake I’m going to bake myself tonight. It’s gonna be so good!
DT_Dialogue_Apo_Production.91_Text: I’m not always good at figuring things out.
DT_Dialogue_Apo_Production.90_Text: Olan always seems like he’s got everything figured out. I hope I can be like that one day.
DT_Dialogue_Apo_Production.92_Text: Olan has a very good reputation around here. Everyone knows he’s the best cook in the entire kingdom.
DT_Dialogue_Apo_Production.95_Text: Oops! I probably shouldn’t have said that.
DT_Dialogue_Apo_Production.134_Text: Sometimes after storms, you can see huge clouds of fish caught up in the currents.
DT_Dialogue_Apo_Production.70_Text: Sometimes my friends and I play coral chase on the weekends. It’s where everyone hides and one person tries to find everyone inside the coral fields.
DT_Dialogue_Apo_Production.93_Text: That’s why the king hired him!
DT_Dialogue_Apo_Production.50_Text: The water feels deliciously cold today, too. Aaaahhhhh.
DT_Dialogue_Apo_Production.24_Text: We’ve got a busy day ahead of us. The only thing we can do about it is put on our aprons and get to work.
DT_Dialogue_Apo_Production.102_Text: What a beautiful day for eating! Don’t you agree?
DT_Dialogue_Apo_Production.31_Text: What should I have for dinner tomorrow?
DT_Dialogue_Apo_Production.72_Text: What’s your favorite food of all time? Like, out of everything?
DT_Dialogue_Apo_Production.101_Text: Working in a castle basically makes me royalty, right?
DT_Dialogue_Apo_Production.84_Text: You’re a farmer, right? Have you tried growing anything in that little plot of land by the gate?

DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.118_Text: *mumbling to himself* Is there a leak in my caravan?
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.3C0BC5C341BF50322AF759AD1370C905: *mumbling to himself* Is there a leak in my caravan?
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.131_Text: <NpcName>Emily</> cuts my hair. She oozes talent, doesn’t she?//But that’s not why I’m here.//I’m here to deliver some stuff for <NpcName>Sam</>.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.E9993ED74B42352735FF819EE1069696: <NpcName>Emily</> cuts my hair. She oozes talent, doesn’t she?//But that’s not why I’m here.//I’m here to deliver some stuff for <NpcName>Sam</>.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.209_Text: <NpcName>Luke</> makes great food. He sends me jars of apple jam sometimes.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.DA54C5314532BF16B2B4E8A74289BA91: <NpcName>Luke</> makes great food. He sends me jars of apple jam sometimes.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.105_Text: <NpcName>Luke</> showed me a picture of Funbucket at the Animal Festival, and he looked like he was having the time of his life.//He just walked and walked, saying hi to everybody. A kind-hearted fellow, that one.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.84AC03084788C25EB2CC8AABC3A34AB8: <NpcName>Luke</> showed me a picture of Funbucket at the Animal Festival, and he looked like he was having the time of his life.//He just walked and walked, saying hi to everybody. A kind-hearted fellow, that one.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.176_Text: <NpcName>Suki</> is a beautiful soul. I feel like maybe she and I are on the same wavelength.//The platonic kind, though. Strictly friends.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.FC13CC8F445EB6D038B75996DA6CE196: <NpcName>Suki</> is a beautiful soul. I feel like maybe she and I are on the same wavelength.//The platonic kind, though. Strictly friends.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.183_Text: <NpcName>Suki</> is such a super lady. Ha ha ha… Umm…
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.BA2E5BEE496E801F14FFB2868EABB1C2: <NpcName>Suki</> is such a super lady. Ha ha ha… Umm…
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.189_Text: <NpcName>Suki</> is super chill.//<portrait=normal>A wholesome type of lady and an incredible mom.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.A4EECE07422F9379CFF1379FCE619EAD: <NpcName>Suki</> is super chill.//<portrait=normal>A wholesome type of lady and an incredible mom.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.129_Text: <NpcName>Suki</> taught me how to make green smoothies.//<portrait=annoyed>Want one?
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.6E020D0D4E64DF2D949FE5A391CE179A: <NpcName>Suki</> taught me how to make green smoothies.//<portrait=annoyed>Want one?
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.171_Text: <PlayerName>$Player</>, if I’m sad, you better believe you’ll see me sad.//<portrait=happy>There’s no point in telling folks to be happy when they’re sad. Let me be sad.//It’s okay to be sad.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.CA62ECAD43224AF602079D8700539448: <PlayerName>$Player</>, if I’m sad, you better believe you’ll see me sad.//<portrait=happy>There’s no point in telling folks to be happy when they’re sad. Let me be sad.//It’s okay to be sad.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.67_Text: <PlayerName>$player</>, don’t you just love all the flowers? So much life around us. Let’s stay still for a moment and absorb it all.//<portrait=surprised><Italic>Ommmmm!</>
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.7DB371974E7978ADDC7DD58737E2391C: <PlayerName>$player</>, don’t you just love all the flowers? So much life around us. Let’s stay still for a moment and absorb it all.//<portrait=surprised><Italic>Ommmmm!</>
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.87_Text: <PlayerName>$player</>, let’s take a deep breath of that chilly Winter.//<portrait=surprised>Whoa… That is <Italic>cold!</>//<portrait=blushing>I think my brain froze a little there.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.D81DDD774D072A024B407391D4FF838C: <PlayerName>$player</>, let’s take a deep breath of that chilly Winter.//<portrait=surprised>Whoa… That is <Italic>cold!</>//<portrait=blushing>I think my brain froze a little there.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.121_Text: A beanie sure helps when it’s snowing.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.3725C03649396D88E7A69784BF938D03: A beanie sure helps when it’s snowing.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.204_Text: A lot of people have a great aura today.//I credit the sunny day.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.40B5287E4FD8AF45756ADEAA85630AD9: A lot of people have a great aura today.//I credit the sunny day.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.113_Text: A ton of rain coming down lately…
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.9BD332A349100BB1860B98BF40BA2BA8: A ton of rain coming down lately…
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.22_Text: Ah, <PlayerName>$player</>, <PlayerName>$player</>. Here I am… And there you are…
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.4AF63EB54EAE599DC77A79813A3A668A: Ah, <PlayerName>$player</>, <PlayerName>$player</>. Here I am… And there you are…
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.71_Text: Ah, Spring. Everything is just so beautiful, isn’t it?
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.CD30660E43B13C6F890404BAFBBFE4BF: Ah, Spring. Everything is just so beautiful, isn’t it?
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.49B35A974AD88B4D391565A35B410B74: Ah, Summer. Enjoy the heat and humidity, <PlayerName>$player</>. I feel great.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.73_Text: Ah, Summer. Enjoy the heat and humidity, <PlayerName>$player</>. I feel great.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.178_Text: Ah, hot pepper jam. Coral island’s delicacy. Looks rather disgusting.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.6F23635244ECBC2BBACEB3A6150C76DE: Ah, hot pepper jam. Coral island’s delicacy. Looks rather disgusting.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.27BB40424814A9C1F03C0EA6A7470F75: Ah, too bad I’m leaving soon.//I see all these mushrooms popping up, and I won’t be able to gather any on my trip.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.84_Text: Ah, too bad I’m leaving soon.//I see all these mushrooms popping up, and I won’t be able to gather any on my trip.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.104_Text: Ah… Yeah, and other people too.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.AC3E4A7F4A1C6FDC83CD3A89BE6B667C: Ah… Yeah, and other people too.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.126_Text: All I need in life is green tea and bananas.//<portrait=happy>They’re all I need to spread positivity.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.2B95421F4A6D9858628F509801DA4665: All I need in life is green tea and bananas.//<portrait=happy>They’re all I need to spread positivity.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.1CF64A1F4E0A0F0068F93D8A0C3F1ECC: All the snow on the ground… That’s Winter, mate.//It’s one of the reasons I always come back here for Winter. Who wants to miss out on this beauty?//But also, I don’t have a long-term parking permit anywhere else.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.91_Text: All the snow on the ground… That’s Winter, mate.//It’s one of the reasons I always come back here for Winter. Who wants to miss out on this beauty?//But also, I don’t have a long-term parking permit anywhere else.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.27_Text: Also, there was this strong odor after wearing them awhile.//<portrait=happy>I took that as my feet telling me no.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.3C2E50FD42A1FD6F53D4AC9C85C2384A: Also, there was this strong odor after wearing them awhile.//<portrait=happy>I took that as my feet telling me no.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.80_Text: Am I sad the leaves are falling?//A little bit, but I know they’ll grow back.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.93DA05404FEECC9A240C97A7F04FEF6A: Am I sad the leaves are falling?//A little bit, but I know they’ll grow back.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.4D1DC9124BB5BE4C548299AC6C8C5FB3: Are you allergic to pollen, mate? The doc's been sneezing like mad. I feel for him.//<portrait=normal>The one with the short hair, not the one with the sick green hair.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.70_Text: Are you allergic to pollen, mate? The doc's been sneezing like mad. I feel for him.//<portrait=normal>The one with the short hair, not the one with the sick green hair.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.108_Text: Around this time, there should be plenty across the island.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.E10F90C74CD4319930EF38B7052322B8: Around this time, there should be plenty across the island.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.177_Text: As for us, we're pretty tight, huh? But hey, I’m not hustling for anything in this universe, <PlayerName>$player</>.//Just a comfortable cruising altitude and a chance to ride the wave away…
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.1A40057243A3BCE083CF16B784BEA416: As for us, we're pretty tight, huh? But hey, I’m not hustling for anything in this universe, <PlayerName>$player</>.//Just a comfortable cruising altitude and a chance to ride the wave away…

DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.173_Text: When I’m alone in my caravan and all zoned out, I’m almost positive I can hear some sort of melody playing, but I don’t know where it’s coming from.//The mind-blowing part is I swear there are different songs for different seasons.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.D975F68347B72F6E8AD9AD90E5183E47: When I’m alone in my caravan and all zoned out, I’m almost positive I can hear some sort of melody playing, but I don’t know where it’s coming from.//The mind-blowing part is I swear there are different songs for different seasons.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.04334D414BBBEBC3EB8FD284970364C1: When my store is quiet like this, I think about my duck sometimes.//He lives at the barn over there.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.36_Text: When my store is quiet like this, I think about my duck sometimes.//He lives at the barn over there.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.161_Text: When the season shifts, your body oil shifts too. Told myself, “<NpcName>Ben</>, some days you’re a greaseball, and that's no fun. Time for a bath.” Then it clicked.//<portrait=angry>You know, <PlayerName>$player</>. Like yeah, this is a greasy day.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.65A7378A416BABD2E1BD4AA808DEA708: When the season shifts, your body oil shifts too. Told myself, “<NpcName>Ben</>, some days you’re a greaseball, and that's no fun. Time for a bath.” Then it clicked.//<portrait=angry>You know, <PlayerName>$player</>. Like yeah, this is a greasy day.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.3BEAC2064F83B302054F2A8B17742A22: Whoo! It’s getting hot, isn’t it? But no sweat. We just gotta take more showers, eh?//<portrait=happy>See what I did there? No sweat?
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.76_Text: Whoo! It’s getting hot, isn’t it? But no sweat. We just gotta take more showers, eh?//<portrait=happy>See what I did there? No sweat?
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.153_Text: Whoopsie!//Watch your step there! <portrait=concerned>You almost got my foot <Italic>again</>.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.EF278CB749C85CD4D6975580E714908A: Whoopsie!//Watch your step there! <portrait=concerned>You almost got my foot <Italic>again</>.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.117_Text: Why is it raining so hard lately? Jeez…
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.AA6184054CDA9263AE6CBFAE6CD79D02: Why is it raining so hard lately? Jeez…
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.143_Text: Would you believe me if I told you I learned that in my dreams?
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.8E208011485E227D0A7A7C9A9854D776: Would you believe me if I told you I learned that in my dreams?
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.12_Text: Yeah, I sell them, sure. But it's all about recycling, my friend.//You got the idea. Right on!
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.649DFD8148BC2C3C59D8C9AC71D35F1F: Yeah, I sell them, sure. But it's all about recycling, my friend.//You got the idea. Right on!
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.28_Text: Yeah, the van works.//Well, the brakes are a little funny sometimes.//<portrait=happy>You gotta stand on them pretty hard, but hey! Aside from that, it rides okay.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.708D8DE5408CE062342372BE6E985C2E: Yeah, the van works.//Well, the brakes are a little funny sometimes.//<portrait=happy>You gotta stand on them pretty hard, but hey! Aside from that, it rides okay.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.25_Text: Yes, I’ve always been a wanderer.//<portrait=normal>Since the age of three, according to my mom.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.2B278A75491ED8A6C73F4795E8241526: Yes, I’ve always been a wanderer.//<portrait=normal>Since the age of three, according to my mom.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.137_Text: You can mark my word on that! I think it’s about time. You know what I mean?
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.80A1B90B4A178BB6211C278C8EE666AA: You can mark my word on that! I think it’s about time. You know what I mean?
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.0061295C46B77A7DA815C88AF88F3F7A: You can only buy things from the window. Sorry, friend. It’s nothing personal – just a business decision.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.154_Text: You can only buy things from the window. Sorry, friend. It’s nothing personal – just a business decision.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.68E2A19C483EF9317376C5B4024BF26B: You don’t need a lot of money to be happy, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.9_Text: You don’t need a lot of money to be happy, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.151_Text: You ever feel like you cough so hard that part of your lung falls out?
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.163D41B8485CB8DA5C0EE090A69304D2: You ever feel like you cough so hard that part of your lung falls out?
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.188_Text: You get things crawling out of the ground there.//It’s full of surprises.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.ED1FFF8E46C3D3D19B966ABD2FF90056: You get things crawling out of the ground there.//It’s full of surprises.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.37_Text: You give off a real animal-loving vibe.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.BB9B7978440C5488DC2167940468E8BB: You give off a real animal-loving vibe.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.43AF29374A9AC8CF3002B08ACA4ACD6C: You got a trumpet to blow there, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.59_Text: You got a trumpet to blow there, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.78_Text: You hear that Summer music, <PlayerName>$player</>? Pretty awesome, isn’t it?//<portrait=happy>You have to feel it in your heart. Open your third ear… Then you can hear… Is that an angklung?
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.8FC42E0A474AEA077C45699279CBF9BC: You hear that Summer music, <PlayerName>$player</>? Pretty awesome, isn’t it?//<portrait=happy>You have to feel it in your heart. Open your third ear… Then you can hear… Is that an angklung?
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.0606B60440366A6EDD6DB28924520DD4: You heard of this thing? Um…tempeh?//<portrait=happy>Oh yeah… That stuff is yummy as heck. Nothing beats fresh bananas, though.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.54_Text: You heard of this thing? Um…tempeh?//<portrait=happy>Oh yeah… That stuff is yummy as heck. Nothing beats fresh bananas, though.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.953CDF174E8C7A6E4EDE14BCA1A9FE85: You know what I’m saying, <PlayerName>$player</>? I’m free to see my toes dancing whenever I want.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.97_Text: You know what I’m saying, <PlayerName>$player</>? I’m free to see my toes dancing whenever I want.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.003CE56A401DD3894237A99FCAE1C354: You know what I’m saying, <PlayerName>$player</>?//<portrait=happy>Whenever I want, I’m free to see my toes dancing. Now, that’s something.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.39_Text: You know what I’m saying, <PlayerName>$player</>?//<portrait=happy>Whenever I want, I’m free to see my toes dancing. Now, that’s something.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.2C3D9C524979A76647556EA4FEAA00B9: You know, once I’m all snuggled up in bed, I barely notice how cold it is.//It’s kinda nice, actually, to sleep when it’s freezing cold out. As long as I don’t freeze, that’s all I ask.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.90_Text: You know, once I’m all snuggled up in bed, I barely notice how cold it is.//It’s kinda nice, actually, to sleep when it’s freezing cold out. As long as I don’t freeze, that’s all I ask.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.4EDF1C814D903019A7E291B99266F397: You seem like the chill farmer type. Not the get-off-my-lawn kind.//<portrait=normal>Know what I mean?//<portrait=concerned>A friend was camping on somebody’s lawn one time, and he may have been kicked out.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.62_Text: You seem like the chill farmer type. Not the get-off-my-lawn kind.//<portrait=normal>Know what I mean?//<portrait=concerned>A friend was camping on somebody’s lawn one time, and he may have been kicked out.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.208_Text: You think so too? I knew it!
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.A9651F964DA5C92290A868BE563C89E1: You think so too? I knew it!
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.214_Text: You wouldn’t believe this shirt was once white. Very boring.//<portrait=annoyed>I, uh, I dyed it myself. It fits more with who I am now.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.E5F5A2294A3D87FB26A47EBC4259E2BC: You wouldn’t believe this shirt was once white. Very boring.//<portrait=annoyed>I, uh, I dyed it myself. It fits more with who I am now.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.165_Text: Your presence cleanses my aura right away, <PlayerName>$Player</>.//<portrait=normal>Powerful stuff.
DT_Dialogue_Ben_Production.2A7DB76948794C2BB51071B3E0050CB7: Your presence cleanses my aura right away, <PlayerName>$Player</>.//<portrait=normal>Powerful stuff.

DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.110_Text: <NPCName>Frank</> is a joker. I see a lot of my late husband in him.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.129_Text: <NpcName>Aaliyah</> was always a smart kid. Ever since she was a little girl, she got trophies left and right.//Look around, they’re everywhere in this house!
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.112_Text: <NpcName>Connor</> has been mayor for as long as I can remember.//He truly cares about Coral Island and the people in it.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.119_Text: <NpcName>Emma</> makes terrific food. She’s great with spices.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.158_Text: <NpcName>Erika</> always dotes on <NPCName>Butter</>, calling her “Baby <NPCName>Butter</>.” She never uses such a nickname for <NPCName>Peanut</>.//<portrait=annoyed>Don't think I haven't noticed that, <PlayerName>$Player</>.//It seems quite clear to me that she has a favorite.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.16_Text: <NpcName>Eva</> and I have a lot in common. We both love red velvet cake.//<portrait=normal>But who doesn’t?
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.86_Text: <NpcName>Millie</> is the only one who’s building a house in this area. I wonder why it isn’t more popular.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.41_Text: <NpcName>Noah</> needs to be more careful when he puts dishes away.//We almost lost a stack of cups the other day when he crammed the cabinet too full.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.31_Text: <NpcName>Noah</> says I spoil the cats, <NPCName>Peanut</> and <NPCName>Butter</>.//<portrait=happy>I’m starting to think he might have a point.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.111_Text: <NpcName>Noah</> – ah, he’s a sensitive soul. He has a gentle heart, that one.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.8_Text: <NpcName>Pablo</> helps me fix the broken bird feeders.//<portrait=happy>He and his brother are very handy.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.47_Text: A community garden reminds me of the old days, when we used to share everything we had.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.127_Text: A house needs kids’ laughter, don’t you think?
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.10_Text: After all, you moved here, didn’t you?
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.100_Text: Ah, this one still seems to have plenty.//<portrait=concerned>Maybe <NPCName>Suki</> just refilled them.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.55_Text: Am I really going to complain about the heat?//<portrait=annoyed>No. I will not.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.85_Text: Are you heading to the beach?
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.103_Text: Are you stopping by the Tavern?
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.59_Text: Are you thinking of growing any on your farm, dear?
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.45_Text: Be careful of crows. They may seem harmless, but they like to steal crops.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.109_Text: Besides, they have <NpcName>Aaliyah</> to help if anything were to go south.//<portrait=happy>I know I can count on my girl to watch over her little siblings.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.29_Text: Can’t answer that one?//Maybe your old days are different from the ones I remember.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.5_Text: Did you know turtles often eat trash? They think it’s plankton or floating seaweed. But they can’t digest it.//<portrait=sad>Eating trash really harms animals.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.19_Text: Don’t strain yourself. I need to drink more water in Summer, even though I do the same tasks every season of the year.//Make sure you do that too.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.113_Text: Ever since my husband, <NPCName>Frankie</>, passed away, <NPCName>Frank</> has been stepping up a lot.//I pray for that boy. He has a lot on his shoulders.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.6_Text: For old folks like me, Monday is just another day.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.107_Text: Good thing <NpcName>Aaliyah</> keeps a close watch on him.//<portrait=concerned>I just wish he’d call more often.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.122_Text: Happy New Year, dear. I pray this year is good for you, bringing you a lot of fortune and happiness.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.88_Text: He and <NpcName>Noah</> are picky when it comes to yogurt.//<portrait=sad>No matter what I put in it, they don’t seem to like it.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.13_Text: Hmm. You seem preoccupied, dear.//Everything okay, I hope?
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.39_Text: Hmm… I’m going to try to make a batch of popiah sometime this week.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.25_Text: Hopefully, they carry these lessons into their adulthood.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.1_Text: How lovely to see a new face around here!//You can call me <NPCName>Betty</>, dear.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.60_Text: I can’t be outside in the heat for too long. The heat can be…a bit much.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.159_Text: I don’t always agree with everything <NpcName>Erika</> does, but she’s a sweet girl.//<portrait=happy>She spends a lot of her time teaching kids, doing volunteer work. My son is lucky to have her.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.105_Text: I don’t mind helping to sort the recyclables.//<portrait=normal>With my children all grown up, it’s nice to feel needed sometimes.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.7_Text: I don’t mind refilling the bird feeders around town.//I have a lot of time on my hands.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.81_Text: I have to wear extra socks at night.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.42_Text: I like a lot of things about this town.//<portrait=happy>The lake, the wildlife, <NpcName>Jim’s</> smoked salmon.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.126_Text: I like to think <NPCName>Frankie</> and I did the best we could raising the kids.//<portrait=normal>We might not have had a lot, but we made sure they always got what they needed.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.124_Text: I make sure to always make mooncakes for the Harvest Festival.//It’s good to share them with the people we love.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.28_Text: I miss the old days sometimes, don’t you?
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.93_Text: I must be extra careful walking around here.//One fall and I could break my hip.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.61_Text: I never get tired of the Fall breeze.//Ah… This is my favorite time of year.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.149_Text: I should make more bird food.//I'm running a bit low.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.64_Text: I sometimes wish <NPCName>Frank</> would give me some grandchildren! But I respect their decision.//<portrait=normal>There’s always <NPCName>Peanut</> and <NPCName>Butter</>.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.15_Text: I still find joy in baking, but not quite as much as I used to.//<portrait=concerned>I just don’t have the same energy.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.89_Text: I suppose I can’t blame them.//They’re still young, and they think they’ll be healthy forever.//<portrait=normal>But we need to take care of our bodies so our bodies take care of us, yes?
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.12_Text: I thought I’d pass on the information to you.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.23_Text: I try not to meddle too much.//I believe they've got the Tavern under control.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.128_Text: I try to clean the ceramic plates at least once a year. Get them out of the cabinet, wash them, and put them back.//<portrait=happy>Oh, we don’t use them. Only for the New Year’s dinner, at most.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.155_Text: I try to stay strong and keep a positive spirit, but it's not always easy.//Sometimes, I just get overwhelmed and the tears come.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.133_Text: I used to make my own noodles for birthdays, but now it’s just too much work, especially with four children.//<portrait=concerned>I don’t think my hands could take it.//<portrait=normal>Now we just buy noodles to use in my recipes.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.131_Text: I used to take the children to visit my parents on New Year’s. Not always, but if we could, we would. This was before, when they were still alive.//It was a good way for the children to spend time with their cousins.//<portrait=concerned>New Year’s visits were important to my parents.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.37_Text: I volunteer at the school each week.//<portrait=normal>It's a little something I share with my daughter-in-law, <NpcName>Erika</>.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.52_Text: I was talking about the Cherry Blossom Festival. What were you talking about, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.143_Text: I was worried when <NPCName>Frank</> was dating that Pokyo girl.//I was afraid he might not want to come back home after university.//<portrait=concerned>With <NpcName>Eddy</> living abroad and <NpcName>Aaliyah</> busy with her duties, I’d be left with just one son to run this place.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.141_Text: I watched the twins, <NpcName>Alice</> and <NpcName>Suki</>, grow up.//That girl <NpcName>Alice</> was over at the house every other day, playing with my sons, watching TV.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.40_Text: I wonder how many carrots we have left in the fridge.//<portrait=sad>I know we have some eggplants, but you can’t use eggplants to make popiah.//<portrait=annoyed>It wouldn’t be popiah without carrots.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.121_Text: I wonder if I should wear red to the Cherry Blossom Festival.//It’s a happy day. Thought it might bring some of that same good luck from New Year’s.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.54_Text: I'm trying to help the bees by planting flowers.//Hopefully, in time, we'll see more bee houses popping up around the island.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.144_Text: If <NPCName>Frank</> had wanted to stay in Pokyo, I guess it would have been fine.//<portrait=sad>Fishensips is big. It’s too much work for one person, but <NpcName>Noah</> always could have hired help.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.69_Text: If I don’t absolutely have to leave the house, I try to stay in when the weather’s like this.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.71_Text: If I don’t absolutely have to leave the house, I try to stay in when the weather’s like this.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.72_Text: If I don’t absolutely have to leave the house, I try to stay in when the weather’s like this.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.74_Text: If I don’t absolutely have to leave the house, I try to stay in when the weather’s like this.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.76_Text: If I don’t absolutely have to leave the house, I try to stay in when the weather’s like this.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.77_Text: If I don’t absolutely have to leave the house, I try to stay in when the weather’s like this.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.91_Text: If you feel comfortable in the forest, the area around <NpcName>Kira’s</> cabin is very lush.//<portrait=normal>My late husband used to find plenty of things there.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.11_Text: If you have fruit trees on your farm, don’t chop them down at the end of the season.//Unlike crops that die at the end of the season, they’ll be ready to produce again in the coming year.//<portrait=happy>Your grandmother shared that bit of wisdom with me.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.30_Text: If you plant bee-friendly flowers on your farm, it can really boost the bee population.//And if you could set up a few bee houses, that'd be the cherry on top.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.14_Text: If you’re looking for things to do during Winter, maybe you could take up fishing.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.46_Text: If you’re worried, I hear scarecrows can be effective.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.123_Text: In our house, we never miss eating mooncakes together in Fall.//<portrait=happy>I hope it brings us good luck.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.56_Text: It <Italic>is</> warm…//But warm is good.//<portrait=normal>We need warmth sometimes, yes?//<portrait=annoyed>The humidity, though… Hmm…
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.118_Text: It was our seafood day. I looked forward to it every week.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.139_Text: It’s good to have a coffee shop in front of Fishensips. It makes the area lively.//<portrait=happy><NpcName>Raj</> is a good kid too. They know so much about coffee beans.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.38_Text: It’s our responsibility to take care of the planet for future generations.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.35_Text: It’s the same way with cats. They’re very smart.//We also need to be a good example for them.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.57_Text: It’s too hot for tulips.//<portrait=annoyed>I think I’ll plant irises instead.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.51_Text: I’ll be bringing red velvet cake tomorrow. I suspect there won’t be many desserts.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.90_Text: I’m enjoying the view.//<portrait=normal>I was foraging in the woodland earlier, and I think I gathered enough for dinner.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.156_Text: I’m grateful for <NpcName>Aaliyah’s</> service, and I couldn't be prouder of the woman she's grown into.//I prayed for her safety every day she was away from me.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.99_Text: I’m just here to refill the bird feeder.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.20_Text: I’m not entirely against plastics. I have plenty of plastic things in my kitchen.//I find ways to reuse them.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.108_Text: I’m not worried about what will happen to Fishensips when I–//<portrait=normal><NPCName>Frank</> and <NpcName>Noah</> are doing great running the Tavern.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.120_Text: I’m so proud of her.//<portrait=normal>I still remember when she used to work at <NpcName>Sam’s</>, and now she has a business of her own.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.134_Text: I’m trying to make the rounds. I want to make sure the bird feeders are all full before the end of the week.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.87_Text: I’ve been trying to get <NPCName>Frank</> to eat more yogurt.//He’s been eating pancakes all the time lately, and <NpcName>Erika</> doesn’t seem to pay much attention to their diet at home.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.148_Text: Just try to be more patient, dear.//<portrait=normal>Sometimes we do forget to show ourselves some kindness.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.62_Text: Keep some lotuses in your pantry, <PlayerName>$player</>. You never know when you’ll have a craving for mooncakes.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.34_Text: Kids are very perceptive.//They absorb everything we do like little sponges.//As grown-ups, it's up to us to show them the right way.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.151_Text: Life has a slower rhythm here, but that's how we enjoy it. We take our time and appreciate every single moment.//<portrait=happy>No need to hurry, dear. There's no rush.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.153_Text: Living on this small island, it can be tough at times. We have to make do with what we've got, and there's always the worry about the electricity going out during a storm.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.65_Text: Making mooncakes isn’t that tough. All you need is a lotus, mix it with flour and egg, and give it a good blend.//You should give it a try!
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.95_Text: Many fond memories were made here at the beach with my late husband.//Money has never held much value to me.//It's quality time spent with family that truly warms the heart.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.101_Text: Mayor <NpcName>Connor</> put me in charge of the town’s decorations and landscaping.//I like doing it, but it’s a lot of work.//<portrait=happy>Thankfully, I have <NpcName>Pablo</> to help.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.125_Text: My children and I used to sit and watch the moon on Fall nights.//<portrait=normal>I’d tell them tales my mother used to tell me. Like stories about the Moon <NPCName>Goddess</> and her Moon Rabbit.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.154_Text: My daughter, she's the light of my life. When she was away in the military, I missed her each and every day.//<portrait=concerned>I was always so worried about her safety and well-being.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.48_Text: My great-grandparents were part of the farming community on this island. They planted, while others fished or built.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.117_Text: My husband and I used to go diving in the middle of the week.// Afterward, we’d always have big bowls of seafood ramen.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.27_Text: My only advice is to keep experimenting with your cooking.//<portrait=happy><NPCName>Frank</> always has an eye out for new recipes to try.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.106_Text: My youngest son, <NpcName>Eddy</>, hasn’t answered my last letter after a week. It’s nothing out of the ordinary for him.//It doesn’t keep me from worrying every time he does it, though.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.21_Text: Not just plastic, tin cans too.//<portrait=normal>They make excellent containers for crackers.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.102_Text: Now that I have a lot of free time on my hands, I can finally give back to the community.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.43_Text: Now, remember to give your fresh produce a good rinse under running water before you eat them, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.33_Text: Oh, why, you ask? Well, perhaps for a nice meal in the future? You never know.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.136_Text: Oh, you heard that too? Ah, I’m worried about them.//Cats out at night – I don’t think it’s very safe. I wish <NPCName>Frank</> would do something about it.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.150_Text: Our community here is close, as tight as a hand-knit sweater. We all know and care for each other.//It's such a lovely feeling to be surrounded by all these friendly faces.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.49_Text: Peonies are blooming this time of year.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.135_Text: People around town have been talking about how <NPCName>Frank</>’s cats, <NPCName>Peanut</> and <NPCName>Butter</>, go roaming around at night.//I had no idea they were so adventurous.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.84_Text: Please watch your step. I’d hate for you to crush these flowers.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.63_Text: Raising four children isn’t easy. Especially when they’re so close in age. It was chaos from the first, but I wouldn’t change it for the world.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.3_Text: Remember to reuse what you can and recycle what you can’t, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.17_Text: She’s such a ray of sunshine.//I always look forward to having Sunday tea with her.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.147_Text: Sometimes when we knock on a door, the one who answers it isn’t who we expected.//<portrait=happy>And that’s okay.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.58_Text: Sunflowers are blooming this time of year.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.116_Text: Ten percent of success is down to the quality of the ingredients.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.114_Text: That boy has grown to be a very dependable man. His dad would’ve been proud.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.115_Text: The key to baking is to follow the recipe as closely as possible.//Do that, and you’ll get a perfect result 90 percent of the time.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.79_Text: The kids must be out building snowmen by the park.//<portrait=normal>It used to be the favorite spot for all my kids when it snowed. Heh heh.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.22_Text: The kids run the Tavern on their own.//It may look easy, but running a food business is a lot of work.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.152_Text: The nearest town is a few hours away by boat, so I only go there when necessary.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.146_Text: The ocean introduced me to a lot of creatures.//<portrait=happy>Keep diving, <PlayerName>$player</>. I’m sure it’ll open up to you, too.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.80_Text: The snow is giving me cold feet…
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.137_Text: The stairs are a little slippery today. I’ll ask <NpcName>Joko</> to take a look. Maybe it’s mold.//Hopefully not. Hopefully, it’s just water or something.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.145_Text: The water is refreshingly cool today.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.66_Text: The weather keeps getting colder. It’s not agreeing with my joints.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.97_Text: The wind does seem to have a bit of a bite today.//I should be getting back soon.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.130_Text: There weren’t a lot of books around when I was a little girl.//<portrait=normal>Now kids have books on their computers and phones.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.138_Text: Thinking about how much Fishensips has seen makes me sad sometimes.//We raised four children in it…the cats…<NPCName>Frankie</>…
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.9_Text: This island has a lot of potential.//It warms my heart to see people beginning to appreciate it.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.104_Text: Today I want to focus on the town’s landscaping.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.140_Text: We need to stock up on oranges. I’ll be taking some to <NPCName>Frankie</>’s and my parents’ graves soon.//Maybe <NpcName>Noah</> can pick some up from <NpcName>Sam’s</>.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.142_Text: We used to take her with us to family gatherings. She’s practically family to us.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.96_Text: We used to watch the sunsets together, right there by that old tree.//I always remind my children to cherish the moment, to truly live.//<portrait=happy>One must never be too busy for little adventures.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.44_Text: We wouldn’t want to be munching on dirt, now would we?
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.82_Text: What a lovely day!//<portrait=happy>I might bake mooncakes to enjoy with some evening tea.
