DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.24_Text: When I visit the school, I talk about many things.//<portrait=normal>Like how to recycle properly, for example.//It might seem straightforward, but it's crucial for the kids to learn it right.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.98_Text: Where’s your wetsuit? It’s perfect diving weather.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.83_Text: Why, of course I can bake mooncakes.//I don’t just bake cookies, dear.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.50_Text: Will you be planting any at your farm?//<portrait=normal>It’s not too late, you know.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.75_Text: Would you wipe your boots at the door, please?
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.36_Text: Yesterday, I taught about all the different things that damage coral reefs and how to prevent the reefs from dying.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.32_Text: You might consider storing a part of your harvest for later.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.160_Text: You might think cats don’t understand you, but I believe they do.//They have feelings too, my dear. I do my best not to favor one over the other.//I wouldn’t want to hurt their feelings.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.73_Text: You should go home and rest, dear.//With this weather, you have to be careful not to catch a cold.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.53_Text: You'll find a handy little calendar in front of <NpcName>Sam’s</> store. It's got all the festivals and birthdays.//<portrait=normal>Do give it a look. Quite helpful, I must say.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.70_Text: Your boots are soaking, dear.//Would you please wipe them off at the door?
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.132_Text: You’re a good addition to this community, dear.//<portrait=normal>I’m glad you moved here.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.4_Text: You’re right, we don’t have any community recycling machines yet.//<portrait=normal>But all in good time.
DT_Dialogue_Betty_Production.2_Text: You’re the first visitor we’ve had in a while.//After the oil spill last year, tourists hardly come anymore.

DT_Dialogue_Bonbon_Production.2_Text: No wonder Bonbon seems happy here.//It’s very comfy!
DT_Dialogue_Bonbon_Production.21_Text: [Bonbon barks a lot. He’s a dog, after all.]
DT_Dialogue_Bonbon_Production.19_Text: [Bonbon has a full belly. He must have just had a big meal.]
DT_Dialogue_Bonbon_Production.12_Text: [Bonbon is one adventurous pup! You see him everywhere.]
DT_Dialogue_Bonbon_Production.16_Text: [Bonbon looks happy, and that makes you happy.]
DT_Dialogue_Bonbon_Production.11_Text: [Bonbon seems to be enjoying his day!]
DT_Dialogue_Bonbon_Production.20_Text: [Is Bonbon a puppy or a full-grown boy?]
DT_Dialogue_Bonbon_Production.18_Text: [You call Bonbon a cute ball of fur.]//[He seems happy with the nickname.]
DT_Dialogue_Bonbon_Production.14_Text: [You want to just stay here and pet Bonbon all day.]
DT_Dialogue_Bonbon_Production.13_Text: [You want to take Bonbon for a walk, but you have errands to run.]
DT_Dialogue_Bonbon_Production.9_Text: [You wonder how Bonbon can be so cute <Italic>and</> so fluffy!]
DT_Dialogue_Bonbon_Production.15_Text: [You’re glad you ran into Bonbon.]//[You wish it could happen more often.]

DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.34_Text: <NPCName>Taco</>’s a very happy puppy. We’re so glad he came to live with us.//<portrait=normal>He’s precious. I’ve grown attached to him very quickly.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.29_Text: <NPCName>Taco</>’s a very independent pup. He likes to explore.//Sometimes I worry about him getting lost.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.2_Text: <NPCName>Walter</> and I own the vineyard, you see. Our clients are mostly abroad.//<portrait=normal>Shall I send over a bottle?
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.134_Text: <NpcName>Archie’s</> lovely. He says the funniest things.//<portrait=normal>I wonder if I’ll ever get grandkids from <NpcName>Luke</>.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.9_Text: <NpcName>Ben</> is tricky. His shop is often closed on weekdays.//If you want to give him a visit, I’d recommend going on the weekend.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.16_Text: <NpcName>Dinda’s</> a dear friend of mine. She’s always so sweet.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.40_Text: <NpcName>Luke</> handles all the vineyard business except for the farming side.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.89_Text: <NpcName>Luke</> used to run around the vineyard when he was little, and he’d eat grapes until his stomach hurt. Ah, ha ha.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.44_Text: <NpcName>Walter</> can be stubborn sometimes, especially when it comes to big decisions.//<portrait=concerned>But he isn’t half as pushy as some people. You know?
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.107_Text: <NpcName>Walter</> would go wild if I came home with pink hair or something.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.32_Text: About a year after we settled here, we were graced with our <NpcName>Luke</>.//My precious little <NpcName>Luke</>.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.64_Text: Actually, it was more like he grew it out really tall.//<portrait=normal>I wish he’d kept that style. He looked very nice that way.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.78_Text: Ah dear! I’ll have to ask <NpcName>Luke</> to shovel the snow tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.103_Text: Ah, fresh flowers sound good, don’t they, <PlayerName>$player</>? They really cheer the place up.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.96_Text: And gossiping a little about the townies, right, <NpcName>Dinda</>? Ha ha.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.162_Text: Any other time of year, I’m simply too busy.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.82_Text: Are you looking for <NpcName>Taco</>?//He should be around here somewhere.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.144_Text: Are you looking forward to the Harvest Festival?//The display contest is always exciting to watch.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.117_Text: Aren’t they great? Maybe I’ll get one myself for the house.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.24_Text: Being a farmer in this little town is so much fun. A lot more fun than playing the wife in the big city.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.30_Text: But he always comes home.//He’s a smart one.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.47_Text: But it’s nice to know we have an extra supply.//<portrait=annoyed>Don’t you grow a surplus on your farm? Tsk, tsk, tsk. I hope you do, <PlayerName>$Player</>.//It’s for your own good.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.22_Text: But let's keep our little farming chats under wraps. We wouldn't want to incite any petty jealousy.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.7_Text: By the way, <NpcName>Ben</> sells seeds too.//If <NpcName>Sam</> is ever closed, give <NpcName>Ben</> a try.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.150_Text: Does that happen to you too?//<portrait=annoyed>Oh, right. You just ship things overnight with <NpcName>Sam</>, huh? That makes it easy.//<portrait=normal>Maybe we’ll start using a third party like that.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.20_Text: Doesn't farming give you a sense of tranquility, too?
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.23_Text: Doing dishes is a chore, and it takes forever. To be perfectly honest, I’d rather cook all day.//<portrait=normal>I’m more gifted in that area.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.141_Text: Everyone has a past, right, <PlayerName>$player</>?//<portrait=happy>There’s no point in dwelling on what’s already happened.//<portrait=normal>It’s over. We’re new people today.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.61_Text: Farming is easier if you have automatic sprinklers.//But not everybody needs them.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.19_Text: Farming, to me, is therapeutic. Nurturing plants from seedlings and witnessing their growth is a serene experience.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.166_Text: For a price, of course. But we can’t put a price on art, can we, <PlayerName>$Player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.133_Text: Ha ha ha. Yes, love at first sight – something like that.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.81_Text: Have you eaten, <PlayerName>$player</>?//Would you like some tea? Or coffee?
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.36_Text: Have you settled in yet? Take your time, dear. I didn’t feel like this was home for years.//I felt comfortable right away, sure. But home? That’s always been hard for me.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.41_Text: He even does quality control to keep our standards high.//<portrait=normal>I’m very proud of him. He’ll do very well when he takes over.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.164_Text: He got hissed at by the brown one. Oh, that scared him, yeah!//<portrait=concerned>My poor baby.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.35_Text: He has <Italic>so</> many friends around town, you know. He’s popular.//I think his best friend is our neighbor <NpcName>Archie</>.//Ah, and that curly dog. The small barky one.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.6_Text: How much longer are we going to let this pile up?
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.26_Text: How’s your Summer going, <PlayerName>$Player</>? Mine’s been good, though I can’t seem to find my pearl earrings this morning.//<portrait=annoyed>The ones <NpcName>Walter’s</> mother gave me. Now, if you think <NpcName>Walter</> is eccentric, wait till you meet his mother.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.25_Text: I always look forward to the town’s charming little holidays too.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.92_Text: I always loved gardening. But who’d have thought I’d actually enjoy making a living out of it?
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.55_Text: I brought some bok choy, and nobody touched it. What is it with vegetables, <PlayerName>$player</>?//Is it just because they’re green?
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.10_Text: I can't be sure about <NpcName>Ben's</> business hours.//Best take the initiative and find out for yourself.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.111_Text: I can’t comment on our caterer for the New Year’s Festival event. It’s going to be a surprise!
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.130_Text: I can’t even begin to think about <NpcName>Luke</> getting married.//It makes me nervous.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.152_Text: I don’t like dealing with stuff like that. I let <NpcName>Luke</> take care of it.//I’ve had enough wining and dining in my youth with <NpcName>Walter’s</> friends.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.163_Text: I don’t think <NPCName>Taco</> likes the cats very much.//<portrait=normal>Oh, I’m not talking about just any cats. <NpcName>Erika’s</> cats. I’m sure you’ve seen them around.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.127_Text: I don’t think I’m asking too much. I mean, he’s my only son.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.151_Text: I get tense just thinking about distributing our wines.//Public relations and everything. Yada yada yada…
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.106_Text: I guess I know where <NpcName>Luke</> gets his indecisiveness.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.71_Text: I have to be somewhere. Please excuse me.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.76_Text: I have to be somewhere. Please excuse me.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.50_Text: I heard about Pufferfish moving in. I’d rather not discuss it right now.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.131_Text: I hope when he has his own family, he still has time to visit me and his dad.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.52_Text: I hope you enjoyed the New Year’s gathering, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.83_Text: I make my own bread when I can. <NpcName>Eva’s</> is a little too chewy. It’s not the best for soup.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.132_Text: I met <NpcName>Luke’s</> father when I was working.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.153_Text: I moved here for a second chance. A new story. A new life.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.27_Text: I need to find the earrings before our next dinner with her.//I can’t risk getting on her bad side again.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.101_Text: I need to pick up some flour. Hmm…
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.143_Text: I ran into <NpcName>Charles</> yesterday, and he wasn’t wearing his lab coat.//<portrait=happy>He looked nice. I’m used to seeing him in the lab coat, but maybe change is good sometimes. Yeah.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.145_Text: I secretly loathe going to dinner parties with <NpcName>Walter’s</> friends in the city.//I can just feel their scorn.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.140_Text: I simply don’t understand what <NpcName>Ben’s</> wearing.//A tank top in Summer, in the middle of the forest. Tsk, tsk, tsk.//Not a good call.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.154_Text: I still see my old friends sometimes. But now, we live so far away from our…er…old life.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.38_Text: I usually don’t like getting my hands dirty, but I just feel better when I’m working in the soil.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.93_Text: I was a little bored at home. There wasn’t much to do.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.128_Text: I was telling <NpcName>Dinda</> that <NpcName>Luke</> overthinks things sometimes. He’s always been like that.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.115_Text: I wish <NpcName>Luke</> would worry less. He overthinks things sometimes.//<portrait=concerned>I keep telling him to stop worrying. It’s no use.//It’ll give you unnecessary wrinkles.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.122_Text: I wonder if <NpcName>Ben</> is around.//He might have some.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.124_Text: I wonder if <NpcName>Ben</> is around.//He might have some.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.102_Text: I wonder what <NpcName>Eva</> puts in this insanely delicious cake.//I’m determined to find out her secret!
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.48_Text: If wild vegetables pique your interest, you're in for a treat.//Our land is quite generous in that regard.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.165_Text: If you like paintings, I recommend <NPCName>Dippa</>.//They produce one-of-a-kind art.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.62_Text: If you only have a few rows of crops, you could probably do without them.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.84_Text: In Summer, I usually grill whatever fruit or vegetables I can find and just drizzle honey on them.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.8_Text: In fact, I buy a lot of things from him.//To help out his business a little, you see.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.12_Text: In the world of winemaking, the grape is king. Quality wine is impossible without quality grapes.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.80_Text: It makes you think about all the things you haven’t done.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.37_Text: It must be a shock to your system, moving here from a big city.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.43_Text: It shows that something doesn’t have to be logical to be beautiful.//<portrait=normal>It really gets me, you know.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.54_Text: It was such a blast last week at the lake. It’s a great way to keep the community close.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.57_Text: It was tiring. Moonlighting at clubs every night to make ends meet until I got my big break…//That was the plan, anyway.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.135_Text: It would be nice, yes. But I’m not a pushy person, so I won’t force him.//<portrait=annoyed>Though if he knows what’s good for him, he should start thinking about it.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.51_Text: It’s a bit upsetting, isn’t it? We came here to this beautiful island, hoping to get away from big corporations.//Then a part of the past followed us.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.70_Text: It’s been raining like this all day. *sighs*
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.74_Text: It’s been raining like this all day. *sighs*
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.104_Text: It’s important to take care of yourself. It’s not selfish.//<portrait=happy>On the contrary, it can really improve your performance, and it’s good for your mood.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.39_Text: It’s like I’m giving back to Mother Earth. It gives me a purpose in life, yeah.//<portrait=happy>Intense, I know.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.126_Text: It’s not that I don’t trust <NpcName>Luke</>.//<portrait=normal>I just want to know who he’s spending time with, you know?
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.155_Text: It’s really time for my hair treatment again, huh?//<portrait=annoyed>My hair feels so coarse. Blech!
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.113_Text: I’m going to try a new recipe today.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.95_Text: I’m just bringing over some baked goods…
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.156_Text: I’m just getting my hair blown out today, nothing fancy.//Something decent for a simple dinner tonight.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.112_Text: I’m keeping it a secret so everybody’s surprised.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.97_Text: Live music in the evening is always a good idea.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.118_Text: Live music in the evening is always a good idea. *dances in her seat*
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.60_Text: Looking for tips? Oh, I’d love to give you some.//<portrait=normal>You have to ferment rice in a keg for several days to make sake.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.108_Text: My Monday has been wonderful. How’s yours?
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.42_Text: My favorite style of painting has to be impressionism.//<portrait=happy>The short, strong brushstrokes really capture the essence of the subject without getting bogged down in the details.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.159_Text: My hair is a mess, but I’m simply too busy to go to the salon.//It’ll have to wait until later.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.18_Text: Never neglect breakfast, <PlayerName>$player</>. It's fundamental!//Skipping it will only leave you famished and prone to overeating.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.94_Text: Not everyone can do woodwork. You need certain skills, plus, it’s labor intensive.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.58_Text: Obviously, I never got my big break.//<portrait=normal>But that’s a story for another time.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.114_Text: Oh dang! I ran out of basil. Let’s see if I can just cook this without it.//<portrait=concerned>Would it taste funny, you think, if I changed the basil to ginger? I’ve got plenty of ginger.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.66_Text: Oh my! I’m glad your toes are all covered up and warm.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.65_Text: Oh no! It’s Winter already. I need to start getting ready for the annual feast.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.75_Text: Oh no. You seem flushed, <PlayerName>$player</>. You’re coming down with a cold! Get some rest!
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.137_Text: Oh, don’t judge, dear.//I’m sure you’ve done the same thing with your pet.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.68_Text: Oh, it’s hard to work in this weather.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.72_Text: Oh, it’s hard to work in this weather.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.110_Text: Oh, it’s incredibly stressful!//I need my old assistant back.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.1_Text: Oh, you’re the new farmer.//I was worried there for a bit about a potential competitor.//<portrait=happy>Nothing to worry about, it seems.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.148_Text: Oh. Dear <NpcName>Kira</> does like to tease. Maybe I should visit her charming little cabin again.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.45_Text: Okay, maybe he is pushy, but just not with me.//As long as he isn’t that way with me, I’m all right.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.77_Text: Once, I went to this beautiful ski resort in a small town down south.//It looked exactly like this when it snowed.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.119_Text: People back in the city used to stare at me when I was out with <NpcName>Walter</>.//This was way before we had <NpcName>Luke</>.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.120_Text: People don’t do that here. They see me as more than just <NpcName>Walter’s</> wife.//They see me as <NpcName>Bree</>.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.17_Text: She makes the best homemade meals.//<Italic>Sometimes</> even better than my own.//<portrait=normal>It might be because she grows her own herbs. Yes…that must be it.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.56_Text: Sometimes I do miss modeling. The glam, the people…//But I don’t miss all of it. Some of it was rough.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.105_Text: Sometimes, I just want to chop my hair off, but I probably won’t.//Ha ha ha! I don’t think it would suit me.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.86_Text: Sorry about the mess! I haven’t straightened up.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.139_Text: Thankfully, he recovered quickly.//He has a sensitive tummy.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.109_Text: The New Year’s Festival is coming up.//I have to take care of the seating, catering, and minigames.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.157_Text: The dinner is at home, of course.//<portrait=normal>I much prefer it that way.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.33_Text: The good thing about this place is that it still feels sleepy on the weekend.//Oh no, no, no, don’t get me wrong. It’s a good thing.//<portrait=happy>We <Italic>want</> sleepy.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.5_Text: The recycling center is such an eyesore. We want to recycle, but there’s no place to do it.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.13_Text: The same goes for our sake.//The key to good produce is good seeds.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.125_Text: The shampoo here smells divine. It’s just not the same when you wash your hair at home, even if you use the <Italic>exact</> same shampoo.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.88_Text: The soil here is ideal for grapes.//And there’s the hills and just the right amount of sunlight.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.91_Text: There aren’t a lot of wild fruits here, for some reason.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.63_Text: There was a period when <NpcName>Luke</> dyed his hair bright blue. Then he grew it out really long.//<portrait=normal>No, no – without the blue dye.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.138_Text: There was a point when <NPCName>Taco</> was very sick with a rare stomach bug.//<portrait=concerned>His vet in Pokyo put him on a strict diet. I was worried, of course.//My mind went to dark places.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.15_Text: These days, I prefer homemade meals as much as possible.//<portrait=happy>I consider it my way of making amends for the carelessness of my youth. Such a laugh.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.149_Text: Things never make sense around here.//We’ll have perfectly happy customers, then suddenly they stop ordering.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.123_Text: Too bad <NpcName>Sam</> isn’t selling blueberries right now.//I’m craving fresh blueberries. Hmm…
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.121_Text: Too bad <NpcName>Sam</> isn’t selling pumpkins right now.//I’m craving pumpkin soup.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.3_Text: Ugh… Every time I walk past that recycling center, I get a headache.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.98_Text: Umm, I felt like dancing tonight, so I just skipped cooking dinner and came here instead.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.53_Text: Up to your standards, I hope?
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.136_Text: Watch your step, <PlayerName>$player</>. <NPCName>Taco</> can sneak up on you.//<portrait=concerned>I’ve stepped on him getting up from my chair when he’d been asleep right there all along.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.67_Text: We certainly don’t want them to freeze. Great call!
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.46_Text: We don’t necessarily have to grow grapes all year-round.//In Winter, we focus on other aspects of the vineyard.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.85_Text: We have cold drinks in the fridge. Feel free!
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.14_Text: We maintain a strict business model—our products are exclusively available to licensed liquor establishments.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.28_Text: We make sure to have enough grapes to make wine year-round.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.21_Text: We should meet up and talk about farming sometime, since we both seem to be working in the same field now.//<portrait=happy>Oh! That’s a pun!
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.4_Text: What are people putting in there? I thought we agreed to only put in clean, recyclable items.//<portrait=annoyed>Obviously, some people don’t know what clean means.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.116_Text: What are you doing here, <PlayerName>$player</>? Picking up a new wall clock?
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.142_Text: What matters is who we are now and who we will be tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.147_Text: Wine lady? Hmm… Who called me that?
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.160_Text: Winter is the time to retouch my hair. A nice cut and color. The usual maintenance.//It’s when I have the <Italic>time</>.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.161_Text: Winter is the time to retouch my hair. A nice cut and color. The usual maintenance.//It’s when I have the <Italic>time</>.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.79_Text: Winter nights can be really lonely, don’t you think?//I think it’s the sense that the year is ending.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.59_Text: You can grow grapes in Fall. Are you planting some this year?//I don’t know if you’ll be able to plant them now. If I were you, I’d wait until Fall arrives and start then.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.146_Text: You make jam and stuff on your farm, don’t you? And you sell it?//<portrait=happy>Good for you.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.11_Text: You see, we are quite particular about our seeds at the vineyard. Quality consistency is essential.//<portrait=annoyed>I presume you grasp the importance of that, yes?
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.49_Text: You're more than welcome to forage here often.//We don't mind.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.100_Text: Yummy. I wonder what <NpcName>Frank</> puts in this.
DT_Dialogue_Bree_Production.99_Text: [<NpcName>Bree</> is snapping her fingers slightly off-beat.]

DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.172_Text: <Italic>Man</>! I’ve been hanging out too much with the space geeks.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.138_Text: <Italic>Man</>, I’m craving some ramen.//<portrait=determined>I’m not too fussy when it comes to food, though. I’ll take any ramen. Seafood ramen, veggie ramen – whatever!
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.139_Text: <Italic>Man</>, shoveling snow is such a workout. My arms are gonna be sore tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.105_Text: <NPCName>Frank’s</> pesto pasta is good.//<portrait=happy>Easy to overeat.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.122_Text: <NpcName>Aaliyah</> can throw stones so far out into the sea. I need to ask her to teach me how to do it.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.166_Text: <NpcName>Aaliyah’s</> got this cool plane sweater, huh? I wonder if they make one with a duck or somethin’.//<portrait=determined>I’d totally rock that.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.153_Text: <NpcName>Ben</> hooked me up with it, so like, who knows if it’s legit, right?
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.132_Text: <NpcName>Takeba</> takes great care of the bathhouse. We should go there sometime…together.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.113_Text: <NpcName>Wakuu</> and I have completely different schedules, so we don’t get in each other’s way. It’s perfect.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.87_Text: <NpcName>Wakuu</> goes to see his dad every weekend like clockwork.//Come Saturday, the place is all mine until Monday.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.68_Text: <NpcName>Zarah</> was using a metal detector down on the beach the other day, and she found a gold coin.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.165_Text: After a long day at work or practice, I like to unwind with a big bowl of ramen.//<portrait=happy>The spicier, the better!
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.9_Text: And those riptides are no joke!//People think they’re good swimmers, but the waves will pull you under in a split second.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.77_Text: Apples are in season, no? Do you have them on your farm, <PlayerName>$Player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.89_Text: Are you doing one of those New Year’s resolution things?//<portrait=determined>Mine is the same every year. Get better at life.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.107_Text: But it doesn’t last forever, you know?//You don’t see grandparents competing in the Pokyo Volleyball Tournament.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.145_Text: Can’t wait for Summer to roll around again! The beach, the sun, the sand. It’s my favorite season.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.162_Text: Chill in the shade and avoid that direct sun.//<portrait=sad>I don’t want you gettin’ heatstroke or anything.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.116_Text: Dang, I forgot my water bottle again. I swear, my mind’s in the clouds today.//<portrait=annoyed>At least I still have my head on my shoulders, or I’d probably lose it too!
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.10_Text: Didn’t mean to freak you out! It’s calm most of the time. But when a lifeguard tells you to stay close to shore, pay attention.//<portrait=determined>We’re just looking out for you.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.147_Text: Do scientists really rake in that much cash?
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.48_Text: Don’t forget to properly dispose of six-pack rings after a picnic. You hear?
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.70_Text: Found a pearl on the beach the other day. Not yours, is it?
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.16_Text: Gimme some carbs, you know what I mean? Pizza, pasta, gnocchi…ramen!//<portrait=happy>I would kill for some ramen right now.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.60_Text: Guess I’ll have to stay inside today.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.64_Text: Guess I’ll have to stay inside today.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.177_Text: Have a seat. Let’s chill out a little!
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.146_Text: Have you ever wondered where <NpcName>Wakuu</> gets his money?//The dude’s always splurging on fancy coffee <Italic>every day</>.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.66_Text: Have you seen a pair of sunglasses anywhere?//I lost mine. I’m sure I had them yesterday at work…
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.99_Text: Have you seen that dog running around town? <NPCName>Taco</>?//<portrait=happy>I love that scruffy guy.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.133_Text: Having short hair is awesome for beach volleyball.//Sand just slides right off. No fuss, no muss.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.158_Text: He also mentioned that basil might help with getting rid of bad spirits, so maybe he’s not <Italic>totally</> on point.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.180_Text: Heading to the hot spring? It’s that way, behind this building.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.27_Text: Hey, check out my new sneakers! They give me extra spring in my toes. Perfect for volleyball.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.109_Text: Hmm… Should I get my flu shot now? Kinda don’t wanna go to the clinic.//Not a fan of clinics or hospitals. That’s where <Italic>sick</> people go, you know what I mean?
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.17_Text: How about this weather, huh? Rainy one day, sunny the next. Bah!
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.19_Text: How about this weather, huh? Rainy one day, sunny the next. Bah!
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.21_Text: How about this weather, huh? Rainy one day, sunny the next. Bah!
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.131_Text: I always feel like a real adult when I shovel snow.//<portrait=happy>Like, look at me being a responsible homeowner and stuff.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.115_Text: I can’t believe how much weight I’ve been able to lift lately.//I’m really sore, though.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.4_Text: I can’t chitchat all day.//Talk to someone else, will you?
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.80_Text: I cleaned the leaves in front of the bathhouse yesterday, and they’re already piling up again.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.140_Text: I don’t keep my dumbbells in my room because I’m selfish or anything.//<portrait=surprised>It’s just that sometimes I like to work out early in the morning when <NpcName>Wakuu</> is still asleep.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.49_Text: I don’t like staying indoors too long, sitting behind a desk. Bah!
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.125_Text: I don’t want to come on too strong, but I just have to say it. You are one fine specimen of a human being.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.141_Text: I don’t want to disturb his rest, you know? I’m just being considerate.//<portrait=blushing>I’m nice, huh? I bet that’s why you like me. *winks* Ha ha!
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.108_Text: I feel dizzy… My head…//Whoaaaaa… I might’ve caught something.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.119_Text: I gotta clean my place next week. It’s a total disaster.//<portrait=concerned>Also, I’m missing a pair of shorts.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.18_Text: I had no idea what to expect when I woke up this morning.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.20_Text: I had no idea what to expect when I woke up this morning.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.22_Text: I had no idea what to expect when I woke up this morning.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.54_Text: I hadn’t even worn it once!//The first wash, and it shrank. Dang it!
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.106_Text: I hate to think about getting older.//<portrait=determined>I’m in the prime of my life, <PlayerName>$player</>. I’m in better shape now than I’ve ever been.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.149_Text: I have no clue who decked out the observatory. It was already looking fresh when I rolled in.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.75_Text: I jacked up my knee yesterday. I slipped on some leaves and fell down the stairs in front of the bathhouse. Bah!
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.159_Text: I kinda wish you were heading home with me tonight.//It’d be nice to have some company.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.88_Text: I know <NpcName>Wataru</> gardens at his house. Has a small patch in front of the lighthouse.//<NpcName>Wakuu</> always brings random produce back to the observatory. Tastes great! Really fresh.//<portrait=concerned>What do they do now Winter is here? Can’t be gardening, can it?
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.74_Text: I like playing sports where there are winners and losers.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.98_Text: I like playing volleyball with <NPCName>Aaliyah</>.//We both play hard, you know what I mean?
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.112_Text: I live up the hill ’cause it’s a killer workout every day. And the view from the observatory tower? It’s insane!//You been up there? Yeah, you know what’s up.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.46_Text: I managed to stay in pretty good shape over Winter, but I feel a little off my game, you know?//<portrait=determined>I’m itching to get in a good workout.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.155_Text: I mean, it might’ve been <NpcName>Archie</> or <NPCName>Taco</>, but at 9 pm?//<portrait=concerned>Nah, I’m pretty sure it was a ghost, for real.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.39_Text: I might take a class online to learn something new.//Not right now. I’m way too busy. But maybe this Winter, when it’s too cold for volleyball.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.134_Text: I offered <NpcName>Alice</> some pizza when we were at the beach the other day, but she said it makes her bloated.//<portrait=happy>Oh well. More for me, I guess!
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.91_Text: I only work the afternoon shift, so I have lots of time to practice volleyball.//<portrait=determined>Gotta keep my eyes on the prize, you know what I mean?
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.28_Text: I paid way too much for these shoes. Hopefully, they’re going to up my game.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.90_Text: I started lifeguarding during my last Summer of high school, before I moved to Coral Island.//<portrait=happy>I didn’t think I’d still be doing it all these years later, but no complaints.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.11_Text: I started lifeguarding in high school and just stuck with it, I guess.//It’s not a hard job, and it helps me stay in shape.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.41_Text: I still run to the beach from my house, but the snow slows me down! Bah!//And when it’s icy, forget it. Trying to run on ice is a sure way to break a bone.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.117_Text: I think I pulled a muscle in my leg during practice the other day.//I’m going to have to sit out for a little while.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.33_Text: I think it’s just seaweed that washed up, but still. Ugh.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.168_Text: I tried making green pesto pasta the other night, and it was super delish!//<portrait=happy>I’m thinkin’ I’ll make it again tomorrow, maybe add some extra veggies.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.73_Text: I used to swim a lot when I was a kid, but it didn’t grab me. Not competitive enough, I think.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.169_Text: I usually just buy it from the Tavern, but money’s a little tight lately.//<portrait=happy>Or I could always eat <NpcName>Wakuu’s</> food again. Ha ha! Kidding, <PlayerName>$Player</>!//Live a little!
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.58_Text: I was about her age when I started playing. It’s never too early.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.59_Text: I was gonna get in some volleyball time, but it’s just too wet out there. Bah!
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.63_Text: I was gonna get in some volleyball time, but it’s just too wet out there. Bah!
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.57_Text: If <NPCName>Zoe’s</> serious about volleyball, I’ll take her under my wing.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.161_Text: If you start feelin’ dizzy, head to the Beach Shack and grab a drink.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.83_Text: Is getting mittens worth it, you reckon?//You look like the type who’d have a lot of that kind of thing.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.76_Text: It kinda hurts when I walk. I guess this is a glimpse into what old age will feel like.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.61_Text: It really rains the whole day, doesn’t it?
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.62_Text: It really storms the whole day, doesn’t it?
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.45_Text: It’s Spring, baby! Time to hit the volleyball court and work off my Winter blues!
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.38_Text: It’s almost the end of the year already. Fast, huh?
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.160_Text: It’s always a good idea to swim with a buddy or stay close to the lifeguard tower.//I’m here to help if anything goes wrong. It’s better to be safe than sorry.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.14_Text: It’s cool if it’s not your thing. I won’t hold it against you.//<portrait=determined>I mean, to me, a life without volleyball seems like a pretty sad existence, but I guess you feel the same way about a life without…I dunno…corn?//<portrait=normal>Whatever you grow at your farm.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.82_Text: It’s freezing today.//Do a few jumping jacks or push-ups if you wanna get toasty warm. Try it.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.65_Text: It’s gonna snow the whole day today. I just <Italic>know</> it.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.124_Text: It’s infectious. I can’t help but smile when I’m around you.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.30_Text: It’s pretty, but I’m worried the petals will clog up the drain. <Italic>My</> drain.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.84_Text: I’ll see if <NpcName>Wakuu</> has some and test-drive them, maybe.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.114_Text: I’m gonna have to skip the beach today.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.118_Text: I’m hyped for the Cherry Blossom Festival next week. The food is always next level.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.175_Text: I’m loving the Tavern’s playlist.//<portrait=happy>They’ve got a perfect mix of classic hits and fresh tunes. Makes me wanna bop.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.52_Text: I’m seeing more and more people busting out the swimwear.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.43_Text: I’m so itchy today! I’ve got bug bites all over my legs.//The bugs are out in force lately. Great!
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.110_Text: I’m sure the one in town is cleaner than my room right now, but who knows what kind of germs or viruses are in there? *shivers*
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.121_Text: I’m thinking of getting a tat. I want something that screams strength and perseverance. Cool, huh?//<portrait=annoyed>But honestly, between you and me, I’m a bit of a wimp when it comes to needles. What if it’s not sterile or something?
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.92_Text: I’ve been swimming for years, but you know what I wish I did more of? Diving.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.164_Text: I’ve been working on my serve lately. It’s all about that perfect balance of power and control, you know what I mean?
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.101_Text: I’ve thought about getting a pet, but between volleyball practice and workouts and work, I’m hardly ever home to take care of one.//<portrait=concerned>I don’t want to stay cooped up in my house like <NpcName>Wakuu</>, and that’s not fair to a pet.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.13_Text: Join me sometime. We’ll get a game going. Gotta warn you, though. I play to win.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.95_Text: Kind of a hike to get to the beach, but I like that. Keeps me in shape, you know?
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.93_Text: Maybe I could train to be a deep-sea diver. Who knows?
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.97_Text: Might stop by the Beach Shack later, pick up some coconuts.//I’m kinda in the mood for one.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.150_Text: Must’ve been the boss man, <NpcName>Wakuu</>, who did the magic.//<portrait=normal>Swimming in cash, that dude.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.8_Text: My job’s not just a day at the beach. I have to be on the lookout all the time.//It only takes a split second for somebody to get into trouble in the water.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.181_Text: Need to eat more bananas, for sure.//Don’t want any cramps after all this!
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.81_Text: Need to find <NpcName>Wakuu</>. It’s his turn to clear the path for <NpcName>Takeba</>.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.53_Text: Never buying from White Flamingo again.//Got a new swimsuit, and…
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.67_Text: Oh <Italic>man</>! I forgot I let <NpcName>Wakuu</> borrow them.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.156_Text: Oh, the observatory is <Italic>totally</> haunted, no doubt.//I don’t have any solid proof or anything, but my gut just tells me it’s true.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.86_Text: One of those giant animal suits from White Flamingo would be nice.//<portrait=determined>Nice and toasty inside.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.32_Text: Oof, the beach is gross today. Smells like dead fish.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.143_Text: Please, <NPCName>Goddess</>, keep me safe out there.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.135_Text: She also said it was nasty. What <Italic>is</> her problem?
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.137_Text: Smoked, though. Fish tastes kinda good when you smoke it.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.72_Text: So what if you lose? Gotta face it and try again tomorrow.//It’s not the end of the world.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.154_Text: So, like, I was walkin’ home late one night, right? And I swear, I saw this ghost by the observatory!//<portrait=concerned>It was short, sorta cylinder-shaped, and it moved super fast. <Italic>Man</>, I couldn’t sleep for days after that!
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.71_Text: Sports teach humility. I like that.//Sometimes we win and sometimes we lose.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.55_Text: Stargazing is cool.//Didn’t think so at first, but now I’m living at the observatory, I kinda get it.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.5_Text: The Beach Shack has people in it if you want to chat.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.23_Text: The hot spring is really good for sore muscles. Nothing beats a hot soak after a hard workout.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.42_Text: The hot spring sounds good right now.//<portrait=annoyed>What is it?
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.50_Text: The human body was built to move.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.148_Text: The observatory gets super chilly in Winter. I swear it’s because of the size.//The place is way too big.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.163_Text: The sunset at the beach is just unreal.//Stick around and watch it with me.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.182_Text: The weather is nice today.//Outdoor time, baby!
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.44_Text: The weather is warming up.//If I dressed any warmer, I’d sweat <Italic>buckets</>.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.6_Text: There’s plenty of room over there if you wanna sit down.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.29_Text: There’s this pink tree next to the hot spring.//Do you know what it is? Cherry, maybe?
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.51_Text: There’s usually an influx of people visiting the beach in Summer.//I get it. Summer, beach. Yeah, whatever.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.142_Text: These icy sidewalks give me anxiety, I swear. I’m so afraid of slipping and falling!//Can’t take any chances when I only have two legs.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.100_Text: This one time, I saw <NPCName>Taco</> swimming in the fountain. Yeah, the one in front of the general store.//<portrait=happy>What a funny little dude.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.34_Text: This storm is wild! The beach is going to be a mess tomorrow.//All sorts of trash and debris washes up after weather like this.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.35_Text: This storm is wild! The beach is going to be a mess tomorrow.//All sorts of trash and debris washes up after weather like this.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.36_Text: This storm is wild! Watch out.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.37_Text: This storm is wild! Watch out.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.120_Text: This year is zooming by <Italic>fast</>!//It feels like we just celebrated New Year’s yesterday.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.183_Text: Took me forever to put these pants on. Do they really have to be this tight?
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.136_Text: Ugh, hate fish. It’s the one thing I just can’t stomach.//Something about the taste and texture just makes me want to gag.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.102_Text: Unless I brought them out with me. I hadn’t thought about that.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.12_Text: Volleyball – that’s my real passion. Do you play?
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.179_Text: Wanna join me for a workout?
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.31_Text: Watch out for jellyfish on the beach.//Don’t get stung.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.173_Text: What do you think I should grab from the menu?
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.78_Text: What’s with the giant chicken they have at the Harvest Festival, huh? So weird!
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.144_Text: When <NpcName>Wakuu</> brings home his catch from the weekend, it stinks up the whole dang house. Drives me nuts!
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.184_Text: Where are my sweatpants anyway?//I keep misplacing stuff. Bleh.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.79_Text: Where do you think I could get one of those?
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.176_Text: Where do you think they get this wine from? Your farm or something?//<portrait=blushing>’Cause it’s seriously tasty! *hic*
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.151_Text: Who else could it have been, a ghost? Ha ha ha!//<portrait=concerned>No, seriously. Don’t joke about ghosts. It freaks me out.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.103_Text: Who made that sign for the Beach Shack?//<portrait=annoyed>The coconut drink sign says Buy Two, Get Two. It’s funny ’cause it reminds me of something my dad always said.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.130_Text: Winter makes me appreciate the warmer weather even more.//Bring on the Summer sun, baby!
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.170_Text: Yesterday morning, I did my workout at the beach, and <Italic>man</>, the sand really made things more challenging.//<portrait=determined>But hey, I got to dive right into the ocean after, so it was a pretty sweet way to start the day!
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.24_Text: Yikes, this rain! I’ve never seen anything like it!
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.25_Text: Yikes, this rain! I’ve never seen anything like it!
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.26_Text: Yikes, this rain! I’ve never seen anything like it!
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.128_Text: You always seem to know the right thing to say. I admire that about you.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.7_Text: You can’t dive from here. You gotta go there.//Go to the inn, then go south. You can dive there.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.56_Text: You either get it or you don’t.//If you don’t, then it’s your loss.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.174_Text: You gotta try <NpcName>Frank’s</> basil pesto pasta. It’s the <Italic>bomb</>!
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.127_Text: You have such a unique style. I love it.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.94_Text: You know the Hillside observatory? I live out there.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.47_Text: You know the plastic rings six-packs come in?//<portrait=sad>They can kill sea life if they end up in the ocean. It’s so sad.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.152_Text: You know those charms that’re supposed to keep bad spirits away?//<portrait=annoyed>It might sound goofy, but I have one in my room all the time, just in case.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.126_Text: You know, I think you and I would make a pretty great team.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.157_Text: You know, some scientists actually believe in ghosts.//<portrait=surprised>Like <NPCName>Scott</>. He’s some kind of scientist, and he told me there’s something sketchy goin’ on at that beach villa.//<portrait=concerned>Yeah, you won’t see me anywhere near that place.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.167_Text: You should come join me for a workout sometime!//I could show you some of my favorite exercises, and we could keep each other motivated.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.69_Text: You think there might be more?//I should invest in a metal detector.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.171_Text: You won’t believe the dream I had last night.//<portrait=happy>I was an astronaut, exploring the farthest reaches of the galaxy. It was so surreal!
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.129_Text: You’re a really great listener. I always feel heard and understood when I talk to you.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.2_Text: You’re in my way.//No, seriously, you are in my way.
DT_Dialogue_Chaem_Production.1_Text: You’re the new arrival, huh?//Don’t bother me, and I won’t bother you.//<portrait=happy>Ha! <Italic>Sike!</>

DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.137_Text: *sneezes* Oh, sorry. The flowers. This season…really gets to me… *sneezes*
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.133_Text: *sneezes* You never know when allergies will hit.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.87_Text: <NPCName>Yuri</> and I are usually pretty busy this season.//The townsfolk always need us for something or other, whether it’s treating a cold or patching them up after a slip on the ice.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.174_Text: <NpcName>Millie</> would be upset if I misplaced another one of her books.//<portrait=annoyed>You’d think that I’d have a better memory, being a doctor and all, wouldn’t you? But nope.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.43_Text: <NpcName>Scott's</> a bit...messy, yeah. And he tends to leave things all over the place.//<portrait=normal>But, um, aside from that, he's actually a...a decent housemate, I suppose.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.210_Text: <NpcName>Scott</> worries that I’ll be alone if I’m still single when he moves out.//<portrait=normal>I don’t think he gets it. I don’t mind.//I like my own company.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.151_Text: <NpcName>Sunny</> always tries to talk me into going fishing. Heh heh. Funny guy.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.217_Text: <NpcName>Sunny</> could use hearing aids, but he refuses.//<portrait=happy>I’m not too worried about it. It isn’t anything major.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.142_Text: Ah, who am I kidding? My hair isn’t this bright.//I’ve got gray hair, <PlayerName>$player</>! That’s why I keep revamping the color.//<portrait=concerned>Oh jeez. Do youngsters still say “revamping”?
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.100_Text: All this snow must be challenging for people in your trade.//Farming and the snowy season… Tough business.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.86_Text: Are you excited about the Harvest Festival, <PlayerName>$player</>?//Well, I can't wait, but I'm a bit nervous too.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.123_Text: Are you okay? You look a bit flushed and sweaty.//<portrait=normal>I think you might need some medicine.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.52_Text: Being seen next to <NpcName>Yuri</> can be overwhelming for me.//She's so...vibrant and green, it's...um, quite striking, if you ask me.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.220_Text: By the way, thanks for always being there for me.//I appreciate it.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.201_Text: Cookies sound great right now.//The ones from <NpcName>Sam’s</> are my <Italic>kryptonite</>.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.80_Text: Daisies...um, they don't make me sneeze too much unless I get really close.//So, I just try to avoid places where they grow.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.13_Text: Dehydration is a real thing. Your body’s mostly water, and it can’t work right without it. So, remember to stay hydrated, and drink plenty!
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.180_Text: Did I just say “alive”? Oh gosh. Heh heh. I meant lively!//Someone <Italic>lively</> like <NpcName>Scott</>.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.192_Text: Diet is much more important than you realize.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.112_Text: Do I have something in my hair?
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.139_Text: Do you, um, come here often?
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.200_Text: Doesn’t matter… I’m enough. I’m loved.//A little mantra my therapist taught me. *hic*
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.122_Text: Don’t shame a man for trying to sell his products, <PlayerName>$player</>.//<portrait=normal>Vitamins help you, and they help me at the same time. I don’t know what you’re talking about.//It doesn’t sound shady to me at all.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.170_Text: Don’t tell <NpcName>Scott</>! I don’t want his head to get bigger than it already is. Ha ha!
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.11_Text: Don’t you feel great after a good farming session, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.157_Text: Errr… I mean, to make sure her tasks are done on time.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.16_Text: Especially not when you’re in the middle of a hot date.//Take a bite of that clam, then a rash suddenly breaks out, and your lips start to swell.//<portrait=happy><Italic>Not</> based on personal experience… *winks*
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.110_Text: Fancy seeing you here this late, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.227_Text: Get your flu shot if you haven’t already.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.61_Text: H-Hey, I'm not mumbling incomprehensible gibberish!//I’m trying to remember the medicines I need to restock.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.32_Text: Ha ha. What can I say? I should really follow my own medical advice sometimes.//<portrait=happy>Um, certain things are just easier said than done, especially when burritos are involved! Heh...
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.197_Text: Have I told you about my ex?//Oh, here come the tears!
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.85_Text: Have you, um, gotten your flu shot yet?//Winter is next week, you know.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.46_Text: Health care is a basic human need.//So I don’t think wealth should determine whether or not somebody gets it.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.19_Text: Health is wealth. Don’t forget that!//Your money means nothing if you’re not healthy enough to enjoy it.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.216_Text: His son, <NpcName>Oliver</>, is a major incentive for him to stay healthy.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.66_Text: Hmm… I’d apply more sunscreen in about an hour if I were you.//<portrait=normal>Better safe than sorry, I always say.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.63_Text: Hold on a–//<portrait=surprised>*achoo!*//<portrait=normal>What I was saying was–//<portrait=surprised>*achoo!*//<portrait=normal>Okay. I think I’m good now. Where were we?
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.69_Text: I always change clothes as soon as I get home.// You don’t want to sleep with pollen sticking to your clothes and hair and stuff. *shivers*
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.221_Text: I appreciate everything <NpcName>Scott’s</> done for me.//He’s a good friend.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.224_Text: I bet we can see the stars tonight.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.99_Text: I blame the snow. Well, at least the dinner party is coming up soon, eh?
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.171_Text: I came to Starlet Town right after I was licensed. I was being good. I was trying to have a normal life, make enough money to feed my family.//<portrait=annoyed>At the time, I was ready to settle down with my–
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.164_Text: I can hear you, you know.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.181_Text: I can make home visits if necessary, yeah.//Just let me know when, and I’ll be there.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.149_Text: I can’t believe how bright it is outside today.//If it weren’t for that ice-cold wind, you’d think it was Summer!
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.134_Text: I can’t believe people want to drill for oil here, of all places.//<portrait=normal>This island is beautiful!//Before the oil spill happened, anyway.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.6_Text: I can’t remember for the life of me.//Tell you what, I’ll write you if it comes back to me.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.50_Text: I could go for a burrito right now.//<portrait=normal>And maybe...some strawberries later.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.167_Text: I didn’t think my life would turn out like this.//<portrait=sad>I thought I’d be married and have a family of my own by now, but sometimes life throws you a curveball.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.103_Text: I don't think I'll venture out today.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.113_Text: I don’t think I’ll go out today.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.7_Text: I don’t want to be rude, but I wonder what you put in those pockets of yours.//<portrait=happy>They always seem so full.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.179_Text: I feel like I’m too uptight sometimes, so having a friend who’s alive, like <NpcName>Scott</>, can be good for my sanity.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.73_Text: I feel like myself again! No more endless sniffling!
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.27_Text: I feel very safe here. This is home to me.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.153_Text: I found wild berries by the lighthouse the other day!
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.96_Text: I guess farmers like your good self must be busy this season, eh?
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.169_Text: I hate to admit this, but…//<portrait=normal>I like having <NpcName>Scott</> around because he makes the house feels less empty.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.30_Text: I have this ritual that I’ve been doing for who knows how long.//On Saturdays, I like to make burritos and keep the leftovers for Sunday’s lunch.//<portrait=happy>Are you like that too?
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.75_Text: I have to say, hot weather isn’t my thing.//It puffs up my hair like cotton candy.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.4_Text: I hope you like Coral Island. See you around!
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.135_Text: I hope you're not overfeeding your pet.//Playing with them when they're bored is...well, better than just giving them treats, I think.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.81_Text: I just love Fall. There’s all the warming comfort food, and it’s not too hot or too cold outside.//It’s perfect.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.68_Text: I know what you’re gonna say. I should probably take allergy medicine, right? But it makes me really drowsy.//Haven’t found the right one, probably.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.223_Text: I like sunny days like these.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.71_Text: I like the weather, but Spring’s gotta be at the bottom of my list of favorite seasons.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.202_Text: I like this color on me. Green, yeah!//<portrait=happy>It lifts my spirits.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.42_Text: I might have to remember to apply sunscreen to my head if I become bald.//<portrait=concerned>Or, um, perhaps wearing a hat would be a good idea.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.90_Text: I open my windows first thing in the morning.//I like to let the cold air in.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.59_Text: I popped into the Tavern to see if anybody was there, but then I just left.//I wasn’t really feeling it today.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.198_Text: I should go home. I think I’ve had enough to drink.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.20_Text: I should make a poster about that and hang it here.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.159_Text: I think I’ll head home after this...//I'm feeling pretty tired.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.105_Text: I think I’ll stop by the Tavern after work to warm up.//On rainy days like this, I bet it’s busier than ever.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.215_Text: I told <NpcName>Sunny</> to keep up with his swimming. He’s great at it, too! One of the fastest swimmers in town.//<portrait=happy>Swimming is easy on the knees, and it keeps him healthy.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.162_Text: I tripped on a shoe and spilled my coffee this morning. What a Monday, eh?
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.51_Text: I try to match my tie to my hair. It’s hard to choose the right shade sometimes.//But thankfully, I managed to figure it out somehow.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.213_Text: I was talking to the mayor the other day, and he seemed down.//<portrait=normal>I’m going to check up on him tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.23_Text: I wear my green button-down when I’m feeling daring.//<portrait=happy>Have you seen me in it?//<portrait=normal>It makes for quite the outfit, I’ve been told.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.98_Text: I'm feeling a bit, um, low.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.148_Text: I'm just having a chat with <NpcName>Suki</>.//It's a bit too hot for me to be outside.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.35_Text: I'm sorry, I don't mean to scare you or anything. It's just...the truth.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.79_Text: I've already had to treat a few people for sunburn...//<portrait=surprised>I won't name any names, <PlayerName>$player</>. Doctor-patient confidentiality and all that.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.214_Text: If he gets the Winter blues, vitamin D should help.//I’ll see if I can take him some.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.145_Text: If my pollen allergy weren’t so bad, I’d buy some flowers.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.132_Text: If you get a cut or a scrape, wash it right away with running water.//It'll help clean the wound.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.49_Text: In all my years at the clinic, I've never turned anyone away in need.//That's...um, not what we stand for here.//We believe in providing care and support to everyone, because that's the right thing to do.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.168_Text: Instead, I’m all alone, living in a house with an overgrown frat boy.//<portrait=happy>And that’s A-OK!
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.109_Text: Is <NpcName>Millie</> looking this way? How do I look?
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.108_Text: Is my hair okay? I think the rain messed it up on the way here.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.127_Text: It can get a bit too bright in here sometimes. Makes it hard for me to nap.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.131_Text: It feels like it's going to be a good day... I think!
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.76_Text: It's good that more people are out and about in Summer. J-Just...um, don't forget the sunscreen, okay?
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.33_Text: It's important to get your health checked regularly.//If something's wrong, it's better to catch it early... I mean, it's crucial for early detection and prevention.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.31_Text: It's okay to let loose on special occasions, I suppose.//But we should always remember not to get carried away... I-I mean, it's important to exercise caution and not go overboard, you know?
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.114_Text: It’s a good time to catch up on some paperwork.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.95_Text: It’s bright yet soothing, vibrant yet refreshing, crisp yet soft, and full of warmth.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.186_Text: It’s good to have extra medicine on hand if you go down to the cavern.//Just in case.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.15_Text: It’s important to be aware of our allergies.//You really don’t want to discover an allergy accidentally.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.222_Text: It’s nice and sunny today. I wish I could enjoy it.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.117_Text: I’ll be out late today. I don’t want to be home all by myself.//I’m feeling kinda lonely.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.9_Text: I’m all for farming. I think it’s an excellent activity for both body and mind.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.84_Text: I’m better suited to colder weather, I think.//Not too many mosquitos, and I just wake up refreshed!
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.158_Text: I’m checking out a couple of books today to read over the next week.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.45_Text: I’m glad everybody here has equal access to health care.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.156_Text: I’m here to make sure <NpcName>Millie</> is doing well.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.67_Text: I’m keeping my windows closed for the whole season.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.92_Text: I’m looking forward to the New Year’s Festival. Are you? I can’t wait for the present exchange and eating all the good food.//<NPCName>Bree</> is an amazing host!
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.209_Text: I’m not looking for love. I told <NpcName>Scott</> love isn’t something we “look for.”//If it’s meant to be, it’ll come.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.101_Text: I’m noticing that compared to other seasons, there’s less variety of fresh produce at <NpcName>Sam’s</>.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.70_Text: I’m so glad <NPCName>Yuri</> is here. She’s made of iron, that one.//I would’ve been miserable running the clinic alone with all this pollen flying around.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.54_Text: I’m trying to reduce my dairy intake. But some things are harder to cut out than others.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.154_Text: I’ve yet to see this place packed.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.120_Text: Let me tell you something. The loneliness hits differently when you’re home alone on a snowy day.//It makes you not want to be at home.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.172_Text: Let’s just say things don’t always go as planned.//<portrait=annoyed>But I learned you don’t have to worry about feeding your family if you don’t <Italic>have</> any family to feed.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.64_Text: Life must be exciting right now for farmers like you.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.226_Text: Make sure to wash your hands often.//Flu season’s here.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.53_Text: Milk gives me an upset stomach, so I try to avoid it.//Honestly, I...um, I'd rather not drink it at all.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.72_Text: My allergies are like clockwork, <PlayerName>$player</>. On the 1st of Spring, that’s it for me.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.177_Text: My hair looks great today. It <Italic>feels</> great.//<portrait=happy>I think I have a great day ahead of me.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.144_Text: Never once in my life have I come here intending to buy anything, but somehow, I always buy something I don’t need.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.21_Text: New fashion trends are cool, but on other people.//I’m pretty comfortable with my style, so I’m sticking with it.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.199_Text: Not going to lie. I do envy <NpcName>Yuri</> sometimes.//She’s done so much with her life. What have I done? *sobs*
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.83_Text: Nothing like the crisp Fall air for enjoying some sweet potato chips.//<portrait=annoyed>I wish I had some now…
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.166_Text: Now I’m just looking for some peace and solitude.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.74_Text: Now that the pollen has calmed down, I can...um, I can open my windows again.//Nothing beats waking up in the fresh air.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.195_Text: Oh boy… I don’t know why I told you that.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.183_Text: Oh goodness! You surprised me there, <Italic>buddy</>.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.188_Text: Oh my, it’s dead in here.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.178_Text: Oh! Don’t touch it.//<portrait=sad>Sorry! I don’t want you to mess it up.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.147_Text: Oh, um, what am I reading? Just some medical journals and fashion magazines.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.65_Text: Oh, you know, with the new season and all.//<portrait=happy>It’s, um, an ideal time for farming, I suppose.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.40_Text: Oh, you said "lazy." I thought you said my hair was...<Italic>messy</>.//<portrait=annoyed>Oh, um, please don't startle me like that! I'm not being lazy, I'm just taking a short break.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.176_Text: Oh, you’re going to <NpcName>Sam’s</>, huh? Hmm. Let’s see. What do I need from <NpcName>Sam’s</>?
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.41_Text: One day not long from now, my hair will be gone. So I'm trying to cherish every strand while I still can.//<portrait=surprised>N-not that there's anything wrong with going bald.//<portrait=annoyed>I'm just imagining how warm it would be under the sun...um, hypothetically speaking.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.193_Text: One of the things I wish all patients knew is that they should always be honest with their doctors.//We’re just trying to give the best care possible.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.225_Text: Oof! My belt feels tight.//<portrait=angry>It must be all the cookies I ate last week.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.48_Text: Our clinic only charges for emergency services.//And even then, we’re highly subsidized by the government, so everybody pays what they can afford.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.26_Text: People here are kind.//It was the right move to choose Starlet Town as my forever home.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.106_Text: People just don’t like to walk around in the rain, and I guess they get bored sitting around at home.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.78_Text: People may call me...um, annoying for it, but I'll keep reminding them about sunscreen.//Especially in this scorching Summer sun.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.88_Text: Please take care of yourself this season, <PlayerName>$player</>. Winter can be tough on our health, with less sunlight and all...//And it's not just about the flu or colds. The Winter blues can really get to you.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.194_Text: Psst… I tried to curl my hair back in the day.//<portrait=happy>Still have a picture of it somewhere at the house. Ha ha. I wish I didn’t.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.104_Text: Rainy days like this are a rare opportunity to catch up on some paperwork.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.136_Text: Right, I, um, I don't have any pets...//<portrait=normal>But that doesn't mean I don't know a thing or two about them.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.196_Text: Should I order another cake?//I mean, I've been watching what I eat lately, so I feel like I deserve a little reward.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.165_Text: Sometimes I feel like I’m 150 years old. *chuckles* I went through way too much, too fast.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.184_Text: Sorry I called you buddy. That felt kinda weird.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.14_Text: Sorry, I often sound stuffy in the morning.//But it usually clears up later.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.8_Text: That reminds me. I forgot to take the recycling out yesterday.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.44_Text: That said, he...um, often walks straight into doors. Not just screen doors, but regular solid ones too.//<portrait=annoyed>It's quite surprising how successful he is, given his...um, clumsiness.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.37_Text: That way, we could detect mental illness faster and easier.//<portrait=happy>I mean, early intervention is...um, crucial for maintaining good health, you see?
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.12_Text: That’s what sunshine and physical activity does for you, my friend.//It gets the endorphins going – your feel-good chemicals.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.82_Text: The best thing about Fall is definitely sweet potato chips.//Sure, I could get them in other seasons, but they’re just better in Fall, you know?
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.28_Text: The first time I met <NPCName>Leah</> was…scary.//<portrait=sad>She used to scare me.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.77_Text: The humidity isn’t helping my hair at all.//Yours is fine, though. How come? What shampoo do you use?
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.55_Text: The last time I went out dancing? Hmm… Has to have been last week.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.211_Text: The mayor sets a great example for what people should wear in Summer.//Nice breezy clothing, a well-fitting hat.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.5_Text: The recycling center been here since…umm…
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.146_Text: There are plenty of wild fruits around here.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.58_Text: There are so many people, there’s no room to dance.//What’s the point of going if I’m not going to dance, right? I prefer to go on Fridays.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.182_Text: There aren’t many requests for home visits around here. Unless they’re badly injured or can’t get out of bed, people usually prefer to come to the clinic.//<portrait=normal>Oh, except for <NpcName>Walter</> and his family.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.219_Text: There’s nothing wrong with it, but why would you <Italic>want</> to eat flowers?
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.143_Text: They don’t say “youngsters” anymore, do they?//<portrait=concerned>My age is showing.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.130_Text: This morning, I woke up and I just, um, realized that this island is filled with clean air and nice people.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.212_Text: This white coat is handy in Winter.//<portrait=annoyed>Wearing just scrubs is too cold for me. Way too cold.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.102_Text: Time passes so quickly these days. Just like falling raindrops.//There one second, gone the next.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.57_Text: Today isn’t a good day to go to the Tavern. Trust me!//It’s so busy on weekends. Phew!
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.22_Text: Too much change makes me nervous.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.141_Text: Two drinks and I’m done. Anything more and it’s hangover city for me the next day.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.150_Text: Ugh, I don’t think I put on enough sunscreen today. I hope they have extra!
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.24_Text: Uh-oh! I hope I don’t sound vain. That’s not what I mean.//<portrait=concerned>*mumbles* Oh no, I’m starting to sound like <NpcName>Scott</>.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.62_Text: Uh-oh, here it comes. Spring allergies.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.38_Text: Um, a hobby can help you relax and improve your overall well-being in the long run.//So if you don’t already have a hobby, maybe you could consider...um, reading or maybe even...uh, picking up a fishing rod... If that's something you're interested in.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.39_Text: Um, excuse me, but is my hair...uh, messy? I hope not...
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.107_Text: Want to know what’s fun to do in this type of weather? Work.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.119_Text: Want to know what’s fun to do in this type of weather? Work. Get your body moving and warm up.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.126_Text: We disinfect the clinic according to international standards, especially after an emergency visit.//Excellent hygiene is critical in health care.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.18_Text: We don’t charge an outrageous amount.//Just enough to cover the cost.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.36_Text: We need to start talking about mental health more, so we can erase the social stigma around it.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.206_Text: We should hang out soon, at my place.//<portrait=normal>I’ll make pasta, pop open some wine.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.29_Text: Well, even now, actually. <NPCName>Leah</> can be a touch intimidating.//<portrait=concerned>A little, yeah…
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.3_Text: Well, hello to you too! You must be new here.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.1_Text: Well, hello to yo–//ACHOOOOOO!//<portrait=annoyed>Ugh… Spring. Not the best time to move here.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.47_Text: We’re lucky we never have to worry about health care.//<portrait=concerned>It’s a luxury in some parts of the world. Unfair, I know.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.124_Text: What brings you here, <PlayerName>$player</>?//<portrait=surprised>Are you alright?
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.97_Text: What do you mean, why? It’s Fall. Some even call it the harvest season.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.111_Text: What? Why are you looking at me like that?
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.173_Text: Where did I put that book? Hmm. I have at least three books I need to return.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.89_Text: Whew, another Winter's almost over...//Thankfully, there weren't many flu cases this year. I'm relieved.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.185_Text: While you’re here, you should buy some vitamins to boost your health.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.175_Text: Will you be going to the library after this, <PlayerName>$player</>?//I may have some stuff that you can return to <NpcName>Millie</> for me.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.17_Text: Work hard. But more importantly, work smart.//Don’t overexert yourself and pass out, or you’ll be billed for a medical emergency.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.205_Text: Wow! You look amazing in that.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.207_Text: Wow! You look incredibly hot in that.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.94_Text: Wow, seems like my hair matches the season…
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.203_Text: You always look fashionable, <PlayerName>$Player</>.//You must spend millions on clothes!
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.218_Text: You could technically eat flowers, but I can’t recommend it.//That’s just my personal opinion.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.10_Text: You know what?//<portrait=normal>I wish more people would get out of their houses and do some farming. Or gardening. Get up and sweat it out!
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.91_Text: You need to layer up when you leave the house, especially in Winter.//Another tip: wash your hands when you get home. Some viruses thrive in cold, dry conditions.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.56_Text: You seem interested in my dancing schedule. You’re not going to take me out dancing, are ya?//<portrait=normal>’Cause I wouldn’t say no. *chuckles*
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.34_Text: Your mental health is just as important as your physical health.//If either is suffering, it could be catastrophic.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.155_Text: You’re not looking for me, are you, <PlayerName>$player</>?//<portrait=happy>Because I’m off duty right now.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.160_Text: You’re not looking for me, are you, <PlayerName>$player</>?//<portrait=happy>Because I’m off duty right now.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.161_Text: You’re not looking for me, are you, <PlayerName>$player</>?//<portrait=happy>Because I’m off duty right now.
DT_Dialogue_Charles_Production.163_Text: [<NpcName>Charles</> looks confused, as if he forgot his lunch again.]

DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.39_Text: <NPCName>Gort</>, sad we are when remember.//Studied hardest, that one. <NPCName>Gort</> is a determined Giant...acomplished great things, <NPCName>Gort</> did.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.51_Text: Be bad at things, do not. That is key to success.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.26_Text: Blessing, many forms it come in.//Rain is one of them.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.28_Text: Blessing, many forms it come in.//Rain is one of them.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.52_Text: Casting magic is how Giants enchant tools.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.47_Text: Cleanse your heart, Hooman.//Our loved ones, we must focus on.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.31_Text: Come to forest, you are...//Hooman, rest.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.49_Text: Each Giant can enchant tools, goom//Talk to Giant, you must.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.23_Text: Giants purpose is to take care of Earth, goomgoom.//Earth up top, down below and beyond.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.41_Text: Giants...we all family, goom.//Forgiveness come, it must. Hatred can not win.
