DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.11_Text: Good day for farming, this is. Busy you must be.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.38_Text: Good listener <NPCName>Grog</> is.//Easy to lead to right direction. Others...worry we do.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.1_Text: Goomgoom, Hooman. Good it is that you can see us. Need your help freeing the others we will.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.4_Text: Happy again the giants are. Imprisoned no longer we are.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.42_Text: Hate family, we do not.//We love family... Embrace family, we must.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.43_Text: Hatred kill love, Hooman.//Remove hate from heart, we must. Heart only for love.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.7_Text: Hope almost we lost. <NPCName>Goddess</> we thank for your appearance.//Imprisoned no longer, we are.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.30_Text: Ice Season is sleeping time.//Sleep, sweet Earth, sleep.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.13_Text: If Hooman looking for bamboo shoots, plenty there are at this time.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.16_Text: If Hooman looking for matsutake, plenty there are at this time.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.21_Text: Listen to forest song, you must.//Close your eyes. Embrace.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.32_Text: Look back, Hooman.//We are watching Sprouting Season coming soon. New beginning, it is.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.17_Text: Looking for fig is Hooman? Plenty around, there should be now.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.14_Text: Looking for kale is Hooman? Plenty around, there should be now.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.15_Text: Looking for wasabi is Hooman? Plenty around, there should be now.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.20_Text: Love Sprouting Season, the giants do. More lively we are.//Very nice the sun is on our skin.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.29_Text: Love the rain we do, but take a break from it we must.//Take shelter here, we do.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.35_Text: Many moons ago Giants built these houses.//Kept the houses good we did. Wanted it to be good for when the others are back, we did.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.12_Text: Miss the snow, we do not. Nice and warm Sprouting Season is.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.25_Text: Nature healing. Greatful, we are for the rain.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.27_Text: Nature healing. Greatful, we are for the rain.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.33_Text: Nature is angry, it seems like.//But healing it is. We believe.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.18_Text: Nice, this rain is. Water all the plants and give animals drink it does.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.40_Text: Not all great things are good, we must remember.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.19_Text: Pink, some trees are. Others are green. Nice to see.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.22_Text: Plenty of flowers around.//Earth is smiling, it is.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.46_Text: Poison, jealousy is goomgoom.//It break Giants. It breaks Hooman. Poison, jealousy is.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.45_Text: Powerful water Giant <NPCName>Gong</> is. Match <NPCName>Gong</> we cannot.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.34_Text: Sad we are, when the sky is like this.//Reminds us of the day the Giants turn to stone, it does.//Goom...
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.5_Text: Strong and healthy again, the island is. Hooman we thank.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.24_Text: The Falling Season, it is.//The season of abundance food.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.50_Text: The way to find out is to find out.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.9_Text: Today, nice is the air. Very nice.//Falling Season.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.10_Text: Today, nice is the air. Very nice.//Sprouting Season.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.8_Text: Unruly the giants can be, but well-meaning they always are. Patience hooman must have.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.36_Text: We enchant tools in center temple.//Giants magic connect to Earth, it does.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.44_Text: We love and love will come.//Do not ask, love who. Love all, we do.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.37_Text: When all Giants gather, our magic is more powerful.//Strong together, we are.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.6_Text: Worried we were for the island. Invisible we are to other hoomans.//But with you, not so. Special one, you are.
DT_Dialogue_Chieftain.3_Text: You the giants thank. Free again we are. Help Hooman we can.

DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.194_Text: *murmuring to himself* Do I really need a new blender?//Yes, I do.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.52_Text: <NpcName>Ben’s</> usually out of town for the last two weeks of Fall.//He likes to go on adventures, that one.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.173_Text: <NpcName>Charles</> keeps telling me about sunscreen and hats. Oh <Italic>boy</>! It makes you think.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.27_Text: <NpcName>Frank</> makes a mean pasta.//The kids love it.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.138_Text: <NpcName>Luke</> helped me make the brochures.//Hmm… I see we could certainly use a new design.//<portrait=happy>This one is kind of outdated. Do you know anything about design, by any chance?
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.197_Text: <NpcName>Luke’s</> parents are major donors to this town.//They remind me of <NpcName>Nina’s</>. If I’m not mistaken, her parents were good friends with the Duckornses.//Their families spent a lot of time together. Picnics at the beach, birthday parties… Things like that.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.36_Text: <NpcName>Sam</> carries a different variety of crops every year.//I hope he brings back durian next year.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.141_Text: <NpcName>Sam</> doesn’t give discounts.//<portrait=normal>I’ve known him for years and years, and I’ve never been given any sort of markdown.//Or even a rebate, for crying out loud.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.69_Text: A new week is right around the corner. Are you planting anything new at the farm?
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.34_Text: Ah, darn… Socket is closed today.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.45_Text: And the fishing, of course.//You can catch salmon in the sea all Summer long.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.193_Special: Any good ones, really. Nothing specific.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.88_Text: Are you going to plant pineapples this Summer? <NpcName>Sam</> might have seeds this year.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.95_Text: Are you having a productive Summer, <PlayerName>$player</>? Because I sure am.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.82_Text: Are you ready for Summer?//<portrait=happy>The beach is very lively this time of year!
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.202_Text: As <NpcName>Luke’s</> biggest customer, I probably shouldn’t be giving out shopping tips.//<portrait=happy>I’ve bought too many things there.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.62_Text: At a town meeting, I decided to ask if I should run to replace her.//<portrait=happy>There seemed to be support for it, so I did.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.61_Text: Back in my youth, I used to run a general store downtown. But then Mayor Leanne passed away.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.48_Text: Back in the day, I’d spend Saturdays at the beach from sunrise to sundown.//Ah, the good old days…
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.184_Text: Back in the day, the area behind my house was all forest. Trees everywhere!//The townies were far too scared to go there. You didn’t know what you might run into. Bears, wild boars, oh <Italic>boy</>!
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.163_Text: Before you know it, it’s chaos.//Chaos, I tell you!
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.175_Text: Bok choy makes everything taste better.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.149_Text: Boring, perhaps!//But in retrospect, I could have traveled more.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.60_Text: But I’m not sure how I could get the funding.//It’s a bit tight with trying to keep our festivals running every year.//The governor may not like the idea much.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.23_Text: Can you believe it’s almost the weekend already?
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.5_Text: Can you imagine how much trash there actually is in the ocean?
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.44_Text: Coral Island has very fertile soil.//You can grow almost anything here.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.18_Text: Did you really see a merperson?//<portrait=happy>Ah! You got me again. Nice one, <PlayerName>$player</>!
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.188_Text: Do I ever miss running the store? Hmm…
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.25_Text: Do you have any plans for the weekend?
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.154_Text: Do you know what would make a great meal?//<portrait=happy>A pizza with pineapple!//I like the sweet taste.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.207_Text: Do you notice anything different about my hat?
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.112_Text: Doesn’t the way the town is covered in snow like this remind you of that town from that movie?
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.115_Text: Doesn’t the way the town is covered in snow like this remind you of that town from that movie?
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.118_Text: Doesn’t the way the town is covered in snow like this remind you of that town from that movie?
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.132_Text: Don’t let me keep you from mingling!
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.37_Text: Durian sure is my guilty pleasure.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.198_Text: Even so, I rarely saw <NpcName>Nina’s</> dad out.//It was usually the mom, one of the nannies, and <NpcName>Nina</>. Never the dad.//<portrait=normal>Great man, though. Charitable heart. He was very giving.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.38_Text: Even though I’m busy… I am, by the way! I have a lot on the agenda this season.//But even so, I still like to take fishing breaks here and there. Having the time to do things I like is important to me.//And the doctors agree!
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.174_Text: Ever since I started living alone, there’s been a lot of bread in my diet.//So I decided to add more bok choy to my lunches lately.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.176_Text: Ever since I started living alone, there’s been a lot of bread in my diet.//So I decided to add more leafy vegetables to my lunches lately.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.136_Text: Fancy a room for a weekend getaway?
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.22_Text: Giving birthday presents is the quickest way to make friends.//<portrait=happy>I particularly like sake, but I wouldn’t turn down some pineapple upside-down cake either.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.119_Text: Good day, <PlayerName>$player</>! I’m happy to see the locals supporting each other.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.165_Text: Ha ha! Not a bad take, I tell ya!
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.30_Text: Have you caught the new commercial on TV yet?//From what I’ve seen, <NpcName>Luke</> has an eye for quality electronics.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.78_Text: Have you planted any Spring seeds yet?//<portrait=happy>Sugarcane is my personal favorite.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.49_Text: Have you tried growing grass?//When you cut it, it’s automatically deposited into your silo as animal feed.//<portrait=happy>It might save you some money in the long run.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.140_Text: Have you tried their pineapple upside-down cake?
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.133_Text: Heh heh… I’ve heard that story at least three times now, and it gets funnier and funnier each time.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.53_Text: His eyes do always look red. He must not sleep very much.//<portrait=normal>That young man must have plenty of work to do.//I might go and check up on him next week.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.196_Text: His parents are major donors to this town.//They remind me of <NpcName>Nina’s</>. If I’m not mistaken, her parents were good friends with the Duckorns.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.169_Text: Hopefully, it’s just the Winter blues.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.110_Text: How are your plants holding up in the storm?
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.73_Text: How was your first week on the farm?//It’s been a while since anybody stayed in that cabin.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.11_Text: How was your weekend?//<portrait=happy>I’m going to start this week off with a cup of the Tavern’s coffee.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.102_Text: How’s the farm doing? I hope the old house is holding up okay.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.121_Text: How’s the farm doing?//I hope the old house is holding up okay.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.19_Text: I admit, shopping can get addictive.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.70_Text: I always have less work on the weekend, except for when we’re putting on a festival.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.199_Text: I buy extra kitchen appliances when I have the money.//I don’t use them all myself. No, <PlayerName>$player</>.//<portrait=happy>Don’t be silly.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.104_Text: I can’t hear you! Let’s go inside and continue our chat.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.211_Text: I couldn’t find any flowers for my hat, so I’m going through Winter <Italic>accessory-less</>.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.160_Text: I count myself lucky to have so many friends here.//<portrait=concerned>It’s been very lonely since Carol passed away.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.167_Special: I don’t know. I have a long life ahead of me, and I don’t need to think about that.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.128_Text: I don’t think so.//<portrait=normal>To make a point, I’m about to show you how much fun I’m having.//Just hang on a minute. You don’t want to miss my classic dance moves.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.15_Text: I don’t think you need a fancy tool for it.//I believe your standard scythe will do.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.166_Text: I feel the same way.//I make sure to do something I like every day, no matter how small.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.209_Text: I found a fairy rose the other day, and I thought I’d change things up a little with my hat.//<portrait=normal>Am I appropriate for Fall now?
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.12_Text: I got some and kept it in the fridge over the weekend.//You know, I save the cups and use them as planters.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.205_Text: I got some hot peppers from <NPCName>Sam</>’s the other day and put them in my soup.//<portrait=surprised>Whoa! Too spicy. It wasn’t for me.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.189_Text: I guess not. I like being the mayor of this town.//I get to walk around and talk to people.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.97_Text: I hate policing the booths at festivals, but there are regulations that people need to follow. We can’t just approve every design. What if it looks out of place?
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.162_Text: I hate to be the police of this town, but somebody has to uphold the town code.//<portrait=annoyed>I feel bad for telling <NpcName>Sam</> off about how to decorate his shop, but if I start letting him do whatever he wants, everybody else will want to do whatever they want.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.192_Text: I have to say, it’s a popular genre.//Fantasy is my weakness too. I can lose hours!
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.103_Text: I haven’t seen rain this hard since…hmm…//<portrait=happy>Since the last time it rained, I guess.//Apologies, rainy days make my head a bit fuzzy.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.151_Text: I heard not all mayors do that. Every place has different rules, but I don’t mind collecting taxes.//<portrait=concerned>It’s not like I have a lot of things going on in my life.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.6_Text: I hope we can clean up the trash on the ocean floor someday so we can finally start our coral reef nursery.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.147_Text: I hope we have enough trash bins around the island.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.68_Text: I just don’t feel like traveling anymore. If it’s only me, is it even worth it?
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.120_Text: I just had a good chat next door, and I thought I’d come by here to see what <NpcName>Luke</> has in stock.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.206_Text: I like red curry, but this one was different. Maybe I added too many hot peppers.//<portrait=happy>It wasn’t kind to my stomach.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.158_Text: I must have slept wrong last night. Ugh.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.33_Text: I need to visit Socket & Pan today and ask <NpcName>Luke</> where my new blender is.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.29_Text: I particularly like sake, but I wouldn’t turn down some pineapple upside-down cake either.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.63_Text: I saw this town panic during a flu outbreak some years ago. People started stocking up on food, which depleted our food supply very fast.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.200_Text: I ship them to a women’s shelter in the city. Donate them in Carol’s name.//She used to do that. I’m only carrying on her legacy.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.20_Text: I should probably update the bulletin board tomorrow and make sure there aren’t any outdated posts.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.91_Text: I think I’m going to visit the <NpcName>Sanchezes</> tomorrow and see what they’ve been up to.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.3_Text: I think people here already have the right mindset to reduce, reuse, and recycle.//It’s a shame we don’t have an appropriate facility for it.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.54_Text: I think the last time I went to your farm was when you first moved to the island.//<portrait=happy>Do you remember that?
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.129_Text: I used to be quite the fun machine back in the day.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.90_Text: I usually spend my Summer weekends at the Beach Shack, catching up with <NpcName>Nina</>.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.155_Text: I was talking to <NpcName>Dippa</>, that talented painter who lives up behind my house. //<portrait=happy>They like it too! Pineapple on pizza.//<portrait=normal>I always liked them. Nice young couple, <NpcName>Dippa</> and <NpcName>Emma</>.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.98_Text: I wish someday somebody would create a warm fizzy drink with dried pumpkin in it.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.164_Text: If you could live forever, would you, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.21_Text: If you want to keep track of people’s birthdays, there’s a calendar near <NPCName>Sam</>’s General Store.//Don’t worry, I make sure to update it every season.//<portrait=happy>If I don’t forget, that is. Heh heh!
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.16_Text: If you want to upgrade any of your tools, take them to the <NpcName>Sanchezes’</> shop.//They know what they’re doing.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.201_Text: If you’re thinking of buying an appliance, you should get it now.//Because it may not be there tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.79_Text: It does take a while to grow, but we grow the sweetest sugarcane here.//<portrait=happy>I’m sure <NpcName>Sam</> would pay a lot for it.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.55_Text: It feels like ages ago.//Now you’ve become part of the community.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.58_Text: It isn’t in my power to change the law, but there’s nothing wrong with trying.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.186_Text: It makes me smile every time I see <NPCName>Taco</> or one of <NpcName>Erika’s</> cats.//I always make sure to stop and pet them, no matter how busy I am.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.101_Text: It might be a good time to check out different parts of the island. Or maybe make friends.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.13_Text: It must take plenty of work to get your farm ready for planting every season.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.183_Text: It was much smaller back then. But then again, it was a much smaller community as well.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.8_Text: It would be nice to have a place where the community could grow crops, share produce, and form bonds.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.203_Text: It’s Spring, but <Italic>boy</>! Do you feel the wind?//It goes straight through my bones.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.208_Text: It’s a cactus! I thought I’d change things up a little. Keep it summery.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.1_Text: It’s good to see you out and about.//Have you introduced yourself to the townies?
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.177_Text: It’s hard to find bok choy in Spring, so I have to use lettuce.//<portrait=happy>It’s good, yeah, crunchy. But lettuce isn’t bok choy.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.181_Text: It’s harder to be positive on some days than others, I suppose.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.71_Text: It’s nice to see the youth getting more involved in the community.//The kids at the school volunteered to clean up the beach last week.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.125_Text: It’s right next door.//<NpcName>Luke</> runs an electronics store there now.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.210_Text: It’s too cold to wear my other hats. I need one with ear flaps.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.99_Text: I’d call it “pumpkin extract drink.” Sounds good, doesn’t it?//<portrait=surprised>They have a pumpkin extract drink in Pokyo?! Lucky them!
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.26_Text: I’ll probably go to the Tavern tonight and catch up with folks.//<portrait=happy>My favorite thing to do!
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.172_Text: I’m always torn between wanting to feel the fresh air in my hair and protecting my head from the sun. Hmm…
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.131_Text: I’m debating whether I should take some cake home.//You know, for tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.89_Text: I’m glad <NpcName>Nina</> is coming to visit. I remember when she was born. The celebration was out of this world.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.35_Text: I’m going to treat myself to a pineapple upside-down cake today.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.182_Text: I’m happy <NpcName>Luke</> can make good use of my old store space.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.195_Text: I’m here to pick up some donations from Socket.//<NpcName>Luke</> is a very charitable young man.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.14_Text: I’m no farmer, but clearing weeds is probably the first step.//Would you agree?
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.51_Text: I’m not exactly sure about <NpcName>Ben’s</> store hours.//<portrait=normal>I don’t go to that part of the forest very often. It’s too far for my knees.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.74_Text: I’m not too thrilled to announce Pufferfish’s arrival next week.//But the islanders need to know as soon as possible.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.65_Text: I’m proud to say we have excellent doctors here.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.191_Text: I’m shocked.//<portrait=annoyed>We have free books in the library. You should check them out sometime.//I mean, actually check them out to take home! Ha!
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.168_Text: I’m starting to doubt my ability to run this island.//I’ve been feeling my age lately.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.66_Text: I’m sure it’s just a matter of time before Coral Island attracts more talented people like you.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.193_Text: I’m that way too. Great minds! Heh heh!//<portrait=normal>Bestsellers are usually what I’m drawn to.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.122_Text: I’ve been sporting this hairstyle since I was eighteen.//Maybe it’s time for a change.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.127_Text: I’ve heard people say you shouldn’t mix business with pleasure.//Well, I don’t know what to tell ya, but I’m here to check up on local businesses.//<portrait=happy>It doesn’t mean I can’t enjoy myself, does it?
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.148_Text: I’ve managed this town for too many years. Sometimes I wonder what my life would have been like if I’d never run for office.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.67_Text: I’ve spent my life taking care of Coral Island. I never got to take Carol to see the world, and now I spend sleepless nights regretting it.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.57_Text: I’ve spoken to the governor about lowering our taxes and increasing the school budget.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.137_Text: Just monitoring our tourism industry by collecting some data from <NpcName>Suki</>.//I’m also restocking the town’s brochures for the guests.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.84_Text: Letting the tax returns pile up can be mentally draining.//<portrait=normal>It’s good to get them done early.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.7_Text: Looking for some work to do, <PlayerName>$player</>?//<portrait=happy>Ah, I was just thinking, Wouldn’t it be nice if we could have a community garden?
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.157_Text: Maybe it’s not too late for me. After all, I always have her in my heart…
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.145_Text: My favorite part of town meetings is seeing us come together to tackle problem after problem. Doing that as a community feels special.//<portrait=concerned>Unfortunately, we don’t have a lot of them.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.212_Text: My hat is missing its personality now. Hmm… Pins might not be a bad idea.//<portrait=normal>I always see <NpcName>Eleanor</> wearing butterfly pins. I should ask her where she got them.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.159_Text: My right arm feels stiff. It hurt when I reached into the cupboard for tea this morning.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.123_Text: Nah! People seem to like it.//I’ll keep this style.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.106_Text: No matter the season, it gets cold when it rains here.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.166_Special: No. I think there’s beauty in limits.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.93_Text: Now that the sun is blazing nonstop, I need this hat on me at all times.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.108_Text: Oh my! It’s been a while since we had a storm like this!
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.185_Text: Oh, this was way back when your grandparents were still here.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.124_Text: One of these days, I’ll show you my old general store.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.4_Text: Our goal is to build a recycling center for the locals.//Hopefully, we can teach our youth, and they can carry the tradition forward.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.150_Text: Part of being the mayor of a small town is collecting local taxes.//<portrait=happy>It gives me a reason to get out of the house and visit folks.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.56_Text: Part of my job is to check in on local businesses and make sure they’re doing okay.//I also make sure their taxes are paid on time.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.96_Text: Plenty of people want to join our Harvest Festival. But with a limited budget, I have to make sure that local merchants get their booths first before opening them up to anybody else.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.28_Text: Psst! <PlayerName>$Player</>, birthday presents are the quickest way to make friends.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.77_Text: Pufferfish is building a mini golf course for the community. First they buy us off with gifts, then they’ll try to buy us out.//<portrait=concerned>I think as long as we don’t sell our land, we don’t have anything to worry about.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.76_Text: Pufferfish wants to start drilling on our island.//The only thing that stopped them from bringing their equipment here was that they didn’t have any property.//They want to buy us out, then drill as much oil as they can.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.153_Text: Remember to drink wine only in moderation.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.85_Text: Remember, we have the Cherry Blossom Festival potluck tomorrow. There will be so much food!//See you there!
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.59_Text: Should we put in a request for an expanded library?//I could see it being beneficial to the islanders.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.41_Text: Some of the islanders like to do group yoga at the community center every Saturday morning.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.50_Text: Sometimes <NpcName>Ben</> has seeds that <NpcName>Sam</> doesn’t carry.//If you want to check it out, <NpcName>Ben</> is open today.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.180_Text: Sometimes, I want to forget for a minute that I’m going home to an empty house at the end of the day.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.80_Text: Spring is my least favorite season because…you know – taxes.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.87_Text: Summer is here! Ah, I can feel the sun on my skin! Life’s good, eh?
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.64_Text: Thankfully, we got it contained quickly, and the hysteria settled.//But that was one expensive year for the town.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.204_Text: The Winter wind is still here. Brrrr.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.134_Text: The beach is stunning this time of year.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.187_Text: The little brown one with curly hair – ah, forgot the name.//Bonbon! Yes. That one is <Italic>barky</>, for sure.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.47_Text: The rats could be way worse.//<portrait=annoyed>I heard from a friend who’s also a mayor that rats destroyed their community center.//<portrait=normal>Thankfully, it’s all restored now. It’s fine.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.135_Text: The sea right here, <PlayerName>$player</>, is home to many creatures.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.32_Text: The weather is perfect for diving.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.24_Text: The week goes by really fast when you’re having fun – or have a lot to do.//<portrait=happy>Either way, a full week is always good week.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.156_Text: There are a few things that I regret in my life.//One of them is never taking my late wife to see the world.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.10_Text: There aren’t that many items on the list right now, but I think we should add to it as we see how our island progresses.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.9_Text: There’s a list of community upgrades we can do.//It’s in the community center.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.105_Text: There’s something about rainy nights. So soothing.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.17_Text: They live in the woodland, just across the creek from my house.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.92_Text: They’re a lot of fun to chat with. That <NpcName>Pablo</> always has some stories!
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.75_Text: They’re looking for land, you know.//<portrait=normal>The governor told me they were planning to purchase your farm, but it didn't go through. So they came here to look for another parcel to buy.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.113_Text: Umm… I can’t think of the name, but you know what I’m talking about.//<portrait=happy>The famous movie! With the snow and the town.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.116_Text: Umm… I can’t think of the name, but you know what I’m talking about.//<portrait=happy>The famous movie! With the snow and the town.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.179_Text: We already gather so often for festivals. It wouldn’t be efficient for me to clog up everyone’s calendars with meetings.//<portrait=happy>Though I wouldn’t be opposed. Heh heh!
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.146_Text: We don’t have enough problems to need more-frequent meetings.//<portrait=happy>I like the bonding. I guess that’s what festivals are for.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.178_Text: We don’t hold town meetings often. We only have them to address specific important problems.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.142_Text: Well, okay. <NpcName>Sam</> carries the best-quality produce, and to be fair, his prices aren’t too bad.//<portrait=happy>So, you’re right. I really can’t complain, can I?
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.81_Text: Well, that was negative of me.//<portrait=happy>Spring is great, actually, with all the colorful tulips growing all over the island. Bamboo shoots!
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.46_Text: We’re incredibly blessed here with the weather and the fertile soil, and not too much of a rat problem.//To give back, it’s important for us to take care of our environment.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.171_Text: We’re lucky to have you here.//Thank you, <PlayerName>$Player</>!
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.2_Text: We’ve been setting aside recyclables in that lot near the park.//I’m hoping someday we can build something there.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.86_Text: What better way to celebrate Spring, eh?
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.190_Text: What kind of books do you like?
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.130_Text: What’s a Sunday without a little trip to the Tavern, right, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.152_Text: Wine is wine. Whether it’s good or bad, it tastes the same to me.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.167_Text: Yes, I can understand that.//<portrait=normal>Although nobody can predict how long they’ll live. Not you, not me.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.40_Text: Yes, he’s <NpcName>Oliver’s</> dad, and he’s the one at the cash register.//<portrait=happy>Not the one in the kitchen.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.165_Special: Yes. Imagine all the things I’d get to try!
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.161_Text: You gotta get yourself some friends like mine, <PlayerName>$Player</>. Heh heh!
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.100_Text: You probably can’t do all that much farming in this harsh weather, eh, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.83_Text: You should save some of your Spring vegetables in a chest in case you need them for something later.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.39_Text: You should talk to <NpcName>Sunny</> at the Beach Shack if you have any questions about fishing.
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.72_Text: You’re setting an excellent example for all of us, <PlayerName>$player</>. Keep up the good work!
DT_Dialogue_Connor_Production.170_Text: You’ve been a great help to this community.//<portrait=happy>I’m glad you chose to take over your family’s farm.

DT_Dialogue_Derek_Production.1_Text: Hello, there. Don’t mind us. We’ll be out of your hair in no time.
DT_Dialogue_Derek_Production.4_Text: It’s nice to be outdoors. Don’t you agree?
DT_Dialogue_Derek_Production.5_Text: I’m sore. I think I’ll head to the hot spring tonight.
DT_Dialogue_Derek_Production.2_Text: Sorry about all the noise and dust. We can’t really help it.
DT_Dialogue_Derek_Production.8_Text: The weather is nice.//<portrait=happy>A little snow can’t hurt.
DT_Dialogue_Derek_Production.3_Text: We’re working every day to get this done. Please be patient with us.

DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.177_Text: *mumbling to herself* I need to get some eggs tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.15_Text: *sighs* The house is turning into a treasure trove of moldy rocks.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.72_Text: <NpcName>Archie</> found a pair of old boots near the cavern yesterday and brought them home.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.148_Text: <NpcName>Archie</> is always getting into something new. Sometimes I wish he’d stick with one thing and get good at it, you know?
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.43_Text: <NpcName>Archie</> loves playing with <NPCName>Taco</>.//<portrait=concerned>I just hope he isn’t bothering <NpcName>Bree</> too much.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.158_Text: <NpcName>Archie</> will eventually outgrow his shirt. It’s hard to shop for a boy that age.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.183_Text: <NpcName>Archie</> – that boy brings everything home.//<portrait=annoyed>Rocks, empty bottles, binoculars, sick animals.<Italic>Everything.</>
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.181_Text: <NpcName>Archie’s</> room is always so messy. I don’t even know why I bother cleaning up after him.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.145_Text: <NpcName>Ben</> has called me “Doodz” several times. I don’t quite understand.//There’s so much to learn from the young…
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.199_Text: <NpcName>Joko</> and I had a meeting at the school the other day, <NpcName>Archie’s</> parent-teacher conference.//It went pretty well.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.36_Text: <NpcName>Joko</> and I rely a lot on furniture sales.//<portrait=normal>Construction projects are a great way to make some cash because we’re paid up front, but let’s face it!//<portrait=concerned>Big projects don’t come around often.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.192_Text: <NpcName>Joko</> and I spent almost all our savings opening the furniture store in town.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.31_Text: <NpcName>Joko</> and I usually spend our Saturday mornings doing yoga at the community center.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.152_Text: <NpcName>Joko</> tried to assure me <NpcName>Archie</> will be just fine if he ever decides to be a full-time adventurer.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.1_Text: <portrait=annoyed>Is everything okay with your cabin?//<portrait=happy>Oh, good.//<portrait=normal>How do you like the island so far?
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.73_Text: And that’s just one of his “finds.”
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.46_Text: Are you enjoying your Sunday so far?
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.133_Text: Are you here for the yoga class too, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.102_Text: Are you looking for anything in particular?
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.149_Text: But I guess it’s a process of self-discovery.//At least his interest in rocks seems consistent.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.57_Text: But when I have a big project to work on, I don’t usually do any other crafting. I try not to overwork myself.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.34_Text: Clocks are fun to make.//Don’t get me wrong, some of them are hard to craft, but they’re fun regardless.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.124_Text: Did you know white oak is the easiest wood to bend?//My father told me that.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.51_Text: Do you have any projects for me?
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.75_Text: Doesn’t it take a while for them to grow?//I’m afraid if you start now, you might not be able to harvest them in time.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.4_Text: Don’t get discouraged! I hope you find what you’re looking for here.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.151_Text: Don’t tell anyone, <PlayerName>$player</>.//I’d hate for <NpcName>Joko</> to hear I’m worrying about that.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.115_Text: Don’t worry about your boots! No need to take them off.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.200_Text: Except for the part when <NpcName>Randy</> told us <NpcName>Archie</> sometimes goes back to class with muddy shoes after recess.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.28_Text: Favorite fruit? Hmm…//I have to go with melon.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.5_Text: For sure! I hope you find what you’re looking for here, <PlayerName>$player</>.//We’re certainly happy to have you.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.82_Text: Frostbite is a real thing, <PlayerName>$player</>. You be careful, okay?//<portrait=normal>Keep those socks on and keep your feet dry at all times.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.81_Text: Have a seat and warm up.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.117_Text: Have you had dinner? We have some leftovers, if you’d like.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.24_Text: Have you watched the weather channel today?
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.108_Text: He told me my vaccinations were up to date, and that was it.//I don’t know how to feel about that.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.16_Text: Herbs are easy to grow.//As long as you don’t overwater them, they basically grow themselves.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.143_Text: He’s a great florist. I came here for a bouquet.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.114_Text: He’s probably used to a bigger place, anyway.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.184_Text: His heart’s in the right place, I suppose.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.155_Text: Hmm. What am I going to do with the rest of my Sunday?
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.25_Text: Hot Summer days are best spent eating freshly harvested melons.//<portrait=happy>My nephew <NpcName>Surya</> and <NpcName>Millie</> both love them too.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.93_Text: Hot tea sounds good right now. It’s too bad we ran out.//<portrait=concerned>Time to get groceries, I suppose.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.94_Text: Hot tea sounds good right now. It’s too bad we ran out.//<portrait=concerned>Time to get groceries, I suppose.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.107_Text: I almost cut my finger off chopping wood one time, and all <NpcName>Charles</> did was bandage it up.//<portrait=concerned>He didn’t even give me a tetanus shot.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.99_Text: I can take your order at the counter in a minute.//Do you need anything urgently?
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.55_Text: I can teach you how to make some of them, but it would be safer to buy the plans.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.170_Text: I can tell it’s made of top-quality wood.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.90_Text: I can’t wait for Spring.//There aren’t many options for fresh flowers this time of year.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.169_Text: I checked out <NpcName>Zarah’s</> boat yesterday while I was in town. The craftsmanship is incredible.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.129_Text: I did a little warm-up before my yoga session. I feel very awake now.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.10_Text: I don’t have enough space to plant big vegetables like pumpkins.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.113_Text: I don’t think <NPCName>Taco</> likes our house very much. Every time he comes in, he goes right back out.//I think it might be too noisy for him.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.105_Text: I don’t think I could live at the beach like <NpcName>Sunny</> does.//<portrait=normal>The sun is always so intense over there.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.160_Text: I don’t think a forest is the best place for children, but <NpcName>Archie</> seems to be doing just fine.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.139_Text: I enjoy gathering wild vegetables.//It’s always exciting to see what nature has to offer.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.123_Text: I found some wasabi earlier. Is it even in season?
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.61_Text: I gathered a lot of bamboo shoots over the weekend.//Have you found any yet?
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.58_Text: I guarantee I’ll sleep great tonight after all the stretching I did.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.190_Text: I guess he’ll have to wear his regular shoes for now.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.44_Text: I hope you’re doing well today, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.49_Text: I pulled a muscle on Saturday, trying to stretch.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.161_Text: I really should stop worrying about him. It serves no purpose, and it’s just stressing me out.//<portrait=concerned>Easier said than done, <PlayerName>$Player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.187_Text: I saw <NPCName>Taco</> swimming in town yesterday.//Should I be worried?
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.119_Text: I should just read my book.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.188_Text: I talked to <NpcName>Joko</> about it, but he said <NPCName>Taco</> is a snow dog – something like that.//<portrait=concerned>Is that right? Snow dog? He does look like a small bear.//That’s something, right?
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.8_Text: I taught <NpcName>Archie</> to bring back things that don’t look like they belong in the forest when he’s playing out there.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.48_Text: I think I’m going to make some pies for dinner tonight.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.144_Text: I think it’s admirable that <NpcName>Ben</> tries not to consume animal products.//So keep that in mind when you’re choosing gifts for him.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.23_Text: I think the hardest thing to craft is probably a wall clock.//<portrait=normal>But for me, a nice wall clock is what completes a house.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.71_Text: I use leftover logs to make wall clocks in my spare time. I guess you could call it a hobby.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.9_Text: I was hoping he’d bring back trash and empty bottles.//<portrait=annoyed>But instead, he brought home a lot of shiny rocks because they “didn’t look like they belonged.”
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.12_Text: I was just chatting with <NpcName>Jack</> about starting a small vegetable garden.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.189_Text: I washed <NpcName>Archie’s</> rubber boots a couple days ago, and they’re still not dry.//The weather makes it impossible to dry boots. It’s just too cold out.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.173_Text: I water my plants every day, but some of the basil wilted anyway.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.14_Text: I wish <NpcName>Archie</> wouldn’t bring in so much dirt from the forest.//<portrait=normal>He sees things on the ground, and they’re suddenly “treasures.”
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.98_Text: I wonder why my celery keeps wilting.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.150_Text: I won’t know what to say when <NpcName>Archie</> starts asking to learn about combat.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.64_Text: I worry a little when <NpcName>Archie</> gets picky about his food.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.77_Text: I worry a little when <NpcName>Archie</> gets picky about his food.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.121_Text: If you want to see our service, please come back tomorrow.//I should be in the shop and can show it to you then.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.6_Text: If you’re on the way to the recycling center, would you take some of my recycling and drop it off, please?
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.127_Text: Imagine what we could achieve if most people did that.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.83_Text: Is everything okay? No leaks, I hope?
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.86_Text: Is everything okay? No leaks, I hope?
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.125_Text: It allows me to make furniture with unusual designs.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.182_Text: It takes way too much time, and let’s face it, it’ll be messy again as soon as he comes home anyway.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.193_Text: It was a little risky, but it was the only way we could expand our business.//<portrait=normal>People always need new furniture, I guess.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.195_Text: It would be nice to make a habit of walking to town in the morning. Maybe <NpcName>Joko</> and I could get coffee together or something.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.166_Text: It would have to be a lot of work, but I bet I could make a boat like that if anybody ever asked me to.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.32_Text: It’s a great way to socialize.//Catch up with a lot of neighbors in one go.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.40_Text: It’s finally Friday.//We have yoga in front of the community center tomorrow. If it isn’t raining, that is.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.106_Text: It’s great to be in the sun every once in a while, but all the time? I don’t think so.//I need my cool breeze.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.132_Text: It’s great to see you out and about!
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.120_Text: It’s nice of you to visit, <PlayerName>$player</>!
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.140_Text: It’s nice to come here for a break after work once in a while.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.74_Text: It’s probably not a good time to start planting pumpkins, huh?
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.130_Text: I’d like to see more classes. It’s a beautiful way to bond with the community.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.60_Text: I’ll have to check out the lake this weekend and gather some Spring vegetables.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.63_Text: I’ll have to check out the lake this weekend and gather some shallots.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.172_Text: I’ll wait until after work to do it. That way, they’ll be fresh.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.85_Text: I’m a bit busy. Please feel free to hang out, though.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.88_Text: I’m a bit busy. Please feel free to hang out, though.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.159_Text: I’m afraid he’ll outgrow his new clothes too quickly if I don’t buy a size larger than he needs.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.191_Text: I’m glad <NpcName>Surya</> lives with us instead of spending his money on rent.//Besides, he eats better here than he would if he ate out all the time.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.164_Text: I’m glad to see the farm in your possession, <PlayerName>$player</>. At least now, if my son wanders over there, I’ll know there’s someone familiar he can ask if he needs help.//<portrait=normal>In case he gets lost or something.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.171_Text: I’m going to harvest some herbs for dinner tonight.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.42_Text: I’m going to relax and work on my flexibility.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.179_Text: I’m hoping to find some mushrooms to grill for dinner tonight.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.186_Text: I’m just scared I might pass out if I take a hot bath in this heat.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.153_Text: I’m just scared he might get hurt.//And I know that boy. Curiosity always gets the best of him.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.197_Text: I’m making sure to teach <NpcName>Surya</> how to cook his favorite meals. Well, basic dishes, at least.//<portrait=concerned>I think making lodeh might be a stretch.//<portrait=normal>Anyway, cooking is an important skill for everyone, not just girls.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.136_Text: I’m not here to see the mayor.//<portrait=happy>There are plenty of wild vegetables around here. Foraging for them is my one of my favorite things to do.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.135_Text: I’m not positive, though. I was a little preoccupied.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.103_Text: I’m so glad <NpcName>Sam</> doesn’t give out plastic bags.//There’s no reason we can’t just shove fruit and veggies into our own bags.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.69_Text: I’ve hardly noticed that it’s Fall already, what with all the work preparing for the Harvest Festival.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.18_Text: Jam makes a great gift.//I make sure to pack some for <NpcName>Joko’s</> family when he goes to visit them.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.101_Text: Just write down your request at the counter, and <NPCName>Joko</> and I will be there.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.97_Text: Keeping these herbs healthy isn’t as easy as it looks.//It took me a couple of months to learn the secret!
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.20_Text: Making a cabinet is easier than you think. It just takes a lot of time.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.11_Text: Maybe, when I have a chance, I’ll think about expanding my garden a little bit.//<portrait=concerned>But now just isn’t a good time.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.47_Text: Mine has been good. Thank you for asking.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.126_Text: More people should make it a habit to pick up trash and throw it away.//Even if it wasn’t their trash to begin with.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.167_Text: My head feels funny, but I feel weirdly energized. It must be that coffee <NPCName>Raj</> was talking about.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.89_Text: My hometown doesn’t get snow, so to me this is unusual.//Even though I’ve lived here almost my whole life, I’m still not used to it yet.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.50_Text: My leg still feels a bit funny now.//Hopefully, it’ll be better soon.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.7_Text: No worries if you can’t.//<portrait=concerned>I’m just so swamped today.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.162_Text: Nobody was taking care of your grandparents’ farm before.//Yes, everybody helped out and cleared the lot now and then, but it was mostly abandoned.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.54_Text: Not all woodwork is complicated.// You can make some simple things yourself.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.174_Text: Oh no. I’m afraid the roots might be rotten.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.157_Text: Oh no. I’m turning into my father.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.146_Text: Oh, he called you that too! What a fun coincidence.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.147_Text: Oh, we closed early yesterday. I had some errands to run.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.80_Text: Oh, you poor thing. It must be so cold out!
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.56_Text: On a slow day like this, I can make two or three shipping crates.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.156_Text: Part of being a parent is worrying too much about what could happen to my son. The hardest part, I’d say.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.52_Text: Smaller items, like a doghouse or a shipping crate, can be finished on the same day they’re ordered.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.185_Text: Some people still go to the hot spring in Summer.//I don’t know how they do it.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.78_Text: Sometimes, he’ll only want one or two kinds of food for weeks.//<portrait=happy>Good thing he has a healthy appetite for outdoor activity, though, even in the snow.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.65_Text: Sometimes, he’ll only want one or two kinds of food for weeks.//<portrait=happy>Good thing he has a healthy appetite for outdoor activity, though, even in this heat.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.176_Text: Take a look at my new wall clock.//I just came up with this design!
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.68_Text: That boy gets into trouble as it is.//I don’t like thinking about what could happen in the water.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.3_Text: That’s great! I hope you find what you’re looking for here.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.109_Text: The bad thing about having the workshop connected to the house is all the noise.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.67_Text: The beach is too far for <NpcName>Archie</> to play there.//I get worried. Especially with all that open water.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.96_Text: The best part of the day is seeing the morning mist, don’t you think?
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.165_Text: The craftsmanship of <NpcName>Zarah’s</> boat is incredible.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.163_Text: The massive size of the lot was also a problem. Who knows what kind of animals were living there?//As the parent of a small child, I was always uneasy. Because small children – they wander.//They <Italic>sure</> do, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.134_Text: The mayor? I saw him going toward town earlier.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.41_Text: The shop will be closed tomorrow.//We’re heading down to the community center in the morning.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.118_Text: There are so many channels. Two would be just fine.//Having this many is overwhelming.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.104_Text: There’s already too much plastic in the world.//<portrait=normal>The least we can do is use as little as possible. Reuse your containers, <PlayerName>$player</>!
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.142_Text: These can last us the whole week.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.26_Text: Too bad you can’t grow them year-round, though.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.62_Text: Try checking around <NpcName>Dippa’s</> house. There may be some over that way.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.84_Text: Try not to stand in the rain too long, <PlayerName>$player</>.//I can’t imagine it would be good for your health.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.87_Text: Try not to stand in the rain too long, <PlayerName>$player</>.//I can’t imagine it would be good for your health.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.22_Text: Tuesday is a workday for us. Judging by your boots, that seems to be the case for you too!
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.30_Text: Typically, it takes me two to three days to complete a project.//<portrait=happy>So it would be wise for you to plan ahead before committing to one.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.13_Text: We all can chip in, and everyone can take what they need from it.//<portrait=happy>Sort of like a community garden, yes.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.53_Text: We always have the parts on hand because they’re so popular.//So all I need to do is put them together.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.110_Text: We do most of our woodworking outdoors, but we still do some of it inside, you know.//So you can imagine how it can disturb the family.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.37_Text: We live by the forest. Nothing beats the silent evenings.//<portrait=happy>For me, life couldn’t get any better than this.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.131_Text: We never miss a class. You’ll most likely find us here on Saturdays.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.178_Text: We only take orders in the shop.//Go there tomorrow, and I can give you a quote!
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.168_Text: We still have some in the kitchen.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.154_Text: We tried to grow melons in our backyard once, but it didn’t work out.//<portrait=concerned>I don’t think there’s enough space.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.111_Text: We use dovetail joints for all our furniture.//It’s the strongest joint, and the design is aesthetically pleasing.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.100_Text: Welcome! I don’t have any projects right now, so if you need any building upgrades, we could start first thing tomorrow morning.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.33_Text: We’re closed today.//It’s not urgent, is it?
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.194_Text: We’re grateful to have our cousins working at the store.//We can trust them, you know.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.116_Text: What brings you here so late, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.128_Text: What time does yoga start today?
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.91_Text: What’s Winter without a little snow, right?
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.92_Text: What’s Winter without a little snow, right?
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.202_Text: With all the business you’ve given us, you might put <NpcName>Archie</> through school. Ha ha ha!
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.35_Text: With all the land you have, farming could be a good way to make some fast money.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.196_Text: With watering my garden and having to open the shop at 9 am, I’m just not sure we’d have enough time.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.39_Text: You also need to provide the building materials.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.19_Text: You can make any fruit into jam as long as you have some of those jars for preserves at your farm.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.112_Text: You can still stay inside your cabin tonight, even if you choose to upgrade it.//We don’t usually start work until the morning.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.29_Text: You can tell how sweet a melon is by pushing on the spot where the vine was attached.//It should release a sweet scent.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.45_Text: You need to have enough money before we can start a project.//We require payment up front.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.38_Text: You need to have enough money to pay for a project before we can start on it.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.17_Text: You probably have more gardening tips than I do.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.137_Text: You should check the lake for mushrooms!//There were plenty over there the other week.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.201_Text: You’re one of our best customers.//Thank you for supporting us.
DT_Dialogue_Dinda_Production.175_Text: You’re welcome to take some herbs if you’d like, <PlayerName>$player</>. I grew them myself. All organic!

DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.44_Text: <NPCName>Ben</> supplies me with out-of-season items sometimes. He’s strangely resourceful.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.46_Text: <NPCName>Emma</> insists on shopping at <NPCName>Sam</>’s for seeds. Beats me why.//<NPCName>Ben</> has good seeds too. Why not buy from him? Besides, he owes a lot to the taco truck. I might be able to get some for free.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.186_Text: <NpcName>Emma</> drinks alcohol. You could gift her sake and stuff.//I don’t mind. I don’t have a problem with people drinking around me.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.204_Text: <NpcName>Emma</> forgot to close the roof window. That’s where they must’ve gotten in.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.197_Text: <NpcName>Emma</> is adorable. I know she doesn’t like painting much. She’d rather garden.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.202_Text: <NpcName>Emma’s</> birthday was yesterday. We had a chill evening.//I made her a candlelit dinner, and we relaxed at home. She was happy, and that made me happy.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.187_Text: <NpcName>Luke</> told me he’s seen painted coats for sale, and people are <Italic>buying</>!//I suppose it <Italic>is</> Winter. The demand for coats is high.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.63_Text: A good bout of emotion can be addictive. It’s my sole source of inspiration.//Without it, life is boring, and boring is no way to live.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.55_Text: A little sip from an oasis of inspiration, I call it. Ha ha.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.21_Text: A nice long walk in the rain is all I need sometimes.//You too, huh?
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.22_Text: A nice long walk in the rain is all I need sometimes.//You too, huh?
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.104_Text: Ah, those pictures are from my performing days. They’re covered with dust now.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.185_Text: Alcohol keeps your body warm, but I don’t drink. I hate alcohol.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.75_Text: All our crops died. It’s too cold, I think.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.180_Text: Almost stepped on a dog this morning. It was taking a nap in a pile of leaves.//<NpcName>Paul’s</> dog, I think. Not so sure. The dog ran away really fast.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.59_Text: An artist should never be afraid to show emotion.//I try very hard to engage with my feelings before creating art.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.38_Text: Anyone who goes through a life-changing event knows that. Life goes on.//<portrait=concerned>There are other things, believe it or not. There are always other things in life.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.90_Text: Anything can be an inspiration. Flowers, animals… Life events.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.117_Text: As a kid, I loved to paint. It fell by the wayside when I…went down another career path.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.30_Text: Back in the day, my hair had to be a natural color. You know, it was a job requirement.//They didn’t let us dye our hair unusual colors. Didn’t want to attract attention, they said.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.14_Text: Besides painting on canvas, I collect rocks and paint on them.//<portrait=happy>They’re free. Good for my wallet.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.33_Text: Bit of a mess, aren’t you?//<portrait=happy>No offense.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.34_Text: Bit of a mess, aren’t you?//<portrait=happy>No offense. You have sand in your eyelashes.//<portrait=annoyed>How did you get sand in your <Italic>eyelashes</>?
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.32_Text: Bit of a mess, aren’t you?//<portrait=happy>No offense. You have snow in your eyelashes.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.35_Text: Bit of a mess, aren’t you?/<portrait=happy>No offense. You have mud in your eyelashes.//<portrait=annoyed>Wait – is that <Italic>really</> mud in your eyelashes? How?
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.189_Text: Bonsai are kind of neat. They seem easy to take care of.//I like them.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.118_Text: But I’m back at it. Didn’t have much of a choice.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.47_Text: But hey, happy wife, happy life.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.157_Text: But some customers are willing to pay so much I can’t say no.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.136_Text: But the rain actually washed away parts of it I hated.//The rest I could fix easily.//<portrait=happy>Happy accident. My favorite artist taught me that.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.111_Text: By the way, <NPCName>Sam</> was <NPCName>Emma’s</> old boss. He was the one who helped her with the taco truck in the beginning.//<portrait=happy>He gave her free groceries until she could support herself with the business.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.195_Text: Can’t wait for Spring. I miss morels already.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.203_Text: Cats got inside the taco truck last week, and gosh, it was a mess!//Cat hair everywhere. Took us the whole day to clean it up.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.148_Text: Could you move a little? You’re in the way.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.152_Text: Did I say hate? I meant dislike.//Summer’s full of them.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.28_Text: Do you ever kind of feel like you miss your old self sometimes?
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.89_Text: Do you have one of those massive heaters we could borrow?
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.116_Text: Don’t. Dwelling on that stuff will kill your spirit.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.150_Text: Everything went great at the rehearsal. Then I fell doing an aerial stunt. Don’t remember much after that.//The next thing I knew, I woke up in a hospital.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.179_Text: Fall windows are good subject to paint.//A peek into an empty, warm room.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.50_Text: Farming isn’t something I could do, unfortunately. No more physical work for me.//I did enough in my youth to last the rest of my life. Now I paint, for crying out loud.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.11_Text: Fruit and wildlife inspire me. They’re so pure and free.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.69_Text: Gah… Another festival is coming up. It’s exhausting to go to so many community activities.//I’d rather stay at home, but I know <NPCName>Emma</> wants to go.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.181_Text: Gave me a heart attack. Good grief!
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.88_Text: Go home, <PlayerName>$player</>. It isn’t safe to wander around in the dark during a storm like this.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.129_Text: Good. It’s good for you. Self-expression and stuff.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.122_Text: Have you ever had <NPCName>Emma’s</> tacos?//They’re killer.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.3_Text: Hey, thanks for clearing up debris in the forest. I saw you’d done it a couple of times when I went there to paint.//I like to chill there sometimes, but I don’t have any farming tools, so I appreciate your doing that.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.97_Text: Hmm… How do you know when a painting is finished?//<portrait=happy>You don’t. You let your instinct decide.//<portrait=normal>If it’s finished, then it’ll feel finished. Until then, keep painting.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.114_Text: Hobbies? Uh… I like to paint.//That’s about it.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.4_Text: How do you avoid getting bitten by bugs when you’re clearing land?
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.5_Text: How do you avoid getting bitten by bugs when you’re clearing land?
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.143_Text: I actually don’t care if what I paint here sells or not. It makes me happy.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.171_Text: I asked <NpcName>Ben</> to take some of my paintings on his travels.//He sold a couple last Fall.//I like that guy.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.154_Text: I avoid people altogether.//I’m better off listening to my own voice inside my head.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.160_Text: I can always tell when you’re nearby. You smell of fresh flowers.//Like the kind I find near the lake.//I don’t know the names. I’m not too familiar with plants.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.31_Text: I can do whatever I want to my hair now, and nobody cares.//I could dye it purple tomorrow, and it wouldn’t matter. It doesn’t make any difference, because I don’t perform anymore.//<portrait=concerned>Ugh…
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.128_Special: I can’t even draw a stick figure!
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.190_Text: I checked out <NpcName>Lily’s</> bonsai garden this morning.//They’re all so pretty.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.57_Text: I could use a nice big jar of fresh jam right now.//Strawberry jam. I should plant strawberries in my garden. They’re in season.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.76_Text: I could use a nice long walk right now.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.184_Text: I could use tea leaves and brew some tea for myself. Warm my body up.//<NpcName>Emma</> loves her green tea too.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.156_Text: I do commissions here and there. I don’t encourage them, though. I don’t like being told what I should paint.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.45_Text: I do wonder where he gets his stuff.//<portrait=normal>Some of his things are great. He has nice seeds too. Better than <NPCName>Sam</>’s, I’d say.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.107_Text: I don’t give pointers. You should paint you.//Get drenched in emotion. Be honest with yourself.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.149_Text: I don’t know why, but I woke up thinking about the night I broke my back.//What a bummer way to start the day.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.82_Text: I don’t wanna get muddy but maybe muddy is good sometimes.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.87_Text: I don’t wanna get muddy but maybe muddy is good sometimes.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.106_Text: I feel full of creativity and inspiration.//<portrait=happy>Nature spoke to me today.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.166_Text: I forgot it takes a while for strawberries to grow.//I planted several last week, but now they’re all withered.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.43_Text: I hate drinking. The alcohol smell is the worst.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.42_Text: I hate self-doubt. It kills the fun.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.74_Text: I hope you have a fireplace in your cabin for this kind of weather.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.170_Text: I just got back from <NpcName>Ben’s</> place.//Took some of my paintings there. He said he’d put them in his caravan and see if anyone’s interested in buying while he’s traveling.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.92_Text: I like painting inanimate objects.//The challenge of bringing them to life grounds me.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.145_Text: I like this spot. It has a nice view.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.60_Text: I like to magnify my feelings and emotions, then I get to work and pour them into the canvas.//That’s why I dread making dark paintings…
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.200_Text: I love radishes. They’re my favorite vegetable.//They’re great in tacos. Radishes and a bit of hot sauce!
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.100_Text: I need to paint them. Nature chose birds’ nests as my next subject.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.183_Text: I need to start shutting off the heater during the day.//Save on the electric bills.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.71_Text: I painted falling leaves the other day. It turned out okay, but I’m not satisfied.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.177_Text: I peeked from the window.//Scary stuff.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.161_Text: I probably smell like paint, right?
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.174_Text: I ran into the mayor the other day. He was chilling across the river, fishing.//That man sure likes fishing.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.73_Text: I really don’t want to walk in the snow.//My boots get all cold and soggy. Gah!
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.40_Text: I said it’s a total time saver. Humph.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.188_Text: I should look into it. Would you buy a hand-painted coat?//How much would you pay?
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.169_Text: I should paint pumpkins. What do you think?//I don’t really feel like it, though.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.175_Text: I spotted him near Fishensips too – fishing!//Maybe he’s trying to catch Spring fish. We’ll never know.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.110_Text: I suppose one of us should be, huh?
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.163_Text: I think I probably knew about it, but I was just too hard-headed to believe it.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.18_Text: I think I’ll avoid Fishensips this weekend.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.65_Text: I took some sand from the beach the other day and used it in my latest painting.//It seems fitting, you know. It <Italic>is</> Summer.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.120_Text: I tried meditating, but it didn’t go well. Mindfulness doesn’t stop the back pain.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.146_Text: I try to look closely when I paint here. The closer I look, the more unusual my paintings get.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.10_Text: I try to paint something that lifts my mood…unless I’m in the mood for feeling sad.//Does that make sense?
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.77_Text: I want to admire the town covered in snow before it all melts.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.164_Text: I wasn’t a professional acrobat long enough before I got injured.//I didn’t have much savings.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.119_Text: I wish I could say other people’s opinions don’t bother me. But everyone needs validation.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.103_Text: If I only had my old job back, I’d be able to afford more than this.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.98_Text: If you’re looking for <NPCName>Emma</>, she should be by the school somewhere.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.101_Text: If you’re looking for <NPCName>Emma</>, she should be in the woodland somewhere.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.155_Text: Inspiration is hard to come by. When it finally strikes, you could end up getting lost.//<portrait=happy>You could stay too long and forget the way back home.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.95_Text: It makes me happy.//<portrait=happy>Can’t you tell?
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.137_Text: It sure is snowing. Glad you don’t have to farm in this weather.//But then, what <Italic>are</> you gonna do?
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.192_Text: It would be too much to keep up with that <Italic>and</> the vegetable garden. Gosh!//No, thank you! Recipe for back pain right there.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.196_Text: It’s a little too cold for morels right now. Once the snow melts, they’ll grow.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.72_Text: It’s generic and bland. It’s missing something, that’s for sure.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.109_Text: It’s nice to see you in such good spirits, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.172_Text: It’s not a bad idea, living in a mobile home.//<NpcName>Ben’s</> doing it, and he seems happy.//But it might be a <Italic>little</> cold when the snow is raging like it is now.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.29_Text: It’s okay to feel that way, I think.//<portrait=concerned>I miss my performing days all the time. That’s normal, isn’t it?
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.140_Text: It’s wild to me that this island gets snow in Winter when the Summers get so dang hot.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.9_Text: I’m not a fan of night skies.//The darkness and silence only make me feel sadness and sorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.105_Text: I’m on a roll right now.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.27_Text: I’m plenty expressive. I’m smiling right now.//Can’t you see my excitement?//Yes, that’s a joke.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.191_Text: I’m tempted to create a bonsai garden. Maybe it could be across from our vegetable garden.//But it would be too much work.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.94_Text: I’m using my favorite brush to paint today.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.158_Text: I’ve gotten plenty of commissions from <NPCName>Bree</>. She seems to like my work, but she likes exclusivity.//<portrait=surprised>Oh, and she’s sent some of my paintings to her family too, I believe.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.194_Text: I’ve seen them play. They’re good!
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.176_Text: Living in the middle of nowhere has its downsides.//Just yesterday, I think I saw a massive bear. A flute-playing bear walking past the river.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.8_Text: Many painters are only appreciated after their tragic death.//<portrait=concerned>Makes you think, doesn’t it?
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.178_Text: Maybe someday, if I paint enough happy things, I’ll be able to let go of some bad things.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.51_Text: Me? I used to do gymnastics five days a week. Now I walk for exercise.//Life is funny that way.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.15_Text: Meditating first thing in the morning helps me map out my day.//You gotta know what you want from the day in order to get it done, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.128_Text: Meh. It’s a skill. Anyone can learn if they’re persistent enough.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.19_Text: My brain feels sluggish. I could really use some inspiration right now. Or maybe a nice long walk in the rain.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.20_Text: My brain feels sluggish. I could really use some inspiration right now. Or maybe a nice long walk in the rain.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.25_Text: My brain feels sluggish. I could really use some inspiration right now. Or maybe a nice long walk in the snow.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.91_Text: My fear is I might run out of inspiration someday. Then what would I do with myself?
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.53_Text: My week has been good. What’s up, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.141_Text: Nature sells. But it’s also comforting, in a way.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.132_Text: No need to water my garden today.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.134_Text: No need to water my garden today.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.37_Text: Not everyone can follow their passion. And you know what? That’s okay.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.49_Text: Now I can’t even take <NPCName>Emma</> to a performance without being a bummer about it.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.67_Text: Oh my!//If somebody tells me to have a great day one more time…
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.2_Text: Oh, a corporate employee?//And now you’re a farmer. What a twist, huh?
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.135_Text: One time, I was doing this huge outdoor painting project, and it started pouring.//I nearly had a panic attack.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.108_Text: Only then can you let yourself go on the canvas.//Until then, I’m afraid your paintings will be empty.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.68_Text: Oops, sorry. I think I’m having a bad day… If you’ll excuse me.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.102_Text: Our cottage is pretty small, huh?//I don’t know what we’d do if we decided to get a pet.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.64_Text: Our garden is lush this Summer. It feels good to eat food we grew ourselves.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.153_Text: People are opinionated, aren’t they?//Gotta stop listening to people, <PlayerName>$player</>. If we listened to every single thing everybody said, it would only drive us mad.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.56_Text: Pufferfish? Oh, I don’t care about things like that.//They own the place, so they’re free to use it however they like.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.131_Text: Rain is good for your crops, right?//Neat.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.133_Text: Rain is good for your crops, right?//Neat.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.130_Text: Really? You’ll have to show me your work sometime.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.39_Text: Reruns are the best. You know precisely what you’re going to get, and you already know whether or not it’s good!//A total time saver.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.162_Text: Saying things out loud helps me control my thoughts.//That’s a good thing, because sometimes there are so many bad ones bubbling in my head.//I wish I’d known I could do that earlier.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.159_Text: She also made me sign one of those documents about the original work.//I can’t make copies and all that. Who cares, really?
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.198_Text: She never said it, but I can tell. She gets frustrated easily when she gets things “wrong,” and yet she makes sure we paint together now and then.//I love her.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.112_Text: She’s very grateful to them… Oh, <NPCName>Sam</> and <NPCName>Emily</>, I mean.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.127_Text: So, uh, you ever do art, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.93_Text: Some days, I get caught up in an idea, and all of a sudden, it’s nighttime.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.16_Text: Some days, though, small things seem like such a chore.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.61_Text: Some of my best work is from my dark days. It just seems easier to create when I’m in the depths.//It’s hard to do in Summer.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.58_Text: Some of my paintings were painted in tears, so I hope when people look at them, they get the same feeling.//They don’t have to be sad tears. They could be happy ones, like the feeling of a new beginning in Spring after a long Winter.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.96_Text: Sometimes, I use wool or fresh flowers instead of a brush. It’s fun to change things up.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.54_Text: Started my day off with some hash browns and hot coffee.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.7_Text: That’s the beauty of art, isn’t it? So unpredictable.
