DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.62_Text: The hardest thing for me to paint is sadness. Yet those paintings turn out the best.//<portrait=happy>Isn’t the universe funny? The games she plays!
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.168_Text: The hot peppers we planted in Summer grew great.//They saved us a lot of money. No need to buy more seeds.//They grew and grew and grew. No withering for them.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.142_Text: The lake has seen better days, but the ocean is even worse.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.193_Text: The neighbors invited us for a volleyball game.//Not about to show off my nonexistent volleyball skills literally during the busiest time of year at the beach.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.138_Text: The snow makes me look like I have bad dandruff.//<portrait=normal>See any on my hair?
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.126_Text: The what? Ah! Interesting. I’ve been a few times.//<portrait=happy>It’s a bit much for me at my age.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.99_Text: There are birds’ nests everywhere. I think it’s a sign.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.80_Text: There isn’t much for me to do when it rains, so I figured I’d help <NPCName>Luke</> with his display.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.79_Text: There isn’t much for me to do when it rains, so I usually catch up on my reading here.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.85_Text: There isn’t much for me to do when it storms, so I figured I’d help <NPCName>Luke</> with his display.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.84_Text: There isn’t much for me to do when it storms, so I usually catch up on my reading here.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.147_Text: This is a nice spot for painting people.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.201_Text: Tomorrow is <NpcName>Emma’s</> birthday. I’m ready.//I filled a box with her favorite things. I can’t wait for her to open it.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.17_Text: Town life isn’t for me. Socializing is too exhausting.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.113_Text: Ugh… My back is killing me.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.52_Text: Walked past a bunch of kids going to school this morning. I see them, and I see hope.//I don’t know what I’m hoping exactly, but it makes it seem like the world isn’t as dark as it feels, you know?
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.144_Text: Want to watch TV with me? I love this show.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.13_Text: We don’t know everything.//Do <Italic>you</> know everything?
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.199_Text: We got a box of radishes yesterday from our neighbors. They must’ve had a bountiful harvest.//<portrait=happy>So kind of them.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.70_Text: Well, at least there’ll be free mooncakes.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.167_Text: We’re planting hot peppers this Summer.//The seeds are pretty cheap, and the plants last till Winter.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.182_Text: We’ve been cranking up the heat this Winter.//I’m not looking forward to the electric bill.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.125_Text: Where are you from, anyway? Never asked.//I mean where in Pokyo City did you live?
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.12_Text: Who’s to say mangoes and jackfruit aren’t sentient?//We tend to assume too much, when in reality, we know so little.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.41_Text: Why do I feel like my creativity just isn’t flowing if I’m not in some sort of… Never mind.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.165_Text: With the hospital bill, my savings were gone, just like that.//I liked the job, so I guess money didn’t matter at the time.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.36_Text: You can get some of my paintings at Socket Electronics.//<NPCName>Luke</> has some in his store.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.123_Text: You ever listen to The Luwaks? Punk band.//Love ’em. Give their latest album a listen if you have the time.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.115_Text: You ever think about how your life could have gone if you hadn’t made some little mistake?
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.6_Text: You never know when inspiration might come. It could be now…//…or an hour from now, or even tonight, when you’re about to fall asleep.
DT_Dialogue_Dippa_Production.121_Text: You’re right. I guess it works for some people. Not me, though.

DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.88_Text: 3 am, bam! Coconut hits our roof. Sounded like an explosion.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.27_Text: <NPCName>Oliver’s</> given me an opportunity I didn’t think I’d ever have—being a mom.//If it weren’t for the bravery of his biological mother, my story would’ve been so different.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.7_Text: <NPCName>Suki</> has great bug repellent. I believe she makes it herself.//It comes in handy in Summer.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.54_Text: <NPCName>Sunny</> can be loud sometimes. But that’s just his personality.//<portrait=normal>Yeah, and his voice.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.55_Text: <NpcName>Sunny</> and I went to the parent-teacher meeting last week. We got to talking to the other parents.//<portrait=surprised>I was looking at <NpcName>Paul</> and <NpcName>Anne</>. My gosh, they’re young!//<portrait=concerned>I wonder if we started this parenting thing too late.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.86_Text: And how much of the ocean hasn’t been explored? A lot. We don’t know what’s down there.//That’s what <NpcName>Alice</> said. She made a compelling point, <PlayerName>$Player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.32_Text: At first, right after we brought <NPCName>Oliver</> home, I thought I wasn’t mom material.//Doubts… They get to you sometimes.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.65_Text: Blue morpho butterflies are really rare, but they do exist here.//I’ve seen them flying around the lake in Summer.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.33_Text: But eventually, it just felt like everything fell into place.//<portrait=normal>I don’t know how or when it started. The next thing I knew, he called me Mom.//And that’s who I’ve been ever since.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.17_Text: Catch any good bugs lately? Bring them to the museum if you want to contribute to our insect exhibit.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.67_Text: Crickets are in full force now that the ice has melted.//They’ll be out till the end of Summer. Watch out!
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.28_Text: Days like these make you think, don’t they?//It takes me back to when we first brought <NPCName>Oliver</> home.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.30_Text: Days like these make you think, don’t they?//It takes me back to when we first brought <NPCName>Oliver</> home.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.81_Text: Fireflies are the prettiest bugs I’ve ever seen. They’re my favorite.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.15_Text: Green tea has a lot of health benefits. It may even protect the brain from aging! But mainly, I like the taste.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.34_Text: I always knew deep down that being a mom was something I was meant to do, and adopting <NPCName>Oliver</> just confirmed it.//Even when it didn’t go as well as I thought it would at first.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.47_Text: I can’t believe it’s already Fall. Where did Summer go?
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.42_Text: I can’t believe it’s already Summer. Time flies, huh?
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.73_Text: I can’t promise you anything, though.//What we sell at the shack depends on what we can get.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.51_Text: I can’t wait for the Winter Fair.//The beach is lively again. The best part is we can see the pretty lights from the shack.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.29_Text: I didn’t bond with him right away. I was worried, of course.//Maybe I wasn’t cut out to be – to be his mom. You know, those thoughts.//<portrait=annoyed>I didn’t fall in love right away, and back then I had so much shame.//<portrait=normal>All in the past now. Couldn’t imagine life without my son.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.31_Text: I didn’t bond with him right away. I was worried, of course.//Maybe I wasn’t cut out to be – to be his mom. You know, those thoughts.//<portrait=annoyed>I didn’t fall in love right away, and back then I had so much shame.//<portrait=normal>All in the past now. Couldn’t imagine life without my son.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.38_Text: I feel bad for flies. Everybody seems to hate them, but they’re just trying to do their part in the world.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.77_Text: I got <NpcName>Sunny</> that brown sweater he’s wearing at White Flamingo.//It cost a fortune, but I can’t deny the quality.//<portrait=happy>It’s been years, and it’s held up better than I thought it would.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.74_Text: I hope I’m not wearing too many brooches today.//<portrait=happy>I couldn’t pick one, so I wore all three.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.3_Text: I like to spend my Spring mornings in Garden Lane.//<portrait=happy>It’s close by, and have you seen it? Incredibly gorgeous.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.26_Text: I love watching butterflies move from flower to flower. They’re so graceful and elegant.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.39_Text: I mean, sure, flies can be a nuisance when they’re around your food, but they’re just looking for a meal like any other living thing.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.68_Text: I miss the sound of crickets.//There isn’t any more cricket song when we open our windows, but that’s all right. They’ll be back soon enough.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.64_Text: I rarely buy clothes at White Flamingo.//<portrait=annoyed>Everything costs way too much there.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.84_Text: I studied a bit about ocean critters, and there are around forty different species in our sea.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.70_Text: I try not to go to the forest. There are way too many wasps.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.79_Text: I want to be supportive of <NpcName>Oliver’s</> dream to become a police detective, even though it makes me nervous.//I want him to know I’ll always love him, whatever he does.//<portrait=concerned>I just hope I’ll be here for it.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.60_Text: I was going over <NpcName>Oliver’s</> homework yesterday, and I understood <Italic>nothing</>. The math they teach these days is beyond complicated.//<portrait=surprised>I don’t remember it having so many letters.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.1_Text: I was telling the mayor I didn’t think anyone would want to visit the island until we got rid of the oil on the beach, but you proved me wrong.//Welcome to the community!
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.44_Text: If I plant flowers this Spring, what do you think I should grow? Peonies or daisies?
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.56_Text: If we had more room, I’d love to have an insect house or two. I’d get one now, but where would we put it?//<portrait=surprised>It would take up the whole kitchen.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.37_Text: It’s interesting how flies can sense when something is rotting or decaying. It’s like they have a sixth sense or something.//Morbid, I know.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.53_Text: It’s nice to see kids enjoying the snow and building snowmen.//<portrait=normal>Some of the kids I used to watch building snowmen a long time ago are grown up now. The twins who run the inn, <NpcName>Frankie Jr.</> … //<portrait=happy>Gosh! I’m old!
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.21_Text: It’s raining pretty hard. I should be going home.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.22_Text: It’s raining pretty hard. I should be going home.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.69_Text: It’s starting to get chilly out.//I’ll need a warmer jacket soon. This one won’t do.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.35_Text: I’d been waiting to be a mom for so long.//<portrait=concerned>And <NPCName>Sunny</> – of course, he was meant to be a dad. You can just tell these things.//I knew it the moment he met my nieces.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.78_Text: I’m glad I bought it, but I’m not sure if I’d get another one. Ha ha!
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.14_Text: I’m glad we have a good coffee bar here in Starlet Town, but to tell you the truth, I much prefer green tea.//<portrait=happy>Don’t tell <NPCName>Raj</>!
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.48_Text: I’m surprised a lot, aren’t I?//Well, what can I say? The change of seasons always takes me by surprise. A good kind of surprise!
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.49_Text: I’m thinking of having a bonfire tomorrow evening with <NPCName>Oliver</> and maybe some of his friends.//It would be in front of the inn, not by the shack. There’s just more room for the kids to play.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.43_Text: I’m thinking of replanting my garden outside the bedroom.//Do you have any good gardening tips?
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.11_Text: I’ve been telling those two that’s what happens, but nope. They still insist. All right, then. What can I say?//<NPCName>Jim</> and <NPCName>Sunny</> are in charge of the kitchen.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.63_Text: I’ve prepared myself for when <NpcName>Oliver</> asks about his biological mother.//<portrait=normal>I’d like to think that when the time comes, I’m ready to answer questions and support his decisions, whatever they might be.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.75_Text: Little wood satyr butterflies are everywhere – around the lake, by the school, and even behind our house!//That’s how I know it’s Spring.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.5_Text: My brooch? Oh…//<portrait=normal>It’s special to me. Not expensive. Nothing like that.//<NPCName>Sunny</> gave it to me the day we brought <NPCName>Oliver</> home from Pokyo.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.82_Text: Not many people believe in it, but I think there’s a whole civilization under the water.//<NpcName>Alice</> thinks so too.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.19_Text: Oh gosh… It’s a storm, all right.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.18_Text: Oh gosh… It’s raining, all right.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.66_Text: Oh, by the way. I’ve been meaning to tell you this. You do so much for this community, <PlayerName>$Player</>.//<portrait=happy>I’m so grateful for you. The environment around us is better now because of you.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.8_Text: Oof! No more humidity. I have to use curlers on my hair now.//<portrait=normal>Good thing I have short hair.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.9_Text: Oof! No more humidity. I have to use curlers on my hair now.//<portrait=normal>Good thing I have short hair.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.36_Text: Some kids came to the museum the other day, and oh gosh… <NPCName>Scott</> sure loves kids, and kids adore him!//<portrait=normal>He reminds me a lot of <NPCName>Sunny</>.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.25_Text: Sometimes at night, I take <NPCName>Oliver</> to the porch on the second floor, and we watch the snow falling on the water.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.41_Text: Summertime here is lively!//<portrait=happy>The beach, the shack. People are vivacious.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.10_Text: The Beach Shack has been smoking a lot of salmon lately.//<portrait=annoyed>The smoke gets trapped on the second floor all day… No matter how many times we change our clothes, we end up smelling like smoked salmon.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.57_Text: The fish pond could be very useful. You could put fish in it, and they multiply.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.6_Text: The heat can get intense at the beach this time of year.//<portrait=concerned>Even with the windows open, sometimes it’s still hot, even at night.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.59_Text: The host is <NpcName>Luke’s</> cousin, Jenna. I overheard him telling <NpcName>Sunny</> about it.//<portrait=normal>I thought it was neat.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.24_Text: The museum is cold in Winter.//I guess the high ceiling doesn’t help. It gets <Italic>really</> cold sometimes.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.4_Text: The museum is nice and warm now.//Not too hot, not too cold. It’s a comfortable place to work in Spring.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.85_Text: The ocean is big. It’s even bigger than the land. Seventy percent of the Earth’s surface is ocean – something like that.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.46_Text: The only thing I need in this sleepy weather is a cup of green tea.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.45_Text: The salty air in front of the shack makes it hard for plants to grow. A lot of them end up dying, and the bushes are all that’s left.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.58_Text: There’s a very informative TV show called The Bug’s Life.//<portrait=surprised>Oh no, no! That’s a different show.//<portrait=normal>It’s Back to Nature. The host gives information about when certain bugs come out and things like that.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.20_Text: This rain isn’t good for our caterpillars! I covered the terrarium with a plastic bin. We don’t want those little guys to drown!//I’m going to go and cover the others.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.23_Text: This rain isn’t good for our caterpillars! I covered the terrarium with a plastic bin. We don’t want those little guys to drown!//I’m going to go and cover the others.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.62_Text: We didn’t have the tools to open a treasure chest, so I told <NpcName>Theo</> to take it to the blacksmith and to keep whatever was in it.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.83_Text: We got to talking about folklore and Coral Island history.//Suffice it to say, she convinced me.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.87_Text: We had some very tall coconut trees near the house, but we had to cut them down.//<portrait=annoyed>They cost us our roof! You know how windy it gets at the beach. When the coconuts are bearing fruit, it’s a dangerous time for us.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.50_Text: We may not do it, though. <NPCName>Oliver</> doesn’t like going out at night.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.72_Text: We sell bug nets at the Beach Shack.//Sometimes, we even have nets of different quality. The better your net is, the wider its catching radius is.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.13_Text: Well… I don’t know if that’s a very good analogy, to be honest.//I just know I love those little fruits!
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.16_Text: We’re always looking for donations at the museum. Please stop by if you have any interesting bugs you’d like to share!
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.52_Text: We’ve been making ramen at the shack lately.//<portrait=normal>Maybe I’ll roast some chestnuts tonight. It’s <NPCName>Sunny’s</> favorite.//<portrait=happy>We still have some chestnuts from Fall… I hope.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.12_Text: When a caterpillar spins its chrysalis, it’s an ugly little thing! But then a beautiful butterfly emerges.//And lychees are the same… Ugly on the outside, but soft and sweet on the inside.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.2_Text: Yeah, you’re right. The island isn’t like it used to be.//It is what it is.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.61_Text: You can find all kinds of things in the ocean.//<portrait=surprised>This one time, <NpcName>Jim’s</> boy brought us a treasure chest. I said, “What are we supposed to do with this?”
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.71_Text: You can upgrade your bug net to catch bugs more easily.//<portrait=surprised>Oh, no that’s not what I meant.//<portrait=normal>What I meant was you can <Italic>buy</> better-quality bug nets.
DT_Dialogue_Eleanor_Production.40_Text: You might think there are more flies in Summer than any other time of year, but that’s actually not true.//<portrait=normal>Yeah, maybe in some parts of the world, but here in Starlet Town, the flies are out year-round.

DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.126_Text: *laughs* On a lighter note, his family is very fun to be around.//I want that!
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.27_Text: <Italic>Yes!</> <NPCName>Jim</>! They look so much alike.//<portrait=normal>That girl has her dad’s smile. Which is rare.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.160_Text: <NPCName>Ben</> has a lot of healing crystals.//None of them spoke to me though. So I haven’t brought any of them home yet.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.40_Text: <NPCName>Ben</> has a stunning collection. You never know when he’ll have something new. Hmm…
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.75_Text: <NPCName>Erika</> and I don’t have set customers, exactly.//But people usually have a preference for who works on their hair.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.157_Text: <NPCName>Erika</> should already be at the salon. I go in around noon. I don’t usually take morning appointments anyway.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.9_Text: <NPCName>Eva’s</> a talented baker. She reminds me a lot of <NPCName>Betty</>.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.41_Text: <NPCName>Sam</> and I are going dancing at the Tavern tomorrow night. You should join us!
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.113_Text: <NPCName>Sam</> inherited the store from his dad. I’m sure some people, like the mayor, still remember it as Remi’s.//<NPCName>Sam</> changed the name to simplify things.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.51_Text: <NPCName>Sam’s</> in the mood for fried rice, and it isn’t the same without fresh shallots.//<portrait=concerned>If you ever make it yourself, you’ll agree.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.180_Text: <NpcName>Ben’s</> out of town. He usually goes to a music festival.//I hope he brings some good items when he comes back.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.173_Text: <NpcName>Erika</> gave me a book of baby names a long time ago. It was probably too early for the gift, but I loved the way she was just as excited as I was.//I couldn’t bring myself to get rid of it.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.125_Text: A big family was always an exciting idea for me. <NPCName>Sam</> comes from one, whereas I grew up without any siblings.// Sometimes, I feel like I missed out on that.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.138_Text: After work? Hmm. I don’t think we have anything special planned.//But I have to confirm with <NPCName>Sam</>.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.150_Text: Ah, I hate to stain my fingers. But I can’t resist! Just look how juicy they are.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.53_Text: Ah, I’m being dramatic again. I think I’ll cool off and have some ice cream or something.//<portrait=annoyed>The heat is making me fuzzy.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.168_Text: Ah, my aura is definitely affected by Winter.//I’m not feeling it today.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.47_Text: Ah, you’d think it would be easier for us to get the groceries we need, what with owning a general store and all.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.92_Text: And look how pretty it is now. People can have a picnic here.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.54_Text: Are you ready for snow season? The kids are going to love it. //<portrait=happy>They usually go to that park over there and build snowmen. Ah!
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.31_Text: As the saying goes, “Sunday clears away the rust of the week.”//<portrait=normal>Oh! What a fun thing to say!
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.120_Text: Bless <NPCName>Eva</>. She’s a dear to actually like being in the store as much as <NPCName>Sam</>.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.87_Text: But you probably need to go to the other side of the island to dive.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.145_Text: But you probably need to go to the other side of the island to dive.//<portrait=normal>There isn’t a diving site around here.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.176_Text: Coconuts are everywhere.//I know they’re all-year-round fruits here, but for some reason, they’re more visible in Summer.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.177_Text: Coconuts are so abundant.//<portrait=normal>I’m sure there’s plenty of them in Garden Lane or on the beach, if you’re looking for any.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.103_Text: Do I talk to <NPCName>Noah</> or <NPCName>Frank</> about it? Who’s in charge tonight?
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.105_Text: Do I talk to <NPCName>Noah</> or <NPCName>Frank</> about it? Who’s in charge tonight?
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.156_Text: Do people even buy this oil? We could do with better quality, for sure.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.26_Text: Do you know who <NPCName>Lily</> reminds me of? Take a guess!//<portrait=happy>Oh, this is fun.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.84_Text: Don’t you think a boutique hotel sort of thing would do splendidly here?
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.123_Text: Ever since we were young, <NPCName>Sam</> and I always knew we wanted to have two or maybe even four children, like <NPCName>Betty</>.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.38_Text: Goodness knows, that was a long time ago. I tried growing it out one time, but it just wasn’t me.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.74_Text: Gosh, I sound like a salesperson. Ha ha!
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.94_Text: Have you found any flowers? Oh dear. I sure hope I didn’t pick them all. There were plenty earlier.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.23_Text: Have you tried your luck in the kitchen?
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.181_Text: He should be back the first week of Winter, if you’re wondering.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.62_Text: How about the rain, huh? How are we supposed to go on like this?
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.69_Text: How’s your Winter been so far? I hope the cold and mountains of snow don’t discourage you.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.32_Text: I believe everything happens for a reason, be it good or bad.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.43_Text: I believe everything happens for a reason, be it good or bad.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.179_Text: I bring cookies and drinks for the Sanchez boys while they’re putting up decorations. Can’t be easy.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.39_Text: I collect lots of things. Antique furniture, for example. I’m always in the market for that.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.111_Text: I cut my hair often. Every other week at least.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.161_Text: I don’t like choosing crystals. I want to let one speak to my soul.//That’s the confirmation I need.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.2_Text: I don’t often go to the part of the island where your farm is.//<portrait=annoyed>It was overgrown the last time I visited. Just a mess.//How is it so far?
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.36_Text: I don’t shop much at Socket & Pan. It’s not to my taste.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.106_Text: I don’t tell <NPCName>Sam</> how to handle his store, but please tell him if a purchase isn’t up to your standards.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.134_Text: I don’t think we’re ready for it after– *sighs* Anyway, maybe someday.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.24_Text: I feel like going foraging tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.93_Text: I filled a basket full of wild fruit and flowers. There were plenty near the shrine, over there.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.118_Text: I get to meet people and chat with my customers. I can’t think of a better job for someone like me.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.170_Text: I get why it’s a popular treat there.//<portrait=normal>It seems <NpcName>Raj</> figured out how to bake delicious muffins. They should try making pumpkin muffins.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.78_Text: I have a little free time before my errands this morning.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.89_Text: I have mixed feelings about putting a TV in our bedroom.//I feel like it might be too much of a distraction.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.133_Text: I have my hands full right now. I’m not thinking about having children at the moment.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.100_Text: I have to go to work soon. Let me just finish up with this shelf.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.77_Text: I have to mention this before I forget.//<portrait=normal>I had a feeling you’d visit today, for some odd reason. I’m glad you did. My instincts never fail me.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.88_Text: I have to read for half an hour or so before going to bed. It’s become a habit, I think.//I can’t just close my eyes and fall asleep.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.137_Text: I have work tomorrow. I think I have some appointments.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.121_Text: I help with the store’s inventory when I have free time. I check the shelves and restock, but that’s all.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.152_Text: I honestly don’t know if putting a community garden that far from town would work, if we’re being honest with ourselves here.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.131_Text: I hope <NPCName>Ben</> has some unique antiques. I’m in the market for some tables to put in the guest room.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.55_Text: I hope Winter isn’t as cold this year.//<portrait=normal>I can’t seem to find my wool gloves anywhere.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.65_Text: I just wish there were something we could do about it.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.71_Text: I just wish there were something we could do about it.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.20_Text: I know this may sound random, but I just want to say that sometimes things don’t make sense, and that’s okay.//Oh, you’re so full of energy and have so much ahead of you.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.119_Text: I love <NPCName>Sam</> dearly, but I can’t bring myself to work at the store for too long.//<NPCName>Goddess</> help me, it’s so dull.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.14_Text: I may talk to him about it, but I don’t know if that would be the right call.//<portrait=concerned>Probably not.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.58_Text: I might go to the lake later. Rainy days are perfect for berry hunting.//Can you guess why?
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.28_Text: I prefer decor that has a meaningful story over something that’s brand new and clean looking.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.4_Text: I quite like my hair today.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.61_Text: I really should rest. I’m starting to feel sleepy.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.172_Text: I saw <NpcName>Oliver</> and <NpcName>Valentina</> walking to school the other day in their Winter gear.//<portrait=happy>So, so cute!
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.50_Text: I should check around the mayor’s house for shallots tomorrow. It’s already the last week of Summer.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.154_Text: I should have gone to the lake instead. The vibe here is too jarring today.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.143_Text: I should retire to the living room. Would you care to join me?
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.182_Text: I spotted a few gray hairs last week.//I might leave them be. I’ll see.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.35_Text: I suppose if you miss an episode, it’s good that they rerun it.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.169_Text: I went to Raja’s Coffee Corner the other day and had some hot cocoa.//It was delicious. I had it with a muffin.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.49_Text: I went to look for shallots near the lake yesterday. But nothing. Maybe I should check again today and see if they’ve sprouted.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.13_Text: If <NPCName>Sam</> stopped bringing in supplies from the mainland, maybe more people would start farming again.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.107_Text: If you’d rather, feel free to tell me. I’m all ears when it comes to customer complaints.//I wish other businesses would handle complaints like I do, to be honest.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.5_Text: If you’re looking for easy dish ideas, try this.//You can put fruit and vegetables on a grill, then drizzle them with honey for a fantastic, colorful meal!
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.130_Text: In my case, anyway. And I’m glad I did.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.15_Text: Inhale…exhale… I’m trying to relax a little.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.76_Text: Is business good at the farm, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.102_Text: It could use a little chilling before serving. Then it would be just right.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.129_Text: It feels good to move on. Sometimes, closure is what we need. And acceptance is the first step.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.174_Text: It reminds me of how kind and supportive she is as a friend.//It brings good memories, even after I lost the baby.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.128_Text: It reminds me of the whole jelly and jam mess.//So similar, yet so different.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.7_Text: It’s crunchy and sweet.//<portrait=normal>Easy to toss together after a long day of work.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.48_Text: It’s easier for us than the general public, true.//But we still rely a lot on local farmers like you, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.178_Text: It’s not an easy job to put up festival decorations and then take them down.//Especially for the Animal Festival. There are so many different decorations!
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.85_Text: It’s too nice to stay inside today, isn’t it?
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.95_Text: It’s too nice to stay inside today, isn’t it?
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.19_Text: It’s your voice that matters most, my dear. Listen to it first, then consider others.//Try not to get it confused. I know I sometimes do.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.97_Text: I’m glad you did, by the way. Now someone will take care of the land.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.83_Text: I’m going to take it easy and eat only raw food today.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.144_Text: I’m not a diver. I don’t like water. But you go ahead!//I’m a Sagittarius, you know. Fire and water don’t mix.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.127_Text: I’m not big on cooking, but I do watch the cooking channel every once in a while.//Cooking I can do. Baking is a little harder to grasp.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.135_Text: I’ve been thinking about redoing the house completely! Perhaps I could reconfigure the rooms and make a huge living room.//Or maybe I could turn the space into a yoga studio.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.79_Text: I’ve developed a habit of winding down with a cup of green tea after a long day of work.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.112_Text: Just a little trim helps. It isn’t easy to keep up with short hair.//It becomes fairly obvious as it grows out. The unevenness. Goodness gracious!
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.59_Text: Less competition, correct! Great minds think alike, they say.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.148_Text: Maybe I should leave it empty for now.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.82_Text: Maybe it’s greenery I’ve been longing for lately.//<portrait=normal>My body is craving nature.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.151_Text: Mayor <NPCName>Connor</>, bless his heart, had good intentions for turning your lot into a community garden. With the former owner’s approval, of course.//But do you really think people would walk there every single day to garden?
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.158_Text: Mayor <NPCName>Connor</>, bless his heart, had good intentions for turning your lot into a community garden. With the former owner’s approval, of course.//But do you really think people would walk there every single day to garden?
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.165_Text: My energy is charged. Summer has such a positive effect on me.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.80_Text: My gut tells me today is going to be a relaxing day.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.37_Text: My hair is my signature, you know. I’ve worn it like this since I was a bachelorette.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.46_Text: My hairspray doesn’t hold all day. I should write the company and let them know. What a disaster!
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.183_Text: Next week is Winter anyway. I’ll probably be wearing a beanie most of the time.//I’ll just wait till Spring to touch up my hair.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.86_Text: No, I’m not a diver. But you go ahead! I’m a Sagittarius, you know. Fire and water don’t mix.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.166_Text: Now that it’s Spring, I can feel the color in my aura coming back again.//<portrait=happy>I like it.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.147_Text: Now that the nursery is no longer a nursery, what should I do with the room, do you think?
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.122_Text: Oh dear. I just know I wouldn’t enjoy having more responsibility than that. I prefer working directly with customers.//Computers put me right to sleep.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.52_Text: Oh my! I could do with a little rain right now.//The heat is destroying my hair!
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.45_Text: Oh my. I need to get my hair done. I can’t possibly go out like this!
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.25_Text: Oh no! I have work tomorrow.//<portrait=concerned>Maybe over the weekend. That’s better for running around the island.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.42_Text: Oh, I hope <NPCName>Theo</> is there! He has such a fabulous voice!
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.1_Text: Oh, the new neighbor.//<portrait=happy>So, someone really <Italic>was</> moving into town, huh?//<portrait=normal>I didn’t believe it until I saw you myself.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.91_Text: Oh, you should have seen this place! It was overgrown before Mayor <NPCName>Connor</> decided to bring everybody together to clean it up a bit.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.132_Text: Perhaps I could put some paintings in there too. Hang some of <NPCName>Dippa’s</> originals on the wall.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.11_Text: Remember to eat your greens, <PlayerName>$player</>.//The more color on your plate, the better.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.114_Text: Remi is my father-in-law, that’s right.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.108_Text: Running the salon takes a lot of my time. There’s maintenance to consider, and ordering as well.//Even when I’m not there, I still think about it.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.70_Text: Snowing again? Seriously, how are we going to survive this Winter if the sun keeps hiding like this?
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.141_Text: Some of our furniture is from <NPCName>Ben</>. They’re antiques, you see.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.81_Text: Something told me to come here.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.18_Text: Sometimes we forget to consider the most important opinion when we make big decisions – our own.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.22_Text: Stew is easy to make. It’s also impossible to mess up.//It was one of the first meals I learned to cook.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.64_Text: Storming again? Seriously, how are we going to survive this Winter if the sun keeps hiding like this?
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.163_Text: Summer fits my energy the best.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.117_Text: Thank <NPCName>Goddess</> I have a full schedule at my salon. What a perfect way to keep me busy.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.29_Text: That feels empty to me.//<portrait=happy>But of course, sometimes there are exceptions.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.136_Text: That seems unnecessary, though, since we have a perfectly good place to work out together in the community center over there.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.12_Text: That sounds nosy, I know.//<portrait=normal>It’s still good advice.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.90_Text: That’s a very good point. It is convenient.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.6_Text: The assorted grilled platter is my all-time favorite.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.146_Text: The evenings are so quiet here. It would have been nice with a couple of kids around.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.57_Text: The key is to find more activities to keep myself busy.//<portrait=normal>The less free time I have, the less I’ll have to complain about. You should try that.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.110_Text: The key is to make sure the salon is well maintained.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.3_Text: The salon is closed today, my dear. <NPCName>Erika</> is busy volunteering at the school.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.171_Text: The snow is here!//<portrait=happy>We have about three more weeks of this weather. Are you ready?
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.115_Text: The snow makes you think, doesn’t it?//It’s one thing not to have something in the first place. But it’s another thing to have it and then have it taken away so quickly.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.124_Text: The thought of running around with small children, taking them to the beach, teaching them how to dive… It was exciting for us.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.155_Text: The town gets so quiet when it rains. As if it’s telling us to slow down, forcing us to take a break.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.8_Text: There should be plenty of wild mushrooms or berries around the school. I haven’t checked today, though.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.175_Text: There’s a sweet scent in the air today. Hmm. Can you smell it? It’s faint.//<portrait=happy>That’s the scent of cherry blossoms blooming.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.104_Text: They need to turn up the volume a little, don’t you think, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.101_Text: This sauce is delicious! I wonder what <NPCName>Frank</> puts in it.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.164_Text: Today is a good day to garden.//<portrait=happy>The weather couldn’t be better.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.10_Text: Too bad <NPCName>Betty</> doesn’t bake anymore.//<portrait=normal>I do miss her pastries sometimes.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.159_Text: We could have divided the work, true. But I honestly don’t know if putting a community garden that far from town would work, if we’re being honest with ourselves here.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.30_Text: We donate what we can to Starlet Town. Mayor <NPCName>Connor</> is very grateful.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.33_Text: We learn from both good things and bad.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.44_Text: We learn from both good things and bad.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.73_Text: We mix the dyes here ourselves. All organic, without any harsh chemicals.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.67_Text: What a storm, huh?//How are we supposed to go on like this?
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.162_Text: Winter can get pretty wet, and it’s a little too slow for a Sagittarius like myself.//It doesn’t fit well with my energy.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.149_Text: Would you like some berries, <PlayerName>$player</>? They’re a bit messy to eat, though.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.34_Text: You can improve your cooking skills by watching the cooking channel. They show reruns sometimes, though.//That’s a bit of a bummer, especially when you’re looking forward to a new recipe.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.139_Text: You could at least use a trim, my dear. Hmm…
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.17_Text: You didn’t take off your boots.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.60_Text: You don’t mind the rain, I see.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.72_Text: You don’t mind the snow, I see.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.66_Text: You don’t mind the storm, I see.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.109_Text: You don’t want a leak when you have a salon. It could run up a massive water bill.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.56_Text: You know, <PlayerName>$player</>, as part of my New Year’s resolution, I’m going to complain less.//I have an excellent feeling about next year!
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.16_Text: You should take off your boots and be one with nature.//Take a deep breath…
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.140_Text: You should try wigs! It’s a great way to change up your look without too much commitment.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.96_Text: Your grandparents’ farm was neglected for a long time. You should have seen it! It wasn’t a pretty sight.//Mayor <NPCName>Connor</> was going to turn it into a community garden before you moved in.
DT_Dialogue_Emily_Production.153_Text: Your livestock must be happy to be able to run around on such a massive plot of land.

DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.62_Text: <NPCName>Archie</> told me he learned about coral reefs and the island’s ecosystem from her.//I guess she probably knows this place better than anyone.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.64_Text: <NPCName>Archie</> told me he learned about coral reefs and the island’s ecosystem from her.//I guess she probably knows this place better than anyone.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.95_Text: <NPCName>Bree’s</> holding an annual appreciation dinner for the mayor.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.4_Text: <NPCName>Dippa</> decorated my truck. I don’t have an eye for all this artsy stuff.//<portrait=happy>It’s something else, isn’t it?
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.56_Text: <NPCName>Erika</>? Hmm. I see her at school sometimes, but I don’t know where she might be today.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.58_Text: <NPCName>Erika</>? Hmm. I see her at school sometimes, but I don’t know where she might be today.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.77_Text: <NPCName>Eva</>! We’ve made it a tradition to exchange gifts every year. It’s a little inside joke. Ha!
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.165_Text: <NPCName>Sam</> gave me my first grocery orders for free. He told me to just pay when I could.//It really helped in the beginning when I was just starting my food truck business.//<portrait=happy>I’ll never forget that.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.13_Text: <NPCName>Sam</> has a good variety of items. His place is a one-stop shop for the food truck.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.7_Text: <NPCName>Sam</> has a good variety of items. His place is a one-stop shop for the food truck.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.8_Text: <NPCName>Sam</> has a good variety of items. His place is a one-stop shop for the food truck.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.191_Text: <NpcName>Ben</>. He had a long overdue tab at the truck and decided to pay with a hammock.//<portrait=happy>It’s super comfy.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.186_Text: <NpcName>Dippa</> has some paintings at Socket & Pan, so <NpcName>Luke</> gives us a discount.//<portrait=happy>Money, money, money!
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.108_Text: After the storm, there might be more wild vegetables around the island.//I don’t know for sure, but it’s worth checking!
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.139_Text: Ah, I should’ve packed an extra lunch.//<portrait=doubt>I ate mine too early, and my stomach is growling again.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.140_Text: Are you on a picnic too?
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.175_Text: Aww. All right. Well, the more you know!
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.196_Text: Besides, he’s got some bills to pay.//<portrait=happy>Maybe he can just pay with seeds or new blankets.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.156_Text: But I’m thankful they took me under their wing. And for the memories too.//I owe <NPCName>Sam</> and <NPCName>Emily</> for a lot of good memories and life lessons.//<portrait=normal>They were very encouraging and supportive.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.80_Text: But we also get a lot of cosmos, the flowers.//<portrait=normal>So, I don’t want to complain too much about Summer.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.23_Text: But when I do have leftovers, I refrigerate them to eat later.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.25_Text: But when I do have leftovers, I refrigerate them to eat later.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.150_Text: But who cares, right? I have fun doing it.//<portrait=normal>That’s all that matters.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.142_Text: But, er, don’t expect too much.//<portrait=happy>I love myself enough to admit I don’t have a single artistic bone in my body.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.190_Special: Can I nap in your hammock?
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.192_Special: Can I pick something from your garden?
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.49_Text: Did you know the creek in front of the mayor’s house was once dried up? Oh, but it was so long ago. I doubt many people know about it.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.38_Text: Did you know the creek in front of the mayor’s house was once dried up?//Oh, but it was so long ago. I doubt many people know about it.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.45_Text: Did you know the creek in front of the mayor’s house was once dried up?//Oh, but it was so long ago. I doubt many people know about it.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.51_Text: Did you know the creek in front of the mayor’s house was once dried up?//Oh, but it was so long ago. I doubt many people know about it.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.53_Text: Did you know the creek in front of the mayor’s house was once dried up?//Oh, but it was so long ago. I doubt many people know about it.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.179_Text: Don’t let the warm weather make you lazy.//I try to do a set of jumping jacks every morning before starting my day.//<portrait=happy>Get my blood pumping!
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.31_Text: Everything I sell is made fresh every day, by the way.//So you can be sure you won’t be eating day-old meals.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.72_Text: Everything is a mess! I can’t even find my old grill.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.28_Text: Fishensips is just too loud for me.//<portrait=annoyed>The music hurts my ears, honestly.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.35_Text: Fishensips is just too loud for me.//<portrait=annoyed>The music hurts my ears, honestly.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.44_Text: For some reason, the kids don’t buy as much when I make anything other than tacos.//<portrait=normal>Why is that, do you think?
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.48_Text: For some reason, the kids don’t buy as much when I make anything other than tacos.//<portrait=normal>Why is that, do you think?
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.78_Text: Going to the beach a lot, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.195_Text: Gonna check out <NpcName>Ben’s</> stuff this weekend.//He usually brings back some interesting things from his trips.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.16_Text: Grapes and rice can be fermented in kegs to make alcoholic beverages. Did you know that?
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.12_Text: Grapes and rice can be fermented in kegs to make alcoholic beverages.//Did you know that?
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.145_Text: Having a big house sounds like a lot of work.//<portrait=normal>It would be nice to have the extra space, but the cleaning and maintenance… Too much commitment.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.170_Text: Here’s an insider tip: <NPCName>Dippa</> hates fresh tomatoes.//You know, I could never understand that. Fresh tomatoes taste fine to me.//I don’t love them, but hate? Nah.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.17_Text: Hmm. I can’t remember who told me.//<portrait=normal>Why? Does it matter?
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.138_Text: Hmm. I may need to buy extra flour today.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.37_Text: Hmm… Seems like I’m always running out of something.//Do I need to make another trip to <NPCName>Sam</>’s already?
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.132_Text: Hmm… What else do I need?
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.180_Text: Homegrown tomatoes make all the difference in tacos.//They’re fresh, and more importantly, cheap!
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.198_Text: How much do you think it would cost to install a little television in my truck?//<portrait=doubt>It would be a nice way to pass the time.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.153_Text: I always knew I didn’t want to stay at <NPCName>Sam</>’s too long.//Not because there were any problems, though.//He was a really good and fair boss.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.169_Text: I ate moldy bread one time, and I was sick for two days. Never again!//<portrait=happy>Hey, I like how we’re opening up to each other!
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.21_Text: I can’t believe it’s Sunday already. I’m still so tired from yesterday.//<portrait=normal>Maybe I can sneak in some beach time next weekend and lie in the sun.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.98_Text: I can’t remember the last time I changed the tires, to be perfectly honest. It’s worrisome if you ask me.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.30_Text: I do my errands around Starlet Town on Wednesday or Thursday.//That way, I can go out of town on the weekend if I need to.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.26_Text: I don’t know why <NPCName>Dippa</> doesn’t just buy and sell art, you know?//<portrait=normal>They have an eye for it.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.101_Text: I don’t like going out in the rain, so I usually just spend the day cooking.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.107_Text: I don’t like going out in the rain, so I usually just spend the day cooking.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.33_Text: I don’t really like hanging out at Fishensips.//<portrait=normal>It’s too loud there.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.193_Text: I don’t recommend wearing sandals to walk in the woods.//Broke mine the other day. I had to walk home barefoot. The path was scorching hot!
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.97_Text: I don’t travel in Winter. I’m afraid the truck might get stuck in the middle of a snowstorm.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.22_Text: I don’t usually have any food left at the end of the day, because I don’t make a lot to begin with.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.24_Text: I don’t usually have any food left at the end of the day, because I don’t make a lot to begin with.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.184_Text: I enjoy my walk to work.//The cooler weather is refreshing.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.3_Text: I get most of my ingredients from <NPCName>Sam</>.//I also forage around the island for some things.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.6_Text: I get most of my ingredients from <NPCName>Sam</>.//I also use vegetables from my garden.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.9_Text: I go out of town sometimes. Not often, though, and usually only on weekends.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.11_Text: I go out of town sometimes.//<portrait=normal>Not often, though, and usually only on weekends.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.194_Text: I got my sandals from <NpcName>Ben</>.//<portrait=normal>I’ll stick to shoes from now on.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.122_Text: I have no idea where this creek flows from. But I’m not one for exploring nature, so I can never bring myself to try finding out.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.148_Text: I have regulars over there.//<portrait=happy>Not a lot, but I appreciate them. Money is money, right?
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.89_Text: I have to forage extra hard during Winter because there’s not much around to begin with.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.133_Text: I just buy my tortillas here. It takes too long to make them from scratch.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.185_Text: I keep a portable heater in my truck.//It’s pretty small, but it works well. I got it at Socket & Pan.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.174_Text: I knew it! I love getting to know new people.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.159_Text: I know it isn’t a lot, but I’m proud of myself for getting this food truck.//<portrait=happy>A little pat on my own back. Self-love. Ha ha!
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.158_Text: I know they like having visitors, especially <NPCName>Emily</>.//<portrait=concerned>She always complains about the house being too quiet.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.151_Text: I liked working at <NPCName>Sam</>’s. I couldn’t bake very well, so the bakery corner had a limited selection back then.//Only bread, if I’m not mistaken. We didn’t even have cookies.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.135_Text: I might open my truck later.//<portrait=doubt>I don’t know yet.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.104_Text: I need to crank up the heat in here.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.110_Text: I need to crank up the heat in here.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.41_Text: I need to make a list before I go to the store, or else I buy too much.//<portrait=annoyed>So annoying!
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.34_Text: I prefer going to the lake or just staying home. I hope you don’t think I’m dull!
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.87_Text: I remember the first Winter I opened my truck.//Almost the whole town showed up to celebrate with me.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.187_Text: I remember when money used to be tight, tighter than now.//<portrait=happy><NpcName>Dippa</> and I went shopping for our first dining table. My old one was a side table.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.61_Text: I see <NPCName>Betty</> at school a lot. I think she teaches the kids every week.//<portrait=happy>But I’m not 100 percent certain.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.63_Text: I see <NPCName>Betty</> at school a lot. I think she teaches the kids every week.//<portrait=happy>But I’m not 100 percent certain.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.157_Text: I should probably visit <NPCName>Sam</> and <NPCName>Emily</> one of these days. Catch up and stuff.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.59_Text: I taught the kids a few things about making tacos. *laughs* I hope their parents don’t mind.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.65_Text: I taught the kids at school a few things about making tacos. *laughs* I hope their parents don’t mind.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.116_Text: I think I may take a quick walk later before I head home.//You know, to enjoy the weather.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.147_Text: I think I’ll go down to Beluga Bay this Summer. Just on weekends.//Spend a day or two, come back Monday.//<portrait=doubt>Can’t go during the week, or I’d lose too much business.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.149_Text: I try to paint sometimes. *laughs* I’m not good at it!
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.130_Text: I use red cabbage when it’s in season.//<portrait=happy>It has that nice crunchy texture.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.137_Text: I use red cabbage when it’s in season.//<portrait=happy>It has that nice crunchy texture.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.167_Text: I used to work over there, by the oven.//It wasn’t as big back in the day.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.152_Text: I was in charge of stocking and ordering. I was honestly much better at that than at baking.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.154_Text: I was paid well, but I knew I wanted to cook food, not pastries.//So I saved up my salary until I could afford a used truck and my own cottage.//<portrait=happy>And I did.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.68_Text: If you find any wild fruit, feel free to take it, by the way.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.113_Text: Isn’t there a saying about snow bringing good luck?
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.93_Text: Isn’t there a saying about snow bringing good luck?
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.111_Text: It feels like it was just snowing yesterday, and now it’s snowing again today.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.50_Text: It was all so sudden when we had that earthquake. Then, bam! The creek was flowing again the next day.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.39_Text: It was all so sudden when we had that earthquake.//<portrait=happy>Then, bam! The creek was flowing again the next day.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.46_Text: It was all so sudden when we had that earthquake.//<portrait=happy>Then, bam! The creek was flowing again the next day.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.52_Text: It was all so sudden when we had that earthquake.//<portrait=happy>Then, bam! The creek was flowing again the next day.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.54_Text: It was all so sudden when we had that earthquake.//<portrait=happy>Then, bam! The creek was flowing again the next day.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.146_Text: It would be nice to have an extra refrigerator, though.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.199_Text: It’d be nice to have an automatic window in the roof.//The kind that you press a button to open. Must be expensive to install, though.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.84_Text: It’s a lot of work being a mayor, you know.//I hardly saw him out fishing all Summer, and he loves fishing.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.70_Text: It’s always nice to get together with folks.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.119_Text: It’s easier than you think to make good vegan tacos.//I personally like bell peppers, but you can use any Summer or Fall vegetables you want.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.126_Text: It’s easier than you think to make good vegan tacos.//I personally like bell peppers, but you can use any Summer or Fall vegetables you want.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.136_Text: It’s easier than you think to make good vegan tacos.//I personally like bell peppers, but you can use any Summer or Fall vegetables you want.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.131_Text: It’s good to see you in such good spirits, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.96_Text: It’s great. It’s very nice of her to do that.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.90_Text: It’s just too cold. Plants can’t survive in the snow.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.18_Text: It’s kind of nice to spend the weekend here.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.20_Text: It’s kind of nice to spend the weekend here.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.181_Text: It’s much cheaper to grow food than to buy it at <NPCName>Sam</>’s.//<portrait=happy>Not swimming in money over here.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.109_Text: I’ll have a look tomorrow. Fingers crossed.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.141_Text: I’m all for trying out something new.//Like painting or sculpting.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.125_Text: I’m glad you came to visit.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.162_Text: I’m going to treat myself to some hot cocoa later. Yum. That sounds so good!
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.81_Text: I’m out of fish, so I guess I’m only selling vegan tacos tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.143_Text: I’m so glad I got the cottage when it was cheap.//I think it’s worth twice as much now.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.47_Text: I’ve been trying to make something new to sell, like cookies or pizza.//But it’s easier said than done.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.43_Text: I’ve been trying to make something new to sell, like cookies or something.//But it’s easier said than done.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.92_Text: I’ve been using a lot of substitutes lately.//<portrait=normal>I wonder if my customers even notice.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.127_Text: Just found some time to do meal prep.//Ah, my hands are so dirty.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.134_Text: Knowing where this fruit is grown helps me feel more connected to the island.//It also supports local farmers, right?
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.144_Text: Maybe I’ll renovate it one day with enough room for a bigger kitchen, or even a couple of pets!
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.83_Text: Mayor <NPCName>Connor</> has been walking back and forth to town a lot lately.//I guess he’s trying to get things ready for the Harvest Festival.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.27_Text: Me? Buying art? No, no. I don’t have what it takes, and besides, I don’t want to.//<portrait=happy>I like to keep moving all day.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.128_Text: Might as well marinate some chard for burritos.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.76_Text: My birthday is on the 13th, and do you know who else has a birthday on the 13th?
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.163_Text: My favorite food would be tacos, obviously. I like pumpkin too.//<portrait=doubt>Come to think of it, there isn’t any food I hate.//<portrait=annoyed>Wow! That shocks <Italic>me</>.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.19_Text: My truck is closed today.//Probably wouldn’t get many customers anyway.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.88_Text: No, it wasn’t a gathering or anything like that.//<portrait=happy>They came to help out and probably wanted to support my business.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.82_Text: No, not a good time. I’ll go shopping for fish next week.//The vegetables will do for now.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.29_Text: Oh sure, sure. I think a lot of people like it. The loud music and sweaty crowds.//<portrait=happy>It’s just not my kind of place.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.36_Text: Oh sure, sure. I think a lot of people like it. The loud music and sweaty crowds.//<portrait=happy>It’s just not my type of place.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.73_Text: Oh! It’s the last week of Spring already! I really need to find my old grill.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.114_Text: Oh, is it the rain? Hmm. Maybe it’s the rain.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.94_Text: Oh, is it the rain? Hmm. Maybe it’s the rain.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.55_Text: Oh, you look confused.//Looking for something, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.57_Text: Oh, you look confused.//Looking for something, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.105_Text: Please watch your boots. I’d hate to have to mop again.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.99_Text: Please watch your boots. I’d hate to have to mop again.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.124_Text: Please watch yourself. Try not to step on anything, okay?
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.200_Text: Press a button, breeze comes in. Whoosh!//Press a button, quiet.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.10_Text: School ends around 4 pm.//That’s usually my prime selling time.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.14_Text: School ends around 4 pm.//That’s usually my prime selling time.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.85_Text: So lovely to see the Fall festival decorations.//They always do an excellent job.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.1_Text: So, the rumors were true after all. Welcome to town!//<portrait=doubt>We got a new scientist in town last month too. Can’t remember his name though.//<portrait=normal>Anyway, I hope you like it here.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.190_Text: Sure! It’s super comfy.//<portrait=doubt>I got it from <NpcName>Ben</>. I sent him the bill from his tab at the truck, and instead of money, he paid it with the hammock.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.2_Text: Sure, sure, it’s nice to meet you too! My name is <NPCName>Emma</>.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.171_Text: That reminds me. I need to get some flour and tortillas.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.160_Text: The food truck business can be tricky. I had to go back and forth between here and Beluga Bay a lot in the beginning.//I was trying to build up a customer base.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.197_Text: The mayor has the best hats.//I saw him walking around with a cactus on his hat.//<portrait=happy>He’s so cool!
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.86_Text: The whole town looks like a scene from a television show.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.168_Text: They need the big oven now. With <NPCName>Eva’s</> great baking skills, they can make so much more stuff. Faster too.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.60_Text: They seemed to pick it up quickly, I have to say. I wonder if they’d already learned it somewhere else.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.66_Text: They seemed to pick it up quickly, I have to say.//I wonder if they’d already learned it somewhere else.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.182_Text: This year’s corn is so sweet.//It’s a great crop!
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.161_Text: Traveling takes its toll. Now I’m too tired to do it regularly.//Thankfully, I do just fine focusing my business here in Starlet Town.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.173_Text: True. Look at us. Getting to know each other!
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.192_Text: Umm, no. We have wombats doing that already.//<portrait=happy>But if you’re hungry, I can send you some food.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.15_Text: Usually. Not always, though.//Sometimes I’m lucky if I have five orders.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.100_Text: Wah, the rain is that bad, huh?
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.106_Text: Wah, the storm is that bad, huh?
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.79_Text: We get a lot of bugs here in Summer.//But there must be plenty at the farm too, huh?//<portrait=doubt>I mean, the forest is right there.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.178_Text: We planted plenty of potatoes in our garden.//I might start adding them to my tacos. Use them for a crispy topping.//<portrait=happy>The kids might like that.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.188_Text: We saw this beautiful pair of floral sofas.//We couldn’t afford the set, so <NpcName>Joko</> sold us just one.//The next time we went back, the other one was gone. Too bad!
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.71_Text: We’re halfway through Spring already, and I haven’t done my house cleaning yet!
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.183_Text: We’ve lost a lot of crops lately.//<portrait=happy>I think there’s a wombat out there with a taste for sweet potatoes.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.115_Text: What a great day to be outside.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.155_Text: When I think about it, I owe my independence to <NPCName>Sam</> and <NPCName>Emily</>, in a way.//I could’ve worked at Sockets or at the clinic, and I would have worked just as hard.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.120_Text: When there are no customers, I try to get a quick nap in. Right now, you’re kind of in the way.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.191_Special: Where did you get your hammock?
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.91_Text: With less wild produce available, I have to be very…creative when it comes to my taco recipe.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.102_Text: With this rain, though, tomorrow there may be more wild fruit than usual around the island.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.75_Text: Yes. I am, in fact, one of those people.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.67_Text: You can find all kinds of things around my house. Oh, like food, I mean!//<portrait=happy>There are wild mushrooms and even fresh fruit sometimes.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.118_Text: You can use any kind of fish to make fish tacos.//<portrait=happy>Honestly, after I cook the fish, I can’t even taste the difference. It’s all in the seasoning.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.172_Text: You look like the type who enjoys afternoon tea with cookies.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.117_Text: You need a really good skillet to make tacos.
DT_Dialogue_Emma_Production.74_Text: You see, this is why we shouldn’t put things away.//Then people can’t see them, and people get irritated when they can’t find what they’re looking for.

DT_Dialogue_Etna_OldTemplate_Production.30A117954753D86176765B9D59F7E250: But I have my doubts, I think it's just old decor from a shipwreck. It's missing that certain 'oomph' factor, you know?
DT_Dialogue_Etna_OldTemplate_Production.D911F25B47203EA58F60F9A140A31B27: Cultivating glow algae is tricky.//Oh, that's a diva plant. Get your soil and sand mix just a tad off, and poof! Wilt city.
DT_Dialogue_Etna_OldTemplate_Production.1CA9C12F45C49791449D7DAD57A44301: Did you hear the chatter at the market? Someone found an antique trident they're claiming is King Neptune's!
DT_Dialogue_Etna_OldTemplate_Production.DACD735F4E7161A3EB26D0A57D748D3E: Ever tried mixing coffee and saltwater? I did. Spoiler alert: it's a no-go.//Some dreams just aren’t meant to be brewed.
DT_Dialogue_Etna_OldTemplate_Production.A5437A3142FA21271F447089D9E52222: Have you heard about the Princess' new collection?//Door frames, was it? Let's just say it's making quite the splash around here.
DT_Dialogue_Etna_OldTemplate_Production.1765CEB44659FD0F8E63DBB0C3E93D13: Have you heard the song of the humpback whales? It’s the serenade of the deep. Nothing quite like it.
DT_Dialogue_Etna_OldTemplate_Production.3F44C902405CBE477D22DEAACB9B7316: Heard of the new seaweed diet? Apparently, it’s all about balance. One week green, one week red.//I should give it a go.
DT_Dialogue_Etna_OldTemplate_Production.0BF8146741E0B67E18241DAC88192173: I overheard some merfolk talking about the latest underwater dance craze. Made me want to shake my tail fin and join in.
DT_Dialogue_Etna_OldTemplate_Production.42A1EAE0484A632872C13CA1114FF171: I see the 'twisted fin' hairstyle is back...Wore that in my teens. Everything old is new again, I suppose.
DT_Dialogue_Etna_OldTemplate_Production.FA783B094125EE6CC82B3094EB6DA3D1: I've been weaving some new patterns into the seaweed textiles. It's always refreshing to learn something new.
DT_Dialogue_Etna_OldTemplate_Production.8CE1D831447C5C96D493DCA85D7094CF: I've got this little patch of moonlit corals. They only bloom during the full moon.//So, tell me. You ever have plants that prefer the moon to the sun?
DT_Dialogue_Etna_OldTemplate_Production.7EA08A8C41784EC1F402C7879C8BE5E9: Jellyfish stings are the talk of the town. Either we've got a bloom situation or it's a new beauty trend I'm unaware of.
DT_Dialogue_Etna_OldTemplate_Production.7C3672F940560FBA7D4C7E90316E6716: Maybe the ocean's having its <Italic>frozen</> moment. Let it go, right?
DT_Dialogue_Etna_OldTemplate_Production.0CC6F6F44D013DD890A7EC960B4EA345: My first crafting attempt? Aimed for a necklace, landed on a tiara. Wore it all day and made everyone call me 'Your Highness'. Ha!
DT_Dialogue_Etna_OldTemplate_Production.7F469B7A408D637758B419A0B8CA05FD: My garden is my little escape pod. Perfect spot for daydreaming, pondering life, and dodging the village's latest gossip.
DT_Dialogue_Etna_OldTemplate_Production.22AA5991403D11329DE3BAB62D7D0069: Nothing like waking up to the scent of fresh blooming sea roses.
DT_Dialogue_Etna_OldTemplate_Production.929042F5409EAD36B356908143ED38D6: Ran into a school of fish today. Literally. I swear they change directions more often than I change my mind!
DT_Dialogue_Etna_OldTemplate_Production.345708DC4809C007E14CD7BC2FC7808A: Spring's currents bring the best crafting materials. Those iridescent shells are in this year.//I'm all geared up for some shell shopping.
DT_Dialogue_Etna_OldTemplate_Production.43C912344E84BED6651523AA3F916ADB: Talk about a real test of patience...trying to keep those pesky seahorses from munching on my kelp greens.
DT_Dialogue_Etna_OldTemplate_Production.9E79B4E9464067E592B03F982DFC975F: That's where her heart is. All I can do is cheer her on from the sidelines.
DT_Dialogue_Etna_OldTemplate_Production.748F02944FE1D17F5403038180A6F666: There's something truly special about this community. Everyone's so supportive, it warms my heart.
DT_Dialogue_Etna_OldTemplate_Production.46090E1046887EA568322EB5F59E0793: There's this stubborn coral patch that won't grow. Got any tips?
DT_Dialogue_Etna_OldTemplate_Production.5EA6210848B80914EE915187D6448D78: This cooler current reminds me of the old tales from the deep trenches
DT_Dialogue_Etna_OldTemplate_Production.0E9E8B8E4D19030A188246BCDF3452B2: Took a 'me-time' trip into a cave and got lost. Boom! Stumbled upon a secret coral garden.//Can't find it again, though. Oh well.
DT_Dialogue_Etna_OldTemplate_Production.1416704A4B0C3B9DB01AD9A8B295A8D4: Tried a new hybrid sea-fern. Was hoping for a sparkly blue, got more of a loud green.//Oh, well, adds character.
DT_Dialogue_Etna_OldTemplate_Production.81A95BB14060E08D5314A9B31A3D2083: Well, maybe waking up to the sun shining...yeah? I can't even imagine how you land-dwellers handle that heat.//Do you actually enjoy that?
DT_Dialogue_Etna_OldTemplate_Production.6F20D5ED41B2389A194844BB62C7D221: Whipped up a seaweed casserole today. If it's a hit, it'll be on the weekly menu; if not, well, we'll just call it 'experimental'.
DT_Dialogue_Etna_OldTemplate_Production.15A4422A4A103E0679987FAE6B1B5B93: Winter seaweeds have such rich flavors. I've been experimenting with some new recipes!
DT_Dialogue_Etna_OldTemplate_Production.9A7F707C4277720FCFDEA798DFFA3763: You know, there's a secret recipe to my seaweed soup. But, between you and me, it's all about the love you put into it.
DT_Dialogue_Etna_OldTemplate_Production.06F42A2E45B55C3607F91D90346F1121: You'd be surprised how calming cooking can be. It's like yoga, but without all the poses.

DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.202_Text: *shivering* I need to stand near the fireplace.//<portrait=sad>I’m not built for this type of weather.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.203_Text: *shivering* I need to stand near the fireplace.//<portrait=sad>I’m not built for this type of weather.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.266_Text: *sighs* I want to lead a life that’s worth telling stories about too.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.364_Text: <NpcName>Alice</> has a great collection of boots.//She told me I could borrow them if I’d like. But I don’t know.//<portrait=concerned>I don’t want to be a bother.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.349_Text: <NpcName>Antonio</> brought us a crate of green smoothies last week.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.263_Text: <NpcName>Betty</> and I have this little ritual.//<portrait=normal>Every Sunday, one of us bakes a little cake, and we share it!
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.336_Text: <NpcName>Betty’s</> always teasing me because I talk about you so much.//<portrait=blushing>What am I supposed to do, though?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.150_Text: <NpcName>Bree</> makes a delicious shredded jackfruit pie.//<portrait=happy>Oh, don’t worry! It’s vegan, in case you are.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.151_Text: <NpcName>Bree</> makes a delicious shredded jackfruit pie.//<portrait=happy>Oh, don’t worry! It’s vegan, in case you are.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.152_Text: <NpcName>Bree</> makes a delicious shredded jackfruit pie.//<portrait=happy>Oh, don’t worry! It’s vegan, in case you are.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.171_Text: <NpcName>Frank</> and <NpcName>Betty</> still have the best red velvet cake in town, though.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.233_Text: <NpcName>Frank</> and <NpcName>Betty</> still have the best red velvet cake in town, though.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.51_Text: <NpcName>Macy</> is the one who has a cool pet lobster, not me.//Well, it’s not much of a pet, really. More like a rescue.//<portrait=happy>Pretty eccentric gal, she is.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.52_Text: <NpcName>Macy</> loves pizza and wine.//She said they remind her of home.//I think she’s pretty close with her folks. She talks about home a lot.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.341_Text: <NpcName>Raj</> has their own coffee shop.//<portrait=happy>It’s pretty neat, I think. They always give me a discount too.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.213_Text: <NpcName>Sam</> always insists we use only the best ingredients.//He believes you can taste quality, and I kind of agree with him on that.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.214_Text: <NpcName>Sam</> is a great boss. He may seem off-putting at first, but he’s actually really kind.//<portrait=concerned>He is direct, though. Yeah.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.250_Text: <NpcName>Sam</> needed a baker, I needed a job.//<portrait=happy>And here we are!
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.225_Text: <NpcName>Sam’s</> best quality is that he’s direct. Other than that, he’s very…//<portrait=concerned>You know. Umm…
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.108_Text: <NpcName>Theo</> showed me a handful of jade a long time ago.//<portrait=happy>He told me he found it in an old treasure chest.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.110_Text: <NpcName>Theo</> showed me a handful of jade a long time ago.//<portrait=happy>He told me he found it in an old treasure chest.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.362_Text: <NpcName>Valentina</> and I made beanies last week.//She’s good at it. She even made extra for her grandparents.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.273_Text: <PlayerName>$player</>, do you like the rain?//<portrait=normal>I do. It casts everything in a new light, and it smells great.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.276_Text: <PlayerName>$player</>, do you like the rain?//<portrait=normal>I do. It casts everything in a new light, and it smells great.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.251_Text: <PlayerName>$player</>, what’s your favorite kind of cookie?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.239_Text: <PlayerName>$player</>, you came from Pokyo, right? That’s so interesting! What was it like in the big city?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.173_Text: A beautiful analogy to remind us not to judge one another, I think.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.178_Text: A beautiful analogy to remind us not to judge one another, I think.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.210_Text: A beautiful analogy to remind us not to judge one another, I think.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.326_Text: A day that I get to see my friends is a day well spent, in my book.//Like now. I get to see you. It’s a good day.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.77_Text: Ah, I see. I’m too scared to watch thrillers. One time, <NpcName>Suki</> had a thriller party, and we all watched this movie about a madman in a mask, raging around with a chainsaw.//I had to sleep with my lights on for the next two nights.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.234_Text: Ah, it’s nice to go out every once in a while and not have to cook.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.79_Text: Ah, my kind of friend! I love romantic movies too. We should totally have a red velvet party and binge on rom-coms sometime.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.102_Text: Also, I don’t want to buy ingredients for pies that nobody will eat, just to improve my baking skills.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.96_Text: Also, I don’t want to buy ingredients for pies that nobody will eat, just to improve my baking skills.//Seems a little wasteful.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.22_Text: Also, I get to come out of the kitchen smelling like cookies.//<portrait=normal>Who doesn’t love that?
