DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.269_Text: Although… Come to think of it, that’s not a bad idea!//<portrait=happy>I’ll talk to <NpcName>Sam</>.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.281_Text: And it’s generally cheaper that way too, which is a huge plus for me.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.283_Text: And it’s wonderful to see that farm flourishing again.//<portrait=normal>You’re doing great.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.301_Text: Any plans for tomorrow?//Mine is work as usual.//Can’t leave the bakery too much, or else we’ll start losing customers.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.72_Text: Are you done for the day?//I don’t know how big a farmer’s workload is.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.236_Text: Are you foraging for wild mushrooms too?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.117_Text: Are you going to plant flowers on your farm?//If you do, just don’t give any to <NPCName>Charles</>. He has some sort of pollen sensitivity.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.245_Special: Attend a performance at a prestigious theatre.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.26_Text: Aww, you were at Sam’s looking for me?//<portrait=annoyed>Oh no. Wednesday is my day off.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.13_Text: Aww, you were at Sam’s looking for me?//<portrait=normal>Today is my day off, actually.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.277_Text: Baking is a science as much as it is an art. It takes a lot of technical expertise to make the perfect bread.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.279_Text: Baking pays the bills, but it’s also something I’m passionate about!//<portrait=happy>So that’s a win-win.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.181_Text: Be careful out there. The path might be slippery.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.190_Text: Be careful out there. The path might be slippery.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.138_Text: Better make sure my heater works. The inn’s central heating isn’t warm enough for me.//<portrait=surprised>Oh, but don’t tell <NPCName>Suki</>! She can be scary sometimes.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.238_Text: But I’m grateful I have all of you as my family.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.278_Text: But don’t let that discourage you!//Learning from your mistakes is half the fun.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.339_Text: But it’s not a good solution.//<portrait=sad>I end up with a lot of unfinished projects.//<portrait=annoyed>I like the starting out part. Following through isn’t my biggest strength.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.64_Text: Can you make truffle oil on your farm?//<portrait=happy>The mayor loves it, by the way. He said it’s the secret ingredient in Carol’s stew.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.70_Text: Can you make truffle oil on your farm?//<portrait=happy>The mayor loves it, by the way. He said it’s the secret ingredient in Carol’s stew.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.118_Text: Coral Island is just so beautiful in the Spring. I’m glad I moved here.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.347_Text: Crowds don’t bother me.//<portrait=happy>I like them, actually.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.61_Text: Decorative pillows are so expensive. That’s why I make my own.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.237_Text: Do you ever feel like you’re doing a lot, but no matter what, it’s just not enough?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.297_Text: Do you just walk for the sake of taking a walk?//<portrait=normal>I always see you around the island.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.257_Text: Do you like to go to the library?//Even if you’re not much of a reader, <NpcName>Millie</> has a lot of great insights.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.73_Text: Do you like to visit the museum?//I see you go in and out of there pretty often.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.18_Text: Do you smell that? It’s not perfume.//<portrait=normal>You’re smelling the cookies I baked.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.312_Text: Do you think I could sell these clothes?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.3_Text: Do you think they’ll ever open another bakery in town?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.5_Text: Do you think they’ll ever open another bakery in town?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.201_Text: Does it snow back in Pokyo, <PlayerName>$player</>?//I’ve never been there.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.86_Text: Errr, no. I don’t sing if I don’t have to. I bet you sound good, though. I’ll have to hear you sometime.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.133_Text: Fall is one of the reasons I decided to move here. It’s the most beautiful thing I’ve ever seen.//<portrait=happy>And who wouldn’t want to wake up to see that every day?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.129_Text: Fall is so pretty, isn’t it? Back home, the trees never looked like this.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.43_Text: For some reason, I always crave red velvet cake on Fridays.//<portrait=normal>You know, maybe it’s like a celebration. Maybe.//<portrait=annoyed>In my mind, red velvet cake marks the end of the week.//I don’t know.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.320_Text: For some reason, you’ve been on my mind a lot lately.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.244_Special: Go on an ecotour of a beautiful wilderness.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.185_Text: Going somewhere?//Nobody likes getting wet. Please excuse me.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.194_Text: Going somewhere?//Nobody likes getting wet. Please excuse me.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.252_Text: Good choice! I’ll have to remember that.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.253_Text: Good choice! I’ll have to remember that.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.219_Text: Growing up, my parents told me if you have people who care about you, you have a good life.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.222_Text: Growing up, my parents told me if you have people who care about you, you have a good life.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.127_Text: Have you seen those cute little white flowers growing everywhere?//What are those? I think they’re daisies.//Are they daisies, you think?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.44_Text: Hmm. Do you think there’s, like, a green velvet cake?//<portrait=happy>Should I try making one with lettuce?//<portrait=annoyed>Doesn’t sound very appealing, to be honest.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.289_Text: Hmm. Let’s see. I got a couple of them from my childhood friends.//They probably cost next to nothing, but they’re very special to me.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.92_Text: Hmm. Let’s see. Pineapple upside-down cake, pumpkin pie, doughnuts! Hmm. What else?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.12_Text: Hmm. Yeah, there are plenty of trees and rocks for them to take shelter under.//<portrait=sad>You’re right.//But still.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.8_Text: Hmm. Yeah, there are plenty of trees and rocks for them to take shelter under.//<portrait=sad>You’re right.//But still.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.343_Text: Hopefully, <NpcName>Ratih</> has some orchids.//I’d love to buy some.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.104_Text: How’s your first Spring on Coral Island so far?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.291_Text: How’s your week so far?//<portrait=concerned>You must be pretty busy, huh? I wish I could come over to help out a bit. Take some weight off your shoulders.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.211_Text: I always get all sappy during Winter. Aww…
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.174_Text: I always get all sappy in Winter. Argh…
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.175_Text: I always get all sappy in Winter. Argh…
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.176_Text: I always get all sappy in Winter. Argh…
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.323_Text: I always give <NpcName>Macy</> beanies for her birthday.//<portrait=concerned>Do you think she has too many beanies already?//Should I make her something else next year?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.91_Text: I can bake more things, you know. Not just cookies and bread.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.169_Text: I can only imagine how cozy the nights are at the farm this time of year. What a perfect way to end your day.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.164_Text: I can only imagine how misty the mornings are at the farm this time of year. What a perfect way to start your day.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.167_Text: I can only imagine how misty the mornings are at the farm this time of year. What a perfect way to start your day.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.101_Text: I can’t just start baking a whole bunch of cakes and pies at the inn.//I mean, who’s going to eat them?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.95_Text: I can’t just start baking a whole bunch of cakes and pies at the inn.//I mean, who’s going to eat them?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.116_Text: I can’t wait for the Cherry Blossom Festival. It’ll be so much fun. I might try my luck with balap karung this year. I don’t know! Maybeeeee!
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.368_Text: I catch <NPCName>Surya</> talking in my mother tongue sometimes. Well, <Italic>our</> mother tongue...
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.359_Text: I could never afford her style.//<portrait=happy>Maybe someday?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.314_Text: I couldn’t wear it anymore. It got all soggy and lost its shape.//<portrait=sad>Went straight into the trash. What a waste.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.330_Text: I crocheted this scarf myself.//<portrait=happy>I got the yarn online. It was on sale.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.170_Text: I don’t eat out much. I don’t know. I guess the dishes I actually love, I can make myself.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.232_Text: I don’t eat out much.//I don’t know. I guess the dishes I actually love, I can make myself.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.268_Text: I don’t have any free samples.//<portrait=concerned>We don’t do that here. Sorry!
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.307_Text: I don’t know for sure. I haven’t brought it up to her yet. But like…//…I’m afraid she might shut down my idea.//<portrait=sad>I’m a bit scared of her. She can be… Yeah.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.310_Text: I don’t know if I could live on a farm, but I’m not writing it off just yet.//Because who knows, I might like some space away from all this noise.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.316_Text: I don’t know. You got me all nervous.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.318_Text: I don’t know. You got me all nervous.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.82_Text: I don’t really know <NpcName>Zarah</> that well. She loves cookies, though.//She buys them in bulk.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.85_Text: I don’t really know <NpcName>Zarah</> that well. She loves cookies, though.//She buys them in bulk.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.228_Text: I don’t really like tidying up.//It’s a waste of time, and let’s face it, it’s going to get messy again anyway.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.35_Text: I don’t think I could ever do that.//<portrait=sad>Not brave enough.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.54_Text: I don’t think I could ever do that.//<portrait=sad>Not brave enough.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.137_Text: I don’t think I’ll ever get bored of snow. I didn’t grow up with it, so I always find it mesmerizing.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.299_Text: I don’t want to make this about me, but I really like talking to you.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.311_Text: I enjoy making clothes for myself, but I’m not sure about making clothes for a living.//Baking, yeah. I can do that every day, but <Italic>batiking</>? Hmm. Not sure.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.11_Text: I feel so awful for stray animals.//<portrait=sad>I wish we could build them little houses in the woods.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.7_Text: I feel so awful for stray animals.//<portrait=sad>I wish we could build them little houses in the woods.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.317_Text: I forgot what I was going to say. Sorry.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.315_Text: I forgot what I was going to say. Sorry.//<portrait=blushing>Is it hot in here? My cheeks are getting red. Oh my!
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.321_Text: I gave <NpcName>Macy</> a beanie that I sewed for her birthday in Spring, but I’ve never seen her wearing it.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.34_Text: I gotta say, I envy your courage for taking a leap of faith.//<portrait=concerned>You moved to an island and totally changed career paths.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.53_Text: I gotta say, I envy your courage for taking a leap of faith.//<portrait=concerned>You moved to an island and totally changed career paths.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.122_Text: I grew up with this kind of weather, hot and humid basically all year long.//So yeah, I’m used to it, but working in front of the oven in this weather is still…something.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.66_Text: I had a slice of bread for a quick breakfast this morning.//And some fruit from the kitchen.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.135_Text: I hardly ever baked pumpkin pie until I moved here. I was missing out!
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.227_Text: I have extra food in the kitchen if you’re hungry.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.15_Text: I have lots of dreams. I don’t know where to begin.//<portrait=normal>For instance, I’d love to open my own bakery someday, once I master pies and cakes.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.324_Text: I have work tomorrow, but I’m free afterward.//<portrait=normal>I’ll be at Fishensips if you want to chat. Or we could meet up at the inn. You know, the Tavern can get super crowded.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.363_Text: I haven’t seen <NpcName>Valentina</> wearing her beanie yet.//<portrait=happy>Maybe she’ll wear it in Winter.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.188_Text: I hope I can borrow a couple of extra blankets from <NPCName>Suki</> tonight.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.197_Text: I hope I can borrow a couple of extra blankets from <NPCName>Suki</> tonight.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.327_Text: I hope you consider me a friend too.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.143_Text: I kind of want to play in the snow in the park with the kids. <NPCName>Valentina</> always looks like she’s having so much fun playing outside.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.156_Text: I know, I know. I sound like a brat, but it gets so humid, my hair doubles in volume.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.145_Text: I know, I know.//<portrait=concerned>I sound like a brat, but it gets so humid, my hair doubles in volume.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.14_Text: I like to spend my days off hanging around in the park or hiking somewhere pretty.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.259_Text: I like to take inspiration from the beach sometimes.//<portrait=happy>The shells, the sea… So much material.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.258_Text: I like to visit just to get her talking about something.//She seems so chill, but she can get really fired up.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.305_Text: I live with a lot of people, and I still get lonely sometimes.//I can only imagine how hard it must be for you.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.313_Text: I lost a hat a long time ago and found it by the park next to a snowman.//<portrait=sad>I wonder how it got there.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.158_Text: I love Summer, but I’m ready for it to cool down a little.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.30_Text: I love how we can just talk and talk about baking.//And red velvet.//Turns out we have a lot in common!
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.46_Text: I love how we can just talk and talk about baking.//And red velvet.//Turns out we have a lot in common!
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.267_Text: I love it here.//<portrait=normal>It’s so peaceful but so full of life too.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.136_Text: I love snow, you know. It’s so fascinating, the way it’s soft and fluffy but also cold and clumpy.//It feels magical.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.160_Text: I love summer, but I’m ready for it to cool down a little.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.28_Text: I love the lake in Winter, when everything is still and frozen.//It looks so clean and pretty.//Mesmerizing to look at.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.270_Text: I love the way Sam’s smells. Most stores smell weird, but we keep this place spick-and-span!
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.87_Text: I love to read about traveling, to learn what the world is like out there. Maybe one day I’ll go and see for myself.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.89_Text: I love to read about traveling, to learn what the world is like out there. Maybe one day I’ll go and see for myself.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.215_Text: I made a fruit tart today.//I used fresh blueberries, but you can use literally any fruit.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.224_Text: I mean, look at this town.//<portrait=happy>We have a tavern right there.//The beach is that way.//<portrait=normal>And we have a fully stocked library right there.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.126_Text: I might enter the swimming contest next week. It’ll be fun, even if I’m not a great swimmer. Especially compared to <NPCName>Sunny</>!//<portrait=surprised>He doesn’t move that fast when he’s walking!
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.105_Text: I often find wasabi growing by the lake this time of year.//<portrait=happy>Have you found any yet?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.106_Text: I often find wasabi growing by the lake this time of year.//<portrait=happy>Have you found any yet?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.32_Text: I opened my window this morning, and the mist woke me right up.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.119_Text: I prefer Spring to Summer. But if we’re talking favorites, it would definitely be Winter.//It’s more bearable working in front of the oven in Winter.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.355_Text: I ran into <NpcName>Betty</> this morning.//She was gardening over at the monument park, the one in front of the laboratory.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.360_Text: I ran into the mayor the other day.//<portrait=surprised>He was wearing a cactus on his hat.//<portrait=normal>No, I’m not joking.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.335_Text: I really like your outfit today. It’s so springy, you know?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.333_Text: I really like your outfit today. It’s so you, you know?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.345_Text: I saw a couple of seals swimming earlier!
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.329_Text: I see you at the library pretty often, so I assume you’re a big reader.//<portrait=concerned>I’m not a big reader, so…
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.59_Text: I sew after work.//Ah, for fun. The inn has a community sewing machine in the lobby, so why not?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.319_Text: I stayed up late last night, thinking about you…
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.99_Text: I think I’ll go see <NpcName>Betty</> at the Tavern tomorrow. Why?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.282_Text: I think having a new face in town has been good for Starlet.//Fresh perspectives make everything better.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.141_Text: I usually don’t notice how much heat the oven at Sam’s radiates until it’s Summer.//<PlayerName>$player</>, it’s really hot!
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.134_Text: I want to bake some pumpkin pies. Might as well since pumpkins are in season, right?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.344_Text: I wonder if she’s at the dock today.//What day is this?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.69_Text: I work from noon to five on Sundays.//What about you?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.21_Text: I work regular hours today.//No big deal, though. I like baking.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.47_Text: I work regular hours today.//No big deal, though. I like baking.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.306_Text: If <NpcName>Suki</> allowed it, I’d totally keep strays in my room.//But I don’t think she’d be cool with that.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.308_Text: If <NpcName>Suki</> allowed it, I’d totally keep strays in my room.//But I don’t think she’d be cool with that.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.243_Text: If you could travel anywhere in the world, what would you do first?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.261_Text: Isn’t the lake beautiful in Winter?//So placid. So still.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.128_Text: Isn’t this the best season for cookies and tea?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.131_Text: It is a bit chilly right now, but I much prefer it to the heat of Summer.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.241_Text: It sounds amazing. I bet you’d be a great tour guide!
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.287_Text: It took me a while to make it. But the pattern is pretty, don’t you think? All the work was worth it, in my book.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.271_Text: It’s a shame to stay inside all day when the weather’s like this.//<portrait=concerned>But I’m so busy, what choice do I have?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.274_Text: It’s a shame to stay inside all day when the weather’s like this.//<portrait=concerned>But I’m so busy, what choice do I have?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.207_Text: It’s either fluffy or slippery this time of year. You really have to be careful going back, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.132_Text: It’s getting colder, isn’t it? I guess it’s a sign Winter is just around the corner.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.198_Text: It’s getting late, <PlayerName>$player</>. You should really go home and rest.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.189_Text: It’s getting late, <PlayerName>$player</>.//You should really go home and rest.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.264_Text: It’s important to have friends who share your interests and to make time for them.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.294_Text: It’s nice that the inn has a communal kitchen.//<portrait=concerned>I think it’s only for the residents, though.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.346_Text: It’s nice to see you relaxing, <PlayerName>$Player</>!
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.125_Text: It’s not bad living at the inn, on the second floor especially. Yeah, it does get really hot in Summer because of the broken air conditioner.//<portrait=normal>But after sunset, you open the window, and the salty breeze is just divine!
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.352_Text: It’s such a nice day I thought I’d spend it outside.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.342_Text: It’s very kind of them, but honestly, I feel bad going there now.//I don’t want them to keep selling at a discount.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.340_Text: I’d love to pick up some peonies for my room.//<portrait=concerned><NpcName>Ratih</> didn’t have any the last time I checked.//<NpcName>Suki</> said <NpcName>Ben</> might have some, but I don’t wanna go all the way there to check.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.280_Text: I’m a real believer in the power of DIY.//It’s so fulfilling to make things yourself!
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.16_Text: I’m glad <NpcName>Randy</> is fighting to keep our school open, even though we only have four students.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.37_Text: I’m glad <NpcName>Randy</> is fighting to keep our school open, even though we only have four students.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.155_Text: I’m grateful for everything I have, but living by the sea isn’t as fun as it sounds. Especially in Summer.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.144_Text: I’m grateful for everything I have, but living by the sea isn’t as fun as it sounds.//Especially in Summer.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.357_Text: I’m not big on yoga or working out in general, to be honest.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.182_Text: I’m not going to hike today. I’m afraid I might slip.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.191_Text: I’m not going to hike today. I’m afraid I might slip.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.112_Text: I’m not sure if you’ve noticed, but the grass kind of changes color in Summer.//Nature is beautiful, isn’t it?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.354_Text: I’m sewing a new pillowcase.//Thought maybe my room could use a bit more color.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.159_Text: I’m so ready for some green tea and cookie weather.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.161_Text: I’m so ready for some green tea and cookie weather.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.220_Text: I’m starting to see what they meant.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.223_Text: I’m starting to see what they meant.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.168_Text: I’m turning on my heater tonight. It’s starting to get too cold for me. The central heat at the inn just isn’t cutting it.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.249_Text: I’ve always been interested in baking!//I only started doing it professionally a few years ago, though.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.358_Text: I’ve seen <NpcName>Leah</> doing yoga here a couple of times. Sometimes at the beach too.//<portrait=happy>She always looks so graceful.//<portrait=normal>I love her hair. And her wardrobe! Her wardrobe is to die for.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.42_Text: I’ve tried copying <NpcName>Frank’s</> recipe many times, but mine is never as good.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.50_Text: I’ve tried copying <NpcName>Frank’s</> recipe many times, but mine is never as good.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.63_Text: Just working. Then I’ll watch some TV, then rest.//<portrait=concerned>Sounds so dull when I say it out loud.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.17_Text: Let’s just hope the government doesn’t close down the school the first chance they get.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.38_Text: Let’s just hope the government doesn’t close down the school the first chance they get.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.302_Text: Lots of our customers are looking for mooncakes.//I tell them we don’t sell them.<NpcName>Sam</> won’t budge. They cost too much to make.//Anyway, I tell them to try Fishensips.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.60_Text: Lots of things. But I mostly sew decorative pillows.//<portrait=happy>They’re gorgeous and easy to make.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.240_Special: Loud, smelly, and full of tourists.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.353_Text: Maybe I’ll fill up my water bottle with some iced tea later.//<portrait=happy>Hmm. Yeah, that sounds good!
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.68_Text: Maybe farming. Or swimming with dolphins.//<portrait=normal>Go hiking up the mountain and see the stars up close. I haven’t done any of those things yet.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.292_Text: Maybe we could just relax and watch TV together one of these days.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.88_Text: Maybe, maybe, maybe. With the never-ending bills, it’s hard to know when that might be.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.90_Text: Maybe, maybe, maybe. With the never-ending bills, it’s hard to know when that might be.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.157_Text: My favorite festivals are the Animal Festival and the Harvest Festival!//I like the Cherry Blossom Festival potluck too. It’s just that it’s always so early in Spring. It’s still too cold to be outside all day.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.285_Text: No, no, it’s okay. I don’t mind. At all.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.57_Text: Not just energy.//It takes a lot of patience and dedication, I’m sure.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.235_Text: Now, this is my kind of music!
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.83_Text: Oh gosh. I keep running into you, <PlayerName>$player</>. What a fun thing to happen!
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.75_Text: Oh gosh. I keep running into you, <PlayerName>$player</>. What a fun thing to happen.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.217_Text: Oh gosh. One with big windows!//<portrait=normal>And a bunch of fancy paintings.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.230_Text: Oh gosh. One with big windows!//<portrait=normal>And a bunch of fancy paintings.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.183_Text: Oh my! Stop teasing.//Not a joke. I was being serious.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.192_Text: Oh my! Stop teasing.//Not a joke. I was being serious.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.180_Text: Oh yes! A party where we all can eat fancy food and sip fine drinks. Oh, and everybody has a great time. That would be fabulous.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.78_Text: Oh yes! We should watch a stand-up comedian together sometime.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.33_Text: Oh! I just love your style!//<portrait=normal>I like to pay attention to people’s outfits. You know, for inspiration.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.98_Text: Oh, <PlayerName>$player</>! It’s you again. How fun.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.19_Text: Oh, I don’t mind at all! I love baking.//<portrait=normal>Besides, I get to keep some for myself.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.284_Text: Oh, I don’t think I’ve ever been this close to you…
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.4_Text: Oh, I’m not worried!//<portrait=normal>I think it would be amazing. I’d love to meet other bakers.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.6_Text: Oh, I’m not worried!//<portrait=normal>I think it would be amazing. I’d love to meet other bakers.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.153_Text: Oh, almost forget to tell you.//<portrait=normal>Did you know you can find shallots around the lake this time of year?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.163_Text: Oh, come on! You’re telling me you’ve never gone out of your way to find a pile of crunchy leaves just to step on them?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.166_Text: Oh, come on! You’re telling me you’ve never gone out of your way to find a pile of crunchy leaves just to step on them?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.74_Text: Oh, gotcha. Me neither. It’s too quiet for my taste.//<portrait=concerned>It would put me right to sleep.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.1_Text: Oh, nice to meet you too!//<portrait=happy>My name’s <NPCName>Everest</>.//<portrait=normal><NPCName>Eva</> for short.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.244_Text: Oh, that sounds amazing! Conservation is so important too, especially in this day and age. Good pick!
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.288_Text: Oh, these bracelets? Not all of them are special.//But, like, some of them are.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.242_Text: Oh. Ha ha. I can understand that.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.65_Text: Oh. Haven’t you heard? Carol is Mayor <NpcName>Connor’s</> late wife.//<portrait=sad>May she rest in peace.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.71_Text: Oh. Haven’t you heard? Carol is Mayor <NpcName>Connor’s</> late wife.//<portrait=sad>May she rest in peace.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.255_Text: Oh. Well, um, I’ll…keep that in mind!
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.240_Text: Oh. Well, um, I’m glad you’re here now!
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.265_Text: Older people have the most amazing stories! I suppose when you live that long, it’s bound to happen.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.179_Text: One day, I want to throw fancy parties like <NpcName>Bree’s</> annual dinner party. Ah, you know! With a dress code and an elaborate theme and stuff.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.246_Text: Ooh, I’m hungry just thinking about it. Great pick!
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.298_Text: Oops, sorry if that sounded harsh.//<portrait=normal>I was admiring you, actually. Walking is a good hobby.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.325_Text: Or we could chill at the beach. It might not be a bad idea.//<portrait=happy>Don’t worry about the cold! We could always go inside…umm…to my room or something.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.113_Text: Peonies are the prettiest flowers in the world, don’t you think?//<portrait=normal>Their blossoms are so big, and their colors are so vivid.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.351_Text: Please have a seat.//Make yourself at home.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.94_Text: Practice does make perfect. Maybe if <NpcName>Sam</> started selling other things, like pies, I could finally get good at baking pies too.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.247_Text: Really? I can’t imagine not wanting to see the world. But okay.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.254_Text: Really? Me too! Red velvet everything for me, forever.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.322_Text: She probably doesn’t like it. What do you think?//<portrait=concerned>Well, I guess you’re right. It’s still Summer. Maybe she’ll wear it when the weather cools off.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.208_Text: Should I build a snowman today?//I mean, this is definitely the weather for it.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.123_Text: So glad I picked this blouse today.//It’s nice and breezy!
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.62_Text: So true, they are impractical.//<portrait=normal>But they look so pretty! Can’t help myself.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.216_Text: Someday I want to have a big house with a big kitchen to chop vegetables in. You know?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.229_Text: Someday I want to have a big house with a big kitchen to chop vegetables in. You know?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.218_Text: Starlet is such a beautiful town, and I think people truly care about each other here.//<portrait=happy>I can feel it.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.221_Text: Starlet is such a beautiful town, and I think people truly care about each other here.//<portrait=happy>I can feel it.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.309_Text: Stephen is different. He isn’t really loud or even the walking-around type, you know?//I think that’s why she doesn’t have a problem with him.//<portrait=normal>I mean, Stephen <Italic>is</> a lobster.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.29_Text: Sundays are special for me.//<portrait=happy>I hang out at the Tavern with <NpcName>Betty</> after work. Girls’ night in.//Just a couple of bakers, chatting the night away.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.45_Text: Sundays are special for me.//<portrait=happy>I hang out at the Tavern with <NpcName>Betty</> after work. Girls’ night in.//Just a couple of bakers, chatting the night away.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.124_Text: The Beach Cleanup Festival happens right in front of the inn.//I wake up to people getting the festival ready. On the 27th of Summer, of course! Not today. Ha ha!
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.130_Text: The Harvest Festival here is so cool.//It’s nothing like the one we had when I was growing up.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.212_Text: The baked goods here are made fresh every day.//Don’t you worry, <PlayerName>$player</>. I can vouch for that because I bake everything myself.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.107_Text: The beach is still a little cold.//Have you ever found anything pretty while diving?//<portrait=surprised>You have?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.109_Text: The beach is still a little cold.//Have you ever found anything pretty while diving?//<portrait=surprised>You have?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.147_Text: The best thing is when I find jackfruit.//<portrait=normal>I always share some with <NpcName>Bree</>, the wine lady. She loves to make a fancy meal out of it.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.149_Text: The best thing is when I find jackfruit.//<portrait=normal>I always share some with <NpcName>Bree</>, the wine lady. She loves to make a fancy meal out of it.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.361_Text: The cactus had a little flower on top of it. Gosh! It was so adorable.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.24_Text: The food here is so yum.//Lodeh, popiah, fried rice… I’ll have to teach myself to make those one of these days.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.39_Text: The food here makes me miss my parents.//Ah, you too, huh?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.366_Text: The frog boat from the Tree Planting Festival reminds me of the jukung boats from back home.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.121_Text: The inn doesn’t have a good air conditioner.//It sort of turns on and off by itself sometimes. My room can get pretty hot.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.162_Text: The leaves were so crunchy when I walked to work this morning. They were satisfying to step on.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.165_Text: The leaves were so crunchy when I walked to work this morning. They were satisfying to step on.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.41_Text: The red velvet cake at Fishensips is so yum!//I don’t know what I’d do if <NpcName>Frank</> stopped making it.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.49_Text: The red velvet cake at Fishensips is so yum!//I don’t know what I’d do if <NpcName>Frank</> stopped making it.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.256_Text: The smell of fresh baked goods can really liven up a place.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.115_Text: The snow melts so fast.//It’s already gone, and Spring just started!
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.10_Text: The vineyard view alone! Wow!//<portrait=happy>And right next to the community center.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.272_Text: The weather report said it would rain all day.//<portrait=concerned>And it was right! It’s still going out there.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.275_Text: The weather report said it would rain all day.//<portrait=concerned>And it was right! It’s still going out there.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.67_Text: There are still things I want to see in this world.//Like, I’m sure there’s more to life than baking cookies.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.48_Text: There’s nothing else I can do around here, anyway. So I might as well bake.//<portrait=happy>Besides, baking is fun.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.139_Text: These are the days when I’m super glad I’m a baker. I have my own personal heater at work!
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.356_Text: They have a yoga class here on the weekend.//Right there, by those benches.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.286_Text: This shirt is my own creation. I worked on the batik myself.//Borrowed the tools in the community center, got some dye online. That’s it.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.204_Text: Today was a long day! With the snow and all.//<portrait=sad>Good gosh.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.114_Text: Too bad they only bloom in the Spring.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.246_Special: Travel the continent, trying all the foods I can.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.296_Text: Traveling conquests! Gosh. Ha ha. I’ll bring the cookies.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.36_Text: Ugh, sorry. I don’t know why I said that.//I hope I didn’t bum you out.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.55_Text: Ugh, sorry. I don’t know why I said that.//I hope I didn’t bum you out.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.80_Text: Ugh. My room is such a mess right now. I should clean it up.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.103_Text: Ugh. So much negativity. Sorry for snapping at you like that, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.97_Text: Ugh. So much negativity. Sorry for snapping at you like that, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.304_Text: Umm, it must get pretty lonely up there alone on your farm, huh?//<portrait=concerned>You poor thing.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.27_Text: Umm, no baking for me today.//<portrait=normal>I’d rather spend my day off hanging around in the park or knitting something pretty.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.226_Text: Umm… <NpcName>Sam</> is straightforward, honest.//<portrait=annoyed>Frank, direct.//Did I say “direct” already?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.200_Text: Umm… I don’t know why I keep telling you that.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.81_Text: Unless she needs to pick up some groceries, I rarely see <NpcName>Zarah</> in the shop.//It seems she’s not a big vegetable buyer either, ’cause I mostly see her buying a bunch of flour and oil.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.84_Text: Unless she needs to pick up some groceries, I rarely see <NpcName>Zarah</> in the shop.//It seems she’s not a big vegetable buyer either, ’cause I mostly see her buying a bunch of flour and oil.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.2_Text: We don’t see too many new faces, so your arrival is great for the town.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.350_Text: We still have some in the fridge. I think the only people drinking them are the twins.//I haven’t seen him drinking any either.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.93_Text: Well, if I had to choose, cookies are probably my best baked goods. I make them all the time, so I think I might have maxed out my cookie-baking skills.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.331_Text: We’re lucky the area in front of the inn doesn’t pile up with snow too much.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.120_Text: What do you think would be the perfect baked good for Spring?//<portrait=happy>For me, probably something colorful like a fruit tart. So yum!
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.9_Text: What if someone built a big mansion where the recycling center is?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.76_Text: What type of movies do you like?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.260_Text: What’s your farmhouse like inside?//<portrait=happy>I’d love to see it sometime!//<portrait=normal>You can learn a lot about someone from their home.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.146_Text: When I have time, I’ll forage around the woodland for fresh Summer veggies and flowers.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.148_Text: When I have time, I’ll forage around the woodland for fresh Summer veggies and flowers.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.172_Text: When the snow blankets the town like this, it’s hard to tell the buildings apart. Until you go inside, you don’t know whose house it really is.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.177_Text: When the snow blankets the town like this, it’s hard to tell the buildings apart. Until you go inside, you don’t know whose house it really is.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.209_Text: When the snow blankets the town like this, it’s hard to tell the buildings apart.//Until you go inside, you don’t know whose house it really is.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.338_Text: When things get hard, I like to start a new project to unwind.//Creating takes my mind off things.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.303_Text: Who knows? Maybe if enough people ask for them at Fishensips, <NpcName>Frank</> might start selling them.//<portrait=normal>I’d buy them!
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.186_Text: Why do rainy nights always make me feel sooooo melancholy…
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.195_Text: Why do rainy nights always make me feel sooooo melancholy…
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.293_Text: Wild fruits are great food source.//You can gather them around the lake and make pies or meals out of them.//<portrait=happy>That’s what I do. Saves me a ton of money.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.142_Text: Winter is the perfect time to slow down a little.//Reflect on the year and stuff.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.262_Text: Winter makes everything look so different, doesn’t it?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.111_Text: With Summer right around the corner, it must be a busy time for you as a farmer, huh?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.245_Text: Wow, what I wouldn’t give. Those shows must be breathtaking. Good pick!
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.205_Text: Wow. In snow like this, you can really see everyone’s footprints!//Which ones are yours?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.206_Text: Wow. In snow like this, you can really see everyone’s footprints!//Which ones are yours?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.367_Text: Yesterday, I made fried rice for dinner. It was so simple and tasty.//In my native language, we call it 'Nasi Goreng'.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.154_Text: You can find shallots around the lake this time of year, you know! Have you found any yet?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.290_Text: You can make so much with so few ingredients, once you have a kitchen.//My trick is to forage around, then turn the harvest into a whole meal.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.348_Text: You have sand on your cheeks.//<portrait=normal>How did it get there?
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.140_Text: You look all nice and cozy today.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.56_Text: You must be busy on Mondays, huh?//Running a farm as big as yours must take a lot of energy.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.248_Text: You must have a really interesting perspective on the world!//<portrait=happy>You went from a big city to a farm on an island and all that.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.300_Text: You’re always so kind to me. I feel appreciated.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.337_Text: You’re interesting! And fun to talk to!//<portrait=happy>And cute!//<portrait=blushing>And…um…never mind.
DT_Dialogue_Eva_Production.295_Text: You’re so brave and adventurous.//We need to hang out more, so you can tell me all about your conquests.

DT_Dialogue_Goddess.3_Text: Continue on, and the island shall be saved.
DT_Dialogue_Goddess.1_Text: I am pleased to see you, <PlayerName>$player</>.//Though I cannot remain for long, I am grateful for the good you have accomplished in this realm.
DT_Dialogue_Goddess.2_Text: I yearn to stay longer in this world, for every moment here is a precious gift to be treasured.//Your efforts have not gone unnoticed, and I thank you.
DT_Dialogue_Goddess.7_Text: May you continue to thrive, <PlayerName>$player</>, and may these rewards for completing the sesajen serve you well.
DT_Dialogue_Goddess.4_Text: The sight of the island fills me with awe and wonder, for I can sense its gradual healing.
DT_Dialogue_Goddess.9_Text: These gifts as your rewards for the sesajen, I hope they are of much use to you.
DT_Dialogue_Goddess.6_Text: Though I am summoned to speak with you, there is much yet to be done.//I will return soon.
DT_Dialogue_Goddess.8_Text: Your efforts have not gone unnoticed.
DT_Dialogue_Goddess.5_Text: Your presence has brought about many positive changes, and I am grateful for your contributions.

DT_Dialogue_Gong.23_Text: <NPCName>Gong</> ask <NPCName>Grog</> to run today, but  <NPCName>Grog</> no wanna...
DT_Dialogue_Gong.40_Text: <NPCName>Gong</> asked <NPCName>Chieftain</> to play in snow but <NPCName>Chieftain</> no wanna.
DT_Dialogue_Gong.14_Text: <NPCName>Gong</> has so much to do today! Busy, busy!
DT_Dialogue_Gong.46_Text: <NPCName>Gong</> likes being home. <NPCName>Gong</> can listen to the water trickle.//Very nice and calming. Goom~
DT_Dialogue_Gong.12_Text: <NPCName>Gong</> speak Giant. <NPCName>Gong</> speak Fish. <NPCName>Gong</> speak Hooman.
DT_Dialogue_Gong.43_Text: <NPCName>Gort</> is angry all the time inside.//I hope <NPCName>Gort</> happy one day. Heart feel like river.
DT_Dialogue_Gong.42_Text: <NPCName>Gort</> lied and stoned us all many moons ago.//<NPCName>Gong</> get sad when remember. But <NPCName>Gong</> still love <NPCName>Gort</>.
DT_Dialogue_Gong.35_Text: <NPCName>Grog</> have many forest friends. I always see <NPCName>Grog</> play with them.//I want to play with them too.
DT_Dialogue_Gong.37_Text: <NPCName>Grog</> sad the leaves are falling...but is okay Hooman.//Water will make them alright again.
DT_Dialogue_Gong.21_Text: <NPCName>Grog</> so slow. But sometimes slow is nice.
DT_Dialogue_Gong.28_Text: <NPCName>Grog</> want to go to Hooman village. So fun! So goomgoom!//<NPCName>Gong</> wanna go too.
DT_Dialogue_Gong.16_Text: <NPCName>Groo</> like to run around forest.//<NPCName>Groo</> is so fun! So goomgoom!
DT_Dialogue_Gong.44_Text: Are you here with fruits, Hooman? No fruits no help.
DT_Dialogue_Gong.25_Text: But forest have no yummy food in Ice Season.*sigh*
DT_Dialogue_Gong.13_Text: Fish? Okay. Wait wait...//<NPCName>Gong</> need to focus. I know this.//Blub...blub blub... See?
DT_Dialogue_Gong.36_Text: Forest friends say we can play on fifth week of Ice Season. But we need ice! No play if no ice.//Sad 'cause so far, fifth week of Ice Season have no ice so forest friends can not play. Maybe next Ice Season.
DT_Dialogue_Gong.38_Text: Forest will be green again after drinking ice water soon. Be not sad.//I will try to make it all okay again so <NPCName>Grog</> can be happy.
DT_Dialogue_Gong.45_Text: Heh heh heh! Goombozled! Just kidding.
DT_Dialogue_Gong.6_Text: Hmm, <NPCName>Gong</> miss rain. When is rain, hooman? <NPCName>Gong</> want rain right now, <NPCName>Gong</> miss rain...
DT_Dialogue_Gong.27_Text: Hmm, Falling Season! What do, what do...
DT_Dialogue_Gong.26_Text: Hmm, Ice Season! Time to play in river!
DT_Dialogue_Gong.11_Text: Hmmmm, <NPCName>Gong</> look at you and <NPCName>Gong</> hungry.
DT_Dialogue_Gong.29_Text: Hooman Village have Hooman food. Many spikey fruits.//Ice cold food. Tasty waters! Yummy yummy.
DT_Dialogue_Gong.41_Text: Hooman need help with tools? <NPCName>Gong</> can help! Go to center of village.//Check the temple.
DT_Dialogue_Gong.3_Text: I remember all things in cavern! I remember Hooman. I remember earthshake.
DT_Dialogue_Gong.24_Text: Ice Season is nice. Is cold out.//Water everywhere!
DT_Dialogue_Gong.15_Text: Island is thirsty. <NPCName>Gong</> will ask for rain!
DT_Dialogue_Gong.4_Text: Just kidding. I forget. <NPCName>Gong</> remember nothing.
DT_Dialogue_Gong.33_Text: Many new sprouts this season.//Giants need to speak to Goddess and gift fruits.//Giants love <NPCName>Goddess</>.
DT_Dialogue_Gong.18_Text: Rain is best! Earth is best! Wind is best! Fire is best!//Everything is best! Goom!
DT_Dialogue_Gong.34_Text: River and lake are full of fish now!//Water is alive again. Sprouting Season is best.
DT_Dialogue_Gong.39_Text: Snow snow snow! <NPCName>Gong</> wanna make snowpeople like in Hooman Village.
DT_Dialogue_Gong.19_Text: So many things for <NPCName>Gong</> to do today! What do?!
DT_Dialogue_Gong.31_Text: There is Hooman that throw flower in lake. Why?//<NPCName>Gong</> have to clean it...
DT_Dialogue_Gong.32_Text: Tiny Hooman lost ball in river. It deep below now.//Even <NPCName>Gong</> cannot get.
DT_Dialogue_Gong.5_Text: Very happy <NPCName>Gong</> can be in village again! I can feel water, water everywhere!//Water here, water there, water in the air, so many water!

DT_Dialogue_Grog.53_Text: <NPCName>Chieftain</> say no perfect friends.//Not even <NPCName>Grog</> is perfect. So even naughty, <NPCName>Grog</> still love naughty friends.
DT_Dialogue_Grog.48_Text: <NPCName>Grog</> and <NPCName>Groo</> got many spikey fruits yesterday at forest.//Giants happy! Thank you <NPCName>Goddess</>!
DT_Dialogue_Grog.17_Text: <NPCName>Grog</> and other Giants gone for so long...
DT_Dialogue_Grog.49_Text: <NPCName>Grog</> can feel the wind getting colder. Falling Season is almost over.
DT_Dialogue_Grog.27_Text: <NPCName>Grog</> can not enchant tools here...//<NPCName>Grog</> need to go outside to enchant tools.
DT_Dialogue_Grog.18_Text: <NPCName>Grog</> feels good to be back in village. Now <NPCName>Grog</> can help <NPCName>Chieftain</> again with taking care island.
DT_Dialogue_Grog.38_Text: <NPCName>Grog</> get lost and stuck in Hooman Village for long.//<NPCName>Grog</> eat same red berry everyday.
DT_Dialogue_Grog.33_Text: <NPCName>Grog</> grateful for sun today.//Important to make plants grow.
DT_Dialogue_Grog.23_Text: <NPCName>Grog</> happy to see Hooman farm. Taking care of Earth.//More plants in island, more Giants, animals and Hooman are fed.
DT_Dialogue_Grog.20_Text: <NPCName>Grog</> has many stuff from the Hooman vilage. <NPCName>Grog</> favorite is the hat.//Very nice, but very small for <NPCName>Grog</> head.
DT_Dialogue_Grog.51_Text: <NPCName>Grog</> have many friends in forest. Especially after sundown.//<NPCName>Grog</> friends come out when all is dark.
DT_Dialogue_Grog.24_Text: <NPCName>Grog</> house better than cavern. Very soft and warm.
DT_Dialogue_Grog.29_Text: <NPCName>Grog</> like rain. Rain feed Earth with goodness and energy.
DT_Dialogue_Grog.54_Text: <NPCName>Grog</> looking forward to Sprouting Season.//Spikey fruits everywhere in Sprouting Season.
DT_Dialogue_Grog.44_Text: <NPCName>Grog</> need to go to forest and find fruits.//Giants like fruits. You eat fruits too or no? Ancient hooman like fruits like Giants.
DT_Dialogue_Grog.28_Text: <NPCName>Grog</> not sure <NPCName>Grog</> want to go outside today...//Nap time.
DT_Dialogue_Grog.39_Text: <NPCName>Grog</> sleep at new friend home.//Furry friend have large home near berry patch.
DT_Dialogue_Grog.52_Text: <NPCName>Grog</> told friends in forest, don't take fruits from Hooman.//But some friends are naughty like <NPCName>Gong</> and don't listen.
DT_Dialogue_Grog.14_Text: <NPCName>Groo</> like to taste hooman food.//I like hooman food too but spikey fruit still favorite.
DT_Dialogue_Grog.9_Text: But Giants together will make tool much more powerful.//Giants have share magic.
DT_Dialogue_Grog.40_Text: Earth is cold now. <NPCName>Grog</> can feel in body.//But very pretty... <NPCName>Grog</> is happy to see Earth pretty.
DT_Dialogue_Grog.13_Text: Forest full of magic. A safe place for Giants, animals and Hooman.//Giants safe to be Giants here. <NPCName>Goddess</> keep Giants safe.
DT_Dialogue_Grog.31_Text: Forest get nice drink today.//Thank you <NPCName>Goddess</>.
DT_Dialogue_Grog.26_Text: Forest is pretty. Hooman farm pretty too?//Many plants and animals or no?
DT_Dialogue_Grog.3_Text: Giants plant and nurture earth.//Flowers and trees feed Giants and earth.
DT_Dialogue_Grog.21_Text: Giants take care of island together.//Together with Hooman too from many moons ago.
DT_Dialogue_Grog.32_Text: Good day today, Hooman. <NPCName>Grog</> will train magic.
DT_Dialogue_Grog.12_Text: Goomgoom Hooman.//Hooman need help from <NPCName>Grog</>? <NPCName>Grog</> can help with hooman tools.
DT_Dialogue_Grog.37_Text: Hard to see in snow. Grateful for Giant stone signs in forest.//Snow burry path. <NPCName>Grog</> get confused and lost.
DT_Dialogue_Grog.46_Text: Hooman and Giants are same...even when Hooman and <NPCName>Grog</> look different.
DT_Dialogue_Grog.45_Text: Hooman likes to gather food and eat together by the lake, yes?//Nice, Giants like to do that at village too.
DT_Dialogue_Grog.36_Text: Ice Season now. Everything white and cold.//Earth is sleeping. <NPCName>Grog</> should too.
DT_Dialogue_Grog.11_Text: It is nice that <NPCName>Grog</> can work the Earth again.//Thank you Hooman. I wish <NPCName>Goddess</> gift you good things only.
DT_Dialogue_Grog.50_Text: Many plants are sprouting in forest...//<NPCName>Grog</> can feel Earth is very happy.
DT_Dialogue_Grog.34_Text: Nice day for training. <NPCName>Grog</> can throw rocks no problem.//Goomgom!
DT_Dialogue_Grog.7_Special: No, I have two left feet!
DT_Dialogue_Grog.10_Text: Practice is hard. Magic is hard.//<NPCName>Grog</> need to nap.
DT_Dialogue_Grog.30_Text: Rain brings life to forest and Earth.
DT_Dialogue_Grog.47_Text: Sprouting Season but still no spikey fruits in forest. Sad.
DT_Dialogue_Grog.43_Text: The snow feel nice.//Ice Season is <NPCName>Grog</> favorite.
DT_Dialogue_Grog.41_Text: The wind feel nice. Sprouting Season is <NPCName>Grog</> favorite.//All season is <NPCName>Grog</> favorite!
DT_Dialogue_Grog.42_Text: The wind feel nice.//Falling Season is <NPCName>Grog</> favorite.
DT_Dialogue_Grog.22_Text: This Giant Village. This island is Giants home.//Hooman home too.
DT_Dialogue_Grog.35_Text: Today have good vibe. The sun, warm and the Earth, happy.//If Earth happy, <NPCName>Grog</> happy.
DT_Dialogue_Grog.5_Text: Um, <NPCName>Grog</> want to ask. Can Hooman dance?
DT_Dialogue_Grog.4_Text: We plant trees...flowers in happy mood so earth happy too.
DT_Dialogue_Grog.15_Text: You can plant spikey fruit now.//Sprouting Season is spikey fruit season.
DT_Dialogue_Grog.2_Text: You have large land. Best for farming. Plants give life to Earth.//Land die if you don't farm. It get hard, crusty and sad.

DT_Dialogue_Groo.25_Text: <NPCName>GONG</> SKY LEAK TOO MUCH AGAIN! ARGH!
DT_Dialogue_Groo.32_Text: <NPCName>Gong</> is fast sometimes! Like the wind.//But only sometimes. Most times, <NPCName>Groo</> is faster. Like the wind. Woosh!
DT_Dialogue_Groo.18_Text: <NPCName>Grog</> is too slow! But <NPCName>Grog</> is friend, even when sooooo slooooow.
DT_Dialogue_Groo.46_Text: <NPCName>Groo</> a little sad leaves are falling but <NPCName>Groo</> know leaves will be back in Sprouting Season.
DT_Dialogue_Groo.19_Text: <NPCName>Groo</> ask <NPCName>Gong</> to run but <NPCName>Gong</> says too tired.//<NPCName>Gong</> old. Heh heh heh!
DT_Dialogue_Groo.9_Text: <NPCName>Groo</> collects food from forest.//Hooman too, goom?
DT_Dialogue_Groo.5_Text: <NPCName>Groo</> don't remember how to things after stuck for so long.
DT_Dialogue_Groo.14_Text: <NPCName>Groo</> fix tool.//The best. Heh heh heh!
DT_Dialogue_Groo.33_Text: <NPCName>Groo</> is feeling slow today...//It must be what Hooman feel all time.
DT_Dialogue_Groo.29_Text: <NPCName>Groo</> likes to run through the leaves. Wheeeee!//Wind the best! Better than water. Heh heh heh!
DT_Dialogue_Groo.37_Text: <NPCName>Groo</> not like village when rain like this. Too slippy!
DT_Dialogue_Groo.38_Text: <NPCName>Groo</> not like village when rain like this. Too slippy!
DT_Dialogue_Groo.39_Text: <NPCName>Groo</> not like village when snow like this. Too slippy!
DT_Dialogue_Groo.40_Text: <NPCName>Groo</> tired today. Maybe go outside later.
DT_Dialogue_Groo.31_Text: Bored! <NPCName>Groo</> just want to run in the forest.//Doing useless stuff like Hooman. I want.
DT_Dialogue_Groo.27_Text: Don't remember anything from stone age...//<NPCName>Groo</> got stoned and slept.
DT_Dialogue_Groo.24_Text: Everything so wet!//Last time <NPCName>Groo</> fall and hit head...
DT_Dialogue_Groo.49_Text: Forest so full again! Giants home.//Thank you, Hooman.
DT_Dialogue_Groo.7_Text: Giants can help you.//Giants grow food too.
DT_Dialogue_Groo.17_Text: Giants hate town. Many bouncy hooman.
DT_Dialogue_Groo.16_Text: Giants like town. Many yummy food.
DT_Dialogue_Groo.26_Text: Giants need fire... Cold outside.//Hm, now <NPCName>Groo</> sad...
DT_Dialogue_Groo.8_Text: Giants the best food grower. Hooman lose.//Heh heh heh!
DT_Dialogue_Groo.22_Text: Giants work better together.//If Hooman want better tool, save more Giants.
DT_Dialogue_Groo.10_Text: Goddess food the best!//Better than Giant's.
DT_Dialogue_Groo.48_Text: Hooman always get together near lake in Sprouting Season.//Food smells yummy! Giants want to join.
DT_Dialogue_Groo.11_Text: Hooman done talking to <NPCName>Groo</>? I want to run and pick fruit!
DT_Dialogue_Groo.28_Text: Hooman go to cavern, yes? Where <NPCName>Groo</> was stone?//Why?! It scary!
DT_Dialogue_Groo.20_Text: Hooman want better tool? <NPCName>Groo</> can help!//But only two. Not allowed more.
DT_Dialogue_Groo.15_Text: Hooman, thank for saving <NPCName>Groo</>. Now <NPCName>Groo</> is not stone anymore!
DT_Dialogue_Groo.51_Text: Maybe <NPCName>Groo</> not zoom so much now. Slippy ice.
DT_Dialogue_Groo.30_Text: Snowpeople look like Giants sometimes.//Only the good ones.
DT_Dialogue_Groo.50_Text: So many new sprouts this Sprouting Season. Nice to see.//It make wind smell yummy.
DT_Dialogue_Groo.44_Text: So much nice nice fruit now! Forest is rich. Sprouting Season here!//Giants grow seeds in forest too for animal friends.
DT_Dialogue_Groo.45_Text: Sometimes <NPCName>Groo</> see small hooman eating lot of colorful things on stick. Look so nice and yum yum!//Small hooman can see Giants. Yes.
DT_Dialogue_Groo.34_Text: Storm so fast! Maybe one day <NPCName>Groo</> can be as fast as storm.
DT_Dialogue_Groo.41_Text: Sun is like eye, yes? Watching us all during the day.
DT_Dialogue_Groo.47_Text: Time to see pretty flowers. Busy time for Giants.
DT_Dialogue_Groo.43_Text: White fluffy cold, white fluffy cold~
DT_Dialogue_Groo.36_Text: Why Hooman look like that? So tall. Eyes so big and strange...
DT_Dialogue_Groo.35_Text: Why can Hooman see Giants? Other hooman in hooman village can't.//Strange it is...

DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.187_Text: <NPCName>Jim’s</> son – What’s his name?//Yeah! <NPCName>Theo</>!//<portrait=surprised>I gave him some strawberries this one time, and he told me they were…crunchy.//<portrait=happy>Sure cracked me up!
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.147_Text: <NPCName>Kenny</> does all the work of caring for the animals, so there’s not much to do around here but sell supplies.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.221_Text: <NPCName>Kenny</>? Hmm. He’s either out on the ranch or in his room.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.160_Text: <NPCName>Kenny’s</> a daydreamer, but he has his head on straight.//He’s a good kid.//<portrait=happy>He’s also a good flute player. Just like his mother.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.177_Text: <NPCName>Kenny’s</> such an eager beaver, that kid.//He’s been like that since he was a tiny tot.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.154_Text: <NPCName>Kira</> got me into yoga. It helps to stretch stiff muscles.//So, tell me, are all Pokyoites into yoga, or just you?
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.228_Text: <NPCName>Kira</> is better at this than I am.//You should find her if you need help with yoga poses.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.167_Text: <NPCName>Kira</> isn’t a picky eater. I don’t think she loves or hates any particular foods.//She sure loves flowers, though.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.200_Text: <NPCName>Kira</> never did mind going out in the rain. Me, I’m a little different.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.173_Text: <NPCName>Kira</> said I ought to spend more time at the Tavern making new friends.//She thinks it would be good for me.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.96_Text: <NpcName>Ben</>. That kid just got back from his journey, doing who knows what.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.235_Text: <NpcName>Kenny</> teases me about it <Italic>every day</>.//<portrait=normal>Well, not every day.//Ah, that funny kid.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.76_Text: <NpcName>Kira</> and I don’t celebrate birthdays. It’s personal…
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.61_Text: <NpcName>Kira</> and I don’t really go out on weekdays. I like to watch TV or cook in the evening.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.64_Text: <NpcName>Kira</> and I don’t really go out on weekdays.//I like to watch TV or cook in the evening.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.224_Text: <PlayerName>$player</>! It’s nice of you to visit. You’re welcome to stay for dinner if you want.//<portrait=normal>I’m making plenty!
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.275_Text: <PlayerName>$player</>! It’s nice of you to visit. You’re welcome to stay for dinner if you want.//<portrait=normal>I’m making plenty!
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.205_Text: <PlayerName>$player</>, have you seen my coffee cup?//I swear I left it around here somewhere.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.32_Text: After all this time, <PlayerName>$player</>. It still confuses you, eh?
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.28_Text: Ah, never mind.//<portrait=concerned>It would be way too much work to transport all my animals. Not like I’d ever have the guts to tell my parents I was abandoning their ranch, anyway.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.136_Text: Ah, you’ve never had one of these visits either?//That makes me feel a tad better.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.151_Text: Are you doing okay, <PlayerName>$player</>?//Let me or <NPCName>Kenny</> know if you need anything.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.35_Text: Are you done working for the day?
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.146_Text: Are your animals doing okay, <PlayerName>$player</>?//We’ve got everything you need for them down at the ranch.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.223_Text: As a matter of fact, yes! I did use to live here. This was when I was a single man. Before I moved into <NPCName>Kira’s</> house.//<portrait=happy>In that happy little room right there. Neat, isn’t it?
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.267_Text: Besides, I saw you talking to the instructor that time. You two seemed comfortable.//<portrait=happy>Are you two…?//<portrait=normal>Never mind.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.229_Text: Breathe in… Hold it… Breathe out.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.77_Text: But don’t let that stop you from giving us gifts. Ha ha!
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.260_Text: But for me, it’s perfect.//I never feel lonely for a moment. My cattle keep me company.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.130_Text: But it’s raining today, so I figured I’d just pick up some stuff here.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.103_Text: Can you believe it’s the 21st already?
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.104_Text: Can you believe it’s the 24th already?
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.262_Text: Clean up the cobwebs a little.//<portrait=surprised>Don’t want the spiders to get too comfortable in here. I still have a lot of plans for this place.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.170_Text: Corporate folk, huh? That’s chill.//<portrait=normal>You must have worked in tall buildings, huh? I’m impressed.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.53_Text: Cows produce milk every day when they’re healthy.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.55_Text: Cows produce milk every day when they’re healthy.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.186_Text: Cucumber fan, huh? Not bad, not bad!//<portrait=normal>I’ve always been a big fan of lettuce.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.178_Text: Do you grow most of your own food?//I assume farmers do that.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.23_Text: Do you have enough fodder for the week, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.251_Text: Do you know how to make stew?//<portrait=concerned>I can’t remember if you need coconut water or if normal water will do. Hmm.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.162_Text: Do you need something from the ranch? It isn’t urgent, is it?//<portrait=normal>Oh good! Then let’s just wait until tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.166_Text: Do you prefer sweet or savory foods?//<portrait=surprised>I like them all. Kimchi, fruit tarts… <Italic>Any</> fruit tarts!
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.135_Text: Do you think it’s because he trusts my business more than others?//<portrait=concerned>Or does he just forget because I live in the woods?
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.15_Text: Don’t camp in this forest.//Listen to me on this.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.19_Text: Don’t camp in this forest.//Listen to me on this.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.168_Text: Don’t worry about getting me anything for my birthday.//<NPCName>Kira</> and I don’t celebrate birthdays.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.109_Text: Especially in weather as beautiful as this.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.111_Text: Especially in weather as beautiful as this.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.252_Text: Failed the kimchi experiment this week. I’ll try again next week.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.93_Text: Fall is when we get busy, with the cooking contest coming up.//A lot of preparation for me.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.191_Text: Fall means harvest season, and harvest season means good food!//I can’t decide what to cook first!
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.128_Text: Fancy seeing you here, <PlayerName>$player</>. Buying or selling?
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.194_Text: Fresh veggies are hard to come by in Winter.//I might wait until Spring to try out new recipes again.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.66_Text: Gah. I sounded like <NpcName>Kenny</> just now. That was weird.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.176_Text: Has <NPCName>Kenny</> taught you about the animals’ moods yet?//I bet he has. So, your animals will get upset if you don’t feed them.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.276_Text: Have you ever thought about starting a business? It’s not easy.//Farmers are their own businesses. You understand what I mean by that, right?
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.153_Text: Have you ever tried yoga? It’s a surprisingly good workout.//<portrait=surprised>Oh! You’re a yogi? No way!
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.112_Text: Have you fed your animals today?
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.115_Text: Have you fed your animals today?
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.117_Text: Have you fed your animals today?
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.226_Text: Have you seen my coffee cup?//I know I set it down somewhere.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.195_Text: Have you stored up enough food for Winter?//It’s hard to cook if you don’t have the right ingredients.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.62_Text: Have you watched this week’s cooking show?//It’s very informative, and you learn a new skill every time.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.2_Text: Having another rancher could be good for the local economy. We might be able to make local cheese again.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.239_Text: He feels very connected to the earth. And not in a good way.//I don’t know. I might be overthinking this.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.247_Text: He just needs some friends.//It isn’t healthy to be off in the middle of nowhere without much human contact for too long.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.46_Text: Heh… Why am I giving you fitness advice?
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.246_Text: His mother says <NpcName>Kenny</> is a beautiful soul. Can’t argue with that.//I think the kid will be fine.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.272_Text: Hmm… It is what it is.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.203_Text: Hot meals are great on days when the weather’s bad.//What should I cook for dinner tonight?
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.227_Text: How do you organize your farm, <PlayerName>$player</>? You should tell me about it sometime.//We can trade tips.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.16_Text: I almost became somebody’s lunch years ago because I fell asleep by the creek.//<portrait=normal>Good thing <NpcName>Kira</> was there to scare off the bear.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.20_Text: I almost became somebody’s lunch years ago because I fell asleep by the creek.//<portrait=normal>Good thing <NpcName>Kira</> was there to scare off the bear.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.24_Text: I always say it’s never bad to have extra.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.33_Text: I assign myself one day off a week, usually Saturdays.//I’m pretty strict about it.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.284_Text: I brought my own tea this morning.//<portrait=annoyed>No way I’m spending – how much does a cup of tea cost these days? Thirty, fifty coins?
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.232_Text: I can make a lot of dishes with the vegetables around here.//Fish and all that too. But it doesn’t always turn out good.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.237_Text: I can show you how to properly care for your animals. Great idea, eh?
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.145_Text: I don’t mind him playing his flute, but he should get his work done first.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.148_Text: I don’t mind, though.//<portrait=normal>It gives me more time to maintain the shop’s inventory. Someone’s gotta do it, right?
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.129_Text: I don’t shop here often, because we usually cook with fruit and vegetables from our garden.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.255_Text: I don’t think I have anything to worry about.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.123_Text: I don’t think I have anything to worry about. He’s a gentle soul, and those animals have special place in his heart.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.30_Text: I don’t think I should go to Starlet Town today.//I’m busy. Are you heading there?
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.264_Text: I don’t want to deal with the hustle and bustle of town every day.//<portrait=surprised>I don’t think I could stand it.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.5_Text: I find cooking very relaxing. And better yet, you get to eat the result!
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.8_Text: I find cooking very relaxing. And better yet, you get to eat the result!
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.250_Text: I got some fresh seafood yesterday from the shack. I’m planning to make stew with it.//<portrait=happy>Sounds good, doesn’t it? Stew on a cold day like this?
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.105_Text: I had an apple for breakfast this morning.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.90_Text: I had an apple for breakfast this morning.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.158_Text: I had no idea food could blow up like that! But it’s okay.//<portrait=happy>We’re all learning, am I right?//<portrait=normal>As long as we have fun and don’t give up. That’s the key to successful cooking.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.257_Text: I had this cow, Baby.//She wasn’t a baby. Her name was Baby.//<portrait=happy>We used to be best buds. Took her to a field one rainy day. Oh boy!
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.57_Text: I have a meeting at the community center tomorrow after work.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.134_Text: I hear the mayor often visits businesses around the island. Keeping track and all that.//<portrait=concerned>But I’ve never once had one of these visits.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.79_Text: I hope I don’t get sick before the beach cleanup this Saturday.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.213_Text: I hope nothing gets damaged in this storm.//We can’t really afford any repairs.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.207_Text: I hope this rain is over by morning.//It gets pretty muddy around here.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.215_Text: I hope this storm is over by morning.//It gets pretty flooded out there.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.137_Text: I keep an eye on the animals every single day.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.68_Text: I know they’d do the same for me if our roles were reversed.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.72_Text: I know they’d do the same for me if our roles were reversed.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.183_Text: I like Spring. It’s easier to get fresh ingredients this time of year.//<portrait=surprised>Spring and Summer. And don’t forget Fall.//<portrait=annoyed>Hmm. Hang on. That’s basically the whole year.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.37_Text: I like cooking, but I prefer taking care of my animals.//<portrait=concerned>Besides, who else is going to do it?
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.283_Text: I might go in the back and lie down for a bit.//<portrait=concerned>I woke up too early today.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.51_Text: I name my animals after Summer crops. Melon, Poppy, Radish.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.270_Text: I need to get better about experimenting in the kitchen.//If I don’t start improving, I might not win any cooking contests. Ever.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.210_Text: I need to get out of this before I get hurt.//Being struck by lightning is no joke.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.83_Text: I saw <NPCName>Taco</> here the other day. He went inside the barn and played with the cows.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.84_Text: I saw <NPCName>Taco</> here the other day. He went inside the barn and played with the cows.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.97_Text: I saw <NPCName>Taco</> here the other day. He went inside the barn and played with the cows.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.98_Text: I saw <NPCName>Taco</> here the other day. He went inside the barn and played with the cows.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.39_Text: I should get my nose checked.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.163_Text: I should have done inventory last night, but I got caught up watching the cooking show.//<portrait=surprised>Wow! That show can hypnotize you for hours!
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.184_Text: I should probably restock the ranch’s feed supply.//Everyone stocks up on feed in Spring.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.241_Text: I should talk to that kid. Push him back into society.//If not, I’ll just give him more work. That might do it.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.3_Text: I spend a lot of time at the ranch, managing the shop’s supplies, making sure we have enough to sell.//That sort of thing.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.6_Text: I spend a lot of time at the ranch, managing the shop’s supplies, making sure we have enough to sell.//That sort of thing.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.13_Text: I take a yoga class every Saturday at the community center.//What do you usually do on the weekend?
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.131_Text: I think I’ll make some soup tonight. Nice and warm. Yum…
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.133_Text: I think I’ll take a nap for a bit after you leave.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.52_Text: I think they’re beautiful names.//Not Betsy. <NpcName>Kenny</> named her that.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.122_Text: I told <NpcName>Kenny</> that when I can’t do it anymore, he needs to be the one who takes care of the animals.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.254_Text: I told <NpcName>Kenny</> that when I can’t do it anymore, he needs to be the one who takes care of the animals.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.157_Text: I tried to cook a big dinner for the whole family last night.//<portrait=happy>If you heard <NPCName>Kenny</> shouting all the way over at your place, that was probably why.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.189_Text: I try and stick to the shade on my way to work in the mornings.//<portrait=surprised>I might melt if I spend too much time in the sun.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.256_Text: I used to spend rainy days outdoors, playing with the cows.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.9_Text: I wash my hair every day. A habit, really, rather than a necessity.//<portrait=happy>Thankfully, I don’t have that much hair, so it isn’t a big deal.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.238_Text: I worry about <NpcName>Kenny</> sometimes.//He can be a bit…intense.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.36_Text: If I weren’t a rancher like my dad, I’d be a chef.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.119_Text: If you and I are cold, it stands to reason our animals might be cold too.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.120_Text: If you and I are cold, it stands to reason our animals might be cold too.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.121_Text: If you and I are cold, it stands to reason our animals might be cold too.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.197_Text: If you need a warm place to rest during your errands, come by the ranch.//I keep it nice and toasty in there.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.144_Text: If you see <NPCName>Kenny</>, would you tell him to come find me?//<portrait=concerned>He forgot to feed one of the cows.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.199_Text: If you’re looking for <NPCName>Kenny</>, he’s probably inside the house.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.124_Text: Inhale the future, exhale the past.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.41_Text: Is it really that strong? I should get my nose checked.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.193_Text: It also makes <NPCName>Kenny’s</> flute go out of tune. Someone should probably tell him that.//<portrait=happy>Me? No. Maybe you should. You two are friends, aren’t you?
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.253_Text: It ended up tasting pretty weird. I threw the whole batch out.//Gave me a stomachache.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.220_Text: It feels weird to have guests, let me tell you.//<portrait=happy>In a nice way, though. Weird nice.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.140_Text: It leaks a bit in the rain, but it doesn’t rain that often here. So, no big deal.//But I thought I should mention it up front.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.100_Text: It must be hard to enter the cooking contest with so few fresh options available.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.125_Text: It sounds a bit daunting when you tell yourself you need to exercise.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.261_Text: It’d be good for me to use the kitchen here every once in a while.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.245_Text: It’s <Italic>not</> nothing, I gotta say.//I’m worried he might end up marrying a tree or something.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.113_Text: It’s gloomy out. Our animals could use a little extra love. Just saying. No need to get defensive.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.116_Text: It’s gloomy out. Our animals could use a little extra love. Just saying. No need to get defensive.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.118_Text: It’s gloomy out. Our animals could use a little extra love. Just saying. No need to get defensive.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.99_Text: It’s hard to get fresh vegetables in Winter. Good thing we have some stocked up in the kitchen.//<portrait=concerned>But they won’t last too long.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.159_Text: It’s nice to walk slowly and take in all the island’s sights.//There’s no reason to go too fast.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.94_Text: It’s probably your busiest season too, huh?
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.180_Text: It’s rough when rude customers come to the ranch.//It’s not everyone, or even most people. It’s just a few prickly individuals.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.206_Text: It’s time to make something hot to eat! What should I cook?
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.208_Text: I’ll have to do my yoga indoors this evening. It doesn’t look like the rain’s going to let up.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.175_Text: I’ll have to look for more animal feed to stock.//<portrait=happy><NPCName>Ben</> is helpful with this type of thing.//<portrait=normal>He’s young and gathers feed quickly. Which is weird, ’cause he walks really slowly.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.216_Text: I’ll have to make something hot for dinner tonight.//Have any suggestions?
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.155_Text: I’m curious about the stories people may have told you about <NPCName>Kira</>.//My wife is a bit of a legend around here.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.80_Text: I’m feeling a bit under the weather.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.174_Text: I’m from here, so I know a lot of these folks already.//<portrait=normal>But I don’t know them as well as my parents do.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.188_Text: I’m glad <NPCName>Kira’s</> not out hunting anymore.//Not that I don’t think she could handle it. It’s the heat!
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.263_Text: I’m glad I live in the forest. I couldn’t imagine living anywhere else.//<portrait=happy>It’s not too noisy here, let me tell you.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.204_Text: I’m glad I’m not out in that rain.//My groceries can wait. I’m not going to <NPCName>Sam</>’s in this weather.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.286_Text: I’m gonna spend the day here.//<portrait=happy>It would be a waste of good weather if I didn’t.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.114_Text: I’m just glad I’m still here to make sure the animals are dry and healthy.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.142_Text: I’m pretty sure a library book somewhere lists these barns as some of the island’s oldest buildings.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.44_Text: I’m so energized!//A new man, if you will.
