DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.50_Text: I’m so energized!//A new man, if you will.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.87_Text: I’m trying to collect as many coconuts as possible before Summer ends.//I might go to the beach again tomorrow and see if I can get some more.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.248_Text: I’ve been looking at new recipes.//This weekend is going to be the one I finally nail making kimchi.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.268_Text: I’ve lived here my entire life. So did my parents and their parents as well.//Let me say this now, before I forget.//<portrait=happy>I’m glad you moved in, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.1_Text: Just call me <NPCName>Jack</>!//I run the local ranch.//Your lot has plenty of space to raise livestock. Once you’re settled, maybe we can discuss raising animals.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.58_Text: Just me and a couple of friends. We’ll be sharing our week and all that jazz.//<portrait=normal>Always welcome to stop by, <PlayerName>$player</>. We’ll be all ears. Consider it an open invitation.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.265_Text: Last night’s episode of the cooking show was fantastic.//<portrait=normal>I think one of these days, I’m going to re-create the fruit tarts they made.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.201_Text: Let’s talk another time. I need to get home.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.211_Text: Let’s talk another time. I need to get home.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.217_Text: Let’s talk another time. I need to get home.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.198_Text: Like humans, animals don’t like getting wet.//You should keep them inside on days like this.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.259_Text: Living in a forest can be lonely for town people. If you’re like <NpcName>Sam</>, I wouldn’t recommend it.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.34_Text: Looking after my mental health and all that jazz. You know?
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.108_Text: Make sure to let your animals out of the barn once in a while, okay?
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.110_Text: Make sure to let your animals out of the barn once in a while, okay?
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.65_Text: Make sure to talk to your animals every day.//They may not speak the same language we do, but they understand.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.209_Text: Make sure your animals are inside, <PlayerName>$player</>!
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.234_Text: Many Summers ago, I tried making an egg dish and failed horribly. Yeah, that might have been my worst cooking experiment.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.249_Text: Mark my words. I will not leave the house until I have mastered kimchi.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.179_Text: Me, farming? No, it’s not for me.//Besides, who’s going to take care of my ranch if I farm?//<portrait=surprised>Hmm. Solid point. I do have <NPCName>Kenny</>.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.17_Text: My body is very stiff. What am I doing wrong?//I’ve been doing yoga for so long now.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.47_Text: My wife is the expert if you need any information about cave monsters.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.26_Text: No, I’ve never actually tried it myself.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.230_Text: Not a big fisher myself. I know how to take care of some animals, but you lose me at fish.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.279_Text: Nothing is better than watching the sun rise over the trees on a Saturday morning.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.60_Text: Oh yeah! That’s a good idea, actually.//<portrait=normal>You do need to brush them every day. Good tip.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.74_Text: Oh yeah! That’s a good idea, actually.//<portrait=normal>You do need to brush them every day. Good tip.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.181_Text: Oh! That’s what I was supposed to do yesterday. I completely forgot to get groceries.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.106_Text: Oh, that’s more than enough for me. I can’t eat too much in the morning, or I’d… Umm…
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.91_Text: Oh, that’s more than enough for me. I can’t overeat in the morning, or I’d… Umm…
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.18_Text: Oh, you do yoga too?//So tell me, <PlayerName>$player</>, what did I do wrong?
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.271_Text: On the worst days, it feels like everything is leaving me behind. Nature, my youth, the entire world.//One day, I’ll just be a forgotten guy in the woods.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.150_Text: One way to give your animals love is to make sure you talk to them every day.//Petting them is a great way to show love as well.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.67_Text: Only the best grass for my fodder. Those animals are my friends.//Only the best for them!
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.71_Text: Only the best grass for my fodder. Those animals are my friends.//Only the best for them!
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.70_Text: Or is it an old, charming room? Either way, you get the gist.//<portrait=normal>The room is charming, and it’s old.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.10_Text: Over there. There’s a perfectly good creek down there.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.165_Text: Part of running the ranch is selling items and keeping up with stock.//<NPCName>Kenny</> would rather be out with the animals, so I handle the store part.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.172_Text: People have offered to help me take inventory at the ranch, but I always turn them down.//It feels good to do it myself.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.273_Text: People keep telling me to sell the ranch to a big company so <NPCName>Kira</> and I can truly retire.//<portrait=annoyed>Why would I do that? This ranch has been in my family for generations, and it’ll stay that way.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.190_Text: People need to be careful when they let their kids swim in the ocean. I’ve heard some wild legends about what lives down there.//I won’t risk it.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.86_Text: Psst… There’s a pile of coconuts just behind the barn.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.243_Text: Serenading the flowers. I mean, come on!
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.48_Text: She spent a lot of her adult years in there… Deep in the cavern.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.156_Text: She used to camp out in caverns back in the day.//<portrait=surprised>To clear out the ghouls and stuff.//<portrait=happy>I don’t know for sure. I’ve never been inside a cavern.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.218_Text: Snow’s deep today, huh?//At least it’s warm in here.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.42_Text: So excited that you’re here! My first customer of the day.//Need anything?
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.269_Text: Someday, <NPCName>Kira</> and I might be…somewhere else. Far from here.//<portrait=happy>And I’m glad this island has someone like you to take care of it.//<portrait=normal>You’ve done plenty for Coral Island.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.126_Text: Sometimes after work, I just put on some music in the living room and dance with <NpcName>Kira</> instead.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.277_Text: Sometimes, when business is slow, I close early and tend my vegetables.//You can’t beat the flavor of the fresh stuff.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.78_Text: The Cherry Blossom Festival is coming up.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.139_Text: The extra room in the ranch is for rent, if you know someone who’s looking. Errr…
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.85_Text: The more you upgrade the fodder, the better quality your animal products will be.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.161_Text: The ranch is closing early today, so make sure you get whatever you need soon.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.63_Text: The ranch is old. Takes a lot to maintain.//It was my dad’s and his dad’s before that.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.214_Text: The storm is fine as long as there’s no blackout.//<portrait=annoyed>Oh yeah, it’s happened, let me tell you. It’ll happen again.//<portrait=concerned>Yes, it will.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.242_Text: The thing with <NpcName>Kenny</> is – well, I’m at fault for loving nature and all that jazz.//<portrait=normal>Gotta say, I taught him that. But I had no idea he’d take it this far.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.219_Text: The town needs to get someone to shovel the snow. It’s impossible to get around.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.164_Text: The vineyard? Hmm… No, I don’t really hang out there.//<portrait=concerned>Don’t know that <NPCName>Walter</> guy that well, either.//<portrait=normal><NPCName>Kira</> knows his wife, though.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.29_Text: There’s a path by the vineyard that leads to town.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.31_Text: There’s a path by the vineyard that leads to town.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.225_Text: There’s always something to be done around here.//That’s part of running a business.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.282_Text: There’s this great hot sauce that goes with just about anything. XYZ brand. It kicks, all right!//<portrait=happy>I always have it in my kitchen.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.54_Text: They do need to be mature first. Calves can’t produce milk.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.56_Text: They do need to be mature first. Calves can’t produce milk.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.192_Text: This crisp Fall chill makes working outside easier.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.38_Text: This morning <NpcName>Kira</> told me something smelled really strong. But I don’t smell anything.//<portrait=concerned>Hmm. That makes me nervous.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.40_Text: This morning <NpcName>Kira</> told me something smelled really strong. But I don’t smell anything.//<portrait=concerned>Hmm. That makes me nervous.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.222_Text: This old thing doesn’t look so bad, does it?//<portrait=happy>I’ve been taking good care of this building. Look around!
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.69_Text: Too bad you’re already settled in that cabin, <PlayerName>$player</>.//I would’ve rented you my charming old room.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.101_Text: Unless you have a well-stocked fridge, that is.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.45_Text: Walking is an excellent way to keep moving, but remember to push yourself every once in a while.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.258_Text: We almost got struck by lightning!//What a memory!
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.132_Text: We keep piles of fodder in the back in case the grass supply drops.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.202_Text: Weather forecasting is such a sham sometimes.//<portrait=concerned>They said the rain would be over by now.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.138_Text: Well, it’s actually <NpcName>Kenny</> who does that. Heh!
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.143_Text: Well, when else would you be able to say you live in a historic building?
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.75_Text: We’re not selling the ranch to Pufferfish.//It’s been in my family for many generations, and I hope that won’t ever change.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.185_Text: What are your favorite Spring veggies, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.169_Text: What did you do before you came to Coral Island, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.236_Text: What do you say I walk over to the farm after work sometime? Huh?//<portrait=normal>Now that we’re best buds.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.27_Text: What’s it like, anyway?//Moving to a different island and completely starting a new life?
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.244_Text: When <NpcName>Kira</> does it – singing to a tree – it’s cute. But why do I worry when it comes to <NpcName>Kenny</>?
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.280_Text: When I do yoga, I don’t have to think about anything else. I can just focus on the way my body feels.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.11_Text: When people buy animals from us, we usually ship them the next morning.//But since you live close by, we’ll walk them over right away.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.21_Text: When people buy animals from us, we usually ship them the next morning.//But since you live close by, we’ll walk them over right away.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.274_Text: Where am I going to go, anyway? I love it here.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.4_Text: Who are my customers? Ha. That’s tricky.//<portrait=normal>You, I guess. And neighboring ranchers.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.7_Text: Who are my customers? Ha. That’s tricky.//<portrait=normal>You, I guess. And neighboring ranchers.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.196_Text: Winter’s too cold to stay late at the ranch.//I usually go right home for a warm meal.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.43_Text: Yoga always puts me in a good mood!
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.49_Text: Yoga always puts me in a good mood! I did a little bit of it this morning.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.278_Text: Yoga last week was brutal.//Plenty of tough poses.//<portrait=happy>Lucky I didn’t pull anything!
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.285_Text: Yoga might look easy, but let me just say… It makes you sweat like you never sweat before.//I don’t know how <NpcName>Leah</> does it.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.25_Text: You can place bee houses around the island.//They don’t have to only be on your farm. Um, <NpcName>Ben</> told me that.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.231_Text: You can probably fish in that creek near the cavern.//I see <NpcName>Joko</> fishing there all the time.//Must be something in the water, eh?
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.171_Text: You gave him cheese, huh? That’s too bad. I hope he wasn’t rude about it.//But yeah, <NPCName>Kenny</> doesn’t eat cheese, eggs. Things like that.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.141_Text: You get what you pay for around here, I guess.//The barn isn’t brand new anymore. So I rent the extra room out for dirt cheap.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.240_Text: You saw <NpcName>Kenny</> where? Playing flute for the what?!
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.266_Text: You should come to yoga with me sometime, <PlayerName>$player</>.//I think you’d enjoy it.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.149_Text: You should never be rude to your animals.//They may not understand our language, but they can feel love.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.59_Text: You’re really going to tell me how to raise my cattle?//<portrait=happy>I’ve been doing this for who knows how long. And I’m a rancher. But go ahead, I guess.
DT_Dialogue_Jack_Production.73_Text: You’re really going to tell me how to raise my cattle?//<portrait=happy>I’ve been doing this for who knows how long. And I’m a rancher. But go ahead, I guess.

DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.46_Text: Agung once tried that frozen seaweed special we had. Ended up with his tongue stuck to it!//That guy is something else.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.12_Text: Ah, Winter's chill in the sea – it's brisk, but invigorating. You see the fish moving a bit slower, more gracefully.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.41_Text: Ah, see those pieces over there? The giant kegs? Pulled it from a shipwreck off the Northern Reef.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.43_Text: Ah, treasure! Well, there's the tale of the Sunken Sapphire – a gem as big as your fist, said to be hidden in the deepest trench.//Many have searched, but it's more than just the depth that guards it... Let's just say, the sea keeps its secrets well.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.20_Text: And as for a garden, well, the kingdom's got one, but it's a swim away in the next ocean. We're talking about what we have right here in our own waters.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.18_Text: And then there's this one pesky sea snail, I call him Muncher. Don't get me started.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.59_Text: Bim bam bim boom, where the coral reefs bloom~
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.51_Text: But hey, I still enjoy singing now and then, just for the fun of it – not as a career move, though.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.21_Text: Can I get you something to drink?
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.56_Text: Doo wop doo wam, under the moon's gleam~
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.54_Text: Doo wop doo wam, we sway with the seaweed~
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.55_Text: Dubi dubidam dam, swirling like the currents~//Where the waves kiss the sky and the seagulls fly, that's where our tales are spun~
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.36_Text: Every week, I dive out to collect fresh seaweed and herbs for the Eel's kitchen.//The flavors we get are unbeatable – nothing like those stale imports.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.60_Text: From the depths so deep, where the ancient ones sleep, to the surface kissed by the sun~
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.52_Text: Hmm-hmm-hmm... You recognize that melody? It's a classic from the coastal reefs – always brings back good memories when I hum it.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.3_Text: Huh? Never mind, then.//I'm Jannu, proud owner of the Sleepy Eel Tavern.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.49_Text: I always say, if I weren't doing my own thing, running the Eel, I'd probably be in the Kingdom's kitchen, cooking up a storm.//Now, I'm not saying Olan's not good, but I reckon I'd give him a run for his money.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.3_Special: I don't know what you're talking about.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.38_Text: I like to mix it up with the regulars – they throw me a mood, and I whip up a drink to match.//It's all fun and games, and it sure keeps my mixing game on point.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.47_Text: I overheard that one of guards tried to outswim a dolphin once. Let’s just say, it didn’t go as planned, but they had a good laugh about it.//Semeru, though, he didn’t think it was so funny – not during patrol hours.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.45_Special: I'd like to hear something more mysterious, something unexplained.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.62_Text: I'll never forget the day Maharaja Putput got lost in the kelp forest. The entire palace was in a frenzy! But Princess Miranjani found him in no time.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.4_Text: I'm Jannu, proud owner of the Sleepy Eel Tavern. Never thought I'd see the day when a land-dweller would make waves like this around here.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.44_Special: I'm curious about the storms. What's the wildest one you've seen?
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.32_Text: I've been experimenting with moonlight gardening. Believe it or not, certain corals respond to the lunar cycle.//My night-blooming corallines are thriving like never before.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.29_Text: I've got this special blend of soil right outside my grotto, mixed with crushed corn and seaweed compost.//It works wonders for my sea lettuce – grows twice as lush as the regular stuff.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.7_Text: If I break into song, promise you won't swim off, alright? Haha!
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.42_Text: If the walls of the Sleepy Eel could talk, oh the stories they'd tell! But since they can't, I guess I'll have to do. What are you in the mood to hear – tales of treasure, storms, or maybe something a little more mysterious?
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.58_Text: In the heart of the sea where the spirits are free, is the place we merfolk call home~
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.31_Text: It's a bit of a swim, but my anemone blooms are the envy of the reef because of it.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.26_Text: It's been ages since I've spent more than a few hours on the surface.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.65_Text: King Krakatoa, long may he reign, has this tradition – every year on his coronation day, he swims out to the furthest reef.//Says it's his way of staying connected to every part of his kingdom, from the shallow waters to the deep trenches. That's real humility for you.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.64_Text: King Krakatoa, long may he reign, really showed his mettle at the last council meeting.//Sorted out a heated dispute over seaweed farming borders with just a few words. Drama, drama.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.57_Text: La la la lum, in the heart of the brine~//Shoo bop shoo bam, where the sun doesn't shine~
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.13_Text: Land farmers like you must have it tough in the Winter, with all that frost.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.6_Text: Love the rain, I do. Perfect excuse to whip up some special drinks and enjoy the mellow tunes.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.33_Text: Maintaining pH levels in an underwater garden is tricky.//But hey, a sprinkle of shell powder here and there, and my kelp sprouts are happy as clams.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.50_Text: My singing days are pretty much behind me. My throat just can't handle it anymore, too many strains and things to watch out for.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.63_Text: Now, Nagalita, that's a different story – way more chill.//Gotta say, between you and me, I'm more of a Nagalita fan myself.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.48_Text: Oddly enough, I’ve never seen Agung and Denali hanging out here after work. Guess their patrol partnership doesn’t extend to off-duty hours.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.53_Text: Oh, the waves roll high~ and the stars shine bright, over the endless blue we roam~
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.19_Text: Olan's a whiz in the kitchen, sure, but let's be real – it's all about the ingredients, right? I mean, a chef is only as good as what he's got in his pantry.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.27_Text: Once, I ended up at the surface during a rainstorm. Spotted this boat, right in the middle of nowhere. Just two folks on it, looked pretty frightened. I kept a watch from a distance – wasn't about to let anything bad happen to them.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.61_Text: Princess Miranjani's fish, Maharaja Putput, really knows how to stir things up.//Zipped right through a hoop of pearls at the royal party – everyone's still gabbing about it!
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.8_Text: Rain's got a way of softening the whole sea.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.35_Text: Running the Sleepy Eel isn't just about serving drinks. It's about creating a vibe.//I've decked the place out with these glowing shell lanterns – really sets a mood.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.34_Text: Set up my own little current redirect with some well-placed rocks.//It's pretty neat – gives the garden the perfect mix of nutrients and stops the leaves from getting buried under silt.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.11_Text: Snow falling through the water is a sight to see – kinda magical.//It's days like these I miss my singing days, but hey, the Eel's warm and toasty, ready for ya!
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.45_Text: Something mysterious? Well, there's the Whispering Current.//Travelers speak of a place where the water hums, a melody without a source. Some say it's an ancient merfolk song lost to time, others think it's the ocean's own voice.//I've swum those waters once, and let's just say, the ocean's depths hold more secrets than we can fathom.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.44_Text: Storms, huh? Well, there was the Great Gale of Galeth's Ridge. Waves as tall as mountains, winds howling like sea monsters.//I was just a guppy then, but I remember the elders bracing against the storm.//We talk about the sea's beauty often, but that day, we respected its power.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.43_Special: Tell me about a treasure! I love a good hunt story.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.28_Text: That boat, bright red it was, hard to miss.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.39_Text: The Eel's got its own kind of decor. I got them myself, collected from around. Artistic, huh?
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.37_Text: The best in the area, not even the Kingdom's kitchen has this quality. Oh yeah, I went there.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.17_Text: There's this one fish, I've named him Nibbler. He's got a knack for nibbling on the plants in my garden.//I try to shoo him away, but I think he sees it as a game. He's winning, by the way.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.25_Text: We're not together anymore. It's for the best.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.2_Text: Welcome to the Kingdom! I'm Jannu, proud owner of the Sleepy Eel Tavern.//Never thought I'd see the day when a land-dweller would make waves like this around here.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.40_Text: Welcome to the Sleepy Eel! Grab a seat wherever you like.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.1_Text: Whoa, are you the one everyone's been bubbling about? The ocean cleaner that even the king mentions?
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.9_Text: Whoa, these storms really churn the waters! How is it up there, on the land?
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.5_Text: You feel that rhythm? That's the rain dancing up top. Brings a whole different vibe down here – kind of soothing.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.23_Text: You have to try my creation, the 'Oceanic Mojito.'//It's got a bit of everything: glowing algae, some pearl dust, and just a splash of deep-sea nectar. Took me ages to get it just right, but I think it's a winner.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.24_Text: You land-dwellers really know how to throw a party! Last time I popped up, it was right in the middle of a huge festival – lights in the sky, music floating over the waves.//I hung around just long enough to dance to a few tunes with my partner.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.15_Text: You should see the coral blooms in my garden right now – they're bursting with colors.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.16_Text: You should see the coral blooms in my garden right now – they're bursting with colors.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.30_Text: You wouldn't believe the difference a bit of volcanic ash makes in my garden. I gather it from the nearby undersea vents.
DT_Dialogue_JannuOldTemplate__Production.14_Text: You're finding yourself with free time now, aren't you?//What do you do, just sleep through until the sun decides to show up again or?

DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.130_Text: <NpcName>Betty</> used to run the Tavern with <NpcName>Frank</>. No, not the son. I mean Frank Sr.//I don’t really keep in touch with her, but I think she still bakes to this day.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.141_Text: <NpcName>Lily’s</> never been any trouble. Now or when she was little.//<portrait=happy>She’s a good kid.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.52_Text: And at my age, <PlayerName>$player</>, there’s very little I can do about it.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.138_Text: And if I had my way, it wouldn’t be for my children either.//<portrait=normal>But we live in a different era now.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.111_Text: Are you supposed to be back here?
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.89_Text: At this time of year, we start keeping the heater on at night.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.25_Text: Attention can be dangerous. Look at Pufferfish Corporation.//I kept telling everybody, but nobody listened.//<portrait=concerned>We draw way too much notice with festivals and tourism. And now they want to drill here.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.37_Text: Attention can be dangerous. Look at Pufferfish Corporation.//I kept telling everybody, but nobody listened.//<portrait=concerned>We draw way too much notice with festivals and tourism. And now they want to drill here.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.43_Text: Back in the day, we had to jot down festivals and birthdays on the calendar ourselves. But now, you can just buy preprinted calendars from <NpcName>Dinda</> or get them from TV shopping.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.63_Text: Back in the day, we had to jot down festivals and birthdays on the calendar ourselves. But now, you can just buy preprinted calendars from <NpcName>Dinda</> or get them from TV shopping.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.71_Text: Back in the day, we had to jot down festivals and birthdays on the calendar ourselves. But now, you can just buy preprinted calendars from <NpcName>Dinda</> or get them from TV shopping.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.46_Text: But a better fishing pole wouldn’t hurt if you’re trying to catch those feisty ones.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.57_Text: But a better fishing pole wouldn’t hurt if you’re trying to catch those feisty ones.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.70_Text: But a better fishing pole wouldn’t hurt if you’re trying to catch those feisty ones.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.119_Text: But that seems like too much to ask nowadays.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.68_Text: But we both know it’ll need to be done one day.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.162_Text: Did you just walk in here?//Well then, welcome.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.140_Text: Do you know what I’m talking about? Cockle, murex. That kind.//<portrait=normal>You’ll get a lot for them.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.29_Text: Even though I don’t fish for living anymore, I still like to read about fish. Find anything interesting lately?
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.33_Text: Even though I don’t fish for living anymore, I still like to read about fish.//Found anything interesting lately?
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.27_Text: Fishing can be a way to spend quality time with friends and family. It can also improve your concentration.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.31_Text: Fishing can be a way to spend quality time with friends and family. It can also improve your concentration.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.39_Text: Fishing can be a way to spend quality time with friends and family. It can also improve your concentration.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.14_Text: Fishing is a great skill to cultivate. It builds character and takes patience.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.6_Text: Fishing is a great skill to cultivate. It builds character and takes patience.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.157_Text: Ha ha! Sure. You can tell him I said that.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.155_Text: Ha! <NpcName>Sam</> said that, didn’t he? His head is bigger than I thought.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.83_Text: Have you caught much salmon lately?
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.151_Text: I also know with <NpcName>Theo</>, you can’t force him.//He’d just shut his door tighter. Being patient is the best thing I can do for him.//And it’s so hard.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.129_Text: I can’t help you much here. You’ll have to come see me at the Beach Shack if you need bait.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.153_Text: I can’t make anybody see what they don’t see, especially <NpcName>Theo</>.//It hurts to see him suffering, but I can’t make him talk to me if he doesn’t want to.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.12_Text: I do tai chi on my day off and spend the rest of the day foraging around.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.16_Text: I do tai chi on my day off and spend the rest of the day foraging around.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.22_Text: I do tai chi on my day off and spend the rest of the day foraging around.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.148_Text: I don’t force my children to do anything. But surely, offering simple guidance to make sure they take the right path in life doesn’t count as forcing.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.91_Text: I don’t know how you do it, walking around in the snow and the cold.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.92_Text: I don’t know how you do it, walking around in the snow and the cold.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.2_Text: I don’t know why <NPCName>Connor</> lets anyone move in. Our community is great just as it is.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.146_Text: I don’t recommend eating shells like the ones scattered on the beach.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.47_Text: I fish after work when I don’t feel too tired. I suppose that’s the problem with being an old man. Even fun seems like hard work.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.50_Text: I fish after work when I don’t feel too tired. I suppose that’s the problem with being an old man. Even fun seems like hard work.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.55_Text: I fish after work when I don’t feel too tired. I suppose that’s the problem with being an old man. Even fun seems like hard work.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.102_Text: I guess I’m glad I’ll be spending my day next to a stove.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.106_Text: I guess I’m glad I’ll be spending my day next to a stove.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.96_Text: I guess I’m glad I’ll be spending my day next to a stove.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.99_Text: I guess I’m glad I’ll be spending my day next to a stove.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.23_Text: I just try to live a quiet life, <PlayerName>$player</>.//I don’t want attention.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.150_Text: I know my son is having a hard time letting his mother go, even after all these years.//<portrait=concerned>It makes me sad to see him hurting, but…
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.11_Text: I like cooking, especially if the ingredients are fresh from nature and not store bought.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.15_Text: I like cooking, especially if the ingredients are fresh from nature and not store bought.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.21_Text: I like cooking, especially if the ingredients are fresh from nature and not store bought.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.60_Text: I like to think I’ve caught almost all the kinds of fish that live around here. There are more than fifty, you know.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.65_Text: I like to think I’ve caught almost all the kinds of fish that live around here. There are more than fifty, you know.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.73_Text: I like to think I’ve caught almost all the kinds of fish that live around here. There are more than fifty, you know.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.152_Text: I overheard <NpcName>Lily</> talking to her mother last night.//It broke my heart. My poor girl.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.67_Text: I remain conflicted about not fixing up the shack. I know <NpcName>Sunny</> doesn’t want to do it.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.53_Text: I remain conflicted about not fixing up the shack. I know <NpcName>Sunny</> doesn’t want to do it. But we both know it’ll need to be done one day.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.87_Text: I should collect more wood for smoking fish.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.84_Text: I still fish here and there, you know, especially now that it’s salmon season.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.85_Text: I still fish here and there, you know, especially now that it’s salmon season.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.24_Text: I think a lot of people who live here are the same way.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.149_Text: I think not guiding them would be unfatherly.//That would make me a bad parent.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.121_Text: I think this might be the best place to forage for mushrooms.//But I don’t know about the forest, since I haven’t been there in a while.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.20_Text: I used to fish for a living, but I passed the torch to my son, <NpcName>Theo</>.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.3_Text: I used to fish for a living, but I passed the torch to my son, <NpcName>Theo</>.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.137_Text: I usually order hot tea at the Tavern. Beer is not for me.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.118_Text: I want to have a relaxing day without bothering anybody. And vice versa.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.45_Text: I wouldn’t be too worried about being bad at fishing. It’s one of those things that improve with practice.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.56_Text: I wouldn’t be too worried about being bad at fishing. It’s one of those things that improve with practice.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.69_Text: I wouldn’t be too worried about being bad at fishing. It’s one of those things that improve with practice.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.117_Text: If it isn’t your knees, it’s your hips. That’s old age for ya, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.126_Text: If it isn’t your knees, it’s your hips. That’s old age for ya, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.123_Text: If you go to the beach, could you tell <NpcName>Theo</> not to sell his whole catch and to bring some fish home?
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.112_Text: If you want to talk, <NpcName>Sunny</> seems to be in the mood to chat.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.54_Text: In his defense, it’s where all his memories with… Never mind.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.133_Text: It was fine the way it was. Why would you put some silly fish on the roof?//I’ll never understand.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.86_Text: It’ll be another year before we can enjoy the Summer breeze. The Fall breeze isn’t the same.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.82_Text: It’s <NpcName>Sam’s</> birthday tomorrow. I think I’ll stop by in the morning to give him some of his favorite blueberry tarts.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.4_Text: It’s exciting when you get a bite.//<portrait=normal>And some kinds of bait and certain lures will help you fish better.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.7_Text: It’s exciting when you get a bite.//<portrait=normal>And some kinds of bait and certain lures will help you fish better.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.161_Text: It’s inevitable for us to get visitors, I suppose. Having to live in town and all.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.26_Text: It’s not wise to show off too much beauty. It’s sad, it’s unfair. But so is life.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.38_Text: It’s not wise to show off too much beauty. It’s sad, it’s unfair. But so is life.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.134_Text: I’m glad <NpcName>Lily</> got that IT job.//She isn’t very outgoing. I don’t think she’d like a regular office job in the city.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.127_Text: I’m inclined to say you’re lost, but I’m not sure.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.51_Text: I’m never not tired. It’s not even a question anymore, just a matter of fact, no matter how much rest I get.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.156_Text: Let me tell you my side of things. Sure, <NpcName>Sam</> beats me at chess, but it’s only because I’m usually too busy to play more than one game.//I’m not in the right frame of mind to play.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.36_Text: Like what? Hmm… Trash, for instance. You can easily catch trash.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.42_Text: Like what? Hmm… Trash, for instance. You can easily catch trash.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.122_Text: Maybe the forest is better for gathering mushrooms. I don’t know.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.116_Text: My knees hurt. I think I may have been walking too fast.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.125_Text: My knees hurt. I think I may have been walking too fast.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.18_Text: Nature is very giving. There’s plenty of food in the forest and around the lake.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.9_Text: Nature is very giving. There’s plenty of food in the forest and around the lake.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.104_Text: Not all fish like the Winter water. Too cold for them.//So, there’s only certain kinds of fish you can catch now.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.107_Text: Not all fish like the Winter water. Too cold for them.//So, there’s only certain kinds of fish you can catch now.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.108_Text: Not all fish like the Winter water. Too cold for them.//So, there’s only certain kinds of fish you can catch now.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.75_Text: Now that Spring is finally here, I can start gathering some shiitake again.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.76_Text: Now that Spring is finally here, I can start gathering some shiitake again.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.95_Text: Oh, is it raining?//No wonder it’s colder than usual.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.98_Text: Oh, is it raining?//No wonder it’s colder than usual.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.105_Text: Oh, is it snowing?//You have white stuff on your clothes.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.80_Text: Oh, that’s true. Calendars nowadays already have festivals and birthdays on them.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.131_Text: Red velvet cake is <NpcName>Betty’s</> favorite, if I’m not mistaken.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.142_Text: She doesn’t talk very much. She looks like her mother, but she got her personality from me. Should I be worried?
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.128_Text: Since you’re here, please excuse me while I get on with it.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.5_Text: Sometimes, you can waste a lot of time without getting much in return, though.//You have to be patient.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.8_Text: Sometimes, you can waste a lot of time without getting much in return, though.//You have to be patient.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.79_Text: The Cherry Blossom Festival is on the 10th. Jot it down on your calendar.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.132_Text: The Tavern used to be known as just that, the Tavern.//<portrait=normal>People here know what it is. They changed the name to Fishensips now. Ridiculous.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.144_Text: The lake and creeks around town are rich with fish.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.30_Text: The library has all kinds of informative books about fish, crops, and other topics if you’re interested.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.34_Text: The library has all kinds of informative books about fish, crops, and other topics if you’re interested.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.100_Text: The rain brings out different kinds of fish.//Giant mudskippers are easier to catch in this weather.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.97_Text: The rain brings out different kinds of fish.//Giant mudskippers are easier to catch in this weather.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.81_Text: The water is warm this time of year.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.48_Text: There are all kinds of different fish. Some of them are only out at night, so you need to keep the timing in mind if you’re looking for something specific.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.58_Text: There are all kinds of different fish. Some of them are only out at night, so you need to keep the timing in mind if you’re looking for something specific.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.62_Text: There are all kinds of different fish. Some of them are only out at night, so you need to keep the timing in mind if you’re looking for something specific.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.135_Text: There are fish that you can only catch on rainy days.//You need to know these things.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.136_Text: There are night fish as well.//There should be information about fish and bugs on TV.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.61_Text: There’s no prize for it. But it’s nice to know I’ve done it.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.66_Text: There’s no prize for it. But it’s nice to know I’ve done it.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.74_Text: There’s no prize for it. But it’s nice to know I’ve done it.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.44_Text: Things are too easy for this generation. Everything seems to be online now. Is that a good thing or a bad thing? I don’t know.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.64_Text: Things are too easy for this generation. Everything seems to be online now. Is that a good thing or a bad thing? I don’t know.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.72_Text: Things are too easy for this generation. Everything seems to be online now. Is that a good thing or a bad thing? I don’t know.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.139_Text: Those empty shells are worth quite a bit, and new ones wash ashore just about every day.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.10_Text: Watch out for poisonous plants, though. Plenty of those too.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.19_Text: Watch out for poisonous plants, though. Plenty of those too.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.103_Text: Watch your head. It’s quite the storm!
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.90_Text: Watch your step, please. Slippery floor.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.77_Text: Watch your step. I don’t want anybody to slip in my kitchen.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.78_Text: Watch your step. I don’t want anybody to slip in my kitchen.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.145_Text: What are you doing here, kid?
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.154_Text: What do you do now? Surely you can’t farm in Winter?
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.115_Text: What do you need here, farmer?
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.88_Text: Yes, you do need wood to smoke fish.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.114_Text: You can buy premade meals from <NpcName>Sam</> or <NpcName>Frank</> at the Tavern.//<portrait=normal>He’s quite a cook and has a lot of different home-cooked meals to choose from. If you like stuff like that.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.143_Text: You can catch king salmon at sea on Summer nights. I picked up that little piece of info in my fishing days.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.35_Text: You can catch more than fish in the sea.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.41_Text: You can catch more than fish in the sea.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.49_Text: You can only make smoked salmon using salmon. I thought that was obvious, you know, given the name.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.59_Text: You can only make smoked salmon using salmon. I thought that was obvious, you know, given the name.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.147_Text: You can sell those, but maybe don’t eat them.//Eat fish instead.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.160_Text: You certainly come to the house a lot, don’t you? Are you looking for my children?//I heard you’re friends.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.158_Text: You do come here a lot, don’t you?//That’s nice.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.109_Text: You own the farm. Errr… I want to say you’re, errr…<PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.164_Text: You smell that?//I’m making fish stew.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.93_Text: You’ll eventually find out who everyone really is if you give it some time. Some you’ll get along with, and some you won’t, and that’s okay.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.159_Text: You’re not supposed to be back here.//Cook only.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.1_Text: You’re…the new farmer?//Tch. I see. No offense, but you look like you’ve never held a tool in your life.
DT_Dialogue_Jim_Production.120_Text: [He’s doing his weekend stretches. Better leave him alone.]

DT_Dialogue_JioDan_Production.8_Text: Anything that can go wrong will go wrong.//Always prepare for the worst.
DT_Dialogue_JioDan_Production.7_Text: Don’t go anywhere unprepared, especially if you have the time to make a plan before you go.//That would be dumb.
DT_Dialogue_JioDan_Production.17_Text: If you’re bad at combat, get better at it.//Problem solved.
DT_Dialogue_JioDan_Production.12_Text: It matters what type of monsters you slay.//Some are stronger than others.
DT_Dialogue_JioDan_Production.2_Text: Looking for weapons?//I might have some.
DT_Dialogue_JioDan_Production.9_Text: No matter how sharp your sword is, if you can’t use it properly, it means nothing.//Useless. You hear me?
DT_Dialogue_JioDan_Production.6_Text: Size means nothing.//If you get intimidated easily, maybe combat isn’t for you.
DT_Dialogue_JioDan_Production.5_Text: The key to getting better at combat is training.//That’s what all my students do.
DT_Dialogue_JioDan_Production.15_Text: Use your gardening tools to fight. I don’t care.//Just be good at it.
DT_Dialogue_JioDan_Production.3_Text: We don’t “hang out.” We’re here to keep watch over that cavern and whatever curse might be in there.
DT_Dialogue_JioDan_Production.14_Text: You <Italic>do</> know how to make traps?
DT_Dialogue_JioDan_Production.10_Text: You should always bathe after a trip to the cavern.//Everyone will appreciate it.

DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.190_Text: <NPCName>Archie</> has <NPCName>Dinda’s</> empathetic personality, that’s for sure.//He’d make a great vet.//Umm, nope.//<portrait=happy>He <Italic>will</> make a great vet.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.304_Text: <NPCName>Archie’s</> been asking us to get a pet ferret. I’m running out of ways to say no.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.138_Text: <NPCName>Bree</> and <NPCName>Walter</> are the other farmers in town.//They run the vineyard.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.118_Text: <NPCName>Dinda</> and I actually knew each other in grade school! Can you believe it?
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.136_Text: <NPCName>Dinda</> and I have been on Coral Island for…wow, has it been ten years already?//Gosh, must’ve been more!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.106_Text: <NPCName>Dinda</> and I used to live in Indonesia. We fell in love with the quiet, peaceful life on the island!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.194_Text: <NPCName>Dinda</> surprised me with a beautiful bouquet of wooden flowers the other day.//<portrait=normal>She made them herself!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.291_Text: <NPCName>Dinda’s</> always growing something in her herb garden!//<portrait=concerned>But between you and me, it’s mostly mint.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.142_Text: <NPCName>Rafael Sanchez</> doesn’t talk much, but he doesn’t have to.//<portrait=normal>His craftsmanship speaks for him.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.229_Text: <NPCName>Surya</> loves working with <NPCName>Ling</> in the lab.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.172_Text: <NPCName>Surya</> said there are whales not too far from here! I’d love to see them one day.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.187_Text: <NPCName>Theo</> is one of the most positive people I know. I’m not sure how he does it, given–
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.46_Text: <NpcName>Archie</> is fine, though he’ll go through a period of picky eating sometimes. But what kid doesn’t, right?
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.43_Text: <NpcName>Archie</> is fine, though he’ll go through periods of picky eating sometimes. But what kid doesn’t, right?
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.22_Text: <NpcName>Dinda</> loves gardening, flower bouquets, salad, and pearls. I honestly don’t think she hates anything.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.75_Text: <NpcName>Surya</> is my brother Suparmo’s oldest son.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.31_Text: A new day is here, and the birds are singing. What more could we ask for?
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.11_Text: After school, I try to take <NpcName>Archie</> to the creek in the forest. I want to teach him things I learned in my childhood.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.12_Text: After school, I try to take <NpcName>Archie</> to the creek in the forest. I want to teach him things I learned in my childhood.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.104_Text: Ah, I’m going to miss the snow.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.201_Text: And when the leaves fall off, you can really see how much yield a tree will give. It’s gorgeous!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.84_Text: Are you planting melons this year? It’s a popular fruit in our household.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.79_Text: As a farmer, you must spend a lot of your time outdoors too, I figure.//Well, at least for us, fresh air isn’t a problem. Heh heh.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.308_Text: As if they cared about the environment!//<portrait=annoyed>As if they cared about the welfare of our town! Hypocrites! They want to destroy this place!//I was so mad I almost walked out.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.272_Text: But I don’t want to hold him back just for my peace of mind.//Hardest thing about being a parent.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.288_Text: But it’s hard work, chopping down trees all day. I think it’s actually just the flannel I like.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.131_Text: But like I said, can’t really talk today.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.198_Text: But look who I’m talking to! I don’t need to tell you that, do I?
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.133_Text: But people seem to love the work I do. I feel so blessed!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.135_Text: But people seem to love the work I do. I feel so blessed!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.127_Text: Can’t stop to talk today. Just got a huge order!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.165_Text: Did you know there are over seventeen species of trees growing on Coral Island?//<portrait=happy>Well, now you do!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.42_Text: Do you get your wood from the forest? I go there too because it’s close to the house.//There are plenty of places on the island to harvest wood, though, if you need more.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.47_Text: Do you get your wood from the forest? I go there too because it’s close to the house.//There are plenty of places on the island to harvest wood, though, if you need more.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.51_Text: Do you get your wood from the forest? I go there too because it’s close to the house.//There are plenty of places on the island to harvest wood, though, if you need more.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.96_Text: Do you have a lot of pumpkins on your farm, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.161_Text: Do you know <NPCName>Bree</> from the vineyard yet? I heard she used to be a model.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.280_Text: Don’t get too close. Sawdust everywhere.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.153_Text: Don’t let her prickly demeanor fool you, though. She’s a good person at heart.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.145_Text: Ever tried a yoga class with <NPCName>Leah</>? I love it! She’s a wonderful instructor.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.223_Text: Hardwood is great to work with. I find a ton down in the deep forest.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.199_Text: Have you checked out the Fall colors yet?
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.166_Text: Have you met <NPCName>Zarah</> yet? She’s very mysterious, always coming and going!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.141_Text: Have you met my nephew yet? <NPCName>Surya</>? He’s a lovely fellow!//You should stop by the lab and say hello.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.99_Text: Have you tried to make any crafts, like scarecrows? They can be very helpful on your farm.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.150_Text: He was hesitant at first, but I wouldn’t take no for an answer! He’s family.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.122_Text: Hey, there, <PlayerName>$player</>! Working hard or hardly working?
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.76_Text: He’s a smart one, you can just tell.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.171_Text: He’s actually very convincing. The only problem is I keep finding nuts hidden around the house.//<portrait=normal>He sure loves animals, that one.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.151_Text: He’s also a great addition to family board game night. So, win-win!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.207_Text: Hot enough for ya? ’Cause it sure is for me.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.18_Text: How are you doing today, <PlayerName>$player</>? Things going okay on the farm?
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.16_Text: How’s the farm so far, <PlayerName>$player</>? You know, you can build a greenhouse on your farm to plant more crops. It’s not easy, but it would be worth it. You could grow anything in it year round.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.35_Text: How’s the farm so far, <PlayerName>$player</>? You know, you can build a greenhouse on your farm to plant more crops.//It’s not easy, but it would be worth it. You could grow anything in it year round.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.182_Text: How’s the soil today, <PlayerName>$player</>? Nutrient rich, I hope!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.191_Text: I almost sawed through my wallet in my workshop earlier today!//That’s never happened before.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.58_Text: I always feel good after a whole day of hard work. It’s great to feel productive!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.124_Text: I always keep my tools handy. You’d be surprised how often you need a screwdriver.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.282_Text: I built that little garden over there for <NpcName>Dinda</>.//<portrait=happy>An anniversary gift. Looks pretty solid, right? It hangs great too.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.257_Text: I can almost smell it right now. Ugh…//Feels like I got some stuck in my nose. Blech!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.269_Text: I can see <NpcName>Archie</> growing up to be like <NpcName>Zarah</>. Always on the go. An adventurer.//I think as long as I teach him all the skills I have, he’ll do fine.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.25_Text: I can still feel a bit of a pinch when I stretch in a particular position. Don’t worry, though. I’m fine, thanks.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.108_Text: I can’t imagine a better life than working with my wife, <NPCName>Dinda</>.//<portrait=happy>She’s like my varnish – I’m just not complete without her.//<portrait=happy>Look at me, all <Italic>lovey-dovey</>! Heh heh!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.235_Text: I don’t have any projects to do today, so I think I’ll stay indoors and avoid the storm.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.195_Text: I don’t know how she found the time to make them without me knowing.//She’s so sweet! And sneaky!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.298_Text: I don’t know, though. There’s something special about keeping it in the family.//Maybe I can reach out to more cousins to work there.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.239_Text: I don’t mind the snow if I have a project that needs doing.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.241_Text: I don’t mind the snow if I have a project that needs doing.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.232_Text: I don’t mind working in the rain if I have a project that needs doing.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.237_Text: I don’t mind working in the rain if I have a project that needs doing.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.102_Text: I don’t mind working on projects in Winter. Keeping busy warms me up.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.215_Text: I don’t think I’ll go back to work today. I’ll just relax and see my friends.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.302_Text: I don’t think he knows I know.//But I know.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.175_Text: I enjoy those too, but sometimes I miss the old days.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.87_Text: I feel incredibly old now that I’ve started bragging about waking up early. Heh heh.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.266_Text: I finished the whole jar, and now I’m paying for it.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.39_Text: I get too busy during the week. I can only make it to yoga classes on Saturdays.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.52_Text: I get too busy during the week. I can only make it to yoga classes on Saturdays.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.271_Text: I get worried a lot, thinking about <NpcName>Archie</> in the forest somewhere, alone, hurt.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.265_Text: I had some bad yogurt the other day. I knew it was kind of bad when I ate it. Halfway in, I realized it tasted funny.//But I didn’t listen to myself.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.285_Text: I had to throw out an old bookshelf the other day.//A client asked me to fix it for him, but it was totally infested with termites.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.270_Text: I have no doubt <NpcName>Archie</> will learn more skills as he grows older.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.21_Text: I have no doubt that if she opened a restaurant, she’d have lots of loyal customers.//<portrait=happy>And one of them would be me. Heh heh.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.284_Text: I have to pick up a tool from <NpcName>Rafael</> tomorrow. Hopefully, he’s around.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.262_Text: I heard from <NpcName>Rafael</> that the cemetery has been extra moldy lately.//Must be from all the snow last week.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.245_Text: I hope we get some rain soon.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.246_Text: I hope we get some rain soon.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.92_Text: I know it’s irrational, but I can’t help it sometimes.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.263_Text: I like staining wood more than making furniture.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.221_Text: I like teaching <NPCName>Archie</> fishing.//It’s a good skill to have.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.9_Text: I like to stretch my legs after work, and I usually end up at Fishensips.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.38_Text: I like working outdoors when it isn’t raining.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.117_Text: I love stepping into the workshop in the morning. It’s my happy place.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.154_Text: I love the smell of sawdust in the morning!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.295_Text: I love the water, but I try not to go to that strange temple on the other side of the island.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.200_Text: I love this time of year. The air is crisp, the leaves put on a beautiful show…
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.203_Text: I love watching the snow fall!//<portrait=concerned>From inside, of course.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.110_Text: I love watching them play together.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.115_Text: I made a little table for <NPCName>Archie</> when he was a toddler.//He loved it!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.49_Text: I make it a habit to come to the town on weekends for some yoga.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.93_Text: I make sure to buy a few extra pumpkins for <NpcName>Archie</> and me to carve.//<portrait=happy>Now that the weather is nice, we just chill around the house and carve.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.85_Text: I might go down to <NPCName>Sam</>’s and see if he’s got any melons.//You know, to score extra brownie points with <NpcName>Dinda</>.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.210_Text: I might go to the forest tomorrow and get some more wood.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.177_Text: I might make her a custom chessboard as a thank-you. Don’t tell her, though. I want it to be a surprise!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.228_Text: I must have watched it for fifteen minutes.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.317_Text: I need to start thinking about an anniversary present soon.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.286_Text: I put it out on the street for just a minute, but when I came back, it was gone! Didn’t even have the chance to take it over to the recycling center.//<portrait=concerned>And later, I could have sworn I saw it outside <NPCName>Ben’s</> caravan.//Should I warn him about the termites? I think maybe I should.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.169_Text: I really need to find the time someday.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.224_Text: I really should reorganize my workshop. But I’m always just so busy.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.274_Text: I remember thinking, “Wow! What a polite and thoughtful young man.” I taught him how to fish in the creek.//<portrait=normal>This was all before <NpcName>Archie</> was born. How time flies, eh?
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.303_Text: I saw <NPCName>Archie</> watching a grasshopper the other day. He watched it for over an hour.//<portrait=annoyed>Kids, huh?
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.183_Text: I saw <NPCName>Jack</> in yoga class last week!//He’s surprisingly flexible.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.192_Text: I saw <NPCName>Jim</> doing some kind of martial arts thing at the beach the other day.//Karate, maybe. It was interesting!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.307_Text: I saw a Pufferfish lobbyist at the beach cleanup the other day. I can’t believe the nerve of those…those…
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.29_Text: I saw a grown man throw a bucketful of ice onto himself, outside, in Winter. Why?
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.163_Text: I saw a wonderfully crafted banister at the vineyard the other day.//Rich mahogany, exquisite inlays, beautiful curves.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.293_Text: I still try to get out to the forest to whittle if I can.//The shop’s just so busy these days it’s hard to find the time.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.107_Text: I still try to make it home every now and again to visit family.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.301_Text: I think <NPCName>Surya</> still gets lost in the forest sometimes.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.81_Text: I think the Fall weather is coming.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.220_Text: I think this place should have a trivia night. Don’t you?
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.94_Text: I think this pumpkin carving thing will be a family tradition.//I can see it being passed down for generations.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.212_Text: I thought I’d stretch a bit here.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.119_Text: I took <NPCName>Archie</> up to the old lighthouse last weekend.//<portrait=happy>He spent all his time looking for merfolk.//<portrait=annoyed>He didn’t see any.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.299_Text: I tried to give <NPCName>Dinda’s</> nose a bop the other day, but I missed and bopped her eye instead.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.320_Text: I turned down five more jobs the other day. I’ve never felt so free!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.289_Text: I used to love climbing trees as a kid. Now, I guess I just cut them down.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.173_Text: I used to make fanciful artisan pieces.//<portrait=happy>Bookshelves with intricate scrollwork or handmade jigsaw puzzles.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.275_Text: I used to take <NpcName>Luke</> fishing by the pier. We’d hunt for bait and spend the whole day at the beach.//<portrait=happy>That kid turned red like a banana bruises. Very fast!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.292_Text: I used to whittle away hours in a forest just like this.//<portrait=happy>No, literally. I’d sit with my whittling knife for hours, carving fallen sticks into unicorns, chess pieces, you name it.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.305_Text: I want you to know how much I appreciate you as a friend, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.193_Text: I was going to ask him about it, but he looked like he wanted to be left alone.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.247_Text: I was going to chop some trees, but I think I will wait until tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.248_Text: I was going to chop some trees, but I think I will wait until tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.315_Text: I was going to make <NPCName>Yuri</> a custom chess set as a thank-you for introducing me to the game, but she keeps beating me!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.310_Text: I was trying to plan the perfect place to take her, but then I remembered she loves spontaneity.//So, I think the best plan might be to just go to the port and decide when we’re there!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.267_Text: I wonder if <NpcName>Archie</> is missing out on something, being an only child and all, you know.//I grew up with a sibling. Even now, in our old age, we stick together like peanut butter to the roof of your mouth.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.278_Text: I work outdoors and go to the forest a lot.//It’s better if I wear long pants, but in this heat? No. No can do! That’s what I say.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.277_Text: I work outdoors and go to the forest a lot.//It’s better if I wear long pants. I don’t want to get all kinds of bug bites on my legs from wearing shorts for fashion.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.243_Text: I'm going to nap after this.//I love the rain.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.152_Text: If <NPCName>Kira</> looks intimidating, it’s because she is.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.114_Text: If I were you, I’d hope she doesn’t expand.//<portrait=happy>She’d put you out of business!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.120_Text: If there’s one rule of woodworking, it’s this – respect the saw.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.45_Text: If you want to upgrade your cabin or build something, you need to supply the materials.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.279_Text: If you’re decorating, we make handcrafted knickknacks and furniture.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.32_Text: Indeed. I did wake up in a very good mood. Why not?
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.312_Text: It breaks my heart more than a little.//But the boy’s got to pursue his dreams, right? I want to encourage that.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.62_Text: It feels good to work with your hands, doesn’t it? You’re a farmer, <PlayerName>$player</>, you get it.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.64_Text: It feels good to work with your hands, doesn’t it? You’re a farmer, <PlayerName>$player</>, you get it.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.83_Text: It was much cooler last year.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.7_Text: It would be nice to have a big farm like yours. But then, taking care of it must be a big job.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.54_Text: It’s best to do it outside and do the easy woodwork indoors.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.128_Text: It’s from an independent video rental store on the mainland.//I know, how quaint! I think they still have movies on VHS.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.82_Text: It’s incredibly hot this year, I tell ya.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.233_Text: It’s nice sometimes when it rains like this. It cleans out the drainage system.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.238_Text: It’s nice sometimes when it rains like this. It cleans out the drainage system.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.40_Text: It’s not like they have yoga class any other day, anyway.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.48_Text: It’s probably not the healthiest thing to cut wood indoors, with the sawdust flying around and all.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.53_Text: It’s probably not the healthiest thing to cut wood indoors, with the sawdust flying around and all.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.219_Text: It’s probably not the worst idea to carry a sword or something when you go to the cavern.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.222_Text: It’s quiet here. So peaceful. One of my favorite places for sure.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.178_Text: I’d love to teach <NPCName>Archie</> more about woodworking.//But he seems to want to be a vet when he grows up, which is fine by me.//He should follow his heart.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.156_Text: I’ll tell you the same thing I tell my son, <NPCName>Archie</>. Measure twice, cut once.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.88_Text: I’m a bit busier than usual.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.164_Text: I’m a man who appreciates a fine banister.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.143_Text: I’m a woodworker, but people tend to think of me as a general handyman too.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.179_Text: I’m feeling a little under the weather today.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.176_Text: I’m getting into chess! I started playing with <NPCName>Yuri</> at the shack, and it’s really grown on me.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.77_Text: I’m going to focus on work today and have a quiet evening with a plate of banana fritters.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.276_Text: I’m kind of an expert at pumpkin carving, if I say so myself.//Not to brag, but I’ve been doing it since…oh boy!//<portrait=normal>Since before <NpcName>Archie</> was born. Taught young <NpcName>Luke</>. That was me!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.296_Text: I’m not a superstitious man, but something about that place just spooks me.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.100_Text: I’m not going to focus much on work today. It’s cold, and I could use some downtime.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.3_Text: I’m not one for gardening, but it would be nice to rely less on <NpcName>Sam</> for fresh fruit.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.5_Text: I’m not one for gardening, but it would be nice to rely less on <NpcName>Sam</> for fresh fruit.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.67_Text: I’m not trying to be difficult, but I can’t start working on a large project without payment.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.91_Text: I’m relieved the Harvest Festival ended without incident.//I’m always worried a booth might collapse or something.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.319_Text: I’m so happy now I’ve started being more selective with my work.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.316_Text: I’m still planning to, but I sure wish I could win a game once in a while.//<portrait=happy>Say, we should play sometime!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.218_Text: I’m sure <NpcName>Rafael</> and <NpcName>Pablo</> are the only blacksmiths around here. They’re the only ones who have the equipment to upgrade tools.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.97_Text: I’m sure your farm looks excellent! I’ll have to go and see it sometime.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.19_Text: I’m teaching <NpcName>Archie</> how to fish. The boy’s talented, but there’s definitely room for improvement.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.309_Text: I’m thinking about surprising <NPCName>Dinda</> with a second honeymoon soon.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.186_Text: I’m thinking about taking up calligraphy. You know, with all my spare time…
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.181_Text: I’m thinking of hiring <NPCName>Macy</> to take a family portrait.//<portrait=normal>She’s an excellent photographer!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.55_Text: I’m thinking of taking <NpcName>Archie</> to the forest tomorrow after school.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.249_Text: I’m used to having a big breakfast in the morning.//Now if I don’t, I get really hungry around 10 am.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.287_Text: I’ve always dreamed of being a lumberjack.//You know, spending the day in the woods, wearing one of those red flannel shirts.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.294_Text: I’ve been browsing TVs down at the electronics store lately.//I think it’s time for an upgrade.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.147_Text: I’ve been learning so much about marine life ever since my nephew, <NPCName>Surya</>, moved in with us.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.204_Text: I’ve been racking my brain, trying to think of what to get <NPCName>Dinda</> for her birthday.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.132_Text: I’ve been woodworking ever since I was young.//I just did it for fun, but I never thought I could turn my hobby into a career.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.134_Text: I’ve been woodworking ever since I was young.//I just did it for fun, but I never thought I could turn my hobby into a career.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.168_Text: I’ve never been diving in the ocean before, but my nephew, <NPCName>Surya</>, goes all the time. He tells me it’s beautiful down there.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.78_Text: I’ve spent a lot of time working outdoors this Summer.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.197_Text: Let me tell ya, there’s nothing like fresh produce.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.50_Text: Let’s face it, it’s an excellent excuse to see the islanders too.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.157_Text: Like it? I made it up myself!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.148_Text: Like, did you know octopuses have three hearts? Fascinating stuff!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.57_Text: Looking fresh there, <PlayerName>$player</>! You look like you got in some serious farming today.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.41_Text: My brother and I used to go fishing every day during Summer break. We’d disappear for the whole day, until sunset.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.1_Text: My day is going great, thank you for asking, <PlayerName>$player</>. How are you today?//<portrait=happy>Have you checked out my furniture store?
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.159_Text: My favorite day of the year is Beach Cleanup Day. Coral Island is beautiful, but it takes work to keep it that way!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.256_Text: My mom liked to make a dish with bamboo shoots. Where I’m from, bamboo shoots are easy to find. They’re everywhere!//I used to eat it almost every day. Got tired of it. The smell turns my stomach.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.14_Text: My nephew, <NpcName>Surya</>, is new in town. He studied the ocean, and he’s currently working for <NPCName>Ling</>.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.109_Text: My son, <NPCName>Archie</>, and <NPCName>Valentina</> get along really well!//<NPCName>Valentina</> is <NPCName>Rafael’s</> niece, you know. We see them all the time.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.170_Text: My son, <NPCName>Archie</>, has been pretending to be a squirrel for the past few weeks.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.189_Text: My son, <NPCName>Archie</>, is a huge animal lover. He’s always watching the animal channel on TV, learning all sorts of interesting facts.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.20_Text: My wife is a great cook. If she weren’t a carpenter, she’d probably be a chef. A big-name chef, I’m sure.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.113_Text: My wife, <NPCName>Dinda</>, keeps a garden. It’s small, but the herbs she grows are delicious.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.59_Text: My work requires me to have a lot of energy. So I make sure to start the day with a big breakfast every morning.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.66_Text: My work requires me to have a lot of energy.//So I make sure to start the day with a big breakfast every morning.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.313_Text: My workshop is a total mess!//<portrait=happy>Just the way I like it.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.130_Text: No problem for me, of course! I run a custom shop, you know, and I can make shelving to any specifications. It’s my passion.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.2_Text: No time like the present, I always say. Heh heh!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.318_Text: No woodcraft pieces. <NPCName>Dinda</> and I have done too many of those for each other over the years.//<portrait=happy>Instead, I think I’ll get her an air fryer. She’ll love it!//<portrait=concerned>Well…maybe I’ll keep thinking.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.185_Text: No, I don’t know when <NPCName>Kenny’s</> birthday is. Sorry!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.174_Text: Now I mostly make utilitarian pieces. Desks, tables, chairs. No frills, just practical.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.8_Text: Now that I think about it, I doubt I’d have the time for it.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.250_Text: Oh well. I need it anyway.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.23_Text: Oh! She hates avocados, ice cream, and mayonnaise.//Weird texture. To be frank, I’m no fan of mayonnaise either. It’s rather nasty.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.273_Text: Oh, <NpcName>Luke</>? Yes, I have some stories about him.//<portrait=normal>I’ve known his parents since before he was born. <NpcName>Dinda</> and I watched <NpcName>Luke</> grow up in our backyard.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.205_Text: Oh, it’s not for a while yet. But I’m terrible at coming up with gift ideas. This year, I want to be prepared!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.98_Text: One of these days, I’ll need to check on the community center and the lab to prepare them for Winter.//You know, just a quick inspection to make sure the heaters are working, the roofs aren’t leaking, and all that.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.101_Text: Our herb plants died. None of them can survive the Winter snow.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.240_Text: Our herb plants died. None of them can survive the Winter snow.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.242_Text: Our herb plants died. None of them can survive the Winter snow.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.112_Text: Over the years, I’ve gotten really good at making chairs.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.111_Text: People are so interesting, aren’t they? Everyone has a story!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.36_Text: Remember to take a rest, <PlayerName>$player</>. Wealth isn’t everything.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.121_Text: See how I still have all my fingers? That’s because I take the rule seriously.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.162_Text: She still is, of course.//<portrait=happy>A model citizen, that is!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.264_Text: Something about gliding the color on the wood… So satisfying!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.297_Text: Sometimes I think about hiring an extra hand down at the shop.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.103_Text: Sorry if I seem dusty. It’s not easy to get rid of sawdust.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.216_Text: Sorry if I seem dusty. It’s not easy to get rid of sawdust.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.27_Text: Sunday is our short day. We’re only open until oneish.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.300_Text: That’s like the worst possible place to bop.//Anyway, we spent the day at the clinic. She’s okay.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.144_Text: That’s okay. I love to help out!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.206_Text: The Harvest Festival is just around the corner!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.80_Text: The evenings have started to cool off a bit.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.213_Text: The house isn’t bad, eh? <NpcName>Dinda</> and I built it ourselves. Took us a long time, but it’s really sturdy!//We never thought we needed to expand, because we were too caught up in work.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.56_Text: The lake is too far from our house. I think by the time we went there to fish and came back, it would be close to midnight.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.33_Text: The library is full of information. And you know what they say about knowledge!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.90_Text: The mayor will have an empty booth for you to use if you decide to join in, <PlayerName>$player</>. I’ll make sure it’s nice and sturdy.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.105_Text: The snow may be melting soon, but the weather will still be chilly for at least a week.
