DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.17_Text: The soil here is very rich. When I take <NpcName>Archie</> to the forest, we always seem to stumble upon a new type of plant.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.69_Text: The thing with <NpcName>Archie</> is that if one of his friends is sick, the whole class will probably be sick. Then do you know who gets sick after that?
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.74_Text: The warmer weather is ahead. Are you planting any berries this Summer?
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.227_Text: The way it caught yesterday’s sawdust floating through the air was just… It was just magical.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.208_Text: There are simple craft projects you can make yourself to improve your farm, like scarecrows or lampposts.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.72_Text: There are simple craft projects you can make yourself to improve your farm.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.28_Text: There are some fascinating people on TV. Sometimes I’m at a loss for words.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.259_Text: There isn’t a better time to get windows installed than Summer.//<portrait=happy>Imagine this, a hot evening…you open the windows…and fall asleep in a nice breeze. Huh?
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.261_Text: There isn’t a better time to get windows installed than Winter.//<portrait=happy>Imagine this, an ice-cold evening…you close the windows…and fall asleep in a warm, toasty room. Huh?
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.202_Text: There’s nothing better than sitting with a cup of hot cocoa while looking at the snow.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.244_Text: There’s nothing like the sound of rain pitter-pattering over the workshop. I could listen to it all day!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.71_Text: There’s so much we can pass on to our children. The little things we, the parents, do can become their habits.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.290_Text: There’s something sad about that, isn’t there?//<portrait=normal>Well, best not to think about it!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.129_Text: They want new shelving for their store, but the dimensions are odd.//A few centimeters under industry standard, rounded corners…
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.24_Text: This job comes with its hazards. I threw my back out one time and had to be on bed rest for the rest of the year.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.137_Text: Time flies when you’re having fun!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.95_Text: To be frank, I don’t care much how our pumpkins look when I’m carving with <NpcName>Archie</>.//<portrait=happy>I just know it’s something he looks forward to every year, and it’s become a tradition.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.253_Text: Ugh, it’s time for my weekly yoga session. I can feel it in my hip.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.255_Text: We don’t do house calls for furniture painting.//But if you want new furniture, we often have some pieces at the store. Check it out!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.44_Text: We don’t sell our wood. We just don’t have the space to store that kind of inventory.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.258_Text: We have glass in our inventory for making windows.//<portrait=happy>Do you need any windows?
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.260_Text: We have glass in our inventory for making windows.//<portrait=happy>Do you need any windows?
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.314_Text: We have some iced tea in the fridge if you’re thirsty.//Help yourself.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.196_Text: We just harvested some fresh herbs from <NPCName>Dinda’s</> garden!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.4_Text: We plant a few vegetables and herbs, but our garden isn’t big enough to grow fruit.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.6_Text: We plant a few vegetables and herbs, but our garden isn’t big enough to grow fruit.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.209_Text: We sell some blueprints if you’d like to try one.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.73_Text: We sell some blueprints if you’d like to try one.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.116_Text: We use it for storage now, but looking at it still brings back happy memories.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.214_Text: We used to live in what’s now the workshop, behind the shop counter, until we wanted to enlarge our family.//Then we built the addition with extra bedrooms.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.188_Text: Well, it doesn’t matter. He’s a remarkable person.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.68_Text: Well, large projects are more like upgrading a house or building a coop. I don’t consider making a shipping bin or a chair a large project.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.63_Text: We’re lucky, <PlayerName>$player</>. Not everyone can do what we do.//Don’t be too hard on yourself, okay?
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.65_Text: We’re lucky, <PlayerName>$player</>. Not everyone can do what we do.//Don’t be too hard on yourself, okay?
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.234_Text: We’re not accepting new projects right now, but if you need an upgrade or want to buy anything, stop by tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.86_Text: What is it about Summer that makes people productive?//I woke up earlier than usual and got way more things done during the day.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.184_Text: What you heard is true.<NPCName>Kira</> doesn’t celebrate birthdays.//I think <NPCName>Kenny</> does, though.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.226_Text: When I walked into the workshop this morning, there was this amazing sunbeam streaming through the window.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.268_Text: When my brother and I were little kids, we had a lot of fun together.//The bond is different with siblings. I’m afraid I’m depriving <NpcName>Archie</> of that.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.149_Text: When my nephew, <NPCName>Surya</>, moved to town, I invited him to come live with us right away.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.180_Text: Whenever I start feeling sick, <NPCName>Dinda</> makes me tea with fresh peppermint from her garden.//It peps me right up!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.13_Text: Where I’m from, there are plenty of small islands too. Just like here.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.89_Text: With the Harvest Festival coming up, I have to make sure all the booths are ready to use and fix the broken parts.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.158_Text: Work is really picking up! I wonder if I’ll need to expand.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.123_Text: Working hard, I bet. Sorry, I didn’t mean to offend you.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.230_Text: Wow! You’re out and about!//I think I’ll stay indoors today because, you know…the rain.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.61_Text: You can buy the wall clocks if you like. They’re for sale.//Talk to <NpcName>Dinda</> for more information, though. She handles sales.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.225_Text: You can hear the wind whistling through the trees from here.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.30_Text: You can make a bouquet of flowers yourself. You just need to get the instructions from <NpcName>Dinda</> or <NpcName>Ben</>. The key is to get to know them a little, and they’ll probably teach you.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.60_Text: You can see our available projects at the cash register. We keep the catalog there.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.281_Text: You can talk to <NpcName>Dinda</> if you need something built.//She should be inside.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.311_Text: You know, I’m starting to realize <NPCName>Archie</> may not want to pursue woodworking like his old man.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.125_Text: You must have quite the green thumb, <PlayerName>$player</>!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.251_Text: You saw what?//A masked creature in the forest? What masked creature?//<portrait=normal>I’m in the forest a lot, but I haven’t seen this masked creature, thankfully.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.139_Text: You should go introduce yourself if you haven’t already.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.146_Text: You should join us in class sometime, <PlayerName>$player</>! You’d love it.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.126_Text: You should probably stop by the clinic to get that checked out.//<portrait=happy>Ha ha! I crack me up.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.252_Text: You sure it’s not just <NpcName>Ben</>, right?//<portrait=concerned>He could be dressing up for something, maybe. It gets very dark in there. You never know.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.140_Text: You’re a busy little bee, aren’t you? Well, don’t let me get in your way!
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.37_Text: You’re always welcome to our house for dinner. I know it’s hard to be away from family sometimes.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.155_Text: You’re not really in a talking mood today, are you, <PlayerName>$player</>?//I can tell. I have a sixth sense about these things.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.306_Text: You’re reliable, dependable.//Exactly the sort of person I like to be around.//<portrait=normal>I guess what I’m saying is I’d be happy to write you a recommendation letter.//You know. If it ever comes up.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.15_Text: You’ve met him, right? He’s about your age, I believe.
DT_Dialogue_Joko_Production.167_Text: Y’know, it’s not just wood that I work with. I also carve a mean jack-o’-lantern.

DT_Dialogue_Karen_Production.5_Text: Are you here to help us, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Karen_Production.4_Text: At Pufferfish, it’s all about work-life balance. We give our workers some weekends off so they can do personal things.
DT_Dialogue_Karen_Production.6_Text: I think you could really make a difference in the world. We could help you achieve that goal.
DT_Dialogue_Karen_Production.2_Text: Like our office?//<portrait=normal>At Pufferfish, we work hard all day and all night. It’s important that the office is as comfortable as possible.
DT_Dialogue_Karen_Production.3_Text: My office window gives me a full view of the workers.
DT_Dialogue_Karen_Production.7_Text: We can’t see the outdoors from the office.//That’s by design. We don’t need the distraction.
DT_Dialogue_Karen_Production.9_Text: We keep the office at the same temperature all year long.//There’s something about being just a little chilly that increases productivity.
DT_Dialogue_Karen_Production.10_Text: We provide our workers with coffee and water. Other drinks aren’t necessary.
DT_Dialogue_Karen_Production.1_Text: Would you look at that? If it isn’t the farmer!//What can I do for you?
DT_Dialogue_Karen_Production.8_Text: Your boots are covered in snow.

DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.276_Text: *shivering* Someone light a fire! I’m freezing in here!
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.E2AFCE8945625755D50646B062810A00: *shivering* Someone light a fire! I’m freezing in here!
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.02462AB6411200CA5297F0BE86F1FC2A: <NPCName>Ling</> has been trying to find the right formula to improve our fodder. That’s no rumor!
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.161_Text: <NPCName>Ling</> has been trying to find the right formula to improve our fodder. That’s no rumor!
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.167_Text: <NPCName>Luke</> was going to sell a self-stirring pot one time, but the product was pulled by the manufacturer before anyone had a chance to buy it.

DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.155_Text: <NPCName>Millie</> once told me evening snow made her feel like she was living inside a snow globe.//<portrait=daydreaming>She felt liberated yet fragile at the same time.

DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.3C061E2840384A1F6C5989BCB694D732: <NpcName>Joko</> takes his son fishing with him.//Reminds me of my own childhood with my old man.

DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.119_Text: <PlayerName>$player</>! Sorry, I just got a little lost in the color of the trees.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.D3C4817640029D9E42213B82B4896E53: <PlayerName>$player</>! Sorry, I just got a little lost in the color of the trees.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.363_Text: <PlayerName>$player</>, I– Oh no, I stepped on a worm!
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.F6CB826D4DF6BE3658E32097E5B69745: <PlayerName>$player</>, I– Oh no, I stepped on a worm!
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.0A458FB344C33C05B29D7585BC7F3BCA: <PlayerName>$player</>, have you fed your animals yet today? They could get sick if you forget to feed them.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.194_Text: <PlayerName>$player</>, have you fed your animals yet today? They could get sick if you forget to feed them.

DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.239_Text: <PlayerName>$player</>, whoa! Be careful!//<portrait=concerned>You almost stepped on that ant.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.75EA164B49377562474E13A00E50FEFF: <PlayerName>$player</>, whoa! Be careful!//<portrait=concerned>You almost stepped on that ant.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.175_Text: A bit too stuffy in here at the moment.//<portrait=concerned>I think the humidity is getting to us.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.41C6E2A44EE3A8D54874D19D836078A3: A bit too stuffy in here at the moment.//<portrait=concerned>I think the humidity is getting to us.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.175915B840DF5CE27ED45794C4C42786: A friend asked me if I’d ever seen anything weird in the forest. I told her yeah.//But I don’t go looking for it.//<portrait=smile>If it’s there, it’s there.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.306_Text: A friend asked me if I’d ever seen anything weird in the forest. I told her yeah.//But I don’t go looking for it.//<portrait=smile>If it’s there, it’s there.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.024D07DA477B82D7A5666E9BBC1162D4: A pleasant surprise, that is. A very pleasant surprise.//As if the universe wants us to spend the day together. Do you believe in things like that?

DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.9DA112B44BA9891978CB21804663DAEA: A pleasant surprise, that is. A very pleasant surprise.//As if the universe wants us to spend the day together. Do you believe in things like that?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.24_Text: Ah, I might go to Fishensips this weekend.//<portrait=normal>I don’t know.//Will you be there?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.8FC1A2234A27434921BF079EAC557A8C: Ah, I might go to Fishensips this weekend.//<portrait=normal>I don’t know.//Will you be there?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.345_Text: Ahh...smell that? That's the scent of Coral Island. Hope and dreams.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.D8FE3D094EDDB8D51FE2F89506CAECD8: Ahh...smell that? That's the scent of Coral Island. Hope and dreams.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.16FF8E044A66FA0532D2EB87E8657AE3: All this – the blooming flowers, the mesmerizing sound of the rain.//Running into you… They’re my favorite things.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.326_Text: All this – the blooming flowers, the mesmerizing sound of the rain.//Running into you… They’re my favorite things.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.327_Text: All this – the blooming flowers, the mesmerizing sound of the rain.//Running into you… They’re my favorite things.

DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.123C155545A2F520B8F4D988F21A6B20: All this – the blooming flowers, the mesmerizing sound of the rain.//Seeing you… They’re my favorite things.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.325_Text: All this – the blooming flowers, the mesmerizing sound of the rain.//Seeing you… They’re my favorite things.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.328_Text: All this – the blooming flowers, the mesmerizing sound of the rain.//Seeing you… They’re my favorite things.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.CF72564E42E6BBB7B805EC9255966E89: All this – the blooming flowers, the mesmerizing sound of the rain.//Seeing you… They’re my favorite things.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.13_Text: And maybe a handful of soybeans.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.4441D991448BB4BD350E54B33D97EFF8: And maybe a handful of soybeans.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.4_Text: Animals ain't much different from us folks.//<portrait=smile>That's somethin' my old man taught me.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.8B5C69F145BE4152B8AE10B6A0A87718: Animals ain't much different from us folks.//<portrait=smile>That's somethin' my old man taught me.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.10DFC7FB4D6464B5DFD28FA03CEE4132: Animals are fine listeners.//Even though they don't have a way of talking back to us, I always feel like they're taking in every word I say.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.237_Text: Animals are fine listeners.//Even though they don't have a way of talking back to us, I always feel like they're taking in every word I say.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.145_Text: Animals get cold too, especially when it’s snowing like this. Make sure to turn your heater on, okay?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.A8D99D5446D2BE1669C1E28CE61678E2: Animals get cold too, especially when it’s snowing like this. Make sure to turn your heater on, okay?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.232_Text: Animals that are taken care of well give the best milk, wool, and eggs.//The money from the sale sure keeps our local businesses afloat.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.E12CB24847072B10895E1A9AC7F2FEED: Animals that are taken care of well give the best milk, wool, and eggs.//The money from the sale sure keeps our local businesses afloat.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.375641A84601810004DF19BE3D7A6203: Another year has begun. These cherry blossoms are a beautiful reminder.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.55_Text: Another year has begun. These cherry blossoms are a beautiful reminder.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.56_Text: Are you close to <NPCName>Macy</>?//<portrait=normal>I believe it’s her birthday tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.58_Text: Are you close to <NPCName>Macy</>?//<portrait=normal>I believe it’s her birthday tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.A098A1F1423D0ECDDF7FABB2F3BA76F1: Are you close to <NPCName>Macy</>?//<portrait=normal>I believe it’s her birthday tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.CD09CB4647101DF92FA27E8362C33F63: Are you close to <NPCName>Macy</>?//<portrait=normal>I believe it’s her birthday tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.214_Text: Are you doing anything fun this weekend, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.6B97321940BD5F83C3141EA87A404465: Are you doing anything fun this weekend, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.183_Text: Are you familiar with <NPCName>Peanut</> and <NPCName>Butter</>?//They’re <NPCName>Frank</> and <NPCName>Erika’s</> cats.//<portrait=laugh>Brilliant little fellas. They know which furniture is theirs.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.55AAF2CE4AB2BA743B367AB6A7F096BD: Are you familiar with <NPCName>Peanut</> and <NPCName>Butter</>?//They’re <NPCName>Frank</> and <NPCName>Erika’s</> cats.//<portrait=laugh>Brilliant little fellas. They know which furniture is theirs.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.0934EAE94F27BCB38DEAABB89BABB36E: Are you going to the Winter Fair tomorrow?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.128_Text: Are you going to the Winter Fair tomorrow?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.286_Text: Are you here to get a tool fixed too?//It’s so nice to chat with <NPCName>Pablo</> and <NPCName>Rafael</> while they're workin'.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.9973FDED454850CC797137B17EE3913F: Are you here to get a tool fixed too?//It’s so nice to chat with <NPCName>Pablo</> and <NPCName>Rafael</> while they're workin'.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.225_Text: Are you planning to take home a new animal?//<portrait=normal>I can tell you which ones are the friendliest.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.2DC7E4DA4D98F81D590232A90D0D14E7: Are you planning to take home a new animal?//<portrait=normal>I can tell you which ones are the friendliest.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.130_Text: Aww… Well, if you have time, you should stop by. <NpcName>Luke</> and I are going tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.1A23B29D4AFCF14661C0C59250CEE9A2: Aww… Well, if you have time, you should stop by. <NpcName>Luke</> and I are going tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.52_Text: Being a first-time farmer must be challenging. There’s a lot to get used to, huh?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.902DC9D04CE0C1780E26F2A01550872F: Being a first-time farmer must be challenging. There’s a lot to get used to, huh?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.1A8677A54CB5D11DA9FB5EA59F15BC9D: Building a relationship is like growing a flower. It should happen organically.//You can’t force it. Relationships are fragile and beautiful.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.304_Text: Building a relationship is like growing a flower. It should happen organically.//You can’t force it. Relationships are fragile and beautiful.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.21_Text: But grass doesn’t grow in Winter.//Fact is, most plants don't. So...//<portrait=laugh>That’s when the ranch comes in handy.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.95A516FD48B17718BE0AAE8F539B9D12: But grass doesn’t grow in Winter.//Fact is, most plants don't. So...//<portrait=laugh>That’s when the ranch comes in handy.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.342_Text: But it wouldn't be fair to deprive the world of you, darlin'.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.7E88660345B7C4393B035A866EF77990: But it wouldn't be fair to deprive the world of you, darlin'.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.103_Text: But you sure wouldn't wanna be anywhere near me after work, phew!
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.5CB798324134BAA2B8ECF093D47C19B5: But you sure wouldn't wanna be anywhere near me after work, phew!
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.261_Text: C'mon now, <PlayerName>$player</>, let’s get you inside. Nighttime storms ain't nothin' to trifle with.//You can’t see if something’s flying through the air at you.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.BE078C324C44C58A0561AF9409CE0AEA: C'mon now, <PlayerName>$player</>, let’s get you inside. Nighttime storms ain't nothin' to trifle with.//You can’t see if something’s flying through the air at you.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.421B5EA8407A6ADE509AB29F3C497469: Can you hear it, <PlayerName>$player</>?//The trees, they're singin'. Buzzin' with joy that Spring's here at last.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.70_Text: Can you hear it, <PlayerName>$player</>?//The trees, they're singin'. Buzzin' with joy that Spring's here at last.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.127_Text: Can't for the life of me remember their name though.//They're shy little things, only bloomin' after sunset.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.3AE4D417426E2A1A057A08A546656CF0: Can't for the life of me remember their name though.//They're shy little things, only bloomin' after sunset.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.172_Text: Dad sautéed a questionable fruit from the forest one time, thinking it was jackfruit. Hmm…//<portrait=sad>The whole cabin smelled like rotten eggs for a week.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.9B7C9CA94A7D3B788B8F7DB55E390AAD: Dad sautéed a questionable fruit from the forest one time, thinking it was jackfruit. Hmm…//<portrait=sad>The whole cabin smelled like rotten eggs for a week.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.249_Text: Dang, it's been a steady downpour since this morning.//<portrait=sad>The animals aren’t going to be happy about being cooped up all day.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.57F381794FAC63F95BB381BB2CE3ACC7: Dang, it's been a steady downpour since this morning.//<portrait=sad>The animals aren’t going to be happy about being cooped up all day.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.258_Text: Did you like my dramatic voice?//<portrait=laugh>Maybe I should take up acting!
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.C2BCC57743498ECDBA0EACBE5190F0B5: Did you like my dramatic voice?//<portrait=laugh>Maybe I should take up acting!
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.347_Text: Do they have to be so…abrupt? Our meetings.//It feels like I could use a little more time with you.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.C213A7DE43A1B20244BA4A919DFD9287: Do they have to be so…abrupt? Our meetings.//It feels like I could use a little more time with you.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.235_Text: Do you check the weather forecast, <PlayerName>$player</>?//It's a good habit to have. Animals need shelter from the rain just like humans do.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.696206514F178618446F8BB34699F324: Do you check the weather forecast, <PlayerName>$player</>?//It's a good habit to have. Animals need shelter from the rain just like humans do.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.09EFADEF4B1F1A92D01B7FA34095C340: Do you ever daydream, <PlayerName>$player</>? It’s one of my bad habits.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.230_Text: Do you ever daydream, <PlayerName>$player</>? It’s one of my bad habits.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.361_Text: Do you ever just wonder what’s out there, <PlayerName>$player</>?//<portrait=daydreaming>What kind of amazin' wonders and new friends are out there, just beyond our reach?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.43DF3D6A4791C759F34B6DB3FF26673F: Do you ever just wonder what’s out there, <PlayerName>$player</>?//<portrait=daydreaming>What kind of amazin' wonders and new friends are out there, just beyond our reach?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.240_Text: Do you have a favorite animal, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.3D3314014B87ABCA41EB9F945628174A: Do you have a favorite animal, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.224_Text: Do you know <NPCName>Dippa</> well?//They came to the ranch the other day, and we talked for a while. They seem nice.//<portrait=smile>They sell their paintings at Socket & Pan. Love their paintings.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.6F96D9B14144991C59E14AB4FECC3BE4: Do you know <NPCName>Dippa</> well?//They came to the ranch the other day, and we talked for a while. They seem nice.//<portrait=smile>They sell their paintings at Socket & Pan. Love their paintings.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.291_Text: Do you know what an “automatic despiffer” is?//No? Well, at least I’m not the only one.//<portrait=concerned>I’ll have to figure out something to tell my old man.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.8CF9EF7F495CFCC1235CF5B269B81E20: Do you know what an “automatic despiffer” is?//No? Well, at least I’m not the only one.//<portrait=concerned>I’ll have to figure out something to tell my old man.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.117_Text: Do you think ranch animals notice the changing of the seasons as much as we do?//Do you think they notice the days getting shorter and the air getting colder?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.8D67D8834284EB751409DD9FDE300C85: Do you think ranch animals notice the changing of the seasons as much as we do?//Do you think they notice the days getting shorter and the air getting colder?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.28_Text: Don't you forget to keep their bellies full!//<portrait=normal>I'm hopin' that bit's clear as day.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.FF7EBB9C4AF20140F8160E91D650857C: Don't you forget to keep their bellies full!//<portrait=normal>I'm hopin' that bit's clear as day.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.65_Text: Even if I weren’t here, the natural world would keep on going without me.//<portrait=normal>Sounds a bit gloomy, I know, but there's a certain comfort in it for me.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.AE96FD4C4C8713DF7DFD01B8C3012A3B: Even if I weren’t here, the natural world would keep on going without me.//<portrait=normal>Sounds a bit gloomy, I know, but there's a certain comfort in it for me.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.09CF6C6F4D7F758DD79BE98474643314: Even though I'm happy here, I think 'bout it a lot.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.362_Text: Even though I'm happy here, I think 'bout it a lot.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.109_Text: Even though my parents don’t celebrate birthdays, they still love getting presents.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.89C9B4FB4FED31955673A28F4F5EF353: Even though my parents don’t celebrate birthdays, they still love getting presents.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.156_Text: Ever since, I’ve thought a lot about what she said.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.DA4820AC4A6B3D838F7493B9FC6B13C1: Ever since, I’ve thought a lot about what she said.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.82_Text: Fall is a pretty busy season for farmers, I bet. All the harvesting to do.//<portrait=normal>My old man's got me all tied up preppin' the animals for Winter.//<portrait=laugh>I guess I’m busy in Fall too!
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.A79138FA4603E84213C79997A0D29DFB: Fall is a pretty busy season for farmers, I bet. All the harvesting to do.//<portrait=normal>My old man's got me all tied up preppin' the animals for Winter.//<portrait=laugh>I guess I’m busy in Fall too!
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.354_Text: Fall is giving you a magnificent glow today.//<portrait=blushing>I hope your day so far has been as good as you look.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.7FE463D544A9F13DF50AA5B1A25B0455: Fall is giving you a magnificent glow today.//<portrait=blushing>I hope your day so far has been as good as you look.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.116_Text: Fall is the most delicious time of year! Nothing beats harvest time for a good meal…or five.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.E040F16342D6DC4E6717D582CD29818C: Fall is the most delicious time of year! Nothing beats harvest time for a good meal…or five.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.75_Text: Finally, Spring!//<portrait=daydreaming>I welcome the sound of the creatures coming back to life.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.F819D58E47004FE1278C8AA79F922EC8: Finally, Spring!//<portrait=daydreaming>I welcome the sound of the creatures coming back to life.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.111_Text: Funbucket, bless his little feathered heart, is one of our ducks.//But <NPCName>Ben</> comes by often to help out with the animals, and they seem to have bonded. So now, Funbucket is his duck too.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.455B6F134D247894DCCFF5A5CA3697A0: Funbucket, bless his little feathered heart, is one of our ducks.//But <NPCName>Ben</> comes by often to help out with the animals, and they seem to have bonded. So now, Funbucket is his duck too.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.69_Text: Good sense to keep things organized, mind you.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.7025CBA54B55292F188C6EB649D7455A: Good sense to keep things organized, mind you.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.277_Text: Got a blanket on you, <PlayerName>$player</>?//<portrait=concerned>No?//<portrait=normal>Well, that's alright then.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.B5B3F9BD4C4BC43AD2E071BE3D83430F: Got a blanket on you, <PlayerName>$player</>?//<portrait=concerned>No?//<portrait=normal>Well, that's alright then.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.1DA7C4344F6D558C80119FA509F6FECD: Gotta start gettin' ready for Spring, I tell ya.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.272_Text: Gotta start gettin' ready for Spring, I tell ya.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.151_Text: Ha ha ha. That cracked me up. You’re technically correct. I concur.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.2BC5200846D3CF12313157A9E7972C89: Ha ha ha. That cracked me up. You’re technically correct. I concur.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.61_Text: Had a bit of a morning. We had to nurse an injured cow.//<portrait=sad>She's fightin', bless her. I think she'll pull through.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.CE349DF14C6A4FE48EEB3882C006F611: Had a bit of a morning. We had to nurse an injured cow.//<portrait=sad>She's fightin', bless her. I think she'll pull through.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.322_Text: Happy Friday, <PlayerName>$player</>!//<portrait=concerned>Er, um… It’s already Saturday. Oops!
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.5194CDA442C87FD3CF50F3AB8DA1796C: Happy Friday, <PlayerName>$player</>!//<portrait=concerned>Er, um… It’s already Saturday. Oops!
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.62_Text: Has that ever happened at your farm?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.D0E495D64A6FA69082767D8DE45C85E3: Has that ever happened at your farm?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.144_Text: Have you checked on your animals today?//<portrait=smile>They could use extra love on days like this.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.9C7CE6BB4C258F49AE754AB5E29DDE61: Have you checked on your animals today?//<portrait=smile>They could use extra love on days like this.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.25_Text: Have you ever looked at the sky and wondered what’s out there?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.48C67BB14F7DC04E2FB86D8E32119817: Have you ever looked at the sky and wondered what’s out there?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.285_Text: Have you ever looked into an animal’s eyes and wondered what they’re thinking or what they’d say if they could talk?//<portrait=daydreaming>That's a thought that'll keep me occupied for hours.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.993CF0B54270AA3C2A8D19935F8CBB9C: Have you ever looked into an animal’s eyes and wondered what they’re thinking or what they’d say if they could talk?//<portrait=daydreaming>That's a thought that'll keep me occupied for hours.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.296_Text: Have you learned to cook anything tasty?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.F28616234B081ABE5FA594B1E37698A6: Have you learned to cook anything tasty?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.653B66404B97DA936E81DE8A3D650325: Have you planted any Spring flowers, <PlayerName>$player</>?//<portrait=laugh>Make sure your animals don’t snack on them!
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.66_Text: Have you planted any Spring flowers, <PlayerName>$player</>?//<portrait=laugh>Make sure your animals don’t snack on them!
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.0188F75A48A67EA63062D88A6EB2114A: Have you spent time down by the lake, <PlayerName>$player</>?//It’s gorgeous over there.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.204_Text: Have you spent time down by the lake, <PlayerName>$player</>?//It’s gorgeous over there.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.64_Text: Havin' my birthday in Spring, now that's a blessing.//<portrait=daydreaming>It feels like nature is putting on a show for me.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.E2247356426BF33EF75D42BD14039C19: Havin' my birthday in Spring, now that's a blessing.//<portrait=daydreaming>It feels like nature is putting on a show for me.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.198_Text: Hello, hello! None of the cows farted on me this morning, so I’m pretty sure that means it’s going to be a good day.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.63AA9F1E45CA117B78699AB07315493F: Hello, hello! None of the cows farted on me this morning, so I’m pretty sure that means it’s going to be a good day.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.279_Text: Hey, <PlayerName>$player</>! Watch where you step.//<portrait=normal>You never know where you’ll find manure!
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.5C965BDB4C9B6001C42A3785BAD5A148: Hey, <PlayerName>$player</>! Watch where you step.//<portrait=normal>You never know where you’ll find manure!
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.209_Text: Hey, <PlayerName>$player</>, get this!//<portrait=normal>I was about to eat my lunch yesterday when a deer wandered up next to me. I felt so bad for it that I gave it my edamame.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.78384DF14F0F15D9740FB280E947DBF8: Hey, <PlayerName>$player</>, get this!//<portrait=normal>I was about to eat my lunch yesterday when a deer wandered up next to me. I felt so bad for it that I gave it my edamame.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.288_Text: Hey, <PlayerName>$player</>. Is it just me, or does everything feel quieter around here?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.F9CD12044CA96FE2D29C26AC2B20BBFE: Hey, <PlayerName>$player</>. Is it just me, or does everything feel quieter around here?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.72_Text: Hey, you wanna join me and listen to the birds? They’re so cheerful right now.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.75B26C9542208C739114CEB8F18F90C5: Hey, you wanna join me and listen to the birds? They’re so cheerful right now.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.33_Text: Hmm... Times when my words don't quite cut it, I lean on my flute to do the speakin'.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.7616CFD845BBC7514703EE8EB9C19205: Hmm... Times when my words don't quite cut it, I lean on my flute to do the speakin'.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.118_Text: Hmm... What was I thinkin' 'bout again?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.AB68E25443E465A35223749125CA00A3: Hmm... What was I thinkin' 'bout again?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.264_Text: Hmm… Just look at her go…
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.87368CB54C5F97CFFA82F08E1C0CBA68: Hmm… Just look at her go…
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.219_Text: Hmm… Should I go for a swim later?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.4F7542DC4492B8094C916B84CBBA3626: Hmm… Should I go for a swim later?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.0803E35F4A4BEE8AE8E19A8433EC4A44: Hmm… What do you think that painting over there is trying to say?//It's got me curious.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.170_Text: Hmm… What do you think that painting over there is trying to say?//It's got me curious.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.200_Text: Hopefully, Bessie won’t step on it again.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.7F84548745E38E9026C13A8FDECA00D4: Hopefully, Bessie won’t step on it again.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.142_Text: Hopefully, it won’t happen, but the wind could wreck your roof.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.7682E8CD4BD3975E45FCEFA1EA085BBC: Hopefully, it won’t happen, but the wind could wreck your roof.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.339_Text: I almost passed out trying to get them off me!
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.A8CBE4994A6FB447C1C7759679BB4149: I almost passed out trying to get them off me!
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.245_Text: I always bring extra food for the ants when I come here.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.4FEF3446419475B90BE815B9644F30B2: I always bring extra food for the ants when I come here.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.105551704E1B8100387105A4ABDA5761: I always try to educate myself on animal health from books and the internet.//<portrait=concerned>I read a lot of things online. Some things are straight-up odd, I have to say.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.337_Text: I always try to educate myself on animal health from books and the internet.//<portrait=concerned>I read a lot of things online. Some things are straight-up odd, I have to say.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.207_Text: I better check that there weather forecast for tomorrow.//We’ll have to put the animals in the barn if it rains.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.3E421B1644AEC6D8120318955B8B4DAC: I better check that there weather forecast for tomorrow.//We’ll have to put the animals in the barn if it rains.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.148_Text: I can imagine watching the snow as it falls.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.F8833AC5478E2C9810728CA2C87ABB5E: I can imagine watching the snow as it falls.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.3316C3B54E1C7CD9AC2D378CAE6DC215: I can tell ya one thing, <PlayerName>$player</>, rancher to rancher.//You need to talk to your animals to connect with them.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.3_Text: I can tell ya one thing, <PlayerName>$player</>, rancher to rancher.//You need to talk to your animals to connect with them.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.248_Text: I can’t play my flute outside, either.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.423948CF4CD2E67F70638EA4B892D0FA: I can’t play my flute outside, either.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.67ABA7C64D2CB2018F0D33ACC7BD25FF: I can’t wait to hear the birds again, <PlayerName>$player</>. I miss their songs on my morning walks.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.92_Text: I can’t wait to hear the birds again, <PlayerName>$player</>. I miss their songs on my morning walks.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.343_Text: I consider myself lucky. My parents didn’t force their dreams on me.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.B055265D43A69006A8CDC98936324F82: I consider myself lucky. My parents didn’t force their dreams on me.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.340_Text: I don't like carryin' weapons.//If I'm attacked, then I'm attacked. It's all right.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.6947460447DAEE264903E3ADBC42A3AF: I don't like carryin' weapons.//If I'm attacked, then I'm attacked. It's all right.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.12_Text: I don’t carry a weapon or heavy armor around in my bag, only wooden flutes.//Harmless instruments.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.8A44CB084BA50F57150733BEAA1ED071: I don’t carry a weapon or heavy armor around in my bag, only wooden flutes.//Harmless instruments.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.19_Text: I don’t know. Any emergency.//<portrait=sad>I won’t jinx it.//<portrait=laugh>Don’t you worry, <PlayerName>$player</>! We’ll be just fine.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.73B031904141B011E3F5048AF5A6330A: I don’t know. Any emergency.//<portrait=sad>I won’t jinx it.//<portrait=laugh>Don’t you worry, <PlayerName>$player</>! We’ll be just fine.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.1277F59744BB222B439F1988E7BBF875: I don’t like processed foods, but I’m not gonna lie, I eat 'em  once in a while.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.43_Text: I don’t like processed foods, but I’m not gonna lie, I eat 'em  once in a while.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.22_Text: I don’t really go to the beach unless there’s an important event going on.//<portrait=sad>Yeah, no.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.994AE253406AB26113F56299F0B5E649: I don’t really go to the beach unless there’s an important event going on.//<portrait=sad>Yeah, no.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.311D909240521C408EA5DE83BB672D94: I don’t usually wear red. You see, I like to blend in with the forest.//This sweater makes me pop.//<portrait=happy>But it was free, so hey, what can I say?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.382_Text: I don’t usually wear red. You see, I like to blend in with the forest.//This sweater makes me pop.//<portrait=happy>But it was free, so hey, what can I say?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.141_Text: I don’t want to spread negativity, but you should always check your barn and chicken coop during a storm.//Especially a strong one like this.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.45EB1F3648F55F362869769BFDE40878: I don’t want to spread negativity, but you should always check your barn and chicken coop during a storm.//Especially a strong one like this.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.344_Text: I feel bad that my friend has that expectation imposed on him.//And he said the worst part is his parents mean well, which leaves him with nobody to blame.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.99290DCE4A2202DCEAAD9E8EF62437B5: I feel bad that my friend has that expectation imposed on him.//And he said the worst part is his parents mean well, which leaves him with nobody to blame.

DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.281_Text: I feel like I never stop cleaning in here, but I don’t mind.//If it keeps the animals happy, well, that's all the payment I need.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.A657AE6B4F2B9F7B86D2879921197260: I feel like I never stop cleaning in here, but I don’t mind.//If it keeps the animals happy, well, that's all the payment I need.

DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.EC43405E48C649E6CA9395A4EF2E008C: I found a gecko on the barn floor last week. It freaked out the cows a little, but I thought it was really cool!

DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.6B20015240A70A577BA6D0A0FCE145D9: I found this green jacket in one of Mom’s chests.//Can you believe it?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.033369264D8C35B4B0EB11967D98A9A9: I guess I’ve always known I wanted to work with animals.//I want to make sure they’re properly cared for.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.136_Text: I guess I’ve always known I wanted to work with animals.//I want to make sure they’re properly cared for.

DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.4554A7B14051C60F305E33B7931099E3: I guess it is kind of funny when it piles up on the cows’ backs.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.255_Text: I guess leaving animals out in the rain might make 'em cleaner, but it also gets 'em mighty upset.//<portrait=normal>You should always be sure your animals have a dry place to stay when it rains.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.43518A424FA268EBC8919BB54DEB4589: I guess leaving animals out in the rain might make 'em cleaner, but it also gets 'em mighty upset.//<portrait=normal>You should always be sure your animals have a dry place to stay when it rains.

DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.3A8F42BE4AA5700BEAF18784B924E809: I guess that’s what Fishensips is good for. Nothing warms you up like a hot tea on a chilly evening!
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.0A183CD34ED7516334B331AD5AE37C10: I guess you could call it moving out.//<portrait=laugh>Movin' a whole ten minutes away from home.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.350_Text: I guess you could call it moving out.//<portrait=laugh>Movin' a whole ten minutes away from home.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.17_Text: I have no worries when I’m around you. You seem like a loving person.//<portrait=normal>You just have that aura.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.3FB8B0A745408A9CDB2EE7B8A37B533D: I have no worries when I’m around you. You seem like a loving person.//<portrait=normal>You just have that aura.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.35_Text: I have to say I’m a little surprised to see you here, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.37_Text: I have to say I’m a little surprised to see you here, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.5935987340C4AB83CC93B58510FA0512: I have to say I’m a little surprised to see you here, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.665D2A434F3F1D5888908C8D0E3FFFD9: I have to say I’m a little surprised to see you here, <PlayerName>$player</>.

DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.47_Text: I hope Pufferfish changes their mind.//<portrait=sad>All I sense from this is negativity.

DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.2D9660EB4C4BDF4AF82AFA8736F3FC6E: I hope it clears up tomorrow. I really want to eat in the forest again.

DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.B6CD207C43234B1E3493CEB6DF7909DB: I hope this snow stops tomorrow.//Might go diggin' for root veggies after work.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.368_Text: I just can’t get this song right.//<portrait=sad>I’ve been working on it for weeks, but it’s not going well.

DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.32_Text: I prefer to have my lunch break outdoors. Be one with nature, yeah? 'Course, that's when the weather's agreeable.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.A3539705401A8A71637D2EBD223243D3: I prefer to have my lunch break outdoors. Be one with nature, yeah? 'Course, that's when the weather's agreeable.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.182_Text: I prefer to spend my time in nature.//<portrait=daydreaming>Here and the forest are two of my favorite places.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.A284282D4A412E2708A8708DF22D5EFB: I prefer to spend my time in nature.//<portrait=daydreaming>Here and the forest are two of my favorite places.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.0F20E9DB4E1677C98A8F509B2D2284C2: I ran into <NpcName>Joko</> a couple of times by the creek near <NPCName>Ben</>’s caravan. He seems to like fishing there.//Oh, I was on my way to the hot spring.

DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.113_Text: I reckon I say that every year, but this time I mean it!
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.D87FBF53445785E4CAB410BDAE702668: I reckon I say that every year, but this time I mean it!
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.181_Text: I remember Mom brought some weird things home from her combat excursions.//<portrait=smile>My treasure chest was full of silver spoons and colorful rocks.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.45030F274CC70DCF4A7D869294CEFC44: I remember Mom brought some weird things home from her combat excursions.//<portrait=smile>My treasure chest was full of silver spoons and colorful rocks.

DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.205_Text: I saw the most beautiful fish there the other day.//<portrait=daydreaming>It had this silver head and rainbow scales. I wonder if it’s rare.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.256_Text: I sleep so well when it’s raining.//<portrait=daydreaming>The <Italic>tap tap tap</> on my window is strangely comforting.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.F5C0AEB24D7673B0F28FA2B5A8F31483: I sleep so well when it’s raining.//<portrait=daydreaming>The <Italic>tap tap tap</> on my window is strangely comforting.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.26_Text: I spend a lot of my free time doing just that.//<portrait=daydreaming>Looking at the sky, letting my mind wander.//<portrait=normal>This world sometimes feels too small for my imagination.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.D148DF0F4A4CA477D3BB459035461BC6: I spend a lot of my free time doing just that.//<portrait=daydreaming>Looking at the sky, letting my mind wander.//<portrait=normal>This world sometimes feels too small for my imagination.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.77_Text: I think the daisies in Summer are nature telling us it’s happy and healthy. Don’t you think?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.E91886744CE162ABE1B38C9BF4F56498: I think the daisies in Summer are nature telling us it’s happy and healthy. Don’t you think?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.351_Text: I told my folks they can count on me to take care of the ranch, no matter what happens.//I won’t ever let it fall into someone else’s hands.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.60E34A974FCBCE751012B895A67DE3DC: I told my folks they can count on me to take care of the ranch, no matter what happens.//I won’t ever let it fall into someone else’s hands.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.199_Text: I took one of my tools to <NPCName>Rafael</> to repair. It came back good as new!
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.9D3045B8490BF22AC82FC3AAAA068486: I took one of my tools to <NPCName>Rafael</> to repair. It came back good as new!
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.60_Text: I try to stay away from animal products as much as I can.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.CE03B7104BB2F6FEC018A28C823DF77D: I try to stay away from animal products as much as I can.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.164_Text: I want to visit Stephen more often. He fascinates me. But I’m not too fond of the beach. Too far. The energy is all off over there.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.B214557141BEA2F4D9F8CC840603104A: I want to visit Stephen more often. He fascinates me. But I’m not too fond of the beach. Too far. The energy is all off over there.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.210_Text: I was going to give the deer my water, but I didn’t think it could drink out of a bottle.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.63C2E1054B2E43CD2CED548E3C54855B: I was going to give the deer my water, but I didn’t think it could drink out of a bottle.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.107_Text: I was shocked to wake up this morning and realize it’s already the 16th. *sighs*
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.9D8AE3AB417942B52B29DCBE21218CD7: I was shocked to wake up this morning and realize it’s already the 16th. *sighs*
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.358_Text: I was thinking Bessie Junior, but Dad doesn’t agree with me.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.6EFD9AEB43B1EA172EF4A7B69CC81725: I was thinking Bessie Junior, but Dad doesn’t agree with me.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.349_Text: I was thinking about using the extra room in the ranch.//Havin' my own little space with my stuff in it.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.B09D5FCE44FA0FAD6CD45580ED51EDF4: I was thinking about using the extra room in the ranch.//Havin' my own little space with my stuff in it.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.338_Text: I went into the cavern last week and got attacked by giant lava spiders! Phew.//I must've spooked 'em good.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.694D5AEC41AA8BE077C226A9EC1AD923: I went into the cavern last week and got attacked by giant lava spiders! Phew.//I must've spooked 'em good.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.45_Text: I went to town yesterday and saw a drilling corporation is moving its offices to Coral Island.//<portrait=concerned>I’m disappointed, to be honest.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.56B75C6B4C753F539919049E80393EB6: I went to town yesterday and saw a drilling corporation is moving its offices to Coral Island.//<portrait=concerned>I’m disappointed, to be honest.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.3046D4CC45B1AC8E8092339EC1A10E19: I wish I could hibernate like the bears. Sleep through the cold Winter and wake up when it’s warm again in Spring.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.88_Text: I wish I could hibernate like the bears. Sleep through the cold Winter and wake up when it’s warm again in Spring.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.266_Text: I wish I could still see the storm.//<portrait=normal>It was so much fun to watch while it was light!
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.59619509414C8CE8A20172B0C5766D45: I wish I could still see the storm.//<portrait=normal>It was so much fun to watch while it was light!
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.333_Text: I'll probably take over the ranch someday, just like my dad did.//And his mom before him.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.B0268E3747EA99807C9CD58158DDFCBB: I'll probably take over the ranch someday, just like my dad did.//And his mom before him.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.110_Text: If you want to win my mom over, she has a soft spot for flowers.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.65BE303F48936A7C9490F888677621B1: If you want to win my mom over, she has a soft spot for flowers.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.106_Text: Incredible how time flies, isn’t it?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.838DAC4B4B0A82FA818146B7AB5072C3: Incredible how time flies, isn’t it?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.48_Text: Is Pufferfish building a mini golf area in front of their office?//<portrait=annoyed>Ugh… I kind of want to play.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.873C04BB4C9A3E0A2F0C1EBF07A7DE98: Is Pufferfish building a mini golf area in front of their office?//<portrait=annoyed>Ugh… I kind of want to play.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.278_Text: Is it just me, or does snow make Winter nights twice as cold?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.B742ACFD49F38D413B62469051492311: Is it just me, or does snow make Winter nights twice as cold?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.380_Text: Is pumpkin carving still a thing around here?//I remember carving pumpkins when I was in grade school. We got to display them at the town fair.//<portrait=happy>Right, right. The Harvest Festival!
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.8B276B6747633C5C23184FABACF630E8: Is pumpkin carving still a thing around here?//I remember carving pumpkins when I was in grade school. We got to display them at the town fair.//<portrait=happy>Right, right. The Harvest Festival!
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.193_Text: Is that gross?//Sorry. I just think it’s cool that even animal waste has a good use.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.DF0E604B4D2F3791C4F282888DC38C63: Is that gross?//Sorry. I just think it’s cool that even animal waste has a good use.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.105_Text: Is there a flower nearby that I can brush it on?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.DCCB0444411BE23F5A1476BC7DAEB17F: Is there a flower nearby that I can brush it on?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.6D44A8D8479B673C834F1EB3F2732985: It stung me, but I think it was just scared.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.98_Text: It stung me, but I think it was just scared.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.46_Text: It was a shock, really.//I had no idea they were buying properties here. What will they make of Coral Island, I wonder?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.49C218C24CF7A86771C5EB872FE1A57A: It was a shock, really.//I had no idea they were buying properties here. What will they make of Coral Island, I wonder?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.280_Text: It's cozy in here, ain't it?//<portrait=normal>I think my grandparents did a fine job building the place.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.6899660D477EA218B7C9B6BB66FFA924: It's cozy in here, ain't it?//<portrait=normal>I think my grandparents did a fine job building the place.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.211_Text: It’s Friday! I can’t wait to celebrate at the Tavern tonight.//<portrait=normal>Come with me?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.38A0D93349EF5C4716FAC4866AD41321: It’s Friday! I can’t wait to celebrate at the Tavern tonight.//<portrait=normal>Come with me?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.236_Text: It’s good to leave your plants out in the rain, though!//<portrait=laugh>Weird how nature works.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.7BA5A0E74595EFE9EABA3E8E55D32753: It’s good to leave your plants out in the rain, though!//<portrait=laugh>Weird how nature works.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.299_Text: It’s hard to stay focused when I get stuck.//It makes me want to do something else instead.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.851B7A4F432C4B455C7141B0E4399F73: It’s hard to stay focused when I get stuck.//It makes me want to do something else instead.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.4549E9D1471C13E67B63DCA4993ED4D7: It’s hotter than I’d like for eating outside, but it’s much better than eating inside.//<portrait=daydreaming>Nothing beats eating in nature, not even air-conditioned rooms.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.79_Text: It’s hotter than I’d like for eating outside, but it’s much better than eating inside.//<portrait=daydreaming>Nothing beats eating in nature, not even air-conditioned rooms.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.334_Text: It’s in my blood to take care of these animals.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.51C750384E3FE58149D986BD54AF7A80: It’s in my blood to take care of these animals.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.330_Text: It’s lovely to see you today. The highlight of my day.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.446BBE5B4D33EE9C5C3949A9BE6DDCC3: It’s lovely to see you today. The highlight of my day.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.218_Text: It’s my day off! What should I do today? There’s so much to explore around here!
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.EAA693D74E9A79157B9262BC9A1F19FE: It’s my day off! What should I do today? There’s so much to explore around here!
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.254_Text: It’s not <Italic>really</> reliable, but hey… We don’t have anything better.//I’ll have to take a look later.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.C398074F4765E8FAC0DA9DBB2D4F067F: It’s not <Italic>really</> reliable, but hey… We don’t have anything better.//I’ll have to take a look later.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.4AE3948C4A648113E54FC89C6AA22303: It’s so cold that even a hot cup of green tea isn’t helping.//<portrait=sad>I should just head inside.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.93_Text: It’s so cold that even a hot cup of green tea isn’t helping.//<portrait=sad>I should just head inside.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.09D229B5434EE04A5F68A4A1D30F0E51: It’s so nice to come here and hang out in the evenings.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.303_Text: It’s so nice to come here and hang out in the evenings.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.29_Text: It’s the weekend again!//<portrait=smile>Anything exciting happening?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.C32EE8C2485BA9BB7BC7E08B312246B0: It’s the weekend again!//<portrait=smile>Anything exciting happening?
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.295_Text: It’s time for a snack! I love the way good smells fill up the whole house.//<portrait=normal>It makes me happy that it’s such a small place.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.AA59A039489A0E04FAB177880D262794: It’s time for a snack! I love the way good smells fill up the whole house.//<portrait=normal>It makes me happy that it’s such a small place.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.385_Text: I’ll get a new one when this one has holes in it.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.BEC8A8A94E3DE83F2ADAA0BEABC53C74: I’ll get a new one when this one has holes in it.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.41662BE04DECC0FA7B53B5A9995A8929: I’m a little sad, friend. The trees are starting to lose their leaves, and the animals are leaving.//<portrait=normal>Well, at least I've still got the ranch animals for company.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.81_Text: I’m a little sad, friend. The trees are starting to lose their leaves, and the animals are leaving.//<portrait=normal>Well, at least I've still got the ranch animals for company.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.147_Text: I’m curious to see how beautiful the view must be from up above.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.E9702EF54BE368C1DCC9C484AF5FF87A: I’m curious to see how beautiful the view must be from up above.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.274_Text: I’m glad I’m not out there working in that slush.//<portrait=annoyed>I don’t like it, the animals don’t like it. It’s a bad time all around.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.3B6995924F8DF17179D46788BEAEDC3E: I’m glad I’m not out there working in that slush.//<portrait=annoyed>I don’t like it, the animals don’t like it. It’s a bad time all around.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.132_Text: I’m glad we have a heater for the animals at the ranch.//<portrait=concerned>I hate to think about them being cold and lonely when I’m not there.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.669FFD0E4B63773E3CF1C0BF73434DFE: I’m glad we have a heater for the animals at the ranch.//<portrait=concerned>I hate to think about them being cold and lonely when I’m not there.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.341_Text: I’m glad you moved to Coral Island, <PlayerName>$player</>. If I could keep you all for myself, I totally would.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.CAD84D954FB94078C9D82E8EB60ABE2A: I’m glad you moved to Coral Island, <PlayerName>$player</>. If I could keep you all for myself, I totally would.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.87_Text: I’m not a big fan of the cold.//It’s hard to eat your lunch outside when you’re constantly shivering.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.EBC1F22148D9AB809F558B9A9E4AACBB: I’m not a big fan of the cold.//It’s hard to eat your lunch outside when you’re constantly shivering.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.39_Text: I’m not a fan of processed foods.//I read in some place they're cooked up to make us hooked on 'em.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.63569A8F4D4EFF463648F9B5E1C5B2C8: I’m not a fan of processed foods.//I read in some place they're cooked up to make us hooked on 'em.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.169_Text: I’m not going to buy anything today.//It’s probably not the wisest choice to carry around electronics in this weather.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.E70BC40F45909442E61A21B0E078123B: I’m not going to buy anything today.//It’s probably not the wisest choice to carry around electronics in this weather.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.71_Text: I’m playing along with the trees, <PlayerName>$player</>. Happy as can be.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.9A600F9E46FD281B8AB8DD90A223E2FA: I’m playing along with the trees, <PlayerName>$player</>. Happy as can be.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.83_Text: I’m savoring all the time I can spend outside now.//<portrait=sad>In about a week, I won’t be able to enjoy the outdoors like this.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.FDD4F41D415BBCC961C89184130924BD: I’m savoring all the time I can spend outside now.//<portrait=sad>In about a week, I won’t be able to enjoy the outdoors like this.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.114_Text: I’m trying to catch as much sun as I can by the lake while it’s still Fall.//Once Winter comes, the sun is too weak to warm you up.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.70EE1F814720B34CEFD5C5B19BCFD4E1: I’m trying to catch as much sun as I can by the lake while it’s still Fall.//Once Winter comes, the sun is too weak to warm you up.

DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.37212A82440801781C9B529CFB3DD9A2: I’m trying to figure out this flute melody, but I’m having a hard time.//<portrait=sad>Sometimes the notes seem to jump off the page and float away.

DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.C46E4EE24B09617C76217A926518E0D8: I’ve been trying to learn this new song on my flute, but it’s not going so well.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.191_Text: Just smell that fresh air!//<portrait=smile>I’m so lucky I get to work outside.

DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.165_Text: Just thought I’d pay the <NPCName>Sanchez</> brothers a visit.//It’s been a while since we all hung out.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.EDB854174B1D59958FF40392A65EBFF9: Just thought I’d pay the <NPCName>Sanchez</> brothers a visit.//It’s been a while since we all hung out.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.282_Text: Just you remember to keep your barn spick and span.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.C2AC5AD649E5B71BDFB0429ED4418C6C: Just you remember to keep your barn spick and span.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.260_Text: Keep an eye on your crops and animals!//They might blow away if you’re not careful!
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.3047EFF14AC7F0BA45428A85B4E72C32: Keep an eye on your crops and animals!//They might blow away if you’re not careful!
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.373_Text: Kombucha is great too. But I don’t think they sell any here.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.A33BB3904B77AE1EA4B22F8782BFC5CA: Kombucha is great too. But I don’t think they sell any here.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.2EDC90284A28AA32E36F289256C944E6: Kombucha is the best drink to have with lunch. Love it, yeah?//Especially when it’s sunny out. It has that refreshing kick, you know?

DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.8C402DAA47121035A805C4A9B95D38D0: Lunch tastes so much better here, ain't it?

DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.BA4F12B648EEB48FDB2BF784B07B747A: Things might not be perfect, but I did my best this year, which is good enough for me.//Here’s to the New Year!

DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.432351D545EB1385813C91BAA64F6435: This was back when it was still your grandparents’.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.96_Text: This was back when it was still your grandparents’.

DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.314_Text: Your aura is calming.//<portrait=daydreaming>Like the first bloom of cherry blossoms.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.B8FA20B349A4A40A7EE20787E34A7A4F: Your aura is calming.//<portrait=daydreaming>Like the first bloom of cherry blossoms.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.1C40E4F24B08406ED1434F8D23665FE1: Your aura is calming.//<portrait=daydreaming>Like the warm scent of roasted pumpkin.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.316_Text: Your aura is calming.//<portrait=daydreaming>Like the warm scent of roasted pumpkin.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.177_Text: Your chickens can get really sad if you don’t feed them.//<portrait=concerned>The same goes for cows and other farm animals.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.19198CFA4A00B0DAD6069BA5935F6FC2: Your chickens can get really sad if you don’t feed them.//<portrait=concerned>The same goes for cows and other farm animals.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.1_Text: You’re <PlayerName>$player</>?//<portrait=smile>I heard about you. I heard you’re looking for some fresh air away from the city.
DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.7840A21B49BF5C74254BAA9930FDA313: You’re <PlayerName>$player</>?//<portrait=smile>I heard about you. I heard you’re looking for some fresh air away from the city.
