DT_Dialogue_Kenny_Production.91124A9546D29021814318B58A1CFBBE: [<NpcName>Kenny</> is staring into space.]//<portrait=concerned>What time is it?

DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.151_Text: <NPCName>Ben</> sometimes brings me fresh flowers. He charges for them, yeah. Not much, though.//Friends and family price, he says.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.25_Text: <NPCName>Dinda</> got me this flute on New Year’s ages ago.//<portrait=normal>I don’t celebrate birthdays, but it was the most thoughtful gift I’ve ever received.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.140_Text: <NPCName>Jack</> needs extra help stocking the shelves. Not a hard job, just time consuming, that’s all.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.29_Text: <NPCName>Kenny</> plays the flute, just like me.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.100_Text: A good investment in equipment can save you plenty in healing expenses later.//<portrait=normal>You never know what kind of monsters are down there.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.89_Text: A good investment in equipment can save you plenty in healing expenses later.//<portrait=normal>You never know what kind of monsters are down there.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.18_Text: Anybody can play the flute. All you need to do is get yourself one and blow through the mouthpiece.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.20_Text: Anybody can play the flute. All you need to do is get yourself one and blow through the mouthpiece.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.3_Text: Anybody can play the flute. All you need to do is get yourself one and blow through the mouthpiece.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.23_Text: Are you going to the cavern or coming back?
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.129_Text: Bring me the monsters first. Okay?
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.52_Text: Can’t stand them anymore. I hate them now.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.48_Text: Check my board often.//I might be giving away some old things.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.53_Text: Check my board often.//I might be giving away some old things.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.55_Text: Check my board often.//I might be giving away some old things.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.61_Text: Check often, will ya? I might be giving away some old things.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.10_Text: Check out my board. I’ll give you rewards for slaying certain monsters.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.128_Text: Check out my list over there. I’ll give you rewards for slaying certain monsters.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.122_Text: Clean off the rust, sell them. I don’t know.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.168_Text: Combat is about being quick on your feet and thinking on the go.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.68_Text: Come talk to me if you have questions about combat.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.12_Text: Cooking isn’t for me. I’m more the flower-arranging type.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.152_Text: Did you go to the cavern at all last week?//<portrait=annoyed>Why am I asking?//<portrait=normal>It’s my job to know everything that goes on in there.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.63_Text: Didn’t y'know that? Hmm. Odd. Well, now you do.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.187_Text: Don’t expect too much from me.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.73_Text: Don’t you have work to do to get the farm going again?
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.77_Text: Each will give you a different kind of protection and strength.//<portrait=annoyed>For combat. What did you think I was talking about?
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.83_Text: Figure out your strengths. And bring some armor!
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.69_Text: Fishing? I don’t know much about fishing.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.124_Text: Fodder? Food for animals? No, I don’t have any.//You’ve come to the wrong place.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.146_Text: Gah. You’re one of those <Italic>chipper</> ones.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.46_Text: Have you fought all the monsters on my board?
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.58_Text: Have you fought all the monsters on my board?
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.179_Text: How much is a pumpkin going for these days?//I might sell some of mine. Planted way too much.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.178_Text: How much is a sack of potatoes going for these days?//I might sell some of my harvest. Planted way too much.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.142_Text: How’s the old cabin? Holding up okay?
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.160_Text: I can smell the ocean all the way from here.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.82_Text: I can’t really teach you combat. You just need to go out there and fight.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.27_Text: I can’t wait for yoga on Saturday. It’s a good reason to go into town.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.32_Text: I can’t wait for yoga on Saturday. It’s a good reason to go into town.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.49_Text: I could tell you some legends. What kind do you want to hear?
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.64_Text: I could tell you some legends. What kind do you want to hear?
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.67_Text: I don’t get involved in corporate drama. I save my energy for the actual monsters that live in the cavern.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.164_Text: I don’t like it when people stare.//Eye contact – ugh. But it’s rude not to look people in the eye, so I just limit my social life in general.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.154_Text: I don’t like the sun. It’s always so bright.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.102_Text: I don’t mind being ignored. I prefer it, in fact.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.146_Special: I don’t mind. Birthdays are kind of fun.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.186_Text: I don’t provide food. My friends bring their own food when they visit.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.144_Text: I don’t really care about birthdays or parties in general.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.148_Special: I don’t remember seeing your birthday on the calendar.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.135_Text: I don’t want to scare you, but you should keep those vitamins handy when you go into combat.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.15_Text: I guess my wild days are over.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.7_Text: I guess my wild days are over.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.30_Text: I had <NPCName>Kenny</> when <NPCName>Jack</> and I were very young.//<portrait=happy>Oh, can you tell?
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.36_Text: I had <NPCName>Kenny</> when <NPCName>Jack</> and I were very young.//<portrait=happy>Oh, can you tell?
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.95_Text: I had way too much pumpkin pie with dinner last night.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.121_Text: I have to dig out some of my old blades one of these days.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.114_Text: I have to get back to the cabin.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.45_Text: I just got up. I could use a good stretch right now.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.153_Text: I like TV. You can kill so much time watching it.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.22_Text: I made my first flute myself. It was a way to relax after a long day of combat.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.5_Text: I made my first flute myself. It was a way to relax after a long day of combat.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.44_Text: I still visit the cavern, but not a lot.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.34_Text: I still wear my combat boots every day, just in case.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.38_Text: I still wear my combat boots every day, just in case.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.96_Text: I think I ate enough pumpkin pie for a year.//<portrait=normal>But I wouldn’t say no to more if there’s leftovers.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.78_Text: I think I’ll stay in the forest today.//I don’t have any business in Starlet Town anyway.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.80_Text: I think I’ll stay in the forest today.//I don’t have any business in Starlet Town anyway.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.84_Text: I think I’ll stay in the forest today.//I don’t have any business in Starlet Town anyway.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.86_Text: I think I’ll stay in the forest today.//I don’t have any business in Starlet Town anyway.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.104_Text: I think we all can use rainy days like this.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.111_Text: I think we all can use rainy days like this.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.14_Text: I used to bring food and camp out in the cave for days. Not anymore.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.6_Text: I used to bring food and camp out in the cavern for days. Not anymore.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.70_Text: If you feel like you’re going to pass out, stop and eat something.//It’ll make you feel better.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.141_Text: If you need anything, you should talk to <NPCName>Jack</>. I don’t know much about selling these.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.176_Text: If you’re defeated, run.//Try again tomorrow. No need to force it.//<portrait=normal>Sometimes we lose. That’s just how it is with everything.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.150_Text: It calmed me down.//There’s not much else to do down there.//<portrait=annoyed>In the cavern, I mean.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.147_Text: It can be any date I want it to be.//What’s with the personal questions?
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.148_Text: It isn’t listed. I don’t celebrate it.//Personal reasons.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.11_Text: It makes my job easier.//Makes sense, right?
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.26_Text: It plays much better than my old one.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.131_Text: It’s been empty ever since. Cobwebs. Rats. Gah.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.177_Text: It’s easier to grow your own food than going to Starlet to buy it.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.19_Text: It’s easy to learn but really hard to master.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.21_Text: It’s easy to learn but really hard to master.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.4_Text: It’s easy to learn but really hard to master.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.9_Text: It’s hard to keep track of the days, living so deep in the forest.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.119_Text: It’s hard to succeed in combat if you’re not coordinated.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.166_Text: It’s hard to tell how safe the cavern is anymore.//<portrait=normal>I don’t want to make a big deal about it, but I sure hope somebody carries on my legacy and protects this island.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.123_Text: It’s impossible to live alone without people bothering you, isn’t it?
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.113_Text: It’s too bright in here. The sun’s hurting my eyes. And it’s loud.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.162_Text: I’d rather live in the forest. I don’t really like talking to people.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.118_Text: I’m going to buy the videos and do them at home. That way, I don’t need to come here.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.132_Text: I’m here for a routine checkup. How else am I going to keep healthy?
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.117_Text: I’m here to learn how to stretch correctly. <NPCName>Leah’s</> learning from videos on the internet.//<portrait=happy>You heard about those?
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.163_Text: I’m not much of a people person.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.51_Text: I’m sick of tortillas. That’s all I used to eat.//<portrait=annoyed>Tortilla this, tortilla that.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.54_Text: I’m sick of tortillas. That’s all I used to eat.//<portrait=annoyed>Tortilla this, tortilla that.//Can’t stand them anymore. I hate them now.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.60_Text: I’m sick of tortillas. That’s all I used to eat.//<portrait=annoyed>Tortilla this, tortilla that.//Can’t stand them anymore. I hate them now.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.106_Text: I’m sure I’m not the only one who likes the smell of rain.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.109_Text: I’m sure I’m not the only one who likes the smell of rain.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.75_Text: Just like fishing. There’s no way around it.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.98_Text: Just like fishing. There’s no way around it.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.175_Text: Keep your head during combat.//When you panic, you lose.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.101_Text: Listen to my advice or not. Do what you want.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.90_Text: Listen to my advice or not. Do what you want.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.180_Text: Living in the forest has taught me to respect nature.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.79_Text: Maybe I’ll go down there this weekend.//<portrait=normal>I like it better here anyway, away from loud…people.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.81_Text: Maybe I’ll go down there this weekend.//<portrait=normal>I like it better here anyway, away from loud…people.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.85_Text: Maybe I’ll go down there this weekend.//<portrait=normal>I like it better here anyway, away from loud…people.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.87_Text: Maybe I’ll go down there this weekend.//<portrait=normal>I like it better here anyway, away from loud…people.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.105_Text: No need to water my garden today.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.112_Text: No need to water my garden today.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.92_Text: Not vices, I guess. Things.//We all have our things. Hobbies. Whatever.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.72_Text: Now the ice has melted, I can only imagine how many weeds must be growing on your farm.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.103_Text: Now you should tell the other islanders that.//They seem to think I like visitors, for some reason.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.17_Text: Oh! It isn’t. Today’s Friday. It’s hard to keep track of the days, living so deep in the forest.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.35_Text: Oh, don’t be nervous.//Like you didn’t know there’s a literal army of monsters under this island.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.39_Text: Oh, don’t be nervous.//Like you didn’t know there’s a literal army of monsters under this island.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.62_Text: Playing the flute can make your core stronger. It gives your lungs a workout.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.42_Text: Playing the flute strengthens your core. It’s a workout for your lungs.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.149_Text: Playing the flute used to keep me entertained when I was alone in the caves for days.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.40_Text: Some of my armor’s getting rusty.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.56_Text: Some of my armor’s getting rusty.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.91_Text: Some people fish. I slay monsters. We all have our vices.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.185_Text: Some traveling friends in the guild visit me sometimes.//They’re welcome for as long as they want to stay.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.88_Text: Some weapons can get pretty pricey, but it’s worth it if you visit the cavern a lot.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.99_Text: Some weapons can get pretty pricey, but it’s worth it if you visit the cavern a lot.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.13_Text: Sure, you can do both. I’m just not a good cook.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.165_Text: The B.O.S. hunters are different. They don’t need social norms.//You could be in the same room with them all day and completely ignore them. They wouldn’t think anything of it.//They’re easy to be around.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.130_Text: The barn’s kind of a mess. It hasn’t been lived in for years.//<NPCName>Jack</> used to live there before we got married. It’s falling apart now.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.143_Text: The house?//<portrait=normal>Oh, the cabin, you mean? There are some people from the Band of Smiles in the guildhouse.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.66_Text: The mayor told us all about Pufferfish yesterday.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.94_Text: The season has nothing to do with where the monsters are. They’re all there, just on different levels.//Why are you asking so many questions? You should just go and get hunting already.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.158_Text: The swords and armor are getting rusty. What a sad sight.//Starting to show their age.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.133_Text: These folks seem to know what they’re talking about.//Especially <NPCName>Charlie</>. I like him. He’s the straightforward type.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.136_Text: They help me recover instantly. Ask the doctors if you don’t believe me.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.159_Text: They still work fine.//A little cleaning and they’ll be brand new again.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.172_Text: Timing is crucial in combat.//You don’t need maximum strength if your timing is impeccable.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.24_Text: Today? No, I don’t want to go hunting today, thanks. Actually, I like to hunt alone.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.156_Text: Unfortunately, we still get visitors even though we live deep in the woods.//Unwanted visitors.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.125_Text: Up there, see the barns? You can buy it there. You passed the building already.//<portrait=happy>Also, I’d go and see <NPCName>Charlie</> if I were you. Might need to have that disorientation checked out.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.167_Text: We all know <NPCName>Kenny</> won’t do it. He wouldn’t hurt a fly.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.41_Text: We need to take care of it so it can take care of us in a fight.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.57_Text: We need to take care of it, just like it takes care of us in a fight.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.181_Text: We often hear things at night, all kinds of noises.//Nothing to worry about. It’s probably wild animals.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.28_Text: Well, that’s not quite true. I don’t like yoga Saturdays.//<portrait=normal>But <NPCName>Jack</> likes to go to Starlet Town, so it’s worth the trouble. At least I get to see him happy.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.33_Text: Well, that’s not quite true. I don’t like yoga Saturdays.//<portrait=normal>But <NPCName>Jack</> likes to go to Starlet Town, so it’s worth the trouble. At least I get to see him happy.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.50_Text: Well, that’s true, not a legend. Monsters and ghouls once took over the forest.//<portrait=normal>Nobody was guarding the cave, so they were everywhere. For a while, you couldn’t even go in the forest.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.65_Text: Well, that’s true, not a legend. Monsters and ghouls once took over the forest.//<portrait=normal>Nobody was guarding the cave, so they were everywhere. For a while, you couldn’t even go in the forest.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.137_Text: Well, yeah. They don’t taste good, but we don’t get them for the taste.//We take medicine to get better fast.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.93_Text: Which monsters you encounter depends on how deep in the cavern you go.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.108_Text: Why are there so many things in this house? I never really noticed before.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.16_Text: Why do you keep saying it’s Tuesday? It isn’t. It’s Thursday.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.145_Text: Yeah, they’re all right. Some people make such a big deal out of it.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.174_Text: Yoga’s good training for combat.//Core strength. That’s the key.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.127_Text: You can try using your farming tools to fight monsters, but I don’t know how far it’ll get ya.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.43_Text: You didn’t know that? Hmm. Well, now you do.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.71_Text: You don’t want to pass out, because who knows what creatures are down there in the cavern?//<portrait=normal>That’s how you get your stuff stolen. Do you want to get your stuff stolen, <PlayerName>$Player</>?//I don’t think so.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.120_Text: You got it, <PlayerName>$player</>! And I don’t say that lightly. Keep it up!
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.161_Text: You just can’t escape the ocean here, can ya?
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.76_Text: You might be able to find different kinds of armor and weapons at the B.O.S guild.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.173_Text: You need to know when to attack and when to duck.//And when to run away.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.74_Text: You need to train if you want to get better at combat.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.97_Text: You need to train if you want to get better at combat.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.171_Text: You sound like my son, <NPCName>Kenny</>.//<portrait=happy>When he was seven.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.169_Text: You want to win, you need your footwork.//No way around it.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.157_Text: You’re worse than that wine lady down the hill, always visiting and bringing baskets of things.
DT_Dialogue_Kira_Production.170_Text: “Wash your hands.” Pfft!//What’re my dirty hands going to do, kill me? Ha ha ha!

DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.60_Text: <NPCName>Ling</> has a giant display case of creepy dolls in the living room. Super weird. Not a great way to greet company, is it?//If she just kept them in the privacy of her room, it might be okay.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.87_Text: <NPCName>Ling</> is a bit of an oddball, yeah. But she’s actually okay.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.97_Text: <NPCName>Ling</> is a bit of an oddball, yeah.//But she’s actually okay.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.71_Text: <NPCName>Ling</> is making such a big deal over Pufferfish moving here. Ugh!
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.7_Text: <NPCName>Ling</> isn’t my mom. Is that a surprise?//I mean, we look nothing alike!
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.8_Text: <NPCName>Ling</> isn’t my mom. Is that a surprise?//I mean, we look nothing alike!
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.185_Text: <NpcName>Ling</> lets me do whatever I want with the house.//I decorated it. You like?
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.201_Text: <PlayerName>$player</>, if I ever make it big and get famous, I want to take you with me to travel the world.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.85_Text: <PlayerName>$player</>, you could probably use a cute jacket instead of…whatever that is you’re wearing.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.19_Text: Ah, <PlayerName>$player</>. Do we have to talk about that?//I’m not interested in talking about fresh vegetables right now. Some other time?
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.100_Text: And the weather isn’t too hot.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.275_Text: And then dress them up in couture. Doesn’t that sound fun?//They could run around here. Or play in town with <NPCName>Taco</> and <NPCName>Bonbon</>!
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.141_Text: And then dress them up in couture.//Doesn’t that sound fun?
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.279_Text: Are you excited about the Animal Festival? I could do without the smelly cows, but I can’t wait to see all the pets!
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.103_Text: Are you going to have a booth at the Harvest Festival this year?
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.239_Text: Are you going to have a booth at the Harvest Festival this year?
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.195_Text: Aww! The farmer look really suits you. With the dirt smudges and untidy hair.//<portrait=normal>I think I like it.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.210_Text: Aww, look at you! You look so cute!//Where are you going, cutie?
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.228_Text: Bananas are good for you, right?
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.73_Text: Bananas are good for you, right?
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.189_Text: But it’s hard to stay mad at Dad for long.//He’s an inspiration, to be honest. I didn’t get it at first, but he showed me there are things more important than wealth and fame.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.178_Text: But there’s no such thing as a free lunch, you know? Everything comes with a price, and Mom’s price was expensive.//<portrait=sad>Lucky for her, someone else paid it.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.199_Text: By the way, I have some free time next week.//Maybe we could do yoga together at your place. Or mine. Doesn’t matter.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.240_Text: Can I take a picture of it?
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.104_Text: Can I take a picture of it? People love country festivals.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.38_Text: Can we do this some other time? I’m not in the mood for chitchat right now.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.45_Text: Can we do this some other time? I’m not in the mood for chitchat right now.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.162_Text: Cookies were the only thing she could make back in the day.//Maybe even now. I’m not sure.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.160_Text: Cooking is a good way to unwind.//It’s a solo activity too. It doesn’t usually require assistance.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.36_Text: Dad is a teacher, and guess what he likes? Apples!//Such a cliché.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.43_Text: Dad is a teacher, and guess what he likes? Apples!//Such a cliché.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.56_Text: Dad loves coffee, though. That’s how he starts every day, with a big cup of hot coffee.//What about you? Are you the same?
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.84_Text: Dad used to make me do the pumpkin-smashing game when I was a kid. Ugh!//<portrait=happy>I won a couple of times.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.213_Text: Divorce was hard on a little kid. Sometimes, I still wish they’d just get along.//I see my friends’ parents do it, so why can’t they?
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.165_Text: Do you feel that? The wind is nice today.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.173_Text: Do you think this is my color?//I like the dress, but I want to know what you think.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.175_Text: Do you think this is my color?//I want to know what you think.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.166_Text: Don’t fall asleep here.//<portrait=angry>You’ll wake up sunburned on one side of your body. Disaster!
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.16_Text: Every time I run out of makeup, I have to order it from Pokyo. So inconvenient.//<portrait=angry>Ugh. Living here is so complicated.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.17_Text: Every time I run out of makeup, I have to order it from Pokyo. So inconvenient.//<portrait=angry>Ugh. Living here is so complicated.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.62_Text: For my carefree, effortless look, I’m wearing light foundation and a touch of lip gloss today.//<portrait=happy>You like?
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.65_Text: For my carefree, effortless look, I’m wearing light foundation and a touch of lip gloss today.//<portrait=happy>You like?
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.68_Text: For my carefree, effortless look, I’m wearing light foundation and a touch of lip gloss today.//<portrait=happy>You like?
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.205_Text: Growing up, I always wanted to be like Mom. You know, with the fancy dresses and exotic trips. But not anymore.//As I get older, I want to be more like Dad.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.152_Text: Happy Friday!//I have my yoga lesson down for tomorrow. I’m ready!
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.233_Text: Have you checked out the Pufferfish office?
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.91_Text: Have you checked out the Pufferfish office?//They literally built a mini golf course. That earns them a few points in my book.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.122_Text: Have you ever been afraid your house might be destroyed by a storm?
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.256_Text: Have you ever been afraid your house might be destroyed by a storm?
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.69_Text: Have you heard about a drilling company opening an office here?
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.151_Text: Having a farm doesn’t seem so bad, now that I think about it.//You get to play with cute animals every day.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.206_Text: He’s… Dad’s led such an honest life.//<portrait=happy>He seems happy, you know? Content. I want to feel like that more than I want to look nice.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.191_Text: Hmm. I think I might make fried rice and get some wine for dinner this weekend. Dad loves wine, so I guess it doesn’t matter what I cook.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.286_Text: I always look forward to the snow. It makes the town more magical and interesting.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.78_Text: I appreciate that you work hard, <PlayerName>$player</>, but my advice? You can still pay attention to your appearance.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.177_Text: I can only imagine living a life like my mom’s. Always traveling and dressing up in fancy clothes.//Sounds like a dream, doesn’t it?!
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.119_Text: I can’t wait until it stops. I’m just not a sit-around-doing-nothing kind of girl, you know.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.253_Text: I can’t wait until it stops. I’m just not a sit-around-doing-nothing kind of girl, you know.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.129_Text: I can’t walk in all this snow.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.263_Text: I can’t walk in all this snow.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.135_Text: I could eat ten of them. I probably shouldn’t, though.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.271_Text: I could eat ten of them. I probably shouldn’t, though.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.220_Text: I could learn a lot from Dad. He found his passion early in life and stuck with it.//Never once was he tempted to give up teaching for more money.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.157_Text: I could listen to you all day long.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.179_Text: I could never get upset with you.//<portrait=sad>Sorry if I always seem annoyed. It’s usually just, you know, people.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.128_Text: I could use some sun right about now.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.262_Text: I could use some sun right about now.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.182_Text: I don’t know a lot about charity and all that.//<portrait=angry>I’ll have to ask the mayor what to do with my unwanted stuff. Or I could ask <NpcName>Ling</>.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.18_Text: I don’t know how much longer I can survive living like this.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.148_Text: I don’t know. You just seem tired, that’s all.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.142_Text: I don’t like wearing my hair down. It always seems to get in the way.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.276_Text: I don’t like wearing my hair down. It always seems to get in the way.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.176_Text: I don’t usually wear blue, but I figured it’s Winter.//Blue seems fitting, no?
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.209_Text: I feel kind of down today. Can you stay for a bit?
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.112_Text: I forgot to get gifts for the twins. Maybe I should just give them to them tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.246_Text: I forgot to get gifts for the twins. Maybe I should just give them to them tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.188_Text: I get annoyed at Dad sometimes.//How could he be happy here on such a secluded island, scraping by on the bare minimum?
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.170_Text: I got this outfit in San Franciskyo. You like?//<portrait=normal>It’s always so cold there. I went in Summer, and it was freezing. In fact, this is what I was wearing there in Summer!
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.217_Text: I guess I just want to say thank you. You’re a great friend.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.55_Text: I hate the smell of coffee. It’s so… I can’t find the right word.//Earthy? Bitter? Musty? Anyway…
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.211_Text: I hated my parents for leaving me behind and just carrying on with their lives.//Once they separated, Mom moved out. Off she went.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.221_Text: I have a lot of memories with Dad.//Building sandcastles, going camping, carving pumpkins, catching fish…
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.58_Text: I have a lot of those things. Trust me, I’m far from happy.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.110_Text: I have to get myself a pair. So country. But I don’t know where I’d wear them.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.245_Text: I have to get myself a pair.//So country. But I don’t know where I’d wear them.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.111_Text: I haven’t gotten anything for the twins.//Their birthday’s coming up.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.226_Text: I haven’t heard from Mom in over a year. I wonder how she’s doing.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.99_Text: I honestly think Fall is the best time to go to the beach.//It’s way less crowded.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.124_Text: I hope it stops storming tomorrow. It’s so boring to stay inside all day.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.258_Text: I hope it stops storming tomorrow. It’s so boring to stay inside all day.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.171_Text: I just got my kitchen cleaned up. Oh my.//It was good hand-strengthening exercise for yoga, ’cause some of those stains are tougher than… Ugh, I don’t know.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.236_Text: I just like it, I guess.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.282_Text: I just love Fall fashion. Such a shame it’s so hard to get things shipped to the island, though.//<portrait=concerned>Oh, I know they sell some things here. They’re just…not to my taste.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.168_Text: I kept the hat in my closet for years. Got rid of it several years ago. I put it with the knitting <NpcName>Ling</> donates to the city every year.//<portrait=sad>Good memories.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.47_Text: I learned the right accessory can make or break an outfit.//It’s tricky, because you definitely don’t want to look tacky, like you’re trying too hard.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.83_Text: I like making Harvest Festival content. It’s one of the few good things about this town.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.287_Text: I like this town, actually. I know I complain a lot.//It’s the only way I know how to cope, I guess. I wanted to hate Dad and this town for keeping me here.//But let’s face it. It’s not them keeping me here. It’s Mom who didn’t want me.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.283_Text: I look a bit out of place in this suit right now.//But that’s what fashion is sometimes. Be bold and stand out!
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.158_Text: I made some stew last night from a recipe I got from the internet.//It was horrible! Too many peas, for sure.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.223_Text: I made some tomato soup before I left the house.//<portrait=concerned>I hope <NPCName>Ling</> remembers to take it to work.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.81_Text: I need to prepare for the Spooky Day Festival. My followers love my posts about it.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.218_Text: I ordered a couple things to be shipped here. New dresses and some, er, hats and stuff.//<portrait=happy>You should come by when they arrive.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.117_Text: I really shouldn’t be out in the rain too long.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.120_Text: I really shouldn’t be out in the rain too long.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.251_Text: I really shouldn’t be out in the rain too long.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.254_Text: I really shouldn’t be out in the rain too long.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.183_Text: I should really get my closet reorganized. There’s way too much stuff in there.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.105_Text: I spent two hours on my hair today, and the wind just blew all my hard work away.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.107_Text: I spent two hours on my hair today, and the wind just blew all my hard work away.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.241_Text: I spent two hours on my hair today, and the wind just blew all my hard work away.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.214_Text: I still don’t understand what’s so great about teaching, but I like listening to Dad talk about his day.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.159_Text: I still have some leftovers in the fridge, but to be honest, I’m not touching it.//<portrait=concerned>Do you want to try it?
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.140_Text: I think I’d like to adopt a cat and a dog someday.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.274_Text: I think I’d like to adopt a cat and a dog someday.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.59_Text: I think I’m going to take it easy now.//<portrait=concerned>It’s been a hectic day, and it’s only Monday.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.194_Text: I think he’s lonely. I try to hang out with him, but my schedule is tight.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.139_Text: I thought it was a monster at first, but it turned out to be <NPCName>Taco</>. What a relief!
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.273_Text: I thought it was a monster at first, but it turned out to be <NPCName>Taco</>. What a relief!
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.27_Text: I try to spice up yoga class by incorporating meditation sometimes.//It gets boring otherwise.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.79_Text: I try to take pictures with daisies in the background. They get a lot of likes.//<portrait=angry>But I won’t take any with that patchy grass. So shabby.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.212_Text: I used to spend Summers with either Mom or Dad. A birthday party with Mom. Or Dad.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.167_Text: I used to swim with Dad right over there, behind the big rocks.//<portrait=happy>He used to make me wear this really <Italic>ugly</> hat. Ha ha ha! I hated it.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.92_Text: I wanna challenge you to a game of mini golf sometime.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.280_Text: I watched this film last night. <Italic>The Red Tone</> or <Italic>Note</> or whatever.//Oh, the heartbreak. I can still feel it now.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.207_Text: I wish I didn’t have to say this, but it was hard being raised by my mom. She was always so glamorous and put together.//It’s a lot of pressure to be around her, you know.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.225_Text: I wrote to the governor, complaining about the lack of funding.//They should have a bigger budget for better Winter decorations.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.200_Text: If it’s just me and you, I can focus on you better. Say yes.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.33_Text: If you think about it, I literally live inside art. That mansion has been around longer than any of us.//It was one of the first landmarks here, you know. That counts as art, right?
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.15_Text: If you’ll excuse me, I have to take some pictures. I’m on a tight deadline here.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.26_Text: If you’ll excuse me, I have to take some pictures. I’m on a tight deadline here.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.208_Text: If you’re a little kid, you have no choice but to look up to the closest grown-up around. In my case, it was my mom.//<portrait=normal>At the beginning, anyway.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.70_Text: In Starlet Town! What could they possibly want with a small town like this?
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.174_Text: Is it a good shade of pink?
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.75_Text: Is this…is this your Spring look? How…country.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.93_Text: It gets stuffy inside the house. I prefer to work outdoors, in nature.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.288_Text: It gives me comfort to blame the town. I know, I know. It isn’t fair. But it helps me feel better.//Is that so bad?//<portrait=happy>But the shopping <Italic>does</> suck here. Heh heh!
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.164_Text: It isn’t easy to do yoga on the beach. The sand eats your feet!
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.268_Text: It sounds silly. Trust me, I know.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.41_Text: It was so dull. But I think Mom’s busy schedule paid off.//<portrait=happy>She always wears the prettiest things.//In retrospect, I probably should’ve studied art like her.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.50_Text: It was so dull. But I think Mom’s busy schedule paid off.//<portrait=happy>She always wears the prettiest things.//In retrospect, I probably should’ve studied art like her.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.54_Text: It was so dull. But I think Mom’s busy schedule paid off.//<portrait=happy>She always wears the prettiest things.//In retrospect, I probably should’ve studied art like her.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.72_Text: It’s all she talks about at the dinner table.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.101_Text: It’s almost the first weekend of Fall already.//All my mutuals are going to be posting pumpkin pictures soon.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.22_Text: It’s hard to film on the beach. Always so windy, and the ground is uneven. *sighs*
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.121_Text: It’s the perfect weather for self-reflective meditation.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.255_Text: It’s the perfect weather for self-reflective meditation.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.169_Text: It’s too hot for me to let my hair down. Better to keep it up.//<portrait=happy>Besides, I like it like this.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.219_Text: I’ll do a little fashion show for you, and you can tell me what you think and help me decide what to keep.//Yes? Yes? Say yes!
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.35_Text: I’m always on the move. Super active.//I don’t do sitting still very well.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.42_Text: I’m always on the move.//I get bored just sitting in one spot.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.153_Text: I’m going to stretch a little today. Not too much.//Get in the flow, you know?
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.90_Text: I’m gonna get the perfect Summer glow this year. I just know it.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.232_Text: I’m gonna get the perfect Summer glow this year.//I just know it.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.134_Text: I’m having one of those days when a butter croissant sounds like the tastiest thing in the world.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.270_Text: I’m having one of those days when a butter croissant sounds like the tastiest thing in the world.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.21_Text: I’m leading a yoga class at the community center tomorrow at 10 am.//Ever tried yoga? It’s very good for you.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.161_Text: I’m not a very good cook, but I can make some stuff, you know?//The first recipe I got was from Mom. Cookies.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.146_Text: I’m posting my health checkup video as soon as I get home.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.30_Text: I’m really not in the mood, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.52_Text: I’m self-employed.//<portrait=happy>What difference does it make? Look at how many people came today.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.127_Text: Keep your body moving in Winter, <PlayerName>$player</>. It helps you stay warm.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.261_Text: Keep your body moving in Winter, <PlayerName>$player</>. It helps you stay warm.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.281_Text: Let me give you some advice about constructing the perfect Summer look.//Use bright colors, but don’t be obnoxious about it. You can expose some skin, but make it tasteful.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.74_Text: Let’s see, what’s a good Spring look? Something flowy, definitely. A nice pastel makeup tone. What else, what else?//<portrait=angry>Are you eavesdropping on me? Of course. You would.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.216_Text: Listen, <PlayerName>$player</>. My dad has been the only constant in my life ever since Mom left.//I don’t expect anyone to stick around for me. But you did.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.9_Text: Living right next to a lake isn’t that glamorous, honestly.//It can get really loud.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.187_Text: Maybe I should try wearing my hair down once in a while. Do you think I’d look good like that?
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.40_Text: Mom took me all over the world when I was younger, but there were always art auctions or gallery opening galas. It was work travel.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.49_Text: Mom took me all over the world when I was younger, but there were always art auctions or gallery opening galas. It was work travel.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.53_Text: Mom took me all over the world when I was younger, but there were always art auctions or gallery opening galas. It was work travel.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.31_Text: My earrings were given to my grandmother by the duchess herself. They’re like a family heirloom.//Oh, you can tell?
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.172_Text: My hands are all sore now.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.267_Text: My mom never let me wear my hair down. Ladies wear their hair up, she said.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.102_Text: Oh gosh! Next week will be way too late. I need to find a pumpkin before Saturday.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.278_Text: Oh, <PlayerName>$player</>, I absolutely love your Spring outfit!
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.154_Text: Oh, <PlayerName>$player</>. So lovely to see you.//How are things over there on your farm?
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.13_Text: Oh, I’m afraid I can’t help you. I need to be going.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.202_Text: Oh, and we can check out that old office you’re always talking about. It sounds so fun.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.198_Text: Oh, hey! Didn’t see you there!
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.204_Text: Oh, look at me! Asking for advice.//I’m becoming more and more like you, <PlayerName>$player</>. I’m one outfit away from being a down-to-earth farmer.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.192_Text: Oh, umm. Sorry, it’s just Dad and me, or else I would totally invite you.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.143_Text: People think it must be so great living right next to a park, but to be honest, it gets very noisy on the weekends.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.82_Text: Personally, I don’t care about the competition between Starlet and Beluga at the Harvest Festival.//<portrait=normal>But my audience eats it right up.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.193_Text: Poor <NPCName>Charles</>. I saw him talking to himself <Italic>again</> the other day.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.197_Text: Poor thing. Say hello to him, will you?
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.64_Text: Preposterous, right? I know I sound dramatic, but you know it’s true.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.67_Text: Preposterous, right? I know I sound dramatic, but you know it’s true.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.181_Text: Probably not a bad idea to donate some of my out-of-season things. Make room for new stuff.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.252_Text: Rain really makes you lazy, doesn’t it? Look at me! I didn’t even bother putting on decent makeup today!
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.118_Text: Rain really makes you lazy, doesn’t it? Look at me!//I didn’t even bother putting on decent makeup today!
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.125_Text: Rain really makes you lazy, doesn’t it? Look at me!//I didn’t even bother putting on decent makeup today!
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.259_Text: Rain really makes you lazy, doesn’t it? Look at me!//I didn’t even bother putting on decent makeup today!
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.132_Text: Remember to moisturize after washing your hands. You don’t want to get all chapped.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.266_Text: Remember to moisturize after washing your hands. You don’t want to get chapped.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.227_Text: She’s probably really busy. She’s a big deal, you know.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.88_Text: Sometimes, it’s not bad to be an oddball. The world needs more of them.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.98_Text: Sometimes, it’s not bad to be an oddball. The world needs more of them.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.231_Text: Spring feels so long this year. I’m <Italic>so</> ready for Summer.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.2_Text: Tch. Out of all the places you could go, why on earth would you move here?
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.86_Text: That dusting of snow looks kinda cute on you.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.113_Text: The Coral Inn twins, of course. It’s their birthday today.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.247_Text: The Coral Inn twins, of course. It’s their birthday today.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.284_Text: The Harvest Festival made me miss Mom.//She never took me to one. That’s the weird thing.//How can you miss something that never happened?
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.243_Text: The animals were so cute yesterday.//I wish they’d have the Animal Festival more often instead of just collecting trash or whatever.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.163_Text: The beach here isn’t so bad.//I like the white sand.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.136_Text: The ceramic plates in this house are designer. We have to be extra careful with them.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.224_Text: The lab gets really cold during Winter.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.285_Text: The problem with Winter is I don’t want to look like a ball of fabric, but I also don’t want to freeze.//It’s a tough balancing act.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.130_Text: The snow is going to ruin my shoes.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.264_Text: The snow is going to ruin my shoes.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.238_Text: The whole island is gathering at the beach next week to pick up trash.//<portrait=angry>Yes. Trash.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.95_Text: The whole island is gathering at the beach tomorrow to pick up trash.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.237_Text: The whole island is gathering at the beach tomorrow to pick up trash.//<portrait=angry>Yes. Trash.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.137_Text: They belong in a glass cabinet, not in the sink all covered in grease and stew.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.234_Text: They literally built a mini golf course. Not bad, in my book.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.184_Text: This house is so big…and empty.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.138_Text: This one time, I made a video in the forest, and when I reviewed the footage, I saw I’d caught a slithering shadow.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.229_Text: Ugh, this Sunday is the planting day, yes?//I’m not looking forward to it.
DT_Dialogue_Leah_Production.77_Text: Ugh, why are you so close to me? You smell like a farm.

DT_Dialogue_Lily_Production.8FF60DA14C4F5A79F27ACCAD900A0E96: Yet he still eats cheese. Silly man.
DT_Dialogue_Lily_Production.275A94764637789CCB5706B2F3C1D278: Yet, he still eats cheese… Silly man.
DT_Dialogue_Lily_Production.2C5D4CE74839488ECF43B88B7A314199: You know, just to keep an eye on it.
DT_Dialogue_Lily_Production.59_Text: You know, just to keep an eye on it.
DT_Dialogue_Lily_Production.64DDA4EE49FCB63E52FD9CAA5F37D165: You should only water bonsai trees when the soil gets slightly dry, to avoid overwatering them.
DT_Dialogue_Lily_Production.808C041B482B9CCB3D8AC392E50FDDF7: You should only water bonsai trees when the soil gets slightly dry, to avoid overwatering them.
DT_Dialogue_Lily_Production.81_Text: You should only water bonsai trees when the soil gets slightly dry, to avoid overwatering them.
DT_Dialogue_Lily_Production.901727624768D63A8BE6A78C7AED1CF5: You're a great friend, Player... I really like spending time with you.
DT_Dialogue_Lily_Production.EA880E184F4FFED4CCFA4C83E39209C2: You're a great friend, Player... I really like spending time with you.
DT_Dialogue_Lily_Production.256_Text: You’re making me a bit nervous. I can feel my heart about to jump out of my shirt.
DT_Dialogue_Lily_Production.F1D8D2A242A0CC3F273032A5F4B1B8CB: You’re making me a bit nervous. I can feel my heart about to jump out of my shirt.
DT_Dialogue_Lily_Production.14E83AD6411C08AFC4BDF6906A092C31: … Other than to my bonsais, that is.

DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.36_Text: <NPCName>Bree</> wants to see things change on Coral Island, and she’s proactive about finding ways to make it happen.//I like talking to her about possibilities for improving our island.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.45_Text: <NPCName>Bree</> wants to see things change on Coral Island, and she’s proactive about finding ways to make it happen.//I like talking to her about possibilities for improving our island.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.141_Text: <NPCName>Bree</>? Hmm. I don’t have a clue where she’d be.//We’re good friends, but that doesn’t mean I know where she is every minute.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.201_Text: <NPCName>Kible</>'s my baby. My proudest invention so far.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.163_Text: <NPCName>Leah</> is a lovely young lady.//She may seem detached from reality sometimes, but she has a good heart.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.131_Text: <NPCName>Leah</> is very perceptive about beauty, fashion, and stuff like that.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.175_Text: <NPCName>Leah</> is very perceptive about beauty, fashion, and stuff like that.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.179_Text: <NPCName>Leah</> is very perceptive about beauty, fashion, and stuff like that.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.62_Text: A good thing to keep in mind when you go diving, <PlayerName>$player</>, is that the kelp’s color indicates its rarity.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.73_Text: A good thing to keep in mind when you go diving, <PlayerName>$player</>, is that the kelp’s color indicates its rarity.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.132_Text: A talent she inherited from her mother, I think.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.176_Text: A talent she inherited from her mother, I think.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.180_Text: A talent she inherited from her mother, I think.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.159_Text: All I did was read and build things. At the time, I wasn’t sure what I was going to end up with.//But I was always building something.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.80_Text: An oil-drilling company has been looking into my lab’s work lately and asked me about the state of our coral reefs.//I think it could be the same company that’s moving in this Summer.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.153_Text: And I still do.//<portrait=normal>Years later, a lot has changed – but at the same time, nothing has changed.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.118_Text: Anyway, I can’t work my best if I don’t take a break every now and then.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.172_Text: As my husband puts it, I’m <Italic>living</> a little.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.144_Text: Before I met <NPCName>Randy</>, I didn’t mind devoting my life solely to the study of coral reefs.//Day in and day out.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.155_Text: Besides, it gives my brain a bit of a break.//Even watching TV is too tiring for me sometimes.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.157_Text: But I do enjoy wine from time to time.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.16_Text: But that’s far in the future.//Right now, we just have to focus on getting the ocean floor around this island cleared.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.4_Text: But that’s far in the future.//Right now, we just have to focus on getting the ocean floor around this island cleared.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.67_Text: Careful making it, though.//It leaves a strong smell on your hands that lasts for days.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.72_Text: Careful making it, though.//It leaves a strong smell on your hands that lasts for days.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.181_Text: Careful what you touch here, will you?
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.32_Text: Coral reefs are my babies.//I just like to look at my doll collection.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.54_Text: Coral reefs are my babies.//I just like to look at my doll collection.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.133_Text: Do you know <NPCName>Walter</> well? He used to practice law in the city.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.12_Text: Don’t worry, the kelp around this island is considered a renewable resource.//<portrait=normal>It has a very high growth rate compared to land crops.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.20_Text: Don’t worry, the kelp around this island is considered a renewable resource.//<portrait=normal>It has a very high growth rate compared to land crops.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.164_Text: Errr, it really isn’t my place to comment, but she had a rough childhood.//I think that’s why she’s the way she is now.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.61_Text: Exposing coral reefs to oil can kill them, or at least slow their growth.//It doesn’t matter whether it’s a small amount of oil over a long time or a large amount for a brief period.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.74_Text: Exposing coral reefs to oil can kill them, or at least slow their growth.//It doesn’t matter whether it’s a small amount of oil over a long time or a large amount for a brief period.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.79_Text: For instance, the kelp forest is just like our forest.//It provides a stable home to many species.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.178_Text: Good thing <NPCName>Leah</> gives it the attention it needs.//That is all her, you know.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.37_Text: Green kelp is the easiest to come by, and it doesn’t fetch a very high price if you sell it raw.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.1_Text: Have you given diving a try yet?
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.142_Text: Have you tried the vineyard?//She may be in the greenhouse, gardening.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.59_Text: Having <NPCName>Bree</> on our side definitely helps.//With her connections, she’s the only one who can get as much funding as she does.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.195_Text: He also had a pet lobster, blue like that too.//<portrait=normal>He made a little throne for it. Even had its name engraved on it. Very cute!
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.151_Text: Hmm. I wonder if I should just make grilled vegetables again tonight.//<portrait=normal><NPCName>Leah</> might have taken care of dinner already.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.143_Text: Hmm. I wonder if I should just make grilled vegetables for dinner again tonight.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.191_Special: How do you know so much about merfolk technology?
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.125_Text: I almost always lived by myself when I was young, and I didn’t think I was lonely until I had company.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.98_Text: I always try to donate before Winter hits. Just whatever I knit that year.//Usually, the mayor and <NPCName>Bree</> have things for me to send too.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.187_Text: I brought an extra layer, just in case it gets windy.//You never know.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.149_Text: I buy my coffee beans from <NPCName>Sam</>.//They’re okay.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.152_Text: I came down here to work as soon as I got my degree.//I knew this was my future from the get-go.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.56_Text: I can’t really see myself doing anything but this.//It wouldn’t be fulfilling – to me, at least.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.70_Text: I can’t really see myself doing anything but this.//It wouldn’t be fulfilling – to me, at least.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.186_Text: I crocheted this hat.//<portrait=normal>Made about a dozen or so. I sent them to a homeless shelter in Pokyo last week.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.97_Text: I donate the scarves and beanies I knit during the year to a shelter on the other side of the island.//I hope they can use them.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.86_Text: I don’t plan to work tomorrow. Festivals give me a reason to take a break.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.66_Text: I don’t suppose you know how to make smoked salmon.//Slimy stuff, but <NPCName>Jim</> loves it, you know.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.71_Text: I don’t suppose you know how to make smoked salmon.//Slimy stuff, but <NPCName>Jim</> loves it, you know.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.165_Text: I encourage <NPCName>Randy</> to try to have a better relationship with <NPCName>Leah’s</> mother.//I think it would be good for all of them.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.30_Text: I got lucky and found my house for sale at a good price, so I bought it as soon as I could.//I’ve made it my life’s mission to improve the ocean environment around here ever since.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.126_Text: I guess I was so used to being alone I didn’t know any other way.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.128_Text: I had a hard time concentrating on math homework until I started knitting while thinking about a problem.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.191_Text: I helped bu–//<portrait=annoyed>Er, I’m a scientist. I know a lot about a lot of things.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.77_Text: I hope the big companies can see this and stop doing it.//It’s heartbreaking.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.63_Text: I hope you make good use of the diving suit.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.50_Text: I like to think we’re both passionate public servants, and that’s why we click.//Our goals are aligned.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.34_Text: I like to think we’re both passionate public servants, and that’s why we click.//Our goals are the same.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.47_Text: I like to think we’re both passionate public servants, and that’s why we click.//Our goals are the same.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.145_Text: I love my job. But now I have more than just a job to look forward to.//<portrait=normal>Feels strange. In a good way.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.137_Text: I need to get my flu shot, with colder weather on the way. Better safe than sorry, I think.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.177_Text: I never found the time to redecorate our house. This job requires me to be here all the time.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.129_Text: I never found the time to redecorate this house. Good thing <NPCName>Leah</> gives it the attention it needs.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.173_Text: I never found the time to redecorate this house. Good thing <NPCName>Leah</> gives it the attention it needs.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.25_Text: I once read a study that said music can help attract fish and repopulate dying coral reefs.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.7_Text: I once read a study that said music can help attract fish and repopulate dying coral reefs.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.185_Text: I prefer to have my lunch outside in the little park across from the lab.//<portrait=annoyed>The smell of chemicals and salt are too strong in here. It kills my appetite.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.188_Text: I purchased these sweatpants at White Flamingo.//<portrait=happy>They’re very comfortable. I might start wearing them all the time!
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.110_Text: I should probably go home and make sure the house is still standing.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.199_Text: I should talk to <NpcName>Millie</> and see if I can help prepare the beach clean up festival.//It's coming very soon, isn't it? The 27th?
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.127_Text: I started to knit in grade school.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.139_Text: I think I’ve got the flu, but I’m not sure. I’m going to see what <NPCName>Charles</> thinks.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.57_Text: I usually go to <NPCName>Theo</> if I need a specific specimen from the sea.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.64_Text: I usually go to <NPCName>Theo</> if I need a specific specimen from the sea.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.115_Text: I wear the same beanie every year.//Why replace something that’s still good, right?
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.147_Text: If you’re looking for <NPCName>Leah</>, she should be leading a yoga class in the community center today.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.196_Text: Is everything alright at the farm?
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.166_Text: It must have been hard for that poor girl to grow up in the middle of a divorce.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.200_Text: It was challenging to make <NPCName>Kible</>.//I failed several times. Good thing I could reuse some of the parts, so it wasn't a total waste.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.15_Text: It’ll be good to get all the trash in the ocean cleaned up, won’t it?//For one thing, we’ll actually be able to see how the coral reefs are doing and monitor their health.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.3_Text: It’ll be good to get all the trash in the ocean cleaned up, won’t it?//For one thing, we’ll actually be able to see how the coral reefs are doing and monitor their health.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.119_Text: It’s a bit stuffy here this time of year, isn’t it?
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.136_Text: It’s hard to think about work in this weather.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.122_Text: It’s kind of nice, actually. Especially after a long day of focusing on work.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.84_Text: It’s my good friend <NPCName>Walter’s</> birthday tomorrow.//What should I give him, do you think?
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.124_Text: It’s not just that. It also exercises your brain.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.135_Text: It’s okay to unwind once in a while, but everything in moderation.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.96_Text: It’s sad to see how much trash there is at sea, isn’t it?//It’s unfortunate.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.156_Text: I’d take an exceptional bottle of kelp over wine.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.102_Text: I’m excited about the prospect of heat-resistant coral reefs.//I feel like it’ll make a massive difference in the ecosystem.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.35_Text: I’m going to visit <NPCName>Bree</> at her vineyard tomorrow.//<portrait=happy>Catch up over some cheese and olives.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.44_Text: I’m going to visit <NPCName>Bree</> at her vineyard tomorrow.//<portrait=happy>Catch up over some cheese and olives.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.101_Text: I’m happy with the progress we’ve made this year.//I’m excited to see what the New Year brings to our island.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.171_Text: I’m not working today. So, here I am.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.55_Text: I’m very lucky to have found my passion so young and to be able to devote my life to it.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.69_Text: I’m very lucky to have found my passion so young.//Some people never do.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.29_Text: I’ve always wanted to be a scientist, of course.//I used to spend my days reading books about sea life and coral reef restoration.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.158_Text: I’ve liked learning about hum–//<portrait=concerned>Umm…//<portrait=normal>About technology since I was little.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.140_Text: Just in case, don’t get too close.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.78_Text: Kelp is full of nutrients that can be beneficial to the environment.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.154_Text: Knitting can elevate your mood and improve your motor function.//<portrait=happy>It’s a great hobby!
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.123_Text: Knitting helps keep your joints healthy. Did you know that?
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.13_Text: Little things help our planet too.//Bringing home your trash after a beach day is a great start.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.27_Text: Little things help our planet, too.//Bringing home your trash after a beach day is a great start.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.111_Text: Meh. Checking won’t make any difference.//What good would I be, anyway? It’s not like I could prevent anything from happening.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.99_Text: My ears get cold in Winter. *sighs*
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.48_Text: My lab can help you upgrade all kinds of things. The quality of your seeds, for one.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.38_Text: My lab can help you upgrade all kinds of things.//<portrait=normal>The quality of your seeds, for one.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.85_Text: No mushrooms. I don’t think he likes them very much.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.193_Text: Of course! I used to live there!//<portrait=annoyed>Er, I mean I studied it so much, I practically lived there. That’s a saying, I think. Yeah!
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.103_Text: Of course, we need to fight pollution too.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.105_Text: Oh! Was I sleeping with my eyes open again?
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.109_Text: Oh! Was I sleeping with my eyes open again?
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.58_Text: Oh! You’d help too? Thanks.//I’ll mail you a request sometime, then.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.65_Text: Oh! You’d help too? Thanks.//I’ll mail you a request sometime, then.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.81_Text: Oh, I’m sorry. Not this Summer. It’s earlier than that.//I think it’s actually next week. Pufferfish, isn’t it?
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.18_Text: Oh, many kinds!//<portrait=happy>Hats, beanies, scarves, clothes for my dolls. A lot of things.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.22_Text: Oh, many kinds!//<portrait=happy>Hats, beanies, scarves, clothes for my dolls. A lot of things.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.2_Text: Oh, that machine at the pier?//Yeah, it’s a piece of very old technology.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.134_Text: Oh, that was long before <NPCName>Luke</> was even born. I heard that’s where he met <NPCName>Bree</>.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.76_Text: Oil can be very damaging to coral reefs.//It can stop their growth and affect the entire ecosystem. Fish, crabs. Everything.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.197_Text: Once in a while, <NpcName>Surya</> and I take turns cleaning up the aquarium.//<portrait=annoyed>It's a pain.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.43_Text: Once you find a beacon and clean it, it will transfer data directly to the lab.//<portrait=happy>Neat, right?
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.23_Text: Once you have five bottles of the same kind of kelp, bring them over to me.//I can help you with boosting your farm output.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.5_Text: Once you have five bottles of the same kind of kelp, bring them over to me.//I can help you with boosting your farm output.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.9_Text: Once you have five bottles of the same kind of kelp, bring them over to me.//I can help you with boosting your farm output.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.26_Text: One day, I’d like to incorporate music into my work here.//But we have to tackle pollution in our water first.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.8_Text: One day, I’d like to incorporate music into my work here.//But we have to tackle pollution in our water first.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.184_Text: Our filter broke a couple years back. Turned out there was a soggy kite stuck in it.//<portrait=annoyed>Yeah, the one outside. That was a pain to fix.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.31_Text: People take their dolls out for tea and such. It’s a thing, you know!//Mine just sit behind the glass door.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.53_Text: People take their dolls out for tea and such. It’s a thing, you know!//Mine just sit behind the glass door.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.117_Text: Saturday is a good day to take off.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.116_Text: Seems like it’s snowing pretty hard outside.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.148_Text: She’s a busy girl.//If she’s not there, then I really can’t tell you where she’d be. Sorry.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.83_Text: Some kelp is very rare. Sometimes, I’ll put in a request to <NPCName>Theo</> and still can’t get any.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.160_Text: Studying coral reefs yesterday, I felt like an eager new student.//Now, my hip hurts from standing too much.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.52_Text: Sure, you can try going over now. <NPCName>Surya</> might be there.//But I really doubt it.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.106_Text: Thankfully, the walk to my house from the lab isn’t too far.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.198_Text: The Pet Day yesterday was a blast.//<portrait=happy>Who taught Bonbon to dance like that? What a smart puppy.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.150_Text: The coffee from <NPCName>Raj</>’s probably tastes better, but I don’t want to spend hundreds of coins for a cup of coffee every day.//The normal kind does the job fine.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.194_Text: The cute little lobster, the one that’s always with <NPCName>Macy</>, reminds me of an old friend’s pet.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.82_Text: The snow may have melted, but it’s still freezing around here!
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.33_Text: The thing about <NPCName>Randy</> and me is we bond over our commitment to education.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.46_Text: The thing about <NPCName>Randy</> and me is we bond over our commitment to education.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.49_Text: The thing about <NPCName>Randy</> and me is we bond over our commitment to education.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.183_Text: The water in the tank has the same salinity as the ocean.//In fact, it has the same exact composition.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.146_Text: There are pearls and lots of other things in the ocean you can collect and sell.//<portrait=happy>Not just kelp!
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.75_Text: There might be valuable things you can find when diving.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.10_Text: There will be a fee, of course!
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.24_Text: There will be a fee, of course!
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.6_Text: There will be a fee, of course!
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.121_Text: There’s no need for me to concentrate when I knit.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.130_Text: This is all her, you know.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.174_Text: This is all her, you know.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.113_Text: Ugh. The rain is so heavy. I hope the house isn't making weird noises.//It’s pretty solid, though.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.120_Text: Unfortunately, we need to keep the windows shut. I have to be sure there’s no contamination.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.182_Text: We rarely get visitors.//I invited <NPCName>Randy</> to bring the kids. He brought them a couple of times, years ago, but never since.//<portrait=concerned>Not many things to look at, huh?
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.39_Text: We rely on government funding and private donations to run.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.41_Text: We rely on government funding and private donations to run.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.87_Text: Well, maybe I’ll stop by the lab after the festival for a bit. If time allows.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.51_Text: We’re closed today.//If you need anything from the lab, come by tomorrow morning. I’ll be there first thing.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.168_Text: What brings you to this part of the island, <PlayerName>$player</>?//The weekend?
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.167_Text: When I first came here to live, I thought I’d want to visit my home more, but I’m shocked that I don’t.//I do miss it every once in a while, but not as much as I thought I would.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.17_Text: When I have some free time – now, keep in mind I don’t have a lot of it – but when I do, I like to knit. It’s surprisingly relaxing.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.21_Text: When I have some free time – now, keep in mind I don’t have a lot of it – but when I do, I like to knit. It’s surprisingly relaxing.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.189_Text: Where I’m from, it’s often dark like this. This lab reminds me a lot of where I grew up.//Especially the colorful corals.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.161_Text: Where did all the years go, I wonder?
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.11_Text: While you’re out diving, remember to collect some kelp.//It comes in handy on a farm.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.93_Text: Who knows? They might have valuable items inside.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.95_Text: Who knows? They might have valuable items inside.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.162_Text: Wow! I can’t believe it’s Sunday again!
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.192_Text: Yes, but ocean water doesn’t agree with my skin.//I think I’ll stick to fresh water for now.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.60_Text: Yes, coral reefs. I was talking about Coral Island and how we can improve the ocean environment.//Because you know, <PlayerName>$player</>, it isn’t cheap.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.40_Text: Yes, right. I meant the lab.//I suppose I’m grateful. I’m glad our government is paying attention to the coral reef issue.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.42_Text: Yes, right. I meant the lab.//I’m grateful, I suppose. I’m pleased our government pays a lot of attention to the coral reef issue.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.14_Text: You can actively prevent the trash from being eaten by turtles or sea mammals that way.
DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.28_Text: You can actively prevent the trash from being eaten by turtles or sea mammals that way.

DT_Dialogue_Ling_Production.94_Text: You can break open treasure chests you find at sea.

DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.021C2F3E4615D0962441CA8836B9A51E: All is good, then. I’m glad!

DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.BC97D6484BE5969E4A916C83789C9D2F: All that waitin' around...all for a fish. One fish.//Yeah, can't be bothered with that.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.94_Text: Are you as busy as we are in Fall?//<portrait=concerned>It’s honestly such a pain. But it is what it is.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.FF1CCBEF4E13CC8C4C2212BE1622F1CC: Are you as busy as we are in Fall?//<portrait=concerned>It’s honestly such a pain. But it is what it is.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.102_Text: Are you coming to Mother’s party?//<portrait=happy>You should. We usually have an amazing spread and fun games all night.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.963FCE714A2701242B4F1598E88E2DC1: Are you coming to Mother’s party?//<portrait=happy>You should. We usually have an amazing spread and fun games all night.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.3B18A15047663F9FDDCA3CA9994D67D6: Are you warm in those, <PlayerName>$player</>?//I reckon the jumper I’m wearing is sufficient for Fall. No need for heavy coats just yet.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.99_Text: Are you warm in those, <PlayerName>$player</>?//I reckon the jumper I’m wearing is sufficient for Fall. No need for heavy coats just yet.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.25_Text: Aren’t you supposed to be working?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.8E933DD043A6143DBE57678EDFC6DE7F: Aren’t you supposed to be working?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.124_Text: Blimey, it's the first week of Summer and the mosquitoes are out in full force already.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.991AEEBB41066CDAB32DA0AD5F8731D7: Blimey, it's the first week of Summer and the mosquitoes are out in full force already.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.18_Text: Blimey, you've got quite a style, I must say.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.9671F8264827F80339CEE8BB71D747DE: Blimey, you've got quite a style, I must say.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.13_Text: But I won’t. Well, technically speaking, it's more like I can't.//<portrait=concerned>I've got work piled up that'll keep me busy for at least the next two or three days, you see.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.1B4AD23540551C3FC64BC58433D7EB17: But I won’t. Well, technically speaking, it's more like I can't.//<portrait=concerned>I've got work piled up that'll keep me busy for at least the next two or three days, you see.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.50_Text: But does that mean my decision is based merely on convenience? Would I change my mind if, perhaps, I took flavor into account?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.533F7F7B4D23E8FD70B5FA933F6AEE82: But does that mean my decision is based merely on convenience? Would I change my mind if, perhaps, I took flavor into account?

DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.233_Text: But it sure wouldn’t hurt if the right person came along.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.2F4A46E7474E791857CB7DB135E68BD6: But it sure wouldn’t hurt if the right person came along.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.252_Text: But it’s just a fact I have to live with.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.B4FBAF7D47E17AC42887A2ADC18831DA: But it’s just a fact I have to live with.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.213_Text: But you won’t tell anyone, will you, <PlayerName>$player</>?//I trust you. For some reason, I feel like I can tell you things.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.9F88BF7A410F13697F8233ACEAE74604: But you won’t tell anyone, will you, <PlayerName>$player</>?//I trust you. For some reason, I feel like I can tell you things.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.216_Text: By the way, I like talking to you. Sorry if I don’t always act like it.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.2A8707DB49EEB43D7D5181BD7EBE9B6D: By the way, I like talking to you. Sorry if I don’t always act like it.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.129_Text: Can't believe next week's already Fall.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.B4D356814D4F9239FDA44CBB20F30000: Can't believe next week's already Fall.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.121_Text: Cherry blossoms are so beautiful, yet their lives are so tragically short. Perhaps like life…
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.6B3E46844AB112A6475373B42E3F13CB: Cherry blossoms are so beautiful, yet their lives are so tragically short. Perhaps like life…
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.222_Text: Come and hang out here more often, will you? I could use your company.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.425849E44A68D4072D07248FAFFB26E6: Come and hang out here more often, will you? I could use your company.

DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.D5D9283848F10927E5ED669603CCDFF6: Did you do anything fun to celebrate the New Year?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.0A775031429E1DFAFF4B9CBB4457A909: Do you have a favorite grape?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.47_Text: Do you have a favorite grape?

DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.F7A58DC34706BA9D195326A032E7775A: Do you have one of those too?
