DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.E9339B8C4B56AB02A53428A763A65231: Excuse me. I’m kind of in a rush.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.246_Text: Growing up here, away from any big city, I had a hard time finding electronic toys or even the TV I wanted.//I know it sounds so shallow, but it bugged me.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.EEF63BEE4CD0A0751A231D9B76B2B028: Growing up here, away from any big city, I had a hard time finding electronic toys or even the TV I wanted.//I know it sounds so shallow, but it bugged me.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.36_Text: Has anyone ever told you that you talk a lot? It’s a bit counterproductive when you’re trying to work.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.6975D4054D5751BAF76EA5B2A25AEB9E: Has anyone ever told you that you talk a lot? It’s a bit counterproductive when you’re trying to work.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.142_Text: Have you checked them out? They’re fascinating, to say the least.//<portrait=normal>One time, I saw a puppet made out of wood with a coconut shell for a head. It was all dressed up. Very odd.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.A7AE96884212DB3F455BCB81F7ABC849: Have you checked them out? They’re fascinating, to say the least.//<portrait=normal>One time, I saw a puppet made out of wood with a coconut shell for a head. It was all dressed up. Very odd.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.255_Text: Have you read this book? I picked it up on the way here.//Got it from the library. It looks well read. Must be popular.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.15_Text: Have you seen the new items I have in stock?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.86E112ED45502C58361B06A8764A7618: Have you seen the new items I have in stock?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.190_Text: Have you tried the vineyard? He could be in the greenhouse.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.D0DDF1C249E2BA1D38F5A1BFDCD1FE05: Have you tried the vineyard? He could be in the greenhouse.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.132_Text: Her parents were okay with it. Our families are very close. Ah, fun times.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.D225C38447BAA6C57954ABAB8CF0FE4F: Her parents were okay with it. Our families are very close. Ah, fun times.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.198_Text: Hmm, I think I’ll chill here today. I’m too tired to go to the Tavern.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.200_Text: Hmm, I think I’ll chill here today. I’m too tired to go to the Tavern.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.8EBB45CA4B3AD916459942BF45B0F6B6: Hmm, I think I’ll chill here today. I’m too tired to go to the Tavern.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.BABBD3F047C618A3B795798963A24A8F: Hmm, I think I’ll chill here today. I’m too tired to go to the Tavern.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.53_Text: Hmm. I might need to order some extra TVs to sell. They seem to be flying off the shelves.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.BB5D4E6F42B61D9887C07CB8AC008A84: Hmm. I might need to order some extra TVs to sell. They seem to be flying off the shelves.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.42_Text: Hmm. I should wear a hat.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.CCC6913E4F556733C8C27AA14F749E6D: Hmm. I should wear a hat.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.40_Text: How am I expected to turn a profit? I can't possibly increase my rates.//The townies wouldn't be able to afford my goods if I hiked up the prices.//<portrait=concerned>I'd risk alienating customers, which could very well drive me out of business.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.F1447A304292B3F5525953BCE4180E3E: How am I expected to turn a profit? I can't possibly increase my rates.//The townies wouldn't be able to afford my goods if I hiked up the prices.//<portrait=concerned>I'd risk alienating customers, which could very well drive me out of business.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.10173EE344D2282F27AF9DAB1D4D478E: How do you even choose which ones to pick?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.113_Text: How do you even choose which ones to pick?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.134_Text: How do you keep warm in your cabin on Fall nights?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.5C8E9A944D8655AB448E0E98EDA8128D: How do you keep warm in your cabin on Fall nights?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.21_Text: How’s your week been so far? You look like you haven’t slept much.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.86BDE08B4B756BCDDA0444A8F95B0304: How’s your week been so far? You look like you haven’t slept much.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.125_Text: Huh. I feel like you’ve asked me that already.//<portrait=normal>In any case, I find star fruit aesthetically pleasing, but a tad too bitter for my taste.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.8CB11D664A52A078A2828DAD90A43AF2: Huh. I feel like you’ve asked me that already.//<portrait=normal>In any case, I find star fruit aesthetically pleasing, but a tad too bitter for my taste.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.231_Text: I admire your courage moving here. It was a big change, and you went for it.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.C403F67A498DF9E96B97E98C90BA3586: I admire your courage moving here. It was a big change, and you went for it.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.0E9FCB504A093B62C0CF5198FBEB0265: I always bring lunch from home.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.181_Text: I always bring lunch from home.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.194_Text: I believe, in this instance, that honesty is the best policy.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.D07BD12648BCEDE917E4E385D9F6E9EA: I believe, in this instance, that honesty is the best policy.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.179_Text: I can feel the snow through my sweater, straight to my bones.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.65DFF66D40E829E700BBD7A971E98D7D: I can feel the snow through my sweater, straight to my bones.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.003BCFAE4BFF1C7B83C0618A556F9926: I can never decide on my favorite grape. I want to say yuscat because you can both eat it and turn it into wine.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.37_Text: I can never decide on my favorite grape. I want to say yuscat because you can both eat it and turn it into wine.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.49_Text: I can never decide on my favorite grape. I want to say yuscat because you can both eat it and turn it into wine.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.7D0DF5BA410135AAF926D086846AA39C: I can never decide on my favorite grape. I want to say yuscat because you can both eat it and turn it into wine.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.208_Text: I can’t focus on work at home.//There are always so many distractions, like <NPCName>Taco</> zooming in and out, being adorable. Very distracting.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.2EB109D747D8A8E691B959A27DDD0CD6: I can’t focus on work at home.//There are always so many distractions, like <NPCName>Taco</> zooming in and out, being adorable. Very distracting.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.104_Text: I can’t wait for the Consumer Electronics Expo this Spring.//I wonder what <Italic>weird</> stuff they’ll have!
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.92C22DC34B139F4F5BB50BA66843700E: I can’t wait for the Consumer Electronics Expo this Spring.//I wonder what <Italic>weird</> stuff they’ll have!
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.253_Text: I caught <NPCName>Theo</> singing in the rain the other day. Like, why?//<portrait=concerned>Creative people, huh? They’re hard to understand sometimes.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.B08E4A1741BABF7B4F65B6A67C548C5C: I caught <NPCName>Theo</> singing in the rain the other day. Like, why?//<portrait=concerned>Creative people, huh? They’re hard to understand sometimes.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.239_Special: I consider us good friends too.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.A05E48334031C5C5BFF5B2926579FA71: I consider us good friends too.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.221_Text: I could lose sleep reading about Coral Island lore. As a matter of fact, I have. Many times.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.751C123B4FE95ABF2CEA549BF8C8152E: I could lose sleep reading about Coral Island lore. As a matter of fact, I have. Many times.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.7C8F9BF94008CBDDB116D1A4619FBE73: I did that too. Sailing was nice. The sea is one of my favorite places to be.//And tennis camp was fun. You’re gone for a whole season and come back improved by the time school starts.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.91_Text: I did that too. Sailing was nice. The sea is one of my favorite places to be.//And tennis camp was fun. You’re gone for a whole season and come back improved by the time school starts.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.4_Text: I don't mind chipping in a tad extra in taxes if it goes directly towards sprucing up the buildings around here.//<portrait=concerned>But that’s not always the case, and regrettably, I don't see eye to eye with some of this town's current spending.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.58BB7B394412226353676B9AED544072: I don't mind chipping in a tad extra in taxes if it goes directly towards sprucing up the buildings around here.//<portrait=concerned>But that’s not always the case, and regrettably, I don't see eye to eye with some of this town's current spending.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.11DC757C4F1CF4AF27C971865E218155: I don’t care much about it, but it seems important to her. So, I’ll keep it up. At the end of the day, it’s the least I can do after everything my parents have done for me.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.146_Text: I don’t care much about it, but it seems important to her. So, I’ll keep it up. At the end of the day, it’s the least I can do after everything my parents have done for me.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.0E74D1924024CA6C633883B2137D5DF3: I don’t fancy fishing. You just sit around doing nothing for a long time, waiting for a fish to take the bait.//Doesn’t seem productive to me.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.23_Text: I don’t fancy fishing. You just sit around doing nothing for a long time, waiting for a fish to take the bait.//Doesn’t seem productive to me.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.3_Text: I don’t get why Mother keeps complaining about the recycling center. I walked past it yesterday, and it smelled fine.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.9802DD9343269291C67205A9048222D2: I don’t get why Mother keeps complaining about the recycling center. I walked past it yesterday, and it smelled fine.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.111_Text: I don’t know about Pokyo, but deep-fried bananas are a thing around here. <NPCName>Joko</> loves them.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.87D39794458EC57EB09903ABA0D744B2: I don’t know about Pokyo, but deep-fried bananas are a thing around here. <NPCName>Joko</> loves them.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.60_Text: I don’t know yet. I suppose it depends on how many orders I have to sort out today.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.B88B001245C39EA5B7EE0F9114A59582: I don’t know yet. I suppose it depends on how many orders I have to sort out today.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.155_Text: I don’t mind the rain today.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.842BD37B45585D479CA61E967C5DA99E: I don’t mind the rain today.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.210_Text: I don’t reckon living downtown is an option for me.//My parents worked hard for the vineyard, and they’ve been telling me my whole life how proud they are that I’m carrying on the family business.//Since I was in diapers, I’m sure.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.71CB98DC47035033F58DC0A860013487: I don’t reckon living downtown is an option for me.//My parents worked hard for the vineyard, and they’ve been telling me my whole life how proud they are that I’m carrying on the family business.//Since I was in diapers, I’m sure.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.87_Text: I don’t think I’ve seen Father sailing since I was a boy. I haven’t gone in a while either.//<portrait=normal>Maybe I should ask him.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.B63AADC44B555A52929BB198C59B2960: I don’t think I’ve seen Father sailing since I was a boy. I haven’t gone in a while either.//<portrait=normal>Maybe I should ask him.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.65_Text: I don’t want to startle you, but I’ve got to tell you about this book.//<portrait=surprised>It reckons a bunch of different magical creatures used to dwell on this island.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.D3C41023483CED7FCBAE049097674750: I don’t want to startle you, but I’ve got to tell you about this book.//<portrait=surprised>It reckons a bunch of different magical creatures used to dwell on this island.

DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.152_Text: I feel a bit gloomy today.

That way, you can compare them for yourself right there and then.//Size doesn’t matter when it comes to electronics stores.

DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.87524C814AA0742A3AA5529C9B89C8AE: I guess this’ll be the last week we can enjoy the cherry blossoms this year.

DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.147_Text: I hope you’re going to the New Year’s Eve dinner at the vineyard.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.8C8AEB2C4F1DBF4A1C3EA18C7CFCD6FE: I hope you’re going to the New Year’s Eve dinner at the vineyard.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.2D8BFB954F98E27B6903BF854EE8095A: I just got this cool speaker in this week’s shipment.//I’m going to test it out at <NpcName>Pablo’s</> and see if I should keep it or not.

DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.230_Text: I just want to say how much I appreciate your friendship, <PlayerName>$player</>.//<portrait=normal>You’re one of the only people on this island I consider a close friend.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.7259C8D34851814B1CDECBBA3835A69E: I just want to say how much I appreciate your friendship, <PlayerName>$player</>.//<portrait=normal>You’re one of the only people on this island I consider a close friend.

DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.DD5FBFBC4AF2EB79AFADCB99F9DE1266: I keep my business relationships separate from personal ones.//<portrait=normal>With good business partners, I can’t risk getting too close and damaging the relationship.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.06875F2245639CC860361AB63BED2388: I know it's Summer, but I can't be bothered to put on shorts.//I live on a hill behind a vineyard. If I wore shorts, I’d get eaten alive by mosquitoes.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.81_Text: I know it's Summer, but I can't be bothered to put on shorts.//I live on a hill behind a vineyard. If I wore shorts, I’d get eaten alive by mosquitoes.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.57_Text: I let my hair grow out once, and it was awfully hot.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.BE8072244B36109032730AA624FCD816: I let my hair grow out once, and it was awfully hot.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.68_Text: I like the sound of that!
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.0C7CAB194722797828432895BF9C7052: I mean, maybe there was a Goddess. But merfolk?//Not just a few merfolk, but a whole population. It claims an ancient kingdom of merfolk lived around Coral Island. Huh?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.66_Text: I mean, maybe there was a Goddess. But merfolk?//Not just a few merfolk, but a whole population. It claims an ancient kingdom of merfolk lived around Coral Island. Huh?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.199_Text: I might go to the Tavern later. I’m craving a big plate of pasta!
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.FC6193584C732A5464AFC28A6066B924: I might go to the Tavern later. I’m craving a big plate of pasta!
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.41_Text: I might go to the beach tomorrow. Visit the shack or something of the sort.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.BD995BE2403E50894C08E3A5E326D154: I might go to the beach tomorrow. Visit the shack or something of the sort.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.8511D69145CFB28A03CE8A89E52EE127: I need to make sure we have enough time to process and ship orders before Winter hits.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.95_Text: I need to make sure we have enough time to process and ship orders before Winter hits.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.51_Text: I need to think about this.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.5C1DDC6E4D88F58F9ACED28C53554879: I need to think about this.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.232_Text: I never really thought about settling down, I guess. I was too busy running the vineyard and making a name for myself.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.A018FAF840813ADF9D3E3F9627B00E0A: I never really thought about settling down, I guess. I was too busy running the vineyard and making a name for myself.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.225_Text: I never thought of myself as a relationship kind of guy.//But I can see how it could be tempting.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.85D73E3048229185A040BE9791C6D00E: I never thought of myself as a relationship kind of guy.//But I can see how it could be tempting.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.136_Text: I ordered some heaters for the ranch, and they still haven’t arrived. Disaster!
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.FD0EDD0343AEE1EA601F1E86652A3A40: I ordered some heaters for the ranch, and they still haven’t arrived. Disaster!
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.26078F0E49C705B8D34971A352E46101: I read people in an earlier civilization here used to farm together and share their harvest.//It was the law of the land.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.6_Text: I read people in an earlier civilization here used to farm together and share their harvest.//It was the law of the land.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.20_Text: I reckon I'll change up me display today.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.E6B21EEE4C29F2C5E3BFC4B994AF698F: I reckon I'll change up me display today.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.192_Text: I reckon he likes to live on his own.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.4EB50FC2410484B464D52C87A8160298: I reckon he likes to live on his own.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.27_Text: I reckon it's equally important to work hard and understand our limits.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.5AB5253F42CA32D77C14679D9308BA76: I reckon it's equally important to work hard and understand our limits.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.2A7BC6FD4FAC7BB48DC265907E35CEA1: I shall take things at a leisurely pace today.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.33_Text: I shall take things at a leisurely pace today.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.180_Text: I should have stayed home today.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.63277D9C45A9ACDC283C4CA7C9DD2A2C: I should have stayed home today.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.205_Text: I think I had too much family interaction yesterday. It was still good, but a bit exhausting. It’s a confusing feeling.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.E6C6CF494B8B1C995355FBBA1ED1A3EB: I think I had too much family interaction yesterday. It was still good, but a bit exhausting. It’s a confusing feeling.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.226_Text: I think the key is to find someone compatible. Someone you can be friends with.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.2553341C47E4499C63D8959AC18E622A: I think the key is to find someone compatible. Someone you can be friends with.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.247_Text: I thought to myself, why not buy the things I like in bulk and see if others like them too?//<portrait=happy>It turned out they do. People appreciate not having to order their electronics themselves and wait for them to arrive. So, here we are.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.6AE4542C42C903AB479EB78A22C0174B: I thought to myself, why not buy the things I like in bulk and see if others like them too?//<portrait=happy>It turned out they do. People appreciate not having to order their electronics themselves and wait for them to arrive. So, here we are.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.10_Text: I used to work on Mondays, but there wasn’t much business.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.EB8A206A4B3CA1EDB7FD5B813456B114: I used to work on Mondays, but there wasn’t much business.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.218_Text: I usually just hang out around town or on the beach.//<portrait=normal>Living in Hillside makes me feel like I’m out in nature every day. I have no desire to visit the lake or the forest.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.DA8DF5B74F11C841CA561B9232A177C8: I usually just hang out around town or on the beach.//<portrait=normal>Living in Hillside makes me feel like I’m out in nature every day. I have no desire to visit the lake or the forest.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.63_Text: I was reading at the library the other day, minding my own business, and somebody tapped me on the shoulder.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.73605FA24C9B18D6E910A3A37AFFE6D3: I was reading at the library the other day, minding my own business, and somebody tapped me on the shoulder.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.64_Text: I was reading. At the library. Isn’t that a clear sign I don’t want to be disturbed?//Some of us need to learn to read the room a bit better.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.792451894758669311073E934EF059F7: I was reading. At the library. Isn’t that a clear sign I don’t want to be disturbed?//Some of us need to learn to read the room a bit better.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.93_Text: I wish I could spend more time at Socket, but it's harvest season, and the vineyard is just taking up all of my time.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.9A2AD9014C55887D8D5E85B4B2546690: I wish I could spend more time at Socket, but it's harvest season, and the vineyard is just taking up all of my time.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.052393C14A7AB7CB06079683792E5C68: I wish we could just drop everything and go away for the weekend.//<portrait=blushing>Maybe a weekend sail. Just you and me at sea. How does that sound?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.242_Text: I wish we could just drop everything and go away for the weekend.//<portrait=blushing>Maybe a weekend sail. Just you and me at sea. How does that sound?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.5B0BC0AD42C6212AE48923AA488D17C6: I wouldn’t be much use gardening. I learned a thing or two from Mother, but I have no, umm… What do they call it?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.8_Text: I wouldn’t be much use gardening. I learned a thing or two from Mother, but I have no, umm… What do they call it?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.46685D1C4FBE74EC1EF637AD7A25E4A9: I've got a no-return policy at Socket. My supplier only guarantees my personal orders.//Even then, it’s limited to tellies and speakers, not kitchen appliances.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.56_Text: I've got a no-return policy at Socket. My supplier only guarantees my personal orders.//Even then, it’s limited to tellies and speakers, not kitchen appliances.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.100_Text: If you need more layers for Winter, White Flamingo usually has great jumpers.//I get mine from there. Sometimes they have questionable things, though, like giant animal onesies.//Fashion, I suppose. I don’t quite understand.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.AE08D67B465ECA814569688B3476D9A4: If you need more layers for Winter, White Flamingo usually has great jumpers.//I get mine from there. Sometimes they have questionable things, though, like giant animal onesies.//Fashion, I suppose. I don’t quite understand.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.05E61CB64CB3793F79A5BA88A7A8297E: If you need to buy seeds, go to <NPCName>Sam</>’s General Store.//He carries a variety.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.108_Text: If you need to buy seeds, go to <NPCName>Sam</>’s General Store.//He carries a variety.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.2_Text: Interesting. Moving to a small island from Pokyo is an odd choice.//<portrait=normal>And why now? But I suppose everyone has their own reasons.//Good luck with everything.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.7C4BB0704214B946C9EF85B2AC2CBC69: Interesting. Moving to a small island from Pokyo is an odd choice.//<portrait=normal>And why now? But I suppose everyone has their own reasons.//Good luck with everything.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.0CAF69F340B2C8F43ADAF8BA35527737: It depends, I guess. I don’t mind it today.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.150_Text: It depends, I guess. I don’t mind it today.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.211_Text: It isn’t just a business for us, you see. It’s a legacy.//I knew it would break their hearts if I told them I didn’t want to live at the vineyard.//<portrait=sad>They’d take it as me not wanting the vineyard.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.CA4FE44F46767642AB559FBC08203C36: It isn’t just a business for us, you see. It’s a legacy.//I knew it would break their hearts if I told them I didn’t want to live at the vineyard.//<portrait=sad>They’d take it as me not wanting the vineyard.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.156_Text: It isn’t too windy, and it isn’t pouring. It’s sprinkling, but not raining so hard that I have to put my rubber boots on.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.160_Text: It isn’t too windy, and it isn’t pouring. It’s sprinkling, but not raining so hard that I have to put my rubber boots on.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.59BCB47D462662E349D4F1BF1AE9E92F: It isn’t too windy, and it isn’t pouring. It’s sprinkling, but not raining so hard that I have to put my rubber boots on.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.E916CB494800B071B14C59B16A740B43: It isn’t too windy, and it isn’t pouring. It’s sprinkling, but not raining so hard that I have to put my rubber boots on.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.7_Text: It probably worked because it was a much simpler time back then.//<portrait=normal>Nowadays, I reckon we'd be needing some sort of permit even for running something as basic as a community garden.//Ponderous, isn't it?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.882AFDD44A6C86CB2A8B0A9051B2DE2F: It probably worked because it was a much simpler time back then.//<portrait=normal>Nowadays, I reckon we'd be needing some sort of permit even for running something as basic as a community garden.//Ponderous, isn't it?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.69_Text: It was literal trash. This is ridiculous!
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.70_Special: It's not good. I’m nose-diving into bankruptcy.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.EEB85815486484EECFCACF95B912F9E1: It's not good. I’m nose-diving into bankruptcy.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.73_Text: It’s a jolly day, for sure. And I shall treat it as such. I’m done complaining for the week.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.8A5CE70E48C0EF36A3773CB31D139AD6: It’s a jolly day, for sure. And I shall treat it as such. I’m done complaining for the week.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.61_Text: It’s a pickle deciding on gifts.//How do you know someone’s tastes haven’t shifted since the last time you gave them a present?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.7F52E4B14B1258FA4F7E8DA0EC828874: It’s a pickle deciding on gifts.//How do you know someone’s tastes haven’t shifted since the last time you gave them a present?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.77_Text: It’s always cool to see new technology. That’s why the Consumer Electronics Expo is the <Italic>one</> event I’m looking forward to in Spring.//<portrait=concerned>Well, that’s not true. I also like the Cherry Blossom Festival.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.D43FE9724D25869C31F231B0F1D23932: It’s always cool to see new technology. That’s why the Consumer Electronics Expo is the <Italic>one</> event I’m looking forward to in Spring.//<portrait=concerned>Well, that’s not true. I also like the Cherry Blossom Festival.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.19_Text: It’s distinctive, to say the least.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.D66916404C6AF6363A6C7B815DB1BC98: It’s distinctive, to say the least.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.68_Special: It’s going well. Plant, harvest, ka-ching!
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.DE3E53294900DDBFB43E2D9F719DF3EB: It’s going well. Plant, harvest, ka-ching!
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.234_Text: It’s great that the store is downtown. That’s where most of the traffic is.//<portrait=normal>We’d probably never be able to get a permit for an electronics store anywhere else, anyway.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.3EA8661B4483B5C442CD438F0C04A12E: It’s great that the store is downtown. That’s where most of the traffic is.//<portrait=normal>We’d probably never be able to get a permit for an electronics store anywhere else, anyway.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.74_Text: It’s lively here on Saturday, isn’t it?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.DAB9523D429482862531C0B4FFB61F11: It’s lively here on Saturday, isn’t it?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.117_Text: It’s nearly the end of Spring already. I feel like I haven’t done much.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.7C05B73B40D3A53E3B2E5F8A310F2BBE: It’s nearly the end of Spring already. I feel like I haven’t done much.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.130_Text: It’s still baking hot! Doesn't seem to cool down one bit.//<portrait=normal>Or is it just me?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.E91DE40C46B5BB45FF8B189D9B7D1215: It’s still baking hot! Doesn't seem to cool down one bit.//<portrait=normal>Or is it just me?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.133_Text: It’s the new season! I have new items in stock.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.5D8FF4E74A02D33DE5AE038EA584A635: It’s the new season! I have new items in stock.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.258_Text: It’s warm now. I don’t need my sweater.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.8A1B50374412BA2228C92883A9E05AAF: It’s warm now. I don’t need my sweater.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.220_Text: I’m all for lore, but some of the stuff I read is out of this world. I don’t mind it, though!//That type of thing keeps me on the edge of my seat.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.317E02DB4C9EC8972AB5C88C0CDDFDD9: I’m all for lore, but some of the stuff I read is out of this world. I don’t mind it, though!//That type of thing keeps me on the edge of my seat.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.141_Text: I’m always intrigued by the things <NPCName>Ben</> manages to find on his Fall escapades.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.689C3F204102EAB96642989D9BC92EDF: I’m always intrigued by the things <NPCName>Ben</> manages to find on his Fall escapades.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.26_Text: I’m both for and against taking breaks from work.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.D25B81BD41B626E40DAE588DACAF56BE: I’m both for and against taking breaks from work.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.75_Text: I’m feeling a little antsy. I think I’m just ready for Summer.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.FC8BB2F94A6A3ACA9632C6B1AA2A9ED0: I’m feeling a little antsy. I think I’m just ready for Summer.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.256_Text: I’m going to have a dip in the water soon. Cool off a bit.//<portrait=normal>You should join me!
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.47CC5AAF4506B13963B3CFBEFCA38408: I’m going to have a dip in the water soon. Cool off a bit.//<portrait=normal>You should join me!
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.308BE65E46FEC38B297BA1A54EA55740: I’m not one to care about farming or to poke around in other people’s personal lives.//But how are things with you and your farm, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.67_Text: I’m not one to care about farming or to poke around in other people’s personal lives.//But how are things with you and your farm, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.229_Text: I’m not one to care about farming or to poke around other people’s personal lives.//But how are things with you and your farm?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.23B3C43841201FBFC02C139DEF98CA21: I’m not one to care about farming or to poke around other people’s personal lives.//But how are things with you and your farm?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.185_Text: I’m probably just going to eat lunch in front of my computer and get things done.//No plans.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.AFF52C914EA8DDB0EB1B5EA754E0D19D: I’m probably just going to eat lunch in front of my computer and get things done.//No plans.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.105_Text: I’m so glad Fall is over and done with. Now I can put more energy into Socket.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.66E8D6714687B71C944E3EA4BB734AB4: I’m so glad Fall is over and done with. Now I can put more energy into Socket.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.97_Text: I’ve been knee-deep in reviews of this year’s Consumer Electronics Expo.//Definitely looking forward to the online end-of-year sale. There are things I’d like to get my hands on.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.AF461D954686454E97F89686287DB7D5: I’ve been knee-deep in reviews of this year’s Consumer Electronics Expo.//Definitely looking forward to the online end-of-year sale. There are things I’d like to get my hands on.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.212_Text: I’ve confided lots of personal things to you. Sometimes, I freak myself out at night when I think about it.//<portrait=concerned>Certainly, I didn’t want to bang on your door at one in the morning to ask you this. Umm…
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.793E9AEE46888246030393A522BAB2CC: I’ve confided lots of personal things to you. Sometimes, I freak myself out at night when I think about it.//<portrait=concerned>Certainly, I didn’t want to bang on your door at one in the morning to ask you this. Umm…
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.186_Text: Just some green salad. Nothing fancy.//With herbed tempeh and lemon dressing.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.1D91636B46F2576E42516EAFA12DCA4A: Just some green salad. Nothing fancy.//With herbed tempeh and lemon dressing.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.71_Text: Lamps and blenders? Is that all I am to this island?//Everyone just sees me as the bloke who sells lamps and blenders.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.865CADFE485DEEB521F8C0813D079897: Lamps and blenders? Is that all I am to this island?//Everyone just sees me as the bloke who sells lamps and blenders.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.138_Text: Look at how much snow has accumulated, and we’re not even a week into Winter.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.BDDA1AC34398E9B7729A9ABF920C6ECC: Look at how much snow has accumulated, and we’re not even a week into Winter.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.189_Text: Looking for my father? Hmm. I honestly don’t know where he might be.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.3EE0326141AD06388EE797880B30DC07: Looking for my father? Hmm. I honestly don’t know where he might be.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.259_Text: May I offer you my jacket?//<portrait=happy>Oh, all right, then. Just let me know if you need an extra layer.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.F307446D4DE0075898FA9F834E66064B: May I offer you my jacket?//<portrait=happy>Oh, all right, then. Just let me know if you need an extra layer.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.207_Text: Maybe we can make a regular lunch date. You know how I try out new recipes every so often?//That way, you can try my cooking, and I can get your input in return.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.95D22C6849EFB21BBB90C288C9606672: Maybe we can make a regular lunch date. You know how I try out new recipes every so often?//That way, you can try my cooking, and I can get your input in return.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.145_Text: Mother once told me that after I marry, she wants me to continue the family tradition, and she still expects me to spend New Year’s Eve with her, wherever I end up.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.72A320594087E3A08EFDEF88F530ED2D: Mother once told me that after I marry, she wants me to continue the family tradition, and she still expects me to spend New Year’s Eve with her, wherever I end up.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.228_Text: My friend <NpcName>Pablo</> and his brother usually take care of cemetery maintenance.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.B1CAD84341389674BBB8709A9551688C: My friend <NpcName>Pablo</> and his brother usually take care of cemetery maintenance.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.250_Text: My mother cooks very well. I’d offer to cook for you, but I’m afraid you might be offended by my cooking.

DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.A6D695EF4D1F1BF7BD514BBD2C85F717: My personal go-to gift is a meal from the Tavern.//If folks don’t like that, it’s nothing personal, right?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.097F5EA243C7E4AEA77A5E9C0017EC2F: My store is closed tomorrow. I usually do some bookkeeping at home instead.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.22_Text: My store is closed tomorrow. I usually do some bookkeeping at home instead.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.59_Text: My weekend plans? Hmm. Good question.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.6EA4414B43B35937AB6BFDB3830A52D0: My weekend plans? Hmm. Good question.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.237_Text: No need to thank me, it’s true!
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.8B0F45334D5F25CA0DFDCBB6F96193C3: No need to thank me, it’s true!
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.1224004D4206AEAB7AC76784BA64954F: No obligation, mind you, but I dare say you should.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.35_Text: No obligation, mind you, but I dare say you should.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.215_Text: No wonder you look incredible.//You do so much walking around the island, on top of that farming workout. Respect.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.70B34DD04E9D106F7442B0BC4678D241: No wonder you look incredible.//You do so much walking around the island, on top of that farming workout. Respect.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.17_Text: Not always, though. Might want to keep that in mind.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.E7635918471E563FD8CA769AE132B104: Not always, though. Might want to keep that in mind.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.219_Text: Not an outdoorsy person, I guess.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.E654D4BE4B3892659AADAAB6A3F742DA: Not an outdoorsy person, I guess.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.68FA54934AF0248ABA524BA682AB026D: Not my parents, though. To them, I’m the wine merchant.//<portrait=normal>I’m the one making sure their winery turns a profit. *sighs*
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.72_Text: Not my parents, though. To them, I’m the wine merchant.//<portrait=normal>I’m the one making sure their winery turns a profit. *sighs*
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.58_Text: Not that it looked smashing. I mean “hot” as in body temperature.//<portrait=annoyed>It had me sweating buckets.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.925C1B6D4852D432965C3680863D3CEC: Not that it looked smashing. I mean “hot” as in body temperature.//<portrait=annoyed>It had me sweating buckets.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.103_Text: Now that it’s Winter, there are massive electronics sales everywhere!//I might check out the electronics district in Pokyo. Let’s see how the week goes!
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.2D32B9B8427FC655FC52F7AFE1D2985B: Now that it’s Winter, there are massive electronics sales everywhere!//I might check out the electronics district in Pokyo. Let’s see how the week goes!
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.236_Text: Oh! You like my hair? Thank you. You caught me off guard with the compliment.//Then I’ll keep my hair like this forever. You look magnificent yourself.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.DFECA96D4A1046D34C07B7AA893073BC: Oh! You like my hair? Thank you. You caught me off guard with the compliment.//Then I’ll keep my hair like this forever. You look magnificent yourself.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.187_Text: Oh, blimey! I forgot to close my bedroom door.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.1A8A5264450025780C8F87A4C911A582: Oh, blimey! I forgot to close my bedroom door.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.31_Text: Oh, good Goddess! What happened to you? Did you get attacked?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.BED9857944EA4D72C8D2A294834320B2: Oh, good Goddess! What happened to you? Did you get attacked?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.1134303740D4C0F69B9411B71FD4EBF4: Oh, good! I just never really know with you, I guess.//You always seem to maintain a rather, shall we say, relaxed appearance.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.32_Text: Oh, good! I just never really know with you, I guess.//You always seem to maintain a rather, shall we say, relaxed appearance.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.206_Text: Oh, perfect timing! I was preparing my lunch this morning and thought of you.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.54B9C1134EE19D287510B8A82FC6BF8B: Oh, perfect timing! I was preparing my lunch this morning and thought of you.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.559F332F483185789022C19F967DD701: One of the coolest things I saw at the Consumer Electronics Expo has to be self-driving cars. When they were first introduced.//I thought it was groundbreaking. Hmm.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.78_Text: One of the coolest things I saw at the Consumer Electronics Expo has to be self-driving cars. When they were first introduced.//I thought it was groundbreaking. Hmm.

DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.2B5D719443A31B9520CADD8288A0118D: One time, I found an onyx lying around in my cash register drawer. I gave it to <NpcName>Rafael</>, and he was thrilled.

DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.462C7B2D4E46F51887A3018608D7C54B: Only if you want to. You certainly don’t have to.//But judging by the state of your boots, you already know that.

DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.6A6ED6E143AAD292E6E6E7AEE3720DB1: Our family donates to the town every year for the upkeep of the cemetery.//It’s not much, but it seems to be helping.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.11_Text: People are too busy to shop at the beginning of the week, I suppose. So, here I am.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.905B868546A4377DC6ED9798265EBF15: People are too busy to shop at the beginning of the week, I suppose. So, here I am.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.0DE8CA13474C07C2D152C8B4346C59F5: People ask a lot of questions without reading the user manual first.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.182_Text: People ask a lot of questions without reading the user manual first.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.118_Text: People tend to buy more outdoor grills this time of year. Maybe they’re getting ready for Summer cookouts.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.C7E8FAD74FE9660BCF386E9FEF8BA8BA: People tend to buy more outdoor grills this time of year. Maybe they’re getting ready for Summer cookouts.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.88_Text: People who think tomato soup is best in Fall are completely off their rocker.//<portrait=normal>Tomatoes are a Summer crop and therefore best enjoyed in Summer.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.CCD079A94118540B47040B8E20AB9E53: People who think tomato soup is best in Fall are completely off their rocker.//<portrait=normal>Tomatoes are a Summer crop and therefore best enjoyed in Summer.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.101_Text: Phew, things have finally slowed down at the winery.//Mother can take care of the greenhouse, and all that’s left is filling orders and doing paperwork. Simple.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.BDAB3C97456CF98CC8F75B92C32406F3: Phew, things have finally slowed down at the winery.//Mother can take care of the greenhouse, and all that’s left is filling orders and doing paperwork. Simple.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.245_Text: Please forgive my heart. It’s pounding very loudly, very rude. I can’t help it. You’re making me nervous.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.67EBAE474CF2086A9A1B568E09909663: Please forgive my heart. It’s pounding very loudly, very rude. I can’t help it. You’re making me nervous.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.109_Text: Pufferfish Corporation owns that building, you know.//We found out last Fall when we tried to lease the building for our tasting room.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.B60878C64C4E32ABC13330BB4BAE8DF3: Pufferfish Corporation owns that building, you know.//We found out last Fall when we tried to lease the building for our tasting room.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.14_Text: Shopping day? Tuesdays are when people usually shop and submit their orders.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.DFCBCE94489D95CFBA8447993222F5C9: Shopping day? Tuesdays are when people usually shop and submit their orders.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.107_Text: Shouldn’t you start farming or something?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.96DF104C4C6CAD180C6EE695F6A1C191: Shouldn’t you start farming or something?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.248_Text: So busy today. I have so many orders to process.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.8C0A21DD4ABB49F2AE1D119C4B1D3E34: So busy today. I have so many orders to process.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.139_Text: So, what are you going to do for the next three or four weeks, seeing as you can’t farm much?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.4EB6D6CA438AB3EDA1EAE3BF18E566AD: So, what are you going to do for the next three or four weeks, seeing as you can’t farm much?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.251_Text: Someday, I’ll have to take over this place, focus on the vineyard, and put my personal goals aside.//I’m not too happy about it.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.A3CF31E14345E68D660919A825C2824A: Someday, I’ll have to take over this place, focus on the vineyard, and put my personal goals aside.//I’m not too happy about it.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.3210C7D540FD24FF2F6AA88B48924C6E: Spring is like the start of the life cycle for electronics, much like many things in life and nature. It's when new gizmos are launched to the market.//<portrait=happy>Exciting time for farmers too, I suppose. With the going back to farming and all.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.80_Text: Spring is like the start of the life cycle for electronics, much like many things in life and nature. It's when new gizmos are launched to the market.//<portrait=happy>Exciting time for farmers too, I suppose. With the going back to farming and all.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.53FBE5D0455502016F9A2C83E1920DC3: TVs are expensive to stock, though. I’m not quite sure what to do. I've noticed people tend to buy more when I have tellies on display.//<portrait=sad>The trouble is I don’t have actual data to back up my theory.

DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.116_Text: That was a bold statement, wasn’t it? Well, I think it’s true.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.692124E64DE8B2F48D98A9A71F7F45C6: That was a bold statement, wasn’t it? Well, I think it’s true.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.122_Text: That was a song lyric, wasn’t it?//From the Shell Rockers? I love that band.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.5F0A08384AFFFFE7511AADA031031325: That was a song lyric, wasn’t it?//From the Shell Rockers? I love that band.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.119_Text: That wasn’t a wild guess.//I looked at the sales numbers. Well, in any case, it’s good for business.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.570F7BD64722F6F694AFDA9F5614F3B7: That wasn’t a wild guess.//I looked at the sales numbers. Well, in any case, it’s good for business.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.241_Special: That’s it? You don’t think I’m cute or something?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.2FFEECFD4052A244FC9922AAABCCBF76: That’s it? You don’t think I’m cute or something?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.212506D741ABEC3DBF6B2E9BCD771E86: The seasonal decorations, for instance.//I reckon we don't need to be splashing any more of the budget on that.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.5_Text: The seasonal decorations, for instance.//I reckon we don't need to be splashing any more of the budget on that.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.79_Text: The smart bathtub was amazing too. You set your preferred temperature, and it does everything for you.//It fills up, makes sure the temperature is spot on, and drains automatically when you're done.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.B08BA8C14E044D919DCFE4ACAA73B86C: The smart bathtub was amazing too. You set your preferred temperature, and it does everything for you.//It fills up, makes sure the temperature is spot on, and drains automatically when you're done.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.0382482E4D44E88EEFE604845CDE6567: The store also gives me a reason to take a good three- to four-hour walk two or three days a week.//My doctor likes that.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.235_Text: The store also gives me a reason to take a good three- to four-hour walk two or three days a week.//My doctor likes that.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.3C0E155C43E4D59E21C09C9BFCF917D3: The town is lively in Summer.//I quite like it.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.85_Text: The town is lively in Summer.//I quite like it.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.140_Text: The vineyard will rely on the greenhouse. Our production is declining. But it’s on purpose.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.4ED02197417D375A50432FAA134A1B6E: The vineyard will rely on the greenhouse. Our production is declining. But it’s on purpose.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.12_Text: The weather is nice today. I should do something, like go to the beach.//<portrait=sad>Feels like a waste otherwise.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.A22A29DC4331C855FF2C6891CC3EAEEB: The weather is nice today. I should do something, like go to the beach.//<portrait=sad>Feels like a waste otherwise.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.112_Text: There are plenty of flowers around. You can find tulips and violets around the lake if that’s your thing.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.9B8F9B4A472059AACB38F59F825F5F24: There are plenty of flowers around. You can find tulips and violets around the lake if that’s your thing.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.5AA337464BA9A56DB9FF14958C2E9738: There's no exciting news about electronics in the Summer. All that happened in Spring.//Let’s wait and see what the reviews say!
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.82_Text: There's no exciting news about electronics in the Summer. All that happened in Spring.//Let’s wait and see what the reviews say!
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.195_Text: There’s no better way to spend the day than being outside, especially in weather like this.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.EC8ABC464932EC14FC7DF88211C48F2D: There’s no better way to spend the day than being outside, especially in weather like this.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.196_Text: There’s so much more to running a vineyard than shipping wine.//I have to maintain relationships with our buyers, which means inviting them over for dinner every once in a while.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.93287CE744E8759D014E1591C6F5CF15: There’s so much more to running a vineyard than shipping wine.//I have to maintain relationships with our buyers, which means inviting them over for dinner every once in a while.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.39_Text: They just increased the price of ads. Again! Unbelievable.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.98AFEBE949BB345D2DD874946E9E622C: They just increased the price of ads. Again! Unbelievable.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.110_Text: They rejected our offer without any explanation. Now we know why.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.DED3AE614AE39186C81E9A997C3F71AF: They rejected our offer without any explanation. Now we know why.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.151_Text: This rain isn’t that bad. It’s not too windy, and it’s not pouring.//It’s sprinkling, but not raining so heavily that I have to wear my rubber boots.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.82D5A2914E32FC0DD9973C83D5301BC4: This rain isn’t that bad. It’s not too windy, and it’s not pouring.//It’s sprinkling, but not raining so heavily that I have to wear my rubber boots.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.43660FA748257E9EBF0209A0F9971300: This year’s Consumer Electronics Expo was amazing. Too bad I could only stream it.//I wasn’t able to get tickets.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.76_Text: This year’s Consumer Electronics Expo was amazing. Too bad I could only stream it.//I wasn’t able to get tickets.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.115_Text: Tomorrow is the Cherry Blossom Festival. It’s probably the highlight of the year on Coral Island.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.AEB0750F4F861CD32E05D3916AE6F590: Tomorrow is the Cherry Blossom Festival. It’s probably the highlight of the year on Coral Island.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.204_Text: Too much tension at the house sometimes.//It’s better to just walk it off or to disappear for the day altogether.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.68E061E44CD4644AC049E4A041676ED4: Too much tension at the house sometimes.//It’s better to just walk it off or to disappear for the day altogether.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.201_Text: Tradition is what links us to our past, and hopefully to our future as well.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.F756E25641FF7AA469BBC08E47C0F693: Tradition is what links us to our past, and hopefully to our future as well.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.46_Text: Ugh. I did it again. Sorry if I sounded condescending. I didn’t mean to.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.C7C79A554ED359A5A4D58488B67786CD: Ugh. I did it again. Sorry if I sounded condescending. I didn’t mean to.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.243_Text: Unless you wouldn’t like that, of course. The choice is yours, as always.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.9FAE5E164FA52DF2882F698E070CA8DD: Unless you wouldn’t like that, of course. The choice is yours, as always.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.110F364248DC34BC22F824A5F2947C8C: Watching an old film on <NpcName>Pablo’s</> setup is something else.//<portrait=happy>It’s the best place see a film in Starlet Town. Not even I have a setup like his.

DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.ED14554C433A5C1770F8C2A39CBF97C7: We have a duty to look after Mother Nature. If we don’t, then who will?

DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.4E32BB21462D3CFCC78DF89B326009CA: We offered to let <NpcName>Ben</> stay at the house, but he turned it down.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.149_Text: Well, I actually do, a little.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.4C5E5F174F9A59DFAC74558861A66CD2: Well, I actually do, a little.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.154_Text: Well, you know what, <PlayerName>$player</>? I actually <Italic>do</> mind the rain a little.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.1582AC514F981E32D5FF24B49A1BFD0F: Well, you know what, <PlayerName>$player</>? I actually <Italic>do</> mind the rain a little.

DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.A061B03348BF0873C2252A8EC997CBA6: Well, you know what, <PlayerName>$player</>? I actually do mind the rain a little.

DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.1B0B55E24371E98166BA23B759E76932: We’re cleaning up the beach next Saturday, <PlayerName>$player</>. Come prepared!

DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.244_Text: We’re standing so close to each other. Umm…

DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.89_Text: What did you do in Summer when you were a kid?

DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.07E82B1B400FACEEE42C6B956EE9E16A: Why are you so keen about star fruit?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.126_Text: Why are you so keen about star fruit?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.183_Text: Why would they think I have better information than the literal user manual?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.6C5F44134BCF04C364AFA4A19CB11870: Why would they think I have better information than the literal user manual?

DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.D07E023948DE9457587A16BE8BB28C4C: Winter is around the corner. This is unprofessional! I should give them a ring.

DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.874EB0924658F3C34C5D73BAFEFD7B93: You can see my commercial on TV every other day. But I usually only add new stock on weekends.

DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.8BBF888047BC8FB9162509926A1469E0: You have snow on your clothes.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.48_Text: You seem surprised. Why? Did I startle you?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.B970522D4999FD1036E2DF8B3DC4A707: You seem surprised. Why? Did I startle you?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.214_Text: You? A bother? Never. I actually enjoy picking your brain.//<portrait=normal>You say the most outrageous things. I love it!
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.80992D7D49BC5074DC194B9D4C7A71B3: You? A bother? Never. I actually enjoy picking your brain.//<portrait=normal>You say the most outrageous things. I love it!
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.44_Text: Your boots are dirty, by the way. Perhaps one of these days, you could go by the creek and clean them.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.CD26B72A42FBDB84B1BDBBAEBD2DECE6: Your boots are dirty, by the way. Perhaps one of these days, you could go by the creek and clean them.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.238_Text: You’re always so kind to me. I consider us close friends.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.DA5D34FB450E1095801C46AC41856774: You’re always so kind to me. I consider us close friends.
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.223_Text: You’re not going to make me beg, are you, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.C559104848D1312FAF1532A405D29DB2: You’re not going to make me beg, are you, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.217_Text: You’re really cool. Besides, you’re one of my biggest customers. *chuckles*
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.33D4DE074CE2CEA02B8183B92BEC0D58: You’re really cool. Besides, you’re one of my biggest customers. *chuckles*
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.123_Text: [<NPCName>Luke</> hums a sad song by the Shell Rockers.]
DT_Dialogue_Luke_Production.FFBE6C464ADC19D2EB394F978E0F326D: [<NPCName>Luke</> hums a sad song by the Shell Rockers.]

DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.191_Text: <NpcName>Anne</> and I used to spend hours in the forest behind our house, watching the wildlife.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.153_Text: <NpcName>Anne’s</> been bugging me about it all Winter.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.142_Text: <NpcName>Anne’s</> been busy lately, but she always makes sure we have a good meal. Can’t complain.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.144_Text: <NpcName>Paul’s</> a good guy.//Dude’s solid. I like him.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.193_Text: <NpcName>Zoe</> got me a husky calendar for my birthday a few years ago. Told her I liked it… And now she gets me the same one every year.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.183_Text: Accepting his dinner invites is a game of Russian roulette. You never know what you’re signing up for.//Exciting, though.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.92_Text: All the weapons are in the guild, not here.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.185_Text: Anyway, things that don’t require a lot of fuss.//Life’s complicated enough as it is.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.80_Text: Are you looking for an animal?
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.136_Text: Be careful out there. It’s icy.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.151_Text: Bonbon and <NpcName>Zoe</> are probably the same age.//<portrait=happy>The lil guy looks like a puppy, though, huh?//Acts like one too.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.170_Text: Boots are the way to go – sturdy and reliable.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.22_Text: Breathe that Winter air in, <PlayerName>$player</>.//It’ll toughen you up.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.21_Text: Breathe that Winter air in, Garden Rake.//It’ll toughen you up.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.194_Text: But you know what? I like it every single time.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.11_Text: Can you believe this heat? I’ve never sweat so much in my life.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.25_Text: Caught someone slipping in the rain the other day…wearing sandals. Tch.//And he wondered why he slipped.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.118_Text: Didn’t bring anything to eat today. I thought I could just pop by the shack if I get hungry.//It’s right there.//<portrait=annoyed>I did get some coffee this morning. Bad decision. Should’ve gotten the hot cocoa instead.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.177_Text: Don’t get me wrong, art’s great and all, if you’re into that kind of thing.//I should stick to what I know.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.106_Text: Don’t pass out. The shack sells coconuts.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.180_Text: Every night, I tell my niece good night, and she always hollers back, “Good night!”//<portrait=sad>But pretty soon, she’ll be all grown up and off to <Italic>uni</>. Can’t believe how fast time flies.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.31_Text: Favorite season? I don’t have one.//All seasons are the same.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.32_Text: Favorite season? I don’t have one.//All seasons are the same. We make too much fuss about them.//The temperature changes. No big deal.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.28_Text: Fishing isn’t my thing. I could if I had to, of course.//<portrait=annoyed>What type of person couldn’t fish or make their own food?
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.68_Text: Gah, it’s Winter. Means he’s busy upgrading farming tools.//<portrait=normal>I’ll wait till Spring.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.171_Text: Gardening in Spring can be pretty rewarding.//Teaching my niece that.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.158_Text: Goat cheese – the bane of my existence.//Can’t fathom how anyone can eat that stuff without gagging.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.76_Text: Good thing making a lot of money doesn’t interest me.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.78_Text: Gotta make sure the shelter is clean and safe for the animals.//They don’t have anywhere else to go.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.179_Text: Gotta take out the trash before it becomes its own ecosystem.//<portrait=annoyed>Here’s hoping I remember to do it before the smell knocks me out tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.42_Text: Ha! Easy on the compliments. We just met. You don’t really know me yet.//<portrait=annoyed>Easily impressed, are you?
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.53_Text: Ha!//<portrait=angry>Flirting, are you, Garden Rake?//<portrait=annoyed>Thanks. Scars are sexy. That’s why I have one.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.145_Text: He could tackle a bear if he wanted to. He can protect my niece fine.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.126_Text: Heard you had something to do with getting it going again. Is that right?
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.41_Text: Heh heh!//[His chuckles sound like an earthquake.]
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.105_Text: Here I thought I was gonna read my book in peace. Tch.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.119_Text: Here for those yoga classes, are ya?//Pink Hair teaches it. See it all the time.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.108_Text: Hey! Can’t resist the beach in this weather either, huh?//<portrait=happy>Look at us. The moment the sun shines, we hit the beach. Typical islanders. Tch.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.157_Text: Hot peppers? Why would anyone willingly set their mouth on fire? No, thank you.//Not a chance.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.102_Text: Hot spring is empty this time of year.//Perfect.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.176_Text: I always found comfort in the company of animals.//<portrait=happy>They don’t judge, they don’t ask questions. They just are.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.124_Text: I can feel my muscles relaxing.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.13_Text: I could use some homemade tomato soup.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.110_Text: I don’t buy books. I prefer to read the free ones.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.88_Text: I don’t fish much. Don’t need to.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.90_Text: I don’t fish much. Don’t need to.//You can fish in that rice field, by the way. It’s free.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.7_Text: I don’t go to the cavern.//I don’t have any reason to since I don’t mine or collect artifacts.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.23_Text: I don’t have any weapons at home, no. Why?
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.24_Text: I don’t have any weapons at home, no.//I have a niece living with me, <NPCName>Zoe</>. I don’t want any accidents or anything like that.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.27_Text: I don’t like fishing.//And I also don’t like being interrupted.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.148_Text: I don’t like kids.//I only like my niece.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.57_Text: I don’t like talking about my scar because first of all, it’s nobody’s business.//<portrait=angry>Second of all, it’s <Italic>still</> nobody’s business.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.58_Text: I don’t live here. This is where I work.//<portrait=angry>Those aren’t my crops. I look like a farmer to ya?
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.189_Text: I don’t mind it one bit. It’s part of the job.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.178_Text: I don’t think Bonbon can grow any bigger. He’s maxed out.//<portrait=happy>Bonbon’s a pint-sized pup.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.166_Text: I don’t wanna spend money on new scarves. It’s wasteful.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.54_Text: I got my scar from one of the cats at the shelter. Not from fighting off a bear or a wolf, not from combat. Nope!//<portrait=annoyed>I’m far too good to get injured in combat. Heh heh!//<portrait=normal>It’s the one you let your guard down for who hurts you.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.195_Text: I have a small CRT TV in my room, nothing fancy.//I like it. It does its job.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.99_Text: I like reading books at the beach.//<portrait=angry>I don’t care if people think it’s a cliché.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.71_Text: I like the hot cocoa from the Coffee Corner.//Don’t like coffee.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.114_Text: I might need to hit the hot spring on the way home. Just a dip or something.//<portrait=annoyed>This heat? Tch. Doesn’t bother me.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.81_Text: I need to clean all the litter boxes today.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.152_Text: I need to write back to my mom.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.184_Text: I prefer simple, hearty meals like tomato soup, smoked salmon, hot cocoa… Does that count?
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.164_Text: I saw some kids flying kites the other day. Pretty cute, actually.//<portrait=happy>Maybe kids aren’t so bad.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.64_Text: I spoke to <NpcName>Ben</> some time ago. Saw him walking the duck near the cavern. He told me his name was Funbucket.//<portrait=angry>And by “his” I mean the duck’s name, not <NpcName>Ben’s</>. <NpcName>Ben’s</> name is Ben.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.139_Text: If we ever get tired of our usual roles, maybe I could take care of the animals, and you could…take care of me?
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.138_Text: If you ever need a break from the farm, I wouldn’t mind showing you some of the more secluded spots in the forest…or at sea.//<portrait=normal>You seem like the swimming type.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.174_Text: If you ever need any help with farmwork, just ask.//Not that I’m volunteering, but you know. I’m around.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.85_Text: If you’re going to keep talking, let me go first…
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.198_Text: If you’re worried, just wear a helmet. It’ll protect your head.//<portrait=happy>You <Italic>would</> look ridiculous, though, yeah.//You should do it.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.169_Text: It could be 100 degrees out, but I’m never wearing sandals. I don’t care.//Gotta protect my feet.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.82_Text: It gets busy in here on the weekend.//There’s a yoga class on Saturdays.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.17_Text: It would be better if it were Winter all year round. Maybe I should move farther north.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.167_Text: It’s harvest time, <PlayerName>$Player</>. Better make the most of it.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.65_Text: It’s quiet tonight, just how I like it.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.66_Text: It’s quiet tonight. A little too quiet.//Stay frosty, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.30_Text: It’s safe here in Fall. It isn’t too hot.//In some places, this is wildfire season.//I’ve run away from several of those myself.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.4_Text: I’d set all the animals at the shelter free if I could.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.6_Text: I’d set all the animals at the shelter free if I could. But it wouldn’t be safe for them.//They don’t know how to live in the wild.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.147_Text: I’ll teach her everything I know.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.70_Text: I’m a little tired today. <NPCName>Paul</> thought he saw the wooded bighorn in the backyard last night, and…//<portrait=annoyed>Let’s just say it was a whole thing. No one got much sleep.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.101_Text: I’m certainly gonna spend my Summer at the beach. Why not?//<portrait=normal>It’s free. It’s fun.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.113_Text: I’m feeling a little sore from training the other day.//<portrait=sad>At least now I’m relaxing here on the beach, but it doesn’t seem to help my muscle recovery.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.117_Text: I’m gonna be here for a bit.//<portrait=annoyed>Why are you still here?
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.127_Text: I’m gonna see if there’s some mushrooms out there. After this. Aaaaah…
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.77_Text: I’m here to take care of the shelter.//<portrait=angry>What? Pick up a broom. Help out.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.130_Text: I’m liking this part of the forest way more than the woodland.//<portrait=angry>There are more bugs here, though. Annoying.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.73_Text: I’m sick of hearing people whine about how they can’t handle a little bit of cold weather.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.186_Text: I’m terrible at picking out gifts.//I never know what to get people.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.67_Text: I’m visiting <NPCName>Rafael</> later today.//My sword could use some sharpening.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.60_Text: I’ve never stepped foot into Socket Electronics in my life.//<portrait=annoyed>Socket & Pan – yeah, whatever. The electronics store.//I don’t have much use for gadgets.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.52_Text: Jeez! I wouldn’t have known if you hadn’t mentioned it. Thanks, Sherlock.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.175_Text: Keep an eye out for wild mushrooms.//They can be a lifesaver sometimes.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.14_Text: Kinda nice to see you out in this harsh weather.//<portrait=normal>Doesn’t seem like it bothers you, huh?//Nice, nice.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.162_Text: Layer up, Garden Rake. Winter’s not kind to the unprepared.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.5_Text: Lots of people here, like my sister, grow their own food.//There’s a small garden in front of the guild too… It’s <NpcName>Kira</>'s.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.83_Text: Me? No, thanks. I don’t think I’ll be joining the yoga class anytime soon.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.187_Text: Music’s not really my thing, but I can appreciate a good beat when I hear one.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.74_Text: My dog likes to hang around here.//He’s probably napping somewhere by the clinic right now if he isn’t playing with the kids at school.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.72_Text: My favorite thing to get from the Coffee Corner is hot cocoa.//Not a fan of coffee. It’s a tad bitter for my taste.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.146_Text: My niece will grow up to be a great hunter. She’s sharp.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.55_Text: My scar might look scary to people, but I’m not too worried about it.//My face is fine. Still functioning as intended.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.18_Text: Need to put out more water for the animals.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.133_Text: Nice day, huh?//I like the rain.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.134_Text: Nice day, huh?//I like the snow.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.45_Text: No, I can’t go with you to the cavern.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.47_Text: No, I can’t go with you to the cavern.//I have important things to do.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.100_Text: Not surprising to see you at the beach in Summer.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.172_Text: Our neighbor’s got some garden too.//<portrait=annoyed>Wildlife came along and trashed it pretty good. They blamed <NpcName>Paul</> for it. Tch.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.12_Text: People here seem to like Spring weather.//They’re so annoyingly vocal about it.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.3_Text: People sure like to garden here. Tch.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.9_Text: Pokyo has a real problem with strays. Their shelters are overcrowded.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.56_Text: Poor Chap, the cat that scratched me, didn’t mean it.// I was about to give him his vaccine, and he was scared. But he was very brave about it at the end of the day.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.61_Text: Saw that duck with the little helmet on my way here.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.63_Text: Saw that duck with the little helmet on my way here.//<portrait=happy>It was adorable.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.143_Text: She’s a good sister. I need to cut her some slack.//<portrait=angry>She gets too nosy about Mom sometimes. Tch.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.116_Text: Shiitake are great. Other mushrooms are okay.//Not that good.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.159_Text: Shiitake’s in season, right? Good stuff.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.8_Text: So, you came here from Pokyo, huh?
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.79_Text: Some of the animals at the shelter just wandered here from Hillside or the forest. Like Taco, the vineyard’s dog.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.182_Text: Sometimes <NpcName>Jack</> experiments with different recipes, but let’s just say not all of them are a success.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.190_Text: Sometimes I’ll help my sister and <NpcName>Paul</> with their wildlife shoots.//<portrait=normal>It’s pretty cool getting up close and personal with some of these animals.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.43_Text: Sorry if I call you Garden Rake. It’s a reference to the first time we– Tch. Never mind.//<portrait=angry>If you don’t like the nickname, that’s too bad, ’cause it’ll stick.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.36_Text: Stop looking at my face. It’s still the same. Nothing’s changed.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.197_Text: Storms can be pretty intense.//But they’re nothing to be worried about. Just be sensible.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.87_Text: Summer’s almost here.//Might need to change up my gear.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.188_Text: Taking care of animals can be messy work.//You gotta be prepared to get scratched and all.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.53_Special: That scar looks good on you.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.91_Text: That would require you to be <Italic>able</> to fish in the first place.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.163_Text: The animals in the shelter need extra care in this cold weather.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.168_Text: The animals in the shelter need extra water in this weather.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.16_Text: The birds are back.//It’s nice to walk outside with them around again.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.150_Text: The curly brown dog you see around town is mine. Well, <Italic>ours</>, I guess.//Bonbon is <NpcName>Zoe’s</>.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.29_Text: The hot spring is free. I wonder why more people don’t go there.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.107_Text: The ones on the trees aren’t ripe yet. Could be wrong…
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.37_Text: The scar on my face? It doesn’t hurt anymore.//<portrait=angry>Any other questions?
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.38_Text: The scar on my face? It doesn’t hurt anymore.//<portrait=normal>Do you think I’d be less miserable if I’d never gotten attacked?//I don’t think so.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.165_Text: The scarf? It’s <NpcName>Anne</>'s. Why? Does it look weird? It’s warm.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.104_Text: The sunscreen they sell around here comes in tiny little bottles.//It barely covers my legs. Tch.//<portrait=angry>What a scam!
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.111_Text: There’s so many people living on this island.//Wouldn’t know it at first – hardly see anybody around.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.120_Text: There’s so many people living on this island.//Wouldn’t know it at first – hardly see anybody around.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.97_Text: They come back again.//I think the solution might be down on the ocean bed.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.173_Text: They were pretty ticked off at <NpcName>Paul</> since we have those wildlife feeders near the house.//<portrait=normal>They asked him to close them at night to avoid attracting critters to the neighborhood.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.109_Text: This book is from the library.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.75_Text: This job at the animal shelter doesn’t pay much.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.20_Text: This? Hot?//<portrait=normal>Maybe it’s a bit hot, but nothing unbearable.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.19_Text: This? Hot?//<portrait=normal>No, it isn’t. Stop complaining.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.44_Text: Those monsters were sure agitated today.//Eavesdropping on me, Garden Rake?
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.96_Text: Those rotten roots on the beach are nasty.//I tried getting rid of them over there. Cutting them up doesn’t work.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.131_Text: Training day for me today.//<portrait=annoyed>You got nothing better to do?
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.46_Text: Watch out if you’re headed into the cavern today. <Italic>They</> seem agitated.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.93_Text: We keep weapons in the B.O.S. guild right there. That little round door by the bush.//It’s safer to keep them all in one place. Easier to maintain too.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.103_Text: Weird that shiitake only grow here in Spring.//They grow in Spring and Fall in Beluga.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.192_Text: We’d track animals, build forts, and just explore.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.10_Text: What are you doing here on a Thursday?
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.1_Text: What do you want?//I’ve got no business with you.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.40_Text: What? You don’t like the nickname?
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.112_Text: When I’m at the community center, I just assume most of them are tourists.//<portrait=normal>Except the one doing yoga, Pink Hair. I know she lives here.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.121_Text: When I’m at the community center, I just assume most of them are tourists.//<portrait=normal>Except the one doing yoga, Pink Hair. I know she lives here.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.199_Text: When a storm rolls in, I’ll admit I get a little excited.//There’s something exhilarating about being in the midst of nature’s fury.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.34_Text: Why are you talking to me here in a storm?//What’s so important, Garden Rake?
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.33_Text: Why are you talking to me here in the rain?//What’s so important, Garden Rake?
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.86_Text: Why do you look like that? I startled you, huh? Tch.//<portrait=normal>Jumpy farmer, aren’t ya?
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.89_Text: You can fish in that rice field, by the way. It’s free.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.155_Text: You ever try egg custard? It’s like a hug for your taste buds.//<portrait=annoyed>But hey, maybe that’s too fancy for a farmer.//<portrait=happy>Teasing. Don’t be mad <Italic>please</>.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.95_Text: You feed them all right over there? Let them get some sun sometimes?
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.52_Special: You have a giant scar across your face.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.94_Text: You have animals on your farm?
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.129_Text: You know, I have to say you’re not as completely useless as I thought.//<portrait=normal>Maybe there’s hope for you yet, Garden Rake.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.128_Text: You know, it’s amazing how you manage to keep all those plants alive when you can barely take care of yourself. Tch.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.50_Text: You look like you’re about to give me opinions.//What is it? Spit it out.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.137_Text: You look pretty good when you’re all covered in dirt from working on the farm.//It suits you.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.26_Text: You need a pair of nice sturdy boots for walking in the rain.//My boots have saved me from slipping many times.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.122_Text: You sure are everywhere, Garden Rake.//<portrait=normal>All right, what is it?
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.39_Text: You’re adventurous, aren’t you, Garden Rake?
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.115_Text: You’re in my way.//I need to see if the shiitake are sprouting yet.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.84_Text: You’re not looking for seeds here, are you?//<portrait=angry>I don’t sell seeds.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.156_Text: You’re the fanciest and the <Italic>only</> farmer I know.
DT_Dialogue_Mark_Production.69_Text: You’re walking around at this time of day like you got nothing to do.

DT_Dialogue_Merfolk_Test.4_Text: ...//Is there something you needed from me?
DT_Dialogue_Merfolk_Test.126_Text: <NPCName>Dinda</> and <NPCName>Joko</> are very talented. They made some of our cabinets.//I wonder how long it took them to get so good at carpentry.
DT_Dialogue_Merfolk_Test.164_Text: <NPCName>Karen</> used to have a room at the inn before she rented that space over there.
DT_Dialogue_Merfolk_Test.127_Text: <NPCName>Noah</> wanted to open a booth with the information we gathered on flying saucers.
DT_Dialogue_Merfolk_Test.73_Text: <NPCName>Rafael</>? Yeah, he might be at the inn today.//He does visit us on Sunday when he can.
DT_Dialogue_Merfolk_Test.13_Text: <NPCName>Suki</> and I divide our workload.//I get the weekday shift, and she covers the weekend.
DT_Dialogue_Merfolk_Test.18_Text: <NPCName>Suki</> and I divide our workload.//I get the weekday shift, and she covers the weekend.
DT_Dialogue_Merfolk_Test.153_Text: <NPCName>Suki</>’s too active for a desk job.
DT_Dialogue_Merfolk_Test.68_Text: Ah, she doesn’t mind anyway. Besides, it’s not like I use it every day… Maybe three times a year, tops!
DT_Dialogue_Merfolk_Test.62_Text: Ah, she doesn’t mind anyway. Besides, it’s not like I use it every day…//<portrait=surprised>Maybe three times a year, tops!
DT_Dialogue_Merfolk_Test.118_Text: Ah, the beach looks so clean. But I hope we don’t forget there’s still so much trash in the sea and the river.//We still need to change our lifestyle to stop this from happening.
DT_Dialogue_Merfolk_Test.82_Text: Ah… I kinda miss the snow already.
DT_Dialogue_Merfolk_Test.21_Text: Another good hobby is having meaningful discussions. Pick each other’s brains and share views…//You learn a lot of new things that way.
