DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.35_Text: After working at Fishensips for a while, I think selling drinks is where the money’s at.//<portrait=angry>If it were up to me, the Tavern would cut down on serving food and expand the drink menu.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.180_Text: Ah, I can’t look down the cliff.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.33_Text: Ah, forget about it. Sorry for venting.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.51_Text: Alice pointed out how it's kinda odd that some flowers bloom at night. Like, post-sunset. Don't they need sunshine?
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.116_Text: Another exciting thing about Summer is merfolk supposedly come out in the warmer weather…//<portrait=happy>Makes no sense whatsoever.//<portrait=normal>Also, impossible to prove.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.117_Text: Are you excited for your first Summer here, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.100_Text: Are you ready for the New Year’s Eve Festival? I know I am.//<portrait=happy>Yes, I know this is still the first week of Winter, but you can never prepare too early!
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.211_Text: Back in my university days, my dorm was right next to a temple, and whenever Mama came to visit me, we’d go there and pray.//<portrait=happy>Mama would make sure we burned enough incense for our ancestors.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.16_Text: Back in the day, my secret hideout was right behind the welcome sign.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.20_Text: Baking a cake is way more complicated than it looks.//For starters, it requires a lot of ingredients.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.36_Text: Besides, serving drinks is much easier than serving food.//Less mess, especially with big parties.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.76_Text: Best memory with Mama? Ah, that's a tough one. So many great beach times with her, can't pick just one.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.195_Text: But Beach Shack is already selling coconut drinks…hmm…not sure if that’s the right thing to do.//I should talk to my sister about it…get some advice. <NpcName>Aaliyah</> is good with numbers.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.231_Text: But I am who I am. I’ve realized I like familiarity, and the familiarity I like the most is right here.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.93_Text: But another story says they’re where the fairies sleep.//I like the fairy story better, honestly.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.193_Text: But the Beach Shack is already selling coconut drinks…hmm. Not sure if it’s the right thing to do.//I should talk to my sister about it, get some advice. <NpcName>Aaliyah</> is good with numbers.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.229_Text: But then I remember the Tavern is a legacy.//<portrait=normal>It was my parents’, and someday, <NpcName>Frank</> and I will pass it to the next generation.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.201_Text: Dad had a happy and long life. I don’t think it’s fair for me to ask for more.//After all, a long and happy life is all anyone wants, right?
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.210_Text: Dad’s side of the family doesn’t have that culture. We didn’t need to wear red with him…or Mama, actually.//She’s kind of modern that way.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.252_Special: Depends. If it’s with you, then yes.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.190_Text: Do I believe them? That’s another story… It would be on a case-by-case basis.//<portrait=normal>I don’t believe everything I read…//Most of them are just for fun.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.232_Text: Do I have cat hair on me?
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.203_Text: Do I look artistic to you? That’s a huge compliment. Thank you. But, no, I studied accounting, actually.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.255_Text: Do you hang out with anyone special on the weekends?
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.246_Text: Do you like people who can cook? Or no?//<portrait=sad>I can cook a little, by the way. I mean, I’m not too bad at it, if you’re into that sort of stuff. Um…
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.63_Text: Do you think that’s good enough?
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.37_Text: Do you want to sign up for the live performance?//We only have <NpcName>Theo</> so far. I think he’s all right. People like his energy.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.30_Text: Eh, just need an early start tomorrow, that's all.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.155_Text: Even if it’s just normal joint pain, why not get a professional opinion, right?
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.83_Text: Finally, it’s Summer!//Have you planted your Summer crops yet?
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.50_Text: Finding the right balance between working and taking time for yourself is important.//It helps you refocus on your goals.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.121_Text: Get to know them, and they might share their knowledge with you.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.32_Text: Getting through to <NPCName>Frank</> about hiring more help is tough. We rarely see things the same way.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.167_Text: Good morning, <PlayerName>$player</>.//<portrait=normal>You’re out early today. Running errands?
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.26_Text: Got the day off today. Tavern's closed. What's new with you?
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.41_Text: Got work today, but only for half a shift.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.102_Text: Gotta say I’m not a big fan of the cold, but then again, who is, right?//Wait… Are you?
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.208_Text: Growing up, Mama would always tell us red is a lucky color and to wear it on special occasions, like a wedding or New Year’s.//<portrait=happy>But we don’t always follow things like that to a T. <NpcName>Frank</> didn’t wear red at his wedding. No big deal!
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.202_Text: Guess what I studied back in university?
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.75_Text: Had a great time this week just strolling around town and catching up with her.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.179_Text: Have you been inside the lighthouse, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.213_Text: Have you done your farming for the day?
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.284_Text: Have you noticed how the stars seem brighter out here in Starlet Town?//Nothing like a clear night sky to remind you how grand the universe is.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.283_Text: Having eggs in the morning is like an instant pick-me-up. Gets the day going!
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.58_Text: Having three siblings taught me there’s no such thing as personal space.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.223_Text: Here’s what I’m thinking: if the Tavern stays open longer, and we hire more people, I think both <NpcName>Frank</> and I will get more days off.//<portrait=happy>We’ll also make more money, on top of that.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.234_Text: Hey! So nice to run into you, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.165_Text: Hmm… It feels incredibly humid today!//<portrait=annoyed>I hate the sticky feeling in the Summer.//<portrait=concerned>The heat is nice sometimes, but in this heat, just being outside can be tiring. Even if I’m doing nothing.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.78_Text: Honestly, at this point, I’m just counting down the days until Summer.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.204_Text: How did you know? Did you study accounting too?
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.275_Text: I always feel like a weight has been lifted off my shoulders when Winter ends and Spring begins.//It’s safe for Mama to walk outside again. No more ice.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.44_Text: I always say I’ll go to sleep early, but I end up watching TV until way too late.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.279_Text: I always try to add durian to the menu and always fail ’cause <NpcName>Frank</> removes it right away. Who made him the boss?//<portrait=normal>Think of all the desserts you can make from it! Oh, sounds so good!
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.163_Text: I bumped my head trying to clean the cabinet this morning.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.161_Text: I can’t bear the thought of moving out and leaving my mom alone.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.262_Text: I can’t believe they don’t have pineapples.//I specifically came here looking for them.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.9_Text: I can’t wait for the recycling center to be fixed up.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.101_Text: I can’t wait to eat all the good food at the New Year’s Eve Festival.//The Duckorns, <NPCName>Luke’s</> family, usually have it catered by fancy Pokyo restaurants.//They had garlic ice cream a few years ago… It was weird but delicious.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.21_Text: I don't have time to cook just for fun. Running a restaurant is no joke.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.71_Text: I don't think a 20% price hike would drive people away. But we’re too afraid to risk it, I guess.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.129_Text: I don’t have a sweet tooth, so I think it’s just the cold weather getting to me. You know, having a bigger appetite and all.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.249_Text: I don’t know how I would have coped if you hadn’t been there that time when my mom fell.//I was such a wreck.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.148_Text: I don’t know if it’s safe to walk around in this weather.//<portrait=sad>What am I thinking?
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.98_Text: I don’t know why anyone would eat mushrooms raw. Ew.//<portrait=happy>Now roasted, that’s the way to go.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.49_Text: I don’t mind doing the shopping.//That way, <NpcName>Frank</> can focus on cooking.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.207_Text: I don’t want to look unprofessional, but I also don’t want to be uncomfortable.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.238_Text: I enjoyed having a picnic with you that time.//<portrait=normal>If I promise to make you something else besides fried eggs…could we do that again sometime?
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.244_Text: I feel guilty for spending a lot of money on university and never actually using my degree to get one of those fancy jobs at a big firm.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.287_Text: I gotta hunt down my sweater, starting to feel a bit chilly out here.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.65_Text: I grew up eating <NpcName>Frank’s</> experimental food, probably why I'm picky about food now.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.273_Text: I hate having to run the heater all the time. It’s so expensive, and it dries out the air at the Tavern.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.13_Text: I have a feeling she’ll be gardening there twenty-four seven.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.103_Text: I have a video camera in my room that I usually leave on during Winter nights to record the sky.//One time, when I was about <NPCName>Archie’s</> age, I stayed up watching TV. It was pretty late, and I saw something flying in the sky – a sleigh.//I know, I know. But I know what I saw, so I’m trying to catch it on video.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.135_Text: I haven’t complained once about how cold it is this Winter.//Go, me!
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.61_Text: I hope it won’t rain tomorrow. I need to visit the vineyard to pick up some wine…//<portrait=normal>The Tavern is dangerously low.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.140_Text: I hope there isn’t a leak in the community center.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.272_Text: I hope we don’t start getting half-naked customers, being near the beach and all.//<portrait=annoyed>The only place where it’s socially acceptable to wear a bathing suit and flip-flops all day is the beach, never the Tavern.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.153_Text: I hope you don’t mind if I stop by your place sometime.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.158_Text: I hope you don’t mind if I stop by your place sometimes.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.160_Text: I hope you don’t mind if I stop by your place sometimes.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.154_Text: I keep telling Mama to see <NpcName>Yuri</> for her hip pain, but she keeps ignoring it.//<portrait=concerned>She told me it’s just old age.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.267_Text: I know I tend to complain a lot, but I really don’t mean it.//<portrait=concerned>I was just venting, you know?
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.196_Text: I know Winter has just started, but let me get this off my chest.//The moment Summer is here, I pledge to never leave the beach.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.162_Text: I know she says she’s fine, but I don’t want to see her all alone in this big building.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.221_Text: I like that you get along with my mom. It really shows what type of person you are…
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.14_Text: I like this town. It may not be Pokyo, but it’s home to me.//That’s hard to beat.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.23_Text: I like to knock out my errands before lunch. Helps me focus on work later.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.73_Text: I lost a lot of sleep because of that, which inevitably affected my mood.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.280_Text: I love the way durian smells. Some people say it smells bad, but I think it smells amazing.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.168_Text: I make a habit of checking the weather channel every morning before heading out.//You know, in case it might rain or something.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.99_Text: I managed to find tons of mushrooms the other day! Now I just need to roast them all.//Not a big fan of cleaning them, though. It’s a lot of work.//The dirt just doesn’t seem to come off.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.182_Text: I might grow my hair out after this.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.183_Text: I might stay here a little longer to cool off.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.88_Text: I need to tell Mama to wear her hat. She can’t be walking around in this Summer heat without one.//I’m worried she might get light-headed at the lake, and…//I don’t even wanna think about it.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.241_Text: I never really gave a lot of thought to having my own family.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.122_Text: I picked up some coconuts from the beach the other day. They can be a quick hydration solution…//<portrait=surprised>Bah!//<portrait=blushing>That was a mouthful to say.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.233_Text: I played with <NPCName>Peanut</> and <NPCName>Butter</> earlier, and there was a lot of hair on my shirt.//I think I got most of it off.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.212_Text: I remember smelling like ash for the rest of the day.//<portrait=normal>Here, we only pray at the house or at Dad’s grave.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.206_Text: I run a tavern and move around a lot. What am I supposed to wear, if not a polo shirt?
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.97_Text: I think Fall is the best season for eating roasted mushrooms. It’s the best season for making them too!//They’re sprouting in the wild. You can hunt for them in the forest.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.253_Text: I think I get what you’re saying.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.171_Text: I think I just caught one of my brother’s cats trying to sneak in here.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.252_Text: I think I would like that.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.240_Text: I think at this point in our lives, you and I both know there’s more out there than just us living in this universe.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.157_Text: I walked past your farm on my way to <NpcName>Ben</>’s the other day.//It looked so beautiful covered in snow.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.159_Text: I walked past your farm on my way to <NpcName>Ben</>’s the other day.//It looked so beautiful covered in snow.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.152_Text: I walked past your farm on my way to <NpcName>Ben’s</> the other day.//It looked so beautiful covered in snow.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.235_Text: I was a bit bored… But I feel better now, after talking to you.//<portrait=normal>Thanks for asking.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.216_Text: I was just thinking about checking up on you!
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.86_Text: I was thinking maybe we could open a booth at one of the festivals, like the annual beach cleanup. Perfect, right?//We could sell cold drinks, homemade sweets… I don’t know. People swim, they get hungry. Simple logic to me.//But <NPCName>Frank</> won’t even give it a chance. Not enough staff.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.245_Text: I wonder if I should start learning how to cook fancy things, like lodeh or pumpkin pie.//Well, anything besides fried eggs, really.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.261_Text: I would offer to warm you up, but…I’m afraid you might say no.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.74_Text: I'm looking forward to taking mom to the beach next week.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.125_Text: If I don’t keep an eye on my mom, who will?
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.79_Text: If Mama can cook seasonal food, why can’t <NPCName>Frank</>? And why can’t we serve it at the Tavern?//<portrait=normal>Now’s the perfect time for a seasonal menu.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.104_Text: If it were warmer, I think I’d spend more time outside, but as it is?//<portrait=normal>I think I’ll just do the paperwork for the Tavern.//Somebody’s gotta do the accounting, and it isn’t gonna be my big bro.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.106_Text: If you have time, try some of our food and drinks. They’re the islanders’ favorites.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.143_Text: Is it actually darker than usual outside, or am I losing my mind?
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.145_Text: Is it actually darker than usual outside, or am I losing my mind?
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.6_Special: It can’t. You must have misheard.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.57_Text: It's not like I mean to forget... Keeping up with birthdays can be pretty overwhelming.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.215_Text: It’s almost the weekend.//<portrait=happy>But you already knew that.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.181_Text: It’s giving me a headache…//My head is pounding.//Nope!
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.220_Text: It’s hard for me to get a day off… Since, as you know, it’s just <NpcName>Frank</> and me at the Tavern.//<portrait=happy>But when I do, I’ll come by the farm and check up on you, okay?
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.198_Text: It’s kind of bittersweet to see the cats now that Dad has passed away.//<portrait=sad>It brings back a lot of memories.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.115_Text: It’s only the beginning of Spring, but I already can’t wait to spend my Summer soaking up some sun at the beach.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.219_Text: It’s really fun hanging out with you. Feel free to stop me if I monopolize the conversation too much, okay?
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.184_Text: It’s so hot outside.//I’m glad <NpcName>Sam</> has his air conditioner on full blast.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.258_Text: It’s tough to concentrate with you around… You’re so distracting!
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.130_Text: It’s truffle season. I’m keeping an eye out in case I spot one in the wild.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.197_Text: I’ll camp there and enjoy every minute of the salty Summer breeze.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.172_Text: I’ll check on the cats later before I go to work.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.169_Text: I’ll just have a small breakfast here before my doctor’s appointment at noon.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.3_Text: I’m convinced something’s living in the recycling area next to the community center.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.10_Text: I’m convinced that something’s living in the dumpster next to the community center.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.82_Text: I’m gathering all the ingredients for the hot pot.//<portrait=happy>Well, other than the ones the townsfolk are bringing, of course.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.250_Text: I’m glad to have someone like you in my life.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.141_Text: I’m going to check on the library when the rain settles down.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.276_Text: I’m looking forward to going on long walks with my mom and enjoying the beautiful Fall scenery.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.11_Text: I’m not going to waste my time trying to convince you. I know what I saw.//<portrait=normal>Sometimes ago when I was walking home, I saw <Italic>something</> running really fast towards the dumpster.//And, get this! I asked around the next day, and <NpcName>Pablo</> said he heard the buzzing noise too.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.4_Text: I’m not going to waste time trying to convince you. I know what I saw.//<portrait=normal>Some time ago, as I was walking home, I saw <Italic>something</> running really fast toward the bins.//And get this! I asked around the next day, and <NpcName>Pablo</> said he heard the buzzing noise too.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.62_Text: I’m not like my kitchen-warrior brother, <NpcName>Frank</>. I’m afraid I can only cook sunny-side up.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.199_Text: I’m not sure how old the cats are, <NPCName>Peanut</> and <NPCName>Butter</>… But they’ve been around since Dad was here.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.277_Text: I’m really enjoying the slower pace of life in Fall. It’s a nice change from the busy Summer.//<portrait=happy>The beach is peaceful again. Ha ha!
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.270_Text: I’m really looking forward to all the fun things I have planned for this Spring.//Everything’s gonna start to bloom soon!
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.274_Text: I’m so glad Spring is here! The weather is finally starting to warm up.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.118_Text: I’m taking a bit of a break today, just trying to spend time outdoors.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.200_Text: I’ve always been close to my mom. I wish I could have had a bit more time with Dad, but it’s no use mourning now.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.128_Text: I’ve been baking a lot more lately, but nothing’s turned out good… Bummer!
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.225_Text: I’ve been watching too much TV lately. I need to get out more.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.285_Text: Just the smell of freshly baked bread from the oven is enough to make my day! There's nothing quite like it.//<NPCName>Eva</> is quite a baker.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.5_Text: Let me ask you, <PlayerName>$player</>. How can there be a buzzing noise in a place with no machines?
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.132_Text: Mama and I used to spend my birthday hunting for truffles and Winter vegetables in the forest. Then at night, she’d cook them up as a side dish for ramen.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.282_Text: Mama has this thing where we must remove all mirrors during the funeral of a family member.//Bad luck, she said.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.209_Text: Mama's family is pretty strict about wearing red on New Year’s.//Whenever we celebrated with them, Ama, that's my grandma from Mama's side... She used to always dress us up in red. No exceptions!
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.242_Text: Maybe when the right person comes along, I can start thinking about it.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.278_Text: My brother <NpcName>Frank</> hates durian, but I think he’s out of his mind.//It’s the best fruit ever.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.66_Text: My dad used to say, “To test a marriage, you should either open a restaurant or have a bunch of kids.”
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.22_Text: My mom has a reputation as the best baker around.//If you want to learn a few baking tricks, you should get to know her.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.67_Text: My parents did both, and they survived! I know he was joking, but I think it’s accurate.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.126_Text: My siblings all left the nest already. I’m all she’s got left.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.17_Text: Nah, not hiding from people, silly!//<portrait=normal>It was my go-to spot during hide-and-seek games.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.286_Text: Need to dig out my swimming trunks, seems like the weather's heating up.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.174_Text: No matter how often you sweep the Tavern’s balcony, it’s impossible to keep it clean this time of year.//The leaves are falling constantly.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.239_Text: No promises, though…about the eggs.//<portrait=happy>The picnic, yes, I promise!
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.205_Text: No, I studied accounting. I wish I knew more about literature, though.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.259_Text: No, no, don’t go. I meant it in a good way. I would rather be here than doing something else.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.18_Text: No, not much has changed… Starlet has looked like this since I was little.//Every corner holds so many memories.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.253_Special: No. I like me and just me.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.48_Text: Nope, I'm not the baby of the family either. Our youngest bro works at a start-up way across the ocean.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.136_Text: Nothing beats the feeling of the warm Spring sun after a cold Winter.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.248_Text: Oh my! Good. That looks good on you. The shirt.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.2_Text: Oh no, I didn’t mean it in a bad way.//I heard from the twins who run the inn that a new farmer moved in.//I just thought…you know…//Never mind.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.185_Text: Oh, bees! Why is it so cold in here?!//<portrait=surprised>With the snow and all, you would think <NpcName>Sam</> would turn down the coolers a bit.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.1_Text: Oh, hey! I have to say, you’re not what I expected.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.147_Text: Oh, um…be safe out there, <PlayerName>$player</>.//The storm is really bad today.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.113_Text: Oh… Maybe we can have a potluck in Fall and Winter too…//<portrait=normal>When people bring their favorite dish for the community to enjoy, the gathering is more meaningful. It has that big-family feel.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.271_Text: One of the good things about Summer is the fact that you can wear colorful shirts.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.56_Text: One of these days, I’m gonna miss somebody’s birthday…//<portrait=sad>I just know it.//<portrait=concerned>And that somebody will get upset because they remembered mine…//These social norms are just so hard to keep track of.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.72_Text: One thing I don’t miss about Pokyo, though, is the constant blaring of car horns.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.85_Text: Our air conditioner broke the other day. Thankfully, <NPCName>Pablo</> fixed it.//Some of the wiring was moldy, apparently. Good thing it wasn’t anything worse, like rats.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.96_Text: Our family wasn’t as busy for the Harvest Festival… Yeah, we helped out.//But we pretty much hosted the Cherry Blossom Festival.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.64_Text: Please, don't order the 'mixed punch' - it's basically <NPCName>Frank</>'s failed experiment.//Save your stomach the trouble.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.105_Text: Restocking supplies and doing paperwork is much better than being outside in the cold.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.222_Text: She’s been asking about us lately…errr, you, I guess. Asking about you in relation to me, to be specific.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.187_Text: Some people say there are humanoid creatures living deep in the forest... Legend has it they're trapped by an evil spirit and can't get back home.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.24_Text: Something about being at the Tavern makes some people share too much, too soon.//<portrait=sad>Hmm…
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.142_Text: Something warm sounds good right now.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.89_Text: Sometimes <NPCName>Alice</> invites me to go to the forest to look for cryptids, but I’d rather search in the ocean or around the beach.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.228_Text: Sometimes I think I should just give up trying to run the Tavern and let <NpcName>Frank</> take over.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.230_Text: Sometimes I wonder what my life would have been like if I’d stayed in Pokyo after university.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.46_Text: Sometimes you don’t really know what you’re getting yourself into.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.138_Text: Spring rains are my favorite. They might make the farm a bit muddy, but seeing everything refreshed and sparkling afterwards, it's worth it.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.53_Text: Strongest memory?//<portrait=happy>Tough to pick, but the pranks stand out. You learn a new one every day when you've got a lot of siblings, trust me!
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.94_Text: Such a bummer that Summer is over. But I guess it means I can focus more on the Tavern.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.127_Text: Taking a break from the farm, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.268_Text: Thank you for being such a great listener.//<portrait=happy>And an even better friend.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.70_Text: The Tavern could charge a premium for drinks and meals, don’t you think? We use only the best ingredients.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.144_Text: The Tavern gets extra muddy when it rains.//<portrait=annoyed>People just don’t bother wiping their feet.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.95_Text: The beach is still pretty fun in Fall, but not as much as it is in Summer.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.7_Text: The blacksmith’s place is very close to the recycling center. Hmm… It could be.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.218_Text: The cavern… Let’s talk about that. I think there’s more life in there than people think.//<portrait=surprised>Well, you’ve been inside, right? What do you think?
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.243_Text: The first thing I did after graduating was move back here.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.191_Text: The house is filled with <NpcName>Aaliyah’s</> trophies. Don’t bother looking for mine. Never contributed to the collection.//She’s been collecting rewards like Dokepon cards since we were little!
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.40_Text: The more I read about UFOs, legends, and myths, the more I think we’re not alone in this world.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.189_Text: The most interesting legends? Hmm… It’s hard to pick.//The crying rock is an interesting one.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.134_Text: The old one was fine. But <NPCName>Frank</> thought it was important to get a new heater in case the old one broke in the middle of Winter.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.151_Text: The potatoes were to keep our hands warm.//Then we would eat them when we got to school.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.146_Text: The tavern gets extra muddy when it rains.//<portrait=annoyed>People just don’t bother wiping their feet.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.91_Text: The tide can get pretty high in Summer, but so far, it hasn’t ever reached the Tavern.//Thank goodness, right? That sounds expensive to fix.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.81_Text: The trees back in Pokyo never looked this good in Spring. So glad I moved back after graduation.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.224_Text: The tricky part is finding more people to train…and convincing <NpcName>Frank</> to spend more.//<portrait=annoyed>Good luck to me, I guess.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.39_Text: The universe is so big, don’t you think? It's kinda arrogant to think it's all here just for us.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.137_Text: The weather is putting people in a good mood.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.123_Text: The wind is getting colder. I think Fall is finally here.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.217_Text: There are plenty of flowers around the lake.//<portrait=blushing>I had no idea you liked flowers. I would've picked some for you.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.77_Text: There are so many interesting Spring crops. I don’t understand why <NPCName>Frank</> won’t introduce a seasonal menu to take advantage of them.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.257_Text: There’s nothing going on between <NpcName>Alice</> and me.//We’re just friends. I love her like my own sister.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.237_Text: There’s something about cats, isn’t there? It makes me feel special when my brother’s cats come to visit me.//<portrait=blushing>They really know how to steal my heart, those furballs.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.107_Text: They also make great gifts.//It’s an easy way to win people over, you know?
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.109_Text: They mostly kept to themselves, and they each had a little yellow brooch on their jacket. I guess they were Pufferfish employees, surveying the area.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.263_Text: They ran out of tea leaves.//<portrait=concerned>I guess we won’t be serving green tea at the Tavern tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.112_Text: They should at least consider having another potluck this Summer.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.19_Text: To me, durian tastes exactly like it smells.//<portrait=happy>Prickles aside, it’s simply the best part of Spring.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.114_Text: Tomorrow is the first day of Summer.//<portrait=normal>Get ready, <PlayerName>$player</>. It’s going to get really hot.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.226_Text: Usually, when I get headaches like this, it’s because I need a new prescription for my glasses.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.31_Text: We could use more help running the Tavern, but <NpcName>Frank</> is against it.//<portrait=concerned>He thinks it would be throwing money down the drain.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.34_Text: We do our own grocery shopping and cooking.//<portrait=annoyed>It’s very time consuming, if you ask me.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.28_Text: We get most of our stuff from <NPCName>Sam</>. It's a nice way to back local businesses.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.178_Text: We live in the middle of town. Ugh…//<portrait=normal>I wish the Tavern was closer to the beach.//I’m pretty sure it would bring us more business, too.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.266_Text: We should have picnics here more often.//<portrait=blushing>Just you and me.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.133_Text: We spent way too much money on a new heater for the Tavern.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.281_Text: We used to have more mirrors here, but since we took them out for Dad’s funeral, we’ve been kind of too lazy to put them back.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.68_Text: Well, what else am I going to do on my day off?
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.111_Text: We’ll be at the Cherry Blossom Festival on Wednesday. <NPCName>Frank</> will be grilling all day, so we should probably arrive a bit early to get things ready.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.269_Text: What do you think?//<portrait=normal>Would I look all right with longer hair, or no?
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.60_Text: When I was growing up, Mama and Dad assigned each of us a roommate.//<portrait=happy>I got <NPCName>Frank</>, and our sis was stuck with baby bro <NPCName>Eddy</>.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.150_Text: When I was in elementary school, our sister would boil potatoes in the morning to put in our coat pockets.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.176_Text: When it’s not raining, I try to come here to watch the sunset.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.12_Text: When the mayor finally gives approval to put in a community garden, my mom will be ecstatic.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.15_Text: Where else can we get a white-sand beach and a lake, huh?
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.6_Text: Who’s talking about me? <Italic>I’m</> not talking about me.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.194_Text: With all the coconuts around the island free to harvest, I wonder if we should start selling coconut drinks at Fishensips.//It’s a great way to hydrate and the base cost is dirt cheap.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.192_Text: With all the coconuts around the island free to harvest, I wonder if we should start selling coconut drinks at Fishensips.//It’s a great way to hydrate, and the base cost is dirt cheap.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.84_Text: With the temperature rising, I think I’ll take Mama to Hillside for morning walks… Too much beach isn’t good for her.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.55_Text: With three siblings, every day felt like a birthday bash at our place.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.251_Text: Would you like to have a big family, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.188_Text: Yeah, I don't know! I like reading about legends and stuff, but can't find many books on it.//<portrait=normal>One mentioned them as Giants... Tiny Giants, actually.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.170_Text: Yeah, I’m okay, thanks for asking. //<portrait=normal>Just going for a checkup.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.254_Text: Yeah, questions like that always catch me off guard. I have no idea why I asked you that.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.120_Text: You can learn a thing or two from your neighbors.//You might pick up a simple recipe to try out or even learn how to craft items for your farm.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.177_Text: You can watch the sunset every day from your farm, yeah?//<portrait=happy>So lucky!
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.92_Text: You know, there’s a folk legend that says the daisy patches in Summer are places where they’ve buried a pure and innocent child who died.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.139_Text: You must not have a lot of watering to do today, eh?
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.149_Text: Your cheeks are getting red. You need to warm up, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.260_Text: Your cheeks are getting red. You need to warm up…
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.175_Text: Your farm is just over the creek, right?
DT_Dialogue_Noah_Production.265_Text: Your farm is just over the creek, right?

DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.257_Text: <NPCName>Jim</> taught me how to smoke fish a long time ago.//I think you need wood or a stone or something like that.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.30_Text: <NPCName>Mr. Barnes</> said I’ll need to train in Pokyo to become a policeman because they don’t have the academy here.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.104_Text: <NPCName>Mr. Barnes</> told me if I missed a reading assignment again, I might have to stay after school for detention.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.98_Text: <NPCName>Mr. Barnes</> told me if I missed a reading assignment again, I might have to stay after school for detention.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.240_Text: <NPCName>Ms. Suki</> said she likes to run for fun. Hmm…
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.167_Text: <NPCName>Valentina</> says even after we finish school here, we have to go to school somewhere else and get a degree. What’s that?
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.207_Text: <PlayerName>$player</>, I d-don’t really w-wanna t-talk right now. C-can we do it l-later?
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.236_Text: As long as I’m careful and go home before dark, I can explore the island and find bugs.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.86_Text: Aww… Winter’s ending soon. I’m gonna miss the snow.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.17_Text: Being a farmer is cool too. I hope you get to be on TV sometime.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.6_Text: Being a farmer is cool too. I hope you get to be on TV sometime.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.63_Text: But even if I had land, I probably wouldn’t plant anything. I don’t like gardening.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.31_Text: But for now, my job is to study hard and eat a lot of greens.//<portrait=normal>So I can grow big and strong someday.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.21_Text: But sometimes, he plays volleyball with us. <NPCName>Rafael</>, his name is.//He’s not very good at it, but he’s a lot of fun!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.190_Text: Can you cook anything tasty with those veggies?
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.225_Text: Dad always makes a big deal out of me getting lots of fresh air. He says it’s good for kids like me.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.259_Text: Dad always tells me stories about my childhood here. And how we used to play at the beach.//<portrait=sad>But I can’t remember most of it, so… I don’t know.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.16_Text: Dad and <NPCName>Jim</> used to chase monster fish!//<portrait=normal>And listen, listen… Dad was on TV a couple of times, being interviewed.//<portrait=happy>How cool is that?!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.5_Text: Dad and <NPCName>Jim</> used to chase monster fish!//<portrait=normal>And listen, listen… Dad was on TV a couple of times, being interviewed.//<portrait=happy>How cool is that?!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.165_Text: Dad caught some really big fish a long time ago. He said he started fishing when he was my age.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.155_Text: Dad got me this really cool kite for my birthday. It looks like a big fish.//I like to fly it in the park when it’s windy.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.222_Text: Dad has lots of books about fishing in here. I don’t really understand most of them.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.127_Text: Dad keeps talking about something called the starboard of a boat.//Is that like the stars in the sky?
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.124_Text: Dad knows everything. He’s really smart.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.253_Text: Dad made green curry for dinner last night.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.46_Text: Dad said I’m a Pokyoite too.//<portrait=normal>He and Mom adopted me there and brought me here when I was a baby.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.55_Text: Dad said I’m a Pokyoite too.//<portrait=normal>He and Mom adopted me there and brought me here when I was a baby.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.183_Text: Dad says Fall is salmon season. I hope <NPCName>Jim</> makes some more smoked salmon!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.59_Text: Dad says I need to take school seriously but also never miss playtime.//He says having hobbies is just as important.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.182_Text: Dad says I should play with some kids from my class, but I don’t wanna.//<portrait=happy>I like to play alone sometimes.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.177_Text: Dad says all the big fish come out in Summer. I wonder where they hide during Winter.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.153_Text: Dad says he doesn’t need to pay for advertising with me around. But I don’t know what that means.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.131_Text: Dad says his favorite day is Friday. He says mine might be Friday when I grow up, too.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.144_Text: Dad says it’s not nice to wish for people to be murdered.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.262_Text: Dad says the Beach Shack is his favorite place in the whole world.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.146_Text: Dad says we can go to the beach tomorrow since it’s a weekend. Yay!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.233_Text: Dad took me to the Tavern one time to get dinner.//<portrait=normal>Maybe I’ll understand when I grow up. Who knows? I might like it then!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.187_Text: Did you give your animals a hug today? You should make sure they’re happy.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.110_Text: Dinner was so yummy! I’m stuffed. But maybe I can have another plate.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.179_Text: Do they live in the ocean and come out just to buy ice cream?
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.125_Text: Do you ever eat fish for dinner, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.134_Text: Do you have any animals on your farm, <PlayerName>$player</>? Can I come pet them sometime?
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.65_Text: Do you have one of those bee houses at your farm?
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.145_Text: Do you know anything about Pokyo?
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.193_Text: Eating ice cream makes me feel even colder in Winter.//Brrrrr!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.24_Text: Errr… I can’t remember right now. I can tell you what we learned today, though.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.270_Text: Everyone likes the detective at the end…except for the bad guys.//Who cares about them?
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.112_Text: Eww. I just sat on something slimy! What is that?
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.147_Text: Got any ice cream, <PlayerName>$player</>? I’m starving!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.200_Text: Guess I can’t play outside today.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.139_Text: Have you ever had <NPCName>Jim’s</> smoked salmon? It’s really good!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.136_Text: Have you ever solved a mystery? I bet it’s really fun.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.266_Text: Have you read that cool new book? It’s called <Italic>Journal of a Weenie Kid</>.//Everyone at school is reading it.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.175_Text: Have you seen anything strange on the island, <PlayerName>$player</>? Any mysteries to solve?
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.61_Text: He came to the school and introduced himself.//<portrait=doubt>He told us his name meant “the sun” in Indonesian.//<portrait=normal>Is he your friend?
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.254_Text: He made a lot, so I think we’ll have it again tonight.//That’s kinda sad, because it didn’t taste very good.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.108_Text: Hmm… Where’s the remote? Is it behind you?
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.184_Text: Hmm…was it Fall or Summer?//I can’t remember.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.252_Text: How cool is that? Having a sword as a nose! Whoa!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.202_Text: I always sleep better when it’s raining out.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.231_Text: I am?! Thank you!//You’re very kind, <PlayerName>$player</>.//That makes you very cool!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.234_Text: I can smell the air changing when it rains! It smells like… Errr… It smells like fish to me.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.235_Text: I can smell the air changing when it rains! It smells like… Errr… It smells like fish to me.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.268_Text: I can’t imagine what Dad looked like when he was a kid. I bet it was weird.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.50_Text: I can’t wait for the weekend so I can play mini golf. It’s a fun game to play alone.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.76_Text: I can’t wait to build a snowman with my friends!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.137_Text: I can’t wait to solve mysteries when I grow up.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.149_Text: I didn’t do so well on my homework last week. I don’t really get math.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.132_Text: I didn’t do so well on my homework last week.//I don’t really get math.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.196_Text: I don’t like standing in the rain. It’s too wet.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.82_Text: I don’t think bees are flying around during Winter.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.206_Text: I don’t wanna go out when there’s thunder! It’s too scary!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.168_Text: I don’t wanna go to school forever.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.156_Text: I don’t wanna go to school tomorrow. I’m tired of taking tests.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.181_Text: I don’t wanna go to school when it’s this hot. It’s too icky.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.265_Text: I get sad when I think about my parents. My mom and dad are kind of old.//The other day, I overheard <NpcName>Erika</> talking about <NpcName>Betty</> falling, and she had to go to the hospital.//I don’t want Dad to fall.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.244_Text: I go to the museum with my friends sometimes.//We meet my mom there and learn things.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.148_Text: I gotta get my homework done fast tonight. Boy Detective is coming on TV again!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.122_Text: I gotta get my homework done fast tonight. Boy Detective is on TV!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.192_Text: I guess that’s because no one goes to the beach when it’s cold outside.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.67_Text: I guess you’re a different kind of farmer, huh?
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.69_Text: I guess you’re a different kind of farmer, huh?
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.117_Text: I had a lot of fun.//Science helps you solve cases, you know! It’s supercool.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.141_Text: I have a big test tomorrow. Excuse me, <PlayerName>$player</>, but I have to get back to studying.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.107_Text: I have a pet, but lizards are very shy, you know. It won’t come out when anyone is around.//It only comes out when the house is really quiet.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.103_Text: I have to finish this chapter today.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.97_Text: I have to finish this chapter today.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.81_Text: I hope Dad cooks seafood ramen tonight.//<portrait=happy>Yummy!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.120_Text: I hope Dad’s making smoked salmon tonight.//I’m starving!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.228_Text: I hope it doesn’t mind me staring.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.205_Text: I hope it doesn’t rain again tomorrow. I wanna go to the beach.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.260_Text: I just feel bad for him. He seems kinda sad when he tells the stories.//I wish he could still do stuff like that now. But I know he’s kinda old, so…better not.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.261_Text: I know I’m adopted, but I always feel like I look a bit like my mom.//<portrait=happy>Well, I look a lot more like Mom than Dad. What do you think?
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.237_Text: I know, I know. Bugs live in the wild.//<portrait=normal>We don’t take them home. My mom already taught me all that.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.66_Text: I learned at school that farmers are usually working on their farms. But I see you around a lot!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.68_Text: I learned at school that farmers are usually working on their farms. But I see you around a lot!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.95_Text: I like the rain. I’d just like it better if I got to play in it a bit longer.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.251_Text: I like to learn about fish. Especially the really fast or really big ones! Oh, oh!//The black marlin has a really long snout, and it’s shaped like a sword!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.9_Text: I really like all my friends here. They’re never mean to me.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.232_Text: I see a lot of grown-ups going to the Tavern. I don’t know why they like it so much there.//<portrait=doubt>It’s so loud!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.169_Text: I stepped on a can at the beach the other day, and it made my foot bleed.//It really hurt, but Dad put a bandage on it, and it felt better.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.204_Text: I think Dad fell asleep on the sofa again. He always does that when the TV’s on.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.215_Text: I think I’ll read inside while it snows.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.70_Text: I think it’s a good day to have ice cream!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.40_Text: I try to have as much fun as possible on the weekend. That way, when I’m at school, I don’t feel left out.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.18_Text: I wanna be a policeman when I grow up and chase bad guys!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.7_Text: I wanna be a policeman when I grow up and chase bad guys!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.93_Text: I wanna go out and find a puddle.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.212_Text: I wanna go to sleep, but the thunder is keeping me awake.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.45_Text: I wanna see Pokyo when I grow up. You’re from there, right?
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.54_Text: I wanna see Pokyo when I grow up. You’re from there, right?
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.271_Text: I wanna swim after this.//<portrait=annoyed>Oh no! I forgot my swimming trunks!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.84_Text: I want to make the biggest snowman in the world! But I don’t think we have enough snow yet.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.242_Text: I went to the lake with my class this one time, and we all collected trash.//We took it back to school and made stuff with it.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.247_Text: I wish I could be as fast as a black marlin so I could catch bad guys before they do bad-guy things.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.99_Text: I wish I could read my graphic novels instead. But I’m almost done, so no big deal. Humph.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.197_Text: I wish Mom had gotten me the Boy Detective umbrella for my birthday.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.166_Text: I wish he would teach me to fish.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.173_Text: I wish the ocean would warm up faster so I can go swimming. It’s still cold from Winter.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.128_Text: I wonder if there are more boats in the world than stars.//I’ll ask Dad.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.162_Text: I wonder if there’s places to go fishing there.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.174_Text: I wonder what Mom’s gonna get me for my birthday. I hope it’s the new Boy Detective shirt!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.161_Text: I wonder what Pokyo looks like. Dad says it’s a big city with lots of people and lots of noise.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.219_Text: I wonder what fish think of snow. Do they even know it’s there?
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.138_Text: I wonder what we’re doing in school tomorrow. <NPCName>Mr. Barnes</> always tells us about interesting stuff.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.154_Text: I wonder what we’re doing in school tomorrow. <NPCName>Mr. Barnes</> always tells us about interesting stuff.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.80_Text: Ice cream is the perfect treat. You can eat it in Spring, Fall like now, even Winter.//It’s <Italic>never</> too cold for ice cream…or too hot! That’s just silly.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.223_Text: If you catch a fish, you should show it to my dad. He knows a lot about them.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.152_Text: If you need any coconut drinks or fish stuff, you should go to the Beach Shack!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.194_Text: Is it time for the Winter Market yet? Mom always buys me a new toy!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.83_Text: It might be too cold for them.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.74_Text: It seems like a good day to have ice cream!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.78_Text: It seems like a good day to have ice cream!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.47_Text: It’s Taco Tuesday! I didn’t bring lunch on purpose today.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.171_Text: It’s almost time for school exams.//I hope I’m ready.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.199_Text: It’s dark and wet and cold out here.//I wish I was at home.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.85_Text: It’s easy. When I have enough money, I’m going to order snow from Socket & Pan and bring it here.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.188_Text: It’s fun to jump in big piles of leaves.//<portrait=normal>You can make them spray everywhere, like – <Italic>woosh</>!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.129_Text: It’s kinda boring on the island sometimes.//I wish there was a mystery for me to solve, like in Boy Detective.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.143_Text: It’s kinda boring on the island sometimes.//I wish there was a mystery for me to solve, like in Boy Detective.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.185_Text: It’s kinda cold out here, but the ocean is still warm. How does that work?
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.263_Text: It’s kinda sandy and musty, but I like it too.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.158_Text: It’s okay if you weren’t. I’m not very good at it either.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.245_Text: It’s really fun. I like my mom.//She’s supersmart.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.209_Text: It’s scary out here. I wanna go home!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.101_Text: It’s snowing today! I hope we can get out of school early so I can build a snowman in the park.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.163_Text: It’s the last day of school for this week! Yay!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.238_Text: I’d rather swim than play volleyball. But nobody wants to swim with me, so I usually play volleyball instead.//The ocean is like a huge bath, and I’ll never, ever get sweaty in it.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.115_Text: I’m allowed to play after school, but only until dinnertime. It’s okay. That’s enough!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.151_Text: I’m glad I got to sleep in today. Getting up every morning to go to school is hard.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.114_Text: I’m going to play at the beach after school.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.14_Text: I’m so excited for the weekend! I’m going to play at the beach all day tomorrow!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.11_Text: I’m so excited for the weekend! I’m going to play at the beach all weekend long!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.159_Text: I’m so hungry! Is it time for dinner yet?
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.195_Text: I’m tired of wearing a jacket every day. Is it time for Summer yet?
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.92_Text: I’ve been inside all day. It’s so boring.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.172_Text: I’ve been studying really hard, but it seems like everyone else gets it better than I do.//Guess I gotta keep working.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.135_Text: I’ve never seen a cow up close before.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.269_Text: I’ve seen every episode of Boy Detective a bazillion times, but watching it always makes me feel better.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.109_Text: Let me see… Can you move a bit?
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.217_Text: Look at it snow out there! Is it gonna snow forever?
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.105_Text: Look at my footprints! Snow is so much fun.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.72_Text: Me and my friends will be there for the Beach Cleanup Festival! We’re super excited.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.229_Text: Mini golf is hard! The clubs are <Italic>really</> heavy.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.160_Text: Mom got me a new action figure when she went into town the other day. It’s really cool.//See? The arms go up and down, and it says a bunch of stuff.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.96_Text: Mom said I have to go home right away after school.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.230_Text: Mom said kindness is cool.//I wanna be kind so I can be cool.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.150_Text: Mom says I have to learn math if I want to be a detective, though. Guess I gotta keep working on it.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.133_Text: Mom says I have to learn math if I want to be a detective, though.//<portrait=normal>Guess I gotta keep working on it.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.53_Text: Mom says I need to take school seriously but also never miss playtime.//She says having hobbies is just as important.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.189_Text: Mom says farmers harvest a lot of crops in Fall. Did you harvest anything?
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.130_Text: Mom says it’s not nice to wish for people to be murdered.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.32_Text: Mom told me I could be whatever I want if I put my heart in it.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.91_Text: Mom won’t let me out. She said I’ll get sick if I play in the rain.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.51_Text: My favorite dinosaurs are velociraptors.//<portrait=happy>They’re the smartest kind, you know!//<portrait=doubt>Errr…I’m pretty sure.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.56_Text: My favorite dinosaurs are velociraptors.//<portrait=happy>They’re the smartest kind, you know!//<portrait=doubt>Errr…I’m pretty sure.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.116_Text: My favorite subject is science. What was your favorite subject in school?
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.123_Text: My homework was really hard last night.//<portrait=doubt>I had to ask Dad for help.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.255_Text: My mom said I have Dad’s humor and charming smile.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.3_Text: My mom says if I promise to do my reading after dinner, I’m allowed to play at the beach after school.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.1_Text: My name?// Hmm… My name’s <NPCName>Oliver</>. Why?
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.191_Text: No one comes to the Beach Shack when it’s cold outside.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.258_Text: No, I don’t like fishing too much. It’s fun, I guess.//<portrait=sad>But it’s also boring.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.90_Text: Oh nooooo! Can’t do anything today.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.87_Text: Oh well! At least I get to see frogs soon!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.12_Text: Oh! Or I might go to the park and play with <NPCName>Taco</>. If I’m lucky, I might get to play with <NPCName>Peanut</> and <NPCName>Butter</> too.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.15_Text: Oh! Or I might go to the park and play with <NPCName>Taco</>. If I’m lucky, I might get to play with <NPCName>Peanut</> and <NPCName>Butter</> too.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.26_Text: Oh, <NPCName>Taco</> the dog.//The one wearing a fancy scarf!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.28_Text: Oh, <NPCName>Taco</> the dog.//The one wearing a fancy scarf!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.49_Text: Oh, don’t worry! We never found anything funny.//<portrait=normal>So you can rest peacefully.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.58_Text: Oh, don’t worry! We never found anything funny.//<portrait=normal>So you can rest peacefully.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.100_Text: Oh, he said we all have to read the same book so we can talk about it as a group.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.42_Text: Oh, um… Never <NPCName>Jim</>. He doesn’t laugh very much, actually.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.44_Text: Oh, um… Never <NPCName>Jim</>. He doesn’t laugh very much, actually.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.113_Text: Oh, yikes… I don’t want to look.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.198_Text: Rain, rain, go away! I wanna go out and play.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.41_Text: Reading at the library is so much better than at home. Because sometimes Dad or <NPCName>Jim</> laughs so hard, the whole house shakes.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.43_Text: Reading at the library is so much better than at home. Because sometimes Dad or <NPCName>Jim</> laughs so hard, the whole house shakes.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.118_Text: School must be very different from what you had back then.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.23_Text: School was good yesterday. I learned a lot!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.264_Text: Seafood ramen is really good!//Have you tried it?
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.29_Text: Seafood ramen is the best kind.//It’s like the sea, with bits of shrimp and clams, but you can eat them.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.37_Text: Sometimes I go to the library on the weekend to check out some books.//<NPCName>Millie</> lets me have first dibs when they get the new Detective Foyle graphic novels.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.140_Text: Sometimes he brings some when he comes over to play chess with Dad.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.239_Text: Sometimes, I sweat a lot when I play volleyball, and I don’t like it.//I feel all sticky. Eww…
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.221_Text: Sorry, <PlayerName>$player</>, but I gotta pay attention.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.272_Text: Sorry, I’m busy playing right now.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.22_Text: Surfing is super fun! Oh, but I can’t wait to dive.//I’m gonna dive too when I’m a little older.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.201_Text: That’s okay. Boy Detective is coming on TV tonight.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.142_Text: That’s what Dad told me to say when I need to work.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.178_Text: The Beach Shack is sooooo busy in Summer. Where do all those people come from?
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.246_Text: The black marlin is my favorite fish in the world. It swims so fast, like a lightning bolt.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.248_Text: The house is so boring. I wish Dad could take me fishing in the forest like <NPCName>Archie</> and his dad.//But I don’t want Dad to get too tired. He gets tired easy, and he doesn’t jump very high, so I can’t play volleyball with him either.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.227_Text: The sky is so big! Sometimes, I just look up and stare at it.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.210_Text: The storm makes everything creepy. You can’t even see anything in the rain.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.273_Text: The water is kinda cool right now.//It feels nice on my feet.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.224_Text: The wind feels nice.//<portrait=annoyed>But don’t open your mouth so wide. Sand might get in it.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.19_Text: There are no bad guys here, so I’ll have to go somewhere else.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.8_Text: There are no bad guys here, so I’ll have to go somewhere else.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.249_Text: There are so many kinds of sharks in the ocean! Umm… There’s mako sharks.//<portrait=normal>And then there’s blue sharks.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.39_Text: There must be a lot of bugs and worms on your farm, huh?
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.170_Text: There sure is a lot of garbage in the ocean. I wonder how it got there.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.60_Text: There was a scientist who moved here last year.//<portrait=normal>He’s at the beach a lot. I think his name is <NPCName>Surya</>.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.126_Text: There’s lots of fish around the island. I want to taste them all.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.94_Text: They keep playing the same shows on TV lately. I think they ran out of ideas.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.250_Text: They’re all really fast. Maybe I can swim that fast one day.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.2_Text: Um, yeah! This is a normal day on the island, I guess.//Except now you’re here.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.88_Text: Umm… Excuse me, <PlayerName>$honorifics $player</>, but what do you do all Winter?
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.111_Text: Umm… Maybe not. I don’t want my stomach to hurt.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.20_Text: Usually on Sundays, <NPCName>Valentina</> gets a visit from her uncle. So we can’t hang out too long.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.256_Text: Wanna see some pictures of my fish?
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.10_Text: We get to look for bugs and dig worms together. Oh, don’t worry. We don’t take them with us.//Only look at them!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.73_Text: We get to play at the beach the whole day and win prizes.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.102_Text: We learned about early civilizations…errr…about how they lived and what tools they used back then.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.64_Text: We learned flowers and bee houses can help increase the bee population.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.243_Text: We made pencil cases and trash bins!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.48_Text: We used to play at your farm after school to try to see ghosts.//We wanted to see if it was haunted.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.57_Text: We used to play at your farm after school to try to see ghosts.//We wanted to see if it was haunted.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.35_Text: Well, you’re rich now. You have a farm and all. Are you happy?
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.157_Text: Were you really good at school, <PlayerName>$player</>? I think Dad was.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.33_Text: What did you want to be when you grew up?
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.226_Text: What does he mean? Isn’t it good for every kid?//Like, is fresh air bad for <NPCName>Valentina</> or something?
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.164_Text: What’s your favorite kind of ice cream? I really like mint.//It feels <Italic>windy</>in my mouth. You should try it!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.25_Text: When I get bored on the weekend, I go to Hillside and play with <NPCName>Taco</>.//<portrait=normal>But only after I do my reading homework.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.27_Text: When I get bored on the weekend, I go to Hillside and play with <NPCName>Taco</>.//<portrait=normal>But only after I do my reading homework.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.180_Text: Why is it so hot? I hope Dad has some extra ice cream.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.211_Text: Why is thunder so big and loud? It sounds like a giant foot stomping on Coral Island.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.62_Text: Will you be planting any flowers this Spring? I can’t plant too much because we live on the beach. The sand won’t work.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.106_Text: Wow! Look at yours! They’re like a giant’s.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.4_Text: Yeah, I can watch TV. Of course.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.216_Text: You can’t really grow any plants when it’s like this, right? It would make them cold and sad.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.38_Text: You have to be healthy and strong if you want to pass the police exam.//I’m eating my vegetables and protein, so I think I will be.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.267_Text: You know how to read, right?//<portrait=normal>I don’t want to assume, ’cause my mom said it’s rude.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.71_Text: You’re right! Every day is a good day to have ice cream!
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.75_Text: You’re right. Every day is a good day to have ice cream.//But Dad always says not too much of it, or I’ll get a stomachache.
DT_Dialogue_Oliver_Production.79_Text: You’re right. Every day is a good day to have ice cream.//But Dad always says not too much of it, or I’ll get a stomachache.

DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.38_Text: <Italic>Gah</>, I love Summer! Everyone's out and about, having a good time.//<portrait=blushing>And I gotta say, I think I look pretty good in Summer clothes. What do you think?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.84_Text: <NPCName>Ben</>'s got a friend who's a miner. Sometimes I have her score me some rare ore, like osmium, trading it for gold plates or weapons.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.11_Text: <NPCName>Ben’s</> the man if you want a fresh perspective.//I like to get his opinion when I’ve got a tough decision to make.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.35_Text: <NPCName>Charles</> was sneezing all night when I saw him at the Tavern. Poor guy.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.194_Text: <NPCName>Luke</> and I tinker with our speakers a lot. Well, speakers, TVs, whatever’s in front of us.//<portrait=happy>Not scooters, though. Can’t do that. We don’t know <Italic>jack</> about scooters. That’s more <NPCName>Frank’s</> thing.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.96_Text: <NPCName>Rafael</> and I used to play in the mud in weather like this.//<portrait=happy>We’d get in so much trouble when Mom found out.//Ha! Good times.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.68_Text: <NPCName>Rafael</> and I went over to the inn and had a quick dinner with our niece, <NPCName>Valentina</>, to celebrate her birthday last week.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.74_Text: <NPCName>Rafael</> loves onyx. <NPCName>Ben</> is usually my go-to guy for rare items, but he’s out of town. That’s just great… Do you know where I can get an onyx?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.73_Text: <NPCName>Rafael</> loves onyx. I sure hope <NPCName>Ben</> has some in stock right now, or else I don’t know what to do.//<portrait=concerned>Do you know where I can get an onyx? Just in case <NPCName>Ben</> doesn’t have any.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.16_Text: <NPCName>Rafael</> wants a day off to spend time with the rest of the family, so we decided to close the shop on Sundays.//He’s usually gone all day.//<portrait=normal>It gives me time to relax.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.114_Text: <NPCName>Rafael</>'s a real whiz. He knows more about crafting quality weapons than I do.//He's got skills.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.135_Special: A delicious home-cooked meal by candlelight.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.136_Special: A hiking trip to sleep under the stars.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.137_Special: A night at the bar with dancing and drinks.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.134_Special: A romantic walk on the beach.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.108_Text: All good.//I don’t blame you. It’s hard to see in this weather.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.65_Text: Any big plans for the Summer?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.71_Text: Any reason is a good reason to get together, eh, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.88_Text: Anyway, those girls are always up to something.///<portrait=happy>Ha ha! I’d hate to miss any of it.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.100_Text: Are you looking for shelter or here on business, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.79_Text: Are you planting anything in your greenhouse this Winter?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.140_Text: Aww, yeah! Same here!//<portrait=blushing><NPCName>Rafael</> thinks it’s too much, but it helps me let loose.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.195_Text: Been thinking about getting another tattoo, but I can't decide on what.//Any fun ideas, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.175_Text: Before you take off, just thought I'd let you know, I saw some flowers over by the lighthouse.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.189_Text: Being a blacksmith is kind of mundane.//Same routine day in, day out.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.150_Text: Being the oldest son in the family has its own burdens.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.89_Text: Big family means there's always someone around.//But it also means we never have enough milk in the fridge!
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.30_Text: Bring 'em by if they need some work, okay? I'll see what I can do.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.15_Text: Business hours, huh? You're making it sound so official, <PlayerName>$player</>. Ha!//<portrait=normal>Our shop is open Monday to Saturday. We’re closed on Sunday.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.26_Text: But hey, gifts never hurt either!
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.6_Text: But if I’m too tired, I’ll just chill in the garage and tinker with my speakers.//<portrait=happy>No big deal.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.190_Text: But sometimes mundane is good, eh?//I want mundane when it comes to my love life too.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.43_Text: Can't figure out why my little bro keeps staying inside. Doesn't he get that Summer is the best time to be out and about?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.13_Text: Did you know <NPCName>Frank</> hates yogurt?//<portrait=normal>A weird thing to hate, isn’t it?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.157_Text: Do you know the mayor speaks highly of you?//And I have to say, I agree with him.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.168_Text: Do you swing by just to hang with me, or am I getting ahead of myself?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.92_Text: Does it feel like it rains more in Summer, or is it just me?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.200_Text: Does it feel stuffy in here to you?//<portrait=angry>We had to keep the windows shut all Winter, and now it sort of smells like…uh…soup?//What's up with that?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.188_Text: Don’t worry about it. It’s kinda dark here.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.8_Text: Don’t worry about our weapons breaking in the middle of combat.//They're built to last!
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.134_Text: Eh, not my thing. I don’t see the appeal of beaches, really.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.72_Text: Fall is here, and I haven’t gotten anything for <NPCName>Rafael’s</> birthday yet…
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.176_Text: Figured you’d like that sort of thing. So, yeah…
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.75_Text: For <NPCName>Rafael’s</> birthday last week, I gave him some cake from the Tavern. He seemed to like it.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.28_Text: Good food, great crowd. What else could I ask for, right?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.197_Text: Ha ha! Because I’m a blacksmith?//<portrait=normal>That could work!
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.62_Text: Had a chat with <NpcName>Randy</> about it, and keeping the education budget afloat is no picnic.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.78_Text: Have you gotten the greenhouse fixed up? You can plant a bunch of different stuff in there all year round.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.146_Text: Have you read up on any of the local folklore?//Good stuff, whether you believe it or not.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.19_Text: Having a good day so far?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.14_Text: He also hates durian, but that, I get.//<portrait=concerned>I wouldn't touch a durian with a ten-metre pole.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.12_Text: He's got a unique vibe going on. Cool guy.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.115_Text: He's usually the one handling the final fold of the weapon too.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.118_Text: Hey there! Good to see you, Farmer. What's the plan?//Me? Just stepping out for some fresh air.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.133_Text: Hey, <PlayerName>$player</>, theoretical question! What’s your dream date look like?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.136_Text: Hey, not too shabby! I could go for that. Theoretically. Ha ha!
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.164_Text: Hey, thanks for lending an ear. Sometimes it's nice to vent.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.162_Text: Hmm… I should read more books.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.171_Text: How are you, <PlayerName>$player</>?//Funny, I was just thinking about you this morning.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.40_Text: How can I work inside on such a beautiful day?//<portrait=sad>Sometimes being a blacksmith sucks.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.60_Text: How was your first festival? I hope you finally got to meet everyone.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.142_Text: Huh! I like both, really.//<portrait=normal>Got any recommendations?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.101_Text: I can’t believe it’s still storming.//<portrait=concerned>I think I’ll go home soon.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.45_Text: I can’t wait for the Harvest Festival. I wonder what everyone is going to show.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.178_Text: I couldn’t work a desk job, I don’t think.//I feel like I always have to keep moving my body to keep my mind at ease.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.91_Text: I don’t know… Just don’t feel like it.//<portrait=concerned>Wanna join?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.177_Text: I don’t mind hard work, to be honest.//I actually kind of like it.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.24_Text: I dropped some eggs today trying to make breakfast. Such a waste of food.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.69_Text: I gave her a geode... Thought she'd get a kick out of a geode, hunting for treasures and all, but I guess I missed the mark…
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.202_Text: I hate to turn him down, but I think he's just got cabin fever from the Winter.//Now that it's Spring, he's all about getting outdoors, doing springtime things like gardening, cleaning up the cemetery, that sort of thing.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.151_Text: I have to carry on with the shop… Not disappoint the family, you know?//I feel like it isn’t an option for me not to be a blacksmith. <NpcName>Rafael</>… He can walk away whenever he wants to.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.31_Text: I keep forgetting to read this book my brother got me about legendary blacksmiths.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.186_Text: I like the idea of having someone special to go home to.//<portrait=blushing>You know, other than <NPCName>Rafael</>.//<portrait=normal>And sharing a warm bed while we grow old together seems nice.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.167_Text: I like when you come and see me… You know that, right?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.97_Text: I might go to the Tavern after work and play some pool.//<portrait=happy>I hope to see you there!
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.90_Text: I might skip Fishensips tonight and just watch some TV at home.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.208_Text: I miss that big, round, natural heat lamp outdoors. Spring, where are you?!
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.165_Text: I think about my parents a lot.//They made a life for me and <NPCName>Rafael</>. Came here with nothing and made something of themselves. I feel like I owe them something.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.87_Text: I try to catch up with my niece and cousins when I can.//<NPCName>Rafael</> and I have this ongoing bet about who's the better uncle to <NPCName>Valentina</>.//<portrait=blushing>Who do you think is ahead?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.5_Text: I try to see my friends after work most days.//Just to take the edge off.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.9_Text: I usually take two days to upgrade tools, so please plan accordingly if you want something worked on.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.39_Text: I was reminded yesterday how I hate working in front of the furnace in Summer. I bet you never felt heat like the heat of a furnace on a hot Summer day.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.66_Text: I'll probably just chill at the Tavern and work on my speakers, same old, same old.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.41_Text: I'm not even exaggerating when I say the Beach Cleanup Festival is my favorite. Love seeing the community come together like that.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.183_Text: I'm not sure how I feel about that.//I just wish I could be the only one who… Forget it.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.58_Text: I'm pretty much over Winter. Can't wait for Spring to roll in.
