DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.48_Text: I've been thinking about heading over to the hot spring one of these days… Clear out some leaves for <NPCName>Takeba</>.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.179_Text: If I weren’t a blacksmith, I could certainly see myself as a farmer, to be honest.//<portrait=blushing>I spent a lot of time gardening growing up. Dirt suits me.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.145_Text: If anything weird ever happens on the farm, come tell me!//I love a good story.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.95_Text: It can be pretty boring being inside all day…//But work is work.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.85_Text: It can get pretty boring being indoors all day.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.57_Text: It doesn’t really feel like Winter until I see the festive Winter decorations.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.206_Text: It was good to see you at the Harvest Festival the other day!//Wait… Was that you? Or was it just someone that looked like you?//Near the pot, with a bowl full of garlic? Yes?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.4_Text: It's the small stuff, like how we entertain ourselves…//They’re what makes us who we are, eh?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.33_Text: It’s <Italic>finally</> getting warmer. Can't wait to get back outside.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.98_Text: It’s good to see you here, <PlayerName>$player</>!
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.3_Text: It’s important to have a hobby.//Gives you a chance to really dig deep into who you are.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.163_Text: It’s just so hard to find the time, yeah? Maybe we can read together! And meet up to talk about what we’re reading.//<portrait=normal>Like a book club, but just you and me.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.124_Text: It’s probably not the healthiest habit, staying indoors all day.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.93_Text: It’s raining hard outside, so I might as well keep the furnace on and get some work done.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.49_Text: It’s starting to get too cold for my taste. I’m not looking forward to Winter…//A hot spring does sound pretty sweet right about now, huh?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.99_Text: It’s storming really hard outside, so I might as well keep the furnace on and get some work done.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.204_Text: It’s too hot to wear anything else right now.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.121_Text: It’s true. Their house is right over there.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.82_Text: I’m cold. Why does it have to be this cold?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.123_Text: I’m just getting out for some fresh air…and some ore.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.81_Text: I’m sure you already know this, but plants don’t wither inside the greenhouse. Easy income all year round, eh?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.80_Text: I’m sure you already know this, but plants in the greenhouse don’t wither. Easy income all year round, eh?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.63_Text: I’m trying to persuade my cousins to expand the inn’s business.//Maybe they could add karaoke! Let people choose songs and sing along.//<portrait=sad>They keep turning me down.//Didn’t see the potential, I guess.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.185_Text: I’ve thought about settling down plenty of times, but it isn’t easy.//<portrait=annoyed>All these years of dating, and I’ve never met “the one.”
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.139_Text: Makes sense! That stuff makes me sleepy.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.32_Text: Maybe tonight I'll finally sit down and read the darn thing.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.147_Text: Me? I guess I’ve never thought about it.//<portrait=normal>I see no reason why those things couldn’t be true.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.130_Text: Me? I like to help keep it clean.//Folks ought to respect the dead, you know?//It clears my head too!
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.192_Text: Me? Oh, you know! Just tidying up, like always.//Helping out my girls.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.53_Text: Might ask my little brother to go to the hot spring with me next week.//I don’t like him being all alone <Italic>all</> the time.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.110_Text: My arms are tired from working all day, but never too tired for a good game of pool!
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.161_Text: My bad. It's not polite to stare, I know… Just can't help myself.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.201_Text: My brother's been talking about starting a garden, like <NpcName>Dippa</>'s.//Grow our own food.//<portrait=concerned>I don’t know...sounds like a lot. Balancing farming and blacksmithing...//I prefer to stick to one thing and do it well.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.20_Text: My cousin <NPCName>Antonio</>, <NPCName>Valentina’s</> dad, comes here for festivals sometimes.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.64_Text: My cousins? Well, technically, the twins who run the inn are my ex-cousins-in-law, but we just treat them like family.//Thought that was pretty standard, but maybe it's just an us thing…
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.169_Text: My family makes casseroles every Sunday.//We have our cousins over, the nieces and all.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.18_Text: My free time? Hmm…//I usually head to town and run some errands.//If not that, I’ll probably just be hanging out at the Tavern.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.111_Text: My left eye feels funny.//<portrait=annoyed>I think I got dust in it on my way here…
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.55_Text: My little brother and I used to play in the snow until late. When we were kids, of course.//We’d make sleighs from tree trunks and just go sliding back and forth.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.153_Text: My parents keep bugging me about giving them grandkids. *sighs* Every time I see them, it’s “Where are my grandkids? Where are my grandkids?”
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.199_Text: My parents would really like you, you know.//Want to meet them one day?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.76_Text: Next Summer, I’m going to remind myself to set aside one piece of onyx for his birthday. Because I know <NPCName>Rafael</> loves that stuff.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.104_Text: No worries…//<portrait=normal>With it being this cold, my toes are probably numb anyways.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.46_Text: Now Fall is here, that farm must be working you hard, huh? The season of harvest and all…//I can tell. Farming looks good on you.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.129_Text: Oh! Farmer <PlayerName>$player</>, hello!//What brings you here?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.191_Text: Oh! Farmer <PlayerName>$player</>, hello!//What brings you here?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.116_Text: Oh, I don’t need a proper heater.//I work in front of the furnace all day.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.126_Text: Oh, hey! Wanna listen to something?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.52_Text: On one hand, I get so bored cooped up inside. On the other hand, it’s so dang cold out!//<portrait=sad>What should I do?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.187_Text: Ouch! You stepped on my foot.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.47_Text: Our family has been helping out Starlet Town by setting up festivals and putting up seasonal decorations.//Gotta admit, the Fall festival decorations are some of my faves.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.143_Text: Read anything interesting lately, <PlayerName>$player</>?//Tell me all about it… I like hearing you talk about the books you read.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.117_Text: Running a farm must take some serious planning. Deciding what to plant and when…
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.61_Text: School’s important. I’m glad we get to keep the school going on such a small island.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.156_Text: Seems like every time I turn around, you're out there, lending a hand to someone.//You're one of the good ones.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.131_Text: Smell that?//Sweet Spring air! I’m so glad Winter is over. Ha ha.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.44_Text: So glad it's starting to cool down. Makes working at the shop a lot easier.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.56_Text: So what do you think of the Winter decorations, <PlayerName>$player</>? <NPCName>Rafael</> and I put them up every year.//They’re great, right? Makes the town more festive.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.138_Text: So, <PlayerName>$player</>! What kind of music do you play to unwind, eh?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.122_Text: So, what brought you out to this neck of the woods today, Farmer <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.144_Text: Sometimes I come here to get away, but a guy like me rarely minds company.//<portrait=happy>Come on in!
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.159_Text: Sorry, <PlayerName>$player</>, didn't mean to pry.//Truth is, I'm feeling a bit wiped myself today.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.119_Text: Spending all day indoors probably isn't the healthiest habit.//<portrait=normal>What brings you here?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.37_Text: Spring always brings so much life. Kinda makes me feel more alive too.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.135_Text: That sounds perfect! You’ve got the right idea.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.137_Text: That sounds perfect! You’ve got the right idea.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.196_Text: That…actually sounds cool!//<portrait=normal>Yeah, I might do that. Thanks!
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.34_Text: The Cherry Blossom Festival is out of this world.//<portrait=happy>Good people, great food, what's better than that?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.70_Text: The annual beach cleanup's taking place near the inn, and I'm sure everyone's gonna chip in.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.59_Text: The drilling company?//<portrait=angry>Yeah… Everyone’s talking about it.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.54_Text: The furnace can keep the whole house warm, all right…//We don't really need an extra heater.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.77_Text: The last day of Fall is the busiest day for us.//That’s when <NPCName>Rafael</> and I put up Winter decorations around town. You know, so it looks more festive! Adds a little color to the plain white snow.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.132_Text: The temperature outside only feels right to me in Summer.//Maybe because I’m always in front of a furnace?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.42_Text: The trash collecting isn’t a contest per se, but…//<portrait=blushing>I like to think it is.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.193_Text: The view out here really is gorgeous. Just like y–//Uh, never mind.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.207_Text: These boots are my favorite. Wear 'em all year round.//They’re good for walking in the snow. They have those teeth that grip your feet to the ground. Anti-slip!
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.205_Text: This necklace is from <NpcName>Valentina</>. She made it from shells she got at the beach.//Creative kid, isn’t she?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.120_Text: This spot sure gets a lot of foot traffic, huh?//<portrait=annoyed>I always see <NPCName>Anne</> and <NPCName>Paul</> walking around here.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.10_Text: Throwing extra coins at me won't speed up the process...yeah, I know.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.113_Text: Today I told myself I’d just play one game of pool and then go home, but I always manage to talk myself into staying longer.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.184_Text: Ugh, I haven’t taken a proper break all week. Been working nonstop.//It’s a busy Winter for me.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.67_Text: Ugh, today’s a busy day for me. I could use a cold drink right about now.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.170_Text: Usually, we watch sports or something.//Fun times!
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.17_Text: We close early on Saturdays.//<portrait=normal>So, if you need my help, better ask before noon.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.7_Text: We develop new weapons every now and then.//Well, basically whenever we have the time, to be honest.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.102_Text: Well, I guess it is Winter.//<portrait=concerned>What else did I expect, besides getting snowed on?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.148_Text: Well, isn't this a nice surprise! Always a pleasure, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.2_Text: Well, it’s nice to finally meet you! Name’s <NPCName>Pablo</>.//I don’t know jack about farming, but hey!//<portrait=happy>If you need help with tools, come by my shop just north of town, and I’ll see what I can do. Ciao!
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.180_Text: Well, look at you, <PlayerName>$player</>. You look fantastic.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.152_Text: Well, sure, nobody’s forcing me. You’re right.//I guess the guilt is hard to explain.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.154_Text: Well… I haven't given it much thought. But sure, why not? Maybe someday.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.25_Text: When it comes to birthdays, people mostly just appreciate you remembering. Kinda shows they're in your thoughts.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.203_Text: Whoa! Summer looks good on you. Gimme some of that glow!
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.112_Text: Why is it always in my left eye?//<portrait=happy>I guess it’s time for a new eye. Ha!
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.50_Text: Winter is such a bummer.//I can’t stand being outdoors in the cold too long.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.182_Text: With everything you've got going for you... You must turn quite a few heads, huh?//You're sweet, attractive… Easy to get along with…
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.86_Text: With this cold, there's hardly anyone out and about.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.36_Text: Workshop's not too hot right now. Kinda nice and warm, really.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.181_Text: Wow! You look fantastic.//Where did you get that outfit?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.27_Text: Yeah, I'm a bit of a Tavern regular. You noticed, huh?//<portrait=normal>Could be after work or on the weekend. Whenever I'm feeling it.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.155_Text: You did what?!//<portrait=normal>Oh, you went mining! I thought you said you went <Italic>lining</>, as in zip-lining or something.//I was like, “Where?”
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.173_Text: You have this quality. How do I say it…//You’re always so polite and warm.//I admire that in a person.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.94_Text: You here for business or just seeking shelter, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.149_Text: You just made my Monday much, much better.//What brought you to this side of the island?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.51_Text: You know what? Sometimes Winter isn’t so bad. At the very least, it makes working in front of the furnace so much better.//<portrait=sad>I’d still rather be outside, though…
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.22_Text: You look like you had a good day!
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.1_Text: You must be <PlayerName>$player</>, right?//<portrait=normal>Damn, I wasn’t expecting you to look like <Italic>this</>.//You’re surprisingly cute!
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.158_Text: You seem tired today. Is everything all right?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.106_Text: You should probably stay put for a bit, warm up some.
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.29_Text: Your tools holding up all right, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.174_Text: You’re the whole package, aren’t you?
DT_Dialogue_Pablo_Production.125_Text: [<NPCName>Pablo</> is hard at work on his speaker.]

DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.183_Text: <NPCName>Anne</> has been grilling fish lately.//We got a deal from <NPCName>Sunny</>, so she bought a lot on the weekend.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.64_Text: <NPCName>Zoe</> is too young to go to the Tavern. It’s very loud, and there’s alcohol and drunk people everywhere.//Just not ideal for kids.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.66_Text: <NPCName>Zoe</> is too young to go to the Tavern. It’s very loud, and there’s alcohol and drunk people everywhere.//Just not ideal for kids.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.142_Text: <PlayerName>$player</>! Great to see you, my friend.//Are you here to see the animal footage we got yesterday?
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.153_Text: A couple of <NPCName>Zoe’s</> friends live around here. She always has a lot of fun at the beach.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.162_Text: A simple thing like refilling bird feeders can help wildlife, and it takes less than ten minutes.//<portrait=happy>Everybody has ten minutes in their week, eh?
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.178_Text: After two days of working in these boots, they were my favorite pair.//Wanna try them on?
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.196_Text: Ah, my vest! I miss it.//It smells kind of musty, but I’m sure it’ll be better after it airs out some.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.171_Text: Ah, they’re just your hands. Sorry. Didn’t mean to alarm you.//<portrait=normal>I thought you were carrying… Never mind.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.95_Text: Ah, yes, yes! Heaters. I forgot the proper name for them for a split second there.//<portrait=normal>Must be my Winter brain coming back.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.97_Text: Ah, yes, yes! Heaters. I forgot the proper name for them for a split second there.//<portrait=normal>Must be my Winter brain coming back.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.18_Text: Ah, your farm– something is going on over there, <PlayerName>$player</>.//<portrait=annoyed>Nothing spooky, but…
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.20_Text: Ah, your farm– something is going on over there, <PlayerName>$player</>.//<portrait=annoyed>Nothing spooky, but…
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.156_Text: And then the bear was behind me all along! That was scary. Very, very scary. The forest can be scary at times.//But of course, I had to keep calm. <NPCName>Anne</> was with me. Didn’t want to spook the bear.//We stayed inside the tent the whole night.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.49_Text: As long as you’re cool with it, of course.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.55_Text: As long as you’re cool with it, of course.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.65_Text: Besides, it’s probably healthier for her to eat at home, where we know where all the ingredients came from.//Though indulging every now and then can’t be too bad, can it?
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.67_Text: Besides, she has school tomorrow.//She won’t be able to wake up on time if she stays up late.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.137_Text: But I’m here pretty much throughout the week, if that means anything.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.165_Text: But hey, you can wear whatever you want!//It seems like you’re already doing just that. Good on you, mate!
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.44_Text: Cassowaries can be very dangerous if they feel threatened. I’m always very careful when I spot one.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.62_Text: Cassowaries can be very dangerous if they feel threatened. I’m always very careful when I spot one.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.70_Text: Cauliflower season, isn’t it? Yeah, I should know.//I used to be obsessed with growing it. My mom’s favorite vegetable.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.149_Text: Come on, <NPCName>Zoe</>! Let’s see who the winners are!
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.197_Text: Damg, every time I see <NpcName>Theo</>'s boat at the beach I get major boat envy. It's so sick!//<portrait=normal>I wonder if he'd let me borrow it for a day.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.155_Text: Did you say something? Really?//Ah, must be the music. It’s so loud, I can hardly make anything out. Apologies!
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.86_Text: Do you think we should plant more trees to shelter wildlife?
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.106_Text: Don’t let the rain stop you, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.111_Text: Don’t let the rain stop you, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.122_Text: Don’t let the snow stop you, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.124_Text: Don’t let the snow stop you, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.115_Text: Don’t let the storm stop you, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.36_Text: Don’t stay up too late, will ya? It happened to me one time, working late editing footage of a cassowary.//It didn’t end well.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.42_Text: Don’t stay up too late, will ya? It happened to me one time, working late editing footage of a cassowary.//It didn’t end well.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.121_Text: Either that or you really need um… Never mind.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.118_Text: Great weather. Great weather, indeed. Keeping my hat on, though!
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.168_Text: Ha ha ha! Wrong person, <PlayerName>$player</>. Not <NPCName>Walter</>.//<portrait=normal>I’m still <NPCName>Paul</>!
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.35_Text: Have you started farming this season?
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.90_Text: Hopefully, we can teach our kids to respect wildlife and to reserve some space only for them.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.92_Text: Hopefully, we can teach our kids to respect wildlife and to reserve some space only for them.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.14_Text: Humph… I’ll just do it tomorrow.//<portrait=normal>I don’t think <NPCName>Anne</> will notice.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.159_Text: I always love visits from <NPCName>Peanut</> and <NPCName>Butter</>. What personalities they have.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.40_Text: I can’t sit around at home for too long. I get bored easily and want to go make something of my day.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.164_Text: I can’t wear bright, colorful things. I need to keep a low profile.//Don’t wanna spook the animals, you know?
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.47_Text: I didn’t swim close to it. <NPCName>Anne</> and I were diving, and she happened to have a video camera on her. Lucky!
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.61_Text: I didn’t swim close to it. <NPCName>Anne</> and I were diving, and she happened to have a video camera on her. Lucky!
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.188_Text: I do what I can, but I want to do more. Build large wildlife conservation areas on secluded islands, help the locals, educate our youth.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.71_Text: I don’t like it that much anymore.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.144_Text: I don’t see you here very often, <PlayerName>$player</>. I hope things are okay back at the farm.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.184_Text: I don’t think I can eat any more fish tonight.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.135_Text: I don’t want to get too close to them. It’s their home. I don’t want to intrude.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.173_Text: I feel so alive today. The river is flowing, the air is crisp.//The birds! Oh, the birds are chirping.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.46_Text: I have footage of this massive green sawfish. I’ll have to show you sometime!
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.60_Text: I have footage of this massive green sawfish. I’ll have to show you sometime!
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.13_Text: I have to do the recycling today. I completely forgot about that.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.147_Text: I haven’t had time to change them. We don’t get visitors often anyway.//Besides, wildlife doesn’t like a lot of light at night.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.138_Text: I just finished editing last week’s footage. Everything is coming along great! Now onto the fun stuff.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.87_Text: I knew you’d think so! Shelter isn’t just for rain, you know. It’s important on sunny days too. Just like us, animals don’t want to overheat.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.141_Text: I know it’s technically a plant, but it’s rare, huh? People love to see it. We certainly do.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.166_Text: I passed by your farm the other day on my way to the lookout.//<portrait=happy>Whoa! Good job you’re doing over there!
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.37_Text: I passed out and had to be taken to the hospital.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.43_Text: I passed out and had to be taken to the hospital.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.134_Text: I saw a couple of monkeys taking a bath in the lake the other day. It’s pretty hard to predict when they’ll be out.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.32_Text: I saw that cute little puppy chasing birds in town yesterday.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.38_Text: I saw that cute little puppy chasing birds in town yesterday.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.163_Text: I spend a lot of time in the wild.//While we have a good environment for the animals here, I know many islands still need help.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.28_Text: I think I’ll go down to the Tavern tomorrow. It’ll be a great excuse to put my dancing shoes on.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.177_Text: I used to wear hiking boots everywhere, and it was fine.//But then, as soon as I tried <Italic>this</> kind of boots – oh boy!//That was it.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.73_Text: I was expecting to see way more frogs and bees this time of year.//Hmm…
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.74_Text: I was expecting to see way more frogs and bees this time of year.//Hmm…
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.189_Text: I was in a band back in university, ya know.//Maybe not as talented as <NPCName>Theo</>, but I had my day.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.181_Text: I was in a band back in university, you know.//Maybe not as talented as <NPCName>Theo</>, but I had my day.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.145_Text: I was looking at a space back there to put a small pet house, maybe. Not for a pet, but shelter for wild animals.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.180_Text: I wear only hiking boots now. My feet get really hot after working for a while, but these… They have a nice cooling effect.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.31_Text: I wouldn’t mind editing some video, but <NPCName>Anne</> said it can wait.//So it’ll wait.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.186_Text: I wouldn’t mind if the animals ate our corn.//Sharing is caring, eh?
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.198_Text: I've been itching to take the family out on the water for ages. <NpcName>Theo</>'s boat would be perfect, but I don't wanna be all up in his business, ya know?//<portrait=annoyed>Maybe I'll just casually mention I wanna go fishing and see if he offers to let me use it.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.56_Text: It was <NPCName>Anne’s</> idea to make informative videos for kids too. Made quite a bit from it, actually.//She thinks about stuff like that. She’s a very outside-the-box type.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.79_Text: It was a rewarding project, and it taught kids about the cycle of life firsthand.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.81_Text: It was a rewarding project, and it taught kids about the cycle of life firsthand.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.48_Text: It would be an exciting project to just camp out at your farm and see what wildlife we can find.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.54_Text: It would be an exciting project to just camp out at your farm and see what wildlife we can find.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.29_Text: It’ll be nice to see <NPCName>Frank</> too.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.158_Text: It’s certainly one of a kind! Let’s dance to it!
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.22_Text: It’s only the beginning of the week, and we’ve already recorded some rare birds.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.72_Text: It’s still a bit chilly out, so I think some animals are still hibernating.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.12_Text: It’s too close to town. So many people in one place scare off the wildlife.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.6_Text: It’s too close to town. So many people in one place scare off the wildlife.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.140_Text: It’s tough to get footage of the corpse flower. The plant doesn’t flower often.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.132_Text: I’m at the lake a lot. It’s my job.//Gotta go where my job takes me. Seems like you are too, huh?
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.104_Text: I’m beginning to miss fresh strawberries. Hmm…
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.119_Text: I’m going to go out on a limb and say the animals are happy today too.//They like sunny days as much as we do.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.30_Text: I’m having fun. I mean, it’s Saturday, and I’m spending time with the family!//<portrait=normal>What else are we gonna do today but have fun?
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.17_Text: I’m refreshed and ready to get back to work!
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.187_Text: I’m saving some money to put toward a wildlife conservation fund.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.19_Text: I’m sure some unusual creatures live on that side of the island.//I don’t have any footage, though.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.21_Text: I’m sure some unusual creatures live on that side of the island.//I don’t have any footage, though.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.131_Text: I’m trying to capture footage. Will you keep your voice down, please?
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.175_Text: I’ve only seen a white crocodile once in my life. He was big. He had a name…something something.//I can’t remember it for the life of me.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.100_Text: Maybe <NPCName>Ben</> might have some. Hmm… Let’s hope so.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.103_Text: Maybe <NPCName>Ben</> might have some. Hmm… Let’s hope so.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.3_Text: Maybe I’ll plant some cauliflower in our backyard. Hmm…
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.110_Text: My wife has been saying how humid it’s been lately. And I agree!
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.109_Text: My wife has been saying how humid it’s been lately. And I agree!//Especially when it rains like this, eh?
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.182_Text: My wife here will tell you the same thing. Ask away!//<portrait=normal>In fact, I think I still have some old pictures somewhere at the house.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.190_Text: My wife here will tell you the same thing. Ask away!//<portrait=normal>In fact, I think I still have some old pictures somewhere at the house.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.101_Text: Oh my, it’s almost the 20th.//I haven’t bought anything for my wedding anniversary yet.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.98_Text: Oh my, it’s almost the 20th.//I haven’t bought anything for my wedding anniversary yet.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.160_Text: Oh, they’re <NPCName>Erika’s</> cats. For some reason, they always come around late at night.//I wonder if she knows about it.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.176_Text: Oh, um… I believe that particular one was an albino crocodile.//Very rare, you know. If I had to put a number on it, I’d say there’s maybe only 100 of them in the world.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.80_Text: One time, <NPCName>Zoe</> had a school project, and we planted strawberries. It was fun.//We shared the harvest with some wild animals.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.113_Text: Or maybe wait until tomorrow.//It’s getting pretty late.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.172_Text: Parrots are brilliant. And very social, a lot like us.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.51_Text: Phew. That was a heck of a surprise.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.53_Text: Phew. That was a heck of a surprise.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.84_Text: Planting bananas around the lake may not be a bad idea. Wildlife could take advantage of them as well.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.82_Text: Planting some bananas around the lake might not be a bad idea. Wildlife could take advantage of them too.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.192_Text: Retiring my vest for a bit.//It can’t take the snow…too thin.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.146_Text: Some of the bulbs on our porch burned out. Be careful going home, okay?
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.169_Text: Somebody had too much fun this weekend. Heh heh.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.26_Text: Sometimes I wait for weeks and don’t get any usable footage at all.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.174_Text: Sunshine dayyyyy~ Sunshineeeee awakeeeees~ Oh, my sunshinyyyyy dayyyyy~
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.148_Text: Sweating the day away, <PlayerName>$player</>? I’m playing volleyball with the family.//<portrait=happy>Trying to see if I can still beat my wife at it.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.167_Text: Taking care of such a large property takes not just skill but dedication.//Hats off, my friend!
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.88_Text: Thankfully, most of the trees here are renewable.//And the fact that we plant more trees every year has really helped the environment.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.127_Text: That’s why I’m out here, <PlayerName>$player</>. Why else?
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.129_Text: That’s why I’m out here, <PlayerName>$player</>. Why else?
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.2_Text: The docuseries Friends with Wildlife? Yeah!//<portrait=normal>My wife and I made that! I can’t believe you know about it.//Cool, cool! Very cool.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.83_Text: The thing about planting in the wild is so many animals come out at night.//The seedlings would probably be gone the next day.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.85_Text: The thing about planting in the wild is so many animals come out at night.//The seedlings would probably be gone the next day.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.15_Text: The town seems much cleaner lately, for some reason.//Have you noticed?
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.11_Text: There are rats and snakes around the recycling center, but I don’t think other wild animals go near it.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.5_Text: There are rats and snakes around the recycling center, but I don’t think other wild animals go near it.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.89_Text: There’s a certain part of this island we don’t touch at all, and I’m glad for the restriction.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.91_Text: There’s a certain part of this island we don’t touch at all, and I’m glad for the restriction.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.161_Text: There’s lots of ways you can help the environment! Building bee hotels, for instance.//<NPCName>Ben</> has some near his cara…errr…house.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.7_Text: Think you could give me some gardening tips? Let’s say I wanted to plant some carrots…
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.9_Text: Think you could give me some gardening tips? Let’s say I wanted to plant some carrots…
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.23_Text: This is my week.//This week is going to be a doozy, I can tell!
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.25_Text: This may come as a surprise, but making a wildlife documentary is mostly just waiting around.//Not a lot of action… The narration, though. That’s a different beast altogether.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.24_Text: Try not to spook the wildlife when you go in the forest, will ya?
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.77_Text: Try not to step on them!
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.136_Text: Uh… I don’t know who comes here on weekends. I usually spend mine at the beach.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.75_Text: Watch your step, <PlayerName>$player</>. As the weather gets warmer, more animals will come out of hibernation.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.76_Text: Watch your step, <PlayerName>$player</>. As the weather gets warmer, you may find snakes in the forest.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.193_Text: We forgot to clear the garden before Winter. Now we have frozen crops in our garden.//I think we’ll just wait for Spring to clean it up. No point in doing it right now, eh?
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.194_Text: We forgot to clear the garden before Winter. So, for a long time, we had frozen crops in our garden.//Good thing it wasn’t hard to clear it up. Frozen and all.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.152_Text: We get to see seals and all kinds of fish here. Turtles come to the shore sometimes, but not very often.//So keep an eye out.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.185_Text: We grow some crops in our garden. It’s a good way for <NPCName>Zoe</> to bond with nature.//We planted some corn, melons. What else did we plant?
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.58_Text: We made some videos for <NPCName>Zoe</> when she was younger, to teach her about wildlife.//We weren’t thinking then that other kids would like them too!
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.68_Text: We made some videos for <NPCName>Zoe</> when she was younger, to teach her about wildlife.//We weren’t thinking then that other kids would like them too!
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.78_Text: We planted strawberries one time for <NPCName>Zoe’s</> school project. It was fun.//We shared the harvest with some wild animals.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.195_Text: We started planting carrots and potatoes already.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.59_Text: Well, <NPCName>Anne</> did, actually.//<portrait=normal>Then we sold a few, and they were surprisingly successful, so we made more. But now <NPCName>Zoe’s</> a bit older, we kind of stopped making them.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.69_Text: Well, <NPCName>Anne</> did, actually.//<portrait=normal>Then we sold a few, and they were surprisingly successful, so we made more. But now <NPCName>Zoe’s</> a bit older, we kind of stopped making them.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.41_Text: Well, not just at home… I don’t like being confined in general.//<portrait=normal>It scrambles my brain.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.139_Text: Well, yeah. My wife does most of the editing. She likes it.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.105_Text: We’ve been enjoying building snowmen this Winter. I think <NPCName>Zoe</> had a lot of fun.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.16_Text: What a weekend! I was glad for a break, but… Phew! I’m glad it’s over.//<portrait=normal>I love dancing, but my hips weren’t made for it, I can tell you that much.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.108_Text: What are we doing indoors? We should be out there in nature. In the rain!
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.117_Text: What are we doing indoors? We should be out there in nature. In the rain!
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.133_Text: What are you doing here this time of day, anyway?
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.34_Text: What are you up to this week? You always seem to be busy and running around all the time.//What a life you must have, eh?
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.10_Text: What have you got up your sleeve? Come on, don’t be shy.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.8_Text: What have you got up your sleeve? Come on, don’t be shy.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.157_Text: What in the world is this song? Do you think <NPCName>Theo</> wrote it himself?
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.179_Text: What kind of boots do you wear? You and me – we’re the same, you know?//Both on our feet all day, every day.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.93_Text: Winter, eh? Less work for me and you. There are significantly fewer animals out and about this time of year.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.45_Text: Yeah, it’s the same way with a lot of animals.//They’re beautiful creatures, and we have to be careful not to harm them. They have feelings too.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.63_Text: Yeah, it’s the same way with a lot of animals.//They’re beautiful creatures, and we have to be careful not to harm them. They have feelings too.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.57_Text: Yeah, the videos are about wildlife, of course. We made them easy for kids to understand.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.150_Text: You can always dive into the ocean if it gets too hot.//Cool down a bit, eh? Don’t overheat!
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.102_Text: You don’t know where to get sunflowers this time of year, do you? They’re <NPCName>Anne’s</> favorite.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.99_Text: You don’t know where to get sunflowers this time of year, do you? They’re <NPCName>Anne’s</> favorite.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.107_Text: You wanna go and mine? You go and mine, fella!//<portrait=normal>The island is your oyster.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.112_Text: You wanna go and mine? You go and mine, fella!//<portrait=normal>The island is your oyster.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.116_Text: You wanna go and mine? You go and mine, fella!//<portrait=normal>The island is your oyster.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.123_Text: You wanna go and mine? You go and mine, fella!//<portrait=normal>The island is your oyster.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.125_Text: You wanna go and mine? You go and mine, fella!//<portrait=normal>The island is your oyster.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.94_Text: Your animals are okay, I hope? It can get really cold in the barn.//I’d get one of those warmer machines if I were you.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.96_Text: Your animals are okay, I hope? It can get really cold in the barn.//I’d get one of those warmer machines if I were you.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.1_Text: You’re going to be a farmer, huh?//<portrait=annoyed>What brings you out here, then?//<portrait=normal>By the way, you can call me <NPCName>Paul</>.
DT_Dialogue_Paul_Production.4_Text: You’ve seen our backyard, right?//Is the environment too harsh for cauliflower, you think?

DT_Dialogue_Peanut_Production.23_Text: [Oh, to be a cat on Coral Island!]
DT_Dialogue_Peanut_Production.21_Text: [Peanut doesn’t seem to be a fan of Winter.]
DT_Dialogue_Peanut_Production.19_Text: [Peanut doesn’t seem to be enjoying the storm.]
DT_Dialogue_Peanut_Production.24_Text: [Peanut looks a lot like Butter. Are they siblings?]
DT_Dialogue_Peanut_Production.25_Text: [Playing with Peanut makes you want to rescue a million cats.]
DT_Dialogue_Peanut_Production.26_Text: [Why is Peanut so cute? It’s the greatest mystery.]
DT_Dialogue_Peanut_Production.27_Text: [You want to be a cat and follow Peanut around all day.]
DT_Dialogue_Peanut_Production.22_Text: [You wonder if Peanut and Taco get along.]
DT_Dialogue_Peanut_Production.10_Text: [You wonder what the cat is doing here, but you realize maybe that’s just what cats do.]
DT_Dialogue_Peanut_Production.28_Text: “Are you a good kitty?”//[You swear Peanut answers back, but maybe you’re just sleepy.]

DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.165_Text: <NPCName>Ben</>'s part of it. But I think he stays here, in Coral Island.//<portrait=normal>Only travels once a year.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.49_Text: <NPCName>Joko</> and <NPCName>Dinda</> are top-notch carpenters, anyway.//I don’t think the market here is big enough for another carpenter, even if I wanted to be one.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.197_Text: <NPCName>Kira</> has a great selection of weapons and armor.//Have you checked them out yet?
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.213_Text: <NPCName>Kira</> is cool. I grew up wanting to be like her, fighting monsters, living in the middle of nowhere, and all that…//But that’s not the life for me. No, I belong here, in my parents’ shack.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.189_Text: <NPCName>Pablo</> and I went to the inn and had a quick dinner with our niece, <NPCName>Valentina</>, to celebrate her birthday last week.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.190_Text: <NPCName>Pablo</> gave her a geode because he thought she’d enjoy finding treasures, but I guess not…
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.75_Text: <NPCName>Pablo</> is my older brother.//We look a bit alike, right?
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.102_Text: <NPCName>Pablo</> keeps inviting me to the Tavern, but I keep telling him I just want to stay in.//<portrait=happy>I don't like the Tavern.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.29_Text: <NPCName>Pablo</> spends a lot of time in the garage. He seems to <Italic>always</> be calibrating his TV.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.174_Text: <NPCName>Taco</> lived here for a few weeks.//Then <NPCName>Suki</> took him over to <NPCName>Luke</>'s for a playdate, and the pup, um, didn’t want to come back.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.107_Text: <NPCName>Valentina</> can play in the sun the whole day – in this heat.//I don’t know… I don’t think it’s healthy, right?//What do you think?
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.58_Text: <NPCName>Valentina</> is a great kid. I feel like <NPCName>Antonio</> is a bit too hard on her sometimes.//But I’m not a parent, so…
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.214_Text: <NPCName>Yuri</> reminds me of <NPCName>Kira</> a little.//She’s brave and saves a lot of lives, I bet.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.248_Text: <NpcName>Valentina</> made me this beanie.//Can you see the tiny little bear on it? I love it.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.157_Text: A storm like this blew our roof off one time.//<portrait=sad>We had to relocate for a few days while it was being fixed.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.63_Text: According to the legend, the Ironeye Hammer even talks to you while it works!//<portrait=happy>I wonder if it knows any, um, jokes.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.15_Text: And some compensation for our labor would be nice.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.145_Text: And…my stomach hurts thinking about it.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.37_Text: Another customer? Coming out of the woodwork these days, aren’t ya?
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.97_Text: Are you busy, <PlayerName>$player</>? I hear farmers are usually really busy in Spring.//Do you need help?//<portrait=concerned>I don’t think I can help, though. I’m a little busy myself. Sorry…
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.118_Text: Are you warm? Make sure to stay warm, okay?
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.234_Special: Aren’t you like a handyman or something?
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.53_Text: Argh.//<portrait=surprised>Oh, hey! Didn’t see you there.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.40_Text: Aside from <NPCName>Pablo</>, of course.//He's really, um, great.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.36_Text: Business is booming. We need more space.//Or better tools.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.47_Text: But tales start somewhere, right? There could be a sliver of truth in ’em.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.202_Text: But then again, maybe something. Shouldn’t I take that chance?
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.168_Text: Calling it a day and going to rest. I’ll continue tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.232_Text: Can’t bake cookies. My oven is broken, and I’m too lazy to fix it.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.67_Text: Do you think the explorer found the tevandium yet?
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.65_Text: Does it get tired? Does it take personal days?//<portrait=surprised>The legends are mysteriously silent on these issues.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.169_Text: Don’t slip on the way home.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.212_Text: Don’t worry about me. I’ll be fine.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.244_Text: Don’t worry, I wash this towel every day. In this heat, you gotta.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.141_Text: Dulca Island is, like, really far from here.//<portrait=normal>When we were kids, our parents would sometimes take <NPCName>Pablo</> and me there to visit our grandparents. But, um, not too often.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.129_Text: Eating something cold like cold fish or ice cream would be good right about now.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.191_Text: Errr… It’s nice to have you around.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.205_Text: Every blacksmith worth his iron knows how to make the Ironeye Hammer. The plans are passed down from master to apprentice.//The only hard part has been obtaining the tevandium.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.113_Text: Fall might be my favorite season, I guess.//I’m lucky to live here. It's easy to just go out and enjoy nature whenever I want to.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.231_Text: Family, settling down. You know the drill.//<portrait=normal>My brother talks about having a big family all the time. For me, I’m happy by myself, but who knows.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.21_Text: Favorite sushi? Umm… I like all sushi I guess.//So, um, as long as it’s fresh, any kind is fine by me.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.125_Text: For some reason, mosquitos don’t bite me. Isn’t that weird?
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.180_Text: Getting the right weapon can really help with slaying certain monsters.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.239_Text: Growing up with someone like <NPCName>Pablo</>, I started noticing things that shouldn’t be a big deal.//<portrait=concerned>Can’t help it… Just an insecurity of mine after being in his shadow my whole life.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.61_Text: Have you ever heard of the Ironeye Hammer? Legend says it’s a magic hammer that forges things by itself!
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.43_Text: Have you heard the legends about magic on this island?//<portrait=annoyed>Bunch of silly hand-waving and mumbling, if you ask me.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.30_Text: Having a big empty place in the middle of nowhere sounds great, to be honest.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.132_Text: Heh heh… What? You look happy today.//It kind of makes me happy to see.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.52_Text: Hillside is a nice place to live. Just far enough from the town.//The woodland, though…it's a bit too close to everyone for me.//<portrait=annoyed>Whatever, though.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.44_Text: Hopefully, I’m wrong… ’Cause that would be really cool.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.144_Text: Hot-air balloon rides kind of scare me. But, um, I'd like to try someday.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.104_Text: How’s your Summer so far? Mine’s okay. I spend a lot of nights watching horror films in my room.//No, no. I don’t have a TV in my room. I have this tablet… Anyway, never mind. It’s small and not very fancy.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.83_Text: I also help out at the inn, doing odd jobs. Changing light bulbs and all that.//The twins never asked me to do anything… They don't really need my help, but I don't mind.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.126_Text: I brought some edamame for <NPCName>Valentina</> yesterday. I keep forgetting she hates it.//I hope she doesn’t hate me now.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.105_Text: I can hear the bugs singing at night outside my window.//Yeah, sure...it’s nice.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.81_Text: I can’t believe people throw out perfectly good food around here.//What a waste.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.193_Text: I carry around an iron morning star with me.//You never really know what you’ll run into on this island.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.4_Text: I don't mind, really...cleaning up the town. It's where I grew up.//This whole town is my playground, and I want to take care of it.//If you, uh, wouldn't mind helping to keep it clean, I'd appreciate it.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.13_Text: I don't really hang out at the Tavern much.//Sometimes, I go to the lake if I need to unwind.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.62_Text: I don't really, um, believe it. But just think about the time I'd save if it were true…
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.221_Text: I don’t know how to say this… I’ve never met anyone like you.//You’re…different.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.176_Text: I don’t take orders outside of the shop.//If you want to get your tools upgraded, come by the shop tomorrow, okay?
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.186_Text: I don’t usually come here, but it’s <NPCName>Pablo</>'s birthday today, so I just came out for a celebratory meal.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.219_Text: I feel, um, kinda bad saying no to people, <PlayerName>$player</>. I don’t know… I feel impolite, I guess.//I’ve heard you turn down a lot of things.//Could you, um, teach me your ways?
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.116_Text: I forgot to close my bedroom windows the other day before going to work…and my bed froze.//Well, yeah… No, it wasn’t actually frozen. It was just really cold.//<portrait=sad>Um…sorry.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.20_Text: I get it, though. It’s hard to get peace and quiet when you work next to a massive furnace all day.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.230_Text: I guess you could raise a bunch of kids in a big place like yours.//Well, if you’re into that type of thing, that is.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.9_Text: I have all these ideas for weapons, but I can’t make them just yet.//<portrait=concerned>Our current furnace isn’t up to it.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.163_Text: I have this habit of spending too much on stuff I don’t need at the fair.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.138_Text: I hope Stephen’s claw grows back real soon so he can go back to exploring the sea.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.148_Text: I hope it starts raining soon.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.69_Text: I hope it’s real. I have big plans.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.226_Text: I hope you know I really like hanging out with you. I feel like I can finally be myself around you.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.99_Text: I just want to stay outside all day…get some fresh air.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.195_Text: I know I can be a bit dull sometimes… Or I’m just not very good at this friend thing.//<portrait=normal>But please know I’m trying.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.86_Text: I know what happened, <PlayerName>$player</>. I figured it out. I sent that explorer to his doom!
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.50_Text: I like making weapons more than upgrading tools.//<portrait=happy>We don't have a lot of resources for making weapons, but that's not gonna, um, stop me.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.19_Text: I like peace and quiet.//<portrait=surprised>Oh, you too? Well, we’re kind of the same, then. Is that why you moved onto your grandparents’ farm?
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.121_Text: I like the cold wind. It feels good against my face after a whole day in front of the hot furnace.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.137_Text: I like the cold wind. It feels good against my face after a whole day in front of the hot furnace.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.143_Text: I like the cold wind. It feels nice against my face after spending all day near the hot furnace.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.249_Text: I like this jacket. It’s nice and warm.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.45_Text: I love creating weapons. One day, I hope to make something truly special.//Something that, um, people will remember me for.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.229_Text: I made a mace for the shop last week. It’s one of my best ones so far. Want to give it a swing?
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.8_Text: I mean, it's not bad, um, but a little upgrade wouldn't hurt, you know.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.196_Text: I might get new swimming trunks from <NPCName>Antonio’s</> shop.//<portrait=annoyed>Things are just so expensive there, though.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.182_Text: I need to go back to work.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.187_Text: I never noticed how loud it is in here. Wow!
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.100_Text: I rented this horror film yesterday. <Italic>Alakazam</> – a classic, I think. I watch it every Summer.//<portrait=annoyed>Anyway, I haven’t had a chance to watch it. I think I’m gonna need to pay late fees again.*sighs*
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.245_Text: I saw <NpcName>Lily</> near the lake last week.//I see her there often, and usually she’s all alone. I hope things are okay with her.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.188_Text: I should go home soon. I feel exhausted.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.223_Text: I should just fish and make sashimi for dinner tonight.//<portrait=normal>I’m starving! I could eat a giant bowl of it.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.77_Text: I smelt ore all day sometimes. *sighs* So, please don’t mind my dirty clothes.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.31_Text: I still have work to do, so I can’t go to the inn today.//I usually visit my niece there on Sundays. Get to see the twins, too.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.115_Text: I think I have the ingredients to make ramen tonight.//Gonna eat it in my room and watch funny videos on my tablet.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.225_Text: I think I overworked myself yesterday.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.48_Text: I tried carpentry, but it’s not for me.//I can handle small things or maybe fix a cabinet, but a whole house is too much.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.39_Text: I use my forge, my bellows, and my own two hands.//Sometimes, though, I wish I had a little extra help.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.228_Text: I want to make sure you get what you need.//<portrait=normal>It’s very important to me.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.200_Text: I was going to keep the katana, but the offer was too good. Oh well.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.98_Text: I wish Winter could be longer, but new horror films are usually released in Fall… So, that’s something to look forward to.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.68_Text: I wonder if it’s real. Tevandium, I mean.//The explorer said he’d seen it, but if it’s mythical, who knows what he really saw?
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.112_Text: I wonder what Beluga Bay will be showing at this year’s Harvest Festival…
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.109_Text: I wonder what horror films are coming out this Fall.//I like the ones with jump scares. Just nice classic horror films with ghosts.//<portrait=concerned>Um…
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.70_Text: I would have expected the explorer to be back with the tevandium by now. I hope he’s okay.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.127_Text: I would probably fish if I didn’t have to keep my parents’ shop open.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.122_Text: I'm bringing some fish to the potluck. Not really into vegetables.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.96_Text: I'm glad to see the birds out and about, but sometimes I wish they'd quiet down a little. Just a little.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.131_Text: I, um, need to go to the clinic this week… For, um, personal matters.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.203_Text: If I can’t forge the Ironeye Hammer, I suppose I could sell the tevandium. Recoup some of my losses…
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.92_Text: If I can’t remove them, I’m wondering if I could just go ahead and make the Ironeye Hammer anyway.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.117_Text: If I get too hot, I just step outside and let the Winter air cool me down.//I can do that now…because it’s Winter.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.201_Text: If I make the Ironeye Hammer without pure tevandium, I’m not sure what will happen.//Probably nothing.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.227_Text: If there’s something I don’t do enough, just let me know, okay?//<portrait=confused>I’m too scared to bother you sometimes, so I like to keep my distance.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.57_Text: If we didn't stick to a schedule, we'd end up working all the time. That's not, um, healthy…
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.181_Text: In my downtime, I sometimes mine for ore in the cavern to make weapons.//You can always count on our store if you need ore right away.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.185_Text: It feels good to be outside every once in a while.//<portrait=normal>The shop is way too hot sometimes.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.247_Text: It feels weird, putting on a dress shirt, a jacket, and the whole shebang, but <NpcName>Antonio</> said it’s the style nowadays, so…//<portrait=happy>Mom said it makes me look fancy.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.173_Text: It was probably <NPCName>Alice</>'s.//<portrait=normal>That girl is out of this world with her theories.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.6_Text: It's been just mushrooms for a while, and I'm, uh, getting a bit tired of them... Yuck.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.78_Text: It's easy to lose track of time. Smelting ore is such a, um...mundane job.//My body kind of goes into autopilot.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.66_Text: It’s been a couple days since my explorer friend left to find tevandium. I can’t wait until he comes back!
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.215_Text: It’s hard to sleep when <NPCName>Emma</> has private events at her food truck.//They usually last past midnight, and the music is a bit loud.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.194_Text: It’s my own handmade weapon, of course. It does great damage, and I’m quite proud.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.111_Text: It’s still a bit too warm to spend all day in front of the furnace.//<portrait=normal>But at least the wind feels pretty nice.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.64_Text: I’d be a fool to put my trust in the Ironeye Hammer.//It works by itself, but the legends don’t say whether it’s a good worker.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.235_Special: I’d let you use my oven if I had one. Sorry!
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.147_Text: I’m afraid I might say the wrong thing and ruin people’s dinner.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.184_Text: I’m going back to work after this.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.216_Text: I’m happy she gets extra income, but I secretly hope she doesn’t do it too often.//Does that make me a bad friend?
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.170_Text: I’m just cleaning up a bit of moss on the stones.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.146_Text: I’m kind of nervous about <NPCName>Bree</>'s dinner party tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.108_Text: I’m looking forward to <NPCName>Betty’s</> homemade mooncakes. They’re always the highlight of Fall for me.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.94_Text: I’m looking forward to the hot pot at the Cherry Blossom Festival.//<portrait=annoyed>Not looking forward to fishing the vegetables out of my portion, though…
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.134_Text: I’m not doing anything special today. It’s just another Thursday for me. What about you?
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.135_Text: I’m not doing anything special today. It’s just another Thursday for me. What about you?
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.136_Text: I’m not doing anything special today. It’s just another Thursday for me. What about you?
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.91_Text: I’m still having a hard time removing the impurities from the tevandium.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.89_Text: I’m sure that explorer will be back with my tevandium any day now.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.158_Text: I’m sure your cabin will be fine, though. Don’t worry.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.82_Text: I’m visiting my niece tomorrow. It’s a good time to go to the beach, isn’t it?
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.199_Text: I’ve only seen a blue goblin katana twice. I’m pretty sure <NPCName>Kira</> has one, and we sold one a long time ago.//<portrait=happy>That was pretty cool.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.84_Text: Lately, I feel like I'm not all there. Need to snap out of it.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.60_Text: Legend has it you can make some really incredible stuff with the right ore.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.106_Text: Maybe I can get some ceiling fans installed for next Summer.//<portrait=annoyed>All I do is fan myself in bed with old newspapers… Makes me feel like a salmon being smoked.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.211_Text: Maybe I can, um, come with you when you go to the cavern sometime.//<portrait=blushing>I can protect you, and you can mine in peace.//That way, you won’t get injured.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.33_Text: Maybe I could live there full time and walk to work.//<portrait=surprised>But it would be a waste of money.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.85_Text: Maybe I need a vacation. Get away from the forge for a bit.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.5_Text: Maybe I should start gardening. I've been relying a bit too much on foraging lately.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.74_Text: Maybe I shouldn’t have paid half up front.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.14_Text: My brother and I can upgrade all kinds of tools.//You just need to bring us the ore.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.246_Text: My cousin, <NpcName>Antonio</>, hooked me up with this jacket.//<portrait=normal>It’s hard to do my job in it, but the fabric feels really nice.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.2_Text: My name is <NPCName>Rafael</>.//<portrait=concerned>Umm…//<portrait=normal>I’m one of the blacksmiths here in Starlet Town.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.140_Text: My parents aren’t originally from Coral Island.// They sort of, um, arrived here from Dulca Island when they were young. They came with two of my uncles.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.41_Text: My work keeps me so busy. I sometimes wish...
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.238_Text: No, I’m not teasing you. But it was probably just the wind or something.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.42_Text: No. No more, um, wishing. Want something? You work for it.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.236_Special: Oh no! Hopefully, it’ll get fixed soon.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.155_Text: Oh no! I need to dry off my boots. Mud everywhere!
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.28_Text: Oh no, I haven’t had time to visit the cemetery.//<portrait=normal>Maybe next Monday.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.139_Text: Oh! Umm, Stephen is <NPCName>Macy’s</> adopted lobster.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.220_Text: Oh, uh… I didn’t mean it that way.//<portrait=blushing>I meant… You’re an honest person, and I can learn a lot from you.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.183_Text: Oh, umm… I came here for some tacos.//I’m not in the mood to cook anything.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.210_Text: Oh… Umm… Yeah, of course I care.//I care about you…a lot.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.208_Text: Oh… Umm… Yeah, of course I care.//You’re my friend.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.27_Text: Okay, maybe trying out a new weapon.//<portrait=happy>That can get the heart beating, too.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.10_Text: Once we upgrade the furnace, hopefully, we can make more advanced weapons and tools.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.7_Text: Our shop hasn't changed since Mom and Dad retired.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.110_Text: Planning to spend the weekend nights watching Fall films with, um, ghosts…//Even better if they're ghosts from folk tales. What are you, um, gonna do?
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.240_Text: Probably for the best, though. Too much attention wrecks me, anyway.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.90_Text: Purifying the tevandium will be hard, <PlayerName>$player</>. I’m not even sure I can do it. But I have to try!
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.198_Text: She doesn’t show them around, but I think she’ll give you some pieces if you help her with the monsters.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.59_Text: She’s the daughter of my cousin, <NPCName>Antonio</>.//Yeah, she calls me and <NPCName>Pablo</> uncle, even though we’re not her dad’s actual brothers. It’s kind of a thing in our family… I don’t know.//It’s not weird for me…
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.172_Text: Some of the books here are very odd.//<portrait=annoyed>I think I read something about a flying dog one time.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.171_Text: Sometimes, I come here to read a book. It’s nice and quiet.//<portrait=normal>What are you, um, doing here?
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.103_Text: Sorry I’m such a bummer, <PlayerName>$player</>. I think it’s just the Summer heat… I hope.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.93_Text: Summer feels a bit too much for me. I, um, prefer Winter.//<portrait=concerned>Uh…or maybe Fall.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.192_Text: Thanks for always checking up on me.//You’re a good friend.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.128_Text: That would be a very different life for me.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.87_Text: That’s the only explanation for why he hasn’t come back. What a fool I’ve been!
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.72_Text: The Greatstone Amulet, the Firestarter’s Axe… This could change the entire shop.//<portrait=happy>The entire island!
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.204_Text: The Ironeye Hammer is supposed to talk to you while it works.//Should I give it a mouth? Does it matter?
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.71_Text: The Ironeye Hammer isn’t the only tool you can make with tevandium. Just the most famous.//<portrait=happy>I can’t help but let my mind wander.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.32_Text: The air is different at the beach. It’s saltier.//<portrait=annoyed>And a bit sticky.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.17_Text: The cemetery is so quiet. And the lake too.//It’s a great place to read horror novels.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.95_Text: The cherry blossoms are looking really nice this year.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.243_Text: The hot spring is too hot for me in Summer. I avoid it. But now that it's nice and cold...
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.241_Text: The lake must be relaxing on a Spring day like this.//I might check it out later.//<portrait=annoyed>No, no. Maybe tomorrow. Yeah!
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.130_Text: The majority of the trash here drifted in from the sea. Can you imagine what it’s like where this trash came from?
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.161_Text: The rain is relaxing, isn’t it?
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.150_Text: The rain makes for some relaxing white noise in the background, don’t you think?
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.153_Text: The rain makes for some relaxing white noise in the background, don’t you think?
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.166_Text: The snow helps me build up a resistance to cold weather.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.149_Text: The walking path could do with a good rinse.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.51_Text: There are some weapons I made that I can't sell, they didn't pass the safety test.//<portrait=happy>Maybe, um, I could show them to you sometime.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.46_Text: There’s more ore than what you find down in the cavern. Some impressive stuff.//Some might call it, um, mythical…//<portrait=annoyed>Most of it probably just old tales, though.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.26_Text: There’s nothing I like more than a good horror movie.//It keeps you on the edge of your seat.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.164_Text: They make a stop here every year before going down south.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.119_Text: This Winter is a little dry.//My hands hurt if I wash them too much. But it’s nothing unbearable. It’s okay…
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.133_Text: Today is the last day of Summer, yet the heat doesn’t want to let up.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.152_Text: Um, I feel a bit weird talking here.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.217_Text: Um, are you okay? I'm not, um, making you uncomfortable, am I?//What is it?
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.12_Text: Umm… After work, I usually just cook dinner or something. I don’t know…//<portrait=sad>Did that answer your question?
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.218_Text: Umm… I could come over and cook for you. That might help a little.//<portrait=blushing>Or if you need anything else…I’d be up for that too.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.123_Text: Umm… I meant for the Cherry Blossom Festival.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.162_Text: Walking's a bit tough when it's raining, though.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.76_Text: We don't have any other siblings...just us two.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.3_Text: We get a lot of work from the town.//You know, like, um, setting up decorations and stuff.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.23_Text: We get our ore from the cavern. The one north of the forest.//If you don’t see the ore you need, um, maybe keep digging?
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.224_Text: We got plenty of salmon the other day!//I might make sashimi for dinner tonight. Yummy!
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.16_Text: We only accept money as payment. Sorry.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.56_Text: We're open pretty much every day, but the store closes early tomorrow.//<portrait=happy>And we’re closed on Sundays.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.207_Text: Wear your armor, <PlayerName>$player</>. It really helps with combat.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.209_Text: Wear your armor, <PlayerName>$player</>. It really helps with combat.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.34_Text: We’re closed today. The store also closes early on Saturdays.//It's our family day.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.242_Text: We’re welcoming Spring soon.//I think I’ll bring some mushrooms to the potluck. We have plenty in the chest.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.38_Text: What can I do for you?
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.73_Text: What if the explorer decided to keep all the tevandium for himself?//I just realized he never told me where the cave was, exactly…
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.178_Text: When <NPCName>Pablo</> tells jokes, my parents laugh harder, you know… Simple stuff like that.//<portrait=concerned>People don’t notice, but I do.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.24_Text: When you upgrade your tools, they’ll change color a bit.//It depends on the material.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.120_Text: Winter coats are, um, hard to wash. They're very thick. Take ages to dry.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.142_Text: Winter is a great time to upgrade your tools. You'd be ready for a busy Spring then.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.114_Text: Winter is nice… I like it.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.101_Text: Working in front of the furnace in Summer is…intense. //I can handle it in other seasons, but Summer is just too much.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.236_Text: Yeah, I know. Oh well. No big deal.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.80_Text: Yeah, sure, I could see myself as a farmer.//Didn't we talk about this already?
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.18_Text: Yes, um, I do read other books too.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.124_Text: You can actually turn canola into oil with an oil maker.//Um, I don’t think you can buy oil makers, but once you have the blueprint, making one is pretty simple.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.177_Text: You can always tell when my brother walks into a room.//Any room, really… Conversations seem to get livelier, don’t they?
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.233_Special: You can bake cookies at my house. We could watch TV and eat them together.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.54_Text: You can check out our shop if you need some new weapons. I make most of them myself.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.167_Text: You can find all sorts of shiny things in the cavern.//If you dig deep enough, there are plenty of diamonds and stuff. Just watch out for those scary bugs, okay?
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.35_Text: You can sell metal bars, and they go for more than raw ore.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.22_Text: You fish a lot, don’t you? You must eat a lot of fish.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.79_Text: You know, my parents used to be farmers, like you. They said you gotta be strong to do it.//Kudos to you.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.88_Text: You want something done, do it yourself.//I should have just paid him to tell me the location of the ore, instead of making him get it for me.
DT_Dialogue_Rafael_Production.222_Text: You’re kinda funny… Always with the smart comebacks.

DT_Dialogue_Raina_Production.4_Text: Are you looking for something in particular?
DT_Dialogue_Raina_Production.13_Text: Every Friday, we’re allowed to wear casual clothing, like jeans.//Nobody does, but it shows how casual the work environment is here.
DT_Dialogue_Raina_Production.1_Text: Good day. How may I help you?
DT_Dialogue_Raina_Production.9_Text: I can’t remember the last time I used my paid time off.//<portrait=happy>I don’t need it. I just need to work and work and work.
DT_Dialogue_Raina_Production.8_Text: I love working at Pufferfish.//We’re all family here.
DT_Dialogue_Raina_Production.14_Text: If I dedicate all my time to work, Pufferfish will reward me for it.//The company cares so much about our well-being.
DT_Dialogue_Raina_Production.18_Text: I’m looking forward to your joining our corporation one day.
DT_Dialogue_Raina_Production.3_Text: I’ve seen all the wonderful things Pufferfish has done for communities.//<portrait=normal>I believe you can see the results of those projects in the meeting room behind me.
DT_Dialogue_Raina_Production.7_Text: Our posters aren’t for sale.//<portrait=surprised>If you wish to purchase one, I can pass on your interest. We’ll get back to you if anything changes.
DT_Dialogue_Raina_Production.5_Text: Over to my right is our employee working area. Behind me is the manager’s office, currently occupied by our branch manager, <NPCName>Karen</>.
DT_Dialogue_Raina_Production.2_Text: Please don’t hesitate to ask for my assistance whenever you’re in Pufferfish Corporation’s Coral Island office.
DT_Dialogue_Raina_Production.12_Text: Pufferfish is the perfect place to kickstart your career in the oil industry.
DT_Dialogue_Raina_Production.15_Text: The area downstairs is for employees only.//You can’t go there. I’m sorry.
DT_Dialogue_Raina_Production.6_Text: The results of some of our past projects are on display in the meeting area. Feel free to look around!
DT_Dialogue_Raina_Production.10_Text: The temperature here is the same all year long.//It’s perfect.
DT_Dialogue_Raina_Production.17_Text: We don’t encourage music here.//<portrait=normal>Distractions of any kind are prohibited.
DT_Dialogue_Raina_Production.11_Text: We have big windows in our break room.//So it feels like you’re outside, but you’re not.
DT_Dialogue_Raina_Production.19_Text: Welcome to Pufferfish Corp. How may I assist you today?
DT_Dialogue_Raina_Production.16_Text: We’re not allowed to receive any gifts here.//<portrait=happy>If you want to show your appreciation to Pufferfish Corp, I suggest sending it directly to our main office.

DT_Dialogue_Raj_Production.E23C3E5F47A693985C3FE6A8FE547C5A: Did you see the sunrise this morning? Just bursting with color!
DT_Dialogue_Raj_Production.0CDFF7764B8821FE044AA8BD5CCC6C58: Do you like dinner parties, friend?//<portrait=normal>I can’t think of a better way to spend a cold night like this. Fine coffee, delicious food, warm convos. Hmm…

DT_Dialogue_Raj_Production.96E3BEC34E7CCEBC0EE3FB80215210FD: Have you seen the daisies? I’m so tempted to put some in my beard!

DT_Dialogue_Raj_Production.BA8A74B742B60EEF55FE87915D5083A8: Hello! I don’t think I’ve seen you before. Are you new in town?
DT_Dialogue_Raj_Production.155_Text: Hopefully, tomorrow’s weather will be as clear as today’s.//I’m planning to have my coffee by the creek in Garden Lane.
DT_Dialogue_Raj_Production.C3A1B0044728286E3EF28D905511A23B: Hopefully, tomorrow’s weather will be as clear as today’s.//I’m planning to have my coffee by the creek in Garden Lane.

DT_Dialogue_Raj_Production.2870596F4CCBE669F0292196E0CFF718: How much do you think it costs to run this place for a year? It can’t be cheap.
