DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.264_Text: <NPCName>Millie</> and I have actually been close friends for a long time.//She always lets me check out more books than I’m supposed to.//<portrait=happy>That’s the only rule I ever break!
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.80_Text: <NPCName>Sam’s</> stock of carrots is low.//Ah, no. I’m hoping to add them to my Spring frittata.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.38_Text: A lot of judgment comes from fear and ignorance.//If I teach the kids diversity, hopefully, it’ll open up our world to them a little bit.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.110_Text: Ah, that reminds me. I need to get my flu shot as soon as possible.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.2_Text: Ah, yes. <PlayerName>$player</>! It’s nice to meet you.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.64_Text: An impossible task, however. It’s easy to get carried away in front of the TV right after work.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.336_Text: An outdoor dancing day might be fun for the kids.//What do you think?
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.95_Text: And maybe in Fall, I can touch on diverse festivals around the world and how different parts of the world celebrate harvest festivals.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.266_Text: And unlike blueberries, strawberries are botanically not berries!//<portrait=normal>It’s because strawberries come from a flower that has many ovaries.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.118_Text: As long as we’re careful, a little rain shouldn’t stop us from carrying on with our day.//<portrait=normal>Dress appropriately, though.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.119_Text: As long as we’re careful, a little rain shouldn’t stop us from carrying on with our day.//<portrait=normal>Dress appropriately, though.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.120_Text: As long as we’re careful, a little storm shouldn’t stop us.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.242_Text: As much as I’d love to talk with you, you caught me on my way home. Let’s chat another time when I’m warmer.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.331_Text: Back when <NPCName>Leah</> was little, I used to bring her here and let her wander for hours.//We’d pick out our favorite books and read together.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.56_Text: Bananas are technically berries, because they come from flowers that have a single ovary.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.58_Text: Bananas are technically berries, because they come from flowers that have a single ovary.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.114_Text: Being a farmer must be relaxing. You get to be outdoors most of the day.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.116_Text: Being a farmer must be relaxing. You get to be outdoors most of the day.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.76_Text: Being a farmer must be relaxing. You get to be outdoors most of the day.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.85_Text: Being a farmer must be relaxing. You get to be outdoors most of the day.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.307_Text: Between you and me, I’m worried about <NPCName>Leah</>.//She’s been growing more distant and distracted lately.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.175_Text: Bless your heart. Go sit down and have a nice cup of coffee. It’ll perk you right back up, I promise!
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.190_Text: Bless your heart. Go sit down and have a nice cup of coffee. It’ll perk you right back up, I promise!
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.271_Text: Botanically, an ovary is a reproductive organ that later ripens into a fruit.//Isn’t that interesting?
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.303_Text: But I’m getting the cold shoulder. I kept my mouth shut.//I don’t want to trash her image in our daughter’s eyes.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.115_Text: But not today, right? With the rain pouring down like this.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.117_Text: But not today, right? With the rain pouring down like this.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.198_Text: Buying books and actually reading them are two different activities, I’ve learned.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.251_Text: By golly, if those kids are pranking me again…
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.247_Text: Can you feel yourself getting smarter and more thoughtful?
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.223_Text: Can you imagine what life would be like if it could rain indoors?//It’d be the darndest thing.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.277_Text: Can’t force someone to stay, <PlayerName>$player</>.//But when her mother would leave, <NPCName>Leah</> would always get so upset on the first night, and she’d lose sleep over it.//Broke my heart every time.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.133_Text: Carrots add that extra crunch to a salad.//My favorite thing to do with them is add them to Spring frittata.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.328_Text: Do you come here a lot? I can see someone like you visiting this place quite a bit.//Bright, cheerful, full of energy. What a life to live.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.313_Text: Do you ever listen to anything while you read? Sometimes I like to put on soft ocean sounds in the background.//<portrait=normal>Sometimes, it makes me so relaxed I fall asleep!
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.326_Text: Do you think you’d ever become a teacher? I could see you doing it.//You’re patient and a good listener.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.269_Text: Don’t worry about my arm. I’m afraid there’s no shocking story behind it.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.124_Text: Even without a set time, the kids are pretty consistent about arriving before 9 am, and we’re usually done before 4 pm.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.324_Text: Every kid learns differently. You just need to take your time with them.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.309_Text: Every once in a while, I wonder what my ex is doing. <NPCName>Leah</> reminds me of her sometimes.//I just hope she’s happy.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.318_Text: Every once in a while, I’ll bring my class a little treat for behaving well.//<portrait=normal>Remind me next time, and I’ll save a little something for you too!
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.274_Text: Extra books and project costs add up. They can be expensive.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.102_Text: Fall must be a busy time for farmers. What are you most excited about this season?
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.152_Text: Feel free to join me whenever it strikes your fancy. I’m always happy to have someone to talk about Dolstoy with.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.177_Text: Feel free to join me whenever it strikes your fancy. I’m always happy to have someone to talk about Dolstoy with.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.97_Text: For the youth, that is. The air is too humid for me. I can’t stand it. I’d rather stay indoors.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.54_Text: Further, farther… Hmm. Actually, an easy way to remember is “farther” has the word “far” in it, so it’s for distance.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.66_Text: Further, farther… Hmm. Actually, an easy way to remember is “farther” has the word “far” in it, so it’s for distance.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.157_Text: Have you been up to the mansion yet? If not, you should really take a look. <NPCName>Ling</> and I keep the most wonderful library inside.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.182_Text: Have you been up to the mansion yet?//If not, you should really take a look. <NPCName>Ling</> and I keep the most wonderful library inside.//It’s on the second floor of the house, in my office.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.317_Text: Have you ever thought about teaching in Starlet Town?//We’d love to have you! If all that farming business doesn’t work out, I mean.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.28_Text: Have you ever tried?//<portrait=normal>Don’t write it off until you give it a go, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.262_Text: Have you seen all the books they have here?//It’s enough to make my poor old heart sing with joy.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.142_Text: Her mother and I got together too young.//We both grew.//Neither of us was the same person when we parted ways.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.49_Text: Hmm… Listen to this idea. Weekend meals will be only fresh vegetables and fruits.//What do you think?
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.107_Text: Hopefully, they’ll get to display theirs tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.168_Text: How’s life on the farm going, <PlayerName>$player</>? Any new plotlines in your life?
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.37_Text: I also hope they’ll teach future generations to be open minded.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.41_Text: I also hope they’ll teach future generations to be open minded.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.325_Text: I always make sure to include a unit on farming in my lesson plans.//<portrait=happy>Maybe we should get you in here to teach that one, <PlayerName>$player</>!
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.146_Text: I always see <NPCName>Millie</> working here. She rarely leaves her area…//She’s very focused.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.263_Text: I always take my class on a yearly field trip to the library.//It helps show them it’s a fun, useful place, even if they can just look everything up online.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.143_Text: I can mostly do everything myself, but it’s nice to have some help.//Who’s better at knowing where to find reading material than <NPCName>Ms. Millie</> herself?
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.258_Text: I can’t believe how beautiful this town has become.//It seems like only yesterday it was a tiny little place in the middle of nowhere.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.164_Text: I can’t wait to teach the kids about <Italic>The Mediocre Gatsby</> and <Italic>The Color Violet</>. They’re not quite old enough to read those, but they’ll be there eventually.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.162_Text: I could see <NPCName>Valentina</> as the protagonist of a book.//She’s sharp as a tack – the best in her class, actually.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.178_Text: I could see <NPCName>Valentina</> as the protagonist of a book.//She’s sharp as a tack – the best in her class, actually.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.339_Text: I could stop by the hot spring to warm up tonight.//Is the hot spring working? Do you happen to know?
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.199_Text: I do a unit on conservation and the environment every year for my class.//The kids are too young to understand the scientific details behind it, but if I can get them to recognize throwing trash in the ocean is bad, I’ve done my job.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.169_Text: I do all the curriculum design for Starlet Town Elementary.//Everyone has a strong opinion about what they want their kids to learn.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.335_Text: I don’t like wearing shorts.//Having to work outdoors often in Summer, mosquito bites are a concern for me.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.194_Text: I don’t mean literally writing.//Everyone writes a story simply by living.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.285_Text: I don’t mean we should have stayed together. No, that part was over long before we separated. I don’t regret that.//I regret the toll it took on <NPCName>Leah</>.//<portrait=concerned>With the fights. With the yelling. She’s become even more estranged from her mother now.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.238_Text: I don’t mind that one bit, but I’ll definitely be tired tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.237_Text: I don’t think I’ll be able to sleep tonight in weather like this.//Looks like another long night of reading.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.332_Text: I don’t think she misses those days as much as I do.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.302_Text: I don’t want to disturb <NPCName>Leah</> with this, but I’ve been reaching out to her mother.//Trying to build a relationship, for<NPCName>Leah’s</> sake.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.297_Text: I feel worn out, and it’s only Wednesday.//One of those days, I think.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.209_Text: I get the feeling this year’s harvest will be a bountiful one.//Thinking about all the concoctions I’ll be eating soon makes my mouth water!
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.147_Text: I have to check out the museum and see if they’ve added more artifacts.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.298_Text: I have to visit my friends at the shack soon. It’s been so long since I’ve caught up with them.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.187_Text: I hear she has quite the following on social media, too.//Her mother and I always knew she’d be an artist.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.293_Text: I hope you feel the same way about your decision to move here.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.234_Text: I hope your work is over soon, <PlayerName>$player</>.//These sorts of storms were made for curling up at home, not running around outside like a headless chicken.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.287_Text: I know how hard it’s been for <NPCName>Leah</>…my divorce.//I hope someday she can forgive me.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.87_Text: I leave for work a little early to enjoy the Summer sun.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.236_Text: I like falling asleep to the sound of rain, but this is a little too much.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.126_Text: I like to achieve something every day, even if it’s just a little bit.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.63_Text: I like to head home after school on the weekdays. Mostly because I prefer to prepare for my next class as soon as possible. That way, I don’t have to think about it during all my time off.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.127_Text: I lock up at night and on the weekends.//Basically, whenever we aren’t here.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.171_Text: I love spending my evenings with <NPCName>Ling</>. The two of us sit by the fire and talk about what we learned that day or what new discoveries she made in her work.//<portrait=normal>I don’t see how life could get better than this.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.188_Text: I made the mistake of reading past my bedtime last night.//As fun as it was, these aging bones can’t handle late nights like they used to.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.333_Text: I make sure the kids play outside as much as I can. Being outside is good for both mental and physical health.//Especially now the snow has melted.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.71_Text: I might go to the vineyard tomorrow…
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.23_Text: I need to return a book to the library tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.158_Text: I promise it’s not nearly as fancy as the name implies.//That’s just what the folks around here have always called it.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.183_Text: I promise it’s not nearly as fancy as the name implies.//That’s just what the folks around here have always called it.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.203_Text: I saw <NPCName>Leah</> taking some very artsy photos of flowers the other day.//It made me happy someone is preserving and sharing the island’s beauty.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.227_Text: I saw <NPCName>Suki</> running in the rain earlier.//How does she do it? There’s no way on this green earth I could motivate myself to get wet and sweaty.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.44_Text: I should extend my weekend walks sometimes.//<portrait=normal>It would be a good habit.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.46_Text: I should extend my weekend walks sometimes.//<portrait=normal>It would be a good habit.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.50_Text: I should extend my weekend walks sometimes.//<portrait=normal>It would be a good habit.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.296_Text: I simply can’t ask for more. My heart is full.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.283_Text: I started chatting with <NPCName>Suki</> about <NPCName>Valentina</> to keep her updated on <NPCName>Valentina’s</> progress more closely.//<portrait=normal>And the next thing I knew, she mailed me a recipe for her secret green smoothies. Generous, isn’t it?
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.75_Text: I still have some extra time this weekend. So I think I’ll make some dessert to take to class tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.21_Text: I take a book and a light lunch to Hillside. You know, the vineyard.//It’s easy to lose track of time there.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.308_Text: I talk to her, but she never says anything to me. It’s just “Yes, Dad” this and “No, Dad” that.//It’s probably been years since we’ve had a real conversation.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.220_Text: I think <NPCName>Valentina</> said she wanted to play volleyball tonight.//Looks like that’s not going to work out in this weather.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.212_Text: I try to have a hot mug of tea and a blanket ready for her when she gets home from work.//It’s the least I can do.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.108_Text: I urge the kids to keep active during Winter. Hopefully, we can keep them healthy the whole season.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.340_Text: I used <NPCName>Leah’s</> hand cream this morning. I ran out of mine. And my hands smelled like coconut the whole day.//Strong scent, that one.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.53_Text: I usually pay out of my own pocket, yeah. But sometimes, we do get parents who donate a massive amount of supplies to the school. It helps us a lot.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.170_Text: I usually stick to the tried-and-true.//<portrait=normal>If it worked for me, it’ll work for them!
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.305_Text: I walked here this morning, and my feet are aching. If you think about it, it isn’t that far!
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.270_Text: I was born with only a partial left arm.//Science has come so far since that day, and I’m grateful to have this arm.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.141_Text: I wish <NPCName>Leah</> and I could spend more time together, like we did when she was younger. But she has other interests these days.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.31_Text: I wish I could convince the governor to give us more funding.//But it’s already a struggle for them to keep the school running.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.33_Text: I wish I could convince the governor to give us more funding.//But it’s already a struggle for them to keep the school running.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.161_Text: I wish I could stay and chat, <PlayerName>$player</>, but I’ve got a few tests to grade.//Let’s take it easy over some coffee another day.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.284_Text: I wish things with <NPCName>Leah’s</> mom had been better.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.311_Text: I wonder if <NPCName>Leah</> would be interested in visiting her mom sometime soon.//I hear she’s in town for an art show not too far from here.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.300_Text: I won’t say no to a fishing trip, though. I just can’t go too long while school’s open.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.230_Text: If I’m not careful, my tie’s going to blow away out here.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.217_Text: If it keeps raining like this, the kids won’t be having recess anytime soon.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.173_Text: If people knew it was against the law to litter, maybe they’d think twice about it.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.192_Text: If people knew it was against the law to litter, maybe they’d think twice about it.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.295_Text: If she ever decided to live abroad like her mother, I’d support her 100 percent.//I know I wouldn’t lose her. She’d keep me in the loop. She wants me in her life.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.291_Text: If you think you need to do something, you may need to “green-light” yourself, as long as it doesn’t hurt others.//No point in waiting around.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.160_Text: If your coffee is thick and strong, you can do no wrong!
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.151_Text: It feels like a good day to drink a glass of wine and read some Dolstoy.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.176_Text: It feels like a good day to drink a glass of wine and read some Dolstoy.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.130_Text: It may not be the worst thing. You can probably concentrate better, being away from the noise like that.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.140_Text: It must be the view.//<portrait=normal>I have a feeling even burned food would taste delicious here.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.244_Text: It must have been awful to be an old-timey author in Winter.//No central heat, having to keep a steady supply of firewood in the house…
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.113_Text: It seems like it’s been snowing less and less lately.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.48_Text: It wouldn’t be a bad idea for me to eat more simply on the weekend.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.253_Text: It’s a wonderful – and terrifying – feeling.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.204_Text: It’s almost time for my yearly library declutter!//Time to put away all the books I’ve been reading over the Winter and replace them with some brand-spanking-new titles.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.215_Text: It’s amazing to think the same water that flows through our rivers and lakes ends up in the sky as rain.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.319_Text: It’s been a rough week. I think a nice glass of red wine and some Joan Austen are on tap tonight.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.144_Text: It’s been a while since I’ve read a great series.//The last one that held my attention must have been the Peppity Witch Adventures.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.17_Text: It’s good to have opinions, and it’s important to know how to communicate them effectively.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.9_Text: It’s good to have opinions, and it’s important to know how to communicate them effectively.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.256_Text: It’s good to take breaks here and there.//It’s good for your mental health.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.77_Text: It’s hard to be confined in a room all day and not get stuffy. I tell ya…
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.86_Text: It’s hard to be confined in a room all day and not get stuffy. I tell ya…
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.137_Text: It’s hard to be upset when you’re this relaxed.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.15_Text: It’s important to stretch every hour or so, especially if we sit long hours every day.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.301_Text: I’ll always love <NPCName>Leah’s</> mother.//If it weren’t for her, I wouldn’t have <NPCName>Leah</>, after all.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.134_Text: I’m craving Spring frittata, but we have no carrots whatsoever.//<portrait=concerned>Gah!
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.322_Text: I’m glad we met, <PlayerName>$player</>.//You’re a great friend.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.292_Text: I’m happy with my life in general, with how things have…played out.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.36_Text: I’m hoping that teaching different views and values from all over the world can help the kids be open minded.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.40_Text: I’m hoping that teaching different views and values from all over the world can help the kids be open minded.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.148_Text: I’m jealous of you adventurous folk who move to the island. Wide-eyed, fresh-faced, all ready to start your hero’s journey.//What a great feeling that must be.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.294_Text: I’m looking forward to my Sunday dinner with <NPCName>Leah</>.//The food is always wonderful, but more than that, I’m more excited to find out about her week.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.299_Text: I’m not a big fisher myself. So, I usually don’t fish, unlike <NPCName>Sunny</> or the mayor.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.34_Text: I’m not convinced about adding camping trips to the curriculum.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.99_Text: I’m not my best self in Summer. I can’t think properly.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.139_Text: I’m not sure what’s in here, but I can taste the flavor all the way to my bones.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.280_Text: I’m proud we’re teaching kids about the effect trash has on the environment.//Getting the little things they can do to help to stick in their minds is tricky, but hopefully, it’s all worth it in the end.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.98_Text: I’m secretly glad Summer is over soon. I just feel so sticky all the time.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.268_Text: I’m sorry if I talk too much about plants. I get carried away easily.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.19_Text: I’m trying to get the kids to love reading.//And also to form their own opinions independent of their peers.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.7_Text: I’m trying to get the kids to love reading.//And also to form their own opinions independent of their peers.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.94_Text: I’m trying to teach relevant subjects. For instance, I’d like to teach them a thing or two about coral reefs worldwide.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.321_Text: I’ve always believed someone’s favorite book says a lot about them. What’s your favorite, <PlayerName>$player</>?//Hard question to answer, huh?
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.81_Text: I’ve been making it without carrots.//<portrait=normal>Bad decision, I tell ya! You can taste that there’s something missing.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.195_Text: I’ve been thinking about starting an after-school reading club at Starlet Town Elementary.//Do you think the kids would like that?
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.316_Text: I’ve been thinking you’re quite a fine addition to the town, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.273_Text: I’ve spent my whole life teaching youth.//It keeps you young, being around young minds all day. But it has its hardships, you know, just like any other job.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.11_Text: Kids are always watching us adults.//They’re very observant.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.3_Text: Kids are always watching us adults.//They’re very observant.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.153_Text: Like I always say, <PlayerName>$player</>, it doesn’t matter what you read, as long as you keep reading.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.184_Text: Like I always say, <PlayerName>$player</>, it doesn’t matter what you read, as long as you keep reading.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.135_Text: Living here has its perks. For one, we’re very close to <NPCName>Sam</>’s.//So whenever we run out of things, we can just pop by.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.254_Text: Look at this place.//I’m so lucky I get to work here every day.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.252_Text: Looking out into a classroom is like looking into a crystal ball.//You can see what the future holds with each and every kid in your class.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.241_Text: Looks like all the snow is starting to freeze over. Cold enough out here for ya, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.74_Text: Maybe I can start teaching some world history soon. I think the kids will be ecstatic!
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.156_Text: Maybe I should ask <NPCName>Valentina</> if she can interpret for me.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.224_Text: Maybe I should write a novel about that.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.286_Text: Maybe if I’d tried harder with her mom, she wouldn’t have left <NPCName>Leah</>.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.304_Text: Might be time for me to get new boots.//These are starting to hurt.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.216_Text: Mother Nature is a sight to behold.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.240_Text: My class challenged me to a snowball fight the other day.//Naturally, they won. I just can’t move as fast as they can.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.174_Text: My goodness, <PlayerName>$player</>! You look exhausted.//I know farming is hard, but I didn’t think it was quite that bad.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.189_Text: My goodness, <PlayerName>$player</>! You look exhausted.//I know farming is hard, but I didn’t think it was quite that bad.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.1_Text: My name is <NPCName>Randy</>. I’m an elementary school teacher. What did you say your name was?
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.42_Text: My pet peeve is when somebody says it’s too late to go to school.//What’s yours?
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.62_Text: My wife, <NPCName>Ling</>, can be a good source if you’re interested in finding out more about coral reefs. <NPCName>Betty</> is another good source.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.150_Text: Nah, I’m just pulling your leg – or maybe your arm! The kids just love that story.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.20_Text: No easy task, let me tell you. Because kids can be…//<portrait=happy>Shall I say…persistent in their opinions and in their way of convincing others.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.8_Text: No easy task, let me tell you. Because kids can be…//<portrait=happy>Shall I say…persistent in their opinions and in their way of convincing others.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.79_Text: No reason… But I thought I might teach the kids a little bit about farming.//Haven’t decided yet.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.245_Text: No wonder everyone who lived a hundred years ago was sad.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.101_Text: No, no. Not about the free mooncakes. Well, that too, probably. But they said they can’t wait to see the pumpkin booth.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.72_Text: No, not for the wine. The view from Hillside is just amazing.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.22_Text: No, not today. Tomorrow, maybe.//Going to Hillside would force me to get out of the house and walk.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.128_Text: Not afraid of crimes, no. More like wild animals.//<portrait=normal>I don’t want animals wandering into the building and destroying the classroom.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.35_Text: Not because of the kids. It’s just that we already live so close to nature, I don’t think it’s necessary.//On the other hand, it could help them bond as a team.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.289_Text: Not my thing. I stick to sports.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.278_Text: Nothing changes. Fake arm or not, I’m still doing the exact same things.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.52_Text: Now and then, I submit a big order for school and art supplies to <NPCName>Luke</>.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.10_Text: Now, the first part is easy.//<portrait=happy>The second one is a whole different lesson plan.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.18_Text: Now, the first part is easy.//<portrait=happy>The second one is a whole different lesson plan.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.229_Text: Now, this is a gale! You ought to call it a day in this type of weather, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.24_Text: Oh darn. Did I leave the book at school?
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.159_Text: Oh good. It’s almost time for another cup of coffee!//<portrait=normal>There’s just something about hot drinks that really keeps me going.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.310_Text: Oh, don’t worry about hiding that from <NPCName>Ling</>.//The two of us have talked about her before.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.207_Text: Oh, how I love Fall! Authors have sung its praises since what feels like the beginning of time. It’s the season of crisp breezes and veggies aplenty.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.261_Text: On warm nights, there’s nothing better than being here with a book, taking in the atmosphere.//It’s a right pleasant way to spend an evening.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.138_Text: One of my students lives in this area.//He lives down the road, in that house. You see?
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.181_Text: One thing that’s great about being a teacher is I always get weekends off.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.265_Text: People often think berries are just small fruits that we pick from bushes or short plants.//But avocados are in fact berries, and they grow on trees.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.166_Text: Questions don’t normally stump me, but the other day <NPCName>Ling</> asked me which author, living or dead, I would eat lunch with. I started at the wall like a nitwit for at least half an hour.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.225_Text: Rain is always a nice sound to fall asleep to. I won’t need to use my sound machine tonight.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.208_Text: Reading in front of kids sets a good example for them.//If they see you reading, they’re more likely to try it for themselves.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.279_Text: Right. Except now, I won’t start shivering if I hold a snowball too long. Hah!
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.13_Text: School is from Monday to Friday, 9 am to 4 pm.//My hope is the kids feel school is more like an informative playdate than work.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.136_Text: Second of all, it’s close to the Tavern.//<portrait=happy>You know, for the lazy nights…
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.312_Text: She can pass on my regards too.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.149_Text: So there I was, facing off with the alligator deep in the jungle. I was tired and hungry, but the gator looked hungrier.//I managed to escape…but not before he took my arm with him.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.288_Text: Some shows can get pretty out there. A zombie apocalypse, talking plants. Hmm. What else?
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.210_Text: Sometimes the Fall harvest comes a little later than usual, but all we can do is wait. There’s no rushing nature.//She knows what she’s doing.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.155_Text: Sometimes, I can’t make heads or tails of what <NPCName>Leah’s</> saying.//It’s like she’s speaking another language.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.5_Text: Sometimes, I grade tests in front of the TV, watching a game or two.//<portrait=happy>Heh heh. Only sometimes…
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.275_Text: Sometimes, I think about whether I did the right thing keeping <NPCName>Leah</> here on Coral Island. I don’t want her to feel stuck.//Just like her mother did.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.260_Text: Sometimes, I try to chase them, but they’re always faster than me. Maybe I’d be faster if I cut back on the wine.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.290_Text: Sometimes, we can’t wait around for a green light, <PlayerName>$player</>.//Taking the initiative is hard, but maybe worth it.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.201_Text: Spring always symbolizes new beginnings in literature. It’s the season of love, renewal, and growth.//<portrait=happy>Or the season of pollen, if you’re allergic.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.96_Text: Summer is the time to visit the beach.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.26_Text: Sunday is a sports day.//For me, anyway. You’re free to do what you please.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.88_Text: Suppose I’ve been going to Hillside on weekends for a while now.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.90_Text: Suppose I’ve been going to Hillside on weekends for a while now.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.92_Text: Suppose I’ve been going to Hillside on weekends for a while now.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.105_Special: Sweating less. Cooler air in general.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.105_Text: Sweating less. Cooler air in general.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.163_Text: That <NPCName>Suki</> knows what she’s doing. I need to ask about her organizational methods.//And <NPCName>Antonio</>, of course.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.179_Text: That <NPCName>Suki</> knows what she’s doing. I need to ask about her organizational methods.//And <NPCName>Antonio</>, of course.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.61_Text: That’s the plan, anyway. Sometimes I change the agenda so the kids don’t get too bored doing the same thing.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.69_Text: That’s the plan, anyway. Sometimes I change the agenda so the kids don’t get too bored doing the same thing.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.12_Text: That’s why we must model correct behavior in front of them.//You understand, I’m sure.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.4_Text: That’s why we must model correct behavior in front of them.//You understand, I’m sure.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.200_Text: The animal and plant species on Coral Island are so interesting.//I know <NPCName>Ling</> moved to the island because there are species here she couldn’t study anywhere else.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.235_Text: The crack of thunder is such a majestic sound. Unless it’s too loud, and it makes all the kids in your class jump.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.129_Text: The forest must get pretty quiet at night.//<portrait=normal>I can’t imagine living in such seclusion.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.70_Text: The kids always seem more excited on Fridays.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.83_Text: The kids and I are going to attend the Cherry Blossom Festival. I hope to see you there.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.180_Text: The kids are always hard to teach on Fridays.//They want to skip right past their lessons and go straight to the weekend.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.106_Text: The kids are excited about pumpkins too.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.100_Text: The kids are excited about the Harvest Festival.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.267_Text: The kids love to study plants.//<portrait=happy>I hope it’d be okay to take them to your farm sometime, you know, to see some seasonal plants in real life. What do you say?
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.125_Text: The kids need to finish their reading for the day before I dismiss the class.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.213_Text: The mansion gets quite drafty in Winter, so we have to plug all its cracks and keep the heat going all the time.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.315_Text: The mansion is a huge place, but when <NPCName>Leah</> is upset, it suddenly feels very, very small.//She has a way of filling up a place when she gets angry.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.45_Text: The path to the lookout through your farm is a good route.//<portrait=happy>Or better yet, I could just go back to the woodland through the forest.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.47_Text: The path to the lookout through your farm is a good route.//<portrait=happy>Or better yet, I could just go back to the woodland through the forest.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.51_Text: The path to the lookout through your farm is a good route.//<portrait=happy>Or better yet, I could just go back to the woodland through the forest.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.30_Text: The school can always use volunteers.//<portrait=concerned>We don’t have the funds to hire more teachers, unfortunately.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.32_Text: The school can always use volunteers.//<portrait=concerned>We don’t have the funds to hire more teachers, unfortunately.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.205_Text: The season of salt and sweat is upon us! I’m always grateful for every one of Coral Island’s seasons.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.337_Text: The trees look beautiful today.//When I opened the windows this morning, the color was everywhere over the lake!
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.29_Text: The youth are our future. Whether we want to admit it or not, we’re responsible for preparing them.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.122_Text: There are a couple of books here that were donated by the town’s library.//We made a deal to cycle the books every year. That way, the kids get to read new books more often.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.330_Text: There are always lessons to be learned from those who came before us.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.323_Text: There are some kids in here who are excelling, and a few who need some extra help.//That’s the same as always, though.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.132_Text: There isn’t much to showcase here. We don’t travel much.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.84_Text: There was way too much delicious food yesterday!
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.82_Text: There will be no school this Wednesday.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.123_Text: There’s no set time for school to start or end since we don’t have that many students.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.43_Text: There’s no such thing as “too late to go to school.”//The least we can do is support anyone who wants to educate themselves, not shame them.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.165_Text: There’s so much to be learned from literature.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.167_Text: There’s too many to choose from! I’d rather have a five-minute snack with ten of them than a full lunch with any one person.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.226_Text: These are the nights wine was made for. It’s one of life’s greatest pleasures.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.196_Text: They’d get to read fun stuff, but they’d also get extra reading practice.//I think it’s a win-win.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.276_Text: Things were rough during <NPCName>Leah’s</> childhood, since her mom traveled every chance she got.//But I couldn’t fault her for that. This island wasn’t for her.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.218_Text: This has turned into a bit of a chilly rain. I’d better get home soon.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.231_Text: This one’s my favorite too! I can’t let it blow away.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.214_Text: Those help a lot, but you still need a blanket if you go too far away from the main room.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.27_Text: Watching games live is a different experience.//Even if you don’t follow sports, the atmosphere is unmatched.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.259_Text: Watching kids run through the yard makes me feel young again.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.221_Text: Watching the rain run down the windows makes me feel like a wise old author.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.39_Text: We may be secluded here on Coral Island.//But I’m making sure they’re aware of the wider world.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.281_Text: We went to the beach last Summer. The whole class went.//<portrait=normal>We made sure to take our trash home from a beach day. Little things like that – they’re important.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.255_Text: Well, I didn’t quite finish grading those papers last night, but that’s okay.//I’ll just tell the kids I decided to take the night off.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.246_Text: We’re in the most quiet and contemplative environment, the snowy night.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.60_Text: We’re learning about the island on Thursdays and a little bit of science toward the end of the day.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.68_Text: We’re learning about the island on Thursdays and a little bit of science toward the end of the day.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.112_Text: We’re living in the middle of nowhere, so it can take a while to restore power after a blackout. It could be the whole day.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.228_Text: We’re two very different people.//You’ve gotta respect her discipline.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.73_Text: What a great weekend! It’s nice to stretch a little.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.239_Text: What a jolly great day! Snow has a way of making everyone feel like a kid again.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.202_Text: What a year for blooms! Spring always looks good on Coral Island, but this year seems even more spectacular than usual.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.89_Text: What can I say? I like a little structure in life.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.91_Text: What can I say? I like a little structure in life.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.93_Text: What can I say? I like a little structure in life.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.145_Text: What do you mean you’ve never heard of the Peppity Witch Adventures?!//<portrait=happy>Get out of here!
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.222_Text: What do you use to keep the rain off you? A raincoat? An umbrella?//Do you just run through it and hope for the best?//<portrait=happy>The kids like that option.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.282_Text: What is it with being friends and sharing recipes here?//I’m not complaining. I think it’s great.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.257_Text: What kind of skills does it take to be a farmer? You probably have to track your resources and be decent with money too.//I bet you have to know how to care for animals and how to deal with people when you sell your crops.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.329_Text: What sort of books are you reading right now, <PlayerName>$player</>?//I have to say I’m rather partial to the classics.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.193_Text: What sort of story do you think you’ll write while you’re on Coral Island, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.57_Text: What’s an ovary in flowers? That would be a lecture for another time.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.59_Text: What’s an ovary in flowers? That would be a lecture for another time.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.154_Text: What’s keeping your attention these days?//Adventure books? Romance novels? The funny pages in the paper?//If only newspapers were as widespread as they used to be.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.185_Text: What’s keeping your attention these days?//Adventure books? Romance novels? The funny pages in the paper?//If only newspapers were as widespread as they used to be.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.306_Text: When things are hard, I look to literature for advice.//Different books may give different answers, but they all lead somewhere good.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.55_Text: Whereas “further” is for nonliteral ideas, like when I ask you, “How much further are you going to talk about this?”
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.67_Text: Whereas “further” is for nonliteral ideas, like when I ask you, “How much further are you going to talk about this?”
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.78_Text: Will you be growing carrots this year?
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.111_Text: With the inevitable snowstorms, I just hope we don’t lose electricity.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.272_Text: Would you consider a tomato a fruit or a vegetable, <PlayerName>$player</>?//I’m asking your professional opinion, as someone who deals with these sorts of crops every day.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.14_Text: Yeah, a lot of days, huh? But I thought it would be better that way.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.232_Text: You ought to head home, <PlayerName>$player</>.//These sorts of storms are even more dangerous at night.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.233_Text: You ought to head home, <PlayerName>$player</>.//These sorts of storms are even more dangerous at night.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.250_Text: You wouldn’t happen to know where my lesson plans went, would you? I just set them down here a moment ago.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.320_Text: Your fresh fruits and veggies would make great snacks for the kids!
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.243_Text: You’d think the kids who live around here would hate snow, but they can’t get enough of it.//That really tickles me.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.327_Text: You’re also good at conflict resolution. That’s important when you’re working with kids.
DT_Dialogue_Randy_Production.249_Text: [<NPCName>Randy</> looks like he’s busy with teaching.]

DT_Dialogue_Ratih_Production.14_Text: <Italic>Whoa!</> You surprised me there.//<portrait=panic>For a second I thought you were…
DT_Dialogue_Ratih_Production.21_Text: <NPCName>Frankie</> has the same name as his dad.//Why do you think that is?
DT_Dialogue_Ratih_Production.16_Text: Do I know you? I feel like I’ve seen you before.
DT_Dialogue_Ratih_Production.5_Text: I can’t promise I’ll be here tomorrow.//Might be needed somewhere else.
DT_Dialogue_Ratih_Production.3_Text: I don’t like to leave my boat for too long.//What if I had a customer?
DT_Dialogue_Ratih_Production.6_Text: I don’t live here.//I have a family, you know.
DT_Dialogue_Ratih_Production.11_Text: I don’t sell my costumes.//Well, maybe – if you’re willing to pay a premium. Heh heh.
DT_Dialogue_Ratih_Production.20_Text: I just dropped off a delivery for <NPCName>Frankie</> there, so why not have a couple of drinks and a warm meal?
DT_Dialogue_Ratih_Production.8_Text: I might have different things to sell next time.//<portrait=happy>So check back when my store’s open.
DT_Dialogue_Ratih_Production.2_Text: It’s nice to get off the boat every now and then.//It’s certainly steadier.
DT_Dialogue_Ratih_Production.12_Text: Keep your voice down.//I don’t <Italic>technically</> have a permit to…//<portrait=surprised>Never mind.
DT_Dialogue_Ratih_Production.1_Text: Thank you for stopping by. Anything I can get you?
DT_Dialogue_Ratih_Production.19_Text: The Tavern is one of my oldest customers.//I knew their dad, <NPCName>Mr. Frankie</>//<portrait=normal>No, not the one behind the counter, the <Italic>original</> one.
DT_Dialogue_Ratih_Production.17_Text: This is my favorite place in Starlet Town.
DT_Dialogue_Ratih_Production.10_Text: Welcome! What can I get you?

DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.147_Text: *mumbling to himself* Is it <NpcName>Frank</> or Rank?//Oh well, let's just roll with it.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.FB8B4DBB45825F448CE41896B7D61DEE: *mumbling to himself* Is it <NpcName>Frank</> or Rank?//Oh well, let's just roll with it.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.122_Text: *singing* Dooo doo doo dooo doo dooooo…
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.6ECF9AFE40ECCAB43E3F9298C0425359: *singing* Dooo doo doo dooo doo dooooo…
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.246_Text: <NPCName>Charles</> hates when it storms at night. He says he’s worried something will fall on the house.//Worries too much, that one.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.9B1683F246068406FFDE8B86E4B549EC: <NPCName>Charles</> hates when it storms at night. He says he’s worried something will fall on the house.//Worries too much, that one.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.37_Text: <NpcName>Frank</> made us one of his experimental recipes last weekend.//<portrait=happy>Heh heh… Wowza! <PlayerName>$Player</>, you need to try it. Even just once.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.5E7196F944F9F2906A6080B13555093D: <NpcName>Frank</> made us one of his experimental recipes last weekend.//<portrait=happy>Heh heh… Wowza! <PlayerName>$Player</>, you need to try it. Even just once.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.052CCA2B48C515D402AC6C83AE83EFF3: A glimpse of what life was like… A quick look at how the world was hundreds of years ago.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.141_Text: A glimpse of what life was like… A quick look at how the world was hundreds of years ago.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.167_Text: A hint of saltiness that's hard to resist.//Care for a taste?
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.2CDC0C774ADF1F77EE267AA09ADB7355: A hint of saltiness that's hard to resist.//Care for a taste?
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.150_Text: A nice hot bath sounds excellent right about now.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.E2452CAC4A7CE39E0931C4BAD7501722: A nice hot bath sounds excellent right about now.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.174_Text: Ah, I didn’t get anything valuable today.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.BDC6FDEE4F29D29B9ABFAF8CCDC95137: Ah, I didn’t get anything valuable today.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.222_Text: Am I ready for Winter?//<portrait=normal>Hmm… I guess so.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.D4D64FE248361032D9B78189213A1D66: Am I ready for Winter?//<portrait=normal>Hmm… I guess so.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.145_Text: And these artifacts know things you and I will never figure out.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.76A36FC04E6E38A043305EB2E05D7C6F: And these artifacts know things you and I will never figure out.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.79_Text: Another Spring…another year begins…another birthday season for me.//Yep, my birthday’s on the 12th. Two days after the Cherry Blossom Festival.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.7B90B5D442B70A919F94ACA0F5E743E1: Another Spring…another year begins…another birthday season for me.//Yep, my birthday’s on the 12th. Two days after the Cherry Blossom Festival.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.2_Text: Anyhow, my name is <NPCName>Scott</>. Welcome to town!//Don’t be a stranger!
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.3D9A813741C097552174E5B9DB695C3D: Anyhow, my name is <NPCName>Scott</>. Welcome to town!//Don’t be a stranger!
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.270_Text: Anything that gets me moving is cool with me.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.B52DA9AC4AC636E011460185D45D3BB8: Anything that gets me moving is cool with me.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.213_Text: Are you growing anything new this year, <PlayerName>$Player</>?//A big turnip and okra salad sounds delicious right about now.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.DAE51DA749F2296A6663F6A322102A25: Are you growing anything new this year, <PlayerName>$Player</>?//A big turnip and okra salad sounds delicious right about now.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.161_Text: Are you out to go fishing too, <PlayerName>$Player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.A4F0E0614EF62A0F0111B8A79A0F3AC0: Are you out to go fishing too, <PlayerName>$Player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.155_Text: Besides, listening to <NpcName>Frank</> is better than TV.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.D194DDE14E36B1518E8F4989CF834049: Besides, listening to <NpcName>Frank</> is better than TV.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.88_Text: Better soak up the last of that Summer sun, <PlayerName>$Player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.F504180A41C99A913191AA8F69C2C4CC: Better soak up the last of that Summer sun, <PlayerName>$Player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.188_Text: Between working in the cavern and hanging out, I hardly get any time to myself these days.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.DECF622F4ADABAAE69D7C293D56463CC: Between working in the cavern and hanging out, I hardly get any time to myself these days.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.1042F5AF41E75924DF90B085710AF607: Bleh… I had some fresh veggies yesterday, and I can still taste the bitter flavor on my tongue.//<portrait=annoyed>Vegetables aren’t for me. So when I go down in the cavern, I usually just pack vitamins from the clinic.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.283_Text: Bleh… I had some fresh veggies yesterday, and I can still taste the bitter flavor on my tongue.//<portrait=annoyed>Vegetables aren’t for me. So when I go down in the cavern, I usually just pack vitamins from the clinic.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.170_Text: But I still wear armor, you know… Just in case.

DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.329_Text: Sometimes, I wish I’d been born a hundred years ago, when men still wore suits everywhere and jazz was the big thing.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.DBE2334143EBA49444921695999D9447: Sometimes, I wish I’d been born a hundred years ago, when men still wore suits everywhere and jazz was the big thing.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.01FB6388444F6E26A4C1CC802C05304C: Speaking of… You smell really nice up close, <PlayerName>$Player</>.//This is the best part about snowy days…
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.337_Text: Speaking of… You smell really nice up close, <PlayerName>$Player</>.//This is the best part about snowy days…
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.47_Text: Still looks good, though, so I’m not stressed about it.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.FE9126824BAC30DD809CCC811A27B2B5: Still looks good, though, so I’m not stressed about it.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.2509089C47D357F279191D9DEA249A1F: Strange, there was a kite just outside my window this morning.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.279_Text: Strange, there was a kite just outside my window this morning.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.0991D54B422E34FA9A9CBB97C889A1B5: Technically, I’m working today. I’m just not in the office.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.66_Text: Technically, I’m working today. I’m just not in the office.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.330_Text: Technology is cool and all, but nothing beats a good big-band show.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.C04F5C184DC462C2ABB10BA7A2A36C2C: Technology is cool and all, but nothing beats a good big-band show.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.298_Text: That’s it, <PlayerName>$Player</>! From now on, I’m taking you to all my parties.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.6368B02C4A0E33F8D3BC27855BDB4529: That’s it, <PlayerName>$Player</>! From now on, I’m taking you to all my parties.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.211_Text: The Spring rains erode the cavern a little more each year. Over time, more artifacts and gems are uncovered.//<portrait=happy>Don’t quote me on that, though. That’s just my theory!
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.D158B854484EF07EFE5C5BA499FA2812: The Spring rains erode the cavern a little more each year. Over time, more artifacts and gems are uncovered.//<portrait=happy>Don’t quote me on that, though. That’s just my theory!
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.98_Text: The air in the cavern is much warmer than outside, especially with the snow everywhere.//Rocks are great insulators. Caverns stay relatively the same temperature year round.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.A79D5E044C4503D4BC7C00BB30BDE02A: The air in the cavern is much warmer than outside, especially with the snow everywhere.//Rocks are great insulators. Caverns stay relatively the same temperature year round.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.48_Text: The cavern in the forest is surprisingly deep.//There are all kinds of things buried down there.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.E50EF3B04597D828D1BF5A9A6EB5076C: The cavern in the forest is surprisingly deep.//There are all kinds of things buried down there.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.117_Text: The cavern is wild, though. The mosquitos attack no matter what… Maybe because there are no other targets down there.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.79030A5F441EF456C1A9A693533EDE99: The cavern is wild, though. The mosquitos attack no matter what… Maybe because there are no other targets down there.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.93_Text: The ground in Fall feels a bit different from other seasons. That’s the first thing I notice, usually.//That and the leaves changing color.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.ACCD022F4B08820A49F15C8FAAF2C3A2: The ground in Fall feels a bit different from other seasons. That’s the first thing I notice, usually.//That and the leaves changing color.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.104_Text: The mayor came by the library the other day and told us a drilling corporation is moving into town.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.6B9CC200422F105365488EBA9DC9899D: The mayor came by the library the other day and told us a drilling corporation is moving into town.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.215_Text: The one thing Coral Island has over the city is beach life.//There’s nothing like blasting a cannonball right into the waves.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.CDCDB7C9484153FBEED946B08B6D6418: The one thing Coral Island has over the city is beach life.//There’s nothing like blasting a cannonball right into the waves.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.217F88644CAF5D2E22D55AA1F147551B: The rain is really coming down out there. I hope it doesn’t ruin your plans for the day.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.238_Text: The rain is really coming down out there. I hope it doesn’t ruin your plans for the day.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.323_Text: The rain makes everything feel so fresh and clean. I love the smell of wet pavement and leaves.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.ACC363E64097E1211EC8C39832BC0127: The rain makes everything feel so fresh and clean. I love the smell of wet pavement and leaves.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.250_Text: The snow makes my hair go flat.//Do you think it looks flat?//<portrait=normal>Phew! Don’t worry about yours. Your hair always looks great!
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.9374BC1B4674F09E23BEC09CA84EC594: The snow makes my hair go flat.//Do you think it looks flat?//<portrait=normal>Phew! Don’t worry about yours. Your hair always looks great!
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.317_Text: The system at the museum was down the other day. Thankfully, <NpcName>Lily</> was able to stop by and help out.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.82DC02654F1F9935DB355B8C1CEF9428: The system at the museum was down the other day. Thankfully, <NpcName>Lily</> was able to stop by and help out.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.133_Text: The thunder woke me up at two o’clock this morning!
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.A00524784F2666B8B12F76ABEA42E2A7: The thunder woke me up at two o’clock this morning!
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.349_Text: The weather is so dreary and depressing today. It’s just not my thing.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.6A8EC52E4B82BDCAB74095A26E069FBB: The weather is so dreary and depressing today. It’s just not my thing.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.0E3B6B3947968C9844DDB385F88E8DC5: There are bad things about rain too, if you think about it.//<portrait=annoyed>For one, if you don’t get to the artifacts in time, the rain can give them a beating. Heck, even destroy them!//<portrait=happy>That’s also my theory.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.212_Text: There are bad things about rain too, if you think about it.//<portrait=annoyed>For one, if you don’t get to the artifacts in time, the rain can give them a beating. Heck, even destroy them!//<portrait=happy>That’s also my theory.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.60E18D084B362A2E8423B99EDC8367B9: There are so many mushrooms in the forest now.//I don’t do that kind of thing, but if you like them, you should go forage around.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.94_Text: There are so many mushrooms in the forest now.//I don’t do that kind of thing, but if you like them, you should go forage around.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.138_Text: There are things I wish I’d handled differently.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.D2D5A78C4AB906004B5DB69F8EC3D6D9: There are things I wish I’d handled differently.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.345_Text: There’s just something about holding an artifact in your hands and imagining all the people and events it’s seen.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.C8B1C30E42ABF8722295D7961C5E71B4: There’s just something about holding an artifact in your hands and imagining all the people and events it’s seen.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.196_Text: There’s nothing better than okra and turnips. They remind me of my mom’s cooking.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.FC1DEED7480912ED33B37A928860E970: There’s nothing better than okra and turnips. They remind me of my mom’s cooking.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.184_Text: There’s so much cool stuff in the cavern, but no one likes to get their hands dirty down there.//It’s too bad.//<portrait=happy>More for me, I guess!
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.A7B88C184657AEBCA23732A702574F3E: There’s so much cool stuff in the cavern, but no one likes to get their hands dirty down there.//It’s too bad.//<portrait=happy>More for me, I guess!
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.77_Text: They are pretty, aren’t they? But I can’t have flowers at home. <NpcName>Charles</> won’t stop sneezing if I do.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.FAF0806743BB019CB4280FA2055B2546: They are pretty, aren’t they? But I can’t have flowers at home. <NpcName>Charles</> won’t stop sneezing if I do.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.199_Text: They need some new drink recipes down at the Tavern.//<portrait=concerned>I wonder if there’s anything they could make with turnips and okra.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.A957EF674C30EEC2776A77B57501250E: They need some new drink recipes down at the Tavern.//<portrait=concerned>I wonder if there’s anything they could make with turnips and okra.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.214_Text: They say the biggest fish come out in Summer.//You wanna see if I can catch any monsters down at the pier?
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.D62099DC4AF8BBC8C360BEA0B397ED3F: They say the biggest fish come out in Summer.//You wanna see if I can catch any monsters down at the pier?
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.189_Text: They should play more jazz at the Tavern.//<portrait=happy>It would give it that classy, ritzy feel. Know what I mean?
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.D8441B704BAFB6AFA315F08B01FC8FCB: They should play more jazz at the Tavern.//<portrait=happy>It would give it that classy, ritzy feel. Know what I mean?
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.243_Text: Think you could surf in weather like this?//<portrait=happy>I bet the waves would be, like, higher than my house.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.B75D13A84406AD011950EC86FF9E7A27: Think you could surf in weather like this?//<portrait=happy>I bet the waves would be, like, higher than my house.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.90_Text: Thinking of playing volleyball at the beach tomorrow. Wonder if anyone will be up for a match.//<portrait=concerned><NPCName>Chaem</> maybe? Or…//<portrait=normal>Will you be there?
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.C1474BD64074145CC3576FB467B6EA88: Thinking of playing volleyball at the beach tomorrow. Wonder if anyone will be up for a match.//<portrait=concerned><NPCName>Chaem</> maybe? Or…//<portrait=normal>Will you be there?
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.176_Text: This is a nice spot for a lunch break.//I might cool my feet in the creek afterward.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.ADC1D52F47D8423C72CED39952652F43: This is a nice spot for a lunch break.//I might cool my feet in the creek afterward.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.2969EBF047EE4C7182074A8623850C75: This would be an excellent place for a date, you know.//Just you, me, and thousands of years of history all around us.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.339_Text: This would be an excellent place for a date, you know.//Just you, me, and thousands of years of history all around us.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.30E585DC4AAA71EE8B3A4B8ABC0C59E5: Time to get back to work.//<portrait=happy>Monday, huh?
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.9_Text: Time to get back to work.//<portrait=happy>Monday, huh?
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.26FF428A4DD7CDFCDD144282A6C29F93: Ugh, but I draw the line at digging in Summer.//<portrait=annoyed>The cavern turns into a sauna, and this adventurer can't handle the heat.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.57_Text: Ugh, but I draw the line at digging in Summer.//<portrait=annoyed>The cavern turns into a sauna, and this adventurer can't handle the heat.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.72_Text: Um… It sounds worse when I say it out loud. Hmm…
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.A8EFDA8A4DC1B33777D3338C326B9653: Um… It sounds worse when I say it out loud. Hmm…
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.286_Text: Very cool. You need to teach me how to be cool like you one of these days!
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.C8141E894E5241F126DFF390B031FC6E: Very cool. You need to teach me how to be cool like you one of these days!
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.1F2D378A49B61A19F7752C8BA5FD77F0: Wait, did I offend you? I meant it as a compliment.//<portrait=happy>You look like someone who recycles a lot, for some reason.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.4_Text: Wait, did I offend you? I meant it as a compliment.//<portrait=happy>You look like someone who recycles a lot, for some reason.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.334_Text: We can… If you want to.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.B9E8C94A49F8420A67B21C847AB08457: We can… If you want to.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.10_Text: We handle artifacts from the cavern and from the sea.//<portrait=normal>They require different approaches to clean.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.F1D042D849890792BCFA8790AD808255: We handle artifacts from the cavern and from the sea.//<portrait=normal>They require different approaches to clean.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.165_Text: We would bring our lunches out and sail home at sunset.//Then Dad and I would stop by a ramen place on the way home for dinner.//We’d cook up our catch the next day.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.822A709E4452FE31DDF46B83862FEE1A: We would bring our lunches out and sail home at sunset.//Then Dad and I would stop by a ramen place on the way home for dinner.//We’d cook up our catch the next day.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.254_Text: Welcome to party central! Make yourself at home.//<portrait=normal><NPCName>Charles</> might disagree with that characterization, but hey!
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.26DF448C40FC99244F75F3A432FE722F: Welcome to party central! Make yourself at home.//<portrait=normal><NPCName>Charles</> might disagree with that characterization, but hey!
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.146_Text: Well, of course I know some of it… But yeah.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.54C545C240C84F9EDCAE2993D1810E49: Well, of course I know some of it… But yeah.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.12_Text: Well… It’s not all old. Most of what we get turns out to be junk.//<portrait=normal>But it’s awesome when we get an artifact that’s both rare <Italic>and</> old.//Feels good to be part of the discovery.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.718B2F574E10B7236F8A868626B780C4: Well… It’s not all old. Most of what we get turns out to be junk.//<portrait=normal>But it’s awesome when we get an artifact that’s both rare <Italic>and</> old.//Feels good to be part of the discovery.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.0FB6F6494540879F77CFF7983576A6C0: Well… We all need money, but all joking aside, <PlayerName>$Player</>, don’t take life too seriously. Remember to breathe a little.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.309_Text: Well… We all need money, but all joking aside, <PlayerName>$Player</>, don’t take life too seriously. Remember to breathe a little.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.114_Text: We’d bring our lunches out and sail home at sunset. Then Dad and I would stop by a ramen place on the way home for dinner. We’d cook up our catch the next day.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.3CB758BC44D9A91EEE18E294BB737791: We’d bring our lunches out and sail home at sunset. Then Dad and I would stop by a ramen place on the way home for dinner. We’d cook up our catch the next day.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.153_Text: What a great way to end the day.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.E28C688D4C05B80C53A94A808C3900D7: What a great way to end the day.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.13_Text: What are you up to?//I don’t do much on Tuesdays and Wednesdays.//I usually just go to the museum and then right back to bed.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.7F3E150F4080E59DFD9686A818AB0564: What are you up to?//I don’t do much on Tuesdays and Wednesdays.//I usually just go to the museum and then right back to bed.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.260_Text: What did the miner say when he walked into the cavern? //<portrait=happy>He said, “Wow, this place <Italic>rocks</>!”//Where’re the laughs?
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.9611D8B8476AC990EC3AFEAAA2D5E69E: What did the miner say when he walked into the cavern? //<portrait=happy>He said, “Wow, this place <Italic>rocks</>!”//Where’re the laughs?
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.324_Text: What did you do today, <PlayerName>$Player</>?//<portrait=sad>You seem a little tired. Is it the weather?
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.A456B9314CD861EA37C352846D8E7D86: What did you do today, <PlayerName>$Player</>?//<portrait=sad>You seem a little tired. Is it the weather?
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.182_Text: What’s your favorite thing to eat around here?//<portrait=concerned>I’m starving.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.DA30EC3446A02716A2F12E8AD8CC91AE: What’s your favorite thing to eat around here?//<portrait=concerned>I’m starving.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.44_Text: When I’m cleaning artifacts, I try not to use too much chemical solution because I’m afraid it might damage them.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.A963B5BE4A9B2B23BC33DEBD1135E2E9: When I’m cleaning artifacts, I try not to use too much chemical solution because I’m afraid it might damage them.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.131_Text: When it isn’t raining, I like to spend my weekends drinking coffee in front of the house.//You know, doing some people watching.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.16AA532548B0E78351D390BD15602775: When it isn’t raining, I like to spend my weekends drinking coffee in front of the house.//You know, doing some people watching.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.226_Text: Winter just seems so depressing to me. It’s dark and cold, and everything is dead.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.767708E1493DCDD88F879DB02FECDC93: Winter just seems so depressing to me. It’s dark and cold, and everything is dead.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.51_Text: With my bare hands? Ha! We're far more sophisticated than that, my dear.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.A2C1416340984E3FC9C7F5AE789214E0: With my bare hands? Ha! We're far more sophisticated than that, my dear.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.140_Text: Working on these artifacts may sound odd, but it's actually incredible. Listen up...//It's like having a time-travel portal right here, allowing us a glimpse into the fascinating world of our ancestors.//The artifacts take me back in time.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.32529CE0493D3F1DE30882A92D3B8C44: Working on these artifacts may sound odd, but it's actually incredible. Listen up...//It's like having a time-travel portal right here, allowing us a glimpse into the fascinating world of our ancestors.//The artifacts take me back in time.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.1FD868CE4DA9316BB3B75F8F33465CBB: Would you help me pick out an artifact to send back to my mom sometime?//No pressure or anything. I just think you two have the same taste.//<portrait=blushing> She’d probably love anything you pick out.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.332_Text: Would you help me pick out an artifact to send back to my mom sometime?//No pressure or anything. I just think you two have the same taste.//<portrait=blushing> She’d probably love anything you pick out.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.302_Special: Yeah, it gets overwhelming after a while.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.7075A384413E1C3FE2A22287D56B06E8: Yeah, it gets overwhelming after a while.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.302_Text: Yeah, that’s why I prefer to live in the moment. We have a lot in common.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.C4716B88449BC6EAC815158A01FFD6C0: Yeah, that’s why I prefer to live in the moment. We have a lot in common.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.30_Text: Yeah, the twins. Wait, you knew they were twins?//<portrait=normal>I couldn’t believe it when I first found out.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.5234A039453AA86A1F08F2BFF1794B19: Yeah, the twins. Wait, you knew they were twins?//<portrait=normal>I couldn’t believe it when I first found out.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.177_Text: Yikes! Something came at me in the dark, so I ran as fast as I could.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.DA6D3CDE40626A88B7DC15B33825AA0B: Yikes! Something came at me in the dark, so I ran as fast as I could.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.148_Text: You freaked me out. Say hi next time, will you?
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.7332C8E14F1280132DB2988080E4E533: You freaked me out. Say hi next time, will you?
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.14BDD0804AA6FCA45B1BAA9ACE2A8CC3: You get so tired after mining all day, yeah.//<portrait=sad>Wow… It's like a thrilling workout!
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.33_Text: You get so tired after mining all day, yeah.//<portrait=sad>Wow… It's like a thrilling workout!
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.180_Text: You gotta come hang out with us one night.//It’ll be the time of your life, I promise!
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.B2F3EC6F4CD3088F47480D8303D25C01: You gotta come hang out with us one night.//It’ll be the time of your life, I promise!
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.291_Text: You know what, <PlayerName>$Player</>? You’re a cool, fun person.//We need to hang out more.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.5FB2B49344FDF014BA72C78C07BC6C3C: You know what, <PlayerName>$Player</>? You’re a cool, fun person.//We need to hang out more.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.303_Text: You know, I couldn’t stop thinking about you last night. Umm…
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.50DFCF5145BB0074DBD845B2AFAB7AA5: You know, I couldn’t stop thinking about you last night. Umm…
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.76_Text: You like tulips? I don’t, personally. I don’t know… They just don’t do it for me.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.CBF69873450448615F560793CD202428: You like tulips? I don’t, personally. I don’t know… They just don’t do it for me.

DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.891AD6754FECBB06A0026D8B107C1AF0: You strike me as the type who reads every night before going to bed.//Am I right?

DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.FB2BDEC74EA161698D69B9AA051DC40B: You sure know how to work the room, huh?//You killed it at that party with <NpcName>Pablo</> and my friends.

DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.426E810C44E142973387F9A3EBCAA8F3: You're about to witness something truly spectacular, <PlayerName>$Player</>. Something so cool, it's yet to be defined.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.1F8230E5412F1D8ADBE250889F88E10D: Your weekend was fun, I hope?
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.36_Text: Your weekend was fun, I hope?
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.1027530149610FCCA704AB91ACA70DC3: You’re a farmer, right?//Let me ask you something. Is a passion fruit the same as a fig?
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.27_Text: You’re a farmer, right?//Let me ask you something. Is a passion fruit the same as a fig?
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.2289EFB947CD612A0D9DE68553D45E34: You’re always welcome at my place.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.312_Text: You’re always welcome at my place.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.1_Text: You’re from Pokyo, huh?//<portrait=normal>I came from a metropolitan area myself. The Big Apple… You’ve heard of it, I’m sure.
DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.422D28DD4ECE65FD8D2BA7A294511DC8: You’re from Pokyo, huh?//<portrait=normal>I came from a metropolitan area myself. The Big Apple… You’ve heard of it, I’m sure.
