DT_Dialogue_Scott_Production.45A8CCCD4EFD744120BC1391F9E0C979: You’re right. I do have too much time on my hands.

DT_Dialogue_Senja.13_Text: A roaring fire at night can ward off more than just the cold. Some monsters hate the light.
DT_Dialogue_Senja.14_Text: Don't trust a monster by its cover. The fluffy ones are often the most dangerous.
DT_Dialogue_Senja.15_Text: Ever seen a sunset from the top of a mountain? It's a sight, I tell you.
DT_Dialogue_Senja.16_Text: Ever tried crashing in a cavern? Not recommended, but it's warm, I'll give you that.
DT_Dialogue_Senja.11_Text: Ever tried fried watermelon? Nah, didn't think so. It's an acquired taste, believe me.
DT_Dialogue_Senja.1_Text: Hmm? Don't plan on sticking around, so no need for introductions.
DT_Dialogue_Senja.17_Text: I can cook a mean stew with just about anything edible...and even some things that aren't.
DT_Dialogue_Senja.7_Text: If your tea doesn't kick like a mule, it's not strong enough. That's my rule.
DT_Dialogue_Senja.6_Text: In this line of work, there's no time for dilly-dallying.//I face the beasts head-on, and that's what keeps me alive.
DT_Dialogue_Senja.4_Text: People think monster hunting is all about strength and glory. They're wrong.//It's about perseverance and a sharp blade.
DT_Dialogue_Senja.9_Text: Rain's just nature's way of telling you to toughen up. Good for a monster hunt, too.
DT_Dialogue_Senja.10_Text: Snow's just nature's way of telling you to toughen up.
DT_Dialogue_Senja.18_Text: The stars in the sky is the best map a wanderer like me could ask for.
DT_Dialogue_Senja.8_Text: These boots have seen more than most folks ever will. Every scuff's a tale of its own.
DT_Dialogue_Senja.2_Text: Unless you have business for me.//Well, do you?
DT_Dialogue_Senja.19_Text: When you're miles from the nearest town, with a storm rolling in, that's when you learn what you're truly made of.
DT_Dialogue_Senja.5_Text: Why am I telling you all this? Hmmph.
DT_Dialogue_Senja.12_Text: You call this a storm? I've faced sea serpents in worse weather.

DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.143_Text: <Italic>Finding Love from Within</> is my absolute favorite book.//It gives you insights into so many things. I always feel like I'm moving forward when I read it.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.9_Text: <NPCName>Alice</> and I are twins, but no, I can't read her mind.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.112_Text: <NPCName>Alice</> and I grew up here. But I guess you already knew that. I remember playing around the town when I was <NPCName>Valentina’s</> age… Building rows of snowmen.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.97_Text: <NPCName>Alice</> and I grew up here. But I suppose you already knew that. I remember playing around town when I was <NPCName>Valentina’s</> age. Building rows of snowmen.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.199_Text: <NPCName>Antonio</> and I used to spend Fall going to concerts and music festivals. I can’t really see myself doing that anymore.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.175_Text: <NPCName>Antonio</> had a fight last night. It rarely happens, so it bothers me when it does.//<portrait=concerned>He said I’m too naggy about <NPCName>Valentina</>.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.206_Text: <NPCName>Rafael</> and <NPCName>Pablo</> bring <NPCName>Valentina</> too many gifts this time of year.//They’re going to spoil her!
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.145_Text: <NPCName>Rafael</> and <NPCName>Pablo</> come to the inn a lot.//<portrait=happy>They’re great uncles to Valentina. Their whole family is very affectionate… Lovey-dovey, you know?//<portrait=normal>I’m grateful <NPCName>Valentina</> was born into their family.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.146_Text: <NPCName>Rafael</> or <NPCName>Pablo</>? What?! Neither of them is my ex.//<portrait=happy>My ex-husband is <NPCName>Antonio</>… He's one of their cousins.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.103_Text: <NPCName>Valentina</> always gives me a hard time at bedtime...//Whenever I complain to her father about it, he just says she doesn't do it at his place.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.73_Text: <NPCName>Valentina</> can be <Italic>very</> excessive when it comes to accessorizing her snowmen. She sneaks and takes my robe, my hat…//Some of the things she takes are Wabanana, you know…
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.53_Text: <NPCName>Valentina</> gets really active in Summer. I think she’s excited to go out and play with her dad.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.217_Text: <NPCName>Valentina</> hates thunder.//I should make sure she’s okay.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.153_Text: <NPCName>Valentina</> is the same way. She gets bored easily.//<portrait=normal>Thankfully, her dad keeps her active with things like basketball and rock climbing.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.141_Text: <NPCName>Valentina</> keeps asking if she can go to the forest by herself.//<portrait=annoyed>I just don’t think it’s safe.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.125_Text: <NPCName>Valentina</> needs to clean up her room, or she won't be allowed to go to the beach tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.318_Text: <NPCName>Valentina</> once asked me what my favorite part is about living on an island. I told her it’s the ocean.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.51_Text: <NPCName>Valentina’s</> birthday is coming up soon. It’s on the 3rd of Summer.//<portrait=annoyed>Should I throw a big birthday party at the inn or just have a picnic at the beach?
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.222_Text: <NPCName>Valentina’s</> hoping for a day off from school tomorrow.//If it keeps snowing like this, she might get it.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.288_Text: <NpcName>Alice</> is such a sensitive soul.//She accepts everything, and the problem is, I don't want her to.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.257_Text: <NpcName>Alice</> said she saw you in town yesterday.//So I thought…you know… Anyway.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.271_Text: <NpcName>Alice</> takes care of the inn in the morning. Then I take over for the evening shift.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.285_Text: <NpcName>Antonio</> and I separated as nicely as possible. Nothing dramatic happened, no cheating or anything like that.//We simply realized we didn't fit together anymore. We were young when we tied the knot, and we've grown into different individuals.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.349_Text: <NpcName>Antonio</> calls <NpcName>Valentina</>, his little <Italic>empanada</>.//Makes me chuckle every time. It's super cute.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.258_Text: <NpcName>Nina</> left town when she was really young, right after her dad passed away.//<portrait=concerned>I guess it was just too much for her and her mom, living in a place filled with memories.//I get it...
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.332_Text: <NpcName>Valentina</> loves spending time in Labuan Bajo with <NpcName>Antonio’s</> family.//<portrait=happy>She gets to plant rows and rows of grapes, and she gets to take care of chickens too.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.250_Text: <NpcName>Valentina’s</> at the age when I can’t tell if she’s being serious or if she’s teasing me with her ideas.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.92_Text: A lot of people here are so dedicated to this island.//It was amazing to see everyone together yesterday.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.148_Text: According to this book I'm reading, we should all be more grateful. Supposedly, it leads to a 15 percent increase in happiness within two weeks.//<portrait=happy>I’m giving it a try. I mean, why not?
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.270_Text: Ah, I might go mini golfing on Wednesday.//<portrait=normal>Hopefully, <NpcName>Ben’s</> in town… He’s a great opponent.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.28_Text: And get this, yeah? <NPCName>Alice</> also took an astrobiology class on the search for extraterrestrial life. I don’t know what she was thinking…
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.294_Text: And let’s not forget about her father.//My ex is gonna be in my life <Italic>period</>, so it would be nice if they get along with him as well.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.315_Text: Any plans this weekend?//I think I’m just gonna take it easy. Might pick up a new book to read.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.100_Text: Are you going to <NPCName>Bree’s</> dinner party on the 28th? I can't decide if I should bring wine or something else.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.44_Text: Are you ready for Spring cleaning, <PlayerName>$player</>? I know I am. I’ve prepared for this all year.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.220_Text: Be careful on your way home. You don’t want to be struck by lightning or anything.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.183_Text: Brooke, <NPCName>Charles’s</> ex, used to be my shopping buddy at Wabanana. We had a blast!
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.130_Text: But I haven’t returned the books we borrowed last week.//<portrait=annoyed>I wonder if <NPCName>Millie</> will make a big deal out of it.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.290_Text: But I honestly can’t trust anyone to keep her feelings safe.//<portrait=sad>Back in university, when she had her first breakup, she was an absolute mess.//That's where my worries stem from.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.241_Text: But being an adult is a whole different ballgame.//<portrait=normal>Still feel like a kid at times, even though I've got this little human relying on me. Life's full of surprises, that's for sure.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.252_Text: But it gives me some time to sit down.//<portrait=happy>I’ve been running around town all week long. Gotta stop sometimes, right?
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.292_Text: But that doesn't mean a potential partner would only deal with me.//<portrait=happy><NpcName>Valentina</> and I are a package deal. I'm her mom forever, and <NpcName>Antonio</> will always be her dad.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.238_Text: Cakes, pizza… They’re so heavy. I usually get really bloated the next day.//<portrait=happy>Sorry if that was too much information. Ha ha!
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.262_Text: Can I ask you something? You can tell me and <NpcName>Alice</> apart, right?
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.336_Text: Can you believe this place is free?//We should totally make a brochure about the hot spring and have it at the inn.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.106_Text: Careful on your way home, okay, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.263_Text: Cause if you can't, we might be in some trouble!
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.333_Text: Coming here during Fall is one of my favorite things to do.//<portrait=happy>The weather's just right, not too cold or too hot, and the water is perfect.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.293_Text: Dating as a single parent is hard. I have to make sure they get along with my daughter.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.160_Text: Deep breath in, deep breath out. Peace from within.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.248_Text: Diamonds and pearls always bring back such happy memories.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.256_Text: Did you check out the yoga class yesterday? Was it fun?
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.99_Text: Did you know animals can have a positive effect on our mental health?//<portrait=concerned>I've tried having pets, but they don't seem to like the inn much.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.211_Text: Didn’t the weather forecast say it wasn’t going to rain today?
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.247_Text: Diving? No, thank you. I think I’ll just stay here with my broom…on solid ground.//You should go, though!
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.182_Text: Do you know of any good places to get exercise gear?//Wabanana is awesome, but if you have any other rad suggestions, I'm all ears.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.274_Text: Do you wear a hat when you farm?//The sun is in full force.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.22_Text: Does the air feel a bit musty to you? I'm worried there might be some mold lurking around the inn.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.29_Text: Don’t know if you know this. But I used to be fun, <PlayerName>$player</>. Now I get excited about a trip to the grocery store.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.275_Text: Don’t overheat, <PlayerName>$Player</>. That would not be good.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.162_Text: Don’t tell anyone, but I may have eaten one strawberry too many yesterday.//They’re so sweet! I’m not usually a big fan of strawberries, but I could eat some more, to be honest.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.215_Text: Either way, I still have to get my to-do list done! Please excuse me.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.185_Text: Even though <NPCName>Antonio</> and I got divorced, I’m happy for the time we had together.//I have <NPCName>Valentina</> because of him, after all, and he’s taught me a lot about myself.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.221_Text: Even though I don’t like Winter, the snow does make the inn look pretty.//It makes the whole town look pretty, actually.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.186_Text: Every once in a while, I think about <NPCName>Antonio’s</> parents. His mom made killer burritos.//<portrait=happy>I wonder how they’re doing.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.82_Special: Eww, not pineapples. A jar of yogurt, of course.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.64_Text: Fall is such a beautiful season, don't you think?
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.132_Text: Flowers are a little expensive here. So I usually get them from <NPCName>Ben</> instead.//Besides, I sometimes buy out-of-season flowers that <NPCName>Sam</> doesn’t carry.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.71_Text: Good news! We have enough blankets for the guests…I think.//Let’s hope!
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.38_Text: Got a lot of cleaning up to do today...
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.30_Text: Gotta embrace the new me, I guess.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.21_Text: Gotta make sure <NPCName>Valentina</> gets her weekend reading done.//<portrait=normal>Sometimes she gets so caught up in things and forgets about it.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.122_Text: Guests are welcome to take a book to read and leave one in exchange when they're done.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.156_Text: Have you ever gone for a sunrise jog on the beach?//It clears your head.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.16_Text: Have you ever tried making eggplant lasagna? It's yummy, and it's super easy to make.//Oh, but you'll need a ceramic bowl for that.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.202_Text: Have you made your plans for Winter yet, <PlayerName>$player</>?//Now’s the time to get started.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.341_Text: Having a good relationship with food is important to me.//I don't want <NpcName>Valentina</> to feel guilty or ashamed about what she eats. It's all about balance and moderation.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.286_Text: He is a fantastic dad despite my occasional complaints. He loves <NpcName>Valentina</> and me…//<portrait=happy>And to tell you the truth, the feeling is mutual. I'll always have love for him, just not in a romantic way.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.102_Text: Her father takes her climbing all the time, and she's good at it.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.4_Text: Hmm? Oh yeah, it's kinda like a wake-up call.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.180_Text: Hmm… I can’t remember if I told <NPCName>Alice</> to clean out the inn’s reception desk or not.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.277_Text: I always used to get us in trouble, growing up. *laughs* <NpcName>Alice</>, she’s very…um…<Italic>tamed</>.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.86_Text: I ate so much yesterday at the Cherry Blossom Festival.//I think I’m still full today. *laughs*
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.239_Text: I brought my own bag, right here! You too, right?//<portrait=happy>Awesome!
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.337_Text: I can see the bamboo forest from here. What a view!
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.344_Text: I can't believe how fast time is flying by.//It feels like just yesterday <NpcName>Valentina</> was a little baby and now I'm talking <Italic>university</>.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.243_Text: I can’t believe I missed that putt! I need to calculate my angle better next time.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.198_Text: I can’t believe it’s time for <NPCName>Valentina</> to start another year of school. She’s growing up way too fast.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.308_Text: I can’t help but smile every time I see you smile.//It’s contagious.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.265_Text: I did love him, and to some extent, I still do...just not in a romantic way.//We're great friends.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.32_Text: I don't talk about it much, but having a child really flipped my life around.//It changed me in so many ways...
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.278_Text: I don’t know how to say this without sounding like… Errr… *sighs*
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.157_Text: I don’t want my head to be too clear, though. There are a lot of things I need to remember.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.65_Text: I enjoy running in Fall.//<portrait=blushing>It's cool enough that I don't overheat, but not too cold that I feel like my toes are freezing off.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.83_Text: I expected to see more rain than this.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.137_Text: I feel bad for saying it, but I like mini golf.//It does feel like a betrayal to be enjoying it, though… I don’t know what to tell ya.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.88_Text: I get fresh flowers for the inn from <NPCName>Ben</>.//He gives us a discount for buying in bulk.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.204_Text: I grew up here, and I’m still having a hard time adjusting to this weather.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.40_Text: I had <NPCName>Valentina</> when I was pretty young. But I want to be there for her for as long as possible.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.190_Text: I had a huge to-do list I wanted to get through yesterday, but I wasn’t able to finish everything.//Normally I’d be upset about it, but I feel…okay?
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.237_Text: I have nothing against sweet things.//I just don’t really enjoy them, I guess.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.68_Text: I have to get the blanket boxes from storage.//I’m gonna ask <NPCName>Rafael</> to do it next weekend… And I have to check the battery in the carbon monoxide detector.//I do it every year at the very least!
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.67_Text: I have to make sure the heaters are working properly before Winter starts… <Italic>Oh!</> And see that we have enough blankets for everyone.//<portrait=annoyed>I asked <NPCName>Alice</> to take care of the blankets a few years ago, but she missed some of the rooms, so I’m taking care of them now.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.236_Text: I hope <NPCName>Sam</> stocks more fresh vegetables soon.//I’m running out of ingredients for green smoothies.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.303_Text: I hope <NpcName>Valentina</> doesn’t miss out on anything.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.280_Text: I hope Pufferfish stops drilling.//Not just here, but I hope they change their business direction altogether.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.216_Text: I hope a branch doesn’t fall on the inn.//That would be expensive.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.205_Text: I hope it doesn’t snow on my birthday.//I’d like to go on a jog without getting my shoes wet.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.181_Text: I hope she does it anyway. It could use some tidying up.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.167_Text: I hope the more people <NPCName>Valentina</> is exposed to, the more she’ll learn about diversity, and the better her social skills will be.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.213_Text: I hope this clears up by tomorrow morning.//I’d rather not take <NPCName>Valentina</> to school in the rain.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.218_Text: I hope we don’t lose power.//One time, there was a really bad storm, and the electricity was out for the whole day.//<portrait=normal>Yeah! A blackout.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.298_Text: I hope you’re not intimidated by <NpcName>Antonio</>. He’s just a bit protective when it comes to me and <NpcName>Valentina</>.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.268_Text: I know <NpcName>Valentina</> hates the healthy food I feed her, but she’s going to thank me one day!
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.72_Text: I know it’s my birthday month, but honestly, I don’t really care about birthdays… The best thing about mine is <NPCName>Alice</>.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.12_Text: I let <NPCName>Alice</> handle our wine selection.//Honestly, I'm not too concerned about alcohol.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.321_Text: I like taking care of this inn.//It clears my mind and makes me feel like I’ve accomplished something when I’m done.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.300_Text: I like that. It shows how dependable you are.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.152_Text: I like to change up my exercise routine every week so I don't get bored.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.284_Text: I literally had to drag her out of her dorm so she’d at least have some friends… Good gosh.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.49_Text: I love running in Spring.//<portrait=normal>It’s so nice to hear all the animals again and see all the plants blooming.//<portrait=happy>It gives me more energy to run!
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.348_Text: I love spending time with my daughter, but sometimes I feel like I need a break. Self-care is important too.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.320_Text: I love sunsets at the beach. The colors of the sky and the ocean are just breathtaking.//<portrait=happy>But here, it’s already breathtaking, even without the sunset… I mean, look at how blue the water is today.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.56_Text: I made some homemade bug repellent, but it doesn't seem to be doing the trick.//Or maybe these Summer bugs are just super resilient...
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.17_Text: I make it all the time. I practically know the recipe by heart.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.240_Text: I miss school sometimes. It was nice having a clear path ahead, one grade after another.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.197_Text: I need to keep an eye on how much candy <NPCName>Valentina</> eats.//She’ll make herself sick otherwise.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.188_Text: I need to tell <NPCName>Valentina</> not to go barefoot on the beach.//<portrait=normal>Better safe than sorry.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.34_Text: I never cared about my diet or lifestyle until I had <NPCName>Valentina</>. Then I became a label-reading momster. Ha!
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.164_Text: I often see you walking past the inn. Been going to the diving spot, huh?//<portrait=happy>Good for you, <PlayerName>$player</>! I'm glad there are people like you who care not only about themselves but also about our environment.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.334_Text: I ran for a bit this morning, and I can feel my muscles relaxing.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.144_Text: I read both Rachel Abram's and Tyna Smith's <Italic>Finding Love from Within</>. They're completely different books.//I personally prefer Rachel Abram's version much better.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.319_Text: I really like it here. The view of the endless ocean is just so beautiful.//<portrait=blushing>Being here with you completes my day. I’m happy.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.158_Text: I run in the forest on Monday mornings… If the weather permits, that is.//<portrait=happy>I’ll hit the woodland tomorrow morning. I usually run back to the inn after taking <NPCName>Val</> to school.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.25_Text: I set up my old sewing machine for the guests to use.//It's never too late to learn a new skill.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.235_Text: I should get <NPCName>Rafael</> and <NPCName>Pablo</> to teach <NPCName>Valentina</> about farm animals.//Maybe she can help out at the ranch when she’s a little older.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.129_Text: I should pick up some books and brochures for the inn while I’m here.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.42_Text: I stay pretty active, but I just can't get into the activities my ex loves.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.187_Text: I stepped on a rusty can during my jog this morning.//Thank goodness for my trusty, thick shoes. Crisis averted!
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.254_Text: I think my sister’s also in the class… Um… I don’t really know for sure.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.136_Text: I think the mini golf course Pufferfish built is a great addition to our town.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.212_Text: I thought I’d be able to take <NPCName>Valentina</> to the beach this evening, but I guess not.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.296_Text: I thought I’d have to wait until <NpcName>Valentina</> was a teenager or even an adult before I could start dating again.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.95_Text: I thought it started to snow last night, but no. *sighs*
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.231_Text: I tried some earlier, and it tasted kinda funky.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.11_Text: I try my best to take <NPCName>Valentina</> to school every morning. It's our little routine.//And on the way back, I usually grab some stuff for the inn.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.342_Text: I try to cook healthy meals for us, but it's not always easy with our busy schedule. I'm thinking about signing us up for a meal prep service.//<portrait=annoyed>They don't have it here.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.316_Text: I was doing okay alone, <PlayerName>$player</>.//But now I have you in my life…things are better.//It’s nice to have someone to rely on.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.3_Text: I went for a run in the forest this morning and made it back before <NPCName>Valentina</> had to leave for school. It's such a great way to kickstart the day!
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.170_Text: I wish <NPCName>Alice</> would make more friends.//Spend less time reading up on those silly things she’s so interested in and actually live her life.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.223_Text: I wish I could stay and talk, but I need to find some extra blankets for <NPCName>Valentina’s</> bed.//It’s going to be a chilly night.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.61_Text: I wonder if it's worth turning on the sprinklers to keep the grass green, or if it'll just be a waste of water.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.177_Text: I wonder what <NPCName>Valentina</> will be when she grows up.//<portrait=normal>Whatever it is, I hope she finds her passion. Her dad and I will be right there, supporting her.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.90_Text: I'm just here to pick up some fresh irises for the inn.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.48_Text: I'm so glad I don't have to run in the cold anymore!//The great thing about running is that once you warm up, you don't feel the cold anymore. But getting started can be tough.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.346_Text: I'm so proud of <NpcName>Valentina</>. She's been doing really well in school lately.//<portrait=normal>I am one proud mama.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.347_Text: I've been practicing yoga in the mornings and it's been great for my mental and physical health.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.343_Text: I've been reading up on nutrition and I want to make sure <NpcName>Valentina</> develops good eating habits before she goes off to university.//<portrait=normal>Her dad is on board with me on this.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.345_Text: I've been trying to come up with some fun Summer activities to do together with <NpcName>Valentina</>.//<portrait=normal>Maybe we can go on a camping trip near <NpcName>Ben</>'s caravan or take a cooking class.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.57_Text: I've put out my homemade bug repellent in the lobby.//It's free for everyone to use, and guests can take a mini bottle with them if they want.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.317_Text: If I get used to having you around, promise you won’t leave?//Because I think I’m already there.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.154_Text: If you ever need a place to stay, you're welcome at the inn.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.225_Text: If you see <NPCName>Valentina</>, could you send her over here, please?//I want to show her something.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.309_Text: Is that a new outfit? It suits you.//You look good, <PlayerName>$Player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.105_Text: It gets a bit cold in here, yeah?
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.297_Text: It turned out that I didn't have to wait that long.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.117_Text: It's a bit stuffy in here. We should open more windows...
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.76_Text: It's always mind-blowing to think that I have a twin.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.5_Text: It's kinda sad to think about, but if I don't take <NPCName>Valentina</> to school now, when else would I get to do it?
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.327_Text: It's way too hot to go to the hot spring now.//<portrait=normal>Maybe if I go at night, it might be nice… What do you think?
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.2_Text: It’ll be nice to have more farmers here.//Being able to get local produce will be a game changer.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.80_Text: It’s <NpcName>Joko’s</> birthday tomorrow… Hmm…//<portrait=normal>Do you think I should get him some pineapples? Or a jar of yogurt?
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.20_Text: It’s Friday again. No school for the kids tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.184_Text: It’s Friday! Got anything fun planned for the weekend?//<portrait=normal>I think I’m going to take it easy.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.123_Text: It’s a “take a book, leave a book” type system…//But if someone doesn't have a book to donate, that's okay. They don't have to leave anything.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.314_Text: It’s always nice to see you, <PlayerName>$player</>.//Have a great weekend, okay?
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.322_Text: It’s better for the wood if we clean the pier often.//<portrait=concerned>You don’t want it covered in leaves or dirt too long. It might get moldy and slippery. Gosh!
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.302_Text: It’s foolish of me to think my divorce won’t affect <NpcName>Valentina</> at all…//But I’m trying to do my best here.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.55_Text: It’s nice to see people getting together and cleaning up the beach.//It's one of my favorite things about Summer.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.15_Text: It’s one of her favorite dishes, by the way.//That and green smoothies… Same as me!
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.219_Text: It’s part of living on an island, I guess.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.189_Text: It’s so nice having <NPCName>Rafael</> and <NPCName>Pablo</> around on Sundays.//They can keep an eye on <NPCName>Valentina</> while I run errands.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.325_Text: It’s the perfect beach weather, right? I’m surprised not to see more people here.//Maybe they’re all over there…near the Beach Shack.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.338_Text: It’s the perfect weather for the hot spring.//By the time I'm done, I'll probably be all sleepy. It's a great way to end the day.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.191_Text: I’ll just roll everything over to today. It’s not a big deal.//Wow, that feels weird to say…but in a good way.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.195_Text: I’ll plant anything but violets.//<portrait=annoyed>I just hate the way they smell.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.60_Text: I’m a little sad Spring is over, but Summer isn’t so bad.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.134_Text: I’m feeling good today. I’m bringing my A game. *laughs*
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.166_Text: I’m glad <NPCName>Valentina</> is close with <NPCName>Antonio’s</> family.//With her school being so small, I want to make sure she gets the social interaction she needs.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.331_Text: I’m gonna see if I can find some pumpkins.//<NpcName>Antonio’s</> mom loves pumpkin pies. I might bake some for him to take home to her.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.131_Text: I’m here to pick up some fresh fruit and veggies for dinner. You?
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.77_Text: I’m looking forward to Spring.//Making my cleaning solution tonight… Getting ready for Spring cleaning. Woo-hoo!
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.101_Text: I’m not too worried about <NPCName>Valentina</>.//She knows to be careful when the ground is slippery.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.142_Text: I’m not worried about people, really… You never know what else lives there.//<portrait=concerned>I don’t actually believe it… But nothing’s wrong with being careful, I think.//<portrait=annoyed>Hmm… <NPCName>Alice</>has gotten her outrageous theories into my head.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.232_Text: I’m sorry, but I don’t feel like chatting… I’m a little tired.//<portrait=normal>Let’s talk later?
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.307_Text: I’m trying to back off a bit… Errr…trying to give her some space.//But I’ll never leave her side, and she knows I’ll always have her back.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.326_Text: I’m trying to finish this book today.//It’s so good! Can’t put it down.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.251_Text: I’m usually on desk duty all day on the weekends. Humph… Boring.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.339_Text: I’m wearing my sister’s boots. They’re so comfy!//<portrait=happy>I borrow them for Winter. She doesn’t seem to mind.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.279_Text: I’m worried… I worry about <NpcName>Alice</> all the time.//She’s too soft sometimes. I’m afraid someone might see it as an opportunity and take advantage of her good heart.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.149_Text: I’ve been keeping a gratitude journal for a week.//In just seven more days, I’ll be a new, happier me!
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.323_Text: I’ve been using the same broom all year. Maybe it’s time to get a new one.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.208_Text: I’ve heard rain is 40 percent more dangerous at night than during the day.//I don’t think <NPCName>Valentina</> will be going out by herself on rainy nights anymore.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.207_Text: I’ve heard rain is 40 percent more dangerous at night than during the day.//I don’t think <NPCName>Valentina</> will be going out by herself on rainy nights anymore.//<portrait=normal>Ha ha! That’s right. I do like statistics.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.58_Text: Lemongrass is the main ingredient in my bug repellent… It smells really strong.//<portrait=concerned>I don’t hate it… It’s just… No point using perfume, you know? It would just be overpowered.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.26_Text: Let me tell you something about my sister. <NPCName>Alice</> took a neuroscience class on zombies, and they did a behavioral study to compare zombie brains to human brains.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.273_Text: Let me tell you something… I’ve been wearing my hair purple for as long as I can remember.//If I didn’t keep my roots natural, I probably would have forgotten my real hair color.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.54_Text: Living by the beach, it gets pretty hot and humid. Layering up is not an option for me.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.289_Text: Look, <PlayerName>$player</>. We’re friends now, so I feel like I can tell you stuff.//<portrait=sad>I’m torn, you know… I love my sister, I do.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.94_Text: Make sure to bring your best produce to the Harvest Festival on the 15th.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.176_Text: Maybe <NPCName>Antonio</> has a point… But I just want the best for her.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.173_Text: Me? Nope. My grades were so-so. She must take after <NPCName>Antonio</>.//<portrait=happy>I was too busy having fun to focus on school.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.172_Text: My day’s been fantastic so far! Thanks for asking.//<portrait=normal><NPCName>Valentina</> just got her report card today. All As, as usual.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.36_Text: My ex’s cousin <NPCName>Rafael</> helps out with odd jobs around the inn when he comes to visit <NPCName>Valentina</> on Sundays.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.85_Text: My parents never explained why they named me <NPCName>Suki</> and my sister <NPCName>Alice</>…
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.272_Text: My shift starts around five-ish. I need to see how the inn is doing, supply-wise, to prepare for tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.7_Text: My sis, <NPCName>Alice</>, is so soft-spoken. Sometimes I can barely hear what she's saying.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.276_Text: My sister and I may look a bit alike, but we have a different approach to things.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.291_Text: My sister asked me about my dating plans...and I told her that I'm looking for a partner, not another parent for<NpcName>Valentina</>.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.14_Text: My sister may look small, but gosh, can she eat!//<portrait=happy>Especially when she makes minced jackfruit pie.//<portrait=normal>A healthy appetite is good!
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.328_Text: No, I should just wait until Fall to go to the hot spring. It’s way too hot now.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.35_Text: Not even going to deny it. That's who I am now.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.295_Text: Not that I need his permission! Nothing like that.//<portrait=normal>But if <NpcName>Antonio</> likes whoever I’m dating, it makes life easier.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.155_Text: Not that you would need it since you have your own house, but the offer is there.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.50_Text: Now that Winter is over, it's time to wash all the blankets and put them in storage.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.224_Text: Now, where did I put that grocery list?//I can’t remember if it’s in the budget notebook, the food notebook, or the shopping notebook. Hmm…
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.27_Text: Of course not. Zombies aren’t real. Don’t be silly!
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.310_Text: Oh gosh, you’re making me blush.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.147_Text: Oh my! <PlayerName>$player</>, what day is it?//<portrait=normal>Tuesday? Thank goodness. I thought I missed a day in my cardio routine.//It’s okay. I’m okay!
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.209_Text: Oh my! Really? Ha ha! I never noticed.//<portrait=normal>You’re right. I do like statistics.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.59_Text: Oh, I better make some minced jackfruit pies for dinner with some fresh jackfruit. It’s in season now!//Sounds so yum!
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.45_Text: Oh, aren’t you glad Winter is over? I certainly am. Besides the snow, the cold was unbearable.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.70_Text: Oh, here we go. It’s Winter again…
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.116_Text: Oh, here, let me show you how to make a green smoothie.//It’s delicious, and it’s a power drink too.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.1_Text: Oh, hey! It’s nice to see you again.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.245_Text: Oh, hey! I’m glad you’re here.//<portrait=normal>Wanna help me sweep? Ha ha!
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.301_Text: Oh, hey, you! What a nice surprise.//<portrait=blushing>You look amazing today. Wow! I don’t know what to say.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.33_Text: Oh, in a good way, of course. Being a parent brings a whole new sense of purpose into your life.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.312_Text: Oh, my hair? Aww! Thank you! Yes, I just got my hair done a couple of days ago.//<portrait=happy><NPCName>Erika</> did a fantastic job, I thought.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.19_Text: Oh, that's right! You probably know them, huh?//<NPCName>Eva</> and <NPCName>Macy</>?
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.161_Text: Okay, I’m good now. Do you need something, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.283_Text: Or even in grade school. She would just sit under a tree by herself or stay in her room all weekend, doing nothing.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.75_Text: Our birthday is coming up soon. What should I do for <NPCName>Alice</>? Hmm…
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.78_Text: Phew! Quite the party last night, huh?
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.52_Text: Phew, I've cleaned everything on my list right on schedule!
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.43_Text: Rock climbing? Diving? Nah, not my cup of tea.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.201_Text: She <Italic>loves</> red curry but can’t eat mushrooms.//Poor thing.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.138_Text: She and I grew up together here…//<portrait=happy>Oh! <NPCName>Nina</>… I was talking about <NPCName>Nina</>.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.10_Text: She can't even feel it when I give her a little pinch.//And no, we don't do everything together.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.6_Text: She'll be all grown up and off to university before we know it.//<portrait=annoyed>Time really does fly, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.305_Text: She's nursing it back to health, so we're supportive of her kind heart.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.313_Text: She’s also having me use this new shampoo…Prestesse?//<portrait=annoyed>It was very pricey, but apparently it holds color better. Let’s see how it goes!
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.261_Text: Since <NpcName>Antonio</> travels a lot for his business, we decided she’d come with me.//<portrait=sad>It wasn’t an easy decision, but I think it’s the right one.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.140_Text: So, how much do I owe you?
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.244_Text: So, if I hit it at a forty-five degree angle off this wall…
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.31_Text: So, what's on your agenda for the week? Anything exciting?
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.62_Text: Some of the guests complained about the yellow grass… No, no, not recently. It was a few years ago.//I told them it’s just the way the grass is here, but they wouldn’t accept it.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.174_Text: Someone made a huge mess in one of the rooms at the inn a few days ago.//<portrait=concerned>It took me the whole day to clean up. Ugh, what a hassle.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.234_Text: Sometimes I bring <NPCName>Valentina</> here to calm down when she’s upset.//The peace and quiet among the trees helps her.//<portrait=happy>It helps me too.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.246_Text: Sorry, I can’t hang out now. I’m in the middle of cleaning up.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.171_Text: Sorry, that was rude. Those things aren’t silly.//It’s just…<NPCName>Alice</> is too focused on them, and she doesn’t have any friends.//<portrait=concerned>Well, yeah. Valid point. <NPCName>Noah</> is her friend… But that’s the problem, isn’t it? <NPCName>Noah’s</> her <Italic>only</> friend.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.193_Text: Spring is the perfect time to start new habits.//Everyone’s shaking off the Winter cold and getting outside again.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.196_Text: Summer is a good time to burn away bad vibes.//Just lie back on the beach and let the sun do its thing.//Don’t forget sunscreen, though!
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.107_Text: Take Garden Lane tonight, will you?//It might be safer than going through the lookout.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.226_Text: Teaching her how to keep the inn’s ledger will help with her math skills.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.139_Text: Thank you for this! It will make a very fresh green smoothie. I’ll send you the recipe tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.324_Text: Thankfully, the inn survived another Winter…and this pier as well.//The snow got me worried. Thought it might get moldy.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.8_Text: That girl needs to turn it up a notch.//Speak up more!
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.126_Text: That girl... When it's time to surf or play with her friends, she's out the door in seconds.//But when it comes to cleaning up her room... Oh gosh!
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.259_Text: That year was tough on her, losing her dad and having to start fresh in a new place.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.41_Text: That's why I'm being more mindful of what I eat. No more junk food for me!
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.330_Text: The Beach Shack charges different prices for them too!//Don’t believe me? Ask <NPCName>Alice</>!
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.329_Text: The Summer coconuts look different from the Spring ones, but to me, they taste pretty much the same.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.87_Text: The beach cleanup is an awesome thing, but we also need to remember to use less plastic and recycle.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.304_Text: The inn can get pretty messy sometimes because <NpcName>Macy</> keeps a lobster in her room...yeah!
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.151_Text: The inn is a great place to live. It may not be a conventional place to grow up, with strangers under the same roof and all. //But <NPCName>Alice</> and I grew up there, and we had a lot of fun.//<portrait=happy>I think <NPCName>Valentina</> will do just fine.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.18_Text: The inn is doing alright, but it's not exactly bursting at the seams. Well, not as much as I'd love it to be!//<portrait=happy>But we do have a handful of regular customers.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.168_Text: The inn is open seven days a week. Gotta be there for the weekenders.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.178_Text: The inn is ours…yeah. My parents used to run it before <NPCName>Alice</> and I took over.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.46_Text: The inn is so big… It’s not easy to clean it alone.//I don’t mind, though. I even make my own cleaning solution.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.93_Text: The nights are starting to get chilly.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.340_Text: The sea water is freezing cold! Have you ever dipped your toes in it?/<portrait=happy>It gives me a jolt every time. Ha ha!
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.110_Text: The snow is piling up outside.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.91_Text: The sun is strong today... Make sure to stay hydrated, okay?
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.253_Text: There’s a yoga class tomorrow in the community center. A lot of people usually turn up.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.169_Text: There’s always so much cleaning to do at the inn.//I don’t mind, though. It keeps me moving.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.200_Text: There’s so much fresh food to cook with in Fall. It makes planning <NPCName>Valentina’s</> meals much easier.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.264_Text: They say around 50 percent of marriages end in divorce, so statistically speaking, it's not too surprising that <NpcName>Antonio</> and I separated.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.249_Text: They're just so personal and special to me. Definitely my favorite things.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.214_Text: This is dangerous weather, <PlayerName>$player</>! Neither of us should be out in it!
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.228_Text: This is going to take ages to fix.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.306_Text: To be fair… Look, I know I can be too much to handle as a sister.//<portrait=sad>I know I can seem pushy, but I have no ill will in my heart. I just want to protect my sister…//<portrait=concerned>I understand it’s not okay. I’m learning to be more respectful.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.227_Text: Ugh! <NPCName>Alice</> messed up the numbers again.//<portrait=annoyed>I had everything all neat and organized in my spreadsheet, and now it's a total mess.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.74_Text: Ugh, I don’t want to give up my morning runs, but I’m seriously considering it.//<portrait=concerned>It’s so cold!
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.269_Text: Ugh, I’m turning into my mom.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.104_Text: Ugh... Of course she doesn't do it with him. I don't even want to know what time he puts her to bed.//<portrait=annoyed>I’m sure that’s why she doesn’t give him trouble.//<portrait=concerned>Midnight bedtime, for crying out loud!
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.267_Text: Wait until <NpcName>Valentina</> hears about my college days. Or maybe I shouldn’t tell her…
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.163_Text: Wait, were they from your farm?//<portrait=normal>I got them from <NPCName>Sam</>’s.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.203_Text: We don’t get many customers at the inn in Winter.//I think people prefer to stay in their own houses during the cold months.//<portrait=concerned>I don’t know. What do you think?
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.89_Text: We get things from <NPCName>Sam’s</> store too, of course…//<portrait=happy>Um… You know, bread and things like that.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.23_Text: We get tons of tourists who come here specifically for the festivals.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.121_Text: We have plenty of books in our library.//If you don't mind well-read books, please help yourself.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.109_Text: We need to find out how to crank up the heat in here.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.66_Text: We usually get more guests the closer we get to the Harvest Festival.//<portrait=concerned>Some of them are up from Beluga Bay for the harvest display, and the rest are just tourists who are curious about the festival.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.13_Text: We usually get our wine from Hillside Vineyard, and their business seems to be doing well, so whatever they're making must be good.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.24_Text: We're kind of a big deal, you know.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.287_Text: Well, I don't really care if I hurt anyone's feelings.//If I see my sister heading down a rough path in a relationship, I'll definitely speak up.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.108_Text: Well, I just thought it might be more slippery.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.39_Text: Well, that’s what weekends are for. Might as well roll up my sleeves and get to work.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.120_Text: We’ll give you the local discount! Heh heh.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.63_Text: We’re bracing ourselves for the oncoming Winter. You should, too.//Heater, blankets… What else do I need?
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.210_Text: What a gloomy day. Thank goodness I'm chilling indoors.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.127_Text: What brings you here so early in the morning?
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.194_Text: What sort of flowers should I plant around the inn this year?//I’ll have to check my plant notebook for ideas.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.229_Text: What’s still on my to-do list? Oh, right.//I need to make <NPCName>Valentina’s</> lunch for tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.260_Text: When I told <NpcName>Antonio</> I wanted to move back to Starlet Town, we went back and forth about where <NpcName>Valentina</> would live.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.111_Text: Winter isn’t my favorite season, but days like these may make me reconsider.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.192_Text: Woo-hoo! It's that time of year again—Spring cleaning extravaganza!//Out with the old, in with the fabulously fresh!
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.230_Text: Would you do me a favor and check the expiration date on the ketchup?//I think it’s going bad.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.81_Text: Yeah, I think he would appreciate it.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.119_Text: You can just relax and read a book in your room with the windows open.//<portrait=happy>Fall asleep to the calming sound of the waves…
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.69_Text: You can run for longer in cooler weather. It's easier to catch your breath.//<portrait=annoyed>Well, for me at least, not sure about you.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.37_Text: You know him, don’t you? Yeah, he’s pretty helpful.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.266_Text: You know what the hardest part of co-parenting is?//Somehow, <NpcName>Antonio</> became the fun parent, and I’m the strict one! Me!
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.84_Text: You know, I have to say… Quite a name you’ve got, <PlayerName>$player</>.//Is there a meaning behind it?
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.179_Text: You look surprised! Ha ha! Interesting reaction.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.150_Text: You meet a lot of people working at an inn.//Traveling does that too.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.124_Text: You should check out the pier. There are usually lots of seals hanging out there at this time.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.118_Text: You should take a break from farm life and stay here for a weekend or something.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.282_Text: You should’ve seen <NpcName>Alice</> and me at university.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.311_Text: You’re a great friend, <PlayerName>$player</>. It’s always nice to hear fresh perspectives on things.//<portrait=happy>Thank you for being a great listener.
DT_Dialogue_Suki_Production.299_Text: You’re very responsible with your farm

DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.2DE556D7431DB89A734680A5C081F387: A lot to explore here, huh?

DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.407EDC8D40DCDE11CE722598AC13CD0B: Always a treat to see you, <PlayerName>$player</>!
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.105_Text: Apparently, she lives in the abandoned villa on the beach and now only comes here for Summer.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.6FF0780B401E7ACF06A8C59EE8A41DA8: Apparently, she lives in the abandoned villa on the beach and now only comes here for Summer.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.987A2D444E239E80223CF0A8379B0E9D: Are there really two more weeks of Winter? I don’t know if I can last through it.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.98_Text: Are there really two more weeks of Winter? I don’t know if I can last through it.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.17_Text: Be careful in the forest. I was out there when I got caught in a storm.//<portrait=normal>And listen to this. While I was looking for shelter, I found a little cave, so I went in, right?//<portrait=surprised>I mean, anyone would have at that point.

While I was looking for shelter, I found a little cave, so I went in, right?//<portrait=surprised>I mean, anyone would have at that point.

DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.A37E568F4BF81CAD837E43BA8154AB0B: Besides, what have you got to lose, am I right?
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.166_Text: Can't thank <NPCName>Ling</> enough for giving me this chance on Coral Island.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.A30F5A014A04A32F9D897E91E2308606: Can't thank <NPCName>Ling</> enough for giving me this chance on Coral Island.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.40_Text: Coral Island has one of the most beautiful coral reefs, and I want to study it!//<portrait=normal>I’d love to spend my life doing what I can to protect it from rising sea temperatures.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.437CAFF742B4EBA87921C592AFD71D10: Coral Island has one of the most beautiful coral reefs, and I want to study it!//<portrait=normal>I’d love to spend my life doing what I can to protect it from rising sea temperatures.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.12_Text: Coral Island's become my second home. After studying the local ecosystem, it feels like I'm where I'm supposed to be.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.7DE1D9D44A481AB4479E89A8A0A82EF3: Coral Island's become my second home. After studying the local ecosystem, it feels like I'm where I'm supposed to be.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.243_Text: Days like this make me wanna go out and stay out.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.D2FB855341DAAAA812CCCB9A6E6FAAF3: Days like this make me wanna go out and stay out.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.244_Text: Days like this make me wanna stay in and sleep the whole day.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.D9ABF0EA4517F1F5AC0C028255EC5D88: Days like this make me wanna stay in and sleep the whole day.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.149_Text: Did I bum you out?//Maybe I should stop talking about work.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.7F0F38C8463CB4C13EFCC5A647D7FF8C: Did I bum you out?//Maybe I should stop talking about work.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.168_Text: Did you know one out of every four marine species lives in coral reefs? Mind-blowing, right?
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.BA6988354FC7020CCCCCAA8B42F48159: Did you know one out of every four marine species lives in coral reefs? Mind-blowing, right?
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.85_Text: Different seasons bring different varieties of coconuts here.//<portrait=concerned>If I'm not mistaken, Summer is when we get the...macapuno coconut, or was it the coral tall?
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.DD53B4AF44133A017F087F835CE53CF9: Different seasons bring different varieties of coconuts here.//<portrait=concerned>If I'm not mistaken, Summer is when we get the...macapuno coconut, or was it the coral tall?
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.233_Text: Do you ever think about that?
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.5418810E4402D378C28FE2A56A19C9E8: Do you ever think about that?
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.8ED6F69442E13CDE8D69E38DE2FCDCA9: Do you know where I can get some bamboo shoots in Fall?//I went looking for them around the hot spring. No luck.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.91_Text: Do you know where I can get some bamboo shoots in Fall?//I went looking for them around the hot spring. No luck.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.116_Text: Don’t freeze at the farm, okay? Heh heh.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.9955B5F14E9C3D3B906FF49427F5D425: Don’t freeze at the farm, okay? Heh heh.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.162_Text: Don’t let their propaganda fool you. If they start drilling, it’ll be a disaster for the nearby coral communities!
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.90235E634759D1EBA25891B49C4558DC: Don’t let their propaganda fool you. If they start drilling, it’ll be a disaster for the nearby coral communities!
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.48_Text: Drinking too much milk gives me a stomachache. And it has that weird aftertaste.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.E639EB914B953B451BBF109EAFCF8BF4: Drinking too much milk gives me a stomachache. And it has that weird aftertaste.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.165_Text: Even with my PhD in marine biology, it was tough landing a good job.//I mean, I applied everywhere!
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.DD9BE1EE42CA7E8523DBD0BE10D74A10: Even with my PhD in marine biology, it was tough landing a good job.//I mean, I applied everywhere!
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.127_Text: Eventually, I want to publish more articles or even a book about my findings.

DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.69D3B8D14D32032C70D858A223E51AA1: Eventually, I want to publish more articles or even a book about my findings.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.746E70524E32F6EF51E13FBC2B608642: Eventually, I want to publish more articles or even a book about my findings.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.66_Text: Except for the clinic. They always have someone on call in case of emergency.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.A7248FAC475B87C4CB0BB39979BA6961: Except for the clinic. They always have someone on call in case of emergency.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.234_Text: Family means a lot to me. Kinda feels like everyone on this island is part of my extended family.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.C97BB47A4C12A5F6C16495B9A9D67AB5: Family means a lot to me. Kinda feels like everyone on this island is part of my extended family.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.14_Text: Feel free to drop by anytime! Although, fair warning, I'm often out and about.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.53CD785D4B1EFFCE177FB6819B6C083D: Feel free to drop by anytime! Although, fair warning, I'm often out and about.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.0854271C423A1BAC2C5BDF808AC21613: Finally, it's warm enough to hit the beach again!
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.179_Text: Finally, it's warm enough to hit the beach again!
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.04C1B36A4E2722954ACE58B02B41D72C: For me, it doesn’t really matter where we are. As long as I’m with you, I think we’ll have a good time.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.203_Text: For me, it doesn’t really matter where we are. As long as I’m with you, I think we’ll have a good time.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.123_Text: For some reason, I concentrate better during Winter. I think it might be the cold.//Or maybe it’s because of the quiet.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.79711F654A4107D9643E579B136AFA6E: For some reason, I concentrate better during Winter. I think it might be the cold.//Or maybe it’s because of the quiet.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.125_Text: For some reason, people feel the need to talk about the rain when it’s raining.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.7490B4814C7CD405164903A78E0AA774: For some reason, people feel the need to talk about the rain when it’s raining.

DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.BBB3718F452C323DD5C03DBCD38A92BF: For some reason, people feel the need to talk about the storm when it’s storming.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.101_Text: Good point. I did come here for work.//And so did Pufferfish.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.3B96036E4063CA188E571BBC52FC01FD: Good point. I did come here for work.//And so did Pufferfish.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.212_Text: Gotta say, I just noticed your eyes. They've got this warm...glow to them.//<portrait=blushing>I could look at you all day.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.909F23744BA804B0F11F97956C1C9B8C: Gotta say, I just noticed your eyes. They've got this warm...glow to them.//<portrait=blushing>I could look at you all day.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.1145CA9D427F0127F753A5AE9CC11025: Growing up, I used to love joining my dad on his early morning fishing trips.//<portrait=happy>Don't let him hear this, but I get bored of fishing real quick.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.208_Text: Growing up, I used to love joining my dad on his early morning fishing trips.//<portrait=happy>Don't let him hear this, but I get bored of fishing real quick.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.104_Text: Have you met <NPCName>Nina</>?//We met at the beach and got to talking a bit.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.83C6C1104D4ADBE2B03C58AD47861C73: Have you met <NPCName>Nina</>?//We met at the beach and got to talking a bit.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.03D3B96B4D07B3CAD6B04F8EF875507A: Have you spotted those oil rigs around the island? That's Pufferfish Corporation's doing.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.161_Text: Have you spotted those oil rigs around the island? That's Pufferfish Corporation's doing.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.171_Text: Have you tried the tacos at Fishensips? They’re delicious!//I guess it’s called Fishensips now. Back in the day, when I was a little kid, it was called the Local Tavern.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.5A175D6A44FC8B7651CBB4AE7959B63D: Have you tried the tacos at Fishensips? They’re delicious!//I guess it’s called Fishensips now. Back in the day, when I was a little kid, it was called the Local Tavern.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.188_Text: Having you moving onto Coral Island a month after I did was exciting.//<portrait=happy>I couldn’t wait to meet you. Made me feel like I had a friend to figure out Coral Island with together. Ha ha!
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.6B3318E643FC878BB0C21EBBF5BC3B70: Having you moving onto Coral Island a month after I did was exciting.//<portrait=happy>I couldn’t wait to meet you. Made me feel like I had a friend to figure out Coral Island with together. Ha ha!
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.0512EEB54ADBE430EEE7479168C0612A: He lives in Mount Yahara, not far from here. But you need to take a boat and then a bus across the desert to get there.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.153_Text: He lives in Mount Yahara, not far from here. But you need to take a boat and then a bus across the desert to get there.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.59_Text: Hmm. Very meta. I never thought about it that way. I like it!//You have a great way of looking at things. I like that about you.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.A1858A5F479DF8A0CDEA25B73506443D: Hmm. Very meta. I never thought about it that way. I like it!//You have a great way of looking at things. I like that about you.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.11_Text: How are you doing here so far, <PlayerName>$player</>?//<portrait=happy>Does it feel like home yet?
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.5A0CCD114FE93A0FBFB15EBA59EBD778: How are you doing here so far, <PlayerName>$player</>?//<portrait=happy>Does it feel like home yet?
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.186_Text: How do you think they came up with the name Coral Island?
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.56_Text: How do you think they came up with the name Coral Island?
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.5AC6D88E458A7DB343CA608EB90789FB: How do you think they came up with the name Coral Island?
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.5C8D18CA4A14641F8C39FEAE45367ACA: How do you think they came up with the name Coral Island?
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.37_Text: I can't stand the thought of losing them.//I want my future kids to experience what I had, to see the wonders I saw.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.F101A79146213FA942513CAE10F7791C: I can't stand the thought of losing them.//I want my future kids to experience what I had, to see the wonders I saw.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.119_Text: I can’t believe I’ve already been living here for a whole year.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.42E2BCA54057AA6A2754ECAC0E557959: I can’t believe I’ve already been living here for a whole year.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.204_Text: I could just sit and listen to you all day. You’re intelligent, and the way you think about stuff is…um…very insightful.//<portrait=happy>I learn something new every time I see you.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.96DAB9A14E49FA64EAB0ED95234D8371: I could just sit and listen to you all day. You’re intelligent, and the way you think about stuff is…um…very insightful.//<portrait=happy>I learn something new every time I see you.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.43EAC7CB405082186FC3928B8D4DED59: I declined her offer and said we could keep the environment in the lab casual.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.55_Text: I declined her offer and said we could keep the environment in the lab casual.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.0E7F12484365A7C80A1FD5841DACD44F: I didn’t realize Winters here were so cold!
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.92_Text: I didn’t realize Winters here were so cold!
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.2CD4438841DF4F6FB7F849A70A2DB5C0: I didn’t want to be rude by calling <NPCName>Dr. Jiang</>, <NPCName>Ling</>. But she asked me to. It felt really weird at first.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.53_Text: I didn’t want to be rude by calling <NPCName>Dr. Jiang</>, <NPCName>Ling</>. But she asked me to. It felt really weird at first.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.196_Text: I don’t know. I just really…wanted to see you.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.474AA5E5475827548E20DCA973969719: I don’t know. I just really…wanted to see you.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.172_Text: I don’t mind living with Uncle <NPCName>Joko</> and Aunt <NPCName>Dinda</>, but I...never mind.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.27B3E3094729D2F3734035A65B4BC563: I don’t mind living with Uncle <NPCName>Joko</> and Aunt <NPCName>Dinda</>, but I...never mind.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.0DFE910541B81719C72A85A6F4FEE098: I don’t think I’ll ever get used to Winter.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.93_Text: I don’t think I’ll ever get used to Winter.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.90A9029B42727727725135AB23017A64: I don’t understand how some people can go out in this weather wearing only two layers.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.94_Text: I don’t understand how some people can go out in this weather wearing only two layers.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.190_Text: I even managed to get a book out of my research.//Got a few copies lying around in my room.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.1F3DF20A4512FF209D1984AA3B2B82F0: I even managed to get a book out of my research.//Got a few copies lying around in my room.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.36_Text: I feel connected to them, you know? The coral reefs, the fish.//They're like childhood friends. I grew up alongside these aquatic creatures.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.F18F76A24060BF5CC23C2EB3391BAA7F: I feel connected to them, you know? The coral reefs, the fish.//They're like childhood friends. I grew up alongside these aquatic creatures.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.147E652044743FC9B554D987C7BD7015: I gotta say, I haven't met anyone quite like you before.//You're smart, courageous. Gosh, the list goes on.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.194_Text: I gotta say, I haven't met anyone quite like you before.//You're smart, courageous. Gosh, the list goes on.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.162BB590470744A341AD98B50DCD57AA: I guess that’s my way of saying you’re important to me too, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.235_Text: I guess that’s my way of saying you’re important to me too, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.214_Text: I had this idea jobs would be lining up for me as soon as I got my doctorate.//<portrait=surprised>But gosh! That wasn’t the case at all. I was so young and naive.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.A21BE7884515747BEE53C5969ECA2FA3: I had this idea jobs would be lining up for me as soon as I got my doctorate.//<portrait=surprised>But gosh! That wasn’t the case at all. I was so young and naive.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.211B98694C3832F2F5C5688D4EF84197: I have to admit that before coming here, I had quite a narrow mindset.//<portrait=annoyed>If science didn't back it, I didn't buy into it.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.9_Text: I have to admit that before coming here, I had quite a narrow mindset.//<portrait=annoyed>If science didn't back it, I didn't buy into it.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.151_Text: I have to remind myself it’s one step at a time.//<portrait=sad>I can’t rush it, or I might fail altogether.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.93B9B681432706D80A8C2F9D81EE9C5D: I have to remind myself it’s one step at a time.//<portrait=sad>I can’t rush it, or I might fail altogether.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.210_Text: I haven't visited here during the Summers in ages, so I wouldn't blame anyone for not remembering me.//<portrait=happy>I barely remember them.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.406A746F4E63030D218CDD84110CF699: I haven't visited here during the Summers in ages, so I wouldn't blame anyone for not remembering me.//<portrait=happy>I barely remember them.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.144_Text: I hope you have extra blankets in the cabin, <PlayerName>$player</>.//This snow doesn’t look like it’s going to be slowing down anytime soon.
DT_Dialogue_Surya_Production.623526384E1CDA45D1A82EBE85644454: I hope you have extra blankets in the cabin, <PlayerName>$player</>.//This snow doesn’t look like it’s going to be slowing down anytime soon.

DT_Dialogue_Takeba_Production.8_Text: I need to wash the hot spring sign by the observatory.//<portrait=happy>It’s been a while since I’ve done it. Last Summer, I think.
DT_Dialogue_Takeba_Production.13_Text: I see. No need to worry. That’s Taro.//He gets carried away with his work and forgets about his friends.
DT_Dialogue_Takeba_Production.14_Text: It’s hard to find bamboo shoots right now. They’re not sprouting yet. The ground is still too cold.
DT_Dialogue_Takeba_Production.4_Text: I’ve been eating the same lunch for years.//<portrait=happy>Oven-baked risotto is a great comfort food.
DT_Dialogue_Takeba_Production.5_Text: Take your shoes off before going to bed, Taro.//<portrait=concerned>You don’t want dirt on your blanket.
DT_Dialogue_Takeba_Production.12_Text: Taro hasn’t been home for…//Well, Winter is here again. I just hope he remembers to wear his jacket.//<portrait=annoyed>Do you ever hear from him?

DT_Dialogue_Takeba_Production.7_Text: There aren’t many visitors at the hot spring in Summer.//It’s not surprising, but I wish more people would come and visit.
DT_Dialogue_Takeba_Production.3_Text: You’re welcome to bathe at the hot spring. It’s open to the public.//You don’t need to pay to enter.
