DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.38_Text: <NPCName>Taco</> used to live with us at the inn, but now he stays at Hillside Vineyard.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.133_Text: <NPCName>Taco</>! He’s cute and fuzzy… Ah, that one’s definitely going in my book.//<portrait=doubt>Hmm… It could be <NPCName>Bonbon</> too, I guess.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.26_Text: <NPCName>Yuri</> is my favorite doctor. She’s supercool.//<portrait=annoyed>But when I have the tiniest cold, she’s always like, “No surfing too long.” No this, no that…
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.64_Text: <NPCName>Yuri</> says I’m sensitive to pollen, just like <NPCName>Charles</>.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.135_Text: Also, they always run away every time I try to pet them.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.145_Text: And maybe Aunt <NPCName>Alice</> can come too, but then who's gonna run the inn?
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.119_Text: Besides, <NPCName>Taco</> doesn’t seem to like the beach very much… He plays at the park a lot, though.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.99_Text: But I also want to be like <NPCName> Mr. Barnes</>. He teaches kids like me and grades projects.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.60_Text: But I kind of want to, you know.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.127_Text: But if he can't get out, I gotta get a grown-up to help.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.45_Text: But when it’s festival time, he takes a day off to play with me for the whole day!//<portrait=normal>Pretty cool, huh?
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.165_Text: Do you know where to get a mistletoe?//I want to bring it when I visit Nana and Papa.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.162_Text: Eggplant lasagna is okay.//<portrait=annoyed>It's...alright, I guess. It doesn't taste terrible, but I wish Mom would stop making it. Yuck!
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.118_Text: Even though <NPCName>Taco</> the dog used to live with me and now he doesn’t anymore, I don’t really miss him.//Because I see him all the time.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.155_Text: Green smoothies are okay.//<portrait=annoyed>They don’t taste terrible, but I wish Mom would just stop making them.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.57_Text: Have you checked out the new mini golf?
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.10_Text: He also said sometimes grown-ups don't even know what they wanna be.//That's okay too…
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.1_Text: Hello, <PlayerName>$honorifics $player</>… Nice to meet you too. I’m <NPCName>Valentina</>.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.81_Text: Hey, do you know one of the many, many reasons I love rain?//<portrait=normal>Because at school, we get to stay inside and play.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.82_Text: Hey, do you know one of the many, many reasons I love rain?//<portrait=normal>Because at school, we get to stay inside and play.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.85_Text: Hey, do you know one of the many, many reasons I love rain?//<portrait=normal>Because at school, we get to stay inside and play.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.88_Text: Hey, do you know one of the many, many reasons I love rain?//<portrait=normal>Because at school, we get to stay inside and play.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.142_Text: How many scarecrows do you have on your farm? I want to keep one in my room.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.24_Text: I believe him. He’s a truth-teller, you know.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.111_Text: I brought some lunch with me, so I don’t have to go home so soon.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.167_Text: I don't like going to my uncle's house in the Summer.//It's super-duper hot there.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.159_Text: I don’t feel like playing mini golf today.//So I think I’ll just play around here.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.19_Text: I don’t like visiting my uncles in their shop. It’s too hot and loud in there…//<portrait=sad>But Dad says sometimes we have to visit them to show we care.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.134_Text: I don’t really play with Peanut and Butter. They don’t go out very much.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.103_Text: I don’t understand why, because Aunt <NPCName>Alice</> is the one who always brings it over anyway…//It’s not like Mom’s going back and forth.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.56_Text: I don’t understand. So Pufferfish is coming to Coral Island to buy houses?
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.140_Text: I found some cool shells today at the beach. Ah… A good day.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.32_Text: I get to play volleyball with Uncle <NPCName>Rafael</> when he comes to visit.//<portrait=happy>He’s not good at it, but that’s okay because it means I always win.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.33_Text: I get to play volleyball with Uncle <NPCName>Rafael</> when he comes to visit.//<portrait=happy>He’s not good at it, but that’s okay because it means I always win.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.40_Text: I gotta be super careful about what I take from the forest, 'cause there are mushrooms there that could make you sick.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.46_Text: I guess I play on the beach a lot after school because I live there. I don’t think Mom would let me go anywhere else on weekdays.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.132_Text: I have a riddle for you, <PlayerName>$honorifics $player</>. What’s cute and fuzzy?
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.37_Text: I have fourteen people on my list so far.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.93_Text: I hope it’s piling up really fast so there’s enough for <NPCName>Ollie</>, <NPCName>Archie</>, and me to make a snowman.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.95_Text: I hope it’s piling up really fast so there’s enough for <NPCName>Ollie</>, <NPCName>Archie</>, and me to make a snowman.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.91_Text: I hope there’s enough for <NPCName>Oliver</>, <NPCName>Archie</>, and me to make a snowman.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.43_Text: I learned a lot about trees, cutting wood, and making things that day.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.168_Text: I like going to Dad’s house. Nana and Papa live right next door, and I get to see them all the time!//<portrait=happy>Plus, in the Summer, Nana always has lots of starfruits growing in her garden.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.78_Text: I like pies too, but only the pumpkin kind…
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.112_Text: I like to be outside with the bugs.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.65_Text: I like to be outside with the bugs.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.13_Text: I like to wear my hair down. Just like my mom!//<portrait=normal>And Aunt <NPCName>Alice</> too.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.8_Text: I love cats. They're so fluffy and adorable.//<portrait=happy>Especially when they do that purr thing…
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.108_Text: I need to find Mom’s extra scarf for my snowman.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.161_Text: I never ever want to leave. I want to live with Mom forever and ever!
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.17_Text: I play at the beach most of the weekend, but that’s not all!//I also like to go to the library with <NPCName>Archie</>.//His mom says the beach is too far for him, so we can only play in Starlet Town.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.5_Text: I play at the beach with <NPCName>Oliver</> after school.//<portrait=happy>So much fun!//<portrait=normal>But then, we get hungry after a while, so we go home.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.4_Text: I saw Uncle <NPCName>Rafael</> yesterday. He came to visit us at the inn.//<portrait=annoyed>Every time I see him, he always asks me about school… Like every week!
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.152_Text: I still don’t know what I wanna be when I grow up.//<portrait=happy>Maybe I’ll be a blacksmith like Nana and Papa!
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.139_Text: I think I can give this to <NPCName>Mr. Barnes</> as my writing project.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.121_Text: I think if Aunt <NPCName>Alice</> had a daughter, she’d look like me… Don’t you?
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.35_Text: I usually finish up my reading stuff on Saturday. So I get to play all day on Sunday.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.116_Text: I wanna play with the cats…//<portrait=doubt>But they don’t go out very much.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.124_Text: I was just thinking about <NPCName>Nina</>'s fancy hats.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.55_Text: I wish I had a twin, just like Mom and Aunt <NPCName>Alice</>… That would be double awesome.//We could play all day and get a double amount of snacks.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.54_Text: I wonder what Mom’s cooking for dinner tonight. I sure hope it isn’t edamame again.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.48_Text: I'm allowed to play after school as long as I finish my reading.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.11_Text: I'm not gonna cut my hair, ever. I want it to be super long like Mom's.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.41_Text: I'm only allowed to go to the forest with an adult, like Aunt <NPCName>Alice</>, or when <NPCName>Archie</> asks his dad to go with us.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.130_Text: I've started writing all my best jokes and riddles.//One day, I'll put them in a book.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.100_Text: If <NPCName>Oliver’s</> up for it, I think we might play some volleyball after school.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.137_Text: If I publish it and we’re famous, we can make another one so we get even more famous!
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.115_Text: If you have an extra Winter hat, you can put it on your snowman to make it fancy!
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.136_Text: If you have good farmer jokes, let me know. I might put them in my book.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.47_Text: It's not really safe for me to explore when it's dark. So I gotta be home before dinner.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.169_Text: It’s fun here too, but at Dad’s house, I get to plant all kinds of things.//Flowers…starfruits! Dad has a garden at his house.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.36_Text: It’s hard to remember birthdays, so I keep a list of my friends’ birthdays in my room.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.101_Text: It’s no fun playing volleyball alone.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.138_Text: I’m busy collecting riddles and jokes right now.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.150_Text: I’m going to paint the prettiest painting in the world. It’ll have birds, and all kinds of flowers, and robot scarecrows.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.146_Text: I’m going to write the prettiest poem in the world and send it to Nana.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.52_Text: I’m kinda small right now, but I’m eating my vegetables and keeping active, so I’m on my way to becoming big and strong.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.143_Text: I’m not good at mini golf yet, but Dad says I have a strong swing.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.18_Text: Living at the inn is awesome.//You get to meet so many nice people!
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.151_Text: Maybe not today… I’m having too much fun.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.171_Text: Mom borrows Aunt <NPCName>Alice’s</> boots sometimes.//They’re very pretty and comfy. I wanna wear them too when my feet are bigger.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.128_Text: Mom doesn't like it when I use her stuff to dress up the scarecrows.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.102_Text: Mom gets pretty upset when I forget my lunch at home.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.30_Text: Mom makes green smoothies, and five minutes later, she forgets about it.//And then she goes and makes another one…
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.34_Text: Mom makes green smoothies, and five minutes later, she forgets about it.//And then she goes and makes another one…
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.39_Text: Mom said Hillside Vineyard is better for <NPCName>Taco</>, 'cause he can run around and play with other animals.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.157_Text: Mom says a wool hat isn’t for snowmen.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.27_Text: Mom says coffee keeps you up at night, and too much gives you a headache.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.129_Text: My clothes are too small, so I gotta use hers.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.44_Text: My dad can only visit a couple of days a week, so he isn’t here most of the time.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.23_Text: My dad says I surf better than he does, and if I keep practicing, I might just be the best surfer in the whole world!
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.12_Text: My mom always packs my lunch for school.//<portrait=doubt>She says lunch first, snacks second… Oh well.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.73_Text: My mom is letting me go to <NPCName>Bree’s</> early on the 28th to play with Taco and <NPCName>Archie</>.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.59_Text: My mom said I don’t have to bring anything yet for the Cherry Blossom Festival.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.28_Text: My parents say we shouldn’t talk to strangers… Um…
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.80_Text: Oh! I didn’t see you there, <PlayerName>$honorifics $player</>!//I was just singing my rain song to get it to rain more.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.70_Text: Oh, finally! I get to dress up snowmen now and not just scarecrows.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.89_Text: Oh, sorry. I’m afraid of thunder. Gotta go.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.87_Text: Oh, sorry. I’m afraid of thunder. I bet you’re not afraid of anything.//I mean, you live on a farm, and you make your own food!
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.117_Text: Oh, they live over there. At the house behind the welcome sign.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.113_Text: Oh, you too?//<portrait=happy>I’m not surprised. You kinda smell like one too.//It’s a good thing! I wish I smelled like bugs.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.20_Text: On the weekend, you can see <NPCName>Taco</> chilling at the town center.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.144_Text: One day, when I'm all grown up, I wanna buy my own island.//Me, Mom, and all my pets will live there!
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.76_Text: Psst… My mom’s and Aunt <NPCName>Alice’s</> birthdays are coming up on the 27th.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.149_Text: She didn’t exactly say the word “magical.” But they sound magical, don’t they?
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.72_Text: She helps <NPCName>Mr. Barnes</> a lot with our school projects and knows a lot of good books.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.7_Text: She showed us how to make fish tacos, but I already knew how 'cause Mom taught me first.//So, didn't learn anything new there.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.170_Text: Some of my clothes are still at Dad’s house.//I keep my fairy dress there because Nana and I put on fairy dresses in Spring and bless the garden before we start planting for the year.//<portrait=happy>Nana is cool!
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.14_Text: Sometimes I get to stay up till ten.//<portrait=doubt>But not too much, 'cause Mom and Dad say I get grumpy in the morning if I stay up too late too late.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.120_Text: Sometimes I wish Mom could play with me more and not be so busy with the inn.//<portrait=doubt>Aunt <NPCName>Alice</> is not that fun. I don’t wanna play with her too much.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.3_Text: Sometimes school is boring.//<portrait=annoyed>You read all these hard books all the time. Blech!
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.98_Text: Sometimes, I want to be a scientist like <NPCName>Ling</>…//<portrait=normal>So I can have my own lab and study whatever I want and tell people about it.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.154_Text: That’s pretty cool! I kinda wish my dad could be around more to teach me cool things.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.104_Text: The inn is too far away for <NPCName>Archie</>, so we meet up here to read the new comic books.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.106_Text: The inn is too far away for <NPCName>Archie</>, so we meet up here to read the new comic books.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.131_Text: Then I'll sell the book and get loads of money to buy my own inn.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.66_Text: There are more seashells at the beach in Summer, by the way…
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.77_Text: They both love minced jackfruit pies, so I asked <NPCName>Archie’s</> mom to help me bake some as a surprise.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.21_Text: This one time, my mom made ice cream from tofu.//<portrait=sad>It was <Italic>not</> yummy.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.62_Text: This one time, we went to visit <NPCName>Jack</> at his ranch, and we got to learn about animal farming the whole day.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.71_Text: Tomorrow is <NPCName>Millie’s</> birthday… She’s the one who works at the library.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.105_Text: Umm… <NPCName>Millie</> gives us cookies and milk sometimes too.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.107_Text: Umm… <NPCName>Millie</> gives us cookies and milk sometimes too.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.29_Text: Umm… I don’t have anything to say.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.67_Text: Umm… Or at least, it feels like it, anyway. I seem to be collecting more lately.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.2_Text: Umm… Yeah, it’s really fun here.//<portrait=happy>You get to fly kites and build snowmen in Winter!
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.148_Text: Um… They’re called beacons… It sounds like “bacon!”//Anyway, there’s also all kinds of magical kelp that can help our island get healthier.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.74_Text: We also get to pretend to be farmers! <NPCName>Archie</> and I get to water the vines and pick grapes.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.110_Text: We borrow books from the library for guests to read.//I help Aunt <NPCName>Alice</> by taking them back on the weekends when I meet <NPCName>Archie</>.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.31_Text: We don’t have any homework. Just a book to read over the weekend.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.158_Text: Well, if a wool hat won’t do, Mom’s green scarf might look fancy on my snowman.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.25_Text: When I ask <NPCName>Yuri</> about one of her tattoos, she tells me superlong stories.//<portrait=happy>And then at the end, she yells, “Psych!” really loud… She’s so funny!
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.90_Text: Yay! It’s snowing. I can’t wait to see how deep the snow is tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.125_Text: Yeah, so… <NPCName>Nina</> said I could borrow her hats for dress-up.//She has so many that I can use some for my snowmen. Do you have fancy hats too?
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.114_Text: You need to make sure the head of the snowman is a smaller ball than the body.
DT_Dialogue_ValentinaProduction.51_Text: You’re not small, <PlayerName>$honorifics $player</>! Someday, I’m going to be big and strong too.

DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.61_Text: <NPCName>Chaem</>? I’m not sure where she is. Why?//<portrait=annoyed>You should try the beach. She might be there practicing.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.113_Text: <NpcName>Chaem</> was going around covered in snow this morning. Boggles my mind why she doesn’t brush it off.//She likes it, I guess. Maybe it’s good for her training or something like that.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.166_Text: <NpcName>Chaem’s</> always on the move, always at the beach.//And somehow, she still finds time to nab my food.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.84_Text: <NpcName>Erika</> said the color is fitting for the “crispy season” now. I assumed she meant Fall.//<portrait=normal>I don’t really care about my hair fitting the season. Does it fit <Italic>my face</>?//Also, why is Fall “crispy”?
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.216_Text: <NpcName>Raj</> is always going on about wanting to put flowers in their beard, but I’ve yet to see them actually do it.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.168_Text: <NpcName>Takeba</> lives alone, so I sort of keep an eye on him.//He has this habit of lounging outside the bathhouse. I often have to nudge him to go inside when it gets late.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.239_Text: <NpcName>Takeba’s</> memory is spotty. He lost his son in a war, but he often forgets that.//<portrait=sad>It makes me worry about Dad. I hope it doesn’t ever get to that.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.65_Text: <PlayerName>$player</>! Are you going to the Cherry Blossom Festival?
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.21_Text: <PlayerName>$player</>! I’ll be at the Tavern tonight, playing pool with the gang.//<portrait=normal>You should join us!
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.1_Text: <PlayerName>$player</>? Did I say it right?//I’m <NPCName>Wakuu</>. It’s a pleasure to meet you. Dad told me about you. He’s the one who brought you here on the chicken boat.//<portrait=happy>Yep, the one with the hat.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.183_Text: A customer asked for a decaf espresso the other day, and <NpcName>Raj</>'s face was a mix of confusion and disbelief.//<portrait=annoyed>I can't say I blame them though, that's like asking for a soda without the fizz!
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.89_Text: Accidentally stepped in a puddle when I went outside with no shoes this morning.//<portrait=concerned>And now I can’t feel the toes on my right foot. Dang it!
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.230_Text: After I’m done with this, though.//Finishing up a round here.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.225_Text: Ah, let’s face it, it wouldn’t be as enjoyable. Who am I kidding?!//<portrait=happy>Half of the fun is playing right here.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.182_Text: Ah, the aroma of freshly brewed coffee and the gentle island breeze.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.205_Text: And get this, I’m pretty sure I’m sitting in a legit boat. <NpcName>Sunny’s</> all about that thrift-store lifestyle!
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.240_Text: And if it ever does happen and I’m not here, I hope the people in this town take care of him like they do <NpcName>Takeba</>.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.97_Text: And since bamboo shoots only grow during Spring, that makes them a rare find, doesn’t it?//<portrait=happy>All right, don’t quote me on the “only grow during Spring” bit. I’m not sure about that one.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.139_Text: And the problem is he won’t keep his opinions to himself.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.208_Text: Apologies for the dirty hands. What’s up, <PlayerName>$Player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.221_Text: Are you cold? Want my jacket?//<portrait=happy>Make sure you don’t stay out too late today, all right?
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.215_Text: Are you sure? Okay.//<portrait=normal>I don’t want bugs coming in. It’s hard to get rid of them once they’re inside.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.153_Text: As he’s getting older, I feel like it’s becoming more important than ever for us to have a good relationship, but at the same time, it’s becoming harder and <Italic>harder</> to achieve.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.112_Text: Being out in the snow isn’t too bad.//It’s cold, but it’s not as cold as I thought it would be.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.43_Text: Brrrr. My toes are going numb!
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.143_Text: But now I can see that I didn’t have a lot of time to just be a kid.//If I ever have kids of my own, I want their experience to be different.//<portrait=blushing>I want them to have the freedom to explore and enjoy the world around them and to have plenty of opportunities to just be kids.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.228_Text: By the way, I have a running tab at the bar. Feel free to put your order on it, <PlayerName>$Player</>.//<portrait=normal>Just let <NpcName>Frank</> know.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.15_Text: Can you believe Spring’s almost over? It really flew by, didn’t it?
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.63_Text: Can you tell the difference between a star and a planet when you look at the night sky?//I guess it takes some practice.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.60_Text: Can’t talk right now. I have some numbers in my head, and I don’t want to lose them!//Gotta run to my computer and do some calculations.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.27_Text: Can’t talk right now.//I have some numbers in my head, and I don’t want to lose them!
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.40_Text: Cleaning all the dead leaves off the telescope is such a pain.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.219_Text: Conferences aren’t really my thing, but they do have their perks.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.116_Text: Dad’s not too thrilled about the moss on the lighthouse. He’s afraid it’s after his plants.//No matter how much we try to remove it, it keeps coming back. It’s moss, for crying out loud!
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.2_Text: Did I hear a Pokyo accent?//<portrait=normal>Oh, you are? Where in Pokyo are you from?
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.154_Text: Did you know if you discover a star, you get to give it a name?
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.201_Text: Do you ever notice how cats are always on the roofs here in Starlet Town?//<portrait=surprised>Don’t believe me? I bet you fifty coins the brown cat is on top of <NpcName>Sam’s</> roof right now.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.83_Text: Does this hair color suit me, you think? I might dye it a different color, if not.//But I have to leave it a couple weeks. Might have to wait till Winter.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.241_Text: Don’t slip going down the stairs!
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.77_Text: Don’t tell him I said that, though.//<portrait=sad>I don’t want him to know I’ve been thinking about it. He’d take it wrong.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.117_Text: Even with all the moss, I think the lighthouse is in great shape. It’s an old building. But that doesn’t matter.//<Italic>Nothing</> will ever be good enough for him.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.52_Text: Ever tried cenil? It’s so good!//I’ve been a fan since I was a kid.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.64_Text: For one thing, stars are like dots, but planets are more spherical.//Stars cast their own light, like our sun, but planets reflect light. Also, stars twinkle. Planets don’t.//<portrait=happy>Sorry I got carried away talking about stars. I hope I didn’t bore you.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.47_Text: Gah! I <Italic>need</> to go to the Coffee Corner in front of Fishensips tomorrow.//<portrait=normal>The coffee is great, and nothing compares to their muffins!
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.90_Text: Gah! I’ll be sure to always wear shoes from now on.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.88_Text: Gloves aren’t for me. They feel weird on my hands. Hate the way they feel.//<portrait=annoyed>Not just that. They make my hands even colder. How is that possible?
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.173_Text: Good thing I keep my hair short, considering the number of times I've dyed it.//<portrait=happy>It's a bit fried, but luckily, it grows out fast.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.135_Text: Grab a drink with me at the Tavern tonight, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.29_Special: Great! You should stop by and see what I’m growing.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.70_Text: Growing up on a boat was tough. I didn’t have any friends my own age.//It might have stunted my social development.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.72_Text: Ha ha, see? I say awkward things, and then the conversation just sort of…
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.185_Text: Have you ever tried garlic jam?
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.224_Text: Having a pool table at home might be fun!
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.126_Text: He took it personally. It didn’t matter how much I tried to explain I really love astronomy.//<portrait=concerned>What I wanted didn’t seem to matter to him.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.32_Text: Honestly, even though I live right next to the hot spring, I hardly ever go there.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.236_Text: Hopefully, it won’t rain this weekend.//Kinda in the mood for fishing.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.93_Text: How do you keep moisturized in the dry Winter weather?//<portrait=annoyed>I’m drinking extra water, but it but it doesn’t seem to help. My hands feel like they’re made of ceramic that’s about to crack.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.28_Text: How’s it going at your farm, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.144_Text: I always enjoy talking to you.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.120_Text: I chatted with <NpcName>Aaliyah</> once, and she’s gotta be one of the smartest people I’ve ever met.//<portrait=normal>It must take a lot of work to be that knowledgeable and accomplished.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.245_Text: I could hang out here for hours. I just need to keep a watchful eye on the cat.//Don’t want it to end up scratching you.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.156_Special: I could see a star named Wakuu.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.227_Text: I don’t always come here for a drink. Sometimes it’s nice to just chill or play pool.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.115_Text: I don’t know what it’s gonna be, but I can feel it coming.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.146_Text: I don’t mean to be forward, but you have a certain something that makes me want to get to know you better.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.222_Text: I don’t want you to get sick.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.145_Text: I find myself thinking about you quite often. You have an unforgettable presence.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.160_Text: I got my dad some bright-yellow rubber boots to wear during Summer, but I think they might be triggering his fashion sense.//<portrait=concerned>He’s used to wearing those clunky, thick boots all year round, poor guy.//<portrait=happy>I guess the obnoxiously yellow color just adds insult to injury.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.165_Text: I got some stuff to decorate the observatory. I don’t mind at all.//The least I can do is take good care of it.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.56_Text: I grew up on my dad’s fishing boat, the <Italic>Pithy Mermaid</>. It was a pretty unique childhood, let me tell you!
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.152_Text: I grew up without a mother, so Dad is the only family I have.//<portrait=concerned>It’s tough that we don’t always get along, because without him, I’d be completely alone.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.155_Text: I guess so, yeah. Though it doesn’t seem as exciting as getting to name a star after yourself.//<portrait=happy>Personally, I’d rather have a star named after me than a disease.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.79_Text: I guess they shouldn’t have been taking me into taverns at such a young age.//<portrait=normal>But no one ever stopped us!
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.86_Text: I had some pumpkin pie earlier today. The neighbor baked one too many and sent us some.//It was good, yeah. Nothing special, but yeah.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.242_Text: I have nothing against <NpcName>Mayor Connor</>, but sometimes I wish we could have a younger person in charge.//<portrait=normal>Give the next generation a chance to lead, right?
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.24_Text: I know they’re good for me, but…green smoothies? Ugh. Can’t stand them.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.78_Text: I learned how to play pool when I was young.//Some of the <Italic>Pithy Mermaid</>’s crew taught me when we were in port.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.123_Text: I like being out in nature. Growing up on a boat probably had something to do with it.//When I’m indoors, I feel like the walls are squeezing in on me.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.85_Text: I like your Fall outfit.//It looks nice.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.212_Text: I like your hair. Did you do something new to it?
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.41_Text: I live at the observatory with my housemate, <NPCName>Chaem</>. Feel free to stop by any time!
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.57_Text: I mean, it’s the only childhood I had, so it felt normal to me.//<portrait=normal>But I was always jealous of other kids who went to school and played sports…all that regular stuff.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.192_Text: I might go for a walk later. I need to clear my mind.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.210_Text: I need to grab some eggs and milk before heading to Dad’s this weekend.//<portrait=normal>Maybe I’ll just do it on the way back.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.38_Text: I need to make sure Dad’s heater works properly this Winter.//<portrait=concerned>I’ll order him some extra blankets too, maybe.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.218_Text: I prefer reading in the observatory because there are way too many distractions here.//<portrait=annoyed>It’s hard to concentrate.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.82_Text: I saw <NpcName>Takeba</> talking to some guy yesterday, mistaking him for his son again.//<portrait=sad>Poor man must really miss his son.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.5_Text: I see… The busy part. The place with lots of cars and tall buildings, I bet.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.99_Text: I should go to <NpcName>Sam’s</> and get some seeds for the lighthouse patch. We’re running out.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.169_Text: I spotted one of the cats leaping onto the roof the other day.//Nearly gave me a heart attack.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.226_Text: I think <NpcName>Pablo’s</> my toughest competitor when it comes to pool.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.95_Text: I think bamboo shoots only grow during Spring, which means we’ve got less than a week to gather them.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.130_Text: I think my dad feels the same way about the sea.//He wants to keep sailing until he reaches the end of it.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.197_Text: I tried to bake muffins for you. They were going to be my masterpiece. But, um, I failed.//<portrait=sad>The whole batch tasted horrible.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.59_Text: I tried to get in some stargazing last night, but it was too cloudy. Disappointing.//<portrait=normal>The Winter sky, huh?
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.19_Text: I try to visit my dad every weekend.//<portrait=normal>It might sound old-fashioned, but I kind of see it as my duty to check in on him and make sure he has what he needs.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.87_Text: I walked past the cemetery last week, and it was mossy! Dead leaves everywhere. But then it was all nice and clean yesterday.//I think the <NpcName>Sanchez</> brothers are working extra hard cleaning it up this Fall. Good men.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.127_Text: I was always the good kid, growing up. I didn’t want to let my dad down.//<portrait=sad>When you disappoint him, he lets you know it!
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.34_Text: I was gardening with my dad yesterday, and his plants are looking pretty unhappy.//<portrait=concerned>Maybe you can go over there and give him some pointers.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.162_Text: I was just reading up on this new theory about dark matter.//<portrait=happy>It’s mind-boggling how much we don’t know about the universe. Makes you feel small, doesn’t it?
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.128_Text: I went a little crazy in college. I guess I was rebelling. But I think I’ve settled into a decent person.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.174_Text: I'm not big into surfing, but give me a beach to chill on, and I can lose hours.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.48_Text: I'm pretty sure <NpcName>Raj</> gets the coffee beans locally, but I can't say for sure.//If you're curious, just ask them! I don't think they'd mind sharing that info.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.96_Text: If I remember correctly, my dad once mentioned you can only find bamboo shoots in the bamboo forest.//It’s right behind the observatory and around the hot spring.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.207_Text: If I still have any energy after this, I might head out and do a little fishing.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.75_Text: If I’d become a fisher like my dad wanted, I’d have to be out at sea. But an astronomer has more freedom. There are stars wherever you go.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.101_Text: If I’m right, wasabi only grows during Spring, which means we have less than two weeks to gather it.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.184_Text: If you ever want a sugary coffee concoction with caramel, apple powder, or anything fancy like that, don’t bother asking <NpcName>Raj</>.//<portrait=annoyed>They’re a firm believer in the purity of “real coffee” and won’t hesitate to give you a lecture about it!//I went down that road, trust me. Not worth it.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.246_Text: If you had to choose, who would you elect as mayor?
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.217_Text: If you’re planning to eat your muffin here, keep an eye on it.//The seagulls around this place are cheeky, and they’ll snatch it in a heartbeat.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.248_Text: Interesting choice.//He seems a bit too chill to be a mayor, but that’s just my opinion.//<portrait=happy>He’d make an <Italic>interesting</> mayor, I’ll admit.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.105_Text: Is it corn season yet? Do you grow it on your farm?
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.213_Text: Is it stuffy in here? I can open some windows if you want.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.203_Text: It always smells ridiculously good in here.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.159_Text: It doesn’t seem warm enough, huh?
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.170_Text: It was the orange one. That kitty’s got some serious spunk!
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.25_Text: It’s always amazed me that when we look at the stars, we’re seeing light from thousands of years ago.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.16_Text: It’s been great spending so much time outdoors.//I like Summer too, but Spring’s my favorite season.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.18_Text: It’s crisp and kind of…spicy?//<portrait=happy>I don’t know what it is, but it makes me want to spend all day hiking in the woods.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.137_Text: It’s more than fourteen million miles wide. That’s around seventeen times the size of the sun! How did that black hole get there? How did it get so big?
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.62_Text: It’s really beautiful this time of year. Peaceful too.//<portrait=happy>Spring is truly special here.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.111_Text: It’s snowing, isn’t it? You have snow on your nose.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.214_Special: It’s stuffy, yeah. I could use some air.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.7_Text: I’d love to chat, but I don’t want to make you stand out here in the rain.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.8_Text: I’d love to chat, but I don’t want to make you stand out here in the rain.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.10_Text: I’d love to chat, but I don’t want to make you stand out here in the storm.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.11_Text: I’d love to chat, but I don’t want to make you stand out here in the storm.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.103_Text: I’d totally camp out more often if it weren’t for all those giant mosquitos.//<portrait=annoyed>But hey, I do live in the middle of the forest, so I guess I can’t really blame them when I’m the one crashing their party.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.36_Text: I’m expecting more rain in Summer.//Let’s hope my expectations are met.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.244_Text: I’m glad Starlet Town decided against constructing that tourist podium.//Can you imagine the throngs of people? It would seriously be hard to get anything productive done.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.13_Text: I’m glad for this rain. The plants needed it.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.53_Text: I’m going to send you some cenil sometime. I hope that’s okay with you.//<portrait=happy>Don’t worry, it won’t be my cooking, so you can feast without fear! Heh heh!
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.151_Text: I’m looking forward to New Year’s. It feels good to start over with a clean slate.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.114_Text: I’m nervous about seeing my dad this weekend.//I just know he’s gonna find something to criticize.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.206_Text: I’m spending the weekend with my dad.//We spent the whole morning tackling those pesky weeds in the vegetable patch.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.100_Text: I’m thinking of buying radish seeds…or maybe strawberries. What’s better? They’re Spring seeds, aren’t they?//Which one do you think my dad would like?
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.164_Text: I’m too lazy to make my own bread.// <NPCName>Sam’s</> is fine.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.191_Text: I’ve been reading this fascinating book on quantum physics, and it’s mind boggling how our perception of reality can be challenged by the tiniest particles in the universe.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.136_Text: I’ve been reading up on black holes to prepare for my presentation, and I’m getting excited about them all over again!//<portrait=happy>For example, did you know there’s a supermassive black hole at the core of our galaxy? It’s dormant now, but it was probably much more active a few million years ago.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.195_Text: I’ve been studying the latest advancements in astrophysics, and it’s mind-blowing how our understanding of the universe keeps expanding.//<portrait=normal>The more we discover, the more questions arise.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.76_Text: I’ve been thinking about where else I might live if my dad weren’t here.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.231_Text: I’ve been told the cake here is amazing, especially the red velvet.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.66_Text: I’ve been trying to get my dad to come, but he doesn’t want to.//<portrait=sad>Maybe you can help me convince him.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.176_Text: I’ve been working on a new theory about wormholes and their potential for interstellar travel.//<portrait=surprised>It’s like unlocking the secret to the universe’s very own express lane.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.50_Text: I’ve cut back on eating fish, but I’ve gotta admit, I still love me some salmon.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.202_Text: I’ve got no clue what I’m eating, honestly. Didn’t order a thing.//<portrait=concerned><NpcName>Jim</> just kinda popped out and handed me this and gave Dad that…<Italic>soup</>?
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.178_Text: I’ve mastered the art of beach bumming.//<portrait=normal>No schedules, no deadlines, just me and a book. Any book. It doesn’t even need to be a good one.//And the endless expanse of the ocean.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.237_Text: I’ve noticed a fair number of people coming in and out of the bathhouse today.//They’re likely popping by to check on <NpcName>Takeba</>.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.54_Text: I’ve tried so many fruits in my life, but mangoes will always be my number one favorite.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.238_Text: Keeping busy with the hot spring seems to be good for <NpcName>Takeba</>.//<portrait=happy>I think he enjoys looking after it.//<portrait=normal>Gives him a sense of purpose, something to do.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.155_Special: Kind of like with a disease.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.51_Text: Know what I could go for right now? A vegan taco.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.190_Text: Last week, I found a four-leaf clover just outside the vineyard.//<portrait=annoyed>Too bad I didn’t have a hoe so I could dig it up and see what was hiding under it.//Missed out on that!
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.118_Text: Living in an inn like <NpcName>Raj</> sounds kinda nice, especially during these crazy snowstorms.//They said the heater works <Italic>most</> of the time, and if not, the twins make sure everyone has extra blankets.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.142_Text: Looking back, I realize I had a pretty conservative upbringing.//Not that I knew it at the time, since I didn’t have anything to compare it to.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.211_Text: Make yourself at home. Sit, sit!
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.94_Text: Maybe it’s not the dryness, could be the dish soap. We bought the cheapest one.//<portrait=annoyed>I’ll start wearing gloves when I do dishes. That should help.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.35_Text: Maybe we overwatered them.//I don’t know.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.186_Text: Me neither. It sounds pretty gross, huh?
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.249_Text: Me? Wow! Thank you. I’m really flattered.//<portrait=normal>But I don’t think I’d make a good mayor.//<NpcName>Millie</> might. Or <NpcName>Sam</>.//They both seem wise.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.17_Text: Mmm, Fall. I just love the way the air smells this time of year.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.138_Text: My dad and I haven’t been getting along so well lately.//<portrait=concerned>He just can’t understand why I wanted to go into astronomy rather than taking over for him on the <Italic>Pithy Mermaid</>.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.234_Text: My dad thinks you’re a great farmer, <PlayerName>$Player</>.//He has a lot of respect for you.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.30_Text: Nah, I’m sure you have it under control. You seem like someone who stays on top of things.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.167_Text: Nearly became a one-footed astrophysicist yesterday.//<portrait=annoyed>Woke up to find a rogue dumbbell in the kitchen, and let’s just say, my little toe made quite the painful introduction.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.158_Text: Next week is already Fall. I might need to change my hair color to match the season. Maybe a warm shade.//I’m thinking dark purple.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.186_Special: No, not about to try it either.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.134_Text: Now it’s Spring, I guess you’ll be busier on the farm.//<portrait=concerned>I hope it doesn’t mean we won’t see each other as much.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.214_Text: Now that I think about it, I don’t want bugs coming in. Sorry!//<portrait=normal>But I agree it does get stuffy in here.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.124_Text: Of course, work sometimes requires me to be inside.//But my favorite workdays – or work nights, rather – are the ones I spend outside, studying the universe.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.220_Text: Oh! I happened to sit next to Stellar Hawkings once at a conference in Pokyo.//<portrait=happy>It was the only empty seat, but <Italic>dang</>, that was a lucky break! Got to chat with him and everything!
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.4_Text: Oh, right, the thingy… Yes, of course.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.30_Special: Okay, I guess. Sometimes I think I’m in over my head.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.74_Text: One nice thing about being an astronomer is you can do it anywhere.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.109_Text: One of the good things about living at the observatory is you can hear the bugs singing on Summer nights.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.49_Text: One reason why traveling is cool is that the constellations look different depending on where you are!//<portrait=happy>Isn’t that wild?
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.157_Text: Oops! Sorry about that. I didn’t mean to.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.188_Text: Pets are <Italic>all right</>. They seem like a lot of work, though.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.104_Text: Plus, it’s Summer right now, which is basically bug season.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.180_Text: Pro tip from a beach veteran: Bring your own chair!//<portrait=blushing>Saves you from a case of sun-toasted buns.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.108_Text: Pulling up trash when you’re fishing isn’t a waste. That’s one less piece of garbage in the water for fish to eat.//It really does make a difference.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.132_Text: Rainy days like this are a good time to get work done and catch up on my reading, but I just hate being cooped up indoors.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.44_Text: Seems like it’s been snowing for days…
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.69_Text: Some of my most memorable Summers were spent at sea, I have to admit.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.26_Text: Some of the stars we see don’t even exist anymore!//They burned out long ago. It just took this long for the light to reach us.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.67_Text: Sometimes I miss the Summer sunsets on the <Italic>Pithy Mermaid</>. We had a panoramic view.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.121_Text: Sometimes I wish I had my dad’s skills, like his green thumb or fishing instincts.//<portrait=sad>He’s just so in tune with nature, and I feel like I’m nowhere close to that.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.33_Text: Sometimes I’m too lazy to go grocery shopping.//<portrait=concerned>I just eat whatever we have, or I eat at the Tavern and stick the leftovers in the fridge.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.22_Text: Spring, finally! I’ve been itching to spend some nice days outdoors.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.46_Text: Stay safe, okay, <PlayerName>$player</>?//Watch out for flying objects.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.68_Text: Summer days like these remind me of my childhood.//Dad and I used to spend nights looking at the stars on the <Italic>Pithy Mermaid</>.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.29_Text: Sure, I’d love to! Thanks for the invite.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.71_Text: Thanks, <PlayerName>$player</>. I always feel comfortable talking to you.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.171_Text: That dog who treats the fountain like his personal swimming pool? Yeah, he’s my neighbor’s.//<portrait=happy>I think <NpcName>Luke</> should consider building him a mini pool. The pup clearly loves water.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.58_Text: That’s why going to college was so important to me.//<portrait=happy>To reclaim some of that normalcy. You know what I mean?
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.106_Text: The Beach Cleanup Festival is important to our community.//It’s a great tradition, and I’m glad we’re keeping it going.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.81_Text: The beach cleanup last week was a win, wasn’t it? A lot of people came to help.//<portrait=normal>It was really hot, but it was worth it. We did good!
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.179_Text: The clouds look like a giant marshmallow army, plotting a fluffy rebellion against the blue sky.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.55_Text: The cold is making me crave chocolate chip muffins.//Do you want some too?
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.37_Text: The lighthouse, where my dad lives, gets really stuffy when it’s this humid.//<portrait=concerned>I try to keep the door open during the day to let the air in. Not sure if it helps or not.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.39_Text: The neighbors usually have this big dinner party at the end of Winter.//<portrait=annoyed>I won’t be able to sleep, that’s for sure. They’ll be loud all night, so I might as well go.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.107_Text: The next one’s happening on the 27th.//<portrait=annoyed>Just come to the beach whenever you’re ready, and you’ll see a bunch of people setting up water booths and stuff.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.200_Text: The night sky here is so clear, perfect for gazing at the stars.//I like it.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.199_Text: The night sky up here is clearer than it is at the beach. Perfect for star gazing.//I quite like it.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.92_Text: The observatory can get cold. For one, the building is huge, and the ceiling is <Italic>really</> high.//The heater has to work <Italic>overtime</> to keep all that space warm.//<portrait=annoyed>It’s a waste of money to run the heat in the main area, so we usually only have it on in the bedrooms.
DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.233_Text: The vegan ones, though. Vegan tacos are the <Italic>superior</> ones! Ha ha!

DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.110_Text: This wind is intense! If it were a little stronger, I think it’d be a storm.

DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.141_Text: Um… You know. Just in case you thought…well…never mind.

DT_Dialogue_Wakuu_Production.23_Text: What do you think of this weather, huh? Another gorgeous Spring day.

DT_Dialogue_Walter_Production.5D5DFEDE4757EF25075CD6879F35ABF2: Well.. I wouldnt object if, lets say, I were given it.. It is valuable regardless
DT_Dialogue_Walter_Production.D2BF0F2A410B9F8853D832AA66F9FF67: Well.. I wouldnt object if, lets say, I were given it.. It is valuable regardless
DT_Dialogue_Walter_Production.08DF88634C9E97593B080E876CC6EFE6: Well.. well. well.. the mooncake festival is right around the corner. Im intrigued to see what you have up your sleeve, farmer Player
DT_Dialogue_Walter_Production.7EDC20EB4BF5F406C0A8F2998F5D682F: Well.. well. well.. the mooncake festival is right around the corner. Im intrigued to see what you have up your sleeve, farmer Player
DT_Dialogue_Walter_Production.39_Text: Well… I can assure you I wouldn’t object if, let’s say, I were given a diamond.//<portrait=normal>It would be valuable, regardless.
DT_Dialogue_Walter_Production.53_Text: Well… I can assure you I wouldn’t object if, let’s say, I were given a diamond.//<portrait=normal>It would be valuable, regardless.
DT_Dialogue_Walter_Production.3_Text: We’re fortunate that we’re able to grow grapes all year round. Of course, that doesn’t come cheap.
DT_Dialogue_Walter_Production.7_Text: We’re fortunate that we’re able to grow grapes all year round. Of course, that doesn’t come cheap.
DT_Dialogue_Walter_Production.111_Text: We’re literally in the middle of a storm, <PlayerName>$player</>. Doesn’t it bother you?
DT_Dialogue_Walter_Production.112_Text: We’re literally in the middle of a storm, <PlayerName>$player</>. Doesn’t it bother you?
DT_Dialogue_Walter_Production.145_Text: We’re paying too much tax and wasting too much heat to keep all that empty space warm.
DT_Dialogue_Walter_Production.184_Text: What are you wearing, Farmer? Don’t cheap out on clothes during Winter.//<portrait=normal>Wear only top-of-the-line wool. It’s worth it.
DT_Dialogue_Walter_Production.7D3A4A7A407EEA2879BBEEB591F43867: What would one do at a night like this..
DT_Dialogue_Walter_Production.104_Text: What would one do on a lazy night like this?
DT_Dialogue_Walter_Production.152_Text: When <NPCName>Bree</> and I first started the vineyard… Ah, I didn’t expect much out of it.//Just a little hobby to keep <NPCName>Bree</> busy. But now…
DT_Dialogue_Walter_Production.154_Text: When <NPCName>Bree</> and I first started the vineyard… Ah, I didn’t expect much out of it.//Just a little hobby to keep <NPCName>Bree</> busy. But now…
DT_Dialogue_Walter_Production.E9329071492FA30A63BCD48E32C2408B: Yet the Good Mayor keeps doing it. Given the amount of taxes we pay, I think we should have a say on things like this. Dont you think?
DT_Dialogue_Walter_Production.78_Text: Yet the good mayor keeps doing it. Given the amount we pay in taxes, I think we should have a say about things like this. Don’t you think?
DT_Dialogue_Walter_Production.0469220141BE4D157C9554961F8DA9CD: You are a hardworker, Player. Just like my son, Luke..
DT_Dialogue_Walter_Production.0F72D5CA4D19BE152A9F9182A2E405FC: You are a hardworker, Player. Just like my son, Luke..
DT_Dialogue_Walter_Production.182_Text: You can try planting some grapes now, I hope. But careful, they wither come Winter… The ones you get from <NPCName>Sam</>’s, anyway.//The grapes in our vineyard are special. They grow all year long for some reason, not just in Fall.
DT_Dialogue_Walter_Production.27_Text: You see, because if one batch is bad, you run the risk of losing clients… Once you lose them, they may never come back.
DT_Dialogue_Walter_Production.1FB4454B437E5A6BB0FB08A06D05ECAC: You're a friend of my son, Luke, ya?
DT_Dialogue_Walter_Production.6D51EAFF4E187658C5D52EAF6C43EBD0: You're right, Im not your lawyer. The pollen is making my brain funny.
DT_Dialogue_Walter_Production.125_Text: You’re a friend of my son, <NPCName>Luke</>, right? I’ve seen you two in town several times.
DT_Dialogue_Walter_Production.164_Text: You’re a hard worker, <PlayerName>$player</>.//Just like my son, <NPCName>Luke</>.
DT_Dialogue_Walter_Production.64_Text: You’re right. I’m not your lawyer. The pollen is making my brain funny.
DT_Dialogue_Walter_Production.25A9615E477CAF8E9BF6029FDDDEEB41: oh well I guess to each their own then..
DT_Dialogue_Walter_Production.FE698A684D3A9B2735AC5C841043E332: oh well I guess to each their own then..
DT_Dialogue_Walter_Production.1331FEDD46F8692073E37DAAF783B166: umm.. The sky is clear today
DT_Dialogue_Walter_Production.0737423A4AB4F2C8572221A4E2F45B02: we only make wine and sake, yes..

DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.37_Text: *talking to his plants* There we go, my lovelies. Stretch your leaves up to the sun…
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.647E65EB404AA651B03FD288AE318AF7: *talking to his plants* There we go, my lovelies. Stretch your leaves up to the sun…
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.40_Text: *talking to his plants* ’Ere we go, my lovelies.//Some water for you, some plant food for you…
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.4C6FED304ECEB9CFFCC29B95B071F9C9: *talking to his plants* ’Ere we go, my lovelies.//Some water for you, some plant food for you…
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.66_Text: <NPCName>Wakuu</> comes around to see me often enough. I’ll give the boy credit for that.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.E7C21AFC4391AF72B85B75ABE03C8E50: <NPCName>Wakuu</> comes around to see me often enough. I’ll give the boy credit for that.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.73_Text: <NPCName>Wakuu</> spent most of his childhood on the <Italic>Pithy Mermaid</> with me.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.8B5068D9443AD11127F89AAE9EF4CCE3: <NPCName>Wakuu</> spent most of his childhood on the <Italic>Pithy Mermaid</> with me.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.82_Text: <NPCName>Wakuu</> told me he wouldn’t mind if he never sets foot on a boat again.//Breaks my heart, it does.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.9BA612A442AEB0825C70EE8D8BE5CA6E: <NPCName>Wakuu</> told me he wouldn’t mind if he never sets foot on a boat again.//Breaks my heart, it does.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.55_Text: <NPCName>Wakuu’s</> been going on about the Cherry Blossom Festival. He wants me to go with him.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.E9EDA0CB48996DF471A9CBAD0EFE16D1: <NPCName>Wakuu’s</> been going on about the Cherry Blossom Festival. He wants me to go with him.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.143399A0452A6B9AA4E313B61AD37949: A fine lass, but she wasn’t around.//<portrait=normal>Ah, never mind. Not worth dredging up the past.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.79_Text: A fine lass, but she wasn’t around.//<portrait=normal>Ah, never mind. Not worth dredging up the past.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.101_Text: A lot of tales on this island… Take it from me. Out of sight, out of mind.//That’s how I live my life.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.A16C2EC24477B96FAC5A4993712809A9: A lot of tales on this island… Take it from me. Out of sight, out of mind.//That’s how I live my life.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.27_Text: And so messy! Putting a food that melts on top of a cone so it can drip all over your hands in the hot sun… I just never understood the appeal.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.BB6BE7C543C602E7F6A3F79DC3E19F5C: And so messy! Putting a food that melts on top of a cone so it can drip all over your hands in the hot sun… I just never understood the appeal.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.58_Text: And the trash! By the end of my time on the boat, some days we’d haul up more garbage than fish.//<portrait=normal>That’s when I knew it was time to retire. Let the new generation take the helm.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.657440584E19A84033F01590E0DF6567: And the trash! By the end of my time on the boat, some days we’d haul up more garbage than fish.//<portrait=normal>That’s when I knew it was time to retire. Let the new generation take the helm.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.52_Text: And then the boat rises up, up, up out of the water. I thought we were riding a swell!//<portrait=concerned>But no! It was a whale, carrying the <Italic>Pithy Mermaid</> along on its back!//I held on for dear life, I did! Then the whale dipped below the surface, and we were back in the sea.//Don’t believe me? Aye, maybe you had to be there.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.A377338C4A19D3C31BB0ADA3A1C1445D: And then the boat rises up, up, up out of the water. I thought we were riding a swell!//<portrait=concerned>But no! It was a whale, carrying the <Italic>Pithy Mermaid</> along on its back!//I held on for dear life, I did! Then the whale dipped below the surface, and we were back in the sea.//Don’t believe me? Aye, maybe you had to be there.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.102_Text: Apparently, there used to be harvest people… Small, they are. Come out during harvest season like now.//Planting around the island. I don’t know. Never seen any.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.12385EB646CF4C2D219FC09994DF12EB: Apparently, there used to be harvest people… Small, they are. Come out during harvest season like now.//Planting around the island. I don’t know. Never seen any.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.12_Text: Back in my fishing days, our nets were always full. Now yer lucky to get one bite all afternoon.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.2615BCA040109C13792C429D55782B7F: Back in my fishing days, our nets were always full. Now yer lucky to get one bite all afternoon.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.4D62E4C64508285CBB927490FD247F55: Bah. I don’t see the point.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.56_Text: Bah. I don’t see the point.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.4DAA572F4FD232DB407DC5857E24B9F4: Bah. ’Ere I go, getting sentimental.//<portrait=normal>I’m just trying to say it’s nice to chat a spell. Does get lonely around ’ere sometimes, y’know.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.64_Text: Bah. ’Ere I go, getting sentimental.//<portrait=normal>I’m just trying to say it’s nice to chat a spell. Does get lonely around ’ere sometimes, y’know.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.72_Text: But sailors are like family too. We worked hard together.//When yer riding out a storm, that’s who you want at yer back – family.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.781CF8404FE56FC5DCB53681C7D3F48C: But sailors are like family too. We worked hard together.//When yer riding out a storm, that’s who you want at yer back – family.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.67_Text: But we never have much to say. Seems we’re always butting heads, me and him.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.EFE167EA46480CCC178C1186C8799441: But we never have much to say. Seems we’re always butting heads, me and him.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.87_Text: Can you still buy seeds at <NPCName>Sam's</>? Might ask <NPCName>Wakuu</> to pick up some for the lighthouse.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.9A3971BD40AF59638E6837A48A0BDDB0: Can you still buy seeds at <NPCName>Sam's</>? Might ask <NPCName>Wakuu</> to pick up some for the lighthouse.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.15_Text: Cold weather’s blowing in from the east. We’ll see some snow before long.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.2BD9FDCD405C2A3F42594B87B74495C8: Cold weather’s blowing in from the east. We’ll see some snow before long.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.1F8891104852316A2F99F197B7298095: Did you hear something?//Like a whistling noise, coming in off the water?
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.22_Text: Did you hear something?//Like a whistling noise, coming in off the water?
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.19_Text: Don’t go sneaking up on an old man like that.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.7613CE724D39674D790BF384BABBB542: Don’t go sneaking up on an old man like that.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.75_Text: Don’t know where I went wrong. He would have been a fine fisherman.//<portrait=concerned>But instead, he had to go and become a <Italic>star</> scientist.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.8617AD7348A6D8E8CA315CAFD6BBF6A6: Don’t know where I went wrong. He would have been a fine fisherman.//<portrait=concerned>But instead, he had to go and become a <Italic>star</> scientist.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.25B1913E4540F8CAA22201A174CA79E2: Don’t tell <NPCName>Wakuu</> I said that. He’d take it all wrong.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.65_Text: Don’t tell <NPCName>Wakuu</> I said that. He’d take it all wrong.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.1_Text: Eh? Are ya looking for farming advice?//Never worked the land, myself. I’m more at home at sea.//’Cept for my plants, ’ere. My lovelies.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.59D1CE204C49CA1EC5743A940E1807D9: Eh? Are ya looking for farming advice?//Never worked the land, myself. I’m more at home at sea.//’Cept for my plants, ’ere. My lovelies.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.98_Text: Every time I look at my son, reminds me a bit of his mother. Well…//Same eyes, those two…
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.BF71D3134A0868600B8C969BF9A7B51E: Every time I look at my son, reminds me a bit of his mother. Well…//Same eyes, those two…
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.40ECC6134E741EBDED28E89543FD0C84: Finally, I stopped trying to make him stay put. The boy was obsessed with those stars, he was.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.60_Text: Finally, I stopped trying to make him stay put. The boy was obsessed with those stars, he was.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.100_Text: Gotta keep moving, even old folks like me. It’s good for yer body, yer brain.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.798472EB4E586E4E5C168E9FECB1981D: Gotta keep moving, even old folks like me. It’s good for yer body, yer brain.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.6AA62D204C84D003EE6D7DA42D2D67A0: Harvest Festival, eh? Yeah, I might see it.//<portrait=normal>I don’t like crowds, y’know. But the crops. They might be worth the trip.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.95_Text: Harvest Festival, eh? Yeah, I might see it.//<portrait=normal>I don’t like crowds, y’know. But the crops. They might be worth the trip.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.92_Text: Have some leftover blueberries from last season in the freezer. I might make some muffins with them.//My son likes those things, y’know…muffins.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.FA022D274455883CFA9DA4BB5CEB2067: Have some leftover blueberries from last season in the freezer. I might make some muffins with them.//My son likes those things, y’know…muffins.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.10_Text: He comes out here on weekends.//Sometimes he’s the only living soul I see all week.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.6142244C4CF054F0573CCF8B9D16C389: He comes out here on weekends.//Sometimes he’s the only living soul I see all week.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.83_Text: He was meant to take the helm of the <Italic>Pithy Mermaid</> someday. My own flesh and blood.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.D8E9E269455FFECD52800FB12E7F7594: He was meant to take the helm of the <Italic>Pithy Mermaid</> someday. My own flesh and blood.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.74_Text: He wasn’t more than four years old when he hooked his first parrotfish. I was proud of him, I was.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.E771BC4B4191E0755339618A4EBF3B59: He wasn’t more than four years old when he hooked his first parrotfish. I was proud of him, I was.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.7371E75D47AA91B966558196A98D3468: Heard there’s some travelers living in the forest who might have some Winter seeds. You know of this person?//<NpcName>Ken</> or something? Not <NpcName>Jack’s</> boy, is it?
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.88_Text: Heard there’s some travelers living in the forest who might have some Winter seeds. You know of this person?//<NpcName>Ken</> or something? Not <NpcName>Jack’s</> boy, is it?
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.18_Text: Holy mackerel, <PlayerName>$player</>!//You scared the barnacles off me!
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.FAF8B64B48480BF2EEDF51A2D0056FF8: Holy mackerel, <PlayerName>$player</>!//You scared the barnacles off me!
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.2957DDE44F2AF8FCF9DB8583CFC7A4A4: I appreciate yer company, <PlayerName>$player</>. I may not be a man of many words, but…
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.63_Text: I appreciate yer company, <PlayerName>$player</>. I may not be a man of many words, but…
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.93_Text: I can already feel the Summer breeze comin’ in.//Gonna be a hot one this year, I know.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.EFF18AAC423A8A346C6B3787BEE9641E: I can already feel the Summer breeze comin’ in.//Gonna be a hot one this year, I know.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.6_Text: I don’t get to Starlet much. Keep to myself ’ere at the lighthouse.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.7B684F1D4A51E7C8313CA49A7DC6D467: I don’t get to Starlet much. Keep to myself ’ere at the lighthouse.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.31519313400961CBACC760A01AD018C3: I don’t mind the snow. It’s the ice that irks me. Turns the water into land.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.34_Text: I don’t mind the snow. It’s the ice that irks me. Turns the water into land.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.71_Text: I had a motley crew on the <Italic>Pithy Mermaid</>. Sailors can be rough people.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.921EC72D4A255C17D171F6999EC178A9: I had a motley crew on the <Italic>Pithy Mermaid</>. Sailors can be rough people.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.6C99F6544F62414CCCABFAA35AF455F4: I have to say, young people like you give me some hope, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.76_Text: I have to say, young people like you give me some hope, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.77_Text: I look at you and everything you’ve done with your farm, and I think at least some of today’s young people ’ave a good head on their shoulders.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.DEA2240143E9E89A5B93CEAD4F4AC1FC: I look at you and everything you’ve done with your farm, and I think at least some of today’s young people ’ave a good head on their shoulders.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.41_Text: I need to go over to the Beach Shack and get some bait. Can’t fish without proper bait!
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.EBC7C82B49E442E38ED088AB1A102CD3: I need to go over to the Beach Shack and get some bait. Can’t fish without proper bait!
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.13_Text: I only have one mouth to feed.//But I feel for them fishermen trying to make a living these days.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.5A07D07C44EF16F68985AA9F990E0970: I only have one mouth to feed.//But I feel for them fishermen trying to make a living these days.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.1A96ED764E4EA97E32BFD29C38FE45EA: I raised <NPCName>Wakuu</> myself, y’know. His mother, well… Not much to say about her.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.78_Text: I raised <NPCName>Wakuu</> myself, y’know. His mother, well… Not much to say about her.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.26_Text: I s’pose now that Summer’s ’ere, everyone’s going to be walking around eating ice cream.//<portrait=normal>Don’t care for it, myself.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.4A488A874EB63E8E6DD5FDB336EAE774: I s’pose now that Summer’s ’ere, everyone’s going to be walking around eating ice cream.//<portrait=normal>Don’t care for it, myself.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.39_Text: I think I’ll have another.//<NPCName>Wakuu</>, have another one. You don’t eat enough.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.E476BAF4419FC67F53F20B9DEFFD52EB: I think I’ll have another.//<NPCName>Wakuu</>, have another one. You don’t eat enough.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.1FA0E03842E3C517871CA7B1EB46E5AA: I used to catch <NPCName>Wakuu</> up on deck at night, stargazing. He’d sneak out of bed!
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.59_Text: I used to catch <NPCName>Wakuu</> up on deck at night, stargazing. He’d sneak out of bed!
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.6A89DD43452B131C439F25B8102E3389: I wonder how she’s doing now.//<portrait=normal>Don’t tell <NPCName>Wakuu</>. He’s gonna get all sad.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.99_Text: I wonder how she’s doing now.//<portrait=normal>Don’t tell <NPCName>Wakuu</>. He’s gonna get all sad.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.53_Text: I wouldn’t mind it if <NPCName>Wakuu</> ran a business like <NPCName>Suki</> and <NPCName>Alice</> at the inn.//Providing a service for the people of Coral Island – That would be noble work.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.B9DF971E4F422398D7BE5BADB10442E2: I wouldn’t mind it if <NPCName>Wakuu</> ran a business like <NPCName>Suki</> and <NPCName>Alice</> at the inn.//Providing a service for the people of Coral Island – That would be noble work.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.80_Text: I would’ve given <NPCName>Wakuu</> the <Italic>Pithy Mermaid</>. The family business. But he didn’t want any part of it.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.CA9E62F54D1D1F8A4B0188B9A2001442: I would’ve given <NPCName>Wakuu</> the <Italic>Pithy Mermaid</>. The family business. But he didn’t want any part of it.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.7EB1FCAF4412A9BD5C299D9E5DB5D8EA: If you want some melons, you gotta wait until next Summer.//Fall isn’t hot enough to grow them.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.86_Text: If you want some melons, you gotta wait until next Summer.//Fall isn’t hot enough to grow them.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.5FB2AAD248C0E88D8A5C6384BEE1FA3D: It’s all right… Wouldn’t go anyway.//Got nothing to wear.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.97_Text: It’s all right… Wouldn’t go anyway.//Got nothing to wear.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.35_Text: It’s hard to garden with snow everywhere.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.8B1155404D212C98589787B05A86F797: It’s hard to garden with snow everywhere.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.3FBADE6B484206EB0AB6FFB55AC70FDC: I’m getting ready to weed my lovelies. Planting juicy berries next season, I think.//What about yer farm? Berries this Summer?
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.94_Text: I’m getting ready to weed my lovelies. Planting juicy berries next season, I think.//What about yer farm? Berries this Summer?
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.7_Text: I’m not too fond of people, if you want to know the truth.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.AD354D5F4706992D2CC9A1B16A6FE1E8: I’m not too fond of people, if you want to know the truth.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.57_Text: I’ve seen the fishing change around here. Used to be we’d catch hundreds of crabs in a day.//The sea was brimming with ’em. But the waters have changed. Fewer of those fat, beautiful crabs, more bottom-feeders.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.927ED2FC4EC11080D97840BA7A703E33: I’ve seen the fishing change around here. Used to be we’d catch hundreds of crabs in a day.//The sea was brimming with ’em. But the waters have changed. Fewer of those fat, beautiful crabs, more bottom-feeders.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.21_Text: Just because I’m an old crank doesn’t mean I can’t enjoy nature.//Humph.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.470AEE874869332E9CAF99B277A003EE: Just because I’m an old crank doesn’t mean I can’t enjoy nature.//Humph.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.62_Text: Just making a little joke there, <PlayerName>$player</>. I ’aven’t even read it.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.A53B21E54294719911D0A59E2ACBD09C: Just making a little joke there, <PlayerName>$player</>. I ’aven’t even read it.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.89_Text: Keep seeing weird stuff at the beach nowadays…//Somebody was half naked, sitting by the fireplace from morning till sunset. Bah.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.D0D5B17142EC6DB2B9B427AB7A6953E6: Keep seeing weird stuff at the beach nowadays…//Somebody was half naked, sitting by the fireplace from morning till sunset. Bah.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.31_Text: Legend has it there’s sunken treasure around these parts. I don’t doubt it.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.54DB41664977BB3A3E44949CFD3A7422: Legend has it there’s sunken treasure around these parts. I don’t doubt it.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.68_Text: Makes me wonder if one of these days he’ll “forget” to stop by.//I raised him better than that, but kids these days just don’t respect their parents like my generation did…
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.706C999D427F024FA85EC3A9C85D6B48: Makes me wonder if one of these days he’ll “forget” to stop by.//I raised him better than that, but kids these days just don’t respect their parents like my generation did…
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.09FF03584E1659273495328389F92B41: Must be good for your crops. My lovelies in the garden are drinking it up.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.43_Text: Must be good for your crops. My lovelies in the garden are drinking it up.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.45_Text: Must be good for your crops. My lovelies in the garden are drinking it up.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.555127A04909A18F56F175B91FEC13A0: Must be good for your crops. My lovelies in the garden are drinking it up.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.536E16E0414CEC9C3819399D1697D4E3: No, he wanted to go to college.//There’s dignity in working with yer hands. I tried to tell him that. But does the boy listen to his own father? Bah.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.81_Text: No, he wanted to go to college.//There’s dignity in working with yer hands. I tried to tell him that. But does the boy listen to his own father? Bah.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.25_Text: Not to be confused with Pufferfish, the corporation. Love the fish; can’t say the same for the company.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.A2A205B54A862DD33FE2BA82C56FF9DA: Not to be confused with Pufferfish, the corporation. Love the fish; can’t say the same for the company.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.96_Text: People are gathering on New Year’s Eve, I think… I don’t know, not invited.//My son told me about it.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.D304AABF4785E5E1ED0F2992AC762ADC: People are gathering on New Year’s Eve, I think… I don’t know, not invited.//My son told me about it.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.28_Text: Some sort of critter’s been munching on my lovelies! The leaves are all riddled with tooth marks.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.A431B9274843DE6D933774B1896540E8: Some sort of critter’s been munching on my lovelies! The leaves are all riddled with tooth marks.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.199EA63147502E5123E31EB2D70351E2: Summer’s the best time for fishing. In this weather, you can toss out a net and pull it in, full of fish. Easy as that!
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.30_Text: Summer’s the best time for fishing. In this weather, you can toss out a net and pull it in, full of fish. Easy as that!
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.90_Text: That’s what warm weather brings out…
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.9D4C26F240383FF31A7C02B5F18C9518: That’s what warm weather brings out…
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.91_Text: The lighthouse isn’t big enough to grow fruit like papaya.//You can on your farm. They should be in season now.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.DC9D81EE45C7769D48C768A85F8BE870: The lighthouse isn’t big enough to grow fruit like papaya.//You can on your farm. They should be in season now.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.14_Text: The sea takes care of you if you take care of it.//And if you don’t…
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.BF49688840B155BF5125C5AAFFF5E8E7: The sea takes care of you if you take care of it.//And if you don’t…
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.84_Text: The sun is out again… This will be good for my lovelies.//Not <NPCName>Wakuu</>. I meant my plants.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.FAB2AF074A00C308847DECA260ABB3AF: The sun is out again… This will be good for my lovelies.//Not <NPCName>Wakuu</>. I meant my plants.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.85_Text: Think it’s probably warm enough for melons now.//Maybe I’ll tell <NPCName>Wakuu</> to pick up some melon seeds next week.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.D4E388054E0561D1A11080B54F7E6C09: Think it’s probably warm enough for melons now.//Maybe I’ll tell <NPCName>Wakuu</> to pick up some melon seeds next week.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.33_Text: This time of year, the beach gets too crowded for my taste. I won’t mind when it gets cooler and all the people go away.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.5A1204BF49E54198FBBC7383E9E5AE99: This time of year, the beach gets too crowded for my taste. I won’t mind when it gets cooler and all the people go away.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.51_Text: This was back in my seafaring days. One day, I was sailing through a monstrous storm…//Worse than this one, even! Rain pounding down, my boat tossing around in the waves.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.696C45814E611A8A7E67E090539FE5A9: This was back in my seafaring days. One day, I was sailing through a monstrous storm…//Worse than this one, even! Rain pounding down, my boat tossing around in the waves.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.54_Text: Tried to get him interested in fishing, but bah, the boy would have none of it.//From a young age, all he ever wanted to do was gaze up at the stars.
