DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.CD9B6DEC49EC92154FD1F89A5DC71AC0: Tried to get him interested in fishing, but bah, the boy would have none of it.//From a young age, all he ever wanted to do was gaze up at the stars.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.42_Text: What d’ya think of this rain, eh?
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.585A2ACB4FD4C338156EB8B27232D604: What d’ya think of this rain, eh?
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.44_Text: What d’ya think of this storm, eh?
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.6CDD4A674BD199257F40DFB81A7AA94D: What d’ya think of this storm, eh?
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.20_Text: What’re you looking at? Never seen an old man on his knees in the dirt before?
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.A1FD49CB4780D3BB59C5EC8BDE6A3E3A: What’re you looking at? Never seen an old man on his knees in the dirt before?
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.32_Text: When a ship sinks, it takes its secrets with it.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.AFFB13E54103AE4631C00AB0EDB564F8: When a ship sinks, it takes its secrets with it.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.69_Text: Working on a fishing boat’s no pleasure cruise, <PlayerName>$player</>.//You’re up all day and night, hauling nets, steering the ship, swabbing the deck.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.9DDF6E284A1BE64740FCE2800322F52C: Working on a fishing boat’s no pleasure cruise, <PlayerName>$player</>.//You’re up all day and night, hauling nets, steering the ship, swabbing the deck.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.0335A81A41E8716814AE9488F6EC0D01: You don't understand what's being said.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.0E2EA2344D3B90FD8CE221AEF556A2C2: You don't understand what's being said.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.736D0F4E46C7AC42D0B0D9B765D009B9: You don't understand what's being said.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.8836E55445F1C736D8F875A438A3F51C: You don't understand what's being said.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.D68715354069EAC6BDD159957E0D7A98: You don't understand what's being said.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.E14D98B248FE4D4AAB8673A3A66FA941: You don't understand what's being said.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.ECA02C634D53210E0B3ED29025D63F43: You don't understand what's being said.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.29_Text: You get that on your farm too?
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.9D18918B463357DD054FEC8149B777EF: You get that on your farm too?
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.61_Text: Y’know that book, <Italic>The Old Man and the Sea</>? That’s my autobiography!
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.B3005AD04AADFA2E9087B28914B86770: Y’know that book, <Italic>The Old Man and the Sea</>? That’s my autobiography!
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.50_Text: ’Ave you heard the story of my tussle with the whale? No?
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.718D97584EC32DE898360EB4AEAB28B4: ’Ave you heard the story of my tussle with the whale? No?
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.24_Text: ’Ere’s something I like about pufferfish: they have an elastic stomach! They puff themselves up into balloons when they’re threatened.
DT_Dialogue_Wataru_Production.EC5F55594340958EA3188CA0253FAA06: ’Ere’s something I like about pufferfish: they have an elastic stomach! They puff themselves up into balloons when they’re threatened.

DT_Dialogue_WindGiant_Production.25_Text: <NPCName>GONG</> SKY LEAK TOO MUCH AGAIN! ARGH!
DT_Dialogue_WindGiant_Production.32_Text: <NPCName>Gong</> is fast sometimes! Like the wind.//But only sometimes. Most times, <NPCName>Groo</> is faster. Like the wind. Woosh!
DT_Dialogue_WindGiant_Production.18_Text: <NPCName>Grog</> is too slow! But <NPCName>Grog</> is friend, even when sooooo slooooow.
DT_Dialogue_WindGiant_Production.46_Text: <NPCName>Groo</> a little sad leaves are falling but <NPCName>Groo</> know leaves will be back in Sprouting Season.
DT_Dialogue_WindGiant_Production.19_Text: <NPCName>Groo</> ask <NPCName>Gong</> to run but <NPCName>Gong</> says too tired.//<NPCName>Gong</> old. Heh heh heh!
DT_Dialogue_WindGiant_Production.9_Text: <NPCName>Groo</> collects food from forest.//Hooman too, goom?
DT_Dialogue_WindGiant_Production.5_Text: <NPCName>Groo</> don't remember how to things after stuck for so long.
DT_Dialogue_WindGiant_Production.14_Text: <NPCName>Groo</> fix tool.//The best. Heh heh heh!
DT_Dialogue_WindGiant_Production.33_Text: <NPCName>Groo</> is feeling slow today...//It must be what Hooman feel all time.
DT_Dialogue_WindGiant_Production.29_Text: <NPCName>Groo</> likes to run through the leaves. Wheeeee!//Wind the best! Better than water. Heh heh heh!
DT_Dialogue_WindGiant_Production.37_Text: <NPCName>Groo</> not like village when rain like this. Too slippy!
DT_Dialogue_WindGiant_Production.38_Text: <NPCName>Groo</> not like village when rain like this. Too slippy!
DT_Dialogue_WindGiant_Production.39_Text: <NPCName>Groo</> not like village when snow like this. Too slippy!
DT_Dialogue_WindGiant_Production.40_Text: <NPCName>Groo</> tired today. Maybe go outside later.
DT_Dialogue_WindGiant_Production.31_Text: Bored! <NPCName>Groo</> just want to run in the forest.//Doing useless stuff like Hooman. I want.
DT_Dialogue_WindGiant_Production.27_Text: Don't remember anything from stone age...//<NPCName>Groo</> got stoned and slept.
DT_Dialogue_WindGiant_Production.24_Text: Everything so wet!//Last time <NPCName>Groo</> fall and hit head...
DT_Dialogue_WindGiant_Production.49_Text: Forest so full again! Giants home.//Thank you, Hooman.
DT_Dialogue_WindGiant_Production.7_Text: Giants can help you.//Giants grow food too.
DT_Dialogue_WindGiant_Production.17_Text: Giants hate town. Many bouncy hooman.
DT_Dialogue_WindGiant_Production.16_Text: Giants like town. Many yummy food.
DT_Dialogue_WindGiant_Production.26_Text: Giants need fire... Cold outside.//Hm, now <NPCName>Groo</> sad...
DT_Dialogue_WindGiant_Production.8_Text: Giants the best food grower. Hooman lose.//Heh heh heh!
DT_Dialogue_WindGiant_Production.22_Text: Giants work better together.//If Hooman want better tool, save more Giants.
DT_Dialogue_WindGiant_Production.10_Text: Goddess food the best!//Better than Giant's.
DT_Dialogue_WindGiant_Production.48_Text: Hooman always get together near lake in Sprouting Season.//Food smells yummy! Giants want to join.
DT_Dialogue_WindGiant_Production.11_Text: Hooman done talking to <NPCName>Groo</>? I want to run and pick fruit!
DT_Dialogue_WindGiant_Production.28_Text: Hooman go to cavern, yes? Where <NPCName>Groo</> was stone?//Why?! It scary!
DT_Dialogue_WindGiant_Production.20_Text: Hooman want better tool? <NPCName>Groo</> can help!//But only two. Not allowed more.
DT_Dialogue_WindGiant_Production.15_Text: Hooman, thank for saving <NPCName>Groo</>. Now <NPCName>Groo</> is not stone anymore!
DT_Dialogue_WindGiant_Production.51_Text: Maybe <NPCName>Groo</> not zoom so much now. Slippy ice.
DT_Dialogue_WindGiant_Production.30_Text: Snowpeople look like Giants sometimes.//Only the good ones.
DT_Dialogue_WindGiant_Production.50_Text: So many new sprouts this Sprouting Season. Nice to see.//It make wind smell yummy.
DT_Dialogue_WindGiant_Production.44_Text: So much nice nice fruit now! Forest is rich. Sprouting Season here!//Giants grow seeds in forest too for animal friends.
DT_Dialogue_WindGiant_Production.45_Text: Sometimes <NPCName>Groo</> see small hooman eating lot of colorful things on stick. Look so nice and yum yum!//Small hooman can see Giants. Yes.
DT_Dialogue_WindGiant_Production.34_Text: Storm so fast! Maybe one day <NPCName>Groo</> can be as fast as storm.
DT_Dialogue_WindGiant_Production.41_Text: Sun is like eye, yes? Watching us all during the day.
DT_Dialogue_WindGiant_Production.47_Text: Time to see pretty flowers. Busy time for Giants.
DT_Dialogue_WindGiant_Production.43_Text: White fluffy cold, white fluffy cold~
DT_Dialogue_WindGiant_Production.36_Text: Why Hooman look like that? So tall. Eyes so big and strange...
DT_Dialogue_WindGiant_Production.35_Text: Why can Hooman see Giants? Other hooman in hooman village can't.//Strange it is...

DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.237_Text: <NPCName>Betty</>'s one of my easy patients. I enjoy working with her.//<portrait=annoyed>But trust me, there are plenty of folks around here who make it onto my "hard patients" list.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.86_Text: <NPCName>Charles</> and I always prepare for medical emergencies at the Beach Cleanup Festival… Nothing in particular.//It’s good to have doctors around at big gatherings in case someone gets heatstroke or something like that.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.153_Text: <NPCName>Charles</> and I can subscribe to as many medical journals as we want. The town covers the cost.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.75_Text: <NPCName>Charles</> has to take his antihistamine…//I don’t know what else to tell him. It will literally make him feel better.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.151_Text: <NPCName>Charles</> is one of the most knowledgeable medical doctors I’ve ever met.//You’re in good hands here.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.116_Text: <NPCName>Dinda</> told me all about it. She's quite the foraging expert
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.225_Text: <NPCName>Frank</> currently holds the title… He’s a great cook, isn’t he? Humph. Hard to beat.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.190_Text: <NPCName>Luke</> is old news… We’re meant to be just friends.//Nothing more can come of it.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.192_Text: <NPCName>Luke</> is old news… We’re meant to be just friends.//Nothing more can come of it. Our basic principles in life are way too different.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.117_Text: <NPCName>Millie</> has a lizard that only comes out of hiding when she’s home.//<portrait=happy>Cute little thing.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.209_Text: <NPCName>Millie’s</> never home. So it gets boring really fast.//<portrait=blushing>Unless you…umm…want to visit me sometime. We’d have the house to ourselves.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.56_Text: A pet? Hmm… <NPCName>Millie</> has a lizard that only comes out of hiding when she’s home.//<portrait=annoyed>Does that count?
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.205_Text: A relationship seemed like a big commitment at first, but when you know, you know, right?
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.223_Text: After all these years moving around, I’ve never felt accepted like I do here.//It’s a nice feeling.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.246_Text: After years of hopping around, I felt the need to settle somewhere and build meaningful relationships.//That's why I ended up here on Coral Island.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.227_Text: And I gotta say, I'm really glad I made the move.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.96_Text: Are you going to show your crops at the Harvest Festival?//<portrait=happy>I love seeing everyone’s hard work.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.55_Text: As a farmer, you must get a lot of daily exercise, yeah?
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.249_Text: As soon as Summer hits, I’m wearing my bikini all the time.//<portrait=happy>I’m throwing myself at the beach every single day. Can’t wait!
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.52_Text: Back in the day, I was part of this universal doctor program, traveling all over the world to help out.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.248_Text: Being alone is fine most of the time, but on days like today, I wouldn't mind having a partner, you know?
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.20_Text: Being in the sun is fine as long as you remember to wear sunscreen.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.211_Text: But am I ever going to go out of my way to find one? No.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.221_Text: But for you, <PlayerName>$player</>… If you think you might need extra care.//Something for me to…er…look at. I’ll make an exception for you.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.67_Text: But hey, don't hold your breath on that one.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.129_Text: But it must be convenient for farmers like you…//<portrait=annoyed>A bit? You don’t have to water your plants today, do you?
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.135_Text: But it must be convenient for farmers like you…//<portrait=annoyed>A bit? You don’t have to water your plants today, do you?
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.47_Text: But it’s just so hot and restricting.//And seriously, can't run a decent sprint with that coat flapping around like crazy.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.184_Text: By the way… Thank you for being so supportive.//<portrait=normal>I’m glad to have someone like you in my life.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.49_Text: Can you tell I dig green?//<portrait=happy>Ha! It's like my signature color.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.238_Text: Can't spill the beans, though. My lips are sealed.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.26_Text: Chess is all about planning and strategy, just like health.//Well, for me, anyway.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.99_Text: Do you ever think about how lucky we are to have Winter?//I'd take layering up in the cold over constantly sweating in the heat any day.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.60_Text: Do you like to hang out at the Local Tavern, <PlayerName>$player</>?//The live music on the weekends is where it's at.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.175_Text: Don’t overwork yourself, <PlayerName>$player</>. I don’t wanna see you in the clinic.//The heat can be exhausting. I’d be extra careful if I were you.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.81_Text: Don’t worry about <NPCName>Charles</>. He’s in good hands.//<portrait=normal>I've got everything under control. Let me do the worrying for the both of us, cool?
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.210_Text: Durian has a strong smell. I know some people love it because of that, like <NpcName>Noah</>.//If someone gives me a durian, will I eat it? Yes.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.148_Text: Even though the clinic is closed on Sundays, <NPCName>Charles</> and I are always ready for emergencies.//So don't worry, we've got you covered.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.2_Text: Farmer? Cool.//I’m one of the doctors here.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.242_Text: Feels good to get that paperwork done, even if it's not the most exciting task.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.103_Text: Finally, the perfect weather for curry. Now <Italic>this</> is what Winter is all about.//It's like the ultimate comfort food season.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.92_Text: Finally, the perfect weather for eating curry.//Curry in Summer is fine, of course, but the heat from inside and out can be too much sometimes.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.74_Text: Funny thing is, the food around here doesn't seem to spoil.//It's like magic or something.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.84_Text: Good thing I'm not wearing a full-blown doctor's coat in this heat. Loose clothing all the way.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.114_Text: Good thing the beach cleanup starts at 11 am.//<portrait=happy>It gives me a bit of time in the morning to stop by the clinic and pick up some stuff.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.85_Text: Gotta give your body room to breathe… Not sandals, though.//<portrait=happy>I can’t run in those.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.76_Text: Gotta say, not really a big fan of Spring. It’s just not for me.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.63_Text: Guess I've always been too busy to really think about settling down and starting a family.//But truth be told, long-term commitment scares me.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.202_Text: Have you eaten, <PlayerName>$player</>? Please make sure you eat meals on time, okay?//Something healthy to boost your immune system, maybe.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.78_Text: Have you had your flu vaccine yet?//I recommend getting it every year. Even if the strain changes, at least you'll have some protection.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.27_Text: Heh, heh… You got me!//<portrait=normal>I do always find a way to bring the conversation back to health talk.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.102_Text: Here we go. It’s Winter. I need to make sure I stay healthy all season.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.147_Text: Here's a little health tip for you: If you're going out hunting or chopping wood in the forest, make sure to take some vitamins with you.//They can give your health a quick boost and help you avoid any clinic visits.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.73_Text: Here’s a nonmedical tip for you. Eat your food in one sitting so it doesn’t go stale.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.48_Text: Honestly, I'm so used to scrubs. Anything else feels weird and constricting, you know?
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.30_Text: How’s your week been so far?
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.176_Text: I always enjoy seeing you around. Maybe we should challenge each other to a game of pool sometime.//<portrait=happy>I bet you’re a good pool player.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.9_Text: I average around fourish hours a day at work…//I usually work from 10 am to 2 pm, seeing patients, reviewing medical histories, or doing inventory.//<NPCName>Charles</> runs the reception most of the time.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.7_Text: I can see how facilities like a recycling center or a community garden could be good for us.//<portrait=annoyed>But I don’t know about upgrading other buildings.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.141_Text: I could use one of those thick knitted blankets right now. Humph…
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.125_Text: I didn’t get to sleep until 3 am, and now I’m absolutely drained.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.119_Text: I didn’t get to sleep until 3 am, and now I’m absolutely drained.//<portrait=concerned>Humph. I need to stop doing this to myself.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.177_Text: I don't know if I'm really an animal person or not. I've never had a pet in my life, so it's hard to say.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.4_Text: I don’t know if you’ve noticed, but it looks like it’s overflowing.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.173_Text: I don’t know what it is about me, but no matter what time I fall asleep, I always wake up at 6 am.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.194_Text: I don’t know what it is about me, but no matter what time I fall asleep, I always wake up at 6 am.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.215_Text: I don’t mind other food either. I’m not very picky in that department.//<portrait=annoyed>But I have to say, some fruits have a very strong smell. Like durian.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.42_Text: I don’t need any reminders of my med school days.//Though I do have some old pictures in a box somewhere.//<portrait=happy>Maybe I’ll show you someday.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.166_Text: I don’t really go to the forest.//I suppose where I live in Garden Lane is foresty enough for me.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.28_Text: I don’t usually work on Fridays unless I have an appointment.//Or if there’s an emergency or something.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.72_Text: I don’t want to scare you, but I don’t think that was me.//I don’t go to the forest.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.178_Text: I feel like I’m missing out on something here.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.230_Text: I feel so close to you… I can smell you from here.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.16_Text: I get all my groceries at <NPCName>Sam's</>.//I love how he buys from local sources.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.250_Text: I got this jacket back when I was in Tangi working with the Universal Doctors.//Feel it! Good quality, right? It was really cheap too.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.89_Text: I got this small handheld fan… Oh, so good.//<portrait=normal>Fully automated, battery operated, and all that. You can take it with you in your pocket. The perfect Summer toy.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.107_Text: I guess it's not kale season anymore. Time to find another leafy green to munch on.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.169_Text: I had an apple for breakfast. What about you?//<portrait=happy>I thought we had nothing at home until I found a couple of apples from who knows when. Oh well… Tasted fine.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.171_Text: I had an apple for breakfast. What about you?//<portrait=happy>I thought we had nothing at home until I found a couple of apples from who knows when. Oh well… Tasted fine.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.90_Text: I had one, anyway… I don’t have the fan anymore.//Accidentally stepped on it. And nobody sells them here.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.120_Text: I had some things on my mind. Hard to shake off sometimes.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.126_Text: I had some things on my mind. Hard to shake off sometimes.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.104_Text: I heard about Pufferfish Corp moving in…//<portrait=annoyed>It’s too bad, huh?
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.213_Text: I heard it from <NPCName>Sunny</>.//Anyway, we should totally check out <NPCName>Emma's</> Taco Truck sometime.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.212_Text: I heard you like tacos. Is that right?
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.200_Text: I just need a house with a kitchen and a place to read my journals, and I’m good.//Then I’ll retire and only go to the clinic two days a week.//<portrait=happy>I plan to spend the rest of my week writing medical articles. Pretty good plan, right?
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.8_Text: I like how some of the buildings here are old. Like the mansion or the lighthouse.//They feel like a time capsule, you know?
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.149_Text: I like my scrubs. They’re comfortable and easy to clean.//But I should wear my white coat once in a while…//<portrait=happy>Change things up a bit.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.181_Text: I love how pet owners are so passionate about what kind of person they are.//<portrait=happy>I kinda want to join in and say, "I'm a cat person" or "I'm a lizard person." It's like a whole subculture!
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.157_Text: I may have had one too many cups of punch. I’m going to call it a night.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.168_Text: I need to swing by <NPCName>Sam's</> and grab a few things.//Our fridge was practically empty this morning. Gotta stock up!
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.170_Text: I need to swing by <NPCName>Sam's</> and grab a few things.//Our fridge was practically empty this morning. Gotta stock up!
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.24_Text: I notice people here love fishing.//I’m all for it, because I think it’s important to unwind.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.214_Text: I personally love curry. Red and green both.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.208_Text: I should start spending more time at the house. It feels like such a waste paying all that rent when I’m never home.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.46_Text: I should totally rock a coat like <NPCName>Charles</> does.//<portrait=normal>Look at him, all sleek and stylish. That coat just adds a certain oomph, doesn't it?
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.23_Text: I should wear regular clothes more.//<portrait=normal>I’m too lazy to change after my shift, so I just go around in scrubs.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.232_Text: I spent years traveling around and adjusting to new groups of people constantly.//<portrait=happy>It’s nice to keep the same bunch long enough to celebrate more than one birthday with.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.35_Text: I still eat out quite a bit, though! Heh, heh… Old habits die hard, huh?
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.88_Text: I think <NPCName>Sunny</> is going to win. He’s got some stamina… Very fast swimmer.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.172_Text: I think I got a bit too much sun at the beach yesterday.//Oops! Time to lather on some aloe vera.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.31_Text: I think I might need to go to <NPCName>Sam's</> tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.97_Text: I think tonight's dinner is gonna be curry. Seems like the right weather for it.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.124_Text: I thought I’d have more time to read this Winter, but right now I’m more swamped than ever.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.111_Text: I took a walk by the lake the other day and saw so many colorful flowers.//What a season!
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.41_Text: I tried “fashion,” or whatever, back in med school.//Let’s just say I’m glad social media wasn’t big back then.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.58_Text: I try my best to live a healthy life, but some days it's harder than others, you know what I mean?
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.239_Text: I used to be a real nomad, always traveling from one place to another.//But you know what? I don't miss it. I kinda like the stability of staying in one spot for a change.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.233_Text: I used to think I needed to be on constant alert to get excitement out of life.//But nope. Things are really exciting with you around.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.158_Text: I was going to practice some volleyball earlier, but there was nobody outside.//So I decided to chill here instead.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.219_Text: I was going to rent it, but <NPCName>Millie’s</> place was closer to work.//<portrait=happy>Besides, she charges a lot less than <NPCName>Jack</>.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.186_Text: I was just thinking about my job, and you know what’s interesting?//<portrait=annoyed>Wanting to help people and actually doing the job are two completely different things.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.222_Text: I was walking home last night and almost fell into the river. This town could use more lampposts.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.130_Text: I wish I could have slept in today. It’s the perfect weather for waking up late and going to bed early.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.132_Text: I wish I could have slept in today. It’s the perfect weather for waking up late and going to bed early.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.255_Text: I wonder what kind of medical conferences they've got lined up for this upcoming Spring. Might be worth checking out!
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.156_Text: I'll be honest, I'm not the greatest dancer out there. But as long as I'm not hurting anyone and it makes me feel good, who really cares?
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.50_Text: I'm all about that simple life. As long as I've got a hot meal on the table, I consider it a good day.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.243_Text: I'm here to pick up some new reading material. Already finished everything I had.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.224_Text: I'm not giving up on mastering the art of making curry.//One day, mark my words, I'll whip up the best curry on this whole island. They'll call me the Curry Master!
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.143_Text: I'm not sure how long <NPCName>Ling</> has been living here.//But she's definitely a local legend when it comes to knowledge about the island.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.93_Text: I'm so glad the air has cooled down. It's a breath of fresh air, quite literally.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.185_Text: I've met a lot of people, but you, <PlayerName>$player</>, you're special.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.10_Text: If I had to choose…//My favorite part of the job is creating care plans with patients.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.217_Text: If you need anything from me, just let me know.//I can’t give you discount at the clinic, though. The vitamins aren’t mine to give. Ha ha!
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.65_Text: If you need anything from the clinic, <NPCName>Charles</> should be in.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.115_Text: If you're into mushrooms, there are some black trumpets and matsutakes sprouting near the mayor's house.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.229_Text: In my head, doctors are all serious and stuff.//Whatever that means.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.139_Text: Is it snowing again or something?
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.199_Text: It looks good. Works well with your…er…hair.//<portrait=normal>Makes you look sharp.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.12_Text: It sounds horrible, but the adrenaline rush is addictive.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.204_Text: It wasn’t easy for me to find someone I wanted to spend my whole life with.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.15_Text: It would also make my job a whole lot easier! Heh, heh.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.161_Text: It's great to see you here, <PlayerName>$player</>!//<portrait=happy>Are you here to buy or sell? Let me know if you need any recommendations
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.174_Text: It's like my internal alarm clock is permanently set. Even in Winter, it's kinda weird, right?
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.45_Text: It’s important for doctors to know your complete medical history to give you the best care possible.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.234_Text: It’s nice to find someone with the same sense of humor and principles…same wavelength and all.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.231_Text: It’s nice… You smell really nice.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.62_Text: It’s not easy for me to find someone I want to spend my life with.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.39_Text: It’s so easy to get carried away and forget to listen to our bodies.//I’m guilty of that too.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.83_Text: It’s so hot, <PlayerName>$player</>.//It takes me back to my days volunteering in the doctor program.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.195_Text: It’s the Summer sun… Yep! It’s because it’s already so bright that early in the morning.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.34_Text: I’m not a very good cook, but I try to eat homemade food when I can.//It’s better for you.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.123_Text: I’m not going to tell you how to live your life, but please, do me a favor and wash your hands often. Think about all the stuff we touch throughout the day.//<portrait=annoyed>Who knows what kind of germs are lurking around?
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.57_Text: I’m not sure if it’s male or female. All I know is she calls the lizard Tin.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.29_Text: I’m not too worried about it. The clinic’s usually very quiet.//<NPCName>Charles</> will do just fine on his own.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.193_Text: I’m occupied with…umm…someone new now.//Besides, I think there’s something about people who work with their hands that’s just so…admirable.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.3_Text: I’m starting to worry about that recycling center near the park.//Should I stop taking stuff there?
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.145_Text: I’m subscribed to four journals, and I've even been published in a few.//Mostly articles about interesting medical cases I encountered during my travels.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.136_Text: I’m trying to get more people to go out and garden.//It’s an easy way to get daily exercise.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.11_Text: I’m used to high-stress situations.//I feel like that’s when my knowledge and training really kick in.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.95_Text: I’ve heard only certain animals come out in Fall, but I’m no animal expert.//<portrait=happy><NPCName>Millie</> probably knows way more than I do. She's got all the facts.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.142_Text: I’ve learned a lot from <NPCName>Ling</>. She’s very knowledgeable about coral reefs and this island.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.241_Text: Just finished submitting my billing for the week.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.18_Text: Just holler whenever you have questions about medicine or health.//I know people get nervous about little things like moles or rashes sometimes.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.19_Text: Let me help by giving you peace of mind.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.38_Text: Make sure to drink enough water, okay?//Our bodies need it.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.14_Text: Make sure to include fresh vegetables in your diet.//They’re a great source of fiber and nutrients.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.245_Text: Maybe that messed up my sense of smell. On the bright side, the rent was free!
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.66_Text: Maybe, just maybe, tomorrow will be the day I finally go grocery shopping.//Who knows, right?
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.79_Text: Most people usually get their flu vaccines in Winter or Spring. That’s when you’re most vulnerable.//I get mine in Fall to prepare for the coming season. Give it a try, see how it feels.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.6_Text: Mr. Mayor thought a community garden would make a great space for outdoor activities.//As a doctor, I agree it’s a great idea.//<portrait=happy>It’ll give people another reason to move their bodies.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.70_Text: My hair has been rocking the green look for so long, I wouldn't even know how to answer if you asked about my natural hair color.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.36_Text: My tattoos?//<portrait=normal>I got most of them at places I was dispatched to. My experiences in the universal doctor program will stay with me forever.//They’re part of me, just like these tattoos.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.131_Text: No Tavern for me today. Got a bunch of chores that I need to tackle.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.133_Text: No Tavern for me today. Got a bunch of chores that I need to tackle.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.253_Text: Normally, Spring is when I'd go to medical conferences.//But these days, I prefer attending them online. Can't beat the convenience.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.68_Text: Not all my tattoos have some deep, profound meaning behind them.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.122_Text: Oh gosh, piping hot curry would be perfect right now.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.127_Text: Oh gosh, piping hot curry would be perfect right now.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.137_Text: Oh gosh, piping hot curry would be perfect right now.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.138_Text: Oh gosh, piping hot curry would be perfect right now.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.235_Text: Oh great! Another fake medical report with a “unicorn finger problem for Yoorie.”//<NPCName>Charles</> must be bored again.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.207_Text: Oh my! I meant you look nice… Nice, nice, nice.//<portrait=happy>You don’t look bad or anything.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.1_Text: Oh, <PlayerName>$player</>? As in <PlayerName>$player</> <PlayerName>$player</>?//<portrait=happy>It’s nice to finally meet you!
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.54_Text: Oh, and let me tell you, foreign travel really opens up your mind and toughens you up.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.21_Text: Oh, another thing!//<portrait=normal>Remember to reapply sunscreen every few hours. That part’s important, and people always forget.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.180_Text: Oh, no reason. I just like the name Pat.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.144_Text: One of my favorite things to do after work is to come here and read medical journals until the sun sets.//It's my way of keeping up with the latest medical advancements.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.44_Text: One of the things I find most challenging about being a doctor is sometimes patients lie.//<portrait=normal>While it’s harmless in most cases, it’s always best to be honest with your doctor.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.13_Text: Paying attention to what you eat is a great way to stay healthy in the long run.//Prevention is worth more than any cure.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.160_Text: Phew! The sun is really blazing today, huh?//I think I’ll enjoy the beach from inside here.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.82_Text: Phew, are you sweating as much as I am? This heat is intense!
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.22_Text: Playing pool after work is a great way to make new friends.//<portrait=normal>But to be frank, I do it mostly because I think I’m pretty good at it.//<portrait=happy>It feels good to win, heh, heh.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.118_Text: She named the lizard Tin. What a fun name…
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.247_Text: Sometimes I envy <NPCName>Dinda</> and <NPCName>Joko</>. They seem to have such a full life.//<portrait=normal>I see them at the tavern dancing sometimes…just enjoying life together, you know?//<portrait=sad>I want that.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.228_Text: Sometimes it feels a little strange calling myself a doctor. I mean, deep down, I don't really feel like one.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.69_Text: Sometimes you just gotta go with the flow, trust your instincts, and get inked.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.146_Text: Sometimes, all we need is a little peace and quiet, right?//Just a moment to unwind and clear our minds.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.108_Text: Speaking of seasonal stuff, you can get tulips, wasabi, and celery this time of year.//<portrait=annoyed>Hmm… What else?
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.252_Text: Spring here isn’t cold. No need to wear a thick jacket anymore.//<portrait=happy>I can move faster now!
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.110_Text: Spring just arrived, and poor <NPCName>Charles</> can't stop sneezing his nose off.//<portrait=annoyed>It's a bit worrisome, you know? I hope he finds some relief soon.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.61_Text: That <NPCName>Theo</> is really something, isn’t he?//That guy's got serious talent.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.80_Text: The Cherry Blossom Festival was really nice, wasn’t it?//<portrait=normal>I had a lot of fun.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.17_Text: The bad thing about <NPCName>Sam's</> is you can’t really find off-season items.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.220_Text: The clinic doesn’t do home visits.//<portrait=annoyed>Well, <NPCName>Charles</> does, actually. I only do it for emergencies.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.254_Text: The conferences have free activities like scuba diving, tours, wine tastings… Yeah, It was fun.//Well, the ones I used to go to anyway.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.164_Text: The eggplants here make incredible pickles.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.165_Text: The eggplants here make incredible pickles.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.188_Text: The good news is <NPCName>Millie’s</> house doesn’t have a rat problem.//I’m not sure if that’s related, but I suppose no rats counts as a win.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.197_Text: The good news is <NPCName>Millie’s</> house doesn’t have a rat problem.//I’m not sure if that’s related, but I suppose no rats counts as a win.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.152_Text: The idea of free books gets me pretty excited. Is that sad?
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.105_Text: The islanders aren’t too happy about it either.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.251_Text: The jacket is really warm. You’d be surprised!
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.106_Text: The other day, I was at the store looking for some kale for my midday snack, but guess what? <NPCName>Sam</> didn't have any. Bummer!
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.53_Text: The pay wasn’t good, but you get one heck of a lot of experience. Plus the satisfaction of helping people in need.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.162_Text: The radishes here are incredibly crunchy and great for pickling.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.163_Text: The radishes here are incredibly crunchy and great for pickling.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.128_Text: The rain doesn’t change anything, I think…//<portrait=annoyed>But it does slow life down a little.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.134_Text: The rain doesn’t change anything, I think…//<portrait=annoyed>But it does slow life down a little.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.182_Text: The whole thing is just fascinating!
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.187_Text: The wild thing about living near the river is the constant fear of flooding every time it rains a little.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.196_Text: The wild thing about living near the river is the constant fear of flooding every time it storms like this.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.5_Text: There are empty sites here we can repurpose.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.112_Text: There are so many coconuts at the beach right now. It's like a coconut paradise out there.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.218_Text: There’s an empty room in <NPCName>Jack’s</> ranch house, complete with a compact kitchen and a place to relax.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.59_Text: Today's plan is to just chill out and take it easy.//How about you?
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.201_Text: Until I have enough money saved to afford that, I’ll keep working four days a week.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.33_Text: Useful for an active person like you, no?
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.51_Text: Volleyball isn't exactly my forte yet, but hey, I won't turn down a game if someone asks.//Gotta keep the ball rolling!
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.159_Text: Wah...I'm seriously craving some seafood today.//Let's see what <NPCName>Jim</> is cooking up. His dishes are always spot on.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.71_Text: Wait, hold up! You've seen me where exactly?!
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.109_Text: Wait, scratch that on the celery.//I don't think it's celery season just yet. My bad.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.189_Text: Want to play pool with me? I could use a win. Heh, heh!
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.77_Text: We do our restocking every Spring… Makes it easier to remember.//Spring…restocking. See?
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.191_Text: We don’t dance the same dance, if you catch my drift.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.91_Text: We have so many melons at home. I think <NpcName>Millie</> might have gone a little overboard…
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.32_Text: We sell medicines and vitamins at the clinic.//They can quickly restore your health, so keep some in your backpack just in case.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.101_Text: We've stocked up on plenty of cold medicine for this season.//The weather is dry and cold, just the way those viruses like it.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.244_Text: Weird smell, you say? Umm… No. I can’t smell anything.//But once, I lived for two years in an abandoned school right next to a dumpster.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.64_Text: Well, lucky for me, I don't have work tomorrow. But you seem to be on the grind every single day, am I right?
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.113_Text: We’re cleaning up the beach soon.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.167_Text: What am I going to do there, anyway?//It’s not like I could just start mining or something.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.94_Text: What is it they say about Fall? Sweater weather?//<portrait=normal>Yeah, I think that’s right.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.179_Text: When I actually get a pet, I really want to name it Pat.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.98_Text: When I was traveling around the world, most of the places I was dispatched to were really hot.//<portrait=happy>I gotta say, it's a breath of fresh air to finally settle somewhere with a proper Winter.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.155_Text: Whenever I can, I try to squeeze in some dancing. It's like an instant mood-booster.//<portrait=happy>Hey, we should go dancing together sometime.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.240_Text: Who knew boring could be so much fun?
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.87_Text: Will you be entering the swimming contest?
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.100_Text: Winter is usually our busiest season. People tend to get sick more often, which is why I prefer getting my flu shot in Fall.//It's all about preparation, <PlayerName>$Player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.121_Text: With the weather getting colder, it's like people are hibernating or something.//<portrait=annoyed>Have you noticed? Streets are practically empty these days
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.226_Text: You and I, <PlayerName>$player</>...we're kind of alike.//We both came here searching for peace and a place to fit in.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.150_Text: You know, like <NPCName>Charles</>. He looks good in his coat.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.206_Text: You look spiffy today, <PlayerName>$player</>!//<portrait=happy>You could pass as a Winter decoration.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.140_Text: You’d think it would’ve stopped by now.
DT_Dialogue_Yuri_Production.216_Text: You’re fun to talk to. One of the coolest people I’ve met, for sure.

DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.219_Text: <NPCName>Sam</> offered me some leftover roasted nuts the other day. It was nice of him, but I turned them down.//<portrait=annoyed>Eating nuts is like chewing on wood.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.183_Text: <NPCName>Walter</> hired me to track down his family's heirloom.//So, off I went, camping all over the island in search of that elusive treasure. It was an absolute blast!
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.306_Text: <PlayerName>$player</>, I was just thinking about how lucky I am that I get to go on adventures with you.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.75_Text: A client once wanted me to search for a chalice in the dead of Winter.//<portrait=annoyed>I said no way, unless he was willing to pay me ten times my usual rate.//<portrait=happy>He gladly waited until Spring.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.212_Text: A life in Pokyo… Interesting! We gotta swap stories sometimes. You look like you have cool ones to share.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.44_Text: A little tip from one treasure hunter to another: Keep your eyes peeled for those chests and give 'em a good whack.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.1_Text: A new farmer in town?//You moved here <Italic>after</> the oil spill? Huh.//<portrait=normal>I’m <NPCName>Zarah</>. //See you around.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.42_Text: A raccoon, you say? Not convinced. A raccoon would’ve eaten it, I’d think.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.97_Text: Ah! What’s that like? I feel like we’re all in a big simulation game sometimes.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.23_Text: Ah, I don’t know. Doesn’t sound very convenient.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.267_Text: Ah, the wind is nice here.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.98_Text: All righty, then. Good day to you.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.237_Text: All this snow on the ground means buried treasure is harder to find. It’s no fun to dig through wet snow, either.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.53_Text: Are you ready for the start of a new year, <PlayerName>$player</>? I know I’m raring to go.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.239_Text: As much as I love my boat, I feel a little trapped during Winter.//I don’t want to stay inside, but I don’t want to go out into the cold air, either.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.262_Text: As much as I love the water, sometimes it’s nice to see some green too.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.160_Text: At first, I thought you were…//<portrait=surprised>A bear or something.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.277_Text: But hey, you don’t have to.//<portrait=happy>You can also sell that stuff. I do it all the time.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.322_Text: But it did leave a big dent in my bank account.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.158_Text: But maybe we can chat again sometime?//<portrait=annoyed>Now just isn’t a good time.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.91_Text: But there are plenty of wild vegetables growing.//That’s a good thing for someone like me, who relies on nature a lot for food.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.10_Text: Camping in a cavern for more than two days is a nasty business. I don’t miss it.//<portrait=annoyed>How can a place be damp and hot at the same time?
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.276_Text: Consider taking any artifact you find to the museum first and having <NPCName>Scott</> inspect it. Chances are, the island might not have it on file.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.28_Text: Cooked plenty of food yesterday.//I don’t think I’ll need to make any more until tomorrow.//But I am craving some grilled fish.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.227_Text: Coral Island is always beautiful this time of year.//<portrait=normal>It’s beautiful year-round, but it really blooms in the Spring.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.217_Text: Coral Island's ecosystem has gone through some major changes over the centuries. Can you imagine?//<portrait=normal>And you can even stumble upon these old fossils scattered around here, like little time capsules. It's mind-blowing.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.315_Text: Could you hand me some more bait, <PlayerName>$player</>? I need to refresh my hook.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.312_Text: Could you see the two of us living in a space like this?//<portrait=normal>Finding hidden treasures and traveling the world? I think it would be the journey of a lifetime.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.70_Text: Daylight is getting shorter and shorter. Looks like I’ll have to stop my exploration pretty soon.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.65_Text: Do you ever find random crabs on your farm?//<portrait=thinking>The rice field <Italic>right</> behind your farm is full of them… This time of year, anyway.//<portrait=normal>Pretty much all I caught the last time I fished there.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.16_Text: Do you think it's up to us to uncover its hidden wonders?//Or should we just wait patiently until nature decides to spill the beans?
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.229_Text: Do you think we’ll get any storms soon, <PlayerName>$player</>?//I’d rather know ahead of time if they’re coming.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.176_Text: Do you think you could ever live on a boat?
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.96_Special: Does studying count? I was a student. In a way, still am.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.82_Text: Don’t make the same mistake I did, <PlayerName>$player</>…//Pack some food.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.40_Text: Don’t worry about it! I’m sure it’s because I’m away a lot. I rarely spend much time on the boat.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.205_Text: Each stone holds a special memory from the adventures I've embarked on, and that's priceless to me.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.310_Text: Errr… You’re the most incredible gem I’ve ever found.//Gosh! That was cheesy…//I hope you like cheesy.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.224_Text: Even though the air feels warmer now, the ocean still has a chilly bite to it. So, I'll hold off on diving off the deck of my boat for now.//<portrait=happy>Wouldn't wanna turn into a popsicle, you know?
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.246_Text: Even when I’m safely inside for the night, I can still feel the rain hitting the deck and the roll of the waves outside.//At least it’s not too windy.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.324_Text: Ever just look at the stars and wonder what’s beyond there? Maybe one day, I'll pack my bags and set off for the unknown...just not today.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.201_Text: Excuse me! I’m so sorry, <PlayerName>$player</>.//My nose is acting up.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.323_Text: Farming sure has a lot of...routine. Not really my style, <PlayerName>$player, but I can see why you enjoy it.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.282_Text: Favorite jam? Hmm… Hang on now. Jam isn’t my favorite food.//<portrait=normal>I just think it’s delicious to indulge in when you have nothing better to eat. That said, I don’t have any favorite jam. I think for me, any jam will do.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.233_Text: Feel that slight chill in the air? Winter's creeping closer, <PlayerName>$Player</>.//Time to bundle up and brace ourselves for some chilly days ahead.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.74_Text: Fished a little the other day and caught a green sawfish.//<portrait=normal>Have you tried catching them? You should, since they only come out in wintertime. I caught it right outside your farm… You know where that giant tree is? It was in the body of water across from the hot-air balloon area.//I’d try in the evening. I think they hide during the day.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.204_Text: Folks often comment on the value of my gem collection, claiming it could fetch a hefty sum.//But you know what? I couldn't care less about their monetary worth.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.182_Text: For my last job, I lived outdoors almost a whole year.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.235_Text: Grilled fish are delicious this time of year. I catch them from my boat and cook them myself.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.221_Text: Ha! That’s okay. I wouldn’t say I’m a hermit.//<portrait=happy>It’s more like knowing who I am, what I like and dislike, and sticking with it.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.326_Text: Had a close encounter with a shark the other day. Scary, but thrilling at the same time. Makes you feel alive.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.78_Text: Have you ever fished near the mayor’s house in Winter?//I heard from the young fisher you can catch silver arowana there.//<portrait=thinking>Long black hair? Yeah, that’s the one.//<portrait=happy>Oh, the one with bright-red boots, not the one with glasses. She’s not a fisher, I don’t think.//<portrait=thinking>But I don’t really know… Never see her around much.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.313_Text: Have you ever sat on this pier at sunset? The view is beautiful.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.85_Text: Have you met <NPCName>Scott</>?//I see him at the cavern every now and then.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.73_Text: Have you tried tilling the soil on your farm? You might find some stuff…//<portrait=thinking>Oh, but it’s pretty much ice right now, huh?
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.231_Text: Having a Summer birthday isn’t too bad. It means I get extra hours of daylight to celebrate.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.84_Text: He moved here just before you did.//<portrait=normal>Heard it was for coral reef restoration. He’s some sort of doctor, I believe. Not the medical kind.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.35_Text: Here's a little secret: If you didn't listen to the town's chit-chat, you'd never guess that <NPCName>Jim</> is a masterful fisherman.//He doesn’t fish much anymore and doesn’t really talk about it.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.255_Text: Hey, <PlayerName>$player</>. Did you come to see me or my boat?
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.184_Text: Hey, it's really awesome of you to drop by!
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.283_Text: Hmm… What should I do this weekend?
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.5_Text: How was your weekend?//Oh, splendid to hear! Mine was a good one, thank you for asking.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.307_Text: I always thought I would go adventuring alone, that I didn’t need anyone to go with me.//I’m glad you’re here, though.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.174_Text: I bought this boat with the payment I got for helping a rich family retrieve a lost heirloom.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.265_Text: I brought some food along, but I have a feeling it might be a bit on the stale side.//<portrait=happy>Oh well, fingers crossed it's still somewhat edible.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.38_Text: I can play with cats now, but I still sneeze here and there… It’s not bad at all, though.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.51_Text: I can’t wait for the Cherry Blossom Festival. There’s going to be a lot of good food.//And people. Not a bad thing, actually.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.115_Text: I caught some fish a little while ago.//<portrait=thinking>I think I’ll make soup with them for dinner.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.117_Text: I caught some fish a little while ago.//<portrait=thinking>I think I’ll make soup with them for dinner.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.130_Text: I caught some fish a little while ago.//<portrait=thinking>I think I’ll make soup with them for dinner.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.142_Text: I caught some giant stingrays earlier.//It really has been a productive day for me.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.81_Text: I could <Italic>not</> have been more wrong. There was hardly any food, and I ran out of energy in the middle of a battle.//<portrait=annoyed>I passed out and was found by a local blacksmith.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.172_Text: I didn’t hear you knock. Umm…
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.185_Text: I don't get to know many people too well, but that's okay since I'm always on the move.//That said, I’m glad I’ve stayed long enough to get to know you.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.226_Text: I don't really need 'em on my boat. My gem collection brings enough colors to my world.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.294_Text: I don’t care about a lot of people, but I do care deeply about my family, my friends… And you.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.298_Text: I don’t even want to think about it, but gosh!//<portrait=surprised02>I woke up thinking about moving to another island… Nightmares. That did it to me.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.216_Text: I don’t have a lot of time to read, but I like to pick up a history book now and again.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.225_Text: I don’t know too much about farming, but they say Spring is the perfect time to plant those colorful flowers.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.303_Text: I don’t know. I guess some of them seem…nosy. Always asking a few too many questions.//That scares me for whatever reason.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.234_Text: I feel closest to nature in Fall. The beautiful colors, piles of leaves on the ground… It’s something to be thankful for.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.197_Text: I found a beautiful vintage-looking cut gem on the beach the other day… Must be at least 100 years old.//I don't think it belongs to anyone, so I'm going to make it a centerpiece of my collection. It'll be a real showstopper!
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.109_Text: I found some scrolls when I was fishing the other day. Fishing!//<portrait=surprised02>Who would’ve thought?
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.12_Text: I found some scrolls when I was fishing the other day. Fishing!//<portrait=surprised02>Who would’ve thought?
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.100_Text: I gathered several coconuts around the inn the other day, and I haven’t touched them.//<portrait=thinking>What should I make with them? Hmm…
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.189_Text: I get a lot of questions about what I do. I’m an adventurer, plain and simple.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.59_Text: I get it, the Beach Cleanup Festival is important, but do they really have to make it an all-day affair?//<portrait=normal>Just a thought, you know?
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.24_Text: I get why some people like to work alone…//<portrait=concerned>It’s nice to have an extra hand, but coordinating can be a pain.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.169_Text: I guess you could say I live in town.//Sure doesn’t feel like it sometimes.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.99_Text: I hate roasted nuts. Nuts are easy to find and simple to roast, but they taste like rotten charcoal.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.106_Text: I have a love-hate relationship with cold weather. It makes me feel like I have endless energy.//<portrait=annoyed>But at the same time, it’s harder to find wild vegetables.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.154_Text: I have to say, I like my privacy.//I mostly keep busy on the island, so it doesn’t leave me much time to socialize.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.92_Text: I heard you worked in a big city before becoming a farmer.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.249_Text: I just can’t stay focused on this book.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.206_Text: I keep hearing stories about legendary treasures scattered all over the island.//It’s my job to investigate!
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.7_Text: I kind of like it here on Coral Island.//<portrait=happy>Who knows? Maybe someday I’ll buy a house and move to a place that doesn’t rock…//<portrait=thinking>Sounds dull, to be honest.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.319_Text: I know I’m not always there for you…but know that I’ll try to be there when you need me, okay?
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.295_Text: I know you go to the cavern a lot. So if you need backup, please come to me.//I hate the thought of you being down there alone. Just…let me look out for you.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.89_Text: I learn something new every day on this island if I look closely enough.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.155_Text: I learned these ruins have been here since the first human settlement.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.241_Text: I like Coral Island too much to do that, though. I’ll just make sure to keep the heat on all the time.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.152_Text: I like being able to hear people chatting.//<portrait=concerned>It makes it feel less lonely on the boat.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.302_Text: I like to keep my distance, not be too, er…chummy with the townies.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.261_Text: I like to spend my days off here. It feels good to stretch my legs and sit under the sky.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.253_Text: I like watching the snow melt as it hits the ocean. It just piles up if it lands on my boat.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.286_Text: I love what you did with the lot, by the way...right, your grandparent's farm. It’s not abandoned like it was before.//<portrait=happy>You have an eye for these things.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.97_Special: I made games. It’s really fun, but it’s not as easy as I thought it was going to be.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.199_Text: I mean, sure, maybe I'll consider it, but truth be told, my boat is better suited for cozy living than speedy races.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.121_Text: I might as well make my day productive and fish for a bit. Right?
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.133_Text: I might as well make my day productive and fish for a bit. Right?
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.181_Text: I need to keep things where they are, or else I'll never be able to find my belongings. So, mind your step, please.//<portrait=normal>I don’t want you to accidentally step on my things.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.281_Text: I never knew how delicious jam was until I went on an adventure for an entire season on a secluded island.//It was in the middle of nowhere. At the time, I ate mainly raw wild vegetables, and all I’d brought was four jars of my mom’s jam.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.291_Text: I never used to keep secrets from my mom… Not until I lived on my own.//<portrait=annoyed>I hate this new dynamic, but…I feel it’s best to keep her out of the loop sometimes.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.293_Text: I notice there’s always fresh flowers at the temple, and yet I’ve never found out who puts them there. Your doing?
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.192_Text: I often wonder about the civilizations that were here before us.//What was happening hundreds of years ago on this very spot?
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.47_Text: I once got into trouble with a client because he wanted his money back. The problem was the government took the treasure I found, and my client sued me for unfinished work.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.320_Text: I really like you, but I like me too…and being alone is part of who I am.//<portrait=normal>I hope it doesn’t offend you when I ask for some time alone.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.300_Text: I really like your hair that way. Suits you.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.36_Text: I see myself in <NPCName>Jim</> a lot.//Makes me wonder if I'll ever find true satisfaction and stop seeking new adventures.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.210_Text: I should have started earlier, but I had more exciting things to do.//Wouldn’t you rather hunt for buried treasure than clean?
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.296_Text: I should send my parents some pumpkins.//They like Coral Island’s pumpkins… Sweetest ones they ever tasted, they said.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.22_Text: I should start leaving my boots by the door.//I track so much mud into the boat, it's a bit of a hassle.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.272_Text: I should talk to <NPCName>Walter</> about the possibility of a new job. His family must have another lost heirloom I can search for.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.58_Text: I spend a lot of time at the beach in Summer.//Anyway, why wouldn’t I?
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.20_Text: I spent practically the whole day yesterday on a quest for fresh vegetables, but, I still came up empty-handed.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.125_Text: I think I’ll head inside in a little bit and make myself a warm meal.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.136_Text: I think I’ll head inside in a little bit and make myself a warm meal.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.143_Text: I think I’m going to read a bit and call it a day.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.214_Text: I think a cat somehow got into my lunch yesterday.//I ate my sandwich and sneezed a little.//Weird.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.164_Text: I think it’s good for me to come here once in a while.//Besides, spending too much time on a small boat can get claustrophobic.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.279_Text: I think they were building a new nest.//<portrait=happy>I don’t usually get all warm and fuzzy, but that was really cute.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.287_Text: I thought settling down in one place would be boring until… Well, until I met you, actually.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.37_Text: I used to have a bad allergy to cats.//<portrait=normal>But thankfully, I outgrew it.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.122_Text: I want to keep close to my boat on rainy days like this.//<portrait=annoyed>Just in case the rain gets really strong, and my boat gets swept away.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.134_Text: I want to keep close to my boat on rainy days like this.//<portrait=annoyed>Just in case the rain gets really strong, and my boat gets swept away.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.305_Text: I warn you, though, it’s not for everybody.//<portrait=happy>But I have a feeling you’re gonna like it.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.2_Text: I was sailing the other day, and oh my, you wouldn't believe how much trash I saw at sea!//<portrait=annoyed>Hmm…
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.252_Text: I was supposed to go spelunking today, but I had to postpone it because of this snow. I guess I’ll just stay close to home for now.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.260_Text: I wasn’t big on fishing before I moved here, but sometimes there’s not much else to do on the water besides catch a few trout.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.80_Text: I went on an adventure to discover a buried temple one time and filled my bag with weapons and no food.//<portrait=normal>I thought there’d be food for me wherever I went. Being not picky and all.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.243_Text: I wish I could stick around and talk, but I want to stay as dry as possible.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.203_Text: I wonder if there are shipwrecks down there… I bet there’s treasure!
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.325_Text: I wonder what's at the bottom of the ocean. You think it's all just rocks and fish, or is there a sunken city waiting to be discovered?
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.263_Text: I'd lend you my metal detector, but, uh, I'm actually using it at the moment.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.269_Text: I'd rather bring my own coconuts. The beach shack has them, but gosh, they're pricey!//I mean, sure, they offer them cold, but I'd rather save a few bucks.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.242_Text: I'm not afraid to get down and dirty. Grime, dust, you name it—I've embraced it all.//But you know what I despise? Getting wet. Ugh, it's the worst!
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.208_Text: I've always considered it simply "mine" and never felt the need for anything more.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.15_Text: I've got this wild hunch that there's more to this island than meets the eye.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.34_Text: I've had my fair share of camping and roasted chestnuts.//It’s safe to say I’m a bit sick of them now. Yuck.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.230_Text: If a storm’s coming, I have to prep my boat… It’s a long process.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.50_Text: If you ask me, Spring and Fall are the prime seasons for seeking hidden treasures.//It's not too scorching hot, and the daylight hours are just right.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.103_Text: If you haven’t noticed, the ruins and temples tell stories. They’re about the island’s history and folklore.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.107_Text: If you haven’t noticed, the ruins and temples tell stories.//They’re about the island’s history and folklore.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.188_Text: If you stumble upon something on the island that looks super old, make sure to take it to the museum! It could be a real rare artifact.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.304_Text: If you want, you’re welcome to stay at my place sometime.//It’ll give you an idea of what boat living is like. But you better do it during Fall or Spring. That’s when the current isn’t as wild, not right now.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.9_Text: If you’re looking for tips, I know a thing or two about combat.//<portrait=normal>For instance, you don’t want to go into combat without armor…//Common sense, yeah?
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.321_Text: In weather like this, I’m grateful I didn’t skimp on the cost of this boat.//The cheaper model didn’t have as good a heating and cooling system.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.177_Text: It is fun! But I wouldn’t recommend it if you get seasick easily.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.299_Text: It isn’t all bad, I think…moving to another island.//<portrait=blushing>It’s just… I’ve already made a lot of friends here.//<portrait=normal>It would be a waste to leave now, don’t you think?
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.48_Text: It was a mess. My hands were tied, and I couldn’t do anything about it. Good thing it’s all behind me.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.289_Text: It was hard for me to tell my family that what made me happy was leaving home and exposing myself to daily danger…//<portrait=annoyed>But that was the truth, and they brought me up to be a <Italic>truth-teller</>…//<portrait=blushing>It’s this thing my dad used to say.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.264_Text: It's a blast sifting through the sand and discovering all sorts of hidden treasures.//It's like a special treat, especially when I find something cute that I can give to the kiddos.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.218_Text: It's funny, sometimes folks bring me gems and ask me to identify them. But to be honest, I don't really know most of 'em.//<portrait=normal>If you want the real gem expertise, you gotta talk to <NPCName>Scott</>. That guy knows his stuff.//As for me, I just love admiring their sheer beauty.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.236_Text: It’s a good, warm meal for cold nights.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.159_Text: It’s a nice surprise to see someone familiar here.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.275_Text: It’s cool. Never thought I’d make a friend here on Coral Island.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.244_Text: It’s easy to slip when it’s dark and rainy like this, especially when you’re walking on a wet deck.//Be careful.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.79_Text: It’s going to be one hot Summer, isn’t it?//I can already tell.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.105_Text: It’s hard to get any warm sunlight lately. It’s making me feel a bit down.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.56_Text: It’s nice that the sun is up longer, but… Never mind.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.314_Text: It’s nice to not think about anything for a while and just enjoy the colors.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.76_Text: It’s not just the cold that makes treasure hunting a pain in Winter. Soil is much harder to dig too… Pretty much concrete at this point.//Better to just wait until the ice melts.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.60_Text: It’s pretty much Fall, and… Wait, no it isn’t.//<portrait=thinking>It’s only the second week of Summer… I thought it was the 20th already.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.170_Text: It’s really nice to see you here!
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.141_Text: It’s too cold for me to sail.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.3_Text: It’s upsetting to see nature being covered in trash like that.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.98_Special: I’d prefer to keep that to myself.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.25_Text: I’d rather work alone too…//On my own schedule and by my own rules.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.168_Text: I’m always on the lookout for a new adventure.//Look closer, <PlayerName>$player</>. This town is full of it.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.52_Text: I’m impatient for Spring to get here.//Maybe, just maybe, I have too many leads to chase... But hey, that's part of the thrilling journey.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.68_Text: I’m looking forward to <NPCName>Betty’s</> mooncakes. It’s a shame she doesn’t make them more often.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.110_Text: I’m making small changes on the boat.//<portrait=normal>I think it’s a bit tidier.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.64_Text: I’m not saying you can only eat grilled fish in Fall. Grilled fish is top-tier food that can be enjoyed any time of day, any time of year.//<portrait=happy>But it’s so much better when the weather’s a bit frisky. Like in Fall.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.165_Text: I’m supposed to go to the forest today, yet here we are.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.26_Text: I’m thinking of putting a big, fun bell on the bow of my boat.//<portrait=happy>Like a doorbell for a house.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.175_Text: I’ve basically lived here ever since.//<portrait=happy>Comfy, isn’t it?
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.86_Text: I’ve been collecting clues about this island’s secrets.//Though I put my mission off for the Winter and decided to enjoy the weather instead. I can’t wait to get going again.//<portrait=happy>Now that it’s Spring, I’ll continue my adventure.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.69_Text: I’ve been having grilled fish almost every meal for the past two weeks. I think I may have a problem.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.63_Text: Lately, I've been reeling in quite a haul of groupers.//<portrait=normal>They may not win any beauty contests, that's for sure. But once you grill 'em up, all fish taste pretty much the same.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.13_Text: Life feels bland when I’m not after something…//<portrait=annoyed>It's a pity, really. I feel stuck, you know? Like I'm trapped in an endless cycle of one adventure after another.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.193_Text: Life moves more slowly out here. It’s nice not to have to stick to a work schedule, isn’t it?//That's just how I like it.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.151_Text: Living at the pier is great because it’s close to the store and close to people.//It’s nice to know they’re right there.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.196_Text: Living on a boat can be hard. Nature has its whims, and it can turn on you in the blink of an eye.//So,<PlayerName>$player</>, always be prepared for whatever it throws your way.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.256_Text: Living on a boat isn’t much different from living on land. I still have to make sure I have enough food, supplies, and medicine.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.245_Text: Look at it pour out there. Do you think it’ll clear up soon?
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.254_Text: Looks like I’ll have shoveling to do tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.297_Text: Maybe I can throw in a birthday card for my dad too. His birthday is the first of Winter.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.250_Text: Maybe I should just go to bed. I’m not going to get anything accomplished while the weather is this bad.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.190_Text: Maybe being an adventurer isn’t the most conventional career out there.//I get why people are confused. Heh heh.//Is it even considered a career path, you think? Hmm…
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.21_Text: Maybe the lake is a better spot for foraging… Hmm…
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.29_Text: Maybe… Maybe I can grill just one fish for today. That way I’ll still have to eat up my other food tomorrow.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.18_Text: Maybe… Maybe after the town fixes the community garden, I’ll try my hand at growing something.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.290_Text: Mom was way too emotional about it. But I’m glad she…er…at least tried to understand.//I can only imagine the worry I put my parents through.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.179_Text: No reason.//Living on a boat can be fun, but I wouldn’t recommend it if you get seasick easily.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.178_Special: No, I prefer a home on solid ground.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.232_Text: Not that I do much celebrating, though.//That’s not really my style.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.171_Text: Not that many people come to this side of town.//<portrait=happy>Most people like to visit the park instead.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.49_Text: Now that Spring is here, I’m ready to search for treasure again.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.14_Text: Now, is that a good thing or a bad thing? I’ll let you decide.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.96_Text: Of course studying counts! Good luck with that. I believe we never really stop learning.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.104_Text: Oh! Do you feel that wind?
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.31_Text: Oh, and listen to this: Exhibit A—this very morning, I discovered a fresh loaf of bread outside my boat.//I wonder who left it there.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.149_Text: Oh, listen, listen. I tried docking my boat right by your farm, but it got too quiet at night.//<portrait=happy>So I bailed. Doesn’t bother you, huh?
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.93_Text: Oh, that’s right! I heard about that.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.8_Text: Oh, you’re the chatty type.//<portrait=normal>Don’t be insulted if I don’t say hi to you first, okay?//Probably I either don’t see you, or I’m too distracted to notice anything.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.194_Text: On the flip side, having a schedule can bring some structure to life.//I guess there are good things and bad things about it.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.316_Text: Ooh, your hand is clammy! Is everything okay?//<portrait=concerned>You can sit here with me for a bit if you need to.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.284_Text: Parents can be too much to handle sometimes.//<portrait=concerned>Mine are always nagging me about coming home.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.180_Text: Please excuse the mess around here. It may seem chaotic, but trust me, I have a system in place.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.278_Text: Pretty sure I saw a couple of birds flying around and carrying twigs this morning.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.19_Text: Pro tip, <PlayerName>$player</>. Always keep a trusty weapon in your bag, just in case you come across any pesky critters on your journey. You never know!
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.161_Text: Should I move my boat here?
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.72_Text: Since I can’t spend a lot of time out there, I usually read up on the treasures I’m looking for.//The history, clues to their locations, things like that.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.251_Text: Snow makes me just as soggy as rain does. Like a stale chip…//…Left too long between the couch cushions.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.198_Text: Some kids on the island asked me if I’d ever use my boat for racing. I had a good laugh at that.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.240_Text: Some people escape to Winter houses in warmer climates when it gets too cold outside.//I suppose I could move my boat somewhere warmer in Winter.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.215_Text: Some people say you can see strange things if you look closely at precious gems. I don’t think they can tell the future or anything like that, but they’re very pretty.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.317_Text: Sometimes I have dreams about huge fish that pull on my line so hard I fall into the water.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.207_Text: Sometimes people ask if my boat has a name.//I’ve never really thought about it.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.248_Text: Thankfully, I bought some supplies for the boat the other day.//You know…flour, eggs, cookies…the usual.//<portrait=thinking>It’d be annoying to be outdoors when it storms like this.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.140_Text: Thankfully, I have a small heater on my boat for snowy days like this.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.94_Text: That makes sense. I can tell from your outfit. It’s very…um…artistic.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.27_Text: That way, no one will ever sneak up on me unawares!//Could be fun, I think…
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.228_Text: The Summer haze makes adventuring much more enjoyable. Everything feels heavy, still, and mysterious.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.77_Text: The boat isn’t really the best place to live in Winter. There’s a lot of wind, and it’s really hard to keep the heat going.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.187_Text: The breeze feels different on land compared to out at sea.//<portrait=happy>Out there, it feels like it goes on forever!
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.258_Text: The fish aren’t biting today.//I might have to eat something else for dinner.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.61_Text: The forest is my ultimate go-to hangout spot… Not that I don’t like the sea.//<portrait=happy>But there's something magical about the forest, especially this time of year. Food is abundant, <PlayerName>$Player</>!
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.270_Text: The lake is a nice change of pace from the beach and the ocean.
