DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.54_Text: The mud can be annoying in Spring, but it’s still better than the bone-chilling Winter for treasure hunting.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.238_Text: The ocean may rage with storms in Summer, but it can be just as bad in Winter.//And it’s a lot colder.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.257_Text: The only real difference is I can take my home everywhere I go.//<portrait=normal>I like that.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.101_Text: The only thing I know how to make with coconut milk is lodeh.//<portrait=normal>But I’m not in the mood for it. Hmm…
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.87_Text: The question is, will I find anything new today?
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.271_Text: The sand here is certainly less gritty.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.162_Text: The water is calmer where I am, though.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.145_Text: The weather couldn’t be better for reading.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.114_Text: The weather couldn’t be better for reading… Or swimming.//<portrait=surprised>Or heck, fishing!
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.119_Text: The weather couldn’t be better for reading… Or swimming.//<portrait=surprised>Or heck, fishing!
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.129_Text: The weather couldn’t be better for reading… Or swimming.//<portrait=surprised>Or heck, fishing!
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.139_Text: The weather couldn’t be better for reading… Or swimming.//<portrait=surprised>Or heck, fishing!
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.163_Text: The weather is great for a beach day today.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.67_Text: There are a lot of delicious things to forage this time of year.//It's a true blessing, really. No need for me to go shopping most days. Nature provides.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.108_Text: There are ancient scrolls scattered around the island. But there’s no way of knowing exactly where they are.//So we just have to explore lots of different places.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.11_Text: There are ancient scrolls scattered around the island… It’s true.//<portrait=normal>But there’s no way of knowing exactly where they are.//So we just have to explore lots of different places.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.120_Text: There are fish that come out only in the rain.//So look out for those.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.132_Text: There are fish that come out only in the rain.//So look out for those.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.273_Text: There are plenty of gems on this island. I found several rare ones digging around the cavern the other day.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.153_Text: There’s something about this forest that feels mysterious to me.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.202_Text: There’s tons of fish around here, you know. I see them under the surface all the time.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.285_Text: They’re trying to be supportive, though. They never give me a hard time about my…journeys.//<portrait=concerned>But a lot of times the fear shows anyway, and the inevitable nagging follows. Hmm…
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.30_Text: This island is packed with mysteries, <PlayerName>$Player</>! I've been saying it for ages.//Glad to see someone else thinks so.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.288_Text: This island is so much more fun when we explore together.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.311_Text: This might sound strange, but I’m getting used to seeing you in here. You’re part of my home now.//<portrait=surprised>Ha ha! <Italic>No!</> Not like a piece of furniture.//<portrait=normal>Like a family member.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.41_Text: This morning, I found a fresh loaf of bread outside my boat.//I wonder who left it there.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.6_Text: This morning, I woke up with the motivation of a sleepy sloth.//It's one of those peculiar days, I suppose.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.45_Text: Those cats… Er…<NPCName>Bread</> and <NPCName>Butter</>? Did I get the names right?//They’re pretty smart.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.209_Text: Today’s the day I usually clean out the boat. I should probably jump in and do that, shouldn’t I?
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.39_Text: Visitors, you ask? No. People don’t visit me…which is cool because I like my space.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.266_Text: Volleyball isn't really my thing.//That ball is massive, and I gotta admit, it kind of scares me. I mean, imagine getting whacked by that thing.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.116_Text: Well, I personally prefer grilled fish to fish soup.//But today, it just feels like soup kind of weather.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.118_Text: Well, I personally prefer grilled fish to fish soup.//But today, it just feels like soup kind of weather.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.131_Text: Well, I personally prefer grilled fish to fish soup.//But today, it just feels like soup kind of weather.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.138_Text: Well, I personally prefer grilled fish to fish soup.//But today, it just feels like soup kind of weather.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.166_Text: What am I doing here? That’s a good question.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.66_Text: What am I grilling tonight?//<portrait=thinking>Hmm... I'm leaning towards monkfish. I happen to have some in the fridge, freshly caught from the dock yesterday.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.55_Text: What are you bringing for the hot pot, <PlayerName>$player</>? I think I’ll bring whatever fish I manage to catch… Or cookies.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.211_Text: What are you up to today, <PlayerName>$player</>?//I hope you’re taking a little time to explore.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.173_Text: What can I do for you?
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.220_Text: What do you like to do on your days off? I used to go on adventures in my spare time.//Now I get to do it all the time!
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.195_Text: What sort of adventures have you had on your farm? I’d love to hear about them sometime!
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.222_Text: What’s the biggest treasure you’ve ever found? I found this stone tablet last year that ended up going to a museum.//It’s halfway across the world now. The plaque underneath it has my name on it and everything.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.62_Text: When hunger strikes, just wander and forage, then gather 'round a crackling fire.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.259_Text: When it comes to preparing fish, there are a gazillion ways to do it. But let me tell you, nothing beats the sizzling goodness of grilling.//<portrait=normal>It really brings out the flavor.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.223_Text: When you live on a boat, you get to know all the ocean’s emotions.//Calm, upset, furious… It really is just like a human being.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.146_Text: Why do I always see you here?
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.156_Text: Why do you think they built this?
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.292_Text: With my injuries, the places I have to sleep when I’m on the job, and the food that…er…//Anyway, Mom wouldn’t be able to handle it. I’d hate to break her heart over and over again.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.308_Text: Would you ever want to live on a boat?//I wouldn’t want you to abandon your farm or anything, but…I wouldn’t mind sharing with you.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.33_Text: Wow! That would be the dream!
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.46_Text: Yeah! <NPCName>Peanut</> and <NPCName>Butter</>, right… <NPCName>Erika’s</>, right? Yeah. Them.//I see them walking around town at night sometimes.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.95_Special: Yes. I ran a small company from my apartment.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.274_Text: You and I… We aren’t too different.//Neither of us is from here, and you don’t seem to mind a little adventure.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.150_Text: You aren’t lost, are you, <PlayerName>$player</>? You look like a mess alone in the middle of the forest.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.102_Text: You can tell it’s Fall from all these chestnuts. They’re everywhere, like weeds!
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.268_Text: You gotta be careful when eating your lunch here...there's sand everywhere.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.144_Text: You have a lot of snow on you, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.318_Text: You have them too?!//What are the odds! That’s an amazing coincidence.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.43_Text: You know about the treasure chests on this island, right? There are plenty of them in the sea or buried in the cavern.//If you break them open, there may be valuable things in them.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.32_Text: You know what I feel? We're all players in this grand game of life, destined for endless adventures... Yeah...
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.280_Text: You know what? I like the way your mind works… It’s never a dull conversation with you.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.17_Text: You know, here’s an idea. It might not be a bad thing if I started gardening.//<portrait=normal>After all, I eat a lot of veggies.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.191_Text: You look a bit tired. Don't let it get you down, though. It's only Tuesday!//<portrait=normal>We've still got plenty of time for exciting adventures this week.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.88_Text: You look all sweaty. Long day at the farm?
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.57_Text: You never realize how important daylight is until you find yourself scrounging around the woods in the dark, looking for valuables, and end up bringing home a bunch of useless things.//Trash, pretty much… Yeah.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.71_Text: You seem pretty much as active in Winter as you are in Summer.//<portrait=happy>Not that I’m keeping tabs… We just seem to travel a lot of the same paths… Well, this year, anyway.
DT_Dialogue_Zarah_Production.83_Text: You’re not the only new person here.//Have you met <NPCName>Surya</>?

DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.188_Text: <Italic>Woo-hoo!</> Bring on the snow and cold! Happy Winter!
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.FC6227A643F61A98E153518DCFB5CC9D: <Italic>Woo-hoo!</> Bring on the snow and cold! Happy Winter!
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.132_Text: <NPCName>Archie</> and I found a stray cat on the beach yesterday. We tried to catch it, but it ran away.
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.DF9B060943387560822F9287736230F7: <NPCName>Archie</> and I found a stray cat on the beach yesterday. We tried to catch it, but it ran away.
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.158_Text: <NPCName>Archie</> got this really cool new video game for his birthday. It lets you pretend to be a farmer.
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.C524DF034EC9D2643143B6B12E4A6552: <NPCName>Archie</> got this really cool new video game for his birthday. It lets you pretend to be a farmer.
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.0D00DE1C4189F34BF43B44ABE7FED8D5: <NPCName>Archie</> has the coolest monocular!//He said he found it in the forest.
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.237_Text: <NPCName>Archie</> has the coolest monocular!//He said he found it in the forest.
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.198_Text: <NPCName>Archie</> said he was gonna visit <NPCName>Taco</> today.//I wonder if he went in the rain.
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.5C0B916E40A6BA5347F476A20D2ED04C: <NPCName>Archie</> said he was gonna visit <NPCName>Taco</> today.//I wonder if he went in the rain.
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.215_Text: <NPCName>Mr. Barnes</> actually watched <Italic>Prince of Paws</> once!//It’s so cool he watched something my parents made!
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.E2D693614D4A8540B728CDB8D2C2FBBE: <NPCName>Mr. Barnes</> actually watched <Italic>Prince of Paws</> once!//It’s so cool he watched something my parents made!
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.19_Text: <NPCName>Mr. Barnes</> said I could go home early if I finished my schoolwork.
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.4055451D488A3D61BB370BB17277E791: <NPCName>Mr. Barnes</> said I could go home early if I finished my schoolwork.
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.117_Text: <NPCName>Mr. Barnes</> said my heart is in the right place!//That’s good, right?
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.124_Text: <NPCName>Mr. Barnes</> said my heart is in the right place!//That’s good, right?
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.73576F874358C391BDD254A0DDF863A9: <NPCName>Mr. Barnes</> said my heart is in the right place!//That’s good, right?
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.FB18A639470B5F9310AABE916CC36B2F: <NPCName>Mr. Barnes</> said my heart is in the right place!//That’s good, right?
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.139_Text: <NPCName>Mr. Barnes</> taught us some really cool stuff at school yesterday. We learned all about the animals in deserts and tun– tund–
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.5664D76B4EEA03FCF5479F8CF28A607D: <NPCName>Mr. Barnes</> taught us some really cool stuff at school yesterday. We learned all about the animals in deserts and tun– tund–
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.177_Text: A bumblebee got stuck in my room yesterday. It almost stung me too!
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.FD3B2AF8491A3B04C0B14393FA5C7EF9: A bumblebee got stuck in my room yesterday. It almost stung me too!
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.205_Text: A tree keeps hitting the side of our house, and it sounds creepy.//I wish it wasn’t windy anymore.
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.47E69C364D44F38BFF593AAD6096FD01: A tree keeps hitting the side of our house, and it sounds creepy.//I wish it wasn’t windy anymore.
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.154_Text: All the kids in my class are really nice.
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.8519EED341513E4E2D5E019899A6065F: All the kids in my class are really nice.
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.199_Text: Are the birds gonna be okay in the wind?//It’s blowing so hard!
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.DF627BD548D7544161410E8FE2C43F77: Are the birds gonna be okay in the wind?//It’s blowing so hard!
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.197_Text: Are there any cartoons on TV? I can’t play outside if it’s raining like this.
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.A8742C134DAF62B0FAA5A597DDD9D12B: Are there any cartoons on TV? I can’t play outside if it’s raining like this.
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.115_Text: Are there any cool animals on your farm?
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.CE65C51F444D1B10AEA417B463F8DC97: Are there any cool animals on your farm?
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.225_Text: Are you gonna tell my mom I’ve been trying to sneak to the recycling center after school?
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.3A0E035F44837C8E6DA9E4833B11BBDA: Are you gonna tell my mom I’ve been trying to sneak to the recycling center after school?
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.109_Text: Aww… It flew away. You missed it!
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.2781D2C5410246CAD5295E8322CD9DD6: Aww… It flew away. You missed it!
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.2_Text: Can me and my friends still go to your farm and play in the mud?
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.65A8FCBE4F32DEA40B065CA164CB5E9F: Can me and my friends still go to your farm and play in the mud?
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.201_Text: Can you see anything in this storm?
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.4A37F039499BD2405854978BC13530E0: Can you see anything in this storm?
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.146_Text: Dad gave me a notebook I can use to write about the birds I see.
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.8E40C3C843E4AE7ECB95C1A8766811C2: Dad gave me a notebook I can use to write about the birds I see.
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.0E8FAB4D4718F30081AD2E83E091B021: Dad said it was called a Highland cow.//You heard of them, or no?
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.37_Text: Dad said it was called a Highland cow.//You heard of them, or no?
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.43_Text: Dad said it was called a Highland cow.//You heard of them, or no?
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.51_Text: Dad said it was called a Highland cow.//You heard of them, or no?
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.9041B097406AFFD6FCF2FEA4725D1E0B: Dad said it was called a Highland cow.//You heard of them, or no?
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.C4FB2613474E29E8DFE8ADB3CEE69F47: Dad said it was called a Highland cow.//You heard of them, or no?
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.204_Text: Dad says you’d get hit by lightning, though.
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.F25820694420EC092A0AB79C3B707644: Dad says you’d get hit by lightning, though.
DT_Dialogue_Zoe_Production.217_Text: Dad? Are there any good cartoons on?

DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.45_Text: <NPCName>Luke</> talks big about winning the games. We'll show him, babe.//We'll show him who's boss.
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.35_Text: <NpcName>Dippa</> was sharing stories about the days when they used to perform.//So many funny anecdotes!
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.26_Text: <NpcName>Suki</> is pretty upset about <NpcName>Antonio</>.//I would stay away from her today if I were you.
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.1_Text: <PlayerName>$player</>! It's great to see you here!
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.20_Text: Ah, to be back here again... I always like the ocean at night.//It's peaceful.
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.73_Text: Are you cold? Do you want me to grab you an extra jacket?
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.6_Text: Are you here for business or fun, <PlayerName>$Player</>?//<portrait=happy>Oh, I'm clocked in, alright! The town's got me on payroll.
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.65_Text: Babe, have you heard <NPCName>Dippa</>'s story about their days as a performer?
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.60_Text: Babe, watch me play the shooting game later! I can get the score super high.
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.40_Text: Back in my day, we had proper Winter fairs. Still, this one isn't half bad.
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.22_Text: Bet I can skip this stone further than anyone else here!
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.39_Text: Can you believe this doctor? She's hilarious...this one.
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.8_Text: Come check out my Winter special!
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.53_Text: Don't go too far, babe. I don't want you to slip on the ice.
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.56_Text: Feeling alright, sweetheart? I've got an extra scarf if you're feeling chilly.
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.3_Text: He likes napping here... Taco. I'd bring him over to the house, but I don't want to wake him.//<portrait=happy>I'll just hang out here with him.
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.4_Text: Hmm... This gotta be the best quality wine. Is it yours, <PlayerName>$Player</>?
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.18_Text: I could really do with a hot cup of tea. Saw <NpcName>Surya</> enjoying one.//Any idea where he might've gotten it?
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.66_Text: I could really go for a hot cup of tea. Could you find some for us, babe?
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.83_Text: I dare you to throw a snowball at the mayor! What? Come on, it’s all in good fun!
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.33_Text: I figured I'd stay near the Clinic, just in case anyone needs help.
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.9_Text: I have to keep an eye on the time; the journey back home isn't exactly a short stroll.//<NpcName>Paul</>, honey...we can't stay out too late.
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.64_Text: I never knew my mother, and that absence left a void in my life. But with you here, my dad's healthy...I've found a deep sense of contentment.//<portrait=happy>The sea, and, most importantly, having you by my side, makes everything feel just perfect.
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.62_Text: I wonder if I can ask the twins to borrow some blankets for us, or should I go home, you think, and grab us a blanket?
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.51_Text: I'll wait here with Taco, alright, love? If you see some hot tea, do you mind grabbing one for me?
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.50_Text: I'm glad we went out tonight. This is...cool.
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.67_Text: I'm just not used to this level of cold – snow everywhere! Can you even imagine how freezing the water must be right now?
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.47_Text: I'm tempted to try the shooting game. Can you teach me, babe?
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.5_Text: I'm trying to come up with a song, but I'm drawing a blank.//<portrait=happy>Maybe it's the universe telling me to just chill and soak in the moment.
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.70_Text: I've been trying to keep my spending in check today. I've already bought loads of stuff, and I'm pretty sure there's no more room in my luggage to take anything else back home.
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.21_Text: I've never seen the beach this crowded before!
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.27_Text: I, um, don't usually come to fairs, but this one is... nice.
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.28_Text: I... I'm just building a snowman.//<portrait=doubt>Do you want to, uh, build a snowman too?
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.34_Text: I...um...it's just nice being here, with everyone.//But it's a bit...overwhelming. Yeah...
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.42_Text: If there's one thing I miss from this town, it's the festivals. Games, foods, drinks...you name it, the fair has it.//<portrait=happy>I'm so glad I'm here for good now, building a family of my own with you.
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.31_Text: It's so pretty here! I'm gonna see if Dad can buy lights like these for my room.
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.84_Text: I’m just here to pick up some Winter supplies from the vendors. //(happy)Though, I suppose one quick round through the festival stalls couldn’t hurt.
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.23_Text: Just soaking in the Winter Fair vibes, <PlayerName>$Player</>. What are you up to?
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.37_Text: Just trying to blend in.//What is it?
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.71_Text: Let's take a picture by the big tree, darling!
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.82_Text: Look at all these festive lights! Oh, and the trees—they’re incredible this year!
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.76_Text: Look at that awesome light! We should get one for our farm, {ParentLabel}.
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.77_Text: Look at that awesome light! We should get one for our farm, {ParentLabel}.
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.14_Text: Looks like I'm not getting any sleep tonight, having this coffee far too late. Ah, bummer!
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.30_Text: My mom is right there if you want to talk to her.//<portrait=annoyed>I'm busy playing with BonBon.
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.2_Text: Not every day do we get to see this area so dolled up.//<NpcName>Ben</> here has quite a Winter collection, have you checked it out?
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.12_Text: Nothing like a hot cup of tea on a cold day.//<portrait=blushing>Well, maybe a good company, care to join?
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.36_Text: Now that my favorite farmer is here, this fair is complete.
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.57_Text: Now that the love of my life is here, this fair is complete.
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.52_Text: Oh babe, sorry, I have to work. We'll catch up later at home, okay?
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.16_Text: Oh, look at all these pretty things! I can't decide.
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.54_Text: Oh, you're here, thank goodness! So much to do, so little time! I wish I could split myself into two sometimes.//<portrait=normal>Don't be too far, babe, I might need your help.
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.43_Text: Ohh, my hands are freezing! Here, feel them, babe! Ha ha ha.
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.49_Text: Pretty hard to find fault when everything's as beautiful as this.
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.7_Text: Pretty hard to find fault when everything's as beautiful as this.
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.13_Text: So much to do, so little time! I wish I could split myself into two sometimes.
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.17_Text: Such a lively fair, it warms my heart to see people enjoying Winter.
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.72_Text: The lights are so beautiful tonight. Want to go for a walk and check them out, babe?
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.63_Text: The sea always reminds me of Mom.//<portrait=happy>It warms my heart to imagine her watching over us, witnessing my happiness with you.//<portrait=sad>I just wish she could have experienced it in person.
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.15_Text: The temperature has dropped tonight. Luckily, this jacket is nice and thick.
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.19_Text: The things here don't exactly come with a budget-friendly price tag.
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.59_Text: The tree looks good, don't you think, babe? We should get one of those for our house.
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.69_Text: There's a kind of magic at the Winter Fair. Maybe it's the twinkling lights or just the happy vibes, but I'm all for it.
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.48_Text: These little critters here, they got a mind of their own.//Nature's a funny thing, ain't it, sweetheart?
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.10_Text: These little critters here, they got a mind of their own.//Nature's a funny thing, ain't it?
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.61_Text: Things are so expensive, babe. I don't think we should buy anything.//It's not worth the price.
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.78_Text: This fair is so awesome, even in the cold!
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.79_Text: This fair is so awesome, even in the cold!
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.32_Text: This fair might not be up to our usual standards, but it is...quaint.
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.11_Text: This tea's my lifeline, keeping me warm. Without it, I'd probably turn into an icicle by tomorrow.
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.25_Text: This town was already a snack, but with these holiday sprinkles on top? Bam! It's a full-on dessert buffet.//<portrait=happy>It's all about the presentation, <PlayerName>$Player</>!
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.24_Text: This view, the atmosphere, it's all so...beautiful, isn't it, darl?//<portrait=happy>Kind of like you, you beautiful soul!
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.85_Text: Ugh, it’s freezing. I don’t see what’s so magical about standing in the cold staring at overpriced trinkets.
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.55_Text: Want to sneak away and go to the villa real quick?
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.86_Text: What game should I try next?
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.29_Text: Whoa! Did you see that? I'm pretty sure I saw a flying whale. Gotta tell <NpcName>Paul</>!//<portrait=doubt>Can you even see that far, <PlayerName>$honorifics $player</>?
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.58_Text: With so many people here tonight, I'm starting to feel a bit, uh...overwhelmed, yeah...but having you here makes it better.
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.68_Text: Wow, you can see so many stars tonight. Is that...is that Saturn?//Wait, is that really Saturn?
DT_DialogWinterFairFestival.44_Text: You've elevated the vibe here, babe. Come here, give me a hug.

DT_Dynamic_Archie.1_Text: Dad said that you have a coop now.//Do you have chickens?//<portrait=happy>Can I go there and play with the <Italic>chikins</>?
DT_Dynamic_Archie.2_Text: You have how many chickens? 100?!//<portrait=annoyed>Nooo...I don't believe you.

DT_Dynamic_Dinda.1_Text: How's the new coop?//<portrait=happy>That's great to hear! I'm glad you're happy with the result.

DT_Dynamic_Eva.1_Text: You sure are...naked.//<portrait=happy>It kinda fits you.

DT_Dynamic_Jack.1_Text: The coop is done already?! No way!!!//<portrait=happy>Welcome to the ranchers club! Heh heh.

DT_Dynamic_Joko.1_Text: Gotta tell you, <PlayerName>$player</>, that new coop does look good in your farm.//You picked the right location for it.

DT_Dynamic_Leah.1_Text: How do you get so much mud on your clothes? It's not even raining.
DT_Dynamic_Leah.3_Text: I overheard that you started building coops. Is that right?//<portrait=happy>Oh, only 1 coop, huh? That's still an accomplishment.//Look at you...Coral Island's little rancher now, aren't you?
DT_Dynamic_Leah.2_Text: Well... I guess, you don't look so bad.//I don't hate it.

DT_Dynamic_Noah.1_Text: Do you smell that? I think I smell durian.
DT_Dynamic_Noah.2_Text: Well... Farming looks good on you.//But please put some clothes on.

DT_Dynamic_Sam.1_Text: Oh my! This is a place for family.//We have the rights to refuse service for...indecent folks.//<portrait=unimpressed>OK...OK...What do you need?

DT_Dynamic_Surya.1_Text: <NPCName>Aunt Dinda</> told me that you recently got your first coop. That's exciting!//<portrait=happy> I never had a coop of my own but I remember getting my first chickens when I was <NPCName>Archie</>'s age.

DT_Marriage_Zarah.NewRow_2_optionsChoice: <NpcName>{brideNpcName}</>, I vow to you that I will always cherish, support and love you, always.
DT_Marriage_Zarah.NewRow_3_optionsChoice: <NpcName>{brideNpcName}</>, a lifetime is not long enough for me to wake up every morning next to you.I’m lost for words.
DT_Marriage_Zarah.NewRow_9_dialogueText: <NpcName>{brideNpcName}</>, do you promise <PlayerName>$Player</> to honor and love in sickness and in health, as long as you both shall live?
DT_Marriage_Zarah.NewRow_7_dialogueText: <PlayerName>$Player</>, do you promise <NpcName>{brideNpcName}</> to honor and love in sickness and in health, as long as you both shall live?
DT_Marriage_Zarah.NewRow_0_dialogueText: <PlayerName>$Player</>, do you want to read your vow?
DT_Marriage_Zarah.NewRow_11_dialogueText: And now, by the power vested in me, I pronounce you married!
DT_Marriage_Zarah.NewRow_5_dialogueText: I vow to always be by your side, to listen when you speak, to value our differences as much as our common ground.
DT_Marriage_Zarah.NewRow_1_optionsChoice: No, I will read my vow to <NpcName>{brideNpcName}</> in private.
DT_Marriage_Zarah.NewRow_6_dialogueText: Right here, <PlayerName>$Player</>, in front of the Community Center, in a town I call home… I choose you to be my forever. I accept you as you are, and offer myself in return.//I promise to walk with you hand-in-hand, wherever our journey may lead us, living, learning, loving – together, always.
DT_Marriage_Zarah.NewRow_2_dialogueText: That’s the most beautiful thing I’ve heard, <PlayerName>$player</>.
DT_Marriage_Zarah.NewRow_4_dialogueText: Today, I vow to love you with all my heart, to support you in your dreams and aspirations, and to be your faithful partner in all things.//I promise to be a source of strength and love for you.
DT_Marriage_Zarah.NewRow_dialogueText: Welcome all to this joyous occasion, the wedding of our friends, <NpcName>{brideNpcName}</> and <PlayerName>$Player</>.//It’s an honor to be here to unite these two love birds today.

DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.26_Text: *Yawn* Reckon I'm nearly ready to hit the hay.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.205_Text: *shivering* Someone light a fire! I’m freezing in here!
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.239_Text: <NpcName>Joko</> takes his son fishing with him.//Reminds me of my own childhood with my old man.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.229_Text: <NpcName>Luke</> has an electric flute here.//I was thinking of getting it, but I don’t think I’d be disciplined enough to recharge the battery.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.136_Text: <PlayerName>$player</>! Sorry, I just got a little lost in the color of the trees.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.225_Text: <PlayerName>$player</>, I– Oh no, I stepped on a worm!
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.170_Text: <PlayerName>$player</>, have you fed your animals yet today? They could get sick if you forget to feed them.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.187_Text: <PlayerName>$player</>, whoa! Be careful!//<portrait=concerned>You almost stepped on that ant.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.162_Text: A bit too stuffy in here at the moment.//<portrait=concerned>I think the humidity is getting to us.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.10_Text: A rainy day with you feels like a peaceful walk. We should take advantage of it... any ideas?
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.11_Text: A rainy day with you feels like a peaceful walk. We should take advantage of it... any ideas?
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.64_Text: Ah, I might go to Fishensips this weekend.//<portrait=normal>I don’t know.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.216_Text: All this – the blooming flowers, the mesmerizing sound of the rain.//Running into you… They’re my favorite things.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.217_Text: All this – the blooming flowers, the mesmerizing sound of the rain.//Running into you… They’re my favorite things.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.215_Text: All this – the blooming flowers, the mesmerizing sound of the rain.//Seeing you… They’re my favorite things.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.218_Text: All this – the blooming flowers, the mesmerizing sound of the rain.//Seeing you… They’re my favorite things.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.59_Text: And maybe a handful of soybeans.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.50_Text: Animals ain't much different from us.//<portrait=smile>My dad taught me that.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.185_Text: Animals are fine listeners.//Even though they don't have a way of talking back to us, I always feel like they're taking in every word I say.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.149_Text: Animals get cold too, especially when it’s snowing like this. Make sure to turn your heater on, okay?
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.183_Text: Animals that are taken care of well give the best milk, wool, and eggs.//The money from the sale of that stuff helps the businesses around here.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.84_Text: Another year has begun. These cherry blossoms are a beautiful reminder.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.85_Text: Are you close to <NPCName>Macy</>?//<portrait=normal>I believe it’s her birthday tomorrow.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.5_Text: Are you heading to town, darlin'? If you find some fresh treats, get some for me!
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.194_Text: As amazing as watching nature is, I’d rather not be soaking wet while I do it.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.31_Text: Been tendin' to the animals all day.//Mighty fine company they are, though they don't have much to say.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.210_Text: Building a relationship is like growing a flower. It should happen organically.//You can’t force it. Relationships are fragile and beautiful.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.61_Text: But grass doesn’t grow in Winter.//Fact is, most plants don't. So...//<portrait=laugh>That’s when the ranch comes in handy.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.123_Text: But you sure wouldn't wanna be anywhere near me after work, phew!
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.93_Text: Can you hear it, <PlayerName>$player</>?//The trees, they're singin'. Buzzin' with joy that Spring's here at last.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.33_Text: Dad's cookin', bless his heart, might not win any awards, but the man sure puts his all into every dish he whips up.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.68_Text: Don’t forget to feed them, of course!//<portrait=normal>I hope that one is obvious.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.89_Text: Even if I weren’t here, the natural world would keep on going without me.//<portrait=normal>Sounds a bit gloomy, I know, but there's a certain comfort in it for me.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.222_Text: Fall is giving you a magnificent glow today.//<portrait=blushing>I hope your day so far has been as good as you look.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.134_Text: Fall is the most delicious time of year! Nothing beats harvest time for a good meal…or five.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.98_Text: Finally, Spring!//<portrait=daydreaming>I welcome the sound of the creatures coming back to life.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.129_Text: Funbucket, bless his little feathered heart, is one of our ducks.//But <NPCName>Ben</> comes by often to help out with the animals, and they seem to have bonded. So now, Funbucket is his duck too.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.92_Text: Good sense to keep things organized, mind you.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.206_Text: Got a blanket on you, <PlayerName>$player</>?//<portrait=concerned>No?//<portrait=normal>Well, that's alright then.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.148_Text: Have you checked on your animals today?//<portrait=smile>They could use extra love on days like this.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.65_Text: Have you ever looked at the sky and wondered what’s out there?
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.209_Text: Have you ever looked into an animal’s eyes and wondered what they’re thinking or what they’d say if they could talk?//<portrait=daydreaming>It’s one of my favorite things to think about.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.88_Text: Havin' my birthday in Spring, now that's a blessing.//<portrait=daydreaming>It feels like nature is putting on a show for me.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.208_Text: Hey, <PlayerName>$player</>! Watch where you step.//<portrait=normal>You never know where you’ll find manure!
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.95_Text: Hey, you wanna join me and listen to the birds? They’re so cheerful right now.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.73_Text: Hmm... Times when my words don't quite cut it, I lean on my flute to do the speakin'.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.135_Text: Hmm... What was I thinkin' 'bout again?
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.200_Text: Hmm… Just look at her go…
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.159_Text: Hmm… What do you think that painting over there is trying to say?//It's got me curious.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.175_Text: Hopefully, Bessie won’t step on it again.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.29_Text: How about turning in early tonight?
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.12_Text: How was your day? I want to hear all about it.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.46_Text: I ain't much for eggs or milk, stuff like that. But I'm right behind you whatever you choose.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.220_Text: I almost passed out trying to get them off me!
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.190_Text: I always bring extra food for the ants when I come here.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.177_Text: I better check that there weather forecast for tomorrow.//We’ll have to put the animals in the barn if it rains.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.152_Text: I can imagine watching the snow as it falls.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.114_Text: I can’t wait to hear the birds again, <PlayerName>$player</>. I miss their songs on my morning walks.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.8_Text: I cooked something special for you. It’s my dad's recipe.//I hope it fills your heart as much as it fills your stomach.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.58_Text: I don’t carry a weapon or heavy armor around in my bag, only wooden flutes.//Harmless instruments.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.221_Text: I don’t like carrying weapons.//If I’m attacked, then I’m attacked. It’s all right.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.79_Text: I don’t like processed foods, but I’m not gonna lie, I eat 'em  once in a while.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.62_Text: I don’t really go to the beach unless there’s an important event going on.//<portrait=sad>Yeah, no.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.244_Text: I don’t usually wear red. You see, I like to blend in with the forest.//This sweater makes me pop.//<portrait=happy>But it was free, so hey, what can I say?
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.226_Text: I feel horrible.//<portrait=concerned>Will you help me bury it? No animal deserves to be stepped on, even the littlest ones.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.243_Text: I found this green jacket in one of Mom’s chests.//Can you believe it?
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.144_Text: I guess I’ve always known I wanted to work with animals.//I want to make sure they’re properly cared for.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.146_Text: I guess I’ve always known I wanted to work with animals.//I want to make sure they’re properly cared for.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.195_Text: I guess leaving animals out in the rain might make 'em cleaner, but it also gets 'em mighty upset.//<portrait=normal>You should always be sure your animals have a dry place to stay when it rains.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.133_Text: I guess that’s what Fishensips is good for. Nothing warms you up like a hot tea on a chilly evening!
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.70_Text: I have no worries when I’m around you. You're a loving person, darlin'.//<portrait=normal>You just have that aura.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.192_Text: I hope it clears up tomorrow. I really want to eat in the forest again.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.204_Text: I hope this snow stops tomorrow.//Maybe I can go digging for root vegetables after work.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.230_Text: I just can’t get this song right.//<portrait=sad>I’ve been working on it for weeks, but it’s not going well.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.80_Text: I just get really sleepy afterward. Ain't a great feeling, not one bit. Blech!
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.236_Text: I just had my dinner, and I’m <Italic>starving</>. What’s good here?
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.54_Text: I just have this feelin' in my bones.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.9_Text: I know some of his cooking is questionable, but this one is actually good.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.213_Text: I learned how to play pool from <NpcName>Pablo</>. Taught me everything I know.//<portrait=happy>That man is a legend.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.67_Text: I learned this from my granddad.//So, once you have animals, make sure to talk to them every day. It’s all they need.//<portrait=concerned>And food. You get that, right?
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.188_Text: I lent my best tool to <NPCName>Ben</>, but he hasn’t given it back yet. Should I ask him about it?
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.248_Text: I like spending my free time here.//<portrait=happy>These animals are my friends.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.228_Text: I like this place. Nice and cold inside.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.37_Text: I might be out in the woods foragin' today, darlin'.//Nothing beats finding your own supper, makes you appreciate every bite.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.227_Text: I might go to Sam’s later. Do you need anything?//I can pick you up some flour or… What do you need?
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.24_Text: I must say, today was a fine one.//<portrait=normal>You'd be surprised what you can find if you just take the time to really look around Dad's ranch.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.246_Text: I only have one hat.//<portrait=happy>And truth be told, it's all I need, so I see no point in hoarding more.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.72_Text: I prefer to have my lunch break outdoors. Be one with nature, yeah? 'Course, that's when the weather's agreeable.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.166_Text: I prefer to spend my time in nature.//<portrait=daydreaming>Here and the forest are two of my favorite places.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.238_Text: I ran into <NpcName>Joko</> a couple of times by the creek near Ben’s caravan. He seems to like fishing there.//Oh, I was on my way to the hot spring.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.198_Text: I really shouldn’t be out here in weather like this, but I couldn’t help myself.//<portrait=smile>I wanted to see nature’s power firsthand!
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.131_Text: I reckon I say that every year, but this time I mean it!
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.165_Text: I remember Mom brought some weird things home from her combat excursions.//<portrait=smile>My treasure chest was full of silver spoons and colorful rocks.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.196_Text: I sleep so well when it’s raining.//<portrait=daydreaming>The <Italic>tap tap tap</> on my window is strangely comforting.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.66_Text: I spend a lot of my free time doing just that.//<portrait=daydreaming>Looking at the sky, letting my mind wander.//<portrait=normal>This world sometimes feels too small for my imagination.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.42_Text: I swung by Mom's place earlier, and lemme tell you, she won't stop askin' about ya, darlin'.//She sure does adore you.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.100_Text: I think the daisies in Summer are nature telling us it’s happy and healthy. Don’t you think?
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.7_Text: I thought you might be hungry, darlin'.//Here, take this. It's my own recipe.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.174_Text: I took one of my tools to <NPCName>Rafael</> to repair. It came back good as new!
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.127_Text: I was shocked to wake up this morning and realize it’s already the 17th. *sighs*
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.219_Text: I went into the cavern last week and got attacked by giant lava spiders! Phew.//I must’ve spooked them.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.110_Text: I wish I could hibernate like the bears. Sleep through the cold Winter and wake up when it’s warm again in Spring.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.39_Text: I'll tell you a secret...a soft melody at twilight, that's the key to a bountiful harvest.//<portrait=daydreaming>Our plants sway to the rhythm, drinking in the notes.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.1_Text: I'm not against ranching. I'm all about coexistence, balance.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.43_Text: I'm thinkin' 'bout heading into town later, catch up with my friends.//Need anything while I'm out there'?
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.4_Text: I've always felt a deep connection to this place, even before we shared it.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.126_Text: Incredible how time flies, isn’t it?
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.207_Text: Is it just me, or does snow make Winter nights twice as cold?
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.242_Text: Is pumpkin carving still a thing around here?//I remember carving pumpkins when I was in grade school. We got to display them at the town fair.//<portrait=happy>Right, right. The Harvest Festival!
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.169_Text: Is that gross?//Sorry. I just think it’s cool that even animal waste has a good use.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.125_Text: Is there a flower nearby that I can brush it on?
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.118_Text: It stung me, but I think it was just scared.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.36_Text: It's a good kind of tired at the end of the day.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.161_Text: It's good to be back here.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.28_Text: It's music to my ears that never gets old.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.178_Text: It’s Friday! I can’t wait to celebrate at the Tavern tonight.//<portrait=normal>Come with me?
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.102_Text: It’s hotter than I’d like for eating outside, but it’s much better than eating inside.//<portrait=daydreaming>Nothing beats eating in nature, not even air-conditioned rooms.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.115_Text: It’s so cold that even a hot cup of green tea isn’t helping.//<portrait=sad>I should just head inside.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.247_Text: I’ll get a new one when this one has holes in it.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.104_Text: I’m a little sad, darlin'. The trees are starting to lose their leaves, and the animals are leaving.//<portrait=normal>Well, at least I've still got the ranch animals for company.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.151_Text: I’m curious to see how beautiful the view must be from up above.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.203_Text: I’m glad I’m not out there working in that slush.//<portrait=annoyed>I don’t like it, the animals don’t like it. It’s a bad time all around.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.141_Text: I’m glad we have a heater for the animals at the ranch.//<portrait=concerned>I hate to think about them being cold and lonely when I’m not there.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.109_Text: I’m not a big fan of the cold.//It’s hard to eat your lunch outside when you’re constantly shivering.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.75_Text: I’m not a fan of processed foods.//I read in some place they're cooked up to make us hooked on 'em.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.158_Text: I’m not going to buy anything today.//It’s probably not the wisest choice to carry around electronics in this weather.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.94_Text: I’m playing along with the trees, <PlayerName>$player</>. Happy as can be.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.105_Text: I’m savoring all the time I can spend outside now.//<portrait=sad>In about a week, I won’t be able to enjoy the outdoors like this.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.132_Text: I’m trying to catch as much sun as I can by the lake while it’s still Fall.//Once Winter comes, the sun is too weak to warm you up.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.176_Text: I’ve been trying to learn this new song on my flute, but it’s not going so well.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.48_Text: Just glad I ain't gotta deal with that no more.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.167_Text: Just smell that fresh air!//<portrait=smile>I’m so lucky I get to work outside.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.157_Text: Just thought I’d pay the <NPCName>Sanchez</> brothers a visit.//It’s been a while since we all hung out.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.235_Text: Kombucha is great too. But I don’t think they sell any here.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.71_Text: Kombucha is the best drink to have with lunch. Love it, yeah?//Especially when it’s sunny out. It has that refreshing kick, you know?
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.35_Text: Life on the farm ain't never a bore.//From sunrise to sunset, there's always work to be done, animals to tend.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.2_Text: Life on this island, it's always been about respect for all living beings. That's how I want our life together to be...full of respect and love.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.13_Text: Living so close to my folks after we got married is kinda neat.//It's like our family just got a bit bigger.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.99_Text: Look up, <PlayerName>$player</>! The birds are makin' their way back, one by one.//Ain't their songs just the sweetest thing?
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.106_Text: Look up, <PlayerName>$player</>.//<portrait=concerned>A lot of birds are migrating south.//Goodbye, sweet birds.//<portrait=daydreaming>I’ll see you again in Spring.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.164_Text: Lunch tastes so much better here, ain't it?
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.69_Text: Make sure to keep your animals inside when it rains, yeah?
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.142_Text: Make sure you stay bundled up, <PlayerName>$player</>. Even though we’re on an island, it can get pretty chilly.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.172_Text: Make sure you take time to smell the roses! And the petunias, and the tulips, and the daisies…
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.47_Text: Mom always has some guests at the guild, bless her heart.//They make so much noise all the time.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.82_Text: Mom used to slay monsters for a living, but she's hung up her sword for now.//<portrait=normal>Reckons the island's peaceful enough these days, so she just keeps an eye on that cavern.//Wouldn't let me nowhere near that place as a kid. Monster infested, she said.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.83_Text: My folks and I... We don't always see eye-to-eye on everything, but they respect my views, and that means a lot.//<portrait=normal>For example, my parents don’t celebrate birthdays, but they don’t force that view on me. I celebrate mine, all right!//Born and bred in Spring, on the 9th!
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.56_Text: My friends <NpcName>Pablo</> and <NpcName>Rafael</> are very talented blacksmiths.//<portrait=smile>They’re my go-to experts when the ranch needs any tools fixed, bless their hearts.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.245_Text: My hat, well, it keeps me warm when the chill of Winter sets in.//Gotta make sure to stay cozy.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.139_Text: My old man enters a cookin' competition every darn year.//Mom and I usually go to town to watch and give him emotional support.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.153_Text: My old man taught me how to handle animals at a young age.//I feel like almost all my significant memories are here on this ranch.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.55_Text: No doubt about it, the cows do seem to take kindly to my flute playin'.//It helps 'em wind down a bit.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.63_Text: No reason. I guess I just don’t have the drive to go to the beach that much.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.108_Text: Not gonna lie, Winter bums me out a bit. The trees are quiet, and a lot of animals are either hibernating or have migrated to somewhere warmer.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.96_Text: Nothin' like being able to have your lunch out in the open again.//I missed doing that in Winter.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.32_Text: Nothin' quite like wanderin' back to the homestead after a day at the ranch, greeted by your smile, my darlin'.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.44_Text: Now don't you overdo it, <PlayerName>$Player</>.//I get to worryin' when you're workin' too hard.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.189_Text: Oh well. He’ll probably return it when he’s done.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.201_Text: Oh! My apologies there.//<portrait=normal>I sort of got lost in the swirling wind.//<portrait=laugh>It's all very theatrical, don't you think?
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.49_Text: One thing I can tell you, darlin', rancher to rancher.//You need to talk to your animals to connect with them.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.124_Text: Oopsie! Got a bit of pollen on my hat.//Lucky it didn't fall in my eyes.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.186_Text: Or maybe they’re just waiting to see if I pull a snack out of my pocket.//<portrait=smile>That’s also possible.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.145_Text: Our animals don’t like the rain very much.//<NPCName>Luke</> said Taco hates it too.//<portrait=laugh>He gets really lazy and stays inside the house all day when it rains.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.163_Text: Please help yourself, <PlayerName>$player</>.//<portrait=normal>We’re all family here.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.86_Text: She’s a beautiful soul with a big soft spot for animals.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.101_Text: Since the days are longer in Summer, it’s nice to have all this time to spend outside.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.202_Text: Snow is part of nature, but it’s not my favorite part.//<portrait=laugh>I’d rather be stretched out under the Spring sun than slipping on this ice.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.160_Text: So many thoughts went into that art piece.//<portrait=daydreaming>When I look at it, I can feel conviction and hope deep down in my bones.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.232_Text: Some of these trees have been here for a hundred years or more.//They’ll probably be here a hundred years after you and I are gone, too.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.211_Text: Some relationships aren’t meant to last long. They wilt when it’s time.//Remember to enjoy it while it’s in bloom.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.182_Text: Sometimes I even hear them when I zone out.//<portrait=laugh>Or maybe that’s because there’s a cow standing right behind me.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.74_Text: Sometimes, well... there just ain't no other way 'round it. Words alone just ain't enough.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.52_Text: Speak your heart's desires, <PlayerName>$player</>.//<portrait=normal>And let nature decide your next steps. That's how I go about it.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.87_Text: Spring is my favorite time of year!//<portrait=normal>The flowers are opening up, the fawns are learning to walk. It feels like everything is waking up after Winter.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.91_Text: Spring is the time to plan for the year to come.//Have you taken stock of all your crops and animals yet?
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.122_Text: Summer heat makes moving the animals twice as hard. It’s not so bad, though.//At least it’s already light when I get up in the morning!
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.103_Text: Sure, the Summer heat makes my work harder, but I’d rather sweat it out surrounded by nature than stay inside.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.45_Text: That Mayor, always stirrin' up a storm.//See him dashin' all 'round town, busy as a bee.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.233_Text: That might sound depressing, but I think it’s pretty romantic, actually.//<portrait=daydreaming>Old trees, the sentinels of the forest. It’s like something out of a fairy tale.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.212_Text: That’s a nice Summer outfit you got, <PlayerName>$Player</>.//I should get something like that. What do you think?
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.57_Text: The boys make durable weapons too.//Mom always puts in a good word for 'em.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.117_Text: The bugs are always thickest in Summer.//Just yesterday, found a wasp in the barn, took it outside.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.119_Text: The color of the lake is so beautiful this time of year.//When you splash, the water catches the sunlight, makin' tiny rainbows.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.14_Text: The farm, you, me...it's like we're living out a good old country song, yeah?
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.116_Text: The hot spring sounds so good right now.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.154_Text: The loudest quack is Funbucket’s.//<portrait=smile>He's our most outspoken duck, no doubt about it.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.180_Text: The mayor was telling me the other day that you’re quite the rancher!//<portrait=normal>So proud of you, darlin'.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.77_Text: The more I think about us, folks, the sadder I get. We put chemicals in our food.//Some of us, we push others around for no good reason. Just ain't right.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.143_Text: The plants and animals are all sleeping, tucked away under the snow. It makes me feel like I should be sleeping too.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.90_Text: There are so many delicious things you can grow in Spring!//<portrait=daydreaming>My mouth is watering with all the taco possibilities…
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.193_Text: There’s not much you can do outside when it’s raining, so I like to pass the time in here.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.41_Text: This farm life can be tough, but it's all worth it when I see our crops growin' strong.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.130_Text: This is the most beautiful foliage I’ve ever seen on Coral Island!
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.137_Text: This island looks like a whole new place when it's covered in snow like this.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.168_Text: This might sound weird, but I don’t mind the smell of manure.//Dad was telling me it makes great fertilizer for the fields!
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.197_Text: This storm is really nasty, <PlayerName>$player</>!//<portrait=concerned>You shouldn’t be out in it!
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.199_Text: To be safe inside, with a roof over my head during a storm… It makes me feel very grateful.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.150_Text: To keep warm during Winter, Mom used to go to the cavern and slay monsters.//<portrait=concerned>I felt kind of bad for her.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.107_Text: Want some of my green tea, <PlayerName>$player</>? I always carry some in Fall. It’s a nice, quick warm-up when it’s chilly.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.60_Text: We can grow our own animal feed by growing grass on the farm.//<portrait=normal>It can save us a lot of money.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.155_Text: We could use an extra heater here.//<portrait=normal>Can I help you with anything?
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.179_Text: Well now, I gotta work tomorrow mornin' myself, but any excuse to spend time with <NPCName>Frank</> and <NPCName>Pablo</> is a good one.//Can't beat good company, I reckon.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.30_Text: Well now, ain't this just the finest mornin'?
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.237_Text: Well, ain't this a nice way to end the day, takin' a moment to relax and unwind.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.25_Text: Well, how about you, darlin'? What went down in your world today? Any adventures or discoveries?
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.53_Text: What a glorious day we're havin'! // I reckon it's gonna be a stellar week.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.38_Text: What better way to spend a fine Spring day like this than foragin'?
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.173_Text: What’s that amazing smell? Did you bring me a snack, <PlayerName>$player</>?
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.234_Text: What’s your favorite drink? Mine’s green tea.//<NpcName>Frank</> here can whip up just about any drink ya fancy. He's quite the master behind that bar.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.111_Text: When it’s cold like this, there’s nothing like a cup of hot green tea to warm you up.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.181_Text: When you work with animals like I do, you start to hear moos and baas in your sleep.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.240_Text: Where do people go in Summer? It seems like it’s not as lively out right now.//<portrait=happy>Ah, right. They’re probably at the beach.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.156_Text: While you're here, lemme just say somethin' real quick.//You still need to feed your animals, even though they’re out during the day.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.19_Text: Who would have thought, <PlayerName>$player</>, a simple rancher like me finding bliss on this tiny island, with you.//It's just...perfect.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.171_Text: Whoops! I almost bumped into you!//<portrait=normal>Where are you off to in such a rush?
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.97_Text: Why coop up indoors when there's all this beauty outside? Just look at all these blossoms!
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.249_Text: Why don't we take a little break and chill for a bit?//I’ll put something on the TV if you want.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.81_Text: Wild fruit and mushrooms are gifts of nature.//They’re so easy to find around here.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.113_Text: Winter is always so quiet.//Hear that? Basically nothing. Just faint music far, <Italic>far</> away.//Don’t worry, I hear it too. It’s nature’s music.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.112_Text: Winter makes me think of roasted almonds.//<portrait=normal>Hmm, maybe I’ll stop by Sam’s and buy some to roast over the fire.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.3_Text: Working on Dad's ranch has taught me the value of hard work and persistence.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.191_Text: Wow, it’s been raining since this morning.//<portrait=sad>The animals aren’t going to be happy about being cooped up all day.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.51_Text: Wow. Your life's a hive of activity.//Don't forget to take a breather and commune with Mother Nature.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.184_Text: Yeah, money is nice.//<portrait=concerned>But it shouldn’t be the only reason to be kind to animals.//<portrait=normal>They deserve love, just like we do.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.121_Text: You harvested any pineapples yet?//Heard they're somethin' special when grilled!
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.27_Text: You hear that? Night sounds are so much more alive out here.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.40_Text: You know, I told <NpcName>Theo</> about this. He agreed.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.231_Text: You want to help me? That’s kind of you.//<portrait=normal>It’s, uh, something I have to do on my own, though. Unless you can read my mind. Ha ha.
DT_MarriageDialogue_Kenny.15_Text: You've really got a knack for handling the animals, <PlayerName>$player</>.

Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.5FA549AC422C5012AE4BF4BF6BF7C89E: <NpcName>Em</>, I made you breakfast. Thought you might like some.
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.E526CE0C44AEE39A9022FDB04F7C12DD: <NpcName>Sam</> and I... We lost the baby.
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.4ABBE6C14D810BCC4D68A890B66B02C7: But now...it's time to let go and donate these items.
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.05238F4640BCB62E65AE6AA66B72F356: But you're not alone, okay? Never alone.//Some days are harder than others, but remember, it’ll pass…//I'm here for you, no matter what.
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.42D6B16A4341C28692AA369EE7102230: Er...I can just come back some other time.
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.F67D9B1843C8FA9827ED7AA2AD7C2650: Er...I can just come back some other time.
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.AA234898415ED77C12844E96EDE339D9: Hah hah! Must be pretty.//<portrait=normal>You know, I've always worn my hair short like this... I wanna say my whole life. //<portrait=happy>This one time in grade school, when I was about your age...
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.F285095A4B10284BA1F4DABE59ABFC50: Hah hah! Must be pretty.//<portrait=normal>You know, I've always worn my hair short like this... I wanna say my whole life. //<portrait=happy>This one time in grade school, when I was about your age...
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.71C1C17F41FD21A35AF5758CF20557F4: Hey <PlayerName>$player</>, please join us for dinner!
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.49E53CD44B98E8BB8683FEBF29A0FE75: Hey there, <PlayerName>$player</>. Welcome!//<portrait=default>What can I do for you today?
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.793B1F5D42D2BC9AEAD327B5AC9C85C0: Hey there, <PlayerName>$player</>. Welcome!//<portrait=default>What can I do for you today?
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.FA4142604D360785C1ACF8B9B8938640: Hey, I thought I heard some voices in here.
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.3B7519414E59283B94E9378671AFA4A0: I just... I don't have the strength today.
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.315981E345593D63B8DDEBBDF2BABD31: I know it's hard, but I think some fresh air might help.//How about we take a walk later?
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.70F1663D4EAAD5107EF93987D289B54B: I'm sorry, honey...//I'm sorry that you have to go through this...
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.BD0EE5D443CA29BD0302919D5B3DEB27: I've been having a hard time clearing out the <Italic>extra room</>.
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.9D3082B744CB26133D769090C93AB451: If you ever need help or advice, just let <NpcName>Sam</> know.
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.E39DD7AA468618F92DDBF796802E5D7D: It's okay.//Just having you here helps.
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.5CBF2A5A407A27945DF32BB8BFCBA9F3: It's our way of finding closure.
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.6CD581AB4C6E7D1472A77584E4EFFA33: Need an extra pair of hands?
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.D027AA69407F065A711A52BED22ED53A: No, no... It's not your fault.//It's just...
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.0181031145D083C68359A7B7DCE77413: Nothing major.//<portrait=default>We're just trimming her hair a bit.//<portrait=happy> Making it all nice and even.
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.2EA1187243AC58EA3ADEFAA663B29A8A: Nothing major.//<portrait=default>We're just trimming her hair a bit.//<portrait=happy> Making it all nice and even.
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.47071BD34AF8747FD04214BD5849CED7: Oh no, I'm sorry to hear that. Maybe I can help you figure out what went wrong.
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.2E8BDA3F40C3C0E4B3801BA7E6A2A6A5: Oh, I can recommend some places to get high-quality seeds. Hah hah hah!
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.A46727254A5F262E85D3E1A58E3E7004: Oh, no need to rush out.//<portrait=default> I won't be long, just make yourself comfortable.
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.C37097B04008EABFD67A6C8C506BA372: Oh, no need to rush out.//<portrait=default> I won't be long, just make yourself comfortable.
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.E42E29514372F1CD0D4AF59BAD373558: Oh, you have to bring it over next time.
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.339444A741B0F451DABC4A86D36FE4D8: Oh... I'm so sorry, <NpcName>Emily</>. I didn't mean to...
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.2D0C550542FFD97D2A95DFB3EBCB700D: Perfect timing! I could use some help with packing, if you don't mind.
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.82C55C1E421C3C35EA7048B4AD3F604A: Sorry about that, dear.//<portrait=default> Shall we continue?
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.E665D1914DC80EF9999D2DAB8FBEC75F: Sorry about that, dear.//<portrait=default> Shall we continue?
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.FFFA292542A7422A44F68AB3612A72B3: Speaking of farming, <NpcName>Dippa</> and I were planning our next seeds for the garden, and we found the cutest picture!
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.723D497446D1647AB759A7AF5AC83290: Thank you and don't worry. Take your time!
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.78BBB5824BEF42386C23689114B6BB2F: Thank you and don't worry. Take your time!
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.A214C52E49E53FEE490C729829A552A7: Thank you!//I brush my hair everyday.//And then when I brush too much...my hair goes puff! It gets super big.
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.BBE49CE54EA6C1432FE7989094CDD2F1: Thank you!//I brush my hair everyday.//And then when I brush too much...my hair goes puff! It gets super big.
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.6932E6424C19A04E94C311A1D65AC219: Thank you. It's been really tough, but we'll get through it.
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.BF235E334CEDAD21B14D259B2C381A0D: Thanks. It helps to know I'm not alone.
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.9C5FDF0045420A3971924B9C12F963FE: That's great to hear! Keep up the good work.
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.6EF5A24A4EE5D22FF2982BBE049FDE94: We were so excited, we rushed into buying everything for the nursery.
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.1E22D7664DF59407697934ACB19E313D: What are you doing to her hair right now?
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.5DEDA6BD45965AE4C81620A01362290B: What are you doing to her hair right now?
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.F58EB93B4F6C29A18A9E5D8253E660C2: Why me? Why us? We tried so hard...
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.153855BC4BB7B24E591E378BF7C4D42D: Wow! Look at your hair!//So nice and shiny. You're taking great care of your hair, missy.//<portrait=happy>These curls are beautiful.
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.DA980BB74DF90FB1B4D00A9119F6962A: Wow! Look at your hair!//So nice and shiny. You're taking great care of your hair, missy.//<portrait=happy>These curls are beautiful.
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.41CFA91F43AD612DD720F0BE142B92ED: Yeah, I have to show you all. It's from our first date.
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.8ECBA8F141707F2BCFE71087D8915D25: Yeah, I keep them in the nursery...//<portrait=concerned>Oh…um…
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.98A980054C5E3782DDE9D9BA0918BA0F: Yeah, actually. That would be nice.
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.E9121C474ADCC5251E7765B78FAA2751: You know, I think <NpcName>Sam</> and I have a first date picture too, don’t we, <NpcName>Sam</>?//We were so adorable!
Emily_Heart_2_Cutscene.3A9ACDF842DDCEDACB9F15B420F3713F: You're the strongest woman I know.//But it's okay to lean on me when you need to.//<portrait=normal>I'm always here for you.

Emma_Heart_2_Cutscene.1_dialogueText: Hey, <NpcName>Eva</>. Did you make any cakes today?//<portrait=concerned>I kinda need one fast.
Emma_Heart_2_Cutscene.2_dialogueText: I didn’t. Sorry!//<portrait=concerned>I have some fresh-baked cookies though.
Emma_Heart_2_Cutscene.10_dialogueText: I gotta go and write some letter.
Emma_Heart_2_Cutscene.8_optionsChoice: Send her flowers and Dinda's wall clocks too.
Emma_Heart_2_Cutscene.7_optionsChoice: She doesn’t have to know. It would just upset her. Tell her you did send her a cake and the mail service might have sent it to the wrong address.
Emma_Heart_2_Cutscene.6_optionsChoice: Tell her the truth and apologize. She's your mom, this doesn't have to be a big deal. You mean well.
Emma_Heart_2_Cutscene.9_dialogueText: Thanks for the help, folks.//I think I’ll buy a couple of cookies to send over.
Emma_Heart_2_Cutscene.6_dialogueText: Yeah, I think I will do that.//I just feel really bad because she must have been waiting for it all these time.

Erika_Heart_2_Cutscene.1B470DC34DCA1A73FC74B4A16BEB5601: <PlayerName>$player</>! I didn’t know you would come tonight! We would’ve waited for you.
Erika_Heart_2_Cutscene.0D65F11944B915B868210C8B48FD82A2: I have never tasted anything like it before.
Erika_Heart_2_Cutscene.A199809648F30641EA18209B2A162B85: I would tell you the secret, but then it wouldn’t be a secret anymore, would it, <PlayerName>$player</>?
Erika_Heart_2_Cutscene.077FEDF34402AE9D9A2876B64A812054: Please join us! I made curry.
Erika_Heart_2_Cutscene.6246C3D24D8A88E37EF283B8429B6661: That’s my new drink mix. I’m thinking to sell that at the tavern next week!
Erika_Heart_2_Cutscene.979864614DEA91B04463078322A10F60: Well, please have a taste. The curry is always delicious.//It’s my all-time favorite meal.
Erika_Heart_2_Cutscene.DECB29794110FBA895D718B1966D920F: Wow! That’s exactly what <NpcName>Erika</> said! Right?!

Eva_Heart_2_Cutscene.9B19E2914DD8C950427C06BEC08CF2C5: Hey, at least it's still bread, right?
Eva_Heart_2_Cutscene.7_optionsChoice: I burned myself. Where’s your oven mitt anyway?
Eva_Heart_2_Cutscene.6_optionsChoice: I think I burned myself. Forgot to use an oven mitt.
Eva_Heart_2_Cutscene.20F3F27447295CB030E8A5BF3333B8E3: I think I’ll mail the recipe to <NpcName>Bree</> tomorrow.//She bakes her own bread, you know. She has to give this one a try.
Eva_Heart_2_Cutscene.B788CF1A46C0260C3414F09FCB2F7973: I've just tried this new recipe. It makes the bread so much softer.
Eva_Heart_2_Cutscene.4_dialogueText: My hands are full.//Could you take the cookies out of the oven, please?//<portrait=annoyed>I’d hate for them to burn.
Eva_Heart_2_Cutscene.6_dialogueText: Oh no! I’m so sorry!//You poor thing.
Eva_Heart_2_Cutscene.7_dialogueText: Oh no! I’m so sorry.//The oven mitts should be around here somewhere…
Eva_Heart_2_Cutscene.2_dialogueText: Really?//<portrait=blushing>I’m not sure about that, but thank you! I appreciate the kind words.
Eva_Heart_2_Cutscene.3_dialogueText: Since you’re here, could you help me out real quick?
Eva_Heart_2_Cutscene.6D1CDF524681C33F101F1590D7777BC6: Speechless? I hope that's a good sign.
Eva_Heart_2_Cutscene.9_dialogueText: Umm…//I’m so sorry about what happened.//I hope your hand heals soon, <PlayerName>$player</>.
Eva_Heart_2_Cutscene.08DAE51647A2C025E84FECA741A9B7CB: Well, why don’t I mail it to you too?!//<portrait=happy>You know what? I think I’ll do that!

Intro_Scene_-_Format__1_.1_dialogueText: $player? Welcome back to Coral Island, your new home. I hope the ride here wasn’t too bad.
Intro_Scene_-_Format__1_.2_dialogueText: You have a big piece of land here, $player. Anyway, here’s a little something from the town to get you started. If you need anything, I’m at your disposal… Or you can find the mayor. He probably knows more about this town than I do.
