Jack_Heart_2_Cutscene.E79DE64C4C40827B4AA1BDA0594CB634: <NpcName>Jack</>, dear. You know I love you, but how in the world are you letting this happen?
Jack_Heart_2_Cutscene.452793C54A6EC26028739D8C85451EDC: <PlayerName>$player</>! Great running into you here! Join me, won’t you?
Jack_Heart_2_Cutscene.3_dialogueText: <PlayerName>$player</>! Perfect timing. Come in! Join us.
Jack_Heart_2_Cutscene.335E70A843A97A607C1E788FE9E7E41B: Ahh, my favorite time of day. No customers, no responsibilities.//Nothing to do but relax and take in the sounds of silence.
Jack_Heart_2_Cutscene.CEF2D0144C79ADBA760141899277FFE7: Although there’s only so much silence one can take, really. In a day.
Jack_Heart_2_Cutscene.805B135F4498031DE4D28AB36CFCF6FD: Before I did research on the internet.
Jack_Heart_2_Cutscene.4EC908B2405DA256837F36B822370F93: Bessie got loose in the shop.
Jack_Heart_2_Cutscene.8_dialogueText: But I’m sure I got the recipe right. I wrote it down.
Jack_Heart_2_Cutscene.D7FFD0F8499D249FE34D9CB664AD4A63: But at least you love the work, right?
Jack_Heart_2_Cutscene.A14AFC4D403DEBCD850CCA89297ED10E: But…well, here’s the thing. I’m a rancher at heart. Always have been.//I fell into the store management as something of a necessity, but it’s not where my passion is.
Jack_Heart_2_Cutscene.B171128547BA012A816FAD9E0D6A22DF: But…well, here’s the thing. I’m a rancher at heart. Always have been.//I fell into the store management as something of a necessity, but it’s not where my passion is.
Jack_Heart_2_Cutscene.827FEAD948A282A5151D3FBEBE1116C5: Can I get you a drink? The cider is wonderful today.
Jack_Heart_2_Cutscene.29C363F34DEB760BD8A94D8C929222BB: Come on now, Bessie. This is hard enough without you—
Jack_Heart_2_Cutscene.C3E37E4D4D40DD7EC38747B334565E27: Come on, you stubborn old thing! What’s gotten into you today?
Jack_Heart_2_Cutscene.713AA9A741E30393CE7E139AD04B406F: I guess I wouldn’t mind some action around here. Something to break up the monotony.
Jack_Heart_2_Cutscene.F6A67EDC42A5CCB8DEB8CDB39BC1CF67: I know, it’s just that Bessie there has been feeling extra anxious today. It’s vaccine day, and I think she remembers getting these shots herself.
Jack_Heart_2_Cutscene.E12F23424F3D8A0F0029D1B31CA1D98D: I swear, I’ve spent a week in the caves and come back less sore than you. What happened?
Jack_Heart_2_Cutscene.2ED67045495AB0CA6A86DAA762520FB6: I think she was trying to run the register. I don’t know.//By the time I found her the front counter was destroyed and we had an unspeakable mess in the back room.
Jack_Heart_2_Cutscene.6_dialogueText: Isn’t it?! It smelled a bit funny at first. I was really worried, to tell you the truth. I thought I used the wrong ingredients.
Jack_Heart_2_Cutscene.1E142D7A4FE418E1C114FC9828436F92: It’s been a long time since I’ve been back at it, <NpcName>Kira</>. My muscles have to remember what they’re doing. It’ll be a process.
Jack_Heart_2_Cutscene.5_dialogueText: It’s egg…frittata something. I can’t remember.
Jack_Heart_2_Cutscene.2ED08AEB43374DD5826A8191635500BE: I’m glad I ran into you, <PlayerName>$player</>. I’m facing something of a conundrum.
Jack_Heart_2_Cutscene.BDAC07204F5CE466A997F5A78FF9EBF1: I’m glad I ran into you, <PlayerName>$player</>. I’m facing something of a conundrum.
Jack_Heart_2_Cutscene.8D210790435726C10ED89BB847CE73B4: I’m not sure the smell is EVER going to come out, if I’m being honest.
Jack_Heart_2_Cutscene.177AEF494DB42D97AF3D25950D4A5638: I’m so proud of him. <NpcName>Kenny</> has a great hand with the animals, and it’s amazing to see what he’s doing with the ranch.//I always hoped he’d follow in my footsteps, and it brings me so much pride to see how well he’s doing.
Jack_Heart_2_Cutscene.AAF6181F49913148A01F89A02092C2D8: I’m so proud of him. <NpcName>Kenny</> has a great hand with the animals, and it’s amazing to see what he’s doing with the ranch.//I always hoped he’d follow in my footsteps, and it brings me so much pride to see how well he’s doing.
Jack_Heart_2_Cutscene.2_dialogueText: No, you just sit down. Let me serve you two my special egg dish.
Jack_Heart_2_Cutscene.3BD6DA7043F8D1561222C894E6C276C5: Now now, girl. It’ll be okay.
Jack_Heart_2_Cutscene.FDAC89BF4FCC0F9C7A721DB82F18E7EB: That bag on your hands. What is that?
Jack_Heart_2_Cutscene.835E34B34E042D315A283DAB19D85CA1: There there, girl. This is just some medicine, nothing more than that. We don’t want you to get sick now, do we?
Jack_Heart_2_Cutscene.A8B1E04B450AB4525631F38798DB6C99: To each their own, I guess. But you’re missing out.
Jack_Heart_2_Cutscene.B240D2DC42E2071E1D7C278DE33D7D7F: To each their own, I guess. But you’re missing out.
Jack_Heart_2_Cutscene.6317614E4A816DAD3B5C188B3E638B22: Too much silence, too much time alone, and who knows what you may start doing?//You might even start talking to yourself, right?
Jack_Heart_2_Cutscene.10_dialogueText: Wait… What? Was I not supposed to put fish in the batter?
Jack_Heart_2_Cutscene.3059B34B4E1EAA8EBD79B3A17C94784C: We’ve been using this feed for years, dad.//Didn’t you tell me that Starlet Town has the best cattle feed on the whole island?
Jack_Heart_2_Cutscene.71A5F1A74EAF193A5F51FF868C74B470: Woah there! It’s just a little shot, that’s all. It’ll be over quick and I’ll get you back to mom, okay?
Jack_Heart_2_Cutscene.E6A0511549CCD52FD1819BA5491705B8: Woah woah woah! You’re doing that all wrong, son.
Jack_Heart_2_Cutscene.8162CF9D4426012D82862482959CFAB1: You haven’t been on the island for too long yet, have you?//You wouldn’t have known me as anything other than the store manager down at the ranch.//It’s my son who does the real ranching these days.
Jack_Heart_2_Cutscene.E11681404D59F48B73135EA204BC2D3F: You haven’t been on the island for too long yet, have you?//You wouldn’t have known me as anything other than the store manager down at the ranch.//It’s my son who does the real ranching these days.
Jack_Heart_2_Cutscene.074E4E24439233A6D6AD8BAF5649C3AA: You just have to know how to treat ‘em, son.
Jack_Heart_2_Cutscene.B222C3F24143A11089BE0BB6D65EC288: You love the late nights and the sore muscles and sleeping with one eye open, just like you did when you were young.//You love always worrying about having enough feed, enough medication, enough pasture.

Joko_Heart_2b_Cutscene.AD6636B04F404C635844E9BCA1491A7D: <PlayerName>$player</>, could you give me a hand?//With your help, this job can be done sooner.
Joko_Heart_2b_Cutscene.FF2783FD4D61659C782D6CABCDF60951: After all, a good deed should never go unrecognized.
Joko_Heart_2b_Cutscene.B35357074AD566081FA0AEBADDA01C11: Ahh, that’s very unfortunate. We need the HVAC running as soon as possible.//Humid air from the recent rainfall could damage the books in my office and the library.
Joko_Heart_2b_Cutscene.AB968EFE47AFF24F17D604B167C8EDFD: All right, let’s head back to the community center and turn on the HVAC right away!
Joko_Heart_2b_Cutscene.79B1F1F3468500E9CB84BDA3CDAB4FB2: Amazing! I know I can always count on both of you!
Joko_Heart_2b_Cutscene.E9D5DFA24BF5C9BB66C2B295443224F6: Big thanks to <PlayerName>$player</> for helping out.//I really appreciate it.
Joko_Heart_2b_Cutscene.944BFDE94AF2B0B09D5ABABE406248E9: Don’t worry, it’s simple. I’ll guide you along. You just need to reconnect the wires.
Joko_Heart_2b_Cutscene.7DF285714E9F561252D8ADBF08492EE4: Enough small talk. Shall we get to work?
Joko_Heart_2b_Cutscene.EAFFAEED4EA3545A120B6D8E06A64329: Hello, <PlayerName>$player</>. Taking care of town business too?
Joko_Heart_2b_Cutscene.881ADEB340429C7255BB898FCD9DB7FB: I got here not too long ago. The mayor should be here soon. I promised him I’d take a look at the broken HVAC unit.
Joko_Heart_2b_Cutscene.8FC6B2F54CF326DBF96253A228BD6A4F: I think I might know what’s wrong. A similar thing happened to my brother’s HVAC unit years ago.//Let’s check the electrical panel first.
Joko_Heart_2b_Cutscene.9A3065D74CE2E1E38254DD8B6C8F13C2: Maybe a wiring issue? Or a blown fuse? I don’t know what to do.
Joko_Heart_2b_Cutscene.C696059E4726284B33DD20961BAE2C97: Oh no, that’s all right. It won’t cost me anything. Please, it’s the least I can do to contribute to the town.
Joko_Heart_2b_Cutscene.19828ABB4E53E01B1F4EC1A90B80696C: Please bill me for your time, <NpcName>Joko</>. I’ll sort it out right away.
Joko_Heart_2b_Cutscene.57D4470443D7E52E93E929BA2B09F336: Sure. It’s just outside, beside the recycling center. This way…
Joko_Heart_2b_Cutscene.1294263E4AD2060B0C98ECA7E380DC16: Thanks for meeting me here, by the way. I know you’re a busy man, <NpcName>Joko</>, so I’ll keep it short.//I have no idea what happened. Last week, I received a complaint from <NpcName>Leah</> about the HVAC not working.
Joko_Heart_2b_Cutscene.FDD90A3243E8A014AA5B27A04DF5E38E: There. That should do it.//<portrait=normal>You handled it pretty well, <PlayerName>$player</>.
Joko_Heart_2b_Cutscene.D31D0EF84A982AF7B01942A2288408D9: Well, if you insist. I’ll be sure to let everyone know at our next town meeting.
Joko_Heart_2b_Cutscene.EDA25CDC413FEB27EE351A9795323CAB: Wow. As I expected, Mayor. We’ve got a couple of blown fuses. Looks like a short caused by old wires.//This may take longer than I thought.

Kenny_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.4AAB700940FBC0E807D1F6ACF2EB90CF: In a way, rain is the beginning of all life.//<portrait=Daydreaming>After the rain, everything looks so fresh and new.
Kenny_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.C7E68AA1441D6531A7AE2EA3F63AC5DB: I’ve never had a cow run away from the barn like that.//<portrait=smile>She was probably confused. The rain can do that to animals.
Kenny_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.A351A1EB49EFF3AF91AB5392E88C5B42: Oh, neat! You seem to be enjoying the rain. I like it myself…
Kenny_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.95BF934C42C278A712B91586FAC543C1: Rainy, eh? I love the rain.
Kenny_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.A51D84614020D03BC78FEAB2D5AF17EF: What a day, huh? I was just passing by and saw you out here.

Kible.CantMoveAnchorMerfolkFestival: Can't move anchor during Merfolk festival.

Kira_Heart_2_Cutscene.2_dialogueText: Ah, it’s good. People want cows, I show them cows. People want animal feed, I sell them animal feed.
Kira_Heart_2_Cutscene.D8D07E33451F5F0DAB8CE7B5700F2102: Are you trying to be funny, farmer?
Kira_Heart_2_Cutscene.C7831E7447ADDB8481D673B1E100FCEF: Dear, where’d I put those extra horsehoes?
Kira_Heart_2_Cutscene.888ABFC74090CDC4E94899B499DB8FC5: Do you see anything in those bushes?
Kira_Heart_2_Cutscene.A8BE30414B58E69053F65999BA431325: Hey <PlayerName>$player</>! Just the person I've been looking for!
Kira_Heart_2_Cutscene.6091ADD14DF6F7D4C20CA59351B0C234: Hey there! Looks like I caught you just in time.
Kira_Heart_2_Cutscene.5_dialogueText: Hey, <PlayerName>$player</>, why are you just standing around? Come over here.
Kira_Heart_2_Cutscene.EDE3DBBC4D0F9587B4795DA75E7307E9: Hmm...you're right.//<portrait=Surprised>I blink, I lose it. And I’m not losing it, <PlayerName>$player</>.
Kira_Heart_2_Cutscene.CABD41D84B7C552FB68DF1BE5099B901: I blink, I lose it. And I’m not losing it, <PlayerName>$player</>.
Kira_Heart_2_Cutscene.261D65DD49F82EA9BCFABDB923EC082B: I have something on the stove.
Kira_Heart_2_Cutscene.BA9BECB943957E621A3A149022151D9C: I’m pretty sure there’s something in there. And whatever it is, it’s patient.//It hasn’t moved since I started watching it.
Kira_Heart_2_Cutscene.7D5E651B48C6CA08B81BA78C5855911B: Me? Oh, you know. The usual. Guarding the forest, making sure nothing dangerous threatens the town.
Kira_Heart_2_Cutscene.6E58737A42552A086DE54794F34E8BB2: Mm hmm. I can give you more of that, you know. If you want to take some home with you.
Kira_Heart_2_Cutscene.C75361754A4BB53A0664149F22461CA4: Mm hmm. So tell me, <NpcName>Kira</>, what’s been keeping you busy lately? I heard you’ve been spending a lot of time at home these days.
Kira_Heart_2_Cutscene.34A69DF24F314A492B4490AB367B1703: No, that’s how I make it. It’s fine.
Kira_Heart_2_Cutscene.E5734F524100C66CEF898AAC021269BC: Oh! Hah hah! That must be <NpcName>Jack</>.
Kira_Heart_2_Cutscene.0288F6C2403DAFA337C56BAFDA107B96: Oh, hey, <PlayerName>$player</>! Now’s not really a good time…
Kira_Heart_2_Cutscene.60F66CDE4F69A4023E2537B8079C0B84: Really, <PlayerName>$player</>. It’s great to see you and all, but I think you should really come back another time.
Kira_Heart_2_Cutscene.354DD8F0420913B291C43BB919C889E0: We saved a fortune, and <NpcName>Walter</> couldn’t even tell the difference! Isn’t that something?
Kira_Heart_2_Cutscene.77C5D4D74A5AB638CFB4DBA8BCA27C01: What? No. I’m sorry. I just…
Kira_Heart_2_Cutscene.7C834D1A45D2977B747ABE8F47D12542: Yes, it’s a wonderful thing you do for all of us.
Kira_Heart_2_Cutscene.3_dialogueText: You seem like you’ve had a full day.
Kira_Heart_2_Cutscene.C121541448DF8A1041422EA333B77128: You wouldn't believe if I told you...
Kira_Heart_2_Cutscene.AE552AC1486FB8BD218A51838DEA9A82: …and so we were actually using concord grapes the whole time, but <NpcName>Walter</> thought we’d ordered black muscat.

Leah_Heart_2_Cutscene.FE209DF0483DEF46C2840E9F7A0A54DA: <NpcName>Charles</>, would you stop moving?//It’s a bit hard to focus with your constant fidgeting.
Leah_Heart_2_Cutscene.312060D84995B2DEEB9C549EF6AA0117: Hey, you’re a farmer or something, right?//Do you think you can bring me some wildflowers?
Leah_Heart_2_Cutscene.B0833ABE45A21756861CEBA952138938: I’m trying to make a cape from dried flowers for my mom.
Leah_Heart_2_Cutscene.6135855340F3E26ED3317F965F843A58: Jacket? No. It’s more than that. It’s art.
Leah_Heart_2_Cutscene.587199C94F7F32E2D4CA7BA775288FBE: My mother is an art dealer, you see. She wears only the best of the best.//With her birthday coming up, I’d like to give her something special.//A cape made of dried flowers.
Leah_Heart_2_Cutscene.11B4462C461FD5487F7440BF7A5BEBDD: My mother used to live here on Coral Island. //Coral Island flowers would greatly add to her art collection.
Leah_Heart_2_Cutscene.5AA7A46A491B8F6A6F2143B11584B031: Oh great. Let me know when you have them. //If you’ll excuse me, I have somewhere else to be.//You may go.
Leah_Heart_2_Cutscene.BEB6947A4FC4B2BFACF0618C9149A50F: Okay, you’re done, <NpcName>Charles</>. You can relax now.
Leah_Heart_2_Cutscene.A68CA73A42BF531025EADF92F509383C: Phew! Finally.//Well, I have to go back to the clinic now. //<portrait=happy>Also, here are the flowers you asked for.
Leah_Heart_2_Cutscene.3A0F34304C145E93B1DC45AEDA630011: Precisely! You get it.//I’m so happy.
Leah_Heart_2_Cutscene.B1B228D34F46765201E55D81A1EEA2AD: There are a lot of flowers here.
Leah_Heart_2_Cutscene.FBD9C9384E592AE33211ED83357A21F8: We’re going to begin with the child’s pose…
Leah_Heart_2_Cutscene.3916774A450C44421316CB8823006C88: Yeah, but this will do for now.//Thanks, though. You can go now.
Leah_Heart_2_Cutscene.CAD9955242F3F09F588AF7B55B7F64FF: You think so? That’s nice to hear.//It’s art.

Library.Debug: Book Content is Empty, not supposed to happen. It's a bug

Lily_Heart_2_Cutscene.CE5641DD4926112A079ADB903D88D05A: <NpcName>Lils</>, you did your best. If you lost your job, so be it.//<portrait=normal>You’re smart. You’ll get another fancy job. You might even get to work on Poogle.
Lily_Heart_2_Cutscene.7FD9C73748A6B284D0D1E3AE192F5E57: Daddy…//I’m not okay. C...can we talk?//I’m ready to talk now.
Lily_Heart_2_Cutscene.4C816D7148ABE7EA44EF9C8A24439237: Hey, Dad, have you seen that old lure with the—
Lily_Heart_2_Cutscene.8D0BB12941CBAAD7562FBBAED7282FAB: I don’t want chores, <NpcName>Lils</>.//<portrait=annoyed> To hell with the fridge.
Lily_Heart_2_Cutscene.0140518D4B39E587AF9BD69D9336049F: I want you to talk to me when you have a problem.//I’m your dad.//We’re family.
Lily_Heart_2_Cutscene.674265E7458B0D0AD77D48965C5DDC58: It’s nothing. My chores are done, and the fridge is stocked.//<portrait=annoyed>I don’t know what to tell you, Dad.//I’m fine.
Lily_Heart_2_Cutscene.A538D6CF413C88A8AC45EC9CB03CDE5A: I’m here to see my dad.//<portrait=sad>He and I gotta set some stuff straight.
Lily_Heart_2_Cutscene.CFA3C38648036EE6D52DB192B23E8126: I’ve been trying to get you to talk, and nothing…//<portrait=normal> I’m your dad, and I’m worried about seeing you like this.//Don’t shut me out, <NpcName>Lils</>.
Lily_Heart_2_Cutscene.9535C44F4ADF33FA3E3624B428287537: Let <NpcName>Lily</> have some time alone. She’ll talk when she’s ready.
Lily_Heart_2_Cutscene.7DDF2EE74FFC3CF793084A92FE02710A: No good can come from keeping your family in the dark, <NpcName>Lily</>. They might be able to help.
Lily_Heart_2_Cutscene.5309731A4C2113C748FFCF96D25EE63B: Nobody from here ever landed a job there.//You’d be the first.
Lily_Heart_2_Cutscene.DDB146054414D142FFC4ECB1D87FE407: Of course.//<portrait=concerned>Do you want to sit down?//Let me make you some tea real quick.
Lily_Heart_2_Cutscene.1EDD275048E01BE8F8687B9353E75376: Oh, hey, <NpcName>Lils</>! This is a nice surprise.//<portrait=concerned>Oh, what’s wrong? Is everything okay?
Lily_Heart_2_Cutscene.C46870014C00513D6DB85A8EAECC8390: Okay, that is it, <NpcName>Lily</>. I've had enough of this…
Lily_Heart_2_Cutscene.1CEA3F854EFF34C5785558BBE5CB67B6: Something is clearly bothering you…//Something or many things. I don’t know… And you’re silent.
Lily_Heart_2_Cutscene.126B16304F6A230311E5A08A474663C5: Sorry.//I know how much this job means to you. I shouldn’t have said that.
Lily_Heart_2_Cutscene.30B4EC514D908FA9BFAFC48044BC98BF: What’s going on? For the past three days, I come home, and you’re just…//Staring at nothing.
Lily_Heart_2_Cutscene.4BC30BDB4175AB84B834F0A0BA764645: Yeah… I thought you got the waterproof kind.

Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.4_dialogueText: ...what was it, hun? Must've been my birthday, I think? 'cause it was a pretty cold evening.//<portrait=Concerned>I remember holding my coat like this...and there was a very fast person on a motorbike and just...bam!
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.13_dialogueText: Ah, apologies everyone. I forgot that I have to get going.
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.177A325E42759E195A40BBB53B2E1E7E: Back in Pokyo, I was something of a big shot. Did you know that?//Big-city lawyer, that was me. Contracts, collections, litigation.//People booked months in advance for five minutes of my time.
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.DC313EB64B19D419BCB56897FDCDC3C0: But out here? I guess we just don’t see as many people as we used to.
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.08760C32421F5D21BDD06FA3710B35FF: Come on, I know that sigh. Something’s got you worried.
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.655E802248347C52AA18589F06491188: Dear, we’re fine. Since when have either of us needed a life of luxury?
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.F1728F6A4E64FC1F3E65DDA0511B9000: Did I tell you we were thinking of planting a little grove of strawberries? //We’ve always wanted to experiment with different flavors but never had the space.
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.9021C03647BC5E25BE5BABA8DCB45F30: Ever since I got here, the mansion has been with me through everything. Becoming a wife, becoming a stepmother, founding the lab…//This place has been my sanctuary through all of it. I can’t let it be bulldozed.
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.A0AEBFFB46790C127E91DE8253541884: I don’t need luxury. It’s just…you should be able to get dessert, <NpcName>Randy</>, if you want to!
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.D9C21278498E0462EA9DDB84E90ED0E6: I don’t need to be rich. And my gut will thank me if I skip dessert every now and again, anyway. All I need, <NpcName>Ling</>, is you.
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.14_dialogueText: I have to make a call in 10 minutes, a pro bono for my friend...
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.D9A6B70D48AD86C4EDC777A9036770D4: I honestly don’t know. I mean, I’m no fool, <NpcName>Randy</>. I know money’s tight around here…
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.2517F7864932F90D788916BEAADA398A: If you decide you want to sell, that’s fine. If you decide you don’t want to sell, that’s fine too. I support you, whatever you want to do.
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.10_dialogueText: It's the fresh air, for me. I don't see a problem raising <NpcName>Luke</> in the city.//I was raised in a big city myself. I had my fun.
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.7862D93A4483138F85431DB7AD097F85: I’m disappointed, <NpcName>Ling</>, but I understand. Of course I understand.
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.217880EB4E0AF8F0E94D7C89FA64C230: I…I have to say, I’m disappointed.
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.85FD24044B2962335198CF9AA0D7B4A6: No. <NpcName>Bree</>, I can’t sell the house.
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.0AD7CACF4BBB7EC0477282B4636A3A13: Of course. <NpcName>Walter</> and I will figure out something else, that’s okay. This is a huge, life-changing decision for you. //I could never live with myself if I pushed you into something you weren’t comfortable with. Thank you for telling me.
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.9_dialogueText: Oh boy, the city can be wild sometimes. Part of why we moved here, actually. It's not a place to raise a family.
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.3_dialogueText: Oh wow! Yes. That was a scary moment. We were just done with dinner and on the way to the car...
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.78A3FE3848C4F2E321C639991FF36A91: Oh! And I didn’t tell you the best part!
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.17DE7C024F5EAC59CBA3F58FAD4A93D5: Oh, <PlayerName>$player</>. It’s you. Thanks for stopping by.//You’re one of the few people who do, it seems.
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.17_dialogueText: Oh, no! Please don't leave. Take your time, enjoy the meal. I'm sure <NpcName>Bree</>'s prepared an amazing dessert. Don't let me ruin the dinner.
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.15_dialogueText: Oh, sure! It's late. We should probably—
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.F7EBA2A54C90ED6BA61B90B6774AD9D8: Oh. Right. You know, I remember sitting right there on my very first night in this place. //I was so young then, and so excited and overwhelmed to be spending my first night on Coral Island—
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.65EFABDE4F273F9808D3268236ED0402: Oh…no, I mean, my spare arm. I must have packed it. Start checking boxes!
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.7CBD52034DFD3727E3AF8088A0C5A474: Please don’t make this decision because of what you think I want. I’m fine. Truly, honestly, I’m fine.
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.FA1FA2B14B560B5F29DA389B88CD06B1: Sure. I…yes, I’m sure you’re eager to get started.
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.1_dialogueText: That is wild. That never happened to us, thankfully.
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.8_dialogueText: That was my fear too. But thankfully I wasn't harmed at all.
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.6C2BFEC4472F414F08C8E7B536FA4F97: That works out great! I love you too.
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.28C9635243A12F3E17D4369C488FC4FA: That’s great. Here, take this lamp.
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.020974C443314DE4299DD8A04F7E629E: That’s unprecedented. And we owe it all to you!
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.6_dialogueText: The attempt failed. I was fine.
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.15EA7FEF473D3B39BC6F68836CF2321D: This is going to be so great, <NpcName>Ling</>. Thank you again so much for doing this! I can’t tell you how thrilled <NpcName>Walter</> and I are to start planting.
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.2B63843C4C8A867C174DE08CD1577808: Tomorrow morning? There’s still so much to pack up!
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.100CE806483C2DE36A71E0B3501A038F: We have dinner parties, of course. We’re not heathens.//I’ve seen you at them, right?
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.66430E82454EE20275F58486AFF8F976: We have preorders coming in from the mainland already, <NpcName>Ling</>.  We haven’t even made an official announcement yet!
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.C258723645ADFA0548E4729A1D1AE307: We scrape by. I know you’re not teaching for the money, but between your salary and the little I can squeeze out of the lab…
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.1E45DB8040275B54AC7461AF24FE6773: Well, I do. And here’s a chance for me to actually do something about it, and who knows if this chance is going to come around again?
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.2_dialogueText: Well, there's that one time when your purse almost got snatched in Pokyo, remember?
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.DA621568437A72984A2F5884511754D3: Well, try to imagine the place being bulldozed first.
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.5052FB4A4794C134AD0B49A56376C093: What time are the movers coming again?
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.61255A3F4216C221F3E639BE5929845C: What, find his arm? I’m sure it’ll turn up, won’t it?
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.4FF8F1CA4970D468CA9530B84FC46850: Why don’t you go take care of that? We’ll talk later.
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.DCC18B894EB83AC9270149AEFA608C62: Yes, it’s a stressful time for all of us. But also exciting!
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.8373887B41E8E2769DE3148E41043938: You have no idea!//<NpcName>Walter</> and I were up all night with our notebooks, sketching, planning, laying out the perfect vineyard on paper before we plant the first seed. //We were giggling like kids; we couldn’t help ourselves. I’m operating on no sleep. None.
Ling_Heart_2_Cutscene.1405F7C74D8EA359CB7681BA45279FF5: You know, that lamp was the first thing I bought for myself on Coral Island. It’s been with me for…wow, for years now. I never realized.

Luke_Heart_2_Cutscene.7_dialogueText: <NpcName>Taco</> loves going on adventures. But he usually goes home at the end of the day.
Luke_Heart_2_Cutscene.2_dialogueText: Ah, yes. That is, I am... Always, in fact.
Luke_Heart_2_Cutscene.12_dialogueText: Anyway, I should probably leave. Take care.
Luke_Heart_2_Cutscene.8_dialogueText: He's a mountain dog... Came from up there, actually. Just followed <NpcName>Suki</> and sort of lives down here now.
Luke_Heart_2_Cutscene.4_dialogueText: I'd love to stay and talk, but I'm kind of in a panic...//My dog, <NpcName>Taco</>, is missing.
Luke_Heart_2_Cutscene.9_optionsChoice: It's only been a day, hopefully <NpcName>Taco</> is on a new adventure.
Luke_Heart_2_Cutscene.11_dialogueText: I’m just worried that he might get lost… Or maybe he went home, back to the mountain.//If he did, then I’d be glad. As long as he’s safe...
Luke_Heart_2_Cutscene.6_dialogueText: Oh, okay. Would you keep an eye out for him please?
Luke_Heart_2_Cutscene.D219955642CD4A5A289FC8BA4C49928D: You should check on <NpcName>Luke</> at the Vineyard later.
Luke_Heart_2_Cutscene.3_dialogueText: You're always so honest, <PlayerName>$player</>. I'm a little sleepy too, I suppose.

Luke_Heart_2b_Cutscene.4_optionsChoice: Don't give up yet. I'm sure <NpcName>Taco</> lost track of time... Playing too much. Maybe he found a new friend. He'll be home soon!
Luke_Heart_2b_Cutscene.3_dialogueText: I think he really did go home.
Luke_Heart_2b_Cutscene.5_optionsChoice: I would give it a week before getting all sappy.
Luke_Heart_2b_Cutscene.2_dialogueText: No luck so far... It's the longest time he has left the house.
Luke_Heart_2b_Cutscene.4_dialogueText: Yes, I think that makes sense. I shall not give up. Thank you...

Luke_Heart_2c_Cutscene.2_dialogueText: <NpcName>Taco</>, where have you been?//I thought you went back to the mountain.
Luke_Heart_2c_Cutscene.4_dialogueText: <PlayerName>$player</>, thank you for your help. I think I know why he came here to play.
Luke_Heart_2c_Cutscene.5_dialogueText: He lived over at the inn for a while. Maybe he just missed his ocean friends.//<portrait=happy>All good now. I should take him back and give him a proper bath.//Come over to the vineyard sometimes, will you? Let's hang out.

Macy_Heart_2_Cutscene.EF6B6BF14BC05D8F1B29C4B92AFFBF9A: Could you take another one of me over here? The lighting is better.
Macy_Heart_2_Cutscene.FBC32B514209987E44CFFB93CCA33DC6: I can help! Why don't you stand a bit further, so we can get a better picture of the lighthouse.
Macy_Heart_2_Cutscene.049AA40C414317F4D55A19A8A885FD8F: I'm not an expert on photography but I can help out a little.
Macy_Heart_2_Cutscene.40E2861645883CEF54B4779178FF57E8: If I don’t send her one soon...//...my mom will <Italic>literally</> come here and drag me home.
Macy_Heart_2_Cutscene.C85DD569454D746C62D249A1772F8481: This is where Macy Heart 10 will happen.
Macy_Heart_2_Cutscene.8C889D504638EA427321D09CDA141550: Were you trying to take a picture?
Macy_Heart_2_Cutscene.4624242A4B41374B55916BB2A94F48A7: You sure? Thank you. Yes, please.
Macy_Heart_2_Cutscene.13D3EA1240A41274C36B59B15C5CEC0F: You sure? Thank you. Yes, please. Please make sure to get the top of the building, okay?

Noah_Heart_1_Cutscene.1_dialogueText: <PlayerName>$player</>! Beautiful day at the lake, huh?
Noah_Heart_1_Cutscene.7_optionsChoice: Are you guys stretching the whole day?
Noah_Heart_1_Cutscene.8_dialogueText: I wish I could stay longer.//<portrait=normal>I have to pick up flour from <NpcName>Sam</>’s.
Noah_Heart_1_Cutscene.5_dialogueText: Mom and I are doing a little stretching. I have some free time today, so what the heck? I figured I’d bring her here.
Noah_Heart_1_Cutscene.0316DF6E4DD6E24D00B6D7A1F57B71F1: Mom, <NpcName>Frank</> needs to hire more people. I can’t be the only one running around for stuff for the Tavern. He’s too cheap for his own good sometimes.
Noah_Heart_1_Cutscene.3_dialogueText: Mom, this is <PlayerName>$player</>. You two have met, right? <PlayerName>$player</> is the new farmer at that lot.
Noah_Heart_1_Cutscene.6_dialogueText: That’s true. It isn’t fun doing it alone. Thankfully, <NpcName>Noah</> doesn’t mind keeping me company.
Noah_Heart_1_Cutscene.4_dialogueText: Yes, we’ve met.//<portrait=normal>How do you do, dear?

Pablo_Heart_2_Cutscene.3_dialogueText: <NpcName>Pablo</> and his brother worked hard to clear the sewers around town.//Thanks to them, we didn't have a bad flood.//<portrait=normal>This season's budget will also go into fixing the leaking roof of the Community Center.//Last on the agenda, the cemetery is showing a lot of moss, and let's face it...//I need volunteers.//Who is it going to be, folks?
Pablo_Heart_2_Cutscene.2_dialogueText: As you all know, heavy rain seemed to clog up our sewage.
Pablo_Heart_2_Cutscene.8_dialogueText: Look at you, dear.//<portrait=happy>So humble.//<portrait=normal>Now, you must not think that way. Instead, look at what you have given to the community...which is plenty.
Pablo_Heart_2_Cutscene.4_dialogueText: Oh great! Thank you.//<portrait=normal>Tomorrow at 10am then. Meeting adjourned!
Pablo_Heart_2_Cutscene.1_dialogueText: Thank you all for coming to today's town meeting.//Today's agenda is to set up the next round of cemetery cleaning.
Pablo_Heart_2_Cutscene.7_dialogueText: Thanks, Mr. Mayor! I'm just trying to contribute. I have nothing but time.//You have to forgive me for not giving more.
Pablo_Heart_2_Cutscene.6_dialogueText: This <Italic>man</> right here...always the first to volunteer.//What a fine young man!//Here you go, son. Have some of my fish soup. I made plenty.
Pablo_Heart_2_Cutscene.9_dialogueText: What a wise way to look at things.//It's always great to hear perspectives from successful people.

Paul_Heart_2_Cutscene.3_optionsChoice: Ah! Sorry! I thought you would've heard me walking here.
Paul_Heart_2_Cutscene.2_dialogueText: Have you been sneaking up on me? Hah hah...
Paul_Heart_2_Cutscene.3_dialogueText: No, it's okay. It's just so quiet in here. I guess, anything would've shocked me.
Paul_Heart_2_Cutscene.4_dialogueText: Okay, I thought you were <NpcName>Anne</>. I was supposed to go and get some fresh vegetables at Sam's, but I thought why not take them from here... Nature, right? It's much closer distance and let's face it, they all taste the same.

Rafael_Heart_2_Cutscene.5101E500492ACB9871F0E893ECBBC9EF: <PlayerName>$player</>, <PlayerName>$player</>, <PlayerName>$player</>!!! Come and join us. We need a model.
Rafael_Heart_2_Cutscene.0CC6D5B74D398A7CE3674F8FECE57A30: <PlayerName>$player</>, you need to keep still! I can't capture your heroic pose if you keep moving.
Rafael_Heart_2_Cutscene.F7AE0CC34C4B1B1E12862D85B2FFCBFB: Can I come over to the house after your work then?
Rafael_Heart_2_Cutscene.207A395448421088DFA99AA72941C168: Don’t worry about her, <NpcName>Rafael</>. She’ll understand.//You’re doing your best. Let me talk to her.
Rafael_Heart_2_Cutscene.16_dialogueText: Errr, that’s not exactly what you told me earlier.
Rafael_Heart_2_Cutscene.50D1762C4D65F423C29E04939B4A32C9: Hi there! These tacos smell amazing.
Rafael_Heart_2_Cutscene.1_dialogueText: Hold still. Don’t move too much, Uncle!//Give me a minute. It’s almost done!
Rafael_Heart_2_Cutscene.67E602C349BDC6C0EB3C45A54EEDCE27: I just... I wish I had more time.
Rafael_Heart_2_Cutscene.F6332F454B83F433F8233BA0A21EABA2: I know, right? I got the same recipe but it doesn’t taste nearly as good at home.
Rafael_Heart_2_Cutscene.11_dialogueText: I was going to take <NpcName>Valentina</> for some cake at Fishensips...only if you’re okay with it, though.//Umm, are you okay with it?//<portrait=normal>If not, we could just get something at the Beach Shack.
Rafael_Heart_2_Cutscene.337D51A44956AECBAD3893BD481FF5DB: I'm, well, really looking forward to having <NpcName>Valentina</> over.
Rafael_Heart_2_Cutscene.6_dialogueText: If that’s the case, I have to ask <NpcName>Suki</> first.
Rafael_Heart_2_Cutscene.324F211C4249B04474BD6A813CE323F2: It’ll be too late by then. It’s not a good idea tonight, <NpcName>Valentina</>.
Rafael_Heart_2_Cutscene.3_dialogueText: Let’s go and hang it somewhere after we get some food, okay?//You need to eat something.
Rafael_Heart_2_Cutscene.4_dialogueText: No! No, Uncle, I don't wanna.//<portrait=sad>I want cake from <NpcName>Frank</>.
Rafael_Heart_2_Cutscene.12_dialogueText: Oh, I see.//Yeah, that’s all right. Just don’t stay too late.//The place gets too loud at night.
Rafael_Heart_2_Cutscene.BAED840C41402B184C45B88EE44ECCC9: Oh, I wish we could! Next time, okay?
Rafael_Heart_2_Cutscene.B833C25F4A880292B5D197ADB5A07E5D: Oh… Sorry, <NpcName>Valentina</>, I can't today. I've got to work on the kiln with <NpcName>Pablo</> after this.
Rafael_Heart_2_Cutscene.15_dialogueText: See, Uncle? I told you she’d be okay.
Rafael_Heart_2_Cutscene.3E2685D3443ED69FF30E528CFBAE7B0F: Should we go to the Beach Shack?
Rafael_Heart_2_Cutscene.9_dialogueText: Slow?//Slow what?//One of you better start talking soon.
Rafael_Heart_2_Cutscene.A9F417B14CB839898558FB80FB7B4F84: Uncle <NpcName>Rafael</> will give you all his money later.
Rafael_Heart_2_Cutscene.90D721F143E7455BB3A3E88C6E1A5D66: Uncle, uncle! Do you want to go fishing later?
Rafael_Heart_2_Cutscene.DD3CEDBD4948CF422C0F6CAC83F2E9C1: You never knew holding a pose could be such a workout!
Rafael_Heart_2_Cutscene.405E21D54AE4A9EC97DDD7BB0D1EAE27: You think so? I hope it will cheer her up.

Sam_Heart_2_Cutscene.D0D31EDC41754CD1AD00B1B491943B27: ...and then he said, where's the other sock?
Sam_Heart_2_Cutscene.212198334D681ED6EB342DACF8D13025: ...and then he said, where's the other sock?!
Sam_Heart_2_Cutscene.6833FF7641AD4C92F25D93A9D406BAF7: I don't even think the punchline was a punchline at all.//There is no sense of "punch" there.
Sam_Heart_2_Cutscene.6082690A4590D84E120722B159ED82EC: I'm sorry <NpcName>Ben</>. I don't think it was funny.
Sam_Heart_2_Cutscene.1EB643234DCE6D37EA778DB102A657C9: No... No, thank you. Please, I have a store to run.
Sam_Heart_2_Cutscene.389F42544A304D043A011AA9AD881AD6: Whaaat? What do you mean? Punchline was totally there.//You wanna hear it again? I don't think you got the joke.

Scott_Heart_2_Cutscene.4BA9A21444084C4F1938638493B5E26A: Have you tried asking <NpcName>Lily</> for help?
Scott_Heart_2_Cutscene.1F94825240EF7355DFE690B71FD1346B: Um, are you allowed to do that?
Scott_Heart_2_Cutscene.22F1E3304EDEE2A70214559D31633C8C: At that time, the island was dead.//<portrait=annoyed>For some reason, the creeks were dry, and there were no fish in the ocean. Odd things like that.
Scott_Heart_2_Cutscene.3E8823624EFE2A5FFAA4E79B7D89E2CD: At that time, the island was dead.//<portrait=annoyed>For some reason, the creeks were dry, and there were no fish in the ocean. Odd things like that.
Scott_Heart_2_Cutscene.1B0859DC45549D546DCFA591CE1174BC: Awesome! I think we’ll be good friends in no time!//<portrait=default>Come and join me at the Tavern sometime. Some of my friends like to hang out there too.//Fishensips is the Tavern. They changed the name a while ago, I think. Some of the locals still call it the Tavern.
Scott_Heart_2_Cutscene.F3F35A8742C2F5A25EA9539A6CA50F1E: Awesome! I think we’ll be good friends in no time!//<portrait=default>Come and join me at the Tavern sometime. Some of my friends like to hang out there too.//Fishensips is the Tavern. They changed the name a while ago, I think. Some of the locals still call it the Tavern.
Scott_Heart_2_Cutscene.D1D813C44060D41D903424869EB22CE8: Eyes on the goal, <PlayerName>$player</>. Let's go.
Scott_Heart_2_Cutscene.40266A1B4CBB3DD7A184E599CF9535C7: Eyes on the goal, <PlayerName>$player</>. Let’s go.
Scott_Heart_2_Cutscene.01E0919443AE50253B5A24833CABF2D2: Ha! So we better fix it soon.

Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.CAE7B64A4642A250165083A787CF1040: I collected some rocks around the farm yesterday morning.//I thought they'd be a nice gift for <NpcName>Archie</>.
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.EE456D724082070BA249F5B78A9DC620: I didn’t mean to eavesdrop. Is everything okay?
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.6E5F1AE64BB1B5D8C4B200BBC5F45630: I don’t think my education prepared me for this…
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.8DD5354946F9FDFDA7F4F4A12A151A99: I got it all boxed up.//Can we go to Uncle <NpcName>Joko</>'s house later tonight? Say, meet me there at 6?//Maybe we can have dinner with them too.//<portrait=happy>Goddess knows they've been asking about it. Hah hah hah.
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.B6ED948D4AB02F293B8CD1BAA375D2FE: I just didn’t take into account how much family means to my aunt and uncle.//<portrait=surprised>They think I’m abandoning them.
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.1F0465B04B0C0874AD3B80B030557259: I know!//<portrait=concerned>To them, it’s like the same thing.
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.85F92BBE446087598883E1AED9E68D41: I know!//You finally found out what those sores on your bottom are.
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.CBEE5DFD4A6E134484CDF896D4BF2A22: I'd almost think you were dying and not moving.
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.767431BD400277B5FF60EAA2688924A0: I'm married to the most beautiful farmer in the world.
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.84CEF4084C25453D84012398B0AFC1F8: It's not uncommon. Many people feel the same way.
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.E591758F4E1390D31083679887877F3D: It's not uncommon. Many people feel the same way.
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.B8F21767491F83D66EC1FDA78CDFB46D: It’s just pressure sores, I bet.//All that time sitting…
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.E63719294B0C975829051E86CCF2EBFF: It…it has a great view of the forest, and you should see the place at sunrise. Just gorgeous.//<portrait=default> The way the light streams through the trees…
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.EF49670C46A5080575D1D9B09EBA8F02: I’ve never seen you so happy.
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.BA895B8349BEBAF7023C85A4AC7F7EC6: Just tinker with it a little bit.//<portrait=concerned>Which part? Er…the back part of it.//<portrait=normal>You’re a scientist, you’ll figure it out.//Thanks, <NpcName>Surya</>. If you need me, I’ll be at the garden outside.
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.7163E3BB4B8EB97C526A239812D3CFA9: No, it’s nothing like that.//<portrait=happy>I finally found an apartment!//<portrait=normal>I’m moving out!
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.9F7036A84DFB1A3A2AF28F8D6CC98586: Not scared... Mortified!//That's why I have to be extra careful when I do woodworking.
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.CFC4DDBA4C5428A5B3454F93DA9AB4A3: OUCH! AAH! My finger! I'm gonna dieeeeeeee! Oh nooooooooo!
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.6B2BC3454B498AAC905CAA97BA2EA0ED: Of course not.//<portrait=default>It must be the lab, right?
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.089A9B834434D41F0B564194474CF1B1: Of course, I’m incredibly grateful for all the kindness they’ve shown me.
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.6800F12246DEF0F4FA951A8287ECA4E4: Oh, hey! You surprised me!//<portrait=normal>What’s up?
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.65B309A5451AC0982AEFF19D9492766B: Oh, you heard, huh?//<portrait=normal>Yeah yeah. Nothing important.
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.D34E953A4F89DEE3CFC38AA1760E3765: Okay, bye-bye now. I've got a playdate!
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.6B482E784646C209EA2606A95DC96922: Okay, kid. Don't come home too late.
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.7AB8BB51490D8ABE367D59B461BC2907: Okay…//<portrait=normal>I have big news for you guys.
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.82F21AAD43545E06B905928CDF0C1F67: Oops! That's <NpcName>Ling</>.//<portrait=blushing>I guess we should continue this at home...
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.A851DF6748A6FB5401FDAF9654FC153D: Oops… Sorry about that.//<portrait=sad>Are you okay?
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.CCEAF2974314155472765CB0A5B64DE5: Oops… Sorry about that.//<portrait=sad>Are you okay?
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.5DDD9A4742C8E2E2F072F686EFD7803C: Phew! Good thing we didn't break anything. Hah hah hah!
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.099900B3422A74758071528EFA504391: Right here is the kitchen, and there’s a shower around the back.
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.83D7A6D74BDA47FACA838995795CF183: See how spacious this place is? It’s amazing, isn’t it?
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.2DF0B38F41A7C4A9222917B587C6BBB5: Seriously?//<portrait=annoyed>Ahem. Well, this is no time for a joke.
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.3743F48F418FBF3046FBEF9DA345A2C0: So, you're a carpenter, uncle... But you're scared of blood?//<portrait=normal>Your line of work seems a bit...dangerous, no?
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.5CB05BA04D5A12C489652F8880F30216: Take your uncle to the table, will you?//I'll have the food ready soon.
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.67B635F04EAC14ADDD33E69ABF3AFF02: Thank you, <PlayerName>$player</>.//<portrait=happy>Well, now that it's fixed, let’s chill.//What did you say you wanted to drink earlier? Sit down and I'll grab some snacks!
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.508CC983482D0145254020905B3D19EE: Thank you, darling!//I just can't stand the sight of blood.//<portrait=annoyed>Makes me nauseous.
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.EDDE5ECA469566B12E5AAFBAFF71EEFA: The place is a steal! I could not ask for more.
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.84A4453A41F196BE9468D4AE2C4728E3: Unless you’re that desperate to move away from your family?
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.1F0485C94527B3148469718D4715E124: Wait. What do you mean, “of course not”?
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.A8F94954468438DA247126AA760757AE: We are sitting, boyo.//<portrait=happy>Why don’t you calm yourself down.
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.1687FE1F41A2E60812E65ABA75B92AB4: Who has done so much for you…
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.481DB27442C90D44E1C5CFA954364A25: Whoa!//<portrait=annoyed>This is worse than I thought.//This is a health hazard... Don’t you think?
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.091CA34449952679594DA9BF29248D67: Yes yes, I’m sure it’s very picturesque.//<portrait=annoyed>From the OUTSIDE.
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.83CD30214DD3712CCBC2E6AFCCAC69AF: Yes! <Italic>Health hazard indeed</>. Yeah, whoa. That was dangerous.
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.985B1BFB4909284DBB7557AA49B10923: Yes!//<portrait=annoyed> Will <NpcName>Jack</> be replacing that with something more appealing?
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.9D4ED816441011ECB02623B7376B6AEE: Yes, in a week!//<portrait=default>It’s this great place over by the ranch.//<NpcName>Jack</> has extra space, and he—
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.EDFE599F46624878EDD417BAFFA52CCA: You know we go to family dinners together?//<portrait=concerned>Parties too. We have game nights, movie nights…
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.B4CC767D4936BCEA1F840C83D43D268A: You mean the side of the building?
Surya_Heart_2_Cutscene_-_Format.17DAAA764F0D70FADA531DAEE790B8EB: You were there when I told my aunt and uncle I was going to move out.

Valentina_Heart_2_Cutscene.3_dialogueText: <NpcName>Val</>, what’s going on? Your uncle told me that you’ve been stopping by on the way to school and giving him your boxed lunch.
Valentina_Heart_2_Cutscene.B1C808044E16DF1CA8F1848E7B5A5B1B: <NpcName>Val</>, what’s going on? Your uncle told me that you’ve been stopping by on the way to school and giving him your boxed lunch.
Valentina_Heart_2_Cutscene.04E68D624FEA79423F2FCEA124D39E61: All right, I will cook new things for us to try, okay sweetheart..//That way we can try them out together and make a list of what you like and dislike..
Valentina_Heart_2_Cutscene.11_dialogueText: Alright, I will cook new things for us to try, okay sweetheart..// That way we can try them out together and make a list of what you like and dislike..
Valentina_Heart_2_Cutscene.14_dialogueText: And thank you for being very considerate about my feelings sweetheart. It's very thoughtful.
Valentina_Heart_2_Cutscene.895343F1496E66F7849A3B85686F2581: And thank you for being very considerate about my feelings sweetheart. It's very thoughtful.
Valentina_Heart_2_Cutscene.2D8BFD334CB036F9722FDBA74F713C69: Do you think you can help me with this?
Valentina_Heart_2_Cutscene.C428B796426549051B0224BAFEE21206: I'm collecting some seashells for a science project at school and I need help carrying some of them in...
Valentina_Heart_2_Cutscene.5866BB7742B547AB4CB6199AC6F93615: I'm collecting some seashells for a science project at school//Do you think you can help me with this?
Valentina_Heart_2_Cutscene.A12F8542492A5A4B6297BAA9F28BE1F1: Incredible. The moment we won… It was like my feet weren’t even on the ground. I was flying. Now I have to wonder, can anything ever top that feeling?
Valentina_Heart_2_Cutscene.06A6675F42A36113C0B7E0A73DC0DFB8: It doesn't sound like you at all..
Valentina_Heart_2_Cutscene.4_dialogueText: It doesn't sound like you at all..
Valentina_Heart_2_Cutscene.B87EE6EC492525F64B2A8F88765D98CD: It turned out that she was a scouter from the Pokyo Tournament. We got the wild card to join in!
Valentina_Heart_2_Cutscene.30491B71433AED3F61257D9EBC1C4FB9: It's not a bad idea to shuffle some options. There are many healthy snacks out there.
Valentina_Heart_2_Cutscene.9_optionsChoice: It's not a bad idea to shuffle some options. There are many healthy snacks out there.
Valentina_Heart_2_Cutscene.733A6E384F0A6DCE376C73AA738A9C45: It’s down to these two teams.
Valentina_Heart_2_Cutscene.80C3FC594F225F9539CCE3A70CC1F9DC: Look at all the people who turned out to watch us. Isn’t it great?
Valentina_Heart_2_Cutscene.0E2216B0414740A4B311B8A80CCA83D9: Me too. Let me guard you.
Valentina_Heart_2_Cutscene.5_dialogueText: Mom, no.. ugh... It's just... //It's just that you keep making edamame lately. //I'm bored of it, but I don't wanna hurt your feelings, so I've been giving them away to <NpcName>Uncle Rafael</>.
Valentina_Heart_2_Cutscene.B1B4A36943244A4E716AB199F96ED651: My thought exactly! Wouldn’t they want to be fast?
Valentina_Heart_2_Cutscene.C6A43275491261F53A64E08D9776777C: Now it's Uncle <NpcName>Rafael</> against the two of us. I don't think it's very fair.// Heh heh heh.
Valentina_Heart_2_Cutscene.3D5B0D5648DCA22CD74DE4BB7ABFF7A5: Now its <NpcName>Uncle Rafael</> against the 2 of us. I dont think its very fair.// Heh heh heh
Valentina_Heart_2_Cutscene.ADD8DD084BC76AD3E98089BE91EE351F: Okay <PlayerName>$player</>, you're front. I have the back covered!
Valentina_Heart_2_Cutscene.C62DCF9C4ED9262438555A995EC25AAE: Okay <PlayerName>$player</>?, youre front. I have the back covered!!
Valentina_Heart_2_Cutscene.A79C8FCD406F149860B49E8E406A8296: Sometimes we need to eat something that we don't like to keep a balanced diet.
Valentina_Heart_2_Cutscene.8_optionsChoice: Sometimes we need to eat something that we dont like to keep a balanced diet.
Valentina_Heart_2_Cutscene.1CF5CA6C41D5B9D0647A088CC0BDFFE2: The Coral Reefs are in the playoffs, baby!//<portrait=Happy>Gah! Feels so good.
Valentina_Heart_2_Cutscene.88BB27EC47E5D3C3EE9E8EA3CD3CFDCB: The Coral Reefs lost the playoff game.
Valentina_Heart_2_Cutscene.D3A1A44B430FDCFED3B90BA70ED30831: We might not be in the big stadium in Pokyo, but at least this way everyone who cares about us can cheer us on.
Valentina_Heart_2_Cutscene.367EA4034A50236B0188FC80326D2F37: We’re happy all right but dang, I would lie if I told you I wasn’t nervous.
Valentina_Heart_2_Cutscene.AFDCA50C454200F6C655FF95E4641462: With one condition okay, honesty is the best policy so you need to tell me if you don't like something. So we can change the menu for your lunch box right away.

Valentina_Heart_2_Cutscene.EB7FFE3B42A653C72812368C45725082: Wow! Look at all these seashells.
Valentina_Heart_2_Cutscene.67C1630B4BAB41C652EC789024704E3B: Yeah, I guess you’re right. It’s really not a bad idea.
Valentina_Heart_2_Cutscene.9_dialogueText: Yeah, I guess you’re right. It’s really not a bad idea.
